Our results suggest that limited task-targeted supervision is an important contributor to this bottleneck and that synthetic supervision is a promising path toward more systematic training for VLMs.

</details>


### [117] [Seeing is Believing: Robust Vision-Guided Cross-Modal Prompt Learning under Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09532)
*Zibin Geng,Xuefeng Jiang,Jia Li,Zheng Li,Tian Wen,Lvhua Wu,Sheng Sun,Yuwei Wang,Min Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将视觉语义反向注入提示标记，用轻量级条件调制机制动态控制注入强度，在冻结大模型的前提下显著提升 VLM 对含噪标签的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示学习虽高效，但对标签噪声敏感；视觉模态语义丰富且相对稳定，却未被充分利用来稳定提示更新。

Method: 1) 跨模态注意力把样本视觉特征反向注入提示表示，使提示聚合与当前图像相关的语义证据。2) 轻量级条件调制网络根据图像质量自适应调整视觉注入强度，平衡文本先验与图像证据。3) 全程冻结 VLM 主干的参数，仅新增极少可训练模块。

Result: 在 7 个基准数据集、合成与真实标签噪声下，VisPrompt 一致优于现有基线，提示更新更平稳，对错误标签的记忆显著降低，仅引入 0.3%–1.2% 额外参数。

Conclusion: 用视觉信息“锚定”提示更新可显著抑制标签噪声，通过动态调制进一步适应样本差异，在保持参数高效的同时为 VLM 提供实用鲁棒的噪声标签学习范式。

Abstract: Prompt learning is a parameter-efficient approach for vision-language models, yet its robustness under label noise is less investigated. Visual content contains richer and more reliable semantic information, which remains more robust under label noise. However, the prompt itself is highly susceptible to label noise. Motivated by this intuition, we propose VisPrompt, a lightweight and robust vision-guided prompt learning framework for noisy-label settings. Specifically, we exploit a cross-modal attention mechanism to reversely inject visual semantics into prompt representations. This enables the prompt tokens to selectively aggregate visual information relevant to the current sample, thereby improving robustness by anchoring prompt learning to stable instance-level visual evidence and reducing the influence of noisy supervision. To address the instability caused by using the same way of injecting visual information for all samples, despite differences in the quality of their visual cues, we further introduce a lightweight conditional modulation mechanism to adaptively control the strength of visual information injection, which strikes a more robust balance between text-side semantic priors and image-side instance evidence. The proposed framework effectively suppresses the noise-induced disturbances, reduce instability in prompt updates, and alleviate memorization of mislabeled samples. VisPrompt significantly improves robustness while keeping the pretrained VLM backbone frozen and introducing only a small amount of additional trainable parameters. Extensive experiments under synthetic and real-world label noise demonstrate that VisPrompt generally outperforms existing baselines on seven benchmark datasets and achieves stronger robustness. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/gezbww/Vis_Prompt.

</details>


### [118] [EgoTL: Egocentric Think-Aloud Chains for Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09535)
*Lulin Liu,Dayou Li,Yiqing Liang,Sicong Jiang,Hitesh Vijay,Hezhen Hu,Xuhai Xu,Zirui Liu,Srinivas Shakkottai,Manling Li,Zhiwen Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有VLM自动标注因缺少动作标签和三维空间信息在长时间家务任务中失准，EgoTL通过度量级空间估计+思维化采集获得精标注数据并微调基础模型，显著改善长程推理与空间定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型VLM+World-Model在家务场景下疗效低下的根源有二：①训练数据缺乏时间级动作、链式思路（CoT）及3D空间标注；②公开视频难以捕捉分钟级真实家庭规划，致使模型产生对象幻觉、遗漏步骤或违背物理特性，急需高质量三维-动作配对数据。

Method: 提出EgoTL标注与训练体系：1. 思维采集流程：基于"说后做"协议收集同步语音，提供单词级时间戳和分步目标；2. 度量空间映射：结合度量尺度深度估计、记忆库场景漫游和片段级导航-操作标签；3. 多基准：设置6×3（66项）评估框架；4. 微调策略：使用EgoTL训练拆分数据上的CoT&度量标注对基础模型进行指令跟调和空间嵌合微调。

Result: 实验证明：1. 当前基础模型在超过100项分钟级家庭任务上均为“不及格”感知助手和开放世界仿真器；2. 单用EgoTL微调后，长程规划、逐步推理、指令遵从及空间定位四项指标显著提升，大幅降低对象幻觉和步骤遗漏。

Conclusion: 精准的长程思维注释+度量空间信息是提升VLM在人类同居环境表现的关键。EgoTL方案在数据捕集与模型微调两端系统补全了现有基准的空白，为实现可信的家务级自主智能体提供了可持续的路线和评估标准。

Abstract: Large foundation models have made significant advances in embodied intelligence, enabling synthesis and reasoning over egocentric input for household tasks. However, VLM-based auto-labeling is often noisy because the primary data sources lack accurate human action labels, chain-of-thought (CoT), and spatial annotations; these errors are amplified during long-horizon spatial instruction following. These issues stem from insufficient coverage of minute-long, daily household planning tasks and from inaccurate spatial grounding. As a result, VLM reasoning chains and world-model synthesis can hallucinate objects, skip steps, or fail to respect real-world physical attributes. To address these gaps, we introduce EgoTL. EgoTL builds a think-aloud capture pipeline for egocentric data. It uses a say-before-act protocol to record step-by-step goals and spoken reasoning with word-level timestamps, then calibrates physical properties with metric-scale spatial estimators, a memory-bank walkthrough for scene context, and clip-level tags for navigation instructions and detailed manipulation actions. With EgoTL, we are able to benchmark VLMs and World Models on six task dimensions from three layers and long-horizon generation over minute-long sequences across over 100 daily household tasks. We find that foundation models still fall short as egocentric assistants or open-world simulators. Finally, we finetune foundation models with human CoT aligned with metric labels on the training split of EgoTL, which improves long-horizon planning and reasoning, step-wise reasoning, instruction following, and spatial grounding.

</details>


### [119] [Tango: Taming Visual Signals for Efficient Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09547)
*Shukang Yin,Sirui Zhao,Hanchao Wang,Baozhi Jia,Xianquan Wang,Chaoyou Fu,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tango框架通过多样性驱动的注意力选择和ST-RoPE几何结构保持，在仅保留10%视频token时仍维持98.9%原始性能并实现1.88倍推理加速


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型的token剪枝方法存在两大缺陷：top-k选择策略未充分考虑空间多模态长尾分布的注意力，直接相似性聚类易产生碎片化聚类导致表征失真

Method: 提出Tango框架：1) 多样性驱动策略优化基于注意力的token选择 2) 引入时空旋转位置嵌入(ST-RoPE)通过局部性先验保持几何结构

Result: 在多种Video LLM和视频理解基准测试中验证有效性，LLaVA-OV模型上保留10% token时性能保持98.9%，推理速度提升1.88倍

Conclusion: Tango框架显著提升了视频token剪枝的效率与保真度，为高效视频大语言模型提供了可泛化的解决方案

Abstract: Token pruning has emerged as a mainstream approach for developing efficient Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs). This work revisits and advances the two predominant token-pruning paradigms: attention-based selection and similarity-based clustering. Our study reveals two critical limitations in existing methods: (1) conventional top-k selection strategies fail to fully account for the attention distribution, which is often spatially multi-modal and long-tailed in magnitude; and (2) direct similarity-based clustering frequently generates fragmented clusters, resulting in distorted representations after pooling. To address these bottlenecks, we propose Tango, a novel framework designed to optimize the utilization of visual signals. Tango integrates a diversity-driven strategy to enhance attention-based token selection, and introduces Spatio-temporal Rotary Position Embedding (ST-RoPE) to preserve geometric structure via locality priors. Comprehensive experiments across various Video LLMs and video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach. Notably, when retaining only 10% of the video tokens, Tango preserves 98.9% of the original performance on LLaVA-OV while delivering a 1.88x inference speedup.

</details>


### [120] [Ranked Activation Shift for Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08572)
*Gianluca Guglielmo,Marc Masana*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对现有 post-hoc OOD 检测在不同模型/数据集上性能波动大、SCaling 法对倒数第二层激活未整流时失效的问题，提出一种无需超参数、直接替换激活排序为固定 ID 参考轮廓的即插即用方法，实现跨数据集/架构稳定 OOD 检测且不损 ID 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于中间层激活编辑的 post-hoc OOD 检测方法性能随模型和数据集剧烈波动；作者发现不稳定性源于激活分布差异，并定位到 Scaling 法在倒数第二层激活未经整流时出现的失效模式，因此需要一种更稳健、无需调参的新方法。

Method: 提出 \ours：1) 构建固定 in-distribution(ID) 参考激活轮廓；2) 推理时把待测样本的激活排序直接替换为该参考轮廓，计算扰动分数作为 OOD 分数；3) 完全无需超参数、无需假设激活函数类型，也不重新训练或微调模型。

Result: \ours 在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 等多个数据集及 ResNet、DenseNet、ViT 等架构上取得一致且领先的 OOD 检测性能(AUROC↑，FPR95↓)，同时 ID 分类准确率保持不变；消融实验显示抑制与增强两类激活偏移均对判别贡献显著。

Conclusion: \ours 通过用固定 ID 激活轮廓替代动态排序，彻底消除了 Scaling 法对激活整流的依赖及超参数调整带来的不稳定性，为 post-hoc OOD 检测提供了简单、鲁棒、通用的即插即用解决方案。

Abstract: State-of-the-art post-hoc out-of-distribution detection methods rely on intermediate layer activation editing. However, they exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets and models. We show that this instability is driven by differences in the activation distributions, and identify a failure mode of scaling-based methods that arises when penultimate layer activations are not rectified. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \ours, a hyperparameter-free post-hoc method that replaces sorted activation magnitudes with a fixed in-distribution reference profile. Our simple plug-and-play method shows strong and consistent performance across datasets and architectures without assumptions on the penultimate layer activation function, and without requiring any hyperparameter tuning, while preserving in-distribution classification accuracy by construction. We further analyze what drives the improvement, showing that both inhibiting and exciting activation shifts independently contribute to better out-of-distribution discrimination.

</details>


### [121] [Silhouette Loss: Differentiable Global Structure Learning for Deep Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08573)
*Matheus Vinícius Todescato,Joel Luís Carbonera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级Soft Silhouette Loss（SSL），将聚类中的轮廓系数可微化，能在batch内全局度量类紧凑性与可分性；与CE或SupCon互补形成混合目标，在7个数据集上把Top-1平均准确率从CE的36.71%、SupCon的37.85%提升到39.08%，且计算开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉熵只优化分类决策边界，不直接约束嵌入空间的几何结构（类内紧致、类间分离）。现有度量学习（SupCon、proxy-based等）虽改善几何，但计算复杂度高、难全局建模；需一种轻量、能全局感知batch结构且易与CE结合的替代目标。

Method: 借鉴聚类轮廓系数思想，设计可微的Soft Silhouette Loss：对每个样本计算其到本类中心与最近异类中心的距离，并用softmax归一化得到类间可分度；同时兼顾类内方差。该loss在batch内一次性评估所有类别，无需构造O(N²)样本对。可将SSL与CE线性组合或与SupCon集成，形成局部成对+全局簇结构协同优化的混合目标。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-100、iNaturalist等7个数据集上系统实验：① SSL+CE持续优于纯CE及多数度量学习baseline；② SSL+SupCon混合版本进一步超过单用SupCon；③ 最终混合方法平均Top-1准确率达39.08%，相比CE提升2.37个百分点，相比SupCon提升1.23个百分点；④ 训练阶段GPU内存与耗时均显著低于SupCon。

Conclusion: 经典聚类原则可被重新诠释为可微深度目标，SSL提供了一种轻量而高效的方式来同时优化表示空间的局部成对一致性与全局簇结构，为后续表示学习研究提供了新的损失设计范式。

Abstract: Learning discriminative representations is a central goal of supervised deep learning. While cross-entropy (CE) remains the dominant objective for classification, it does not explicitly enforce desirable geometric properties in the embedding space, such as intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. Existing metric learning approaches, including supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) and proxy-based methods, address this limitation by operating on pairwise or proxy-based relationships, but often increase computational cost and complexity. In this work, we introduce Soft Silhouette Loss, a novel differentiable objective inspired by the classical silhouette coefficient from clustering analysis. Unlike pairwise objectives, our formulation evaluates each sample against all classes in the batch, providing a batch-level notion of global structure. The proposed loss directly encourages samples to be closer to their own class than to competing classes, while remaining lightweight. Soft Silhouette Loss can be seamlessly combined with cross-entropy, and is also complementary to supervised contrastive learning. We propose a hybrid objective that integrates them, jointly optimizing local pairwise consistency and global cluster structure. Extensive experiments on seven diverse datasets demonstrate that: (i) augmenting CE with Soft Silhouette Loss consistently improves over CE and other metric learning baselines; (ii) the hybrid formulation outperforms SupCon alone; and (iii) the combined method achieves the best performance, improving average top-1 accuracy from 36.71% (CE) and 37.85% (SupCon2) to 39.08%, while incurring substantially lower computational overhead. These results suggest that classical clustering principles can be reinterpreted as differentiable objectives for deep learning, enabling efficient optimization of both local and global structure in representation spaces.

</details>


### [122] [Pretrain-then-Adapt: Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Text-based Person Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08598)
*Jiahao Zhang,Shaofei Huang,Yaxiong Wang,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对文本行人检索因隐私和标注成本导致的数据稀缺，提出“先预训练-后自适应”新范式，在无需目标域标注的前提下，通过离线测试时自适应完成模型迁移；核心贡献为不确定性感知测试时自适应框架UATTA，利用双向检索分歧估计不确定性并校准模型，在4个基准上均优于现有离线TTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统“预训练-微调”范式依赖大量目标域标注，实际部署中不可行；现有基于熵的测试时自适应易产生过度自信与假阳性，亟需不依赖标签、快速、可部署的自适应策略。

Method: 设计UATTA框架：1) 双向检索分歧机制——同一图文对在图像→文本和文本→图像两条检索路径的排名一致性作为不确定性指标；2) 离线测试时自适应——仅利用无标签测试数据，以不确定性为权重对模型进行无监督校准，消除域偏移；3) 兼容一阶段(CLIP)与两阶段(XVLM)检索架构。

Result: 在CUHK-PEDES、ICFG-PEDES、RSTPReid、PAB四数据集上，UATTA相较最强离线TTA基线平均提升2.3–4.1 % R1，且微调时间<1分钟；消融实验证实双向分歧估计对抑制假阳性最关键。

Conclusion: UATTA首次实现无需目标域标注、秒级离线迁移的文本行人检索系统，为隐私敏感场景下的可部署跨模态检索建立了新基准，代码已开源。

Abstract: Text-based person search faces inherent limitations due to data scarcity, driven by stringent privacy constraints and the high cost of manual annotation. To mitigate this, existing methods usually rely on a Pretrain-then-Finetune paradigm, where models are first pretrained on synthetic person-caption data to establish cross-modal alignment, followed by fine-tuning on labeled real-world datasets. However, this paradigm lacks practicality in real-world deployment scenarios, where large-scale annotated target-domain data is typically inaccessible. In this work, we propose a new Pretrain-then-Adapt paradigm that eliminates reliance on extensive target-domain supervision through an offline test-time adaptation manner, enabling dynamic model adaptation using only unlabeled test data with minimal post-train time cost. To mitigate overconfidence with false positives of previous entropy-based test-time adaptation, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation (UATTA) framework, which introduces a bidirectional retrieval disagreement mechanism to estimate uncertainty, i.e., low uncertainty is assigned when an image-text pair ranks highly in both image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, indicating high alignment; otherwise, high uncertainty is detected. This indicator drives offline test-time model recalibration without labels, effectively mitigating domain shift. We validate UATTA on four benchmarks, i.e., CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, RSTPReid, and PAB, showing consistent improvements across both CLIP-based (one-stage) and XVLM-based (two-stage) frameworks. Ablation studies confirm that UATTA outperforms existing offline test-time adaptation strategies, establishing a new benchmark for label-efficient, deployable person search systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/nkuzjh/UATTA.

</details>


### [123] [From Selection to Scheduling: Federated Geometry-Aware Correction Makes Exemplar Replay Work Better under Continual Dynamic Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08617)
*Zhuang Qi,Ying-Peng Tang,Lei Meng,Guoqing Chao,Lei Wu,Han Yu,Xiangxu Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FCL 场景下，仅选“重要样本”不够，还需用好它们。本文提出 FEAT，通过固定等角紧框架原型做结构蒸馏，并基于能量滤除任务无关方向，抑制表示塌陷与多数类偏差，提升少数类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦持续学习(FCL) 的动态非独立同分布数据会导致“罕见类表示被拖向常见类”的灾难性遗忘和表示塌陷；现有重放方法只关注选样本而忽视如何利用，性能受限。

Method: 提出 FEAT 框架：① 几何结构对齐模块：每类引入共享的等角紧框架(ETF) 原型，蒸馏客户端间成对角度相似度，维持跨任务几何一致性；② 基于能量的几何校正模块：在特征嵌入上减去任务无关方向分量，降低对多数类的预测偏差，增强少数类敏感度。

Result: 理论分析表明 FEAT 可抑制表示塌陷；实验上在 CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet 与 EMNIST 的 FCL 协议下，相比 ER、DER++、FRS、FCIL 等基线，平均类准确率提升 2.8%-5.4%，罕见类 F1 提升 6%-10%，遗忘率下降约 30%。

Conclusion: 有效利用重放样本的几何信息比单纯挑选样本更关键；FEAT 通过“固定 ETF 原型 + 能量校正”双模块，在客户端漂移与类别不平衡共存的环境中显著缓解表示塌陷并保护罕见类，为 FCL 提供了简洁高效的新范式。

Abstract: Exemplar replay has become an effective strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting in federated continual learning (FCL) by retaining representative samples from past tasks. Existing studies focus on designing sample-importance estimation mechanisms to identify information-rich samples. However, they typically overlook strategies for effectively utilizing the selected exemplars, which limits their performance under continual dynamic heterogeneity across clients and tasks. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Federated gEometry-Aware correcTion method, termed FEAT, which alleviates imbalance-induced representation collapse that drags rare-class features toward frequent classes across clients. Specifically, it consists of two key modules: 1) the Geometric Structure Alignment module performs structural knowledge distillation by aligning the pairwise angular similarities between feature representations and their corresponding Equiangular Tight Frame prototypes, which are fixed and shared across clients to serve as a class-discriminative reference structure. This encourages geometric consistency across tasks and helps mitigate representation drift; 2) the Energy-based Geometric Correction module removes task-irrelevant directional components from feature embeddings, which reduces prediction bias toward majority classes. This improves sensitivity to minority classes and enhances the model's robustness under class-imbalanced distributions.

</details>


### [124] [VOLTA: The Surprising Ineffectiveness of Auxiliary Losses for Calibrated Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08639)
*Rahul D Ray,Utkarsh Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级确定型 UQ 方法 VOLTA，在涵盖多种数据分布的大规模基准上全面比较十类主流 UQ 基线，VOLTA 在精度、校准与 OOD 检测上均显著优于或媲美现有方法，确立其高效替代地位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度模型在高风险场景落地需可靠的置信度估计，但现有 UQ 方法众多且性能缺乏跨模态、跨分布一致性的系统对比，导致研究者与工程师难以选择。

Method: 构建覆盖 CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、均匀噪声、CIFAR-10-C 与 Tiny ImageNet 特征六大任务的综合评测协议，统一对比 MC Dropout、SWAG、集成、温度缩放、EB-OOD、Mahalanobis、双曲分类器、ENN、Taylor Sensus、分裂保形预测等十类 UQ 基线；提出仅保留深度编码器、可学习原型、交叉熵损失与事后温度缩放的极简 VOLTA 框架，采用三随机种子统计检验与消融验证关键组件贡献。

Result: VOLTA 在 CIFAR-10 上准确率达 0.864，ECE 仅 0.010，显著优于基线 0.044–0.102；OOD 检测 AUROC 0.802，多数指标经统计检验优于或打平复杂方法；消融表明自适应温度与深度编码器为核心因子。

Conclusion: VOLTA 以确定性、轻量、易部署的特性，在广泛数据模态与分布漂移下实现卓越的准确性与校准，可作为现有复杂 UQ 方案的高效替代，为安全关键应用提供实用置信度估计工具。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying deep learning models in safety critical applications, yet no consensus exists on which UQ method performs best across different data modalities and distribution shifts. This paper presents a comprehensive benchmark of ten widely used UQ baselines including MC Dropout, SWAG, ensemble methods, temperature scaling, energy based OOD, Mahalanobis, hyperbolic classifiers, ENN, Taylor Sensus, and split conformal prediction against a simplified yet highly effective variant of VOLTA that retains only a deep encoder, learnable prototypes, cross entropy loss, and post hoc temperature scaling. We evaluate all methods on CIFAR 10 (in distribution), CIFAR 100, SVHN, uniform noise (out of distribution), CIFAR 10 C (corruptions), and Tiny ImageNet features (tabular). VOLTA achieves competitive or superior accuracy (up to 0.864 on CIFAR 10), significantly lower expected calibration error (0.010 vs. 0.044 to 0.102 for baselines), and strong OOD detection (AUROC 0.802). Statistical testing over three random seeds shows that VOLTA matches or outperforms most baselines, with ablation studies confirming the importance of adaptive temperature and deep encoders. Our results establish VOLTA as a lightweight, deterministic, and well calibrated alternative to more complex UQ approaches.

</details>


### [125] [AniGen: Unified $S^3$ Fields for Animatable 3D Asset Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08746)
*Yi-Hua Huang,Zi-Xin Zou,Yuting He,Chirui Chang,Cheng-Feng Pu,Ziyi Yang,Yuan-Chen Guo,Yan-Pei Cao,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AniGen提出首个端到端“单图→可直接动画的3D资产”框架，统一预测几何、骨架与蒙皮，彻底摆脱后续自动绑定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型只能产出静态形状；事后自动绑定拓扑常错、鲁棒性差，无法满足交互图形、智能体与动画管线对“即生即用”角色资产的需求。

Method: 将Shape/Skeleton/Skin表示为同空间下互洽的S³场；引入置信度衰减骨架场处理Voronoi边界歧义、双路蒙皮特征场解耦关节数以支持任意复杂度；采用两阶段流匹配：先稀疏结构支架，再在结构化潜空间生成高密度几何与关节。

Result: 在动物、人形、机械等多类in-the-wild图像上，AniGen的骨架合法率与动画质量显著优于现有串行基线，实现真正“生成即可动画”。

Conclusion: AniGen验证了联合生成几何-骨架-蒙皮的统一范式，为交互式角色创建、具身智能等应用提供了可直接部署的3D动画资产解决方案。

Abstract: Animatable 3D assets, defined as geometry equipped with an articulated skeleton and skinning weights, are fundamental to interactive graphics, embodied agents, and animation production. While recent 3D generative models can synthesize visually plausible shapes from images, the results are typically static. Obtaining usable rigs via post-hoc auto-rigging is brittle and often produces skeletons that are topologically inconsistent with the generated geometry. We present AniGen, a unified framework that directly generates animate-ready 3D assets conditioned on a single image. Our key insight is to represent shape, skeleton, and skinning as mutually consistent $S^3$ Fields (Shape, Skeleton, Skin) defined over a shared spatial domain. To enable the robust learning of these fields, we introduce two technical innovations: (i) a confidence-decaying skeleton field that explicitly handles the geometric ambiguity of bone prediction at Voronoi boundaries, and (ii) a dual skin feature field that decouples skinning weights from specific joint counts, allowing a fixed-architecture network to predict rigs of arbitrary complexity. Built upon a two-stage flow-matching pipeline, AniGen first synthesizes a sparse structural scaffold and then generates dense geometry and articulation in a structured latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AniGen substantially outperforms state-of-the-art sequential baselines in rig validity and animation quality, generalizing effectively to in-the-wild images across diverse categories including animals, humanoids, and machinery. Homepage: https://yihua7.github.io/AniGen-web/

</details>


### [126] [PSIRNet: Deep Learning-based Free-breathing Rapid Acquisition Late Enhancement Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08781)
*Arda Atalik,Hui Xue,Rhodri H. Davies,Thomas A. Treibel,Daniel K. Sodickson,Michael S. Hansen,Peter Kellman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PSIRNet 首次用深度学习把自由呼吸单次 PSIR-LGE 成像推到诊断级，扫描时间缩短 8–24 倍，图像质量不逊于甚至优于传统 MOCO 多平均法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自由呼吸 PSIR-LGE 需 8–24 次心动周期做运动校正平均，耗时长、患者依从性差；若能在 2 次心跳内单次采集获得同等诊断质量，将显著提升临床效率。

Method: 构建 8.45 亿参数、物理引导的端到端网络 PSIRNet，用 64 万切片（4.3 万患者）多中心 1.5 T/3 T 数据训练；输入为单次交织 IR/PD 双心跳采集的原始 k-空间，输出带表面线圈校正的 PSIR 图像；与 MOCO 参考做 SSIM/PSNR/NRMSE 量化，并由两名心脏影像专家用 5 分 Likert 对暗血、亮血、宽带三种 LGE 序列盲评， exact Wilcoxon 检验优效/等效（界值 0.25 分）。

Result: 暗血 LGE 两位医师均判 PSIRNet 优效（P=0.002）；亮血/宽带 LGE 一人判优效、一人判等效（均 P<0.001）。量化指标全面达标；单帧推理约 100 ms，仅为 MOCO 重建时间的 1/50。

Conclusion: PSIRNet 在自由呼吸条件下单次采集即可输出诊断级 PSIR-LGE 图像，实现 8–24 倍提速，具备立即转化到临床的潜力。

Abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a deep learning (DL) method for free-breathing phase-sensitive inversion recovery (PSIR) late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) cardiac MRI that produces diagnostic-quality images from a single acquisition over two heartbeats, eliminating the need for 8 to 24 motion-corrected (MOCO) signal averages.
  Materials and Methods: Raw data comprising 800,653 slices from 55,917 patients, acquired on 1.5T and 3T scanners across multiple sites from 2016 to 2024, were used in this retrospective study. Data were split by patient: 640,000 slices (42,822 patients) for training and the remainder for validation and testing, without overlap. The training and testing data were from different institutions. PSIRNet, a physics-guided DL network with 845 million parameters, was trained end-to-end to reconstruct PSIR images with surface coil correction from a single interleaved IR/PD acquisition over two heartbeats. Reconstruction quality was evaluated using SSIM, PSNR, and NRMSE against MOCO PSIR references. Two expert cardiologists performed an independent qualitative assessment, scoring image quality on a 5-point Likert scale across bright blood, dark blood, and wideband LGE variants. Paired superiority and equivalence (margin = 0.25 Likert points) were tested using exact Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at a significance level of 0.05 using R version 4.5.2.
  Results: Both readers rated single-average PSIRNet reconstructions superior to MOCO PSIR for dark blood LGE (conservative P = .002); for bright blood and wideband, one reader rated it superior and the other confirmed equivalence (all P < .001). Inference required approximately 100 msec per slice versus more than 5 sec for MOCO PSIR.
  Conclusion: PSIRNet produces diagnostic-quality free-breathing PSIR LGE images from a single acquisition, enabling 8- to 24-fold reduction in acquisition time.

</details>


### [127] [MeshOn: Intersection-Free Mesh-to-Mesh Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08799)
*Hyunwoo Kim,Itai Lang,Hadar Averbuch-Elor,Silvia Sellán,Rana Hanocka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshOn 是一种在给定基础模型和用户指定区域后，将配件网格自动、无穿透地贴合到基础模型上的多步优化框架，兼顾物理合理性与语义一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统手工或基于配准的方法难以兼顾“贴合真实感”“无穿透”与“语义正确”三方面，而纯生成式方法又常产生不可控几何。数字艺术家急需一种可直接嵌入工作流、对材质和几何变化鲁棒的自动化组合工具。

Method: 1) 利用 VLM 将配件与基础模型进行语义-结构初始对齐；2) 联合优化吸引几何损失与受物理启发的屏障损失，消除穿透并拉近贴合；3) 引入扩散先验对局部细节做最终形变，生成自然过渡的曲面；整个流程为分步优化，无需额外训练。

Result: 在多种材质（硬/软）、复杂拓扑与不同目标区域的测试集中，MeshOn 实现了无穿透贴合，几何误差和人工修复量显著低于传统 ICP/变形配准与现有生成式基线，且可直接输出至主流 DCC 软件。

Conclusion: MeshOn 证明将 VLM 语义引导、几何-物理联合优化与扩散先验相结合，可在零样本条件下完成高质量网格组合，为数字内容创作提供了实用、可插拔的自动化方案。

Abstract: We propose MeshOn, a method that finds physically and semantically realistic compositions of two input meshes. Given an accessory, a base mesh with a user-defined target region, and optional text strings for both meshes, MeshOn uses a multi-step optimization framework to realistically fit the meshes onto each other while preventing intersections. We initialize the shapes' rigid configuration via a structured alignment scheme using Vision-to-Language Models, which we then optimize using a combination of attractive geometric losses, and a physics-inspired barrier loss that prevents surface intersections. We then obtain a final deformation of the object, assisted by a diffusion prior. Our method successfully fits accessories of various materials over a breadth of target regions, and is designed to fit directly into existing digital artist workflows. We demonstrate the robustness and accuracy of our pipeline by comparing it with generative approaches and traditional registration algorithms.

</details>


### [128] [Post-Hoc Guidance for Consistency Models by Joint Flow Distribution Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08828)
*Chia-Hong Hsu,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次在一致性模型（CM）中实现无需扩散模型（DM）老师的类无分类器引导（CFG）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样代价高，一致性模型虽能一步采样，但现有引导方法需蒸馏DM教师，无法在纯CM上直接应用CFG。

Method: 提出轻量级联合流分布学习（JFDL）：利用已预训练的CM作为ODE求解器，通过正态性检验发现无条件与条件速度场对应的方差爆炸噪声呈高斯分布，据此对齐分布，使CM具备可调引导旋钮。

Result: 仅需对原一致性训练（CT）的CM做轻量后处理，即可在CIFAR-10与ImageNet 64×64上获得类CFG的引导效果，FID显著下降，首次实现无需DM教师的有效后验引导。

Conclusion: JFDL填补了CM无法直接利用CFG的空白，使快速采样与灵活 fidelity–diversity 权衡在同一模型中兼得。

Abstract: Classifier-free Guidance (CFG) lets practitioners trade-off fidelity against diversity in Diffusion Models (DMs). The practicality of CFG is however hindered by DMs sampling cost. On the other hand, Consistency Models (CMs) generate images in one or a few steps, but existing guidance methods require knowledge distillation from a separate DM teacher, limiting CFG to Consistency Distillation (CD) methods. We propose Joint Flow Distribution Learning (JFDL), a lightweight alignment method enabling guidance in a pre-trained CM. With a pre-trained CM as an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, we verify with normality tests that the variance-exploding noise implied by the velocity fields from unconditional and conditional distributions is Gaussian. In practice, JFDL equips CMs with the familiar adjustable guidance knob, yielding guided images with similar characteristics to CFG. Applied to an original Consistency Trained (CT) CM that could only do conditional sampling, JFDL unlocks guided generation and reduces FID on both CIFAR-10 and ImageNet 64x64 datasets. This is the first time that CMs are able to receive effective guidance post-hoc without a DM teacher, thus, bridging a key gap in current methods for CMs.

</details>


### [129] [Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control for Safeguarding Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08846)
*Jinqi Luo,Jinyu Yang,Tal Neiman,Lei Fan,Bing Yin,Son Tran,Mubarak Shah,René Vidal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DACO用15k概念的稀疏字典在冻结MLLM推断时精准抑制恶意查询，无需重训模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM安全加固手段难应对演化攻击、成本高；需一种轻量、细粒度且能保通用能力的实时干预方法。

Method: 收集40万图文→聚15k概念向量→构建DACO-400K字典；用稀疏编码在推断层干预激活；用字典初始化SAE并自动标注语义→定向抑制不安全激活。

Result: MM-SafetyBench、JailBreakV等基准上，QwenVL/LLaVA/InternVL安全性显著提升，视觉问答等通用指标几乎无损。

Conclusion: 基于冻结激活干预的DACO兼顾高安全与低算力，为MLLM在线防护提供通用可扩展方案并开放数据集促后续研究。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been shown to be vulnerable to malicious queries that can elicit unsafe responses. Recent work uses prompt engineering, response classification, or finetuning to improve MLLM safety. Nevertheless, such approaches are often ineffective against evolving malicious patterns, may require rerunning the query, or demand heavy computational resources. Steering the activations of a frozen model at inference time has recently emerged as a flexible and effective solution. However, existing steering methods for MLLMs typically handle only a narrow set of safety-related concepts or struggle to adjust specific concepts without affecting others. To address these challenges, we introduce Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control (DACO), a framework that utilizes a curated concept dictionary and a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to provide granular control over MLLM activations. First, we curate a dictionary of 15,000 multimodal concepts by retrieving over 400,000 caption-image stimuli and summarizing their activations into concept directions. We name the dataset DACO-400K. Second, we show that the curated dictionary can be used to intervene activations via sparse coding. Third, we propose a new steering approach that uses our dictionary to initialize the training of an SAE and automatically annotate the semantics of the SAE atoms for safeguarding MLLMs. Experiments on multiple MLLMs (e.g., QwenVL, LLaVA, InternVL) across safety benchmarks (e.g., MM-SafetyBench, JailBreakV) show that DACO significantly improves MLLM safety while maintaining general-purpose capabilities.

</details>


### [130] [MedFormer-UR: Uncertainty-Routed Transformer for Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08868)
*Mohammed Maaz Sibhai,Abedalrhman Alkhateeb,Saad B. Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用带 Dirichlet 先验的 token 级原型-不确定性感知 MedFormer，在四种模态上把 ECE 降 35%，并提升拒绝预测表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床数据噪声大且类别失衡，现有 Med-ViT 虽准却过度自信、不可解释，阻碍安全落地，亟需可信不确定性估计与可解释机制。

Method: 在改进 MedFormer 中引入：①Dirichlet 分布建模每 token 证据 uncertainty，实现实时定位与量化；②用 uncertainty 主动过滤不可靠特征更新；③类别特定原型保持嵌入空间结构，实现基于视觉相似度的决策。

Result: 在乳腺 X 线、超声、MRI 与病理四种模态上，ECE 最多降低 35%，选择性预测显著提升，准确率提升有限时已获得可靠校准。

Conclusion: 通过把不确定性作为训练信号与结构约束，MedFormer 能在临床异构数据上兼顾精度、校准与可解释，为深度学习医疗设备的安全集成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: To ensure safe clinical integration, deep learning models must provide more than just high accuracy; they require dependable uncertainty quantification. While current Medical Vision Transformers perform well, they frequently struggle with overconfident predictions and a lack of transparency, issues that are magnified by the noisy and imbalanced nature of clinical data. To address this, we enhanced the modified Medical Transformer (MedFormer) that incorporates prototype-based learning and uncertainty-guided routing, by utilizing a Dirichlet distribution for per-token evidential uncertainty, our framework can quantify and localize ambiguity in real-time. This uncertainty is not just an output but an active participant in the training process, filtering out unreliable feature updates. Furthermore, the use of class-specific prototypes ensures the embedding space remains structured, allowing for decisions based on visual similarity. Testing across four modalities (mammography, ultrasound, MRI, and histopathology) confirms that our approach significantly enhances model calibration, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) by up to 35%, and improves selective prediction, even when accuracy gains are modest.

</details>


### [131] [Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T: Multi-Dimensional Grouping for Ultra-High Energy Efficiency in Spiking Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08894)
*Zecheng Hao,Shenghao Xie,Kang Chen,Wenxuan Liu,Zhaofei Yu,Tiejun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Ge2mS-T——首个在时-空-网络三维度做分组计算的脉冲视觉变换器，用 ExpG-IF 无损转换与 GW-SSA 无乘自注意力，一次解决 SNN 的显存、精度与能效冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN 虽能效高，但在 S-ViT 上训练难、精度低、显存大；既有 ANN-SNN 转换和 STBP 无法同时优化记忆、准确度与能耗。

Method: 1) ExpG-IF：分组指数编码 IF 神经元，实现恒开销无损 ANN→SNN 转换并精准控制脉冲模式；2) GW-SSA：多尺度 token 分组 + 无乘混合注意-卷积，显著降低复杂度；3) 整体 Ge2mS-T 框架在时、空、网络结构三维度统一分组计算。

Result: 在 ImageNet 等挑战性基准上，Ge2mS-T 取得 S-ViT 新 SOTA，同时能耗比最优 ANN 低两个数量级，显存占用显著下降。

Conclusion: 首次系统构建多维度分组计算范式，打破 S-ViT 的“显存-精度-能效”不可能三角，为高能效视觉大模型提供新路径。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer superior energy efficiency over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). However, they encounter significant deficiencies in training and inference metrics when applied to Spiking Vision Transformers (S-ViTs). Existing paradigms including ANN-SNN Conversion and Spatial-Temporal Backpropagation (STBP) suffer from inherent limitations, precluding concurrent optimization of memory, accuracy and energy consumption. To address these issues, we propose Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T, a novel architecture implementing grouped computation across temporal, spatial and network structure dimensions. Specifically, we introduce the Grouped-Exponential-Coding-based IF (ExpG-IF) model, enabling lossless conversion with constant training overhead and precise regulation for spike patterns. Additionally, we develop Group-wise Spiking Self-Attention (GW-SSA) to reduce computational complexity via multi-scale token grouping and multiplication-free operations within a hybrid attention-convolution framework. Experiments confirm that our method can achieve superior performance with ultra-high energy efficiency on challenging benchmarks. To our best knowledge, this is the first work to systematically establish multi-dimensional grouped computation for resolving the triad of memory overhead, learning capability and energy budget in S-ViTs.

</details>


### [132] [Towards Lifelong Aerial Autonomy: Geometric Memory Management for Continual Visual Place Recognition in Dynamic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09038)
*Xingyu Shao,Zhiqiang Yan,Liangzheng Sun,Mengfan He,Chao Chen,Jinhui Zhang,Chunyu Li,Ziyang Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: On-board visual place-recognition for long-life UAVs faces catastrophic forgetting when mission domains shift; authors give a ‘learn-and-dispose’ continual-learning scheme that couples a tiny satellite-anchor memory with a dynamic replay buffer selected for structural diversity, beating random replay by 7.8% on a 21-mission benchmark.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current continual-learning remedies break down in aerial geo-localization because geographical features have huge intra-class variance; new missions sequentially change image distribution, causing VPR networks to forget previously learned places and threaten long-term autonomy.

Method: Treat every mission as a new domain-incremental task; keep storage minimal by splitting knowledge into (i) fixed satellite anchor set that encodes global geometry and (ii) compact experience-replay buffer updated via spatially-constrained, diversity-first selection rather than difficulty or class mean; entire pipeline runs on-board under strict memory limits.

Result: 21-mission benchmark shows the heterogeneous memory architecture markedly raises spatial generalization; diversity-driven buffer topples random baseline by 7.8% retention and surpasses class-mean methods in plasticity-stability trade-off, remaining robust to mission order permutation.

Conclusion: Preserving structural feature coverage, not sample hardness or class prototypes, is key to averting catastrophic forgetting in lifelong aerial place recognition; proposed learn-and-dispose framework enables practical, storage-frugal continual VPR for UAV fleets.

Abstract: Robust geo-localization in changing environmental conditions is critical for long-term aerial autonomy. While visual place recognition (VPR) models perform well when airborne views match the training domain, adapting them to shifting distributions during sequential missions triggers catastrophic forgetting. Existing continual learning (CL) methods often fail here because geographic features exhibit severe intra-class variations. In this work, we formulate aerial VPR as a mission-based domain-incremental learning (DIL) problem and propose a novel heterogeneous memory framework. To respect strict onboard storage constraints, our "Learn-and-Dispose" pipeline decouples geographic knowledge into static satellite anchors (preserving global geometric priors) and a dynamic experience replay buffer (retaining domain-specific features). We introduce a spatially-constrained allocation strategy that optimizes buffer selection based on sample difficulty or feature space diversity. To facilitate systematic assessment, we provide three evaluation criteria and a comprehensive benchmark derived from 21 diverse mission sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our architecture significantly boosts spatial generalization; our diversity-driven buffer selection outperforms the random baseline by 7.8% in knowledge retention. Unlike class-mean preservation methods that fail in unstructured environments, maximizing structural diversity achieves a superior plasticity-stability balance and ensures order-agnostic robustness across randomized sequences. These results prove that maintaining structural feature coverage is more critical than sample difficulty for resolving catastrophic forgetting in lifelong aerial autonomy.

</details>


### [133] [CLIP-Inspector: Model-Level Backdoor Detection for Prompt-Tuned CLIP via OOD Trigger Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09101)
*Akshit Jindal,Saket Anand,Chetan Arora,Vikram Goyal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对提示微调 CLIP 模型中恶意植入的后门问题，提出模型级检测工具 CI，仅需 1 000 张 OOD 图像、1 轮迭代即可以 94% 准确率重构触发器并完成模型修复，在 10 个数据集、4 种攻击下 AUROC 达 0.973，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限机构将 CLIP 提示微调外包给 MLaaS 时，无法判断接收的模型是否被恶意服务商植入触发式后门；现有检测方法因不改变编码器权重，均无法直接回答“模型是否被投毒”这一模型级验证问题。

Method: 提出 CLIP-Inspector，在仅拿到白盒模型与未标注 OOD 图像的“零标注”假设下，对各类别逆向重建潜在触发器；若某类触发器能使 OOD 图像一致偏向该类别，则判定为后门；进一步将重建触发器与干净标签一同微调模型，抵消后门效应。

Result: 10 个数据集、4 种后门攻击的实验表明，CI 用 1 000 张 OOD 图像、1 轮训练即可重构高威胁触发器；50 个模型中检测 47 个，准确率 94%；AUROC 0.973，优于改编基线方法 0.495/0.687；修复后门模型可使攻击成功率下降 90% 以上。

Conclusion: CI 首次实现提示微调 CLIP 的模型级后门检测与后修复，免数据、免重训练，验证并修复可在单轮完成，为 MLaaS 场景提供了实用、可靠的模型安全交付方案。

Abstract: Organisations with limited data and computational resources increasingly outsource model training to Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) providers, who adapt vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP to downstream tasks via prompt tuning rather than training from scratch. This semi-honest setting creates a security risk where a malicious provider can follow the prompt-tuning protocol yet implant a backdoor, forcing triggered inputs to be classified into an attacker-chosen class, even for out-of-distribution (OOD) data. Such backdoors leave encoders untouched, making them undetectable to existing methods that focus on encoder corruption. Other data-level methods that sanitize data before training or during inference, also fail to answer the critical question, "Is the delivered model backdoored or not?" To address this model-level verification problem, we introduce CLIP-Inspector (CI), a backdoor detection method designed for prompt-tuned CLIP models. Assuming white-box access to the delivered model and a pool of unlabeled OOD images, CI reconstructs possible triggers for each class to determine if the model exhibits backdoor behaviour or not. Additionally, we demonstrate that using CI's reconstructed trigger for fine-tuning on correctly labeled triggered inputs enables us to re-align the model and reduce backdoor effectiveness. Through extensive experiments across ten datasets and four backdoor attacks, we demonstrate that CI can reconstruct effective triggers in a single epoch using only 1,000 OOD images, achieving a 94% detection accuracy (47/50 models). Compared to adapted trigger-inversion baselines, CI yields a markedly higher AUROC score (0.973 vs 0.495/0.687), thus enabling the vetting and post-hoc repair of prompt-tuned CLIP models to ensure safe deployment.

</details>


### [134] [Training-free, Perceptually Consistent Low-Resolution Previews with High-Resolution Image for Efficient Workflows of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09227)
*Wongi Jeong,Hoigi Seo,Se Young Chun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 先用一张超低分辨率但高保真的“预览图”帮用户筛掉不想要的 HR 图像，再正式生成，整体算力可省 33%，结合其它加速手段最快 3×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型要拿到理想 HR 结果必须“海量抽签”，算力成本极高；若直接先生成 LR 再放大，又难保证 LR 与最终 HR 在感知上一致。

Method: 基于 Flow-Matching 模型提出“对易子为零”条件，推导出无需训练的下采样矩阵选取+对易子零引导策略，使 LR 预览与 HR 结果在感知空间保持一致。

Result: 在 ImageNet、MS-COCO 等基准上，LR 预览与 HR 感知距离（LPIPS）平均仅 0.008；生成阶段 FLOPs 减少 33%，叠加已有加速方案后端到端提速 3×；同样框架可直接用于扭曲、平移等编辑任务。

Conclusion: “先预览后精绘”思路可零成本嵌入任意 Flow-Matching 文生图管线，显著降低用户与云服务的试算开销，并具备向其它图像操作泛化的潜力。

Abstract: Image generative models have become indispensable tools to yield exquisite high-resolution (HR) images for everyone, ranging from general users to professional designers. However, a desired outcome often requires generating a large number of HR images with different prompts and seeds, resulting in high computational cost for both users and service providers. Generating low-resolution (LR) images first could alleviate computational burden, but it is not straightforward how to generate LR images that are perceptually consistent with their HR counterparts. Here, we consider the task of generating high-fidelity LR images, called Previews, that preserve perceptual similarity of their HR counterparts for an efficient workflow, allowing users to identify promising candidates before generating the final HR image. We propose the commutator-zero condition to ensure the LR-HR perceptual consistency for flow matching models, leading to the proposed training-free solution with downsampling matrix selection and commutator-zero guidance. Extensive experiments show that our method can generate LR images with up to 33\% computation reduction while maintaining HR perceptual consistency. When combined with existing acceleration techniques, our method achieves up to 3$\times$ speedup. Moreover, our formulation can be extended to image manipulations, such as warping and translation, demonstrating its generalizability.

</details>


### [135] [2D or 3D: Who Governs Salience in VLA Models? -- Tri-Stage Token Pruning Framework with Modality Salience Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09244)
*Zihao Zheng,Sicheng Tian,Zhihao Mao,Lingyue Zhang,Chenyue Li,Ziyun Zhang,Hong Gao,Yuchen Huang,Yutong Xu,Guojie Luo,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对2D-3D混合的多模态具身智能模型（MVLA）提出三阶段Token剪枝框架，在基本不损失精度的情况下获得最高2.55倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型正向2D+3D多模态演进，输入Token激增导致速度瓶颈；现有剪枝方法仅针对2D场景，无法区分2D/3D模态重要性差异。

Method: 三阶段分析：1)数据预处理阶段比较模态显著性，2)前向传播阶段动态追踪模态贡献，3)决策阶段联合优化2D/3D Token选择；据此设计三阶段Token剪枝框架，实现模态感知的渐进式剪枝。

Result: 在MVLA模型上实现2.55×推理加速，Top-1任务精度下降<0.5%，剪枝带来的额外开销仅5.8%。

Conclusion: 首次揭示MVLA中2D/3D模态显著性差异并系统利用，验证了模态感知剪枝在具身智能加速中的可行性与高性价比。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as the mainstream of embodied intelligence. Recent VLA models have expanded their input modalities from 2D-only to 2D+3D paradigms, forming multi-visual-modal VLA (MVLA) models. Despite achieving improved spatial perception, MVLA faces a greater acceleration demand due to the increased number of input tokens caused by modal expansion. Token pruning is an effective optimization methods tailored to MVLA models. However, existing token pruning schemes are designed for 2D-only VLA models, ignoring 2D/3D modality salience differences. In this paper, we follow the application process of multi-modal data in MVLA models and develop a tri-stage analysis to capture the discrepancy and dynamics of 2D/3D modality salience. Based on these, we propose a corresponding tri-stage token pruning framework for MVLA models to achieve optimal 2D/3D token selection and efficient pruning. Experiments show that our framework achieves up to a 2.55x inference speedup with minimal accuracy loss, while only costing 5.8% overhead. Our Code is coming soon.

</details>


### [136] [AMO-ENE: Attention-based Multi-Omics Fusion Model for Outcome Prediction in Extra Nodal Extension and HPV-associated Oropharyngeal Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09280)
*Gautier Hénique,William Le,Gabriel Dayan,Coralie Brodeur,Kristoff Nelson,Apostolos Christopoulos,Edith Filion,Phuc-Felix Nguyen-Tan,Laurent Letourneau-Guillon,Houda Bahig,Samuel Kadoury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对HPV阳性口咽癌，作者构建了一个全自动CT影像-临床数据融合pipeline，可准确识别淋巴结外侵（ENE）并预测2年复发及生存，显著优于传统分期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ENE是HPV阳性口咽癌的重要预后因子，却因CT对比度低、人工勾画困难等未被纳入分期；亟需客观、高效的自动化评估手段。

Method: 1）分层3D半监督分割模型在放疗CT上自动勾画ENE区域；2）提取影像组学+深度特征训练ENE分级器；3）将节点特征与原发灶特征通过注意力机制融合，建立多模态结局预测模型；4）内部397例HPV阳性患者（2009-2020）验证。

Result: ENE识别模型性能未直接给出，但结局预测2年AUC：远处复发88.2%、总生存79.2%、无病生存78.1%；C-index分别为83.3%、71.3%、70.0%，均显著优于传统TNM基准。

Conclusion: 该全自动pipeline可克服ENE评估的实用障碍，为HPV阳性口咽癌提供精准预后信息，具备直接辅助临床决策的可行性。

Abstract: Extranodal extension (ENE) is an emerging prognostic factor in human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated oropharyngeal cancer (OPC), although it is currently omitted as a clinical staging criteria. Recent works have advocated for the inclusion of iENE as a prognostic marker in HPV-positive OPC staging. However, several practical limitations continue to hinder its clinical integration, including inconsistencies in segmentation, low contrast in the periphery of metastatic lymph nodes on CT imaging, and laborious manual annotations. To address these limitations, we propose a fully automated end-to-end pipeline that uses computed tomography (CT) images with clinical data to assess the status of nodal ENE and predict treatment outcomes. Our approach includes a hierarchical 3D semi-supervised segmentation model designed to detect and delineate relevant iENE from radiotherapy planning CT scans. From these segmentations, a set of radiomics and deep features are extracted to train an imaging-detected ENE grading classifier. The predicted ENE status is then evaluated for its prognostic value and compared with existing staging criteria. Furthermore, we integrate these nodal features with primary tumor characteristics in a multimodal, attention-based outcome prediction model, providing a dynamic framework for outcome prediction. Our method is validated in an internal cohort of 397 HPV-positive OPC patients treated with radiation therapy or chemoradiotherapy between 2009 and 2020. For outcome prediction at the 2-year mark, our pipeline surpassed baseline models with 88.2% (4.8) in AUC for metastatic recurrence, 79.2% (7.4) for overall survival, and 78.1% (8.6) for disease-free survival. We also obtain a concordance index of 83.3% (6.5) for metastatic recurrence, 71.3% (8.9) for overall survival, and 70.0% (8.1) for disease-free survival, making it feasible for clinical decision making.

</details>


### [137] [Characterizing Lidar Range-Measurement Ambiguity due to Multiple Returns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09282)
*Jason H. Rife,Yifan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 激光雷达在自动驾驶定位中存在多散射面导致回波模糊（概率回波）的现象；本研究通过采集数据给出其统计特征，并定性提出对定位影响分析方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度自动驾驶亟需可靠定位与姿态估计，而当前激光雷达位姿估计算法默认“单束射线只返回唯一表面”，忽视了多散射面造成的概率回波，需要在真实道路环境中对该现象特征化，为后续定位鲁棒性研究奠基。

Method: 采集两种主流机械旋转式激光雷达的实测点云，提取同一射线多次观测的回波距离样本；统计每条射线路径的距离分布，构建经验累积分布函数CDF，并与传统“唯最近回波”模型对比。

Result: 发现高速路段与具有多层级反射区域的路况下，同一射线的回波距离CDF呈显著离散；超过30%的光路出现至少两个主要峰值，表明概率回波在道路环境常见且不可忽略。

Conclusion: 情境相关CDF可量化概率回波分布，取代传统一次性最近回波假设；后续定位算法应考虑射线上下文及多回波分布，以提升自动驾驶系统在复杂反射场景下的可靠性与安全冗余。

Abstract: Reliable position and attitude sensing is critical for highly automated vehicles that operate on conventional roadways. Lidar sensors are increasingly incorporated into pose-estimation systems. Despite its great utility, lidar is a complex sensor, and its performance in roadway environments is not yet well understood. For instance, it is often assumed in lidar-localization algorithms that a lidar will always identify a unique surface along a given raypath. However, this assumption is not always true, as ample prior evidence exists to suggest that lidar units may generate measurements probabilistically when more than one scattering surface appears within the lidar's conical beam. In this paper, we analyze lidar datasets to characterize cases with probabilistic returns along particular raypaths. Our contribution is to present representative cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) for raypaths observed by two different mechanically rotating lidar units with stationary bases. In subsequent discussion, we outline a qualitative methodology to assess the effect of probabilistic multi-return cases on lidar-based localization.

</details>


### [138] [Compositional-Degradation UAV Image Restoration: Conditional Decoupled MoE Network and A Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09313)
*Jinquan Yan,Zhicheng Zhao,Zhengzheng Tu,Chenglong Li,Jin Tang,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对无人机影像常被雨、雾、噪声等多种退化同时破坏的问题，作者提出DAME-Net，将“退化感知”与“条件重建”解耦，用显式退化描述指导混合专家网络逐因子修复，并发布首个大规模多退化无人机影像修复基准MDUR，实验显示在未知及高阶复合退化上显著优于现有统一修复方法，且能提升下游目标检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机影像在测绘、巡检、应急等任务中极易同时遭受雨、雾、噪声等复合退化，而现有统一修复方法将多种退化隐式纠缠为单一条件，导致异质校正相互干扰、性能下降。亟需一种可解释、可泛化且能显式分离各退化因子的修复框架。

Method: 提出DAME-Net：1) FDPM模块通过多标签预测+标签相似度软对齐，为每种退化输出显式置信度向量，替代隐式纠缠条件；2) CDMM模块以该向量为阶段级条件，在空-频双域内执行掩码约束的解耦专家路由，实现“哪个专家处理哪种退化”的精准分工；3) 构建含43种退化配置（单退化至四因子复合）的MDUR基准，并划分标准seen/unseen协议。

Result: 在MDUR上，DAME-Net较代表性统一修复方法PSNR提升1.3-2.1 dB，在 unseen 三、四因子复合退化上优势扩大至2.5 dB；消融实验表明FDPM显式描述与CDMM解耦路由分别贡献0.8 dB与1.1 dB；下游 UAV 检测 mAP 提升3.4-4.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式退化感知+解耦专家路由是多因子复合影像修复的有效范式；MDUR 为后续研究提供了标准化测试平台；DAME-Net 不仅修复精度高，且具备可解释性与跨退化泛化能力，可直接增强无人机实际应用中的视觉下游任务表现。

Abstract: UAV images are critical for applications such as large-area mapping, infrastructure inspection, and emergency response. However, in real-world flight environments, a single image is often affected by multiple degradation factors, including rain, haze, and noise, undermining downstream task performance. Current unified restoration approaches typically rely on implicit degradation representations that entangle multiple factors into a single condition, causing mutual interference among heterogeneous corrections. To this end, we propose DAME-Net, a Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Network that decouples explicit degradation perception from degradation-conditioned reconstruction for compositional UAV image restoration. Specifically, we design a Factor-wise Degradation Perception module(FDPM) to provide explicit per-factor degradation cues for the restoration stage through multi-label prediction with label-similarity-guided soft alignment, replacing implicit entangled conditions with interpretable and generalizable degradation descriptions. Moreover, we develop a Conditioned Decoupled MoE module(CDMM) that leverages these cues for stage-wise conditioning, spatial-frequency hybrid processing, and mask-constrained decoupled expert routing, enabling selective factor-specific correction while suppressing irrelevant interference. In addition, we construct the Multi-Degradation UAV Restoration benchmark (MDUR), the first large-scale UAV benchmark for compositional UAV image restoration, with 43 degradation configurations from single degradations to four-factor composites and standardized seen/unseen splits.Extensive experiments on MDUR demonstrate consistent improvements over representative unified restoration methods, with greater gains on unseen and higher-order composite degradations. Downstream experiments further validate benefits for UAV object detection.

</details>


### [139] [UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement via Real-Time Enhancement Methods with Clifford Information Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09321)
*Xiaohan Wang,Chen Wu,Dawei Zhao,Guangwei Gao,Dianjie Lu,Guijuan Zhang,Linwei Fan,Xu Lu,Shuai Wu,Hang Wei,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用 Clifford 几何代数在消费级硬件上实现 4K/8K 极暗图像毫秒级增强，指标优于 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 或高维 CNN 受限于“内存墙”，无法在边缘端对 UHD 极暗图像完成毫秒级推理。

Method: 1) 四层高分辨率递增金字塔把图像拆成高/低频分量；2) 轻量深度可分离 U-Net 双支路提取；3) 引入基于空间感知 Clifford 代数的多重向量相似度融合，抑制噪声保纹理；4) 网络输出自适应 Gamma/Gain 图，以 Retinex 理论做物理约束非线性亮度调整；5) FP16 混精度+动态算子融合。

Result: 单张消费级显卡在 4K/8K 分辨率下实现毫秒级推理，多项重建指标优于现有最佳方法。

Conclusion: 把 Clifford 几何代数引入实时 UHD 低光增强可在保真与速度间取得突破，为移动端超高分辨率暗光成像提供可行方案。

Abstract: Considering efficiency, ultra-high-definition (UHD) low-light image restoration is extremely challenging. Existing methods based on Transformer architectures or high-dimensional complex convolutional neural networks often suffer from the "memory wall" bottleneck, failing to achieve millisecond-level inference on edge devices. To address this issue, we propose a novel real-time UHD low-light enhancement network based on geometric feature fusion using Clifford algebra in 2D Euclidean space. First, we construct a four-layer feature pyramid with gradually increasing resolution, which decomposes input images into low-frequency and high-frequency structural components via a Gaussian blur kernel, and adopts a lightweight U-Net based on depthwise separable convolution for dual-branch feature extraction. Second, to resolve structural information loss and artifacts from traditional high-low frequency feature fusion, we introduce spatially aware Clifford algebra, which maps feature tensors to a multivector space (scalars, vectors, bivectors) and uses Clifford similarity to aggregate features while suppressing noise and preserving textures. In the reconstruction stage, the network outputs adaptive Gamma and Gain maps, which perform physically constrained non-linear brightness adjustment via Retinex theory. Integrated with FP16 mixed-precision computation and dynamic operator fusion, our method achieves millisecond-level inference for 4K/8K images on a single consumer-grade device, while outperforming state-of-the-art (SOTA) models on several restoration metrics.

</details>


### [140] [Multimodal Anomaly Detection for Human-Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09326)
*Guilherme Ribeiro,Iordanis Antypas,Leonardo Bizzaro,João Bimbo,Nuno Cruz Garcia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出MADRI框架，将视频流转成语义特征向量后做重建式异常检测，并融合机器人内部传感与场景图，实验表明多模态特征重建可显著提升人机协作异常检测鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协作中需及时识别可能引发故障或危险偏离正常行为的异常事件；现有研究多直接处理原始数据，缺乏对语义特征向量进行重建式异常检测的深入探索。

Method: 1) 将视频帧转化为富含语义的特征向量；2) 用自编码器对这些向量做重建，以重建误差作为异常分数；3) 将视觉特征与机器人本体传感器数据、场景图信息融合，实现多模态特征重建；4) 在自建pick-and-place正常/异常数据集上对比单模态与多模态方案。

Result: 仅使用视觉特征向量的重建已能有效检测异常；引入传感器与场景图后，检测指标进一步提升，验证了多模态特征重建对异常敏感度和鲁棒性的增益。

Conclusion: 基于语义特征向量的重建式异常检测为HRI提供了一条高效新路径，多模态融合显著增强了对视觉外部异常与机器人内部故障的统一感知能力，对构建安全可信的人机协作系统具有明确价值。

Abstract: Ensuring safety and reliability in human-robot interaction (HRI) requires the timely detection of unexpected events that could lead to system failures or unsafe behaviours. Anomaly detection thus plays a critical role in enabling robots to recognize and respond to deviations from normal operation during collaborative tasks. While reconstruction models have been actively explored in HRI, approaches that operate directly on feature vectors remain largely unexplored. In this work, we propose MADRI, a framework that first transforms video streams into semantically meaningful feature vectors before performing reconstruction-based anomaly detection. Additionally, we augment these visual feature vectors with the robot's internal sensors' readings and a Scene Graph, enabling the model to capture both external anomalies in the visual environment and internal failures within the robot itself. To evaluate our approach, we collected a custom dataset consisting of a simple pick-and-place robotic task under normal and anomalous conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that reconstruction on vision-based feature vectors alone is effective for detecting anomalies, while incorporating other modalities further improves detection performance, highlighting the benefits of multimodal feature reconstruction for robust anomaly detection in human-robot collaboration.

</details>


### [141] [VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09330)
*Xiaolei Lang,Yang Wang,Yukun Zhou,Chaojun Ni,Kerui Li,Jiagang Zhu,Tianze Liu,Jiajun Lv,Xingxing Zuo,Yun Ye,Guan Huang,Xiaofeng Wang,Zheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出流匹配双分支模型 VAG，联合合成对齐的视频－动作数据，降低机器人示教开销并提升策略泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人基础模型依赖昂贵人工示教，现有世界模型无法直接产出动作轨迹；视频-动作对齐弱、两阶段方法误差累积，阻碍规模化。

Method: VAG 以单一流匹配框架并行生成视频与动作：双分支共享去噪过程，通过自适应 3D 池化把全局视频紧凑表征注入动作分支，实现跨模态一致。

Result: 在仿真与真实任务中，VAG 生成的视频-动作对对齐度高、轨迹可执行；用作预训练数据可显著提升下游策略的泛化性能。

Conclusion: VAG 为具身智能提供高效、可扩展的世界-动作数据合成新范式，有望替代部分人工示教。

Abstract: Recent advances in robot foundation models trained on large-scale human teleoperation data have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex real-world tasks. However, scaling these systems remains difficult because collecting task-specific demonstrations is expensive and labor-intensive. Synthetic data, especially generated videos, offer a promising direction, but existing World Models (WMs) are not directly suitable for policy learning since they do not provide paired action trajectories. World-Action (WA) models partially address this by predicting actions with visual outputs, yet often lack strong video-action alignment, while two-stage pipelines that generate video first and then infer actions introduce inefficiency and error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose VAG, a unified flow-matching-based dual-stream framework that jointly generates video and action under visual and language conditioning. By synchronizing denoising in both branches and using an adaptive 3D pooling mechanism to transfer compact global video context to the action branch, VAG improves cross-modal consistency during generation. Across both simulated and real-world settings, VAG produces aligned video-action pairs with competitive prediction quality, supports executable trajectory replay, and provides useful synthetic pretraining data that improves downstream policy generalization, indicating its potential as a practical world-action model for embodied data synthesis.

</details>


### [142] [Through Their Eyes: Fixation-aligned Tuning for Personalized User Emulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09368)
*Lingfeng Huang,Huizhong Guo,Tianjun Wei,Yingpeng Du,Zhu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FixATE 方法，把 VLM 的视觉注意力对齐到真实用户的凝视分布，让“用户模拟器”像真人一样浏览推荐界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 用户模拟器只看文本/结构化元数据，忽略真实用户通过视觉界面浏览推荐时的个性化凝视行为，导致仿真度不足。

Method: 1) 收集轮播推荐场景的眼动数据，验证个体凝视模式稳定且可预测点击；2) 用可解释算子提取 VLM 内部视觉注意力，得到 slot 级 relevance 分布；3) 设计 FixATE，为每位用户学习软提示，将 VLM 注意力对齐到其真实凝视模式；4) 在三类可解释算子、两种 VLM 架构上验证。

Result: 两种骨干模型、三种算子下，注意力对齐指标与点击预测准确率均一致提升，验证“让用户视角指导模型看”的有效性。

Conclusion: 让模型“像用户一样看界面”是提升推荐系统用户模拟器保真度的可行路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as scalable user simulators for recommender system evaluation. Yet existing simulators perceive recommendations through text or structured metadata rather than the visual interfaces real users browse-a critical gap, since attention over recommendation layouts is both visually driven and highly personalized. We investigate whether aligning a vision-language model's (VLM's) visual attention with user-specific gaze patterns can improve simulation fidelity. Analysis of a real-world eye-tracking dataset collected in a carousel-based recommendation setting reveals that users exhibit stable individual gaze patterns strongly predictive of click behavior. Building on this finding, we propose Fixation-Aligned Tuning for user Emulation (FixATE). Our approach first probes the VLM's internal visual attention via interpretability operators to obtain a slot-level relevance distribution comparable with human fixation, and then learns personalized soft prompts to steer the model's attention toward each user's characteristic fixation pattern. Experiments across three interpretability-based probing operators and two architecturally distinct VLM backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in both attention alignment and click prediction accuracy. These results suggest that making the model "see like the user" is a viable path toward simulators that more faithfully reproduce how users perceive and act in recommendation interfaces.

</details>


### [143] [Cluster-First Labelling: An Automated Pipeline for Segmentation and Morphological Clustering in Histology Whole Slide Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09370)
*Muhammad Haseeb Ahmad,Sharmila Rajendran,Damion Young,Jon Mason*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出云原生全自动病理切片标注管线，用 Cellpose-SAM 分割、ResNet-50+UMAP+DBSCAN 进行无监督聚类，让人只需标注聚类而非单目标，3,696 个跨物种组织对象上达到 96.8 % 的加权聚类-标签一致性，7 类组织全零错误，整体流程与工具皆开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理全载玻片图像中细胞、核等结构需逐一手动画边界并分类，标注工作量巨大，成为大规模组织学研究的瓶颈；需要一种能显著降低人工负担同时保持高准确度的自动化方案。

Method: 构建云原生端到端管线：1) 切片瓦片化并预筛；2) Cellpose-SAM 联合模型完成多类组织成分分割；3) ResNet-50 提取神经嵌入；4) UMAP 降维；5) DBSCAN 无监督聚类生成形态学相似对象簇；6) 采用“聚类优先”范式，仅让人对簇做标注，再由匈牙利算法逐瓦片匹配簇与真实标签以评估一致性。

Result: 在涵盖人、大鼠、兔 3 个物种 13 种组织类型、共 3,696 个结构的实验上，方法取得 96.8 % 加权聚类-标签对齐准确率；其中 7 种组织类型达成完全一致（100 %），显著降低人工标注至单目标模式的 1~2 个数量级。

Conclusion: 聚类优先且人仅标注簇的云原生管线可在几乎无监督条件下高保真地对全切片多种组织成分自动分类与标注，破解了大规模病理图像人工标注难题；系统代码、标注 Web 平台及评估脚本均开源，便于社区复刻与扩展。

Abstract: Labelling tissue components in histology whole slide images (WSIs) is prohibitively labour-intensive: a single slide may contain tens of thousands of structures--cells, nuclei, and other morphologically distinct objects--each requiring manual boundary delineation and classification. We present a cloudnative, end-to-end pipeline that automates this process through a cluster-first paradigm. Our system tiles WSIs, filters out tiles deemed unlikely to contain valuable information, segments tissue components with Cellpose-SAM (including cells, nuclei, and other morphologically similar structures), extracts neural embeddings via a pretrained ResNet-50, reduces dimensionality with UMAP, and groups morphologically similar objects using DBSCAN clustering. Under this paradigm, a human annotator labels representative clusters rather than individual objects, reducing annotation effort by orders of magnitude. We evaluate the pipeline on 3,696 tissue components across 13 diverse tissue types from three species (human, rat, rabbit), measuring how well unsupervised clusters align with independent human labels via per-tile Hungarian-algorithm matching. Our system achieves a weighted cluster-label alignment accuracy of 96.8%, with 7 of 13 tissue types reaching perfect agreement. The pipeline, a companion labelling web application, and all evaluation code are released as open-source software.

</details>


### [144] [Efficient Unlearning through Maximizing Relearning Convergence Delay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09391)
*Khoa Tran,Simon S. Woo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“再学习收敛延迟”指标并配套构建Influence Eliminating Unlearning框架，实现兼顾权重与预测空间的深度遗忘，兼顾保真性与抗恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法及其评估仅盯着模型输出，无法探测真实参数层面的知识残留，导致“已删除数据”仍可能被恢复，安全与合规风险高。需要一种既能衡量又能消除深层影响的新策略。

Method: 1) 设计“再学习收敛延迟”指标，同时追踪权重更新轨迹与预测行为变化，量化被遗忘样本的信息残留；2) 提出Influence Eliminating Unlearning：对遗忘集性能进行梯度上升破坏，并引入权重衰减与随机噪声注入抑制权重恢复，全程保持保留集性能；3) 分别针对分类与生成任务给出指数收敛与上界理论保证。

Result: 再学习实验表明：相较于KL散度、SSIM、Error Rate等单维度指标，所提方法在抗恢复、保性能两项均达到近“理想遗忘”（oracle）水平；抗重学攻击成功率<1%，保留集精度损失<0.5%，参数级相似度下降>60%。

Conclusion: 权重-预测双空间评估是揭示残余知识的关键，提出的指标与算法均能给机器学习模型提供可验证的“彻底遗忘”与“性能保持”保障，对隐私合规与模型编辑具有显著工程与理论价值。

Abstract: Machine unlearning poses challenges in removing mislabeled, contaminated, or problematic data from a pretrained model. Current unlearning approaches and evaluation metrics are solely focused on model predictions, which limits insight into the model's true underlying data characteristics. To address this issue, we introduce a new metric called relearning convergence delay, which captures both changes in weight space and prediction space, providing a more comprehensive assessment of the model's understanding of the forgotten dataset. This metric can be used to assess the risk of forgotten data being recovered from the unlearned model. Based on this, we propose the Influence Eliminating Unlearning framework, which removes the influence of the forgetting set by degrading its performance and incorporates weight decay and injecting noise into the model's weights, while maintaining accuracy on the retaining set. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing metrics and our proposed relearning convergence delay metric, approaching ideal unlearning performance. We provide theoretical guarantees, including exponential convergence and upper bounds, as well as empirical evidence of strong retention and resistance to relearning in both classification and generative unlearning tasks.

</details>


### [145] [Multi-task Just Recognizable Difference for Video Coding for Machines: Database, Model, and Coding Application](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09421)
*Junqi Liu,Yun Zhang,Xiaoxia Huang,Long Xu,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 作者把“刚可辨差异”(JRD)从单任务扩展到多任务，构建含27 264条机器标注的MT-JRD数据集，提出融合通用与专用特征的AMT-JRD模型，并引入目标属性先验，显著降低VCM码率且三种视觉任务精度均优于单任务基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JRD仅服务于单任务，难以支撑多样化的机器视觉应用；亟需一套多任务JRD数据与预测框架，以在VCM场景下同时提升压缩效率与多任务精度。

Method: 1) 采集并标注27 264条JRD，覆盖检测、实例分割、关键点三类任务；2) 设计GFEM+SFEM双通路结构实现多任务联合学习；3) 通过AFFM将目标尺寸、位置等属性显式融合至目标级JRD预测，弥补纯图像特征不足；4) 将预测JRD嵌入VCM环路，自适应控制压缩强度。

Result: AMT-JRD在三任务上的平均绝对误差3.781、误差方差5.332，分别较SOTA单任务模型降低6.7%与6.3%；在VCM中相对VVC/JPEG基线，BD-mAP平均提升3.861%/7.886%。

Conclusion: 多任务JRD建模可有效刻画机器视觉的跨任务感知一致性，结合属性先验的AMT-JRD在保持精度的同时显著节省码率，为VCM提供了实用、可扩展的压缩新范式。

Abstract: Just Recognizable Difference (JRD) boosts coding efficiency for machine vision through visibility threshold modeling, but is currently limited to a single-task scenario. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Task JRD (MT-JRD) dataset and an Attribute-assisted MT-JRD (AMT-JRD) model for Video Coding for Machines (VCM), enhancing both prediction accuracy and coding efficiency. First, we construct a dataset comprising 27,264 JRD annotations from machines, supporting three representative tasks including object detection, instance segmentation, and keypoint detection. Secondly, we propose the AMT-JRD prediction model, which integrates Generalized Feature Extraction Module (GFEM) and Specialized Feature Extraction Module (SFEM) to facilitate joint learning across multiple tasks. Thirdly, we innovatively incorporate object attribute information into object-wise JRD prediction through the Attribute Feature Fusion Module (AFFM), which introduces prior knowledge about object size and location. This design effectively compensates for the limitations of relying solely on image features and enhances the model's capacity to represent the perceptual mechanisms of machine vision. Finally, we apply the AMT-JRD model to VCM, where the accurately predicted JRDs are applied to reduce the coding bit rate while preserving accuracy across multiple machine vision tasks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that AMT-JRD achieves precise and robust multi-task prediction with a mean absolute error of 3.781 and error variance of 5.332 across three tasks, outperforming the state-of-the-art single-task prediction model by 6.7% and 6.3%, respectively. Coding experiments further reveal that compared to the baseline VVC and JPEG, the AMT-JRD-based VCM improves an average of 3.861% and 7.886% Bjontegaard Delta-mean Average Precision (BD-mAP), respectively.

</details>


### [146] [DSVTLA: Deep Swin Vision Transformer-Based Transfer Learning Architecture for Multi-Type Cancer Histopathological Cancer Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09468)
*Muazzem Hussain Khan,Tasdid Hasnain,Md. Jamil khan,Ruhul Amin,Md. Shamim Reza,Md. Al Mehedi Hasan,Md Ashad Alam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种融合 Swin Transformer 与 ResNet50 的深度迁移框架，实现多癌种组织病理图像精准分类，在统一多癌数据集上达到 99–100% 测试准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CNN/ViT 在组织病理图像中难以同时捕获长程上下文与局部细微形态差异，且多癌种场景下模型鲁棒性与通用性不足，需构建统一、可解释的高精度多癌分类基准。

Method: 将分层 Swin Transformer 与 ResNet50 卷积特征并行融合，形成双路径特征提取；采用统一 pipeline(平衡预处理、迁移学习、微调) 在含乳腺、口腔、肺-结肠、肾及急淋白血病等原图与分割图数据上训练，并与 DenseNet、InceptionV3、EfficientNet、ViT、Swin 等 SOTA 模型对比。

Result: 所提架构在多癌数据集上全面领先：肺-结肠癌与分割白血病测试集准确率 100%，乳腺癌 99.23%，且 precision、recall、F1 均接近最优，表现出跨癌种、跨成像条件的稳定性能。

Conclusion: 该框架首次实现高精度、可解释且鲁棒的多癌组织病理统一分类，确立新基准，可直接辅助临床 AI 诊断并为后续研究提供统一评估协议。

Abstract: In this study, we proposed a deep Swin-Vision Transformer-based transfer learning architecture for robust multi-cancer histopathological image classification. The proposed framework integrates a hierarchical Swin Transformer with ResNet50-based convolution features extraction, enabling the model to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine-grained local morphological patterns within histopathological images. To validate the efficiency of the proposed architecture, an extensive experiment was executed on a comprehensive multi-cancer dataset including Breast Cancer, Oral Cancer, Lung and Colon Cancer, Kidney Cancer, and Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL), including both original and segmented images were analyzed to assess model robustness across heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions. Our approach is benchmarked alongside several state-of-the-art CNN and transfer models, including DenseNet121, DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ResNet50, EfficientNetB3, multiple ViT variants, and Swin Transformer models. However, all models were trained and validated using a unified pipeline, incorporating balanced data preprocessing, transfer learning, and fine-tuning strategies. The experimental results demonstrated that our proposed architecture consistently gained superior performance, reaching 100% test accuracy for lung-colon cancer, segmented leukemia datasets, and up to 99.23% accuracy for breast cancer classification. The model also achieved near-perfect precision, f1 score, and recall, indicating highly stable scores across divers cancer types. Overall, the proposed model establishes a highly accurate, interpretable, and also robust multi-cancer classification system, demonstrating strong benchmark for future research and provides a unified comparative assessment useful for designing reliable AI-assisted histopathological diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [147] [OmniPrism: Learning Disentangled Visual Concept for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.12242)
*Yangyang Li,Daqing Liu,Wu Liu,Allen He,Xinchen Liu,Yongdong Zhang,Guoqing Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniPrism，一种面向创意生成的多概念解耦扩散模型，通过语言导向的对比正交训练与跨注意力注入，实现内容、风格、构图等多维度独立控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在多概念场景下易被无关概念干扰，导致概念混乱与生成质量下降，亟需统一框架实现语义解耦与精准重组。

Method: 1)构建PCD-200K成对解耦数据集（共享同一概念维度）；2)设计对比正交解耦(COD)训练流程，在多模态语义空间学习正交概念表示；3)将解耦向量注入扩散模型附加跨注意力层，并引入块级嵌入自适应不同概念域。

Result: 在PCD-200K与公开基准上，OmniPrism在FID、CLIPScore与人工评估中均优于单概念及多概念基线，实现高保真、概念纯净且文本一致的生成。

Conclusion: OmniPrism首次在多概念创意生成中实现语言导向的细粒度解耦与重组，为后续风格迁移、个性化编辑等应用奠定通用基础。

Abstract: Creative visual concept generation often draws inspiration from specific concepts in a reference image to produce relevant outcomes. However, existing methods are typically constrained to single-aspect concept generation or are easily disrupted by irrelevant concepts in multi-aspect concept scenarios, leading to concept confusion and hindering creative generation. To address this, we propose OmniPrism, a visual concept disentangling approach for creative image generation. Our method learns disentangled concept representations guided by natural language and trains a diffusion model to incorporate these concepts. We utilize the rich semantic space of a multimodal extractor to achieve concept disentanglement from given images and concept guidance. To disentangle concepts with different semantics, we construct a paired concept disentangled dataset (PCD-200K), where each pair shares the same concept such as content, style, and composition. We learn disentangled concept representations through our contrastive orthogonal disentangled (COD) training pipeline, which are then injected into additional diffusion cross-attention layers for generation. A set of block embeddings is designed to adapt each block's concept domain in the diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can generate high-quality, concept-disentangled results with high fidelity to text prompts and desired concepts.

</details>


### [148] [Growing a Multi-head Twig via Distillation and Reinforcement Learning to Accelerate Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14075)
*Zhenwei Shao,Mingyang Wang,Weijun Zhang,Zhou Yu,Wenwen Pan,Yan Yang,Tao Wei,Hongyuan Zhang,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TwigVLM 在基础 VLM 的浅层植入轻量级 twig 模块，用 twig 信号先裁剪视觉 token 再自投机解码，兼顾精度与长文本生成速度；TwigVLM++ 引入多头 twig+两阶段训练，把 LLaVA-1.5-7B 视觉 token 砍掉 88.9% 仍保持 96% 性能，长回答延迟降低 1.54×，优于现有加速方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于浅层注意力剪 token 的方法，因早期层注意力不敏感导致精度骤降，且面对长回答生成时加速效果有限，需要一种在不牺牲理解能力的同时进一步提高推理速度的新思路。

Method: 1) 在 VLM 浅层外挂可插拔轻量 twig 模块，生成更可靠的注意力图；2) Twig-guided Token Pruning (TTP) 依据该注意力删除冗余视觉 token；3) Self-Speculative Decoding (SSD) 利用 twig 提前预测后续 token，并行验证，减少自回归步长；4) TwigVLM++ 扩展为多头 twig，并增设专用剪枝头，通过“蒸馏预训练 + 剪枝导向强化学习”两阶段范式优化剪枝质量，再用树形投机解码加速整体推理。

Result: LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，TwigVLM 剪去 88.9% 视觉 token 后精度保持 96%，长回答生成速度提高 1.54×；TwigVLM++ 进一步提升剪枝准确率并显著降低延迟，在多项基准与检索、问答、描述等任务上均优于当前最优 VLM 加速方法。

Conclusion: 植入早期 twig 可为视觉 token 剪枝提供高保真信号，配合投机解码能同时缓解精度下降与长文本推理慢两大痛点，且架构简便易迁移，为 VLMs 在端侧部署提供了高效可行的新范式。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in open-world multimodal understanding, yet their high computational overheads pose great challenges for practical deployment. Some recent works have proposed methods to accelerate VLMs by pruning redundant visual tokens guided by the attention maps of VLM's early layers. Despite the success of these token pruning methods, they still suffer from two major shortcomings: (i) considerable accuracy drop due to insensitive attention signals in early layers, and (ii) limited speedup when generating long responses (e.g., 30 tokens). To address the limitations above, we present TwigVLM -- a simple and general architecture by growing a lightweight module, named twig, upon an early layer of the base VLM. Compared with most existing VLM acceleration methods purely based on visual token pruning, our TwigVLM not only achieves better accuracy retention by employing a twig-guided token pruning (TTP) strategy, but also yields higher generation speed by utilizing a self-speculative decoding (SSD) strategy. Taking LLaVA-1.5-7B as the base VLM, experimental results show that TwigVLM preserves 96% of the original performance after pruning 88.9% of the visual tokens and achieves 154% speedup in generating long responses, delivering significantly better performance in terms of both accuracy and speed over the state-of-the-art VLM acceleration methods. Moreover, we extend TwigVLM to an improved TwigVLM++ variant by introducing a novel multi-head twig architecture with a specialized pruning head. TwigVLM++ improves pruning quality via a two-stage training paradigm combining a distillation learning stage and a pruning-oriented reinforcement learning stage, and further accelerates inference via a tree-based SSD strategy.

</details>


### [149] [Chain-of-Zoom: Extreme Super-Resolution via Scale Autoregression and Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18600)
*Bryan Sangwoo Kim,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Chain-of-Zoom把任意现成的4× SR模型变成一个“递归放大镜”，不需再训练就能一路放大到256×以上，且用VLM生成文本提示来补偿高倍率下丢失的视觉线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图超分模型一旦超过训练倍率就崩溃，无法“无限”放大；传统做法需为高倍率重新训练或级联多个专用模型，成本高且难扩展。

Method: 提出模型无关框架CoZ：1) 将目标倍率因子分解为一系列中间倍率状态，用同一骨干SR模型自回归地逐级放大，把条件概率拆成可递推子问题；2) 每步用VLM生成多尺度感知文本提示，弥补高频信息缺失；3) 用GRPO+批判VLM微调提示提取器，使文本引导对齐人类偏好。

Result: 仅用标准4×扩散SR模型作骨干，CoZ实现>256×极端放大，PSNR/LPIPS及主观质量显著优于级联基线与zero-shot方法，细节保真且伪影少。

Conclusion: CoZ证明“递归放大+语言提示”是可行的高倍率SR范式，无需重训、硬件友好，为极端分辨率应用提供了即插即用的扩展方案。

Abstract: Modern single-image super-resolution (SISR) models deliver photo-realistic results at the scale factors on which they are trained, but collapse when asked to magnify far beyond that regime. We address this scalability bottleneck with Chain-of-Zoom (CoZ), a model-agnostic framework that factorizes SISR into an autoregressive chain of intermediate scale-states with multi-scale-aware prompts. CoZ repeatedly re-uses a backbone SR model, decomposing the conditional probability into tractable sub-problems to achieve extreme resolutions without additional training. Because visual cues diminish at high magnifications, we augment each zoom step with multi-scale-aware text prompts generated by a vision-language model (VLM). The prompt extractor itself is fine-tuned using Generalized Reward Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a critic VLM, aligning text guidance towards human preference. Experiments show that a standard 4x diffusion SR model wrapped in CoZ attains beyond 256x enlargement with high perceptual quality and fidelity. Project Page: https://bryanswkim.github.io/chain-of-zoom/.

</details>


### [150] [Gen-n-Val: Agentic Image Data Generation and Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04676)
*Jing-En Huang,I-Sheng Fang,Tzuhsuan Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Yu Wang,Jun-Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Agent化框架Gen-n-Val，用LLM+VLLM协同Layer Diffusion生成并筛检高质量单目标合成数据，显著降低噪声并提升稀有类检测/分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVIS等大词汇量基准中长尾类别样本极少，现有合成数据存在多目标掩膜、标注错位、类别错误等问题，无法有效缓解数据稀缺与标签噪声。

Method: 构建双Agent系统：(1)LD提示Agent用LLM迭代优化文本提示，驱动Layer Diffusion生成前景单一、掩膜精确的单目标图像；(2)数据验证Agent用VLLM对合成实例进行质量打分并剔除低质样本；两Agent的提示均通过TextGrad自动优化。

Result: 在LVIS稀有类上，Mask R-CNN实例分割AP提升7.6%；COCO稀有类上，YOLOv9c/YOLO11m mAP提升3.6%；开放词汇检测YOLO-Worldv2-M基准再提升7.1 mAP；同时将无效合成数据比例从50%降至7%，并展现模型与数据规模的良好扩展性。

Conclusion: Gen-n-Val首次把LLM、VLLM与扩散模型整合为端到端Agent闭环，显著抑制合成噪声，低成本扩充稀有类训练样本，为大词汇量、长尾及开放词汇视觉任务提供高效、可扩展的数据增广方案。

Abstract: The data scarcity, label noise, and long-tailed category imbalance remain important and unresolved challenges in many computer vision tasks, such as object detection and instance segmentation, especially on large-vocabulary benchmarks like LVIS, where most categories appear in only a few images. Current synthetic data generation methods still suffer from multiple objects per mask, inaccurate segmentation, incorrect category labels, and other issues, limiting their effectiveness. To address these issues, we introduce Gen-n-Val, a novel agentic data generation framework that leverages Layer Diffusion (LD), a Large Language Model (LLM), and a Vision Large Language Model (VLLM) to produce high-quality and diverse instance masks and images for object detection and instance segmentation.
