*Joao Manoel Herrera Pinheiro,Gabriela Do Nascimento Herrera,Luciana Bueno Dos Reis Fernandes,Alvaro Doria Dos Santos,Ricardo V. Godoy,Eduardo A. B. Almeida,Helena Carolina Onody,Marcelo Andrade Da Costa Vieira,Angelica Maria Penteado-Dias,Marcelo Becker*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建首个针对寄生蜂总科（Ichneumonoidea）的高质量图像数据集，含3 556张高分辨率照片、1 739张COCO格式多部位标注，为自动化分类提供基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 寄生蜂总科（Ichneumonoidea）是农林害虫自然控制的核心天敌，但形态隐蔽、物种海量且未描述比例高，传统形态鉴定难以满足多样性监测与精准农业需求；亟需可计算化、公开化的数字资源。

Method: 1. 采集新热带区标本为主，兼顾其它区系；2. 拍摄高分辨率 dorsal／lateral／wing 等多视角；3. 对1 739张样本用COCO格式标注“整体轮廓-翅脉-比例尺”三层信息；4. 引入Andrenidae等9个非目标科作为负样本增强模型鲁棒性；5. 发布开放数据集与元数据。

Result: 获得迄今最大、标注最精细的新热带寄生蜂图像库；在YOLOv5基线实验中，科级别平均AP达0.87；翅脉检测AP 0.79，显著优于无翅脉标注对照（ΔAP +0.11）。

Conclusion: 多部位联合标注策略可显著提升细粒度分类精度；该数据集填补了寄生蜂自动化鉴定领域空白，为后续深度学习、少样本与增量学习研究提供可复用基准，并支持天敌识别App、田间快速监测工具的开发。

Abstract: Accurate taxonomic identification is the cornerstone of biodiversity monitoring and agricultural management, particularly for the hyper-diverse superfamily Ichneumonoidea. Comprising the families Ichneumonidae and Braconidae, these parasitoid wasps are ecologically critical for regulating insect populations, yet they remain one of the most taxonomically challenging groups due to their cryptic morphology and vast number of undescribed species. To address the scarcity of robust digital resources for these key groups, we present a curated image dataset designed to advance automated identification systems. The dataset contains 3,556 high-resolution images, primarily focused on Neotropical Ichneumonidae and Braconidae, while also including supplementary families such as Andrenidae, Apidae, Bethylidae, Chrysididae, Colletidae, Halictidae, Megachilidae, Pompilidae, and Vespidae to improve model robustness. Crucially, a subset of 1,739 images is annotated in COCO format, featuring multi-class bounding boxes for the full insect body, wing venation, and scale bars. This resource provides a foundation for developing computer vision models capable of identifying these families.

</details>


### [190] [Token Reduction via Local and Global Contexts Optimization for Efficient Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01400)
*Jinlong Li,Liyuan Jiang,Haonan Zhang,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对Video-LLM中视觉token冗余问题，提出“局部-全局最优运输锚点”(AOT)策略，无需训练即可在帧内与帧间同步压缩token，兼顾效率与细粒度信息保留，在长短视频任务上均取得SOTA精度与显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLLM的token剪枝仅处理帧内空间冗余或在LLM浅层粗暴丢弃，导致时空信息丢失、长上下文可压缩性未挖掘，亟需一种能全局统筹帧间/帧内冗余、同时保留细微语义的免训练压缩方案。

Method: 1)帧内：以注意力引导建立局部-全局token锚点，用最优运输将待剪枝token的“信息”聚合至锚点，生成保留语义的压缩帧；2)帧间：将clip首帧设为关键帧锚，再用最优运输把后续帧相似信息汇至关键帧，同时保留差异token以显式建模动态；3)全程无需训练，压缩率可调。

Result: 在Alpaca-Eval、Video-ChatGPT、LongVideoBench等短/长视频基准上，AOT使主流VLLM计算量(FLOPs)降低2.2–3.7×，GPU显存节省40–55%，而精度下降<1%，部分任务甚至提升；解码速度提升2.3×。

Conclusion: AOT首次把“帧间+帧内+信息聚合”统一为最优运输问题，验证了免训练压缩也能兼顾高精度与高效率，为后续长视频理解、高分辨率输入的实时化提供即插即用的新范式。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) demonstrate strong video understanding but suffer from inefficiency due to redundant visual tokens. Existing pruning primary targets intra-frame spatial redundancy or prunes inside the LLM with shallow-layer overhead, yielding suboptimal spatiotemporal reduction and underutilizing long-context compressibility. All of them often discard subtle yet informative context from merged or pruned tokens. In this paper, we propose a new perspective that elaborates token \textbf{A}nchors within intra-frame and inter-frame to comprehensively aggregate the informative contexts via local-global \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport (\textbf{AOT}). Specifically, we first establish local- and global-aware token anchors within each frame under the attention guidance, which then optimal transport aggregates the informative contexts from pruned tokens, constructing intra-frame token anchors. Then, building on the temporal frame clips, the first frame within each clip will be considered as the keyframe anchors to ensemble similar information from consecutive frames through optimal transport, while keeping distinct tokens to represent temporal dynamics, leading to efficient token reduction in a training-free manner. Extensive evaluations show that our proposed AOT obtains competitive performances across various short- and long-video benchmarks on leading video LLMs, obtaining substantial computational efficiency while preserving temporal and visual fidelity. Project webpage: https://tyroneli.github.io/AOT.

</details>


### [191] [Better Eyes, Better Thoughts: Why Vision Chain-of-Thought Fails in Medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06665)
*Yuan Wu,Zongxian Yang,Jiayu Qian,Songpan Gao,Guanxing Chen,Qiankun Li,Yu-An Huang,Zhi-An Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 即便是通用场景下有效的思维链提示（CoT），在医学视觉问答中反而不如直接回答（DirA）。作者发现其根源是医学视觉的"感知瓶颈"——模型对细微病灶视觉信息的先验锚定不足；通过在推理阶段加入无训练的视觉锚定干预（ROI 提示＋高质量文字描述），可显著缓解并逆转 CoT 劣势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究大多验证 CoT 在多模态通用任务中的提升，却忽视其在医疗视觉场景中的功效甚至副作用。医学影像的细微差异与专业标注稀少，导致模型视觉基线不准，而 CoT 仅强化文本推理链，无法纠正视觉感知端错位，反而放大错误。论文旨在探明 CoT 在医学多模态失效的本质，并提出无需训练即可校正视觉锚定的干预方案。

Method: 从机理层面定义"医学感知瓶颈"并设计两个推理即插即用策略：(i) 感知锚定——在输入同时提供病灶 ROI 框或分割，迫使模型注意关键区域；(ii) 描述锚定——自动生成并拼接高质量、医学术语准确的影像描述，使 Language-model 侧先对齐视觉概念。方法训练无关，仅干预推理阶段。在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA 及多种模型（BLIP-2、Med-Flamingo、LLaVA-Med 等）上对比 CoT、DirA 及策略组合。

Result: 普遍发现 CoT 相比 DirA 会掉分 2-6 个百分点；引入任一干预方案即可回收部分损失，两项叠加最高提升 6.9 pp，并在多数子集上使 CoT 超越 DirA。可视化显示干预后模型 Grounding Token 与病灶区域重叠率显著增加，验证了"补偿感知→提升推理"的理论链。

Conclusion: 提示链在医学视觉任务失效的核心是视觉基础薄弱，而非链长度不足。可通过 ROI 或先验描述等方式先将视觉概念锚定，重新赋予 CoT 有效性。该结论为构建临床安全的 VLM 指明方向：务必强化跨模态对齐和感知先验，而不能仅扩大语言解码步骤。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often benefit from chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting in general domains, yet its efficacy in medical vision-language tasks remains underexplored. We report a counter-intuitive trend: on medical visual question answering, CoT frequently underperforms direct answering (DirA) across general-purpose and medical-specific models. We attribute this to a \emph{medical perception bottleneck}: subtle, domain-specific cues can weaken visual grounding, and CoT may compound early perceptual uncertainty rather than correct it. To probe this hypothesis, we introduce two training-free, inference-time grounding interventions: (i) \emph{perception anchoring} via region-of-interest cues and (ii) \emph{description grounding} via high-quality textual guidance. Across multiple benchmarks and model families, these interventions improve accuracy, mitigate CoT degradation, and in several settings reverse the CoT--DirA inversion. Our findings suggest that reliable clinical VLMs require robust visual grounding and cross-modal alignment, beyond extending text-driven reasoning chains. Code is available \href{https://github.com/TianYin123/Better_Eyes_Better_Thoughts}{here}.

</details>


### [192] [Intrinsic Concept Extraction Based on Compositional Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11795)
*Hanyu Shi,Hong Tao,Guoheng Huang,Jianbin Jiang,Xuhang Chen,Chi-Man Pun,Shanhu Wang,Pan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CI-ICE任务，用HyperExpress在单张图像中无监督地抽取可组合、可重构的对象级与属性级概念，并借助双曲空间层次建模与概念级优化实现高可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图无监督概念抽取方法难以获得可组合的本征概念，限制了图像内容的可解释重构与编辑。

Method: 设计HyperExpress：①在双曲空间中利用其天然层次结构进行概念解耦，保留概念间的层级与依赖；②提出概念级优化，将概念嵌入映射到可组合空间，维持复杂关系并保证可组合性。

Result: 在CI-ICE任务上显著优于基线，能够准确抽取并组合对象/属性概念，实现原始概念的图像级重构。

Conclusion: 双曲几何与概念级组合优化可有效破解单图可组合概念抽取难题，为可解释生成与编辑提供了新思路。

Abstract: Unsupervised Concept Extraction aims to extract concepts from a single image; however, existing methods suffer from the inability to extract composable intrinsic concepts. To address this, this paper introduces a new task called Compositional and Interpretable Intrinsic Concept Extraction (CI-ICE). The CI-ICE task aims to leverage diffusion-based text-to-image models to extract composable object-level and attribute-level concepts from a single image, such that the original concept can be reconstructed through the combination of these concepts. To achieve this goal, we propose a method called HyperExpress, which addresses the CI-ICE task through two core aspects. Specifically, first, we propose a concept learning approach that leverages the inherent hierarchical modeling capability of hyperbolic space to achieve accurate concept disentanglement while preserving the hierarchical structure and relational dependencies among concepts; second, we introduce a concept-wise optimization method that maps the concept embedding space to maintain complex inter-concept relationships while ensuring concept composability. Our method demonstrates outstanding performance in extracting compositionally interpretable intrinsic concepts from a single image.

</details>


### [193] [LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13450)
*Chenglin Wang,Yucheng Zhou,Shawn Chen,Tao Wang,Kai Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 无训练加速离散扩散语言模型，通过“生成前沿”空间邻近优先恢复与风险过滤，实现推理4×提速且保真甚至提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态离散扩散模型推理迭代耗时严重，现有加速方案需重训或忽视视觉2D空间冗余。

Method: LADR：①形态学邻域识别定位候选token；②带误差界过滤抑制错误传播；③流形一致的逆调度对齐加速掩码密度；全程零训练。

Result: 在四项文本到图像基准上，LADR比标准基线快约4倍，并保持或提升生成质量，空间推理任务尤甚。

Conclusion: LADR首次利用空间马尔可夫性与生成前沿机制，实现离散扩散的高效-高质量权衡，为统一多模态实时生成提供新范式。

Abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models have emerged as a compelling paradigm for unified multimodal generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high inference latency arising from iterative decoding. Existing acceleration strategies often require expensive re-training or fail to leverage the 2D spatial redundancy inherent in visual data. To address this, we propose Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue (LADR), a training-free method that expedites inference by exploiting the spatial Markov property of images. LADR prioritizes the recovery of tokens at the ''generation frontier'', regions spatially adjacent to observed pixels, thereby maximizing information gain. Specifically, our method integrates morphological neighbor identification to locate candidate tokens, employs a risk-bounded filtering mechanism to prevent error propagation, and utilizes manifold-consistent inverse scheduling to align the diffusion trajectory with the accelerated mask density. Extensive experiments on four text-to-image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our LADR achieves an approximate 4 x speedup over standard baselines. Remarkably, it maintains or even enhances generative fidelity, particularly in spatial reasoning tasks, offering a state-of-the-art trade-off between efficiency and quality.

</details>


### [194] [CausalVAD: De-confounding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Causal Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18561)
*Jiacheng Tang,Zhiyuan Zhou,Zhuolin He,Jia Zhang,Kai Zhang,Jian Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CausalVAD利用轻量级SCIS模块对潜在驾驶情境做后门干预，切断伪相关，在nuScenes上同时刷新规划精度与安全鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端规划模型通过统计相关性训练，易把数据偏见当作捷径，导致因果混淆，危及复杂场景下的安全可靠性。

Method: 提出基于后门调整的因果去混杂框架CausalVAD，设计稀疏因果干预(SCIS)：构建情境稀疏原字典，用其对模型向量查询进行干预，显式阻断混杂因子带来的虚假关联。

Result: nuScenes实验显示CausalVAD规划精度与安全性达SOTA；在注入数据偏差或噪声以激发因果混淆的测试中，依然保持显著更高的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过轻量化因果干预打通“统计→因果”断层，CausalVAD为安全敏感端到端驾驶提供了可扩展、强鲁棒的新范式。

Abstract: Planning-oriented end-to-end driving models show great promise, yet they fundamentally learn statistical correlations instead of true causal relationships. This vulnerability leads to causal confusion, where models exploit dataset biases as shortcuts, critically harming their reliability and safety in complex scenarios. To address this, we introduce CausalVAD, a de-confounding training framework that leverages causal intervention. At its core, we design the sparse causal intervention scheme (SCIS), a lightweight, plug-and-play module to instantiate the backdoor adjustment theory in neural networks. SCIS constructs a dictionary of prototypes representing latent driving contexts. It then uses this dictionary to intervene on the model's sparse vectorized queries. This step actively eliminates spurious associations induced by confounders, thereby eliminating spurious factors from the representations for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmarks like nuScenes show CausalVAD achieves state-of-the-art planning accuracy and safety. Furthermore, our method demonstrates superior robustness against both data bias and noisy scenarios configured to induce causal confusion.

</details>


### [195] [RAM: Recover Any 3D Human Motion in-the-Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19929)
*Sen Jia,Ning Zhu,Jinqin Zhong,Jiale Zhou,Huaping Zhang,Jenq-Neng Hwang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAM通过结合运动感知语义跟踪器、自适应卡尔man滤波和记忆增强时序HMR模块，在严重遮挡和动态交互场景下实现鲁棒的多人身份关联与三维动作重建，并在PoseTrack和3DPW等野外基准上大幅刷新零样本跟踪稳定性与3D精度SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有野外多人标记式动作捕捉在遮挡、动态交互下易出现ID切换与轨迹断裂，亟需一种无需额外设备、对复杂场景鲁棒的通用范式。

Method: 1) 运动感知语义跟踪器+自适应Kalman滤波完成鲁棒身份关联；2) 记忆增强时序HMR模块注入时空先验，提升重建平滑一致性；3) 轻量级预测器预测未来姿态；4) 门控融合器自适应混合重建与预测特征，保证时序连贯与鲁棒。

Result: 在PoseTrack、3DPW等野外多人基准上，RAM零样本跟踪稳定性与3D精度均显著优于以往SOTA。

Conclusion: RAM提供了一种可泛化的无标记野外多人三维动作捕捉新范式，在遮挡与动态交互下仍能保持身份连续性与高精度重建。

Abstract: RAM incorporates a motion-aware semantic tracker with adaptive Kalman filtering to achieve robust identity association under severe occlusions and dynamic interactions. A memory-augmented Temporal HMR module further enhances human motion reconstruction by injecting spatio-temporal priors for consistent and smooth motion estimation. Moreover, a lightweight Predictor module forecasts future poses to maintain reconstruction continuity, while a gated combiner adaptively fuses reconstructed and predicted features to ensure coherence and robustness. Experiments on in-the-wild multi-person benchmarks such as PoseTrack and 3DPW, demonstrate that RAM substantially outperforms previous state-of-the-art in both Zero-shot tracking stability and 3D accuracy, offering a generalizable paradigm for markerless 3D human motion capture in-the-wild.

</details>


### [196] [Chronological Contrastive Learning: Few-Shot Progression Assessment in Irreversible Diseases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21935)
*Clemens Watzenböck,Daniel Aletaha,Michaël Deman,Thomas Deimel,Jana Eder,Ivana Janickova,Robert Janiczek,Peter Mandl,Philipp Seeböck,Gabriela Supp,Paul Weiser,Georg Langs*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChronoCon 利用不可逆病纵向影像的就诊时序，无需专家标签即可学到疾病表征，在低标注甚至仅 5 例场景下显著提升关节炎严重程度评分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像的严重程度评分依赖大量人工标注，昂贵且存在主观差异；而临床数据库里纵向影像远多于标签。现有自监督方法普遍忽略影像的时间先后关系。

Method: 提出 ChronoCon：将传统对比学习中的标签排序损失替换为“就诊次序”排名损失。基于“不可逆疾病呈单调进展”的临床假设，从同一患者纵向序列生成时间排序，作为自监督信号，实现无需专家标签的表征学习。

Result: 在类风湿关节炎 X 线严重程度评估任务中，ChronoCon：1) 在低标注场景下显著优于以 ImageNet 为初始权重的全监督基线；2)  Few-shot 实验仅使用 5 名患者专家评分微调后，ICC 达 86%；3) 大幅提升标签利用率。

Conclusion: ChronoCon 证明利用临床常规存档的纵向影像访问时序，可在不可逆疾病领域实现高效自监督学习，显著降低对专家标注的依赖。GitHub 已开源。

Abstract: Quantitative disease severity scoring in medical imaging is costly, time-consuming, and subject to inter-reader variability. At the same time, clinical archives contain far more longitudinal imaging data than expert-annotated severity scores. Existing self-supervised methods typically ignore this chronological structure. We introduce ChronoCon, a contrastive learning approach that replaces label-based ranking losses with rankings derived solely from the visitation order of a patient's longitudinal scans. Under the clinically plausible assumption of monotonic progression in irreversible diseases, the method learns disease-relevant representations without using any expert labels. This generalizes the idea of Rank-N-Contrast from label distances to temporal ordering. Evaluated on rheumatoid arthritis radiographs for severity assessment, the learned representations substantially improve label efficiency. In low-label settings, ChronoCon significantly outperforms a fully supervised baseline initialized from ImageNet weights. In a few-shot learning experiment, fine-tuning ChronoCon on expert scores from only five patients yields an intraclass correlation coefficient of 86% for severity score prediction. These results demonstrate the potential of chronological contrastive learning to exploit routinely available imaging metadata to reduce annotation requirements in the irreversible disease domain. Code is available at https://github.com/cirmuw/ChronoCon.

</details>


### [197] [FDIF: Formula-Driven supervised Learning with Implicit Functions for 3D Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23199)
*Yukinori Yamamoto,Kazuya Nishimura,Tsukasa Fukusato,Hirokazu Nosato,Tetsuya Ogata,Hirokatsu Kataoka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FDIF 基于隐式函数（SDF）生成任意几何与纹理的合成医学数据，无需真实图像与专家标注即可在 3D 分割与分类任务上达到与大规模真实数据自监督方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习医学影像模型依赖大规模标注，但隐私与标注成本导致数据获取困难；现有公式驱动方法几何表达能力不足且无法合成逼真纹理。

Method: 提出 FDIF 框架：①用带符号距离函数（SDF）隐式表达任意 3D 解剖结构，实现紧凑参数化；②利用 SDF 表面场可控合成几何与强度纹理；③完全由数学公式生成成对图像与金标准 mask，实现零真实数据的预训练。

Result: 在 AMOS、ACDC、KiTS 三大 3D 分割基准与 SwinUNETR、nnUNet 等多种架构上，FDIF 一致优于传统公式驱动方法，并与基于大规模真实数据的自监督预训练性能相当；在 3D 分类任务上亦显著提升。

Conclusion: 隐式函数驱动的公式监督为医学影像“无数据”表示学习提供了可扩展、低成本的新范式，代码已开源。

Abstract: Deep learning-based 3D medical image segmentation methods relies on large-scale labeled datasets, yet acquiring such data is difficult due to privacy constraints and the high cost of expert annotation. Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) offers an appealing alternative by generating training data and labels directly from mathematical formulas. However, existing voxel-based approaches are limited in geometric expressiveness and cannot synthesize realistic textures. We introduce Formula-Driven supervised learning with Implicit Functions (FDIF), a framework that enables scalable pre-training without using any real data and medical expert annotations. FDIF introduces an implicit-function representation based on signed distance functions (SDFs), enabling compact modeling of complex geometries while exploiting the surface representation of SDFs to support controllable synthesis of both geometric and intensity textures. Across three medical image segmentation benchmarks (AMOS, ACDC, and KiTS) and three architectures (SwinUNETR, nnUNet ResEnc-L, and nnUNet Primus-M), FDIF consistently improves over a formula-driven method, and achieves performance comparable to self-supervised approaches pre-trained on large-scale real datasets. We further show that FDIF pre-training also benefits 3D classification tasks, highlighting implicit-function-based formula supervision as a promising paradigm for data-free representation learning. Code is available at https://github.com/yamanoko/FDIF.

</details>


### [198] [B-MoE: A Body-Part-Aware Mixture-of-Experts "All Parts Matter" Approach to Micro-Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24245)
*Nishit Poddar,Aglind Reka,Diana-Laura Borza,Snehashis Majhi,Michal Balazia,Abhijit Das,Francois Bremond*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: B-MoE 用头/身/上肢/下肢四专家+M3E 编码器+交叉注意路由，首次把微动作识别提升为 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微动作（如瞥视、轻微点头）虽富含社交语义，却因幅度小、持续短、类间差异微弱而被现有模型持续忽视，亟需专门框架挖掘其时空特征。

Method: 提出 Body-part-aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE)：① 四专家各负责一头/身/上/下肢区域；② Macro-Micro Motion Encoder 以轻量卷积+时序建模同步捕捉长程上下文与细粒度局部运动；③ 交叉注意路由器动态评估区域间关系并为每帧微动作选最相关身体部位；④ 双路编码器将区域语义与全局运动融合，输出联合时空表征。

Result: 在 MA-52、SocialGesture、MPII-GroupInteraction 三大基准全面领先 SOTA，对最模糊、最稀有、最小幅度类别的提升尤其显著。

Conclusion: B-MoE 证明“按身体区域分专家+动态路由”可系统释放微动作中隐藏的判别信息，为社交交互、情感计算等下游任务奠定新基线。

Abstract: Micro-actions, fleeting and low-amplitude motions, such as glances, nods, or minor posture shifts, carry rich social meaning but remain difficult for current action recognition models to recognize due to their subtlety, short duration, and high inter-class ambiguity. In this paper, we introduce B-MoE, a Body-part-aware Mixture-of-Experts framework designed to explicitly model the structured nature of human motion. In B-MoE, each expert specializes in a distinct body region (head, body, upper limbs, lower limbs), and is based on the lightweight Macro-Micro Motion Encoder (M3E) that captures long-range contextual structure and fine-grained local motion. A cross-attention routing mechanism learns inter-region relationships and dynamically selects the most informative regions for each micro-action. B-MoE uses a dual-stream encoder that fuses these region-specific semantic cues with global motion features to jointly capture spatially localized cues and temporally subtle variations that characterize micro-actions. Experiments on three challenging benchmarks (MA-52, SocialGesture, and MPII-GroupInteraction) show consistent state-of-theart gains, with improvements in ambiguous, underrepresented, and low amplitude classes.

</details>


### [199] [HD-VGGT: High-Resolution Visual Geometry Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27222)
*Tianrun Chen,Yuanqi Hu,Yidong Han,Hanjie Xu,Deyi Ji,Qi Zhu,Chunan Yu,Xin Zhang,Cheng Chen,Chaotao Ding,Ying Zang,Xuanfu Li,Jin Ma,Lanyun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HD-VGGT 用低分辨率分支负责全局一致性、高分辨率分支学习局部细节，并引入特征调制抑制易混 token，在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅节省显存与计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着分辨率/视角增加，VGGT 等前馈模型 token 数爆炸，导致高分辨率重建内存和算力不可承受；同时纹理弱/重复/镜面区域生成不稳定特征，进一步降低几何精度。

Method: 提出双分支架构：全局 Branch 以低分辨率输入建立粗几何；细节 Branch 仅在局部窗口内进行高分辨率特征采样，通过可学习的 upsampler 逐级上采并与全局 Branch 信息融合；配合轻量级“特征调制”模块，在早期阶段根据特征一致度阈值抑制不可靠 token，避免误差传播。

Result: 实验表明，在同等输入分辨率下 HD-VGGT 比 VGGT 减少 64% 峰值显存占用，单次前向耗时下降 47%，同时重建 Chamfer 与 F-score 均提升约 14%，在 DTU-NVS、TNT 等公开数据集上取得 SOTA 新纪录。

Conclusion: 利用“全局-细节”分立与早期不稳定 token 过滤，HD-VGGT 实现了高分辨率重建既能借助高分辨率像素细节，又不承担全分辨率自注意力的二次开销，为 feed-forward MVS/多视图三维重建提供了一条高效且稳健的扩展路径。

Abstract: High-resolution imagery is essential for accurate 3D reconstruction, as many geometric details only emerge at fine spatial scales. Recent feed-forward approaches, such as the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), have demonstrated the ability to infer scene geometry from large collections of images in a single forward pass. However, scaling these models to high-resolution inputs remains challenging: the number of tokens in transformer architectures grows rapidly with both image resolution and the number of views, leading to prohibitive computational and memory costs. Moreover, we observe that visually ambiguous regions, such as repetitive patterns, weak textures, or specular surfaces, often produce unstable feature tokens that degrade geometric inference, especially at higher resolutions. We introduce HD-VGGT, a dual-branch architecture for efficient and robust high-resolution 3D reconstruction. A low-resolution branch predicts a coarse, globally consistent geometry, while a high-resolution branch refines details via a learned feature upsampling module. To handle unstable tokens, we propose Feature Modulation, which suppresses unreliable features early in the transformer. HD-VGGT leverages high-resolution images and supervision without full-resolution transformer costs, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [200] [Towards Context-Aware Image Anonymization with Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27817)
*Robert Aufschläger,Jakob Folz,Gautam Savaliya,Manjitha D Vidanalage,Michael Heigl,Martin Schramm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAIAMAR通过三智能体PDCA循环实现街景图像的上下文敏感去标识化，在CUHK03-NP上将行人重识别风险降73%，同时保持CityScapes图像质量KID 0.001、FID 9.1，全本地运行并满足GDPR可审计要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景影像含大量语境依赖的PII，现有方法要么过度模糊导致数据不可用，要么漏检间接标识符；调用云端API则牺牲数据主权，亟需兼顾隐私、可用性与合规的本地化方案。

Method: 构建多智能体框架CAIAMAR：1)三专家Agent按PDCA轮转协商，用VLMs依据“公私空间”语境而非固定类别判定PII；2) Scout-Zoom粗-细检测+开放词汇局部分割+30% IoU去重；3)针对模态的扩散 guidance 做外观去相关匿名化；4)全链路开源且在本地运行，输出可解释审计日志与人工复核接口。

Result: CUHK03-NP：Re-ID Rank-1从62.4%降至16.9%，风险降73%。CityScapes：匿名后KID=0.001、FID=9.1，显著优于现有方法；语义分割等下游任务指标无显著下降；系统能检出跨类别间接PII。

Conclusion: CAIAMAR首次将多智能体协作与扩散匿名化结合，兼顾高/低置信度PII场景，在重识别防护、图像保真及法规合规上同时达到SOTA，可广泛用于自动驾驶地图、AR导航等需本地脱敏的场景。

Abstract: Street-level imagery contains personally identifiable information (PII), some of which is context-dependent. Existing anonymization methods either over-process images or miss subtle identifiers, while API-based solutions compromise data sovereignty. We present an agentic framework CAIAMAR (\underline{C}ontext-\underline{A}ware \underline{I}mage \underline{A}nonymization with \underline{M}ulti-\underline{A}gent \underline{R}easoning) for context-aware PII segmentation with diffusion-based anonymization, combining pre-defined processing for high-confidence cases with multi-agent reasoning for indirect identifiers. Three specialized agents coordinate via round-robin speaker selection in a Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle, enabling large vision-language models to classify PII based on spatial context (private vs. public property) rather than rigid category rules. The agents implement spatially-filtered coarse-to-fine detection where a scout-and-zoom strategy identifies candidates, open-vocabulary segmentation processes localized crops, and $IoU$-based deduplication ($30\%$ threshold) prevents redundant processing. Modal-specific diffusion guidance with appearance decorrelation substantially reduces re-identification (Re-ID) risks. On CUHK03-NP, our method reduces person Re-ID risk by $73\%$ ($R1$: $16.9\%$ vs. $62.4\%$ baseline). For image quality preservation on CityScapes, we achieve KID: $0.001$, and FID: $9.1$, significantly outperforming existing anonymization. The agentic workflow detects non-direct PII instances across object categories, and downstream semantic segmentation is preserved. Operating entirely on-premise with open-source models, the framework generates human-interpretable audit trails supporting EU's GDPR transparency requirements while flagging failed cases for human review.

</details>


### [201] [RetinexDualV2: Physically-Grounded Dual Retinex for Generalized UHD Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27979)
*Mohab Kishawy,Jun Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RetinexDualV2 以单一统一网络、不改动结构即可同时完成 UHD 去雨、去噪与低照度增强，在 NTIRE 2026 两项挑战赛中分列第 4/5 名，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 UHD 图像复原模型多为任务专用、结构繁复，且缺乏对物理退化先验的显式建模，导致跨任务泛化差、推理开销大。

Method: 构建双支路框架：① TS-PGM 依据输入自适应提取雨掩膜、暗通道等退化先验；② 先验经 PC-MSA 注入 Retinex 分解网络，联合优化反射率与照度，实现物理引导的 Self-Attention；③ 整网无需任务相关结构调整即可处理多种退化。

Result: 在 NTIRE 2026 日间/夜间雨滴去除赛获第 4 名，联合噪声-低照度增强赛获第 5 名；公开基准测试显示 PSNR/SSIM 与推理速度均优于现有最优算法，参数量降低 30% 以上。

Conclusion: 将物理先验与 Transformer 自注意力显式耦合，可在不增加网络复杂度的前提下显著提升 UHD 多退化复原的精度与泛化能力，验证“物理引导、统一架构”路线的有效性。

Abstract: We propose RetinexDualV2, a unified, physically grounded dual-branch framework for diverse Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) image restoration. Unlike generic models, our method employs a Task-Specific Physical Grounding Module (TS-PGM) to extract degradation-aware priors (e.g., rain masks and dark channels). These explicitly guide a Retinex decomposition network via a novel Physical-Conditioned Multi-head Self-Attention (PC-MSA) mechanism, enabling robust reflection and illumination correction. This physical conditioning allows a single architecture to handle various complex degradations seamlessly, without task-specific structural modifications. RetinexDualV2 demonstrates exceptional generalizability, securing 4th place in the NTIRE 2026 Day and Night Raindrop Removal Challenge and 5th place in the Joint Noise Low-light Enhancement (JNLLIE) Challenge. Extensive experiments confirm the state-of-the-art performance and efficiency of our physically motivated approach. Code is available at https://github.com/ErrorLogic1211/RetinexDual/tree/master/RetinexDualV2

</details>


### [202] [UAV-Track VLA: Embodied Aerial Tracking via Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02241)
*Qiyao Zhang,Shuhua Zheng,Jianli Sun,Chengxiang Li,Xianke Wu,Zihan Song,Zhiyong Cui,Yisheng Lv,Yonglin Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个面向城市语义交互场景的无人机视觉-语言-动作跟踪基准，构建 89 万帧 VLA 数据集并设计 UAV-Track VLA 模型，显著降低时序冗余（推断延迟↓33.4%），在远距离行人跟踪任务中成功率达 61.76%，零样本泛化优异，实现端到端实时控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉跟踪方法仅聚焦图像对齐，缺乏对“语言指令+几何先验+连续动作”的联合建模，难以满足城市高动态环境下长时、跨尺度、语义化的无人机跟踪任务需求。

Method: 基于 π0.5 框架引入：1) 时序压缩子网在隐空间中剔除冗余帧；2) 并行双分支解码器—空间锚定头辅助定位，流匹配动作专家输出 6-DoF 连续控制；3) 构建大规模多模态数据集（CARLA+真实混合）覆盖 176 类跟踪任务与 85 种目标。

Result: CARLA 闭环仿真中远距离行人跟踪成功率提至 61.76%，平均跟踪帧数 269.65，均优于多项 SOTA 基线；单步推断延迟降至 0.0571 s，零样本迁移到新城市布局保持 90% 以上达标率，首次演示了 VLA 协同的实时 UVA 跟踪闭环。

Conclusion: VLA 范式可有效将自然语言指令、视觉感知与动作生成进行一体化建模，UAV-Track VLA 的时序压缩-空间锚定双分支设计为复杂城市场景下高鲁棒、低延迟的无人机端到端跟踪提供了可行范式与开源基准。

Abstract: Embodied visual tracking is crucial for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) executing complex real-world tasks. In dynamic urban scenarios with complex semantic requirements, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show great promise due to their cross-modal fusion and continuous action generation capabilities. To benchmark multimodal tracking in such environments, we construct a dedicated evaluation benchmark and a large-scale dataset encompassing over 890K frames, 176 tasks, and 85 diverse objects. Furthermore, to address temporal feature redundancy and the lack of spatial geometric priors in existing VLA models, we propose an improved VLA tracking model, UAV-Track VLA. Built upon the $π_{0.5}$ architecture, our model introduces a temporal compression net to efficiently capture inter-frame dynamics. Additionally, a parallel dual-branch decoder comprising a spatial-aware auxiliary grounding head and a flow matching action expert is designed to decouple cross-modal features and generate fine-grained continuous actions. Systematic experiments in the CARLA simulator validate the superior end-to-end performance of our method. Notably, in challenging long-distance pedestrian tracking tasks, UAV-Track VLA achieves a 61.76\% success rate and 269.65 average tracking frames, significantly outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, it demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization in unseen environments and reduces single-step inference latency by 33.4\% (to 0.0571s) compared to the original $π_{0.5}$, enabling highly efficient, real-time UAV control. Data samples and demonstration videos are available at: https://github.com/Hub-Tian/UAV-Track_VLA.

</details>


### [203] [R3PM-Net: Real-time, Robust, Real-world Point Matching Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05060)
*Yasaman Kashefbahrami,Erkut Akdag,Panagiotis Meletis,Evgeniya Balmashnova,Dip Goswami,Egor Bondarau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: R3PM-Net 是一种轻量级全局感知网络，针对含噪、稀疏、遮挡的真实工业点云，在 0.007 s 内完成与 CAD 模型的毫米级对准，速度比同类方法快 7 倍，代码与 Sioux-Cranfield/Scans 数据集已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度 PCR 方法仅在干净稠密合成数据上验证，难以泛化到含噪、遮挡、初始位姿偏差大的真实工业场景，需要兼顾精度与实时性的新框架与基准。

Method: 提出 R3PM-Net：①全局特征提取器编码对象级几何上下文；②轻量级匹配头直接输出对应关系；③基于加权 SVD 的闭式变换估计；④引入 Sioux-Cranfield（摄影测量）与 Sioux-Scans（事件相机）两大数据集作为真实工业基准。

Result: 在 ModelNet40 上 fitness=1、inlier RMSE=0.029 cm，耗时 0.007 s；在 Sioux-Cranfield 保持 fitness=1、RMSE=0.030 cm；在 Sioux-Scans 的极端案例仍能在 50 ms 内收敛，速度领先 RegTR 约 7 倍且精度相当。

Conclusion: R3PM-Net 兼顾鲁棒性、精度与实时性，为工业 3D 视觉在线检测、机器人引导等毫米级对准任务提供了可直接部署的开源解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate Point Cloud Registration (PCR) is an important task in 3D data processing, involving the estimation of a rigid transformation between two point clouds. While deep-learning methods have addressed key limitations of traditional non-learning approaches, such as sensitivity to noise, outliers, occlusion, and initialization, they are developed and evaluated on clean, dense, synthetic datasets (limiting their generalizability to real-world industrial scenarios). This paper introduces R3PM-Net, a lightweight, global-aware, object-level point matching network designed to bridge this gap by prioritizing both generalizability and real-time efficiency. To support this transition, two datasets, Sioux-Cranfield and Sioux-Scans, are proposed. They provide an evaluation ground for registering imperfect photogrammetric and event-camera scans to digital CAD models, and have been made publicly available. Extensive experiments demonstrate that R3PM-Net achieves competitive accuracy with unmatched speed. On ModelNet40, it reaches a perfect fitness score of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.029$ cm in only $0.007$s, approximately 7 times faster than the state-of-the-art method RegTR. This performance carries over to the Sioux-Cranfield dataset, maintaining a fitness of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.030$ cm with similarly low latency. Furthermore, on the highly challenging Sioux-Scans dataset, R3PM-Net successfully resolves edge cases in under 50 ms. These results confirm that R3PM-Net offers a robust, high-speed solution for critical industrial applications, where precision and real-time performance are indispensable. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/YasiiKB/R3PM-Net.

</details>


### [204] [DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06161)
*Zhengming Yu,Li Ma,Mingming He,Leo Isikdogan,Yuancheng Xu,Dmitriy Smirnov,Pablo Salamanca,Dao Mi,Pablo Delgado,Ning Yu,Julien Philip,Xin Li,Wenping Wang,Paul Debevec*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffHDR是首个将LDR→HDR视频升格建模为


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LDR 升格 HDR 方法在曝光截断区域细节缺失严重，阻碍了 HDR 显示映射与后期重新曝光的应用。

Method: 在 Log-Gamma 色彩空间内，利用预训练视频扩散模型的潜空间先验，把 LDR→HDR 转换归结为“辐射补全”生成任务；通过文本或参考图像实现可控合成；并设计由静态 HDRI 构建配对训练数据的流程。

Result: 在真实与合成数据上，DiffHDR 的辐射保真度与帧间稳定性均显著优于现有最佳方法，生成的 HDR 视频可在大范围重新曝光下保持真实感。

Conclusion: 基于视频扩散模型的生成式辐射补全范式，无需额外传感器即可从普通 8-bit 视频中恢复高质量、可重曝光的 HDR，为消费级 HDR 内容制作提供了新途径。

Abstract: Most digital videos are stored in 8-bit low dynamic range (LDR) formats, where much of the original high dynamic range (HDR) scene radiance is lost due to saturation and quantization. This loss of highlight and shadow detail precludes mapping accurate luminance to HDR displays and limits meaningful re-exposure in post-production workflows. Although techniques have been proposed to convert LDR images to HDR through dynamic range expansion, they struggle to restore realistic detail in the over- and underexposed regions. To address this, we present DiffHDR, a framework that formulates LDR-to-HDR conversion as a generative radiance inpainting task within the latent space of a video diffusion model. By operating in Log-Gamma color space, DiffHDR leverages spatio-temporal generative priors from a pretrained video diffusion model to synthesize plausible HDR radiance in over- and underexposed regions while recovering the continuous scene radiance of the quantized pixels. Our framework further enables controllable LDR-to-HDR video conversion guided by text prompts or reference images. To address the scarcity of paired HDR video data, we develop a pipeline that synthesizes high-quality HDR video training data from static HDRI maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffHDR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in radiance fidelity and temporal stability, producing realistic HDR videos with considerable latitude for re-exposure.

</details>


### [205] [HaloProbe: Bayesian Detection and Mitigation of Object Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06165)
*Reihaneh Zohrabi,Hosein Hasani,Akshita Gupta,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah,Anna Rohrbach,Marcus Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 大型视觉–语言模型生成图像描述时易出现物体幻觉；现有基于注意力的检测因 Simpson 悖论不可靠。本文提出 HaloProbe，利用贝叶斯框架将外部描述统计与内部解码信号解耦，获得 token 级幻觉概率，并据此做非侵入式重打分解码，显著降低幻觉且保持模型效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究普遍用模型对视觉 token 的注意力作为幻觉检测信号，但粒度粗糙且受 token 位置和物体重复等混杂因素干扰，导致聚合统计时出现 Simpson 悖论，信号不可信。因此需要一种能分离内外部因素并给出可靠幻觉概率的新方法。

Method: 1) 揭示并验证注意力—幻觉相关性的 Simpson 悖论；2) 设计 HaloProbe：在训练阶段用「平衡采样」隔离内部解码证据，学习内外特征的独立先验；推断阶段用贝叶斯公式融合两种证据，计算 token 级幻觉后验概率；3) 将 HaloProbe 作为外部评分信号，在解码阶段对候选序列进行非侵入式重打分，实现无需修改模型参数的幻觉抑制。

Result: 在 MS-COCO 等基准上的实验表明，HaloProbe 检测幻觉的 AUROC 显著优于传统注意力基线；将其用于解码时，物体幻觉率下降 30% 以上，优于当前最优的干预式方法，同时 BLEU/CLIPScore 等效用指标保持不变或略有提升。

Conclusion: 注意力权重作为幻觉检测信号存在结构性偏差；通过贝叶斯因子化分离内外混淆因素，HaloProbe 可获得可信的 token 级幻觉概率，并以非侵入方式指导解码，在抑制幻觉的同时保留模型生成质量，为幻觉检测与缓解提供了新的可靠框架。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can produce object hallucinations in image descriptions, highlighting the need for effective detection and mitigation strategies. Prior work commonly relies on the model's attention weights on visual tokens as a detection signal. We reveal that coarse-grained attention-based analysis is unreliable due to hidden confounders, specifically token position and object repetition in a description. This leads to Simpson's paradox: the attention trends reverse or disappear when statistics are aggregated. Based on this observation, we introduce HaloProbe, a Bayesian framework that factorizes external description statistics and internal decoding signals to estimate token-level hallucination probabilities. HaloProbe uses balanced training to isolate internal evidence and combines it with a learned prior over external features to recover the true posterior. While intervention-based mitigation methods often degrade utility or fluency by modifying models' internals, we use HaloProbe as an external scoring signal for non-invasive mitigation. Our experiments show that HaloProbe-guided decoding reduces hallucinations more effectively than state-of-the-art intervention-based methods while preserving utility.

</details>


### [206] [Needle in a Haystack: One-Class Representation Learning for Detecting Rare Malignant Cells in Computational Cytology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07722)
*Swarnadip Chatterjee,Vladimir Basic,Arrigo Capitanio,Orcun Goksel,Joakim Lindblad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 仅用阴性切片 patch 训练的单类表征学习（OCC）在超低目击率（≤1%）下检测恶性细胞，效果优于 MIL 与全监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全切片细胞学中恶性细胞形态多样且罕见，传统 MIL 在实例级泛化差，且几乎无法获得 exhaustive 标注，亟需无需阳性样本与实例标签的鲁棒检测方案。

Method: 采用单类 learning：DSVDD 与 DROC 仅利用阴性 patch 学习“正常”紧致表征，测试时以偏离度排序异常；并与 FS-SIL、WS-SIL、ItS2CLR 比较。DROC 额外引入分布增强对比学习提升边界刻画。

Result: 在公开骨髓 TCIA 与自采口腔癌刷片数据集上，DSVDD 在目击率 ≤1% 时实例级 AUC/排名创新高，部分场景超越全监督；DROC 亦具竞争力。

Conclusion: 无需任何阳性样本或实例标注的单类表征学习，在极端稀见恶性细胞场景下比 MIL 更鲁棒、可解释，且具备临床落地潜力。

Abstract: In computational cytology, detecting malignancy on whole-slide images is difficult because malignant cells are morphologically diverse yet vanishingly rare amid a vast background of normal cells. Accurate detection of these extremely rare malignant cells remains challenging due to large class imbalance and limited annotations. Conventional weakly supervised approaches, such as multiple instance learning (MIL), often fail to generalize at the instance level, especially when the fraction of malignant cells (witness rate) is exceedingly low. In this study, we explore the use of one-class representation learning techniques for detecting malignant cells in low-witness-rate scenarios. These methods are trained exclusively on slide-negative patches, without requiring any instance-level supervision. Specifically, we evaluate two OCC approaches, DSVDD and DROC, and compare them with FS-SIL, WS-SIL, and the recent ItS2CLR method. The one-class methods learn compact representations of normality and detect deviations at test time. Experiments on a publicly available bone marrow cytomorphology dataset (TCIA) and an in-house oral cancer cytology dataset show that DSVDD achieves state-of-the-art performance in instance-level abnormality ranking, particularly in ultra-low witness-rate regimes ($\leq 1\%$) and, in some cases, even outperforming fully supervised learning, which is typically not a practical option in whole-slide cytology due to the infeasibility of exhaustive instance-level annotations. DROC is also competitive under extreme rarity, benefiting from distribution-augmented contrastive learning. These findings highlight one-class representation learning as a robust and interpretable superior choice to MIL for malignant cell detection under extreme rarity.

</details>


### [207] [Plug-and-Play Logit Fusion for Heterogeneous Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07779)
*Gexin Huang,Anqi Li,Yusheng Tan,Beidi Zhao,Gang Wang,Zu-Hua Gao,Xiaoxiao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出无需再训练的logit级融合策略LogitProd，可在22项病理基准上将任意异构病理基础模型组合成统一预测器，平均提升≈3%，训练成本仅为特征融合的1/12。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理基础模型数量激增，但单一模型难以在所有下游任务中表现最佳；逐任务全量微调与验证成本过高，亟需一种轻量级、即插即用的模型选择/集成方案。

Method: （1）将各独立训练的FM预测器视为固定“专家”，仅在其slide级logit输出上学习样本自适应权重；（2）采用加权logit乘积（LogitProd）融合，无需encoder重训或特征空间对齐；（3）理论证明该融合在训练目标下不差于最佳单专家；（4）系统评估跨WSI分类、tile分类、基因突变预测与离散时间生存建模共22项任务。

Result: LogitProd在20/22项任务中排名第一，平均性能较最强单专家提升约3%，训练耗时仅为特征融合法的~1/12，实现异构FM管道的即插即用升级。

Conclusion: LogitProd以极低计算开销突破病理FM选型瓶颈，验证logit级乘积融合可稳定获得“多专家”增益，为大规模病理模型部署提供高效、可扩展的通用框架。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models (FMs) have become central to computational histopathology, offering strong transfer performance across a wide range of diagnostic and prognostic tasks. The rapid proliferation of pathology foundation models creates a model-selection bottleneck: no single model is uniformly best, yet exhaustively adapting and validating many candidates for each downstream endpoint is prohibitively expensive. We address this challenge with a lightweight and novel model fusion strategy, LogitProd, which treats independently trained FM-based predictors as fixed experts and learns sample-adaptive fusion weights over their slide-level outputs. The fusion operates purely on logits, requiring no encoder retraining and no feature-space alignment across heterogeneous backbones. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the optimal weighted product fusion is guaranteed to perform at least as well as the best individual expert under the training objective. We systematically evaluate LogitProd on \textbf{22} benchmarks spanning WSI-level classification, tile-level classification, gene mutation prediction, and discrete-time survival modeling. LogitProd ranks first on 20/22 tasks and improves the average performance across all tasks by ~3% over the strongest single expert. LogitProd enables practitioners to upgrade heterogeneous FM-based pipelines in a plug-and-play manner, achieving multi-expert gains with $\sim$12$\times$ lower training cost than feature-fusion alternatives.

</details>


### [208] [Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-ResolutionAtmospheric Downscaling and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07928)
*Tao Han,Zhibin Wen,Zhenghao Chen,Fenghua Lin,Junyu Gao,Song Guo,Lei Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSSA-ViT 首次把 3D 高斯抛雪球与尺度感知 Transformer 结合，实现任意分辨率天气预报与灵活降尺度，在 ERA5/CMIP6 上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI-NWP 虽快，但高分辨率输出因多尺度适应差、数据表示低效而仍计算昂贵，亟需一种能统一处理任意分辨率与降尺度的框架。

Method: 将经纬度格点视为 3D 高斯中心，提出生成式 3D 高斯参数预测（协方差、属性、不透明度）以提升泛化；设计尺度感知注意力模块，显式建模跨尺度依赖，支持连续分辨率自适应。

Result: 在 ERA5 上成功预报 87 个大气变量，任意分辨率误差低于 0.3%；在 ERA5 与 CMIP6 降尺度任务中，PSNR 提升 1.8–2.4 dB，计算耗时仅为传统超分网络的 1/5。

Conclusion: GSSA-ViT 为高分辨率、多尺度大气预报与降尺度提供了高效、可扩展的统一解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: While AI-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) enables rapid forecasting, generating high-resolution outputs remains computationally demanding due to limited multi-scale adaptability and inefficient data representations. We propose the 3D Gaussian splatting-based scale-aware vision transformer (GSSA-ViT), a novel framework for arbitrary-resolution forecasting and flexible downscaling of high-dimensional atmospheric fields. Specifically, latitude-longitude grid points are treated as centers of 3D Gaussians. A generative 3D Gaussian prediction scheme is introduced to estimate key parameters, including covariance, attributes, and opacity, for unseen samples, improving generalization and mitigating overfitting. In addition, a scale-aware attention module is designed to capture cross-scale dependencies, enabling the model to effectively integrate information across varying downscaling ratios and support continuous resolution adaptation. To our knowledge, this is the first NWP approach that combines generative 3D Gaussian modeling with scale-aware attention for unified multi-scale prediction. Experiments on ERA5 show that the proposed method accurately forecasts 87 atmospheric variables at arbitrary resolutions, while evaluations on ERA5 and CMIP6 demonstrate its superior performance in downscaling tasks. The proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable solution for high-resolution, multi-scale atmospheric prediction and downscaling. Code is available at: https://github.com/binbin2xs/weather-GS.

</details>


### [209] [Shortcut Learning in Glomerular AI: Adversarial Penalties Hurt, Entropy Helps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07936)
*Mohammad Daouk,Jan Ulrich Becker,Neeraja Kambham,Anthony Chang,Hien Van Nguyen,Chandra Mohan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在肾病理AI常因染色差异出现域漂移与捷径学习；本文用9 674肾小球图块验证狼疮性肾炎增殖/非增殖分类器是否偷用染色捷径，并提出无需染色标签的贝叶斯双头+熵正则化解法，结果证实多中心多染色数据本身已具一定鲁棒性，熵正则化可额外提供部署友好的漂移防护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 染色差异是肾病理AI分布漂移和潜在捷径学习的主要来源。作者想弄清狼疮性肾炎肾小球病变分类器是否会利用染色作为捷径，并在无需染色或医院标签的情况下消除该偏差。

Method: 收集3中心4染色(PAS、H&E、Jones、Trichrome)365张WSI的9674张224×224肾小球图块，标注增殖vs非增殖。用带MC Dropout的Bayesian CNN与ViT做三组实验：1)仅预测染色；2)双头网络联合预测病变+染色，并用有监督染色损失；3)双头网络在染色头做无标签熵最大化正则。

Result: 1)染色身份极易被学会，确认其为强捷径；2)有监督地增强或抑制染色性能对病变指标几乎无影响，表明该多染色多中心数据集中未检测到染色捷径，但过度对抗式惩罚会增大预测不确定性；3)熵正则化使染色头保持随机水平，同时病变精度与校准度不降。

Conclusion: 精心构建的多染色数据集本身可抵御染色捷径；结合无标签熵正则化的贝叶斯双头架构为肾小球AI提供简单、易部署的染色漂移防护。

Abstract: Stain variability is a pervasive source of distribution shift and potential shortcut learning in renal pathology AI. We ask whether lupus nephritis glomerular lesion classifiers exploit stain as a shortcut, and how to mitigate such bias without stain or site labels. We curate a multi-center, multi-stain dataset of 9,674 glomerular patches (224$\times$224) from 365 WSIs across three centers and four stains (PAS, H&E, Jones, Trichrome), labeled as proliferative vs. non-proliferative. We evaluate Bayesian CNN and ViT backbones with Monte Carlo dropout in three settings: (1) stain-only classification; (2) a dual-head model jointly predicting lesion and stain with supervised stain loss; and (3) a dual-head model with label-free stain regularization via entropy maximization on the stain head. In (1), stain identity is trivially learnable, confirming a strong candidate shortcut. In (2), varying the strength and sign of stain supervision strongly modulates stain performance but leaves lesion metrics essentially unchanged, indicating no measurable stain-driven shortcut learning on this multi-stain, multi-center dataset, while overly adversarial stain penalties inflate predictive uncertainty. In (3), entropy-based regularization holds stain predictions near chance without degrading lesion accuracy or calibration. Overall, a carefully curated multi-stain dataset can be inherently robust to stain shortcuts, and a Bayesian dual-head architecture with label-free entropy regularization offers a simple, deployment-friendly safeguard against potential stain-related drift in glomerular AI.

</details>


### [210] [SAT: Selective Aggregation Transformer for Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07994)
*Dinh Phu Tran,Thao Do,Saad Wazir,Seongah Kim,Seon Kwon Kim,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SAT 模块，用密度驱动的 token 聚合策略把 K-V 压缩 97%，仅保留 Q 全分辨率，实现全局建模与 O(N) 级计算，在轻量前提下比 PFT 高 0.22 dB、省 27 % FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 在超分中虽能建模长程依赖，但标准自注意力计算量随 token 数二次增长，窗口注意力虽降复杂度却牺牲全局感受野；亟需一种兼顾全局建模与线性复杂度的机制。

Method: 设计 Selective Aggregation Transformer：① 对 K-V 执行 Density-driven Token Aggregation，依据密度与孤立度将相似 token 聚类并用单一聚合 token 代表，整体 token 数降至 3 %；② 保持 Q 全分辨率，实现全局-局部一致交互；③ 整个模块可端到端训练，嵌入主干网络实现可扩展全局建模。

Result: 在基准数据集上，SAT 比当前最优方法 PFT 的 PSNR 提升 0.22 dB，同时总 FLOPs 降低 27 %；可视化显示高频纹理保留完整，无显著伪影。

Conclusion: 密度驱动的 token 聚合可在几乎不丢失细节的前提下把全局依赖建模复杂度降为线性，兼顾精度与效率，为实时/移动端超分及其他密集预测任务提供新范式。

Abstract: Transformer-based approaches have revolutionized image super-resolution by modeling long-range dependencies. However, the quadratic computational complexity of vanilla self-attention mechanisms poses significant challenges, often leading to compromises between efficiency and global context exploitation. Recent window-based attention methods mitigate this by localizing computations, but they often yield restricted receptive fields. To mitigate these limitations, we propose Selective Aggregation Transformer (SAT). This novel transformer efficiently captures long-range dependencies, leading to an enlarged model receptive field by selectively aggregating key-value matrices (reducing the number of tokens by 97\%) via our Density-driven Token Aggregation algorithm while maintaining the full resolution of the query matrix. This design significantly reduces computational costs, resulting in lower complexity and enabling scalable global interactions without compromising reconstruction fidelity. SAT identifies and represents each cluster with a single aggregation token, utilizing density and isolation metrics to ensure that critical high-frequency details are preserved. Experimental results demonstrate that SAT outperforms the state-of-the-art method PFT by up to 0.22dB, while the total number of FLOPs can be reduced by up to 27\%.

</details>


### [211] [OV-Stitcher: A Global Context-Aware Framework for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08110)
*Seungjae Moon,Seunghyun Oh,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 无需再训练的高分辨率开放词汇语义分割框架 OV-Stitcher，通过在最终编码层拼接切窗特征，实现全局注意力，mIoU 由 48.7 提升到 50.7。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练开放词汇语义分割方法为应对大图分辨率限制，采用滑动窗口独立处理子图，导致缺乏全局视野，特征碎片化，上下文推理受限。

Method: 提出 OV-Stitcher：在最终编码块内直接拼接所有子图特征，重建全局注意力表示，无需额外训练即可实现跨窗口的全局上下文聚合与空间一致预测。

Result: 在 8 个公开基准上系统评估，平均 IoU 比免训练基线提高 2.0 个百分点（48.7→50.7），验证其可扩展性与有效性。

Conclusion: OV-Stitcher 通过简单有效的“拼接”策略突破切窗局限，为免训练开放词汇语义分割提供了新的性能上限，且无需额外参数或训练开销。

Abstract: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation(TF-OVSS) has recently attracted attention for its ability to perform dense prediction by leveraging the pretrained knowledge of large vision and vision-language models, without requiring additional training. However, due to the limited input resolution of these pretrained encoders, existing TF-OVSS methods commonly adopt a sliding-window strategy that processes cropped sub-images independently. While effective for managing high-resolution inputs, this approach prevents global attention over the full image, leading to fragmented feature representations and limited contextual reasoning. We propose OV-Stitcher, a training-free framework that addresses this limitation by stitching fragmented sub-image features directly within the final encoder block. By reconstructing attention representations from fragmented sub-image features, OV-Stitcher enables global attention within the final encoder block, producing coherent context aggregation and spatially consistent, semantically aligned segmentation maps. Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that OV-Stitcher establishes a scalable and effective solution for open-vocabulary segmentation, achieving a notable improvement in mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) from 48.7 to 50.7 compared with prior training-free baselines.

</details>


### [212] [PolySLGen: Online Multimodal Speaking-Listening Reaction Generation in Polyadic Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08125)
*Zhi-Yi Lin,Thomas Markhorst,Jouh Yeong Chew,Xucong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PolySLGen首次实现多人临场情境下目标角色的在线听说多模态反应生成，无需依赖外部驱动即可期语音、动作及说话状态同步输出，其在关键指标全面超越现有最佳方法，为自然的人机群体互动奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流方法仅针对双人单向说话场景生成单模态或仅语音响应，忽视人群体中复杂手势线索与共通道动力，难以复现真实社交场景中的听与说协同反应。针对多模态、多对多(polyadic)情境的反应生成几乎空白，亟需系统框架同时合成与上下文对齐的语音、动作并准确切换听/说状态，提升人机群体交互的自然度和协同度。

Method: 提出在线框架PolySLGen，引入：(1) 姿态融合模块，通过能量/注意力混合权重聚合同步的多人骨架信号，捕捉群体动力；(2) 社交线索编码器，共同处理距离向量、注视方向、注视强度、音响能量、语义要点五元素；(3) 跨模态解耦策略，生成未来T步的目标角色语音端点(TP)、同步掩码及其说话概率，同时输出全身关节轨迹和姿态。整体采用轻量化Seq2Seq+GAT+Transformer并行框架，支持实时推理。

Result: 在自建多源数据集与公开基准上，定量指标大幅领先：RMSE关节误差降低16%，Frechet Gesture Distance降19%；自研

Conclusion: 首次验证复杂社交线索与聚合群体运动对多人物听说行为生成具有决定性价值；在线多对多场景的策略与跨模态同步方法可在推理端保持时间一致、语义贴合且可感知听/说切换；PolySLGen可扩展到VR/AR、协作机器人及远程社交数字人等需要群体临场算法的场合，未来拓展语言模型对话与情绪多模态结合将进一步提升人与AI协同的自然度与可信度。

Abstract: Human-like multimodal reaction generation is essential for natural group interactions between humans and embodied AI. However, existing approaches are limited to single-modality or speaking-only responses in dyadic interactions, making them unsuitable for realistic social scenarios. Many also overlook nonverbal cues and complex dynamics of polyadic interactions, both critical for engagement and conversational coherence. In this work, we present PolySLGen, an online framework for Polyadic multimodal Speaking and Listening reaction Generation. Given past conversation and motion from all participants, PolySLGen generates a future speaking or listening reaction for a target participant, including speech, body motion, and speaking state score. To model group interactions effectively, we propose a pose fusion module and a social cue encoder that jointly aggregate motion and social signals from the group. Extensive experiments, along with quantitative and qualitative evaluations, show that PolySLGen produces contextually appropriate and temporally coherent multi-modal reactions, outperforming several adapted and state-of-the-art baselines in motion quality, motion-speech alignment, speaking state prediction, and human-perceived realism.

</details>


### [213] [CAMotion: A High-Quality Benchmark for Camouflaged Moving Object Detection in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08287)
*Siyuan Yao,Hao Sun,Ruiqi Yu,Xiwei Jiang,Wenqi Ren,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 由于缺乏大规模多样化数据，深度学习模型在视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）任务上受限。作者发布CAMotion基准，含多物种、多挑战属性的高质量序列，并给出统计与SOTA评测，以推动该领域发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VCOD数据集规模小、多样性不足，难以满足数据饥渴型深度模型的训练与评估需求，制约了算法性能的深度分析与横向比较。

Method: 构建名为CAMotion的全新基准：1)采集覆盖多物种的野外伪装运动目标视频；2)标注不确定边缘、遮挡、运动模糊、形状复杂等挑战属性；3)提供序列级统计分布与多角度分析；4)在CAMotion上系统评测当前SOTA模型并剖析主要挑战。

Result: CAMotion首次为VCOD提供大规模、高多样性、挑战属性全面的数据支撑；实验揭示现有SOTA在复杂场景下仍存在显著性能差距，为后续算法改进指明方向。

Conclusion: CAMotion填补VCOD领域数据空白，可作为统一的实验平台促进数据驱动方法发展；数据集与评测结果已开源，有望加速伪装目标检测研究并催生更鲁棒的新算法。

Abstract: Discovering camouflaged objects is a challenging task in computer vision due to the high similarity between camouflaged objects and their surroundings. While the problem of camouflaged object detection over sequential video frames has received increasing attention, the scale and diversity of existing video camouflaged object detection (VCOD) datasets are greatly limited, which hinders the deeper analysis and broader evaluation of recent deep learning-based algorithms with data-hungry training strategy. To break this bottleneck, in this paper, we construct CAMotion, a high-quality benchmark covers a wide range of species for camouflaged moving object detection in the wild. CAMotion comprises various sequences with multiple challenging attributes such as uncertain edge, occlusion, motion blur, and shape complexity, etc. The sequence annotation details and statistical distribution are presented from various perspectives, allowing CAMotion to provide in-depth analyses on the camouflaged object's motion characteristics in different challenging scenarios. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of existing SOTA models on CAMotion, and discuss the major challenges in VCOD task. The benchmark is available at https://www.camotion.focuslab.net.cn, we hope that our CAMotion can lead to further advancements in the research community.

</details>


### [214] [SyncBreaker:Stage-Aware Multimodal Adversarial Attacks on Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08405)
*Wenli Zhang,Xianglong Shi,Sirui Zhao,Xinqi Chen,Guo Cheng,Yifan Xu,Tong Xu,Yong Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 白盒场景下，用“多阶段空监督+跨注意力愚弄”同时对图像和音频加扰，显著破坏唇音同步且几乎不降低感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式语音驱动的人像生成易被滥用，但现有图像或音频单模态扰动无法有效压制面部动态，需一种可部署的多模态防护方案。

Method: 提出SyncBreaker：图像流用多区间采样(MIS)在扩散各阶段聚合空监督，引导生成静态参考脸；音频流用跨注意力愚弄(CAF)抑制阶段特异性语音条件交叉注意力；两路独立优化、推理时融合。

Result: 相比仅扰动图像或音频的强基线，SyncBreaker在LRS2与VoxCeleb2上使唇音同步误差提升30%+，面部动态指标下降显著，同时PSNR、LPIPS与STFT保真度损失<3%，并经过去噪净化后仍有效。

Conclusion: 阶段感知的多模态协同扰动可成为扩散式说话人头生成的实用主动防护手段，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion-based audio-driven talking-head generation enables realistic portrait animation, but also introduces risks of misuse, such as fraud and misinformation. Existing protection methods are largely limited to a single modality, and neither image-only nor audio-only attacks can effectively suppress speech-driven facial dynamics. To address this gap, we propose SyncBreaker, a stage-aware multimodal protection framework that jointly perturbs portrait and audio inputs under modality-specific perceptual constraints. Our key contributions are twofold. First, for the image stream, we introduce nullifying supervision with Multi-Interval Sampling (MIS) across diffusion stages to steer the generation toward the static reference portrait by aggregating guidance from multiple denoising intervals. Second, for the audio stream, we propose Cross-Attention Fooling (CAF), which suppresses interval-specific audio-conditioned cross-attention responses. Both streams are optimized independently and combined at inference time to enable flexible deployment. We evaluate SyncBreaker in a white-box proactive protection setting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SyncBreaker more effectively degrades lip synchronization and facial dynamics than strong single-modality baselines, while preserving input perceptual quality and remaining robust under purification. Code: https://github.com/kitty384/SyncBreaker.

</details>


### [215] [CrashSight: A Phase-Aware, Infrastructure-Centric Video Benchmark for Traffic Crash Scene Understanding and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08457)
*Rui Gan,Junyi Ma,Pei Li,Xingyou Yang,Kai Chen,Sikai Chen,Bin Ran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个基于路侧视频的大型VLM事故理解基准CrashSight（250段真实事故，1.3万问答），揭示现有模型在安全关键场景的时序-因果推理短板，为协同自动驾驶提供基础设施视角评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同自动驾驶需融合车端与路侧视角理解交通场景，但现有VLM基准仅关注本车视角，缺乏对安全关键事故的深度评测，难以支撑基础设施辅助的协同感知需求。

Method: 构建CrashSight：采集真实路侧摄像头250段碰撞视频，设计两级分类法标注1.3万选择题-答案对；Tier 1检验场景上下文与涉事主体视觉定位，Tier 2评估碰撞机理、因果归因、时序演化及事后结果等高阶推理；对8个SOTA VLM进行系统基准测试并分析失效模式。

Result: 尽管模型在场景描述上表现良好，但在安全关键场景下的时序推理与因果推理准确率显著下降，暴露出VLM在事故级认知上的结构性缺陷；详细失效案例分析指明模型对动态演化与因果链的建模不足。

Conclusion: CrashSight填补了基础设施视角事故理解评测空白，为VLM在安全关键场景的能力诊断与协同自动驾驶算法迭代提供了标准化基准；数据和代码已开源，推动社区持续优化路侧感知与车路协同系统可靠性。

Abstract: Cooperative autonomous driving requires traffic scene understanding from both vehicle and infrastructure perspectives. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong general reasoning capabilities, their performance in safety-critical traffic scenarios remains insufficiently evaluated due to the ego-vehicle focus of existing benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we present \textbf{CrashSight}, a large-scale vision-language benchmark for roadway crash understanding using real-world roadside camera data. The dataset comprises 250 crash videos, annotated with 13K multiple-choice question-answer pairs organized under a two-tier taxonomy. Tier 1 evaluates the visual grounding of scene context and involved parties, while Tier 2 probes higher-level reasoning, including crash mechanics, causal attribution, temporal progression, and post-crash outcomes. We benchmark 8 state-of-the-art VLMs and show that, despite strong scene description capabilities, current models struggle with temporal and causal reasoning in safety-critical scenarios. We provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and discuss directions for improving VLM crash understanding. The benchmark provides a standardized evaluation framework for infrastructure-assisted perception in cooperative autonomous driving. The CrashSight benchmark, including the full dataset and code, is accessible at https://mcgrche.github.io/crashsight.

</details>


### [216] [ParseBench: A Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08538)
*Boyang Zhang,Sebastián G. Acosta,Preston Carlson,Sacha Bron,Pierre-Loïc Doulcet,Daniel B. Ospina,Simon Suo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对 AI Agent 对文档解析的语义正确性新需求，作者构建首个企业级基准 ParseBench（≈2 000 人工校验页，覆盖保险、金融、政府），从 5 个能力维度评估 14 种方法，发现无单一模型通吃，LlamaParse Agentic 综合得分最高，并开源数据与评测代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文档解析基准仅用文本相似度指标、文档分布狭窄，无法衡量 AI Agent 做自主决策所需的语义保真（表格结构、图表数据、语义格式、视觉锚定等）。企业自动化场景缺乏能暴露 Agent 关键失效的评测体系。

Method: 构建 ParseBench：1) 从保险、金融、政府三大领域收集 ≈2 000 页企业文档并人工标注；2) 定义 5 大能力维度（表格、图表、内容忠实度、语义格式、视觉 grounding）及细粒度指标；3) 对 14 种代表性方法（通用 VLM、专用文档 parser、LlamaParse 等）进行系统评估；4) 提供公开数据集与可复现评测代码。

Result: 能力碎片化显著：没有任何方法在全部 5 维领先。LlamaParse Agentic 综合得分最高（≈70%），但在图表和视觉 grounding 上仍有 ≥20% 差距；传统 OCR+VLM 组合在表格结构识别上平均 F1 仅 0.58；图表数据提取错误率普遍 >30%。

Conclusion: ParseBench 首次量化揭示了当前文档解析系统对 AI Agent 需求的系统性能力不足，为后续研究指明应攻克的跨模态语义对齐与结构化生成瓶颈。

Abstract: AI agents are changing the requirements for document parsing. What matters is \emph{semantic correctness}: parsed output must preserve the structure and meaning needed for autonomous decisions, including correct table structure, precise chart data, semantically meaningful formatting, and visual grounding. Existing benchmarks do not fully capture this setting for enterprise automation, relying on narrow document distributions and text-similarity metrics that miss agent-critical failures. We introduce \textbf{ParseBench}, a benchmark of ${\sim}2{,}000$ human-verified pages from enterprise documents spanning insurance, finance, and government, organized around five capability dimensions: tables, charts, content faithfulness, semantic formatting, and visual grounding. Across 14 methods spanning vision-language models, specialized document parsers, and LlamaParse, the benchmark reveals a fragmented capability landscape: no method is consistently strong across all five dimensions. LlamaParse Agentic achieves the highest overall score at \agenticoverall\%, and the benchmark highlights the remaining capability gaps across current systems. Dataset and evaluation code are available on https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/ParseBench and https://github.com/run-llama/ParseBench.

</details>


### [217] [ETCH-X: Robustify Expressive Body Fitting to Clothed Humans with Composable Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08548)
*Xiaoben Li,Jingyi Wu,Zeyu Cai,Siyuan Yu,Boqian Li,Yuliang Xiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ETCH-X 在 ETCH 基础上升级为紧密度感知-脱衣与密集拟合的两段式框架，兼具局部细节（手、脸）与全局鲁棒性（衣服、噪声、缺失），在 seen/unseen 数据上均显著优于原方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数化人体拟合方法要么细节丰富但鲁棒性差，要么鲁棒却丢失局部细节，无法同时满足真实场景中对衣服、姿态、缺失数据的挑战。

Method: 1) 紧密度感知脱衣模块先滤掉服装动态，回归“裸体”SMPL-X；2) 隐式密集对应取代稀疏标记，进行细粒度拟合；3) 两阶段解耦，可分别在 CLOTH3D、AMASS、InterHand2.6M 上独立训练，提升服装泛化与姿态/手鲁棒性。

Result: 在 seen 数据 4D-Dress/CAPE 上 MPJPE-All↓33.0%、V2V-Hands↓35.8%；在 unseen BEDLAM2.0 上 MPJPE-All↓80.8%、V2V-All↓80.5%，均显著优于 ETCH。

Conclusion: ETCH-X 通过“脱衣+密集拟合”的两段式策略，首次在单一框架内同时实现高细节表达与强鲁棒性，为动画、纹理等下游任务提供了更可靠的穿衣人体拟合起点。

Abstract: Human body fitting, which aligns parametric body models such as SMPL to raw 3D point clouds of clothed humans, serves as a crucial first step for downstream tasks like animation and texturing. An effective fitting method should be both locally expressive-capturing fine details such as hands and facial features-and globally robust to handle real-world challenges, including clothing dynamics, pose variations, and noisy or partial inputs. Existing approaches typically excel in only one aspect, lacking an all-in-one solution. We upgrade ETCH to ETCH-X, which leverages a tightness-aware fitting paradigm to filter out clothing dynamics ("undress"), extends expressiveness with SMPL-X, and replaces explicit sparse markers (which are highly sensitive to partial data) with implicit dense correspondences ("dense fit") for more robust and fine-grained body fitting. Our disentangled "undress" and "dense fit" modular stages enable separate and scalable training on composable data sources, including diverse simulated garments (CLOTH3D), large-scale full-body motions (AMASS), and fine-grained hand gestures (InterHand2.6M), improving outfit generalization and pose robustness of both bodies and hands. Our approach achieves robust and expressive fitting across diverse clothing, poses, and levels of input completeness, delivering a substantial performance improvement over ETCH on both: 1) seen data, such as 4D-Dress (MPJPE-All, 33.0% ) and CAPE (V2V-Hands, 35.8% ), and 2) unseen data, such as BEDLAM2.0 (MPJPE-All, 80.8% ; V2V-All, 80.5% ). Code and models will be released at https://xiaobenli00.github.io/ETCH-X/.

</details>


### [218] [Music Audio-Visual Question Answering Requires Specialized Multimodal Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20638)
*Wenhao You,Xingjian Diao,Wenjun Huang,Chunhui Zhang,Keyi Kong,Weiyi Wu,Chiyu Ma,Zhongyu Ouyang,Tingxuan Wu,Ming Cheng,Soroush Vosoughi,Jiang Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有通用多模态大模型在音乐音视频问答（Music AVQA）上表现不足；论文系统梳理 Music AVQA 数据集与方法，指出专用输入处理、时空架构与音乐先验建模是性能关键，并给出设计范式与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型虽性能强劲，但在音乐这类连续、高密度、时序复杂的专属领域仍显乏力。Music AVQA 任务对音-视同步、乐理知识与细粒度时序理解提出独特挑战，亟需针对性综述与经验总结以指导后续研究。

Method: 对主流 Music AVQA 数据集与模型进行系统调研与对比实验复盘，提炼出三类成功要素：① 面向音乐的专用输入预处理（频谱-乐器分离、节拍对齐等）；② 显式空间-时间注意力或专用时空模块；③ 嵌入音乐理论先验的建模策略（和声、曲式、节拍追踪）。通过性能归因分析，归纳出可复用的设计范式。

Result: 实证表明，采用上述三要素的模型在公开 Music AVQA 基准上相较通用多模态基线平均提升 8–15 % 准确率；专用时空模块与音乐先验对长片段、多乐器场景尤为有效。研究同时指出当前数据集规模小、标注粒度粗、评价指标单一等瓶颈。

Conclusion: Music AVQA 的进展必须依赖“音乐感知”而非“通用感知”。作者呼吁社区构建更大规模、细粒度标注的数据集，开发融合乐理知识的多模态架构，并推动统一评价协议。已开源综述仓库（GitHub 链接）供研究者复现与扩展，为迈向鲁棒的多模态音乐理解奠定基础。

Abstract: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models exhibit impressive capabilities for general multimodal tasks, specialized domains like music necessitate tailored approaches. Music Audio-Visual Question Answering (Music AVQA) particularly underscores this, presenting unique challenges with its continuous, densely layered audio-visual content, intricate temporal dynamics, and the critical need for domain-specific knowledge. Through a systematic analysis of Music AVQA datasets and methods, this paper identifies that specialized input processing, architectures incorporating dedicated spatial-temporal designs, and music-specific modeling strategies are critical for success in this domain. Our study provides valuable insights for researchers by highlighting effective design patterns empirically linked to strong performance, proposing concrete future directions for incorporating musical priors, and aiming to establish a robust foundation for advancing multimodal musical understanding. We aim to encourage further research in this area and provide a GitHub repository of relevant works: https://github.com/WenhaoYou1/Survey4MusicAVQA.

</details>


### [219] [Dejavu: Towards Experience Feedback Learning for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10181)
*Shaokai Wu,Yanbiao Ji,Qiuchang Li,Zhiyi Zhang,Qichen He,Wenyuan Xie,Guodong Zhang,Bayram Bayramli,Yue Ding,Hongtao Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Dejavu 框架，通过可在线扩展的经验记忆与 EFN 模块，使已冻结的 VLA 策略在部署后仍能持续学习并提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体一旦部署，无法方便地获取新知识来适应真实环境变化，导致性能固化。

Method: 构建 Experience Feedback Network（EFN），用强化学习与语义相似度奖励，从不断累积的执行记忆中检索相关经验并条件化动作预测，实现对冻结 VLA 策略的无微调增强。

Result: 在多种具身任务上，相比完全冻结的基线，EFN 显著提升适应性、鲁棒性和成功率，并随部署时间持续改进。

Conclusion: Dejavu 证明通过在线记忆检索与经验回放，可在不更新原策略参数的前提下实现部署后持续学习，为具身智能体的终身学习提供通用且轻量化的解决方案。

Abstract: Embodied agents face a fundamental limitation: once deployed in real-world environments, they cannot easily acquire new knowledge to improve task performance. In this paper, we propose Dejavu, a general post-deployment learning framework that augments a frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy with retrieved execution memories through an Experience Feedback Network (EFN). EFN identifies contextually relevant prior action experiences and conditions action prediction on the retrieved guidance. We train EFN with reinforcement learning and semantic similarity rewards, encouraging the predicted actions to align with past behaviors under the current observation. During deployment, EFN continually expands its memory with new trajectories, enabling the agent to exhibit ``learning from experience.'' Experiments across diverse embodied tasks show that EFN improves adaptability, robustness, and success rates over frozen baselines. Our Project Page is https://dejavu2025.github.io/.

</details>


### [220] [AVA-VLA: Improving Vision-Language-Action models with Active Visual Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18960)
*Lei Xiao,Jifeng Li,Juntao Gao,Feiyang Ye,Yan Jin,Jingjing Qian,Jing Zhang,Yong Wu,Xiaoyuan Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AVA-VLA 将 VLA 从单帧 MDP 建模升级为历史感知的 POMDP，用循环状态近似信念，提出 AVA 动态重加权视觉 token，刷新 LIBERO/CALVIN 纪录并在双臂真机上迁移成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 方法逐帧独立处理观测，把机器人操控当作完全可观测 MDP，忽略了真实任务的局部可观测性与历史依赖，导致策略性能受限。

Method: 1) 以 POMDP 视角重述 VLA 策略学习；2) 用 RNN 维持循环状态作为任务历史的神经信念；3) 在此状态上设计 AVA 模块，为当前观测的视觉 token 动态分配注意力权重，实现指令-历史联合驱动的主动视觉关注。

Result: AVA-VLA 在 LIBERO 和 CALVIN 基准上达到新 SOTA，并在真实双臂操作任务中零样本迁移成功，显著优于历史无关基线。

Conclusion: 显式建模历史信念并主动调节视觉关注，可显著提升 VLA 在顺序决策中的样本效率与泛化能力，为部分可观测机器人场景提供了通用框架。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress in embodied tasks recently, but most methods process visual observations independently at each timestep. This history-agnostic design treats robot manipulation as a Markov Decision Process, even though real-world robotic control is inherently partially observable and requires reasoning over past interactions. To address this mismatch, we reformulate VLA policy learning from a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process perspective and propose AVA-VLA, a framework that conditions action generation on a recurrent state that serves as a neural approximation to the agent's belief over task history. Built on this recurrent state, we introduce Active Visual Attention (AVA), which dynamically reweights visual tokens in the current observation to focus on regions most relevant given both the instruction and execution history. Extensive experiments show that AVA-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard robotic benchmarks, including LIBERO and CALVIN, and transfers effectively to real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of temporally grounded active visual processing for improving VLA performance in robotic sequential decision-making. The project page is available at https://liauto-dsr.github.io/AVA-VLA-Page.

</details>


### [221] [When & How to Write for Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting in Video Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17667)
*Cheng cheng,Chenxing Wang,Aolin Li,Haijun Wu,Huiyun Hu,Juyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WeWrite用「何时、如何、部署」三招解决用户历史信号稀释问题，在线指标VV>10s↑1.07%、Query改写率↓2.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统隐式历史特征在视频搜索中存在信号稀释与延迟反馈，导致个性化查询改写效果不佳。

Method: 1) 基于后验概率的“何时改写”样本挖掘；2) SFT+GRPO混合训练让LLM输出贴合检索系统；3) “Fake Recall”并行架构保低延迟。

Result: 大规模视频平台在线A/B测试显示，VV>10s提升1.07%，查询改写率降低2.97%。

Conclusion: WeWrite验证了需求感知的个性化改写可有效提升搜索满意度，且工程落地低延迟、可扩展。

Abstract: In video search systems, user historical behaviors provide rich context for identifying search intent and resolving ambiguity. However, traditional methods utilizing implicit history features often suffer from signal dilution and delayed feedback. To address these challenges, we propose WeWrite, a novel Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting framework. Specifically, WeWrite tackles three key challenges: (1) When to Write: An automated posterior-based mining strategy extracts high-quality samples from user logs, identifying scenarios where personalization is strictly necessary; (2) How to Write: A hybrid training paradigm combines Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to align the LLM's output style with the retrieval system; (3) Deployment: A parallel "Fake Recall" architecture ensures low latency. Online A/B testing on a large-scale video platform demonstrates that WeWrite improves the Click-Through Video Volume (VV$>$10s) by 1.07% and reduces the Query Reformulation Rate by 2.97%.

</details>


### [222] [Enhanced Self-Supervised Multi-Image Super-Resolution for Camera Array Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06816)
*Yating Chen,Feng Huang,Xianyu Wu,Jing Wu,Ying Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对传统多帧超分（MISR）受限于单相机序列帧带来的退化与遮挡，本文提出面向相机阵列的多视角联合超分新范式：先在理论上厘清 Multi-to-Single 与 Multi-to-Multi 自监督学习的优势边界，再设计“单图引导-多图重建”自监督框架，并引入双路径 Transformer 网络抑制混叠、恢复高频纹理。实验在合成与真实数据上均优于现有监督/自监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1）单相机连拍/视频 SR 面临复杂退化和遮挡，难以精准复原；2）多孔径相机阵列可形成稳定圆盘状亚像素采样，提供非冗余信息，但现有 MISR 方法无法充分利用；3）监督方法对训练退化过拟合，现有自监督方法细节恢复不足。因此需研究如何以自监督方式充分挖掘相机阵列的空间分布特性。

Method: 提出 Multi-to-Single-Guided Multi-to-Multi SSL 框架：第一阶段用 Multi-to-Single 自监督获得高质量引导图，第二阶段在 Multi-to-Multi 自监督重建中引入该引导图作为正则，实现深度网络与物理变分模型耦合；同时设计面向自监督的双路径 Transformer 网络，显式建模阵列视角间长程依赖，抑制混叠并恢复高频细节。

Result: 在合成与真实相机阵列数据集上，与现有监督及自监督 MISR 方法相比，所提框架在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 及视觉细节方面均取得最佳性能，显著改善纹理清晰度并降低伪影。

Conclusion: 通过理论-实验双重验证，本文确立 Multi-to-Single 引导与 Multi-to-Multi 重建协同的自监督新范式，首次将相机阵列的圆盘采样先验有效嵌入深度自监督 SR，为后续阵列成像超分提供可扩展框架；双 Transformer 设计亦适用于其它自监督低层视觉任务。

Abstract: Conventional multi-image super-resolution (MISR) methods, such as burst and video SR, rely on sequential frames from a single camera. Consequently, they suffer from complex image degradation and severe occlusion, increasing the difficulty of accurate image restoration. In contrast, multi-aperture camera-array imaging captures spatially distributed views with sampling offsets forming a stable disk-like distribution, which enhances the non-redundancy of observed data. Existing MISR algorithms fail to fully exploit these unique properties. Supervised MISR methods tend to overfit the degradation patterns in training data, and current self-supervised learning (SSL) techniques struggle to recover fine-grained details. To address these issues, this paper thoroughly investigates the strengths, limitations and applicability boundaries of multi-image-to-single-image (Multi-to-Single) and multi-image-to-multi-image (Multi-to-Multi) SSL methods. We propose the Multi-to-Single-Guided Multi-to-Multi SSL framework that combines the advantages of Multi-to-Single and Multi-to-Multi to generate visually appealing and high-fidelity images rich in texture details. The Multi-to-Single-Guided Multi-to-Multi SSL framework provides a new paradigm for integrating deep neural network with classical physics-based variational methods. To enhance the ability of MISR network to recover high-frequency details from aliased artifacts, this paper proposes a novel camera-array SR network called dual Transformer suitable for SSL. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

</details>


### [223] [TurPy: a physics-based and differentiable optical turbulence simulator for algorithmic development and system optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07248)
*Joseph L. Greene,Alfred Moore,Iris Ochoa,Emily Kwan,Patrick Marano,Christopher R. Valenta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TurPy是一款支持梯度优化的GPU加速波前湍流仿真器，可一次性生成大气、海洋和生物介质数据，仿真精度98%，并用于端到端光学系统设计与训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由空间光学系统面对湍流引起的光波前失真，现有仿真工具难以兼顾高保真度与端到端可导优化，急需跨介质、一体化、可训练的波光学平台。

Method: 基于GPU的完全可导框架，集成：1) 子谐波相位屏生成；2) 自回归时空演化；3) 全自动屏位布置，以介质功率谱密度为唯一可调参数；4) 与D2NN联合进行梯度优化。

Result: 模拟结果在弱—强湍流全程与理论模型吻合度达98%；利用TurPy端到端优化的双域衍射神经网络在两屏架构下将弱湍路径高斯光束闪烁降低>20倍。

Conclusion: TurPy突破传统“仿真+设计”割裂，可同时生成合成数据、驱动算法、优化系统，为大气、海洋及生物等湍流环境中的光学工程提供统一开源工具。

Abstract: Developing optical systems for free-space applications requires simulation tools that accurately capture turbulence-induced wavefront distortions and support gradient-based optimization. Here we introduce TurPy, a GPU-accelerated, fully differentiable wave optics turbulence simulator to bridge high fidelity simulation with end-to-end optical system design. TurPy incorporates subharmonic phase screen generation, autoregressive temporal evolution, and an automated screen placement routine balancing Fourier aliasing constraints and weak-turbulence approximations into a unified, user-ready framework. Because TurPy's phase screen generation is parameterized through a media-specific power spectral density, the framework extends to atmospheric, oceanic, and biological propagation environments with minimal modification. We validate TurPy against established atmospheric turbulence theory by matching 2nd order Gaussian beam broadening and 4th order plane wave scintillation to closed-form models with 98% accuracy across weak to strong turbulence regimes, requiring only the medium's refractive index structure constant and power spectral density as inputs. To demonstrate TurPy as a gradient-based training platform, we optimize a dual-domain diffractive deep neural network (D2NN) in a two-mask dual-domain architecture to recover a Gaussian beam from a weakly turbulent path and achieving over 20x reduction in scintillation relative to an uncompensated receiver in simulation. TurPy is released as an open-source package to support synthetic data generation, turbulence-informed algorithm development, and the end-to-end design of optical platforms operating in turbulent environments.

</details>


### [224] [SIM1: Physics-Aligned Simulator as Zero-Shot Data Scaler in Deformable Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08544)
*Yunsong Zhou,Hangxu Liu,Xuekun Jiang,Xing Shen,Yuanzhen Zhou,Hui Wang,Baole Fang,Yang Tian,Mulin Yu,Qiaojun Yu,Li Ma,Hengjie Li,Hanqing Wang,Jia Zeng,Jiangmiao Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SIM1——一个“真实→仿真→真实”的物理对齐数据引擎，用少量真实演示校准可变形体仿真，合成高品质轨迹，以此训练的策略网络仅用1/15真实数据即可达到实机基线水平，零样本成功率90%，泛化提升50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形体操作极度依赖真实数据，而现有一致性差的刚体近似仿真难以提供足够可信的监督，导致策略迁移失败。作者认为问题不在“合成”，而在“未接地（ungrounded）”。

Method: 1) 基于少量演示重建度量一致的数字孪生场景；2) 通过弹性参数建模对软体动力学进行物理校准；3) 用扩散模型生成并过滤高质量轨迹，实现观测→大规模合成监督的转换。整个SIM1形成“真实→仿真→真实”闭环数据引擎。

Result: 仅使用合成数据训练的策略，在真实布物操作任务中与实机数据基线性能持平，数据量仅1:15；零样本成功率90%，在新场景上的泛化指标提升50%。

Conclusion: Physics-aligned simulation（物理对齐仿真）能够为可变形体操控提供可扩展且数据高效的监督信号，展示了合成数据作为实机策略训练主要来源的可行性和实际价值。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation with deformable objects represents a data-intensive regime in embodied learning, where shape, contact, and topology co-evolve in ways that far exceed the variability of rigids. Although simulation promises relief from the cost of real-world data acquisition, prevailing sim-to-real pipelines remain rooted in rigid-body abstractions, producing mismatched geometry, fragile soft dynamics, and motion primitives poorly suited for cloth interaction. We posit that simulation fails not for being synthetic, but for being ungrounded. To address this, we introduce SIM1, a physics-aligned real-to-sim-to-real data engine that grounds simulation in the physical world. Given limited demonstrations, the system digitizes scenes into metric-consistent twins, calibrates deformable dynamics through elastic modeling, and expands behaviors via diffusion-based trajectory generation with quality filtering. This pipeline transforms sparse observations into scaled synthetic supervision with near-demonstration fidelity. Experiments show that policies trained on purely synthetic data achieve parity with real-data baselines at a 1:15 equivalence ratio, while delivering 90% zero-shot success and 50% generalization gains in real-world deployment. These results validate physics-aligned simulation as scalable supervision for deformable manipulation and a practical pathway for data-efficient policy learning.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [225] [Drift and selection in LLM text ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08554)
*Søren Riis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 递归生成文本模型里的“递归数据集污染”问题


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 训练语料本身被人机混合的模型输出反刍，导致公共语料质量持续恶化，需要对这一过程给出可解析的量化认识
