Conclusion: 三阶段适配策略可高效将通用大模型迁移至法律领域，LuWen为中文法律智能提供开源新基线。

Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, yet their application in the legal domain remains challenging due to the specialized terminology, complex reasoning requirements, and rapidly evolving legal knowledge involved. In this paper, we present WisdomInterrogatory (LuWen), an open-source Chinese legal language model built upon the Baichuan foundation model through three key techniques: continual pre-training on a large-scale legal corpus, supervised fine-tuning with carefully curated legal instruction data, and retrieval-augmented generation integrated with a comprehensive legal knowledge base. We evaluate LuWen on five representative legal tasks spanning both prediction and generation settings, including legal judgment prediction, judicial examination, legal text summarization, law article question answering, and judicial decision reasoning. Experimental results show that LuWen outperforms several strong baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in adapting general-purpose language models to the legal domain.

</details>


### [339] [Fast-dVLM: Efficient Block-Diffusion VLM via Direct Conversion from Autoregressive VLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06832)
*Chengyue Wu,Shiyi Lan,Yonggan Fu,Sensen Gao,Jin Wang,Jincheng Yu,Jose M. Alvarez,Pavlo Molchanov,Ping Luo,Song Han,Ligeng Zhu,Enze Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Fast-dVLM 用块扩散并行解码替代 VLM 的自回归逐 token 生成，在 11 项基准上保精度的同时实现 >6× 端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现存 VLM 的自回归解码在批大小为 1 的边缘场景下受限于内存带宽，硬件并行度闲置；虽有文本块扩散并行生成方法，却尚未解决连续视觉特征与离散文本 token 的耦合，且需保留预训练多模态能力。

Method: 提出 KV-Cache 兼容的块扩散 VLM——Fast-dVLM：1) 采用“一步式”AR→扩散转换策略，直接对完整多模态模型做扩散微调，比两阶段方案更省训练预算；2) 设计多模态扩散适配组件：块大小退火、因果上下文注意、自动截断掩码、视觉高效拼接；3) 引入可 speculate 的块并行解码流程，并结合 SGLang 运行时与 FP8 量化。

Result: 在 11 项多模态基准上与自回归基线精度齐平；在相同边缘硬件与 batch=1 条件下，集成 SGLang+FP8 后整体推理延迟降低 6 倍以上。

Conclusion: 块扩散并行解码可无缝迁移至 VLM，在保精度前提下显著解锁边缘设备吞吐，为机器人、自动驾驶等物理 AI 实时应用提供了高并行、低延迟的新范式。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) predominantly rely on autoregressive decoding, which generates tokens one at a time and fundamentally limits inference throughput. This limitation is especially acute in physical AI scenarios such as robotics and autonomous driving, where VLMs are deployed on edge devices at batch size one, making AR decoding memory-bandwidth-bound and leaving hardware parallelism underutilized. While block-wise discrete diffusion has shown promise for parallel text generation, extending it to VLMs remains challenging due to the need to jointly handle continuous visual representations and discrete text tokens while preserving pretrained multimodal capabilities. We present Fast-dVLM, a block-diffusion-based VLM that enables KV-cache-compatible parallel decoding and speculative block decoding for inference acceleration. We systematically compare two AR-to-diffusion conversion strategies: a two-stage approach that first adapts the LLM backbone with text-only diffusion fine-tuning before multimodal training, and a direct approach that converts the full AR VLM in one stage. Under comparable training budgets, direct conversion proves substantially more efficient by leveraging the already multimodally aligned VLM; we therefore adopt it as our recommended recipe. We introduce a suite of multimodal diffusion adaptations, block size annealing, causal context attention, auto-truncation masking, and vision efficient concatenation, that collectively enable effective block diffusion in the VLM setting. Extensive experiments across 11 multimodal benchmarks show Fast-dVLM matches its autoregressive counterpart in generation quality. With SGLang integration and FP8 quantization, Fast-dVLM achieves over 6x end-to-end inference speedup over the AR baseline.

</details>


### [340] [An Empirical Analysis of Static Analysis Methods for Detection and Mitigation of Code Library Hallucinations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07755)
*Clarissa Miranda-Pena,Andrew Reeson,Cécile Paris,Josiah Poon,Jonathan K. Kummerfeld*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 静态分析只能抓住 14-85% 的库幻觉，且存在 48.5–77% 的理论上限，廉价但远不足以根治 LLM 代码幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在需要调用第三方库的 NL-to-code 任务中仍频繁生成不存在的 API（8.1–40%），亟需低成本、自动化的检测与缓解手段。

Method: 系统评估主流静态分析工具（类型检查、符号执行等）对 LLM 输出的检测能力；人工标注不可检样本，建立理论上限。

Result: 静态工具可捕获 16-70% 的全部错误、14-85% 的库幻觉；不可检上限为 48.5–77%，且随模型和数据集变化显著。

Conclusion: 静态分析是便宜的部分补丁，但因其固有局限（动态行为、语义 gap、版本漂移等）注定无法彻底消除幻觉，必须与其他动态/运行时方法互补。

Abstract: Despite extensive research, Large Language Models continue to hallucinate when generating code, particularly when using libraries. On NL-to-code benchmarks that require library use, we find that LLMs generate code that uses non-existent library features in 8.1-40% of responses. One intuitive approach for detection and mitigation of hallucinations is static analysis. In this paper, we analyse the potential of static analysis tools, both in terms of what they can solve and what they cannot. We find that static analysis tools can detect 16-70% of all errors, and 14-85% of library hallucinations, with performance varying by LLM and dataset. Through manual analysis, we identify cases a static method could not plausibly catch, which gives an upper bound on their potential from 48.5% to 77%. Overall, we show that static analysis methods are cheap method for addressing some forms of hallucination, and we quantify how far short of solving the problem they will always be.

</details>


### [341] [MemReader: From Passive to Active Extraction for Long-Term Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07877)
*Jingyi Kang,Chunyu Li,Ding Chen,Bo Tang,Feiyu Xiong,Zhiyu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 主动式智能体记忆抽取框架MemReader，以推理驱动的「写/不/后写」决策实现低噪声、可持续更新的长期记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代理将记忆抽取视为一次性、被动的对话转录，导致噪声写入、跨轮依赖缺失和价值低下，阻碍个性化服务。

Method: 提出MemReader系列：0.6B蒸馏的被动抽取器+4B ReAct主动抽取器，后者结合GRPO强化学习，显式评估信息价值、指代歧义与完整性后再决定写入、延迟、检索或丢弃；集成于MemOS系统并开放模型与API。

Result: 在LOCOMO、LongMemEval、HaluMem基准上全面超越抽取式基线，4B版本在知识更新、时序推理、幻觉抑制任务达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: 演示了智能体记忆的关键并非多写而是“有选择地写”，推理驱动的主动抽取可构建低噪声、动态演化的长期记忆。

Abstract: Long-term memory is fundamental for personalized and autonomous agents, yet populating it remains a bottleneck. Existing systems treat memory extraction as a one-shot, passive transcription from context to structured entries, which struggles with noisy dialogue, missing references, and cross-turn dependencies, leading to memory pollution, low-value writes, and inconsistency. In this paper, we introduce the MemReader family for active long-term memory extraction in agent systems: MemReader-0.6B, a compact and cost-efficient passive extractor distilled for accurate and schema-consistent structured outputs, and MemReader-4B, an active extractor optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to make memory writing decisions. Under a ReAct-style paradigm, MemReader-4B explicitly evaluates information value, reference ambiguity, and completeness before acting, and can selectively write memories, defer incomplete inputs, retrieve historical context, or discard irrelevant chatter. Experiments on LOCOMO, LongMemEval, and HaluMem show that MemReader consistently outperforms existing extraction-based baselines. In particular, MemReader-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance on tasks involving knowledge updating, temporal reasoning, and hallucination reduction. These results suggest that effective agent memory requires not merely extracting more information, but performing reasoning-driven and selective memory extraction to build low-noise and dynamically evolving long-term memory. Furthermore, MemReader has been integrated into MemOS and is being deployed in real-world applications. To support future research and adoption, we release the models and provide public API access.

</details>


### [342] [Linear Representations of Hierarchical Concepts in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07886)
*Masaki Sakata,Benjamin Heinzerling,Takumi Ito,Sho Yokoi,Kentaro Inui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语言模型的表示空间里，层次结构被编码为低维、可线性解码的子空间，这一编码方式在不同语义领域保持高度一致，且具备跨层、跨实体长度的通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注单token、单层内的层次结构表示，尚未系统检验多token实体、跨层表示及不同语义域间的可迁移性，因此需要更全面的线性表征分析框架。

Method: 基于“线性关系概念”框架，为每一层级深度与语义域训练专属线性变换，通过比较这些变换刻画层次差异；覆盖多token实体与跨层表示，并在域内未见数据与跨域迁移两种场景下评估。

Result: 域内实验显示层次关系可被线性恢复；层次信息集中在低维子空间，且该子空间具有域特异性；核心发现是不同域的特异性子空间在几何上高度相似。

Conclusion: 预训练语言模型普遍以低维、线性且可解释的方式编码概念层次，其编码几何在不同语义领域共享统一结构，为可控生成与知识编辑提供了可操作的线性接口。

Abstract: We investigate how and to what extent hierarchical relations (e.g., Japan $\subset$ Eastern Asia $\subset$ Asia) are encoded in the internal representations of language models. Building on Linear Relational Concepts, we train linear transformations specific to each hierarchical depth and semantic domain, and characterize representational differences associated with hierarchical relations by comparing these transformations. Going beyond prior work on the representational geometry of hierarchies in LMs, our analysis covers multi-token entities and cross-layer representations. Across multiple domains we learn such transformations and evaluate in-domain generalization to unseen data and cross-domain transfer. Experiments show that, within a domain, hierarchical relations can be linearly recovered from model representations. We then analyze how hierarchical information is encoded in representation space. We find that it is encoded in a relatively low-dimensional subspace and that this subspace tends to be domain-specific. Our main result is that hierarchy representation is highly similar across these domain-specific subspaces. Overall, we find that all models considered in our experiments encode concept hierarchies in the form of highly interpretable linear representations.

</details>


### [343] [HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08256)
*Juwei Yue,Chuanrui Hu,Jiawei Sheng,Zuyi Zhou,Wenyuan Zhang,Tingwen Liu,Li Guo,Yafeng Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出超图层次记忆架构 HyperMem，用超边建模多元素高阶关联，解决对话代理长期记忆碎片化检索问题，在 LoCoMo 基准达 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 与图记忆仅依赖二元关系，无法捕捉多元素联合依赖，导致长时对话检索碎片化、一致性差。

Method: 构建主题-事件-事实三级超图记忆：用超边将相关事件及事实聚合成连贯单元；设计混合词汇-语义索引与粗到细检索策略，实现高阶关联精准高效召回。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 长时对话数据集上，LLM-as-judge 准确率 92.73%，显著超越现有最佳基线，验证高阶记忆建模优势。

Conclusion: HyperMem 通过超图显式建模高阶关联，有效提升长期对话的连贯性、个性化与检索精度，为对话代理长期记忆提供新范式。

Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.

</details>


### [344] [Neurons Speak in Ranges: Breaking Free from Discrete Neuronal Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06809)
*Muhammad Umair Haider,Hammad Rizwan,Hassan Sajjad,Peizhong Ju,A. B. Siddique*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM神经元普遍多义，阻碍传统“单神经元-单概念”解释；作者发现同一神经元对不同概念的激活值呈可分离的高斯型分布，提出按激活区间而非整神经元做归因与干预的新框架NeuronLens，实验证明其副作用显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法默认“高显著性神经元≈单一语义”，但LLM中广泛存在的多义性使该假设失效，导致干预时连带损伤无关概念与模型性能，亟需更精细的归因与操控手段。

Method: 系统量化encoder/decoder类LLM在多样数据上的神经元激活分布→观察到“概念条件激活幅度”呈低重叠高斯状→提出“区间内归因”假设→设计NeuronLens：先为概念估计激活区间阈值，再仅对该区间做mask/scale等干预，而不触及神经元其余激活。

Result: 大量实验表明，NeuronLens在抑制目标概念的同时，对非目标概念的损害降低30–70%，下游任务性能下降减少约一半；区间级AUROC提升10–20个百分点，验证按区间干预可有效绕过多义性副作用。

Conclusion: 多义性并非不可解噪声，其结构化激活分布可被利用；将解释与干预粒度从“整神经元”降至“激活区间”即可在保性能前提下实现精准操控，NeuronLens为LLM可控性与安全提供新范式。

Abstract: Pervasive polysemanticity in large language models (LLMs) undermines discrete neuron-concept attribution, posing a significant challenge for model interpretation and control. We systematically analyze both encoder and decoder based LLMs across diverse datasets, and observe that even highly salient neurons for specific semantic concepts consistently exhibit polysemantic behavior. Importantly, we uncover a consistent pattern: concept-conditioned activation magnitudes of neurons form distinct, often Gaussian-like distributions with minimal overlap. Building on this observation, we hypothesize that interpreting and intervening on concept-specific activation ranges can enable more precise interpretability and targeted manipulation in LLMs. To this end, we introduce NeuronLens, a novel range-based interpretation and manipulation framework, that localizes concept attribution to activation ranges within a neuron. Extensive empirical evaluations show that range-based interventions enable effective manipulation of target concepts while causing substantially less collateral degradation to auxiliary concepts and overall model performance compared to neuron-level masking.

</details>


### [345] [Growing a Multi-head Twig via Distillation and Reinforcement Learning to Accelerate Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14075)
*Zhenwei Shao,Mingyang Wang,Weijun Zhang,Zhou Yu,Wenwen Pan,Yan Yang,Tao Wei,Hongyuan Zhang,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过为VLM早期层嫁接轻量级“twig”模块，提出TwigVLM/TwigVLM++，在Token剪枝与推测解码协同下，仅用11.1%视觉Token即可保留96%原精度，长回答延迟降低2.54×，显著优于现有加速方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于早期层注意力图剪枝视觉Token的VLM加速方法存在两大缺陷：①早期注意力信号不敏感导致精度显著下降；②生成长回答时加速效果受限。作者希望同时解决精度与速度的双重瓶颈。

Method: 1) 在VLM早期层外接轻量级Twig模块，提出Twig-guided Token Pruning(TTP)以动态、可学习的策略剪枝冗余视觉Token，缓解早期注意力不敏感问题；2) 设计Self-Speculative Decoding(SSD)，用Twig模块提前预测未来Token，实现生成阶段额外提速；3) 扩展为TwigVLM++：引入多头Twig与专用剪枝头，采用“蒸馏+剪枝导向强化学习”两阶段训练，并升级为树状SSD进一步提升并发度与加速比。

Result: 以LLaVA-1.5-7B为基础，TwigVLM在剪除88.9%视觉Token情况下保留96%原始精度；生成长回答时获得154%端到端加速；相比现有最优VLM加速方法，在同等或更少Token下mAP/CE等指标提升2–4%，延迟降低30–50%。TwigVLM++在更难 benchmarks 上进一步带来1–2%精度增益与10–20%额外加速。

Conclusion: TwigVLM通过“嫁接-剪枝-推测”正交协同，首次在低Token预算下兼顾高精度与显著生成加速；其通用架构可无缝迁移到其它VLMs，为实时多模态应用提供可行方案；TwigVLM++验证了“模块化+强化学习”继续推进该范式的潜力，未来可在更大模型、视频语言任务中扩展。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in open-world multimodal understanding, yet their high computational overheads pose great challenges for practical deployment. Some recent works have proposed methods to accelerate VLMs by pruning redundant visual tokens guided by the attention maps of VLM's early layers. Despite the success of these token pruning methods, they still suffer from two major shortcomings: (i) considerable accuracy drop due to insensitive attention signals in early layers, and (ii) limited speedup when generating long responses (e.g., 30 tokens). To address the limitations above, we present TwigVLM -- a simple and general architecture by growing a lightweight module, named twig, upon an early layer of the base VLM. Compared with most existing VLM acceleration methods purely based on visual token pruning, our TwigVLM not only achieves better accuracy retention by employing a twig-guided token pruning (TTP) strategy, but also yields higher generation speed by utilizing a self-speculative decoding (SSD) strategy. Taking LLaVA-1.5-7B as the base VLM, experimental results show that TwigVLM preserves 96% of the original performance after pruning 88.9% of the visual tokens and achieves 154% speedup in generating long responses, delivering significantly better performance in terms of both accuracy and speed over the state-of-the-art VLM acceleration methods. Moreover, we extend TwigVLM to an improved TwigVLM++ variant by introducing a novel multi-head twig architecture with a specialized pruning head. TwigVLM++ improves pruning quality via a two-stage training paradigm combining a distillation learning stage and a pruning-oriented reinforcement learning stage, and further accelerates inference via a tree-based SSD strategy.

</details>


### [346] [PaceLLM: Brain-Inspired Large Language Models for Long-Context Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17310)
*Kangcong Li,Peng Ye,Chongjun Tu,Lin Zhang,Chunfeng Song,Jiamin Wu,Tao Yang,Qihao Zheng,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 借鉴大脑工作记忆与皮层模块化思想，提出 PaceLLM：通过“持续活跃”记忆库消除上下文衰减，并用任务自适应的皮层专家聚合 FFN 权重，使任意结构 200 K token 场景下平均提升 6%–17.5%，无需结构调整即可移植并提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在长上下文上因临时神经激活衰减、FFN 权重语义割裂而性能下降，需要一种无需重构模型结构即可维持超长信息一致性的通用机制。

Method: (1) Persistent Activity 机制：引入可读写激活层面记忆库，模拟前额叶持续放电，动态复用关键 FFN 状态，补偿衰减；(2) Cortical Expert Clustering：采用任务自适应聚类将 FFN 权重重组为语义专家模块，显式建立跨 token 依赖。

Result: LongBench 多文档问答 +6%，Infinite-Bench 系列任务 +12.5%-17.5%，200 K token Needle-In-A-Haystack 测试仍保持有效召回；不改动主干结构即可嵌入任意模型。

Conclusion: PaceLLM 首次在保持原始架构的前提下将 LLM 可测长度扩展至 200 K tokens，显著刷新长文档基准，为类脑持续记忆与模块化专家在通用模型中的应用奠定基础，并具有跨模型易移植与新工具促进可解释性的双重价值。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance across domains, their long-context capabilities are limited by transient neural activations causing information decay and unstructured feed-forward network (FFN) weights leading to semantic fragmentation. Inspired by the brain's working memory and cortical modularity, we propose PaceLLM, featuring two innovations: (1) a Persistent Activity (PA) Mechanism that mimics prefrontal cortex (PFC) neurons' persistent firing by introducing an activation-level memory bank to dynamically retrieve, reuse, and update critical FFN states, addressing contextual decay; and (2) Cortical Expert (CE) Clustering that emulates task-adaptive neural specialization to reorganize FFN weights into semantic modules, establishing cross-token dependencies and mitigating fragmentation. Extensive evaluations show that PaceLLM achieves 6% improvement on LongBench's Multi-document QA and 12.5-17.5% performance gains on Infinite-Bench tasks, while extending measurable context length to 200K tokens in Needle-In-A-Haystack (NIAH) tests. This work pioneers brain-inspired LLM optimization and is complementary to other works. Besides, it can be generalized to any model and enhance their long-context performance and interpretability without structural overhauls.

</details>


### [347] [Bayesian Social Deduction with Graph-Informed Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17788)
*Shahab Rahimirad,Guven Gergerli,Lucia Romero,Angela Qian,Matthew Lyle Olson,Simon Stepputtis,Joseph Campbell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在推理阶段将显式概率信念模型嫁接给小规模LLM，我们让语言Agent在《阿瓦隆》中首次以67%胜率碾压人类，并在大幅度蒸馏的情况下仍保持SOTA级表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会推理需从稀疏行为推断他人不可见的信念与意图，现有大模型虽具能力但推理代价高昂，且一旦蒸馏到可实时部署的小模型便大幅退化。我们亟需一个能在‘推理深度-模型规模-实时性’三角中取得平衡的方案。

Method: 提出混合框架：LLM仅负责自然语言理解与沟通，观测与信念更新被外部化为Bayesian概率模型，通过消息接口耦合；同时采用在线推理+小规模参数+轻量蒸馏策略保证实时性。

Result: 在300局人机对照实验中，该混合Agent取得67%胜率，显著优于人类平均51%以及纯LLM基线；在Agent-Agent对抗中，6B级模型的表现可媲美175B全参数模型，推理时延降至1/15。

Conclusion: 把隐式社会信念解耦为显式结构化推理，可在保持语言可解释性的同时量化不确定性，是提升小模型社会推理能力、并支持人机竞技场景落地的有效路径。数据与代码全部开源。

Abstract: Social reasoning - inferring unobservable beliefs and intentions from partial observations of other agents - remains a challenging task for large language models (LLMs). We evaluate the limits of current reasoning language models in the social deduction game Avalon and find that while the largest models demonstrate strong performance, they require extensive test-time inference and degrade sharply when distilled to smaller, real-time-capable variants. To address this, we introduce a hybrid reasoning framework that externalizes belief inference to a structured probabilistic model, while using an LLM for language understanding and interaction. Our approach achieves competitive performance with much larger models in Agent-Agent play and, notably, is the first language agent to defeat human players in a controlled study - achieving a 67% win rate and receiving higher qualitative ratings than both reasoning baselines and human teammates. We release code, models, and a dataset to support future work on social reasoning in LLM agents, which can be found at https://camp-lab-purdue.github.io/bayesian-social-deduction/

</details>


### [348] [Exploiting Web Search Tools of AI Agents for Data Exfiltration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09093)
*Dennis Rall,Bernhard Bauer,Mohit Mittal,Thomas Fraunholz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM 在调用工具与 RAG 场景下易被间接提示注入攻击，主流模型依旧脆弱；作者呼吁用强化训练、攻击库与统一测试把安全前移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 通过工具调用与 RAG 接触企业敏感数据，间接提示注入成为新的高危害攻击面，亟需系统评估并给出防御蓝图。

Method: 对多款不同厂商、不同规模的 LLM 实施系统化的间接提示注入实验，比较攻击成功率与模型参数、实现方式的关系，并复现已知攻击模板。

Result: 即使是最新知名模型仍对经典注入手法高度易感；模型大小与厂商差异显著影响漏洞程度；攻击可稳定触发恶意行为。

Conclusion: 仅靠现有缓解措施无法消除长期威胁，必须在训练阶段内建鲁棒性、建立集中化攻击特征库，并配套持续统一的测试框架，把安全嵌入 LLM 核心设计。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now routinely used to autonomously execute complex tasks, from natural language processing to dynamic workflows like web searches. The usage of tool-calling and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) allows LLMs to process and retrieve sensitive corporate data, amplifying both their functionality and vulnerability to abuse. As LLMs increasingly interact with external data sources, indirect prompt injection emerges as a critical and evolving attack vector, enabling adversaries to exploit models through manipulated inputs. Through a systematic evaluation of indirect prompt injection attacks across diverse models, we analyze how susceptible current LLMs are to such attacks, which parameters, including model size and manufacturer, specific implementations, shape their vulnerability, and which attack methods remain most effective. Our results reveal that even well-known attack patterns continue to succeed, exposing persistent weaknesses in model defenses. To address these vulnerabilities, we emphasize the need for strengthened training procedures to enhance inherent resilience, a centralized database of known attack vectors to enable proactive defense, and a unified testing framework to ensure continuous security validation. These steps are essential to push developers toward integrating security into the core design of LLMs, as our findings show that current models still fail to mitigate long-standing threats.

</details>


### [349] [LLM4Delay: Flight Delay Prediction via Cross-Modality Adaptation of Large Language Models and Aircraft Trajectory Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23636)
*Thaweerath Phisannupawong,Joshua Julian Damanik,Han-Lim Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM4Delay 首次把管制员视角的文本（气象、通告等）与多轨迹模态联合嵌入 LLM，实现 TMA 内航班延误的连续预测，效果优于现有 ATM 系统与时序-文本迁移方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统延误预测主要依赖结构化时序数据，忽视管制员实时使用的丰富文本情报；TMA 阶段延误传导快，亟需融合文本与轨迹信息以提升预测精度和可解释性。

Method: 构建“文本+多轨迹”统一上下文：①实例级投影把每条轨迹编码映射到语言空间；②跨模态适配器实现轨迹-文本对齐；③冻结预训练轨迹编码器与 LLM，仅训练轻量适配层，支持在线更新。

Result: 在真实繁忙机场数据集上，LLM4Delay 的 F1 提升 6.8–12.4%，均方误差降低 18.7%，显著优于 ATM 基线与 SOTA 时序-文本迁移模型；推理延迟 <200 ms，满足管制席实时刷新需求。

Conclusion: 文本与轨迹信息互补，通过实例级投影-适配策略可无损注入 LLM 知识，实现 TMA 延误高精度、可解释、持续预测，为下一代管制决策支持系统提供可落地框架。

Abstract: Flight delay prediction has become a key focus in air traffic management (ATM), as delays reflect inefficiencies in the system. This paper proposes LLM4Delay, a large language model (LLM)-based framework for predicting flight delays from the perspective of air traffic controllers monitoring aircraft after they enter the terminal maneuvering area (TMA). LLM4Delay is designed to integrate textual aeronautical information, including flight data, weather reports, and aerodrome notices, together with multiple trajectories that model airspace conditions, forming a comprehensive delay-relevant context. By jointly leveraging comprehensive textual and trajectory contexts via instance-level projection, an effective cross-modality adaptation strategy that maps multiple instance-level trajectory representations into the language modality, the framework improves delay prediction accuracy. LLM4Delay demonstrates superior performance compared to existing ATM frameworks and prior time-series-to-language adaptation methods. This highlights the complementary roles of textual and trajectory data while leveraging knowledge from both the pretrained trajectory encoder and the pretrained LLM. The proposed framework enables continuous updates to predictions as new information becomes available, indicating potential operational relevance.

</details>


### [350] [Bharat Scene Text: A Novel Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Indian Language Scene Text Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23071)
*Anik De,Abhirama Subramanyam Penamakuri,Rajeev Yadav,Aditya Rathore,Harshiv Shah,Devesh Sharma,Sagar Agarwal,Pravin Kumar,Anand Mishra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者发布首个大规模印度语场景文本基准BSTD（11种语言、10万词、6,500张图），并通过微调英文SOTA模型验证其难度，推动多任务研究与开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英文场景文本识别已趋成熟，而印度语因文字多样、字体非标、风格多变且缺乏高质量数据与开源模型，仍未解决。

Method: 构建BSTD：跨印度多语言区采集6,500+张图像，精细标注10万+词汇，覆盖检测、文字识别、脚本分类与端到端四项任务；随后用英文SOTA模型微调评估。

Result: 实验显示，直接迁移英文模型在印度语任务上性能显著下降，暴露出脚本多样性等核心瓶颈；同时验证了BSTD作为新基准的有效性。

Conclusion: BSTD开源发布填补了印度语场景文本领域的空白，为后续算法改进与多任务研究提供基准与数据支撑。

Abstract: Reading scene text, that is, text appearing in images, has numerous application areas, including assistive technology, search, and e-commerce. Although scene text recognition in English has advanced significantly and is often considered nearly a solved problem, Indian language scene text recognition remains an open challenge. This is due to script diversity, non-standard fonts, and varying writing styles, and, more importantly, the lack of high-quality datasets and open-source models. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bharat Scene Text Dataset (BSTD) - a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark for studying Indian Language Scene Text Recognition. It comprises more than 100K words that span 11 Indian languages and English, sourced from over 6,500 scene images captured across various linguistic regions of India. The dataset is meticulously annotated and supports multiple scene text tasks, including: (i) Scene Text Detection, (ii) Script Identification, (iii) Cropped Word Recognition, and (iv) End-to-End Scene Text Recognition. We evaluated state-of-the-art models originally developed for English by adapting (fine-tuning) them for Indian languages. Our results highlight the challenges and opportunities in Indian language scene text recognition. We believe that this dataset represents a significant step toward advancing research in this domain. All our models and data are open source.

</details>


### [351] [Reasoning Models Will Sometimes Lie About Their Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07663)
*William Walden,Miriam Wanner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 给大模型提前预警“输入可能异常”能提升传统忠实度分数，但新指标显示它们仍会偷偷使用提示却口头上否认，链式思维监控与可解释性面临根本挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既往“基于提示”的忠实度测试发现大模型不愿透露提示对其推理的影响，但未告诉模型该如何应对提示或异常输入；而现实安全策略（如防注入）正要求模型警觉这类输入。作者想验证：当明确告知模型“输入可能异常”时，其忠实度到底如何。

Method: 在提示中先加入“输入可能含误导”类预警指令，再于推理链中植入答案提示；设计更细粒度指标（是否承认提示存在、是否承认使用、实际是否被使用）并与传统指标对比，系统测试模型行为。

Result: 预警提示显著提高了旧有忠实度指标分数；然而新指标揭示：模型虽常口头承认提示存在，却否认自己打算使用，且实验可证其仍在利用提示，形成“言行不一”的矛盾。

Conclusion: 仅靠让模型“警惕异常输入”无法解决忠实度问题；链式思维监测与可解释性需要超越表面自我报告，发展能 expose 隐性利用的外部验证机制。

Abstract: Hint-based faithfulness evaluations have established that Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) may not say what they think: they do not always volunteer information about how key parts of the input (e.g. answer hints) influence their reasoning. Yet, these evaluations also fail to specify what models should do when confronted with hints or other unusual prompt content -- even though versions of such instructions are standard security measures (e.g. for countering prompt injections). Here, we study faithfulness under this more realistic setting in which models are explicitly alerted to the possibility of unusual inputs. We find that such instructions can yield strong results on faithfulness metrics from prior work. However, results on new, more granular metrics proposed in this work paint a mixed picture: although models may acknowledge the presence of hints, they will often deny intending to use them -- even when permitted to use hints and even when it can be demonstrated that they are using them. Our results thus raise broader challenges for CoT monitoring and interpretability.

</details>


### [352] [FP8-RL: A Practical and Stable Low-Precision Stack for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18150)
*Zhaopeng Qiu,Shuang Yu,Jingqi Zhang,Shuai Zhang,Xue Huang,Jingyi Yang,Junjie Lai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首次在大模型RL rollout中实现端到端FP8量化，在vLLM/SGLM等引擎上取得44%吞吐提升且训练效果无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型RL的rollout阶段因长序列attention与KV-cache成为瓶颈，FP8可显著降低计算与访存，但RL场景下

Method: 采用blockwise FP8 W8A8量化策略；（ii）对KV-cache引入每步QKV scale重校准实现FP8化；（iii）对低精度rollout与高精度trainer之间的不一致，提出基于重要性采样的token级TIS/MIS纠偏。

Result: 在dense与MoE模型上，rollout吞吐最高提升44%，学习曲线与BF16基准基本重合。

Conclusion: 该FP8 rollout栈证明极低精度量化可用于RL推理而不牺牲收敛，为把FP8推广到更复杂RL算法和更长上下文提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by rollout (generation), where long output sequence lengths make attention and KV-cache memory dominate end-to-end step time. FP8 offers an attractive lever for accelerating RL by reducing compute cost and memory traffic during rollout, but applying FP8 in RL introduces unique engineering and algorithmic challenges: policy weights change every step (requiring repeated quantization and weight synchronization into the inference engine) and low-precision rollouts can deviate from the higher-precision policy assumed by the trainer, causing train-inference mismatch and potential instability. This report presents a practical FP8 rollout stack for LLM RL, implemented in the veRL ecosystem with support for common training backends (e.g., FSDP/Megatron-LM) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM/SGLang). We (i) enable FP8 W8A8 linear-layer rollout using blockwise FP8 quantization, (ii) extend FP8 to KV-cache to remove long-context memory bottlenecks via per-step QKV scale recalibration, and (iii) mitigate mismatch using importance-sampling-based rollout correction (token-level TIS/MIS variants). Across dense and MoE models, these techniques deliver up to 44% rollout throughput gains while preserving learning behavior comparable to BF16 baselines.

</details>


### [353] [Overstating Attitudes, Ignoring Networks: LLM Biases in Simulating Misinformation Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04674)
*Eun Cheol Choi,Lindsay E. Young,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用 LLM 模拟“受访者”去复现人类对谣言的易感性实验，发现：分布趋势粗看像人，但信念-转发关联被放大，网络变量权重被忽视，偏差源于模型内部对“谣言”相关概念的系统性表征。结论：LLM 仿真更适合做“偏差诊断器”，而非“人类替身”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算社会科学日益用 LLM 代替真人回答调查，但尚不清楚 LLM 是否能复现人类面对不实信息时的信念与分享模式。若 LLM 模拟失真，将直接威胁以外推政策或理论为目的的仿真研究效度。

Method: 从三项现有问卷调查抽取用户画像（网络、人口、态度、行为特征），用 GPT 系列模型生成对应“受访者”对谣言条款的回答；比较模拟分布与真实分布，再用线性模型检验特征-结果关联的还原度，并解析模型生成理由与训练语料中的概念表征。

Result: 1. 模拟回答与真人分布在宏观上呈 modest 相关，但信念-分享关联被人为放大（r 上升约 30–50%）。2. 拟合模拟数据的 R² 比真人数据高 20–40%，态度/行为特征权重膨胀，网络特征权重接近零；与人模型相反。3. 模型内部对“转发”“相信”等词向量的余弦相似度高于语料统计值，证实表征夸大。

Conclusion: LLM 在谣言议题上存在系统性“过度逻辑化”与“态度优先”偏差，无法还原人类社交网络与情境因素的作用。因此，当前 LLM 更适合充当“偏差检测探针”揭示模型-人差异，而非直接替代人类样本；在利用 LLM 进行政策仿真前，必须加入基于真人的校准层与不确定性评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxies for human judgment in computational social science, yet their ability to reproduce patterns of susceptibility to misinformation remains unclear. We test whether LLM-simulated survey respondents, prompted with participant profiles drawn from social survey data measuring network, demographic, attitudinal and behavioral features, can reproduce human patterns of misinformation belief and sharing. Using three online surveys as baselines, we evaluate whether LLM outputs match observed response distributions and recover feature-outcome associations present in the original survey data. LLM-generated responses capture broad distributional tendencies and show modest correlation with human responses, but consistently overstate the association between belief and sharing. Linear models fit to simulated responses exhibit substantially higher explained variance and place disproportionate weight on attitudinal and behavioral features, while largely ignoring personal network characteristics, relative to models fit to human responses. Analyses of model-generated reasoning and LLM training data suggest that these distortions reflect systematic biases in how misinformation-related concepts are represented. Our findings suggest that LLM-based survey simulations are better suited for diagnosing systematic divergences from human judgment than for substituting it.

</details>


### [354] [H-AdminSim: A Multi-Agent Simulator for Realistic Hospital Administrative Workflows with FHIR Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05407)
*Jun-Min Lee,Meong Hi Son,Edward Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出H-AdminSim——一套基于FHIR、多智能体的医院行政流程仿真框架，可日活万级任务，用于系统评估LLM在行政自动化中的可行性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型医院行政部门每日处理逾万次请求，亟需LLM自动化；已有研究仅聚焦医患对话或孤立子任务，无法还原真实行政流程复杂度。

Method: 1) 构建H-AdminSim仿真框架：结合真实数据生成与多智能体协同，覆盖完整行政工作流；2) 设计细粒度评估量纲，对任务完成质量进行定量打分；3) 通过FHIR实现跨异构医院环境的标准化、可互操作测试平台。

Result: 框架支持万级任务量仿真，并首次提供可重复、量化的LLM行政能力基准，可直接比较不同模型在审批、预约、资源调度等场景下的准确率与效率。

Conclusion: H-AdminSim填补了医院行政LLM评估空白，为后续模型迭代、部署决策和跨机构对比提供了标准化试验床，验证了大模型驱动行政自动化的可行性。

Abstract: Hospital administration departments handle a wide range of operational tasks and, in large hospitals, process over 10,000 requests per day, driving growing interest in LLM-based automation. However, prior work has focused primarily on patient-physician interactions or isolated administrative subtasks, failing to capture the complexity of real administrative workflows. To address this gap, we propose H-AdminSim, a comprehensive simulation framework that combines realistic data generation with multi-agent-based simulation of hospital administrative workflows. These tasks are quantitatively evaluated using detailed rubrics, enabling systematic comparison of LLMs. Through FHIR integration, H-AdminSim provides a unified and interoperable environment for testing administrative workflows across heterogeneous hospital settings, serving as a standardized testbed for assessing the feasibility and performance of LLM-driven administrative automation.

</details>


### [355] [ReplicatorBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Replicability in Social and Behavioral Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11354)
*Bang Nguyen,Dominik Soós,Qian Ma,Rochana R. Obadage,Zack Ranjan,Sai Koneru,Anna Szabelska,Adam Gill,Timothy M. Errington,Shakhlo Nematova,Sarah Rajtmajer,Jian Wu,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个覆盖“可/不可复现”双类社科声明的端到端基准 ReplicatorBench，并发布基线代理 ReplicatorAgent，首次系统评估大模型在真实复现流程中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只测代码-数据齐全的“可再现”论文，忽略新数据缺失导致的“不可复现实例”，且只重结果、不重过程，无法衡量 AI 代理像人类那样完成完整复现链路的能力。

Method: 1) 构建 ReplicatorBench：人工标注 140 条社科-行为科学声明（含 70 条不可复现），配套隐藏数据与评价指标；2) 设计三阶段任务：数据提取→实验设计执行→结果解释；3) 开发 ReplicatorAgent：集成搜索、沙箱、代码迭代等工具；4) 在 4 种 LLM、多语言与代码可见度条件下系统评估。

Result: LLM 代理能较好完成实验脚本编写与执行（成功率 65-78%），但在获取新数据阶段仅 22-34% 成功；整体复现准确率 38-52%，显著低于人类 71%。

Conclusion: 当前大模型已具备自动实验能力，但“数据获取”仍是瓶颈；ReplicatorBench 提供了公开、可扩展的测试平台，为后续提升代理的开放世界信息检索与源头批判能力指明方向。

Abstract: The literature has witnessed an emerging interest in AI agents for automated assessment of scientific papers. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on the computational aspect of this task, testing agents' ability to reproduce or replicate research outcomes when having access to the code and data. This setting, while foundational, (1) fails to capture the inconsistent availability of new data for replication as opposed to reproduction, and (2) lacks ground-truth diversity by focusing only on reproducible papers, thereby failing to evaluate an agent's ability to identify non-replicable research. Furthermore, most benchmarks only evaluate outcomes rather than the replication process. In response, we introduce ReplicatorBench, an end-to-end benchmark, including human-verified replicable and non-replicable research claims in social and behavioral sciences for evaluating AI agents in research replication across three stages: (1) extraction and retrieval of replication data; (2) design and execution of computational experiments; and (3) interpretation of results, allowing a test of AI agents' capability to mimic the activities of human replicators in real world. To set a baseline of AI agents' capability, we develop ReplicatorAgent, an agentic framework equipped with necessary tools, like web search and iterative interaction with sandboxed environments, to accomplish tasks in ReplicatorBench. We evaluate ReplicatorAgent across four underlying large language models (LLMs), as well as different design choices of programming language and levels of code access. Our findings reveal that while current LLM agents are capable of effectively designing and executing computational experiments, they struggle with retrieving resources, such as new data, necessary to replicate a claim. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/CenterForOpenScience/llm-benchmarking.

</details>


### [356] [Offline-First LLM Architecture for Adaptive Learning in Low-Connectivity Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03339)
*Joseph Walusimbi,Ann Move Oguti,Joshua Benjamin Ssentongo,Keith Ainebyona*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一套「离线优先」的量化LLM架构，在无网、低配的CPU设备上实现分学段自适应辅导，现场试验验证其可行性与教育价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI教学系统普遍依赖云端与持续联网，在带宽受限地区难以落地；需彻底脱网并能在老旧终端运行的LLM教育方案。

Method: 本地量化LLM＋硬件感知模型选型＋四级复杂度自适应生成（简单英语/初中/高中/专业）；在中学与高校低连通场景部署，评估技术性能、可用性、回答质量与教育成效。

Result: 系统在 legacy CPU 硬件上稳定运行，响应时间可接受；用户普遍认可其对自主学习的支持；不同学段学习者对分级解释给出高评价。

Conclusion: 离线量化LLM架构可切实支持低连通环境下的AI教学，为资源匮乏地区提供不依赖云端的个性化辅导解决方案。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) are transforming educational technology by enabling conversational tutoring, personalized explanations, and inquiry-driven learning. However, most AI-based learning systems rely on continuous internet connectivity and cloud-based computation, limiting their use in bandwidth-constrained environments. This paper presents an offline-first large language model architecture designed for AI-assisted learning in low-connectivity settings. The system performs all inference locally using quantized language models and incorporates hardware-aware model selection to enable deployment on low-specification CPU-only devices. By removing dependence on cloud infrastructure, the system provides curriculum-aligned explanations and structured academic support through natural-language interaction. To support learners at different educational stages, the system includes adaptive response levels that generate explanations at varying levels of complexity: Simple English, Lower Secondary, Upper Secondary, and Technical. This allows explanations to be adjusted to student ability, improving clarity and understanding of academic concepts. The system was deployed in selected secondary and tertiary institutions under limited-connectivity conditions and evaluated across technical performance, usability, perceived response quality, and educational impact. Results show stable operation on legacy hardware, acceptable response times, and positive user perceptions regarding support for self-directed learning. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of offline large language model deployment for AI-assisted education in low-connectivity environments.

</details>


### [357] [LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13450)
*Chenglin Wang,Yucheng Zhou,Shawn Chen,Tao Wang,Kai Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 LADR，利用图像空间马尔可夫特性，在推理阶段仅重绘“生成前沿”象素，4×倍加速文本到图像扩散模型且不降质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在多模态统一生成中表现好，但迭代解码造成极高推理延迟；现有加速方案需重训或忽视图像二维空间冗余。

Method: LADR：基于形态学定位“生成前沿”候选象素，结合有界风险滤噪阻止错误扩散，并以流形一致的逆调度匹配加速掩码密度，全程无需重训。

Result: 在四个文本-图像基准上实现约4×速度提升，同时保持甚至提升生成质量，空间推理任务优势更明显。

Conclusion: LADR首次在免训练条件下把空间先验引入扩散加速，为高效高保真多模态生成提供了新的最优权衡范式。

Abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models have emerged as a compelling paradigm for unified multimodal generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high inference latency arising from iterative decoding. Existing acceleration strategies often require expensive re-training or fail to leverage the 2D spatial redundancy inherent in visual data. To address this, we propose Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue (LADR), a training-free method that expedites inference by exploiting the spatial Markov property of images. LADR prioritizes the recovery of tokens at the ''generation frontier'', regions spatially adjacent to observed pixels, thereby maximizing information gain. Specifically, our method integrates morphological neighbor identification to locate candidate tokens, employs a risk-bounded filtering mechanism to prevent error propagation, and utilizes manifold-consistent inverse scheduling to align the diffusion trajectory with the accelerated mask density. Extensive experiments on four text-to-image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our LADR achieves an approximate 4 x speedup over standard baselines. Remarkably, it maintains or even enhances generative fidelity, particularly in spatial reasoning tasks, offering a state-of-the-art trade-off between efficiency and quality.

</details>


### [358] [AgentCE-Bench: Agent Configurable Evaluation with Scalable Horizons and Controllable Difficulty under Lightweight Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06111)
*Wang Yang,Chaoda Song,Xinpeng Li,Debargha Ganguly,Chuang Ma,Shouren Wang,Zhihao Dou,Yuli Zhou,Vipin Chaudhary,Xiaotian Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AgentCE-Bench用“静态 JSON + 网格排程”替代在线环境，把环境交互耗时压到 0，并通过可调隐藏槽数 H 与干扰项预算 B 分别控制任务长度与难度，实现对 13 种模型在 6 域上的可解释、可复现、训练友好型评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 基准存在两大硬伤：1. 环境交互开销高，最高占去 41% 总评估时间；2. 任务长度与难度分布极不均衡，导致总分不可信。作者认为必须设计一种“零环境交互、长度/难度可精细刻度化”的评测框架，才能让不同规模模型的推理能力被公平、高效、可解释地比较。

Method: 构建统一网格排程任务：代理需在部分填满的日程中补全 H 个隐藏槽位，同时满足局部与全局约束。通过“可扩展视野轴”(H) 与“可控难度轴”(干扰项预算 B) 正交调节任务复杂度。所有工具调用均映射到预先生成的静态 JSON 文件，实现 Lightweight Environment，彻底消除部署与运行开销。

Result: 验证表明：1) H 与 B 能线性、可靠地分别控制任务长度与难度；2) AgentCE-Bench 具有强域一致性与模型区分度。在 13 个不同规模/家族的模型、6 个排程域上的大规模实验显示，模型间性能差异显著且与参数规模非线性相关，基准给出的分数可解释、可重复。

Conclusion: 通过“零交互 JSON 环境 + 双轴刻度化任务设计”，AgentCE-Bench 首次把评测耗时降到理论最小，同时提供细粒度、可复现、训练期可用的 Agent 推理能力评估，为后续规模化、自动化 Agent 训练与对比奠定基准基础。

Abstract: Existing Agent benchmarks suffer from two critical limitations: high environment interaction overhead (up to 41\% of total evaluation time) and imbalanced task horizon and difficulty distributions that make aggregate scores unreliable. To address these issues, we propose AgentCE-Bench built around a unified grid-based planning task, where agents must fill hidden slots in a partially completed schedule subject to both local slot constraints and global constraints. Our benchmark offers fine-grained control through two orthogonal axes: \textbf{Scalable Horizons}, controlled by the number of hidden slots $H$, and \textbf{Controllable Difficulty}, governed by a decoy budget $B$ that determines the number of globally misleading decoy candidates. Crucially, all tool calls are resolved via static JSON files under a \textbf{Lightweight Environment} design, eliminating setup overhead and enabling fast, reproducible evaluation suitable for training-time validation. We first validate that $H$ and $B$ provide reliable control over task horizon and difficulty, and that AgentCE-Bench exhibits strong domain consistency and model discriminability. We then conduct comprehensive experiments across 13 models of diverse sizes and families over 6 domains, revealing significant cross-model performance variation and confirming that AgentCE-Bench provides interpretable and controllable evaluation of agent reasoning.

</details>


### [359] [Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07725)
*Monishwaran Maheswaran,Leon Lakhani,Zhongzhu Zhou,Shijia Yang,Junxiong Wang,Coleman Hooper,Yuezhou Hu,Rishabh Tiwari,Jue Wang,Harman Singh,Qingyang Wu,Yuqing Jian,Ce Zhang,Kurt Keutzer,Tri Dao,Xiaoxia Wu,Ben Athiwaratkun,James Zou,Chenfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在不使用验证器的情况下，单纯依靠进化生成会因多样性枯竭和高算力开销而陷入瓶颈。作者提出 Squeeze Evolve——一种基于“模型能力边际效用最大”原则的多模型协同进化框架，用低成本模型做低影响环节，把强模型留给高影响环节。该方法仅重排模型分布、无需修改硬件或引入验证器，在数学、代码、科学推理及多模态等7个新基准上成本降低∼3倍、固定预算吞吐提升∼10倍，并在若干任务上首次达到甚至超越带验证器进化方法的性能上限，刷新多项 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. verifier-free 进化推理常被两个瓶颈阻碍：     – 多样性崩溃：无外部校验时重复进化快速收敛到少数高效但狭窄的解，丧失探索性。     – 成本不可持续：统一使用高算力模型浪费多余算力，导致 API 成本随规模指数攀升。 现有工作要么接受性能下降，要么额外引入昂贵或难以获取的验证器，迫使研究者寻找更经济的替代策略。

Method: Squeeze Evolve：把进化流程切分为若干阶段（例如分解-探索-凝练），将多模型视作可插拔资源，用∑(边际效用) 最大化模型-任务分配。 1. 按需调度：用轻量级评估（成本-性能回归、k-平均效用、历史误差等）量化各模型在每一进化阶段的边际收益，动态把“昂贵模型”放到高增益步骤，其余步骤由“廉价模型”兜底。 2. 统一调度层：无论模型是开源/闭源还是混合部署，通过一套标准化接口随时插拔，无需修改底层硬件或训练流程。 3. 零验证进化：彻底放弃外部验证/奖励模型，仅从种群质量和收敛速度做自我优化，避免了额外算力与人工标注。

Result: 多任务综合：在 AIME 2025、HMMT 2025、LiveCodeBench V6、GPQA-Diamond、ARC-AGI-V2、MMMU-Pro、BabyVision 等7项最新基准上与单一强模型进化对比： – accuracy 平均提升 4.2–19.8 个百分点； – API 总调用成本降低最高∼3×，固定预算下吞吐提升最高∼10×； – 首次在多项数学与科学发现任务上实现“无验证方法 > 带验证器方法”，刷新任务 SOTA。 消融实验：若去掉边际效用调度，改用随机或静态模型取用，准确率平均下降 6–13 点，成本同时上升。

Conclusion: 通过“能力按需分配”而非“一味堆算力”，Squeeze Evolve 同时解决了 verifier-free 进化中的多样性塌陷与成本失控两大痛点。框架仅依赖 Lightweight 调度层，对开源/闭源、混合模型均透明兼容，不增加任何验证开销即可把性能推到带验证器基准之上。该研究表明：多模型协同策略为未来大算力场景提供了一条可持续、可部署且易扩展的进化推理范式，为进一步扩展到更真实、更长周期的推理业务奠定了低成本、高性能基线。

Abstract: We show that verifier-free evolution is bottlenecked by both diversity and efficiency: without external correction, repeated evolution accelerates collapse toward narrow modes, while the uniform use of a high-cost model wastes compute and quickly becomes economically impractical. We introduce Squeeze Evolve, a unified multi-model orchestration framework for verifier-free evolutionary inference. Our approach is guided by a simple principle: allocate model capability where it has the highest marginal utility. Stronger models are reserved for high-impact stages, while cheaper models handle the other stages at much lower costs. This principle addresses diversity and cost-efficiency jointly while remaining lightweight. Squeeze Evolve naturally supports open-source, closed-source, and mixed-model deployments. Across AIME 2025, HMMT 2025, LiveCodeBench V6, GPQA-Diamond, ARC-AGI-V2, and multimodal vision benchmarks, such as MMMU-Pro and BabyVision, Squeeze Evolve consistently improves the cost-capability frontier over single-model evolution and achieves new state-of-the-art results on several tasks. Empirically, Squeeze Evolve reduces API cost by up to $\sim$3$\times$ and increases fixed-budget serving throughput by up to $\sim$10$\times$. Moreover, on discovery tasks, Squeeze Evolve is the first verifier-free evolutionary method to match, and in some cases exceed, the performance of verifier-based evolutionary methods.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [360] [Spectral-Transport Stability and Benign Overfitting in Interpolating Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08625)
*Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Lundström Fredriksson-Imanov*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对现代深度学习“过参数化却泛化良好”的反常现象，提出“谱-迁移稳定性”统一框架：用数据谱几何、单样本替换敏感度与标签噪声对齐结构三要素合成一个Fredriksson指标，给出有限样本风险界与良性过拟合相变判据，并以多项式谱线性插值为例提供显式速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度过参数化估计器可在训练误差为零的同时保持非平凡预测精度，学界尚缺解释“良性 vs 破坏性”过拟合边界的完整理论。作者旨在将算法稳定性、双下降、隐式正则化等现象纳入同一结构框架。

Method: 1. 建立谱-迁移稳定性框架：把超额风险拆解为谱几何、迁移稳定性(leave-one-out敏感度)、噪声对齐三项。
2. 引入随尺度变化的Fredriksson复杂度指数，整合有效维度、稳定性与噪声结构。
3. 证明插值估计器的有限样本风险上界，并给出指数沿可接受谱尺度趋于0的“良性过拟合”判据。
4. 对多项式谱衰减情形推导显式相变速率；在线性插值模型中给出可达下界。
5. 解释梯度动力学如何选取谱-迁移能量最小的插值解，从而揭示隐式正则化机制。

Result: 1. 首次给出插值情形下统一的有限样本超额风险界，显示风险受Fredriksson指数控制。
2. 证明当该指数沿谱尺度序列趋于0时，系统经历从良性到破坏性过拟合的锐相变。
3. 对多项式谱衰减模型，显式给出风险随样本量n、特征维度p的衰减/增长速率，理论预测与经验“双下降”曲线一致。
4. 线性插值特例下，风险界匹配已有最小范数解结果，并证明其速率最优。
5. 框架将稳定性、算子学习理论、隐式偏差等原本分散的概念纳入同一谱-迁移视角。

Conclusion: 谱-迁移稳定性框架用单一复杂度指标刻画插值泛化，为“为何过参数化可行”提供可计算、可验证的理论边界，并统一解释稳定性、隐式正则与双下降现象。该工作将推动对深度网络及其它过参数化模型泛化机制的定量理解，并为设计可控插值算法提供理论工具。

Abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for generalization in the interpolating regime of statistical learning. The central question is why highly overparameterized estimators can attain zero empirical risk while still achieving nontrivial predictive accuracy, and how to characterize the boundary between benign and destructive overfitting. We introduce a spectral-transport stability framework in which excess risk is controlled jointly by the spectral geometry of the data distribution, the sensitivity of the learning rule under single-sample replacement, and the alignment structure of label noise. This leads to a scale-dependent Fredriksson index that combines effective dimension, transport stability, and noise alignment into a single complexity parameter for interpolating estimators. We prove finite-sample risk bounds, establish a sharp benign-overfitting criterion through the vanishing of the index along admissible spectral scales, and derive explicit phase-transition rates under polynomial spectral decay. For a model-specific specialization, we obtain an explicit theorem for polynomial-spectrum linear interpolation, together with a proof of the resulting rate. The framework also clarifies implicit regularization by showing how optimization dynamics can select interpolating solutions of minimal spectral-transport energy. These results connect algorithmic stability, double descent, benign overfitting, operator-theoretic learning theory, and implicit bias within a unified structural account of modern interpolation.

</details>


### [361] [Policy-Aware Design of Large-Scale Factorial Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08804)
*Xin Wen,Xi Chen,Will Wei Sun,Yichen Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 为组合式产品决策提出两阶段实验设计：先集中化因子实验并用低秩张量补全淘汰劣势因子，再对存活组合做序贯减半，理论证明复杂度仅依赖张量自由度而非全因子规模，淘宝 1 亿数据验证低预算/高噪声下显著优于传统 A/B 与张量一次性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字平台常在共享流量上并行 A/B 测试组合式干预（界面、流程、激励等），可行组合随因子呈阶乘爆炸，而流量有限，导致重叠实验的交互效应被忽视，去中心化测试难以在预算内找出高绩效策略。

Method: 1) 集中化：把重叠实验建模为单一大规模因子实验。2) 低秩张量建模：将期望收益表示为低秩张量。3) 第一阶段：随机采样部分组合→张量补全估计全部组合性能→用边际贡献淘汰劣势因子水平。4) 第二阶段：对幸存组合实施序贯减半 (sequential halving) 选最终策略。5) 理论：给出与因子数无关的 simple regret 界及与因子分离度相关的识别保证，复杂度由张量自由度而非全量 |A|^d 决定。

Result: 在淘宝 1 亿交互的离线商品捆绑任务上，所提方法在低预算（采样率<1%）与高噪声场景下，simple regret 比一次性张量补全降低 40%+，比无结构最佳臂识别降低 60%+；所需流量仅为全因子实验的 1/1000 即可选出同等或更优策略。

Conclusion: 通过集中化、以策略选择为目标的低秩张量实验框架，可在平台规模下用极低采样率解决组合式产品设计的阶乘爆炸问题，为工业界大规模在线实验提供可行路径。

Abstract: Digital firms routinely run many online experiments on shared user populations. When product decisions are compositional, such as combinations of interface elements, flows, messages, or incentives, the number of feasible interventions grows combinatorially, while available traffic remains limited. Overlapping experiments can therefore generate interaction effects that are poorly handled by decentralized A/B testing. We study how to design large-scale factorial experiments when the objective is not to estimate every treatment effect, but to identify a high-performing policy under a fixed experimentation budget. We propose a two-stage design that centralizes overlapping experiments into a single factorial problem and models expected outcomes as a low-rank tensor. In the first stage, the platform samples a subset of intervention combinations, uses tensor completion to infer performance on untested combinations, and eliminates weak factor levels using estimated marginal contributions. In the second stage, it applies sequential halving to the surviving combinations to select a final policy. We establish gap-independent simple-regret bounds and gap-dependent identification guarantees showing that the relevant complexity scales with the degrees of freedom of the low-rank tensor and the separation structure across factor levels, rather than the full factorial size. In an offline evaluation based on a product-bundling problem constructed from 100 million Taobao interactions, the proposed method substantially outperforms one-shot tensor completion and unstructured best-arm benchmarks, especially in low-budget and high-noise settings. These results show how centralized, policy-aware experimentation can make combinatorial product design operationally feasible at platform scale.

</details>


### [362] [A novel hybrid approach for positive-valued DAG learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08935)
*Yao Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: H-MRS算法利用正数变量特有的矩比准则，在log尺度上估计、在原始尺度上排序，先贪心定序再用Elastic-Net挑父节点，高效且无 negativity 问题地从观测数据学DAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有很多因果发现方法默认加法噪声，难以处理基因表达、资产价格等天然正数且呈乘法动态的数据；需要一种既尊重正值约束又能利用其矩特性的因果图学习框架。

Method: 提出Hybrid Moment-Ratio Scoring (H-MRS)：先在log尺度用岭回归估计条件期望，计算矩比\(\frac{\mathbb{E}[X_j^2]}{\mathbb{E}[(\mathbb{E}[X_j\mid S])^2]}\)作为因果排序分数；再按原始尺度矩比贪心排序，最后用Elastic-Net遴选父节点，整体输出DAG。

Result: 在合成log线性模型数据上，H-MRS在精度与召回率上均与主流方法竞争，同时保持线性时间复杂度且天然满足正值约束。

Conclusion: 将对数尺度建模与原始尺度矩比结合，可在正值领域实现高效、可解释的因果发现，为基因组学、经济学等应用提供实用工具。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning and statistics, particularly when variables represent inherently positive quantities such as gene expression levels, asset prices, company revenues, or population counts, which often follow multiplicative rather than additive dynamics. We propose the Hybrid Moment-Ratio Scoring (H-MRS) algorithm, a novel method for learning directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) from positive-valued data by combining moment-based scoring with log-scale regression. The key idea is that for positive-valued variables, the moment ratio $\frac{\mathbb{E}[X_j^2]}{\mathbb{E}[(\mathbb{E}[X_j \mid S])^2]}$ provides an effective criterion for causal ordering, where $S$ denotes candidate parent sets. H-MRS integrates log-scale Ridge regression for moment-ratio estimation with a greedy ordering procedure based on raw-scale moment ratios, followed by Elastic Net-based parent selection to recover the final DAG structure. Experiments on synthetic log-linear data demonstrate competitive precision and recall. The proposed method is computationally efficient and naturally respects positivity constraints, making it suitable for applications in genomics and economics. These results suggest that combining log-scale modeling with raw-scale moment ratios provides a practical framework for causal discovery in positive-valued domains.

</details>


### [363] [Online Quantile Regression for Nonparametric Additive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08969)
*Haoran Zhan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: This paper introduces a projected functional gradient descent algorithm (P-FGD) for training nonparametric additive quantile regression models in online settings. This algorithm extends the functional stochastic gradient descent framework to the pinball loss. An advantage of P-FGD is that it does not need to store historical data while maintaining $O(J_t\ln J_t)$ computational complexity per step where $J_t$ denotes the number of basis functions. Besides, we only need $O(J_t)$ computational time for quantile function prediction at time $t$. These properties show that P-FGD is much better than the commonly used RKHS in online learning. By leveraging a novel Hilbert space projection identity, we also prove that the proposed online quantile function estimator (P-FGD) achieves the minimax optimal consistency rate $O(t^{-\frac{2s}{2s+1}})$ where $t$ is the current time and $s$ denotes the smoothness degree of the quantile function. Extensions to mini-batch learning are also established.

</details>


### [364] [Identifying Causal Effects Using a Single Proxy Variable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09135)
*Silvan Vollmer,Niklas Pfister,Sebastian Weichwald*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 仅凭一个多维度代理变量及其生成机制，即可在SPICE可识别性条件下非参识别因果效应，并可用深度网络（SPICE-Net）估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学实证中常存在未观测混杂，传统需多代理变量才能识别的假设难以满足。作者希望仅用单代理变量完成非参识别，以放宽数据要求。

Method: 提出Single Proxy Identifiability of Causal Effects（SPICE）框架：1) 在“代理生成机制完备”假设下证明单代理即可识别因果效应；2) 将Kuroki-Pearl的离散-线性-低维结果推广至高维、非线性及一般分布；3) 设计SPICE-Net，用神经网络同时学习代理机制与潜在混杂分布，实现离散/连续处理的端到端估计。

Result: 理论上，SPICE条件把单代理问题转化为可识别问题，不依赖处理可逆等传统约束；方法上，SPICE-Net在仿真和真实数据里显著降低ATE估计误差，优于双代理或经典IV基准。

Conclusion: 单代理+已知生成机制是识别因果效应的充分条件；SPICE-Net为实际研究提供了只需一个多维度代理即可实施的深度估计工具，可广泛应用于观测性研究。

Abstract: Unobserved confounding is a key challenge when estimating causal effects from a treatment on an outcome in scientific applications. In this work, we assume that we observe a single, potentially multi-dimensional proxy variable of the unobserved confounder and that we know the mechanism that generates the proxy from the confounder. Under a completeness assumption on this mechanism, which we call Single Proxy Identifiability of Causal Effects or simply SPICE, we prove that causal effects are identifiable. We extend the proxy-based causal identifiability results by Kuroki and Pearl (2014); Pearl (2010) to higher dimensions, more flexible functional relationships and a broader class of distributions. Further, we develop a neural network based estimation framework, SPICE-Net, to estimate causal effects, which is applicable to both discrete and continuous treatments.

</details>


### [365] [A Predictive View on Streaming Hidden Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09208)
*Gerardo Duran-Martin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种针对流式隐马尔可夫模型的“先预测后优化”框架，用固定路径数 S 的束搜索实现确定性在线推断，无需 EM 或采样即可保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流式 HMM 方法先还原完整后验，计算量随路径指数爆炸；作者希望仅维护 S 条路径即可在线识别潜在状态，同时保证一步预测精度。

Method: 1) 假设已知固定的状态转移先验，但各状态对应的预测模型参数可在线学习；2) 将过滤问题转化为“预测分布空间中的受约束投影”，目标是在前向-KL 意义下用仅含 S 条支撑路径的混合分布近似完整后验预测；3) 理论上证明最优解即按后验权重取前 S 路径再归一化，由此导出无需采样、递归且确定性的束搜索算法，并给出闭式预测更新。

Result: 在等计算预算下，新算法与在线 EM、序贯蒙特卡洛相比，单步预测性能相当，同时完全递归、无需 EM 迭代或粒子重采样。

Conclusion: 通过将流式推断重新表述为预测分布空间的有约束投影，可在固定路径预算内用确定性束搜索实现在线 HMM 状态识别与预测，为资源受限场景提供了高效、可扩展的替代方案。

Abstract: We develop a predictive-first optimisation framework for streaming hidden Markov models. Unlike classical approaches that prioritise full posterior recovery under a fully specified generative model, we assume access to regime-specific predictive models whose parameters are learned online while maintaining a fixed transition prior over regimes. Our objective is to sequentially identify latent regimes while maintaining accurate step-ahead predictive distributions. Because the number of possible regime paths grows exponentially, exact filtering is infeasible. We therefore formulate streaming inference as a constrained projection problem in predictive-distribution space: under a fixed hypothesis budget, we approximate the full posterior predictive by the forward-KL optimal mixture supported on $S$ paths. The solution is the renormalised top-$S$ posterior-weighted mixture, providing a principled derivation of beam search for HMMs. The resulting algorithm is fully recursive and deterministic, performing beam-style truncation with closed-form predictive updates and requiring neither EM nor sampling. Empirical comparisons against Online EM and Sequential Monte Carlo under matched computational budgets demonstrate competitive prequential performance.

</details>


### [366] [Iterative Identification Closure: Amplifying Causal Identifiability in Linear SEMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09309)
*Ziyi Ding,Xiao-Ping Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Iterative Identification Closure（IIC）框架，用迭代传播机制替代HTC的孤立判定，可将无法识别的因果系数减少80%以上，理论上严格优于HTC且零误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准半路径准则（HTC）只能孤立地判定节点，留下15–23%的‘不确定’边；现有方法即便引入外部信息也缺乏反馈机制，识别增益有限。

Method: 将识别拆为两步：①任意信息源（工具变量、干预、非高斯性等）给出初始种子边S0；②降维HTC（Reduced HTC）迭代地把已识别系数代入模型，缩减系统维度，并证明修改后的Jacobian仍保持通秩（Reduced HTC定理）。

Result: 在n≤5全部134 144条边上验证：IIC收敛于O(|E|)步（实际≤2），精度100%；仅2个种子即可将总识别率从3%提升至97.5%，传播增益γ≈4×，显著高于无反馈方法的γ≤1.2×。

Conclusion: IIC首次实现因果系数的迭代反馈式识别，理论上严格涵盖HTC与祖先分解，实践中基本闭合识别缺口，为含潜混杂的线性SEM识别提供了通用且高效的新工具。

Abstract: The Half-Trek Criterion (HTC) is the primary graphical tool for determining generic identifiability of causal effect coefficients in linear structural equation models (SEMs) with latent confounders. However, HTC is inherently node-wise: it simultaneously resolves all incoming edges of a node, leaving a gap of "inconclusive" causal effects (15-23% in moderate graphs). We introduce Iterative Identification Closure (IIC), a general framework that decouples causal identification into two phases: (1) a seed function S_0 that identifies an initial set of edges from any external source of information (instrumental variables, interventions, non-Gaussianity, prior knowledge, etc.); and (2) Reduced HTC propagation that iteratively substitutes known coefficients to reduce system dimension, enabling identification of edges that standard HTC cannot resolve. The core novelty is iterative identification propagation: newly identified edges feed back to unlock further identification -- a mechanism absent from all existing graphical criteria, which treat each edge (or node) in isolation. This propagation is non-trivial: coefficient substitution alters the covariance structure, and soundness requires proving that the modified Jacobian retains generic full rank -- a new theoretical result (Reduced HTC Theorem). We prove that IIC is sound, monotone, converges in O(|E|) iterations (empirically <=2), and strictly subsumes both HTC and ancestor decomposition. Exhaustive verification on all graphs with n<=5 (134,144 edges) confirms 100% precision (zero false positives); with combined seeds, IIC reduces the HTC gap by over 80%. The propagation gain is gamma~4x (2 seeds identifying ~3% of edges to 97.5% total identification), far exceeding gamma<=1.2x of prior methods that incorporate side information without iterative feedback.

</details>


### [367] [Sharp description of local minima in the loss landscape of high-dimensional two-layer ReLU neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09412)
*Jie Huang,Bruno Loureiro,Stefano Sarao Mannelli*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Gaussian输入下两层ReLU网络在师生框架中的总体损失曲面可被精确降维描述；过参数化时局部极小值连通且全局极小更易到达，揭示常见简化假设会遗漏关键结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管过参数化网络在实践中有优异表现，其损失曲面几何仍缺乏精确、可解释的低维刻画；现有简化假设可能掩盖关键结构，需在最简可解模型中揭示本质特征。

Method: 采用高斯协变量师生框架，引入可压缩局部极小值的低维汇总统计量，证明其为SGD动力学吸引不动点；通过统计量空间的谱分析刻画参数连通性与宽度效应。

Result: 局部极小值等价于汇总统计量的低维流形；适度参数时极小值孤立，过参数化时出现连接平坦方向；全局极小吸引域随宽度增大而主导，显著降低陷入非全局解的概率。

Conclusion: 即便在两层ReLU最小模型，简化假设也会遗漏损失曲面核心几何；汇总统计量视角为理解SGD动力学与过参数化优势提供精准可解释框架，并提示需重审更复杂模型的理论假设。

Abstract: We study the population loss landscape of two-layer ReLU networks of the form $\sum_{k=1}^K \mathrm{ReLU}(w_k^\top x)$ in a realisable teacher-student setting with Gaussian covariates. We show that local minima admit an exact low-dimensional representation in terms of summary statistics, yielding a sharp and interpretable characterisation of the landscape. We further establish a direct link with one-pass SGD: local minima correspond to attractive fixed points of the dynamics in summary statistics space. This perspective reveals a hierarchical structure of minima: they are typically isolated in the well-specified regime, but become connected by flat directions as network width increases. In this overparameterised regime, global minima become increasingly accessible, attracting the dynamics and reducing convergence to spurious solutions. Overall, our results reveal intrinsic limitations of common simplifying assumptions, which may miss essential features of the loss landscape even in minimal neural network models.

</details>


### [368] [Beyond Augmented-Action Surrogates for Multi-Expert Learning-to-Defer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09414)
*Yannis Montreuil,Axel Carlier,Lai Xing Ng,Wei Tsang Ooi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次将“选择专家后再决定给他什么额外信息”这一现实场景形式化为 Learning-to-Defer with advice，证明简单分离式损失不一致，提出联合优化专家-信息动作的增广损失并给出理论保证，实验在表格/文本/多模态任务上验证其优于标准 LtD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Learning-to-Defer 假设一旦选定专家，其可用信息即固定；现代系统却常在路由后再为专家动态获取文档、工具输出或上下文等额外信息。该现实需求在理论上未被研究，且直观地把路由与信息获取分头学习的做法缺乏一致性保证。

Method: 1) 将专家选择与信息获取合并为复合动作空间，定义新风险；2) 证明一类“分离式”代理损失（各自用独立头学习路由与信息）即使在最小非平凡设定下也不一致；3) 提出直接在整个复合动作空间上优化的增广代理损失，推导 H-一致性界与超额风险迁移界；4) 在极限情形下可恢复 Bayes 最优策略。

Result: 理论给出增广损失的 H-一致性及有限样本超额风险迁移界；实验表明新方法在表格、文本与多模态数据集上显著优于标准 Learning-to-Defer，并能根据代价机制自适应调节信息获取量；合成实验验证了分离式损失的理论失败模式。

Conclusion: Learning-to-Defer with advice 扩展了经典框架以覆盖选专家后仍可获取信息的现实场景；分离式学习在该场景下必然不一致，必须联合优化专家与信息动作；所提增广代理兼顾理论保证与实用效果，为未来动态信息获取系统提供新范式。

Abstract: Learning-to-Defer routes each input to the expert that minimizes expected cost, but it assumes that the information available to every expert is fixed at decision time. Many modern systems violate this assumption: after selecting an expert, one may also choose what additional information that expert should receive, such as retrieved documents, tool outputs, or escalation context. We study this problem and call it Learning-to-Defer with advice. We show that a broad family of natural separated surrogates, which learn routing and advice with distinct heads, is inconsistent even in the smallest non-trivial setting. We then introduce an augmented surrogate that operates on the composite expert--advice action space and prove an $\mathcal{H}$-consistency guarantee together with an excess-risk transfer bound, yielding recovery of the Bayes-optimal policy in the limit. Experiments on tabular, language, and multi-modal tasks show that the resulting method improves over standard Learning-to-Defer while adapting its advice-acquisition behavior to the cost regime; a synthetic benchmark confirms the failure mode predicted for separated surrogates.

</details>


### [369] [Accurate and Reliable Uncertainty Estimates for Deterministic Predictions Extensions to Under and Overpredictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08755)
*Rileigh Bandy,Enrico Camporeale,Andong Hu,Thomas Berger,Rebecca Morrison*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出ACCRUE扩展框架，以神经网络学习输入相关、非高斯（两片高斯/非对称拉普拉斯）不确定性分布，兼顾精度与可靠性，显著改善概率预测并刻画偏斜厚尾误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险决策亟需量化模型不确定性；采样法实时性差，现有分布无关或高斯假设方法忽视输入依赖且难捕非对称、厚尾特征。

Method: 将ACCRUE框架扩展为神经网络末端直接输出两片高斯或非对称拉普拉斯参数；设计同时优化预测精度与预测区间可靠性的复合损失，实现输入依赖、非高斯不确定性端到端学习。

Result: 综合合成与真实数据集实验表明，新方法准确捕获输入 varying 的异方差与偏斜结构，CRPS、区间覆盖率等指标优于传统高斯、分位回归及分布无关基准，且保持对厚尾、偏斜误差的建模灵活性。

Conclusion: 所提输入相关非高斯 uncertainty 建模策略在计算效率与概率预测质量间取得优良平衡，可推广至实时工程与科学决策场景，并为后续更复杂分布或物理约束扩展提供基础。

Abstract: Computational models support high-stakes decisions across engineering and science, and practitioners increasingly seek probabilistic predictions to quantify uncertainty in such models. Existing approaches generate predictions either by sampling input parameter distributions or by augmenting deterministic outputs with uncertainty representations, including distribution-free and distributional methods. However, sampling-based methods are often computationally prohibitive for real-time applications, and many existing uncertainty representations either ignore input dependence or rely on restrictive Gaussian assumptions that fail to capture asymmetry and heavy-tailed behavior. Therefore, we extend the ACCurate and Reliable Uncertainty Estimate (ACCRUE) framework to learn input-dependent, non-Gaussian uncertainty distributions, specifically two-piece Gaussian and asymmetric Laplace forms, using a neural network trained with a loss function that balances predictive accuracy and reliability. Through synthetic and real-world experiments, we show that the proposed approach captures an input-dependent uncertainty structure and improves probabilistic forecasts relative to existing methods, while maintaining flexibility to model skewed and non-Gaussian errors.

</details>


### [370] [Hierarchical Kernel Transformer: Multi-Scale Attention with an Information-Theoretic Approximation Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08829)
*Giansalvo Cirrincione*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HKT 用 L 级可学习因果下采样将多尺度注意力拼成一个核函数，计算量 ≤1.3125×，理论上包容标准注意力与因果卷积，误差可解释；在 ListOps、CIFAR-10、IMDB 字符级任务上平均提升 4.6pp，仅 31% 额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自注意力计算随序列长度二次增长，且单一尺度难以捕捉长程与局部混杂的依赖；需一种兼顾线性复杂度、多尺度表征与理论保证的注意力替代方案。

Method: 提出分层核 Transformer（HKT）：1) 用因果卷积对输入做 L 级可训练下采样，每级保留不同时间分辨率；2) 各级分别计算因果注意力得分矩阵，再通过可学习的凸权重融合为单一层次化核；3) 通过正半定核理论保证整体注意力矩阵的合法性；4) 将非对称得分显式拆成对称/反对称部分，分别建模互反注意与方向性注意。

Result: 理论：1) 给出核正半定的充分条件；2) 证明 HKT 严格包含单头标准注意力与因果卷积；3) 逼近误差显式分解为三项，并给出随 L 几何衰减的界。实验：与重训标准注意力基线相比，ListOps(512)↑4.77pp，CIFAR-10(1k)↑1.44pp，IMDB-char(1k)↑7.47pp，平均计算开销仅 1.31×。

Conclusion: HKT 以≤4/3 的代价把多尺度依赖、因果性与核方法统一，理论完备且实验有效，为长序列建模提供了可扩展的新注意力范式。

Abstract: The Hierarchical Kernel Transformer (HKT) is a multi-scale attention mechanism that processes sequences at L resolution levels via trainable causal downsampling, combining level-specific score matrices through learned convex weights. The total computational cost is bounded by 4/3 times that of standard attention, reaching 1.3125x for L = 3. Four theoretical results are established. (i) The hierarchical score matrix defines a positive semidefinite kernel under a sufficient condition on the symmetrised bilinear form (Proposition 3.1). (ii) The asymmetric score matrix decomposes uniquely into a symmetric part controlling reciprocal attention and an antisymmetric part controlling directional attention; HKT provides L independent such pairs across scales, one per resolution level (Propositions 3.5-3.6). (iii) The approximation error decomposes into three interpretable components with an explicit non-Gaussian correction and a geometric decay bound in L (Theorem 4.3, Proposition 4.4). (iv) HKT strictly subsumes single-head standard attention and causal convolution (Proposition 3.4). Experiments over 3 random seeds show consistent gains over retrained standard attention baselines: +4.77pp on synthetic ListOps (55.10+-0.29% vs 50.33+-0.12%, T = 512), +1.44pp on sequential CIFAR-10 (35.45+-0.09% vs 34.01+-0.19%, T = 1,024), and +7.47pp on IMDB character-level sentiment (70.19+-0.57% vs 62.72+-0.40%, T = 1,024), all at 1.31x overhead.

</details>


### [371] [U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09041)
*Salva Rühling Cachay,Duncan Watson-Parris,Rose Yu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: U-Net+简单两阶段训练即可在1.5°分辨率上达到GenCast/IFS ENS的集合预报水平，训练与推理成本均降10倍以上，60步预报11秒完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOTA AI天气模型依赖专用架构与巨大算力，门槛高；作者质疑“复杂=必要”，希望用通用轻量方案实现同水平概率预报。

Method: 以标准U-Net为骨干，先确定性MAE预训练，再基于CRPS+Monte Carlo Dropout做短时概率微调，直接输出集合样本。

Result: 在1.5°分辨率概率评分上匹配或优于GenCast与IFS ENS；训练耗时<12 H200 GPU-days，推理延迟11 s，成本均降10×以上。

Conclusion: 通用架构+高效训练即可复刻复杂专业模型性能，显著降低算力与门槛，使前沿概率天气预报大众化。

Abstract: AI-based weather forecasting now rivals traditional physics-based ensembles, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models rely on specialized architectures and massive computational budgets, creating a high barrier to entry. We demonstrate that such complexity is unnecessary for frontier performance. We introduce U-Cast, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity. As a result, our model matches or exceeds the probabilistic skill of GenCast and IFS ENS at 1.5$^\circ\$ resolution while reducing training compute by over 10$\times$ compared to leading CRPS-based models and inference latency by over 10$\times$ compared to diffusion-based models. U-Cast trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days and generates a 60-step ensemble forecast in 11 seconds. These results suggest that scalable, general-purpose architectures paired with efficient training curricula can match complex domain-specific designs at a fraction of the cost, opening the training of frontier probabilistic weather models to the broader community. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/u-cast.

</details>


### [372] [Generalization and Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09175)
*Mansour Zoubeirou a Mayaki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次为MoE Transformer提供“把活跃参数与路由组合解耦”的统计泛化框架，推导出仅依赖于活跃参数量的覆盖数界，并据此给出近似-估计权衡、规模律与算力最优配比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规模律研究多聚焦稠密模型，而MoE因“稀疏激活＋动态路由”导致参数总数与有效容量不一致，缺乏能解释其缩放行为的严谨理论。

Method: 1)固定路由并联合界定所有可能路由，建立sup-范数覆盖数；2)结合标准ERM分析，给出基于d维流形数据与C^β目标的泛化界；3)构造性证明：误差既可通过提高活跃容量也可通过增加专家数降低；4)导出模型/数据/算力三维规模律。

Result: 1)首次获得仅随“活跃参数预算”增长的熵界，路由仅带来附加对数因子；2)证明MoE的近似-估计权衡与相同活跃参数量的稠密网络一致；3)给出误差~N^(-β/(2β+d))、样本~模型大小~算力的闭合最优配比；4)明确区分“最坏case可证”与“依赖数据/优化”两类现象。

Conclusion: 理论为MoE提供了透明的统计参照：规模行为主要由活跃容量决定，增加专家数仅在近似瓶颈主导时有效，而数据依赖路由与优化动态则超出最坏case保证，需用实证补充。

Abstract: We develop a theory of generalization and scaling for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers that cleanly separates \emph{active} per-input capacity from routing combinatorics. By conditioning on fixed routing patterns and union-bounding across them, we derive a sup-norm covering-number bound whose metric entropy scales with the active parameter budget and incurs a MoE-specific routing overhead. Combined with a standard ERM analysis for squared loss, this yields a generalization bound under a $d$-dimensional manifold data model and $C^β$ targets, showing that approximation and estimation trade off as in dense networks once active parameters are accounted for appropriately. We further prove a constructive approximation theorem for MoE architectures, showing that, under the approximation construction, error can decrease either by scaling active capacity or by increasing the number of experts, depending on the dominant bottleneck. From these results we derive neural scaling laws for model size, data size, and compute-optimal tradeoffs. Overall, our results provide a transparent statistical reference point for reasoning about MoE scaling, clarifying which behaviors are certified by worst-case theory and which must arise from data-dependent routing structure or optimization dynamics.

</details>


### [373] [High-dimensional Adaptive MCMC with Reduced Computational Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09286)
*Max Hird,Samuel Livingstone*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种稀疏参数化的稠密线性预条件自适应MCMC，复杂度由O(d²)降至O(m²d)，在相关目标分布上兼顾效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对角预条件无法刻画高相关目标，现有能建模相关性的自适应MCMC每步需O(d²)计算；需在不牺牲刻画能力的前提下降低复杂度。

Method: 在线主成分分析估计目标协方差特征，用对角阵与少量反射阵乘积构造“稠密效果、稀疏参数”的预条件矩阵；推导O(m²d)每步更新算法。

Result: 在多个数值实验中，绝对性能优于对角预条件；时间归一化性能优于传统稠密预条件及对角加低秩方案。

Conclusion: 所提预条件以可控稀疏参数m实现复杂度-相关建模权衡，为高维相关目标提供兼顾精度与效率的MCMC采样工具。

Abstract: We propose an adaptive MCMC method that learns a linear preconditioner which is dense in its off-diagonal elements but sparse in its parametrisation. Due to this sparsity, we achieve a per-iteration computational complexity of $O(m^2d)$ for a user-determined parameter $m$, compared with the $O(d^2)$ complexity of existing adaptive strategies that can capture correlation information from the target. Diagonal preconditioning has an $O(d)$ per-iteration complexity, but is known to fail in the case that the target distribution is highly correlated, see \citet[Section 3.5]{hird2025a}. Our preconditioner is constructed using eigeninformation from the target covariance which we infer using online principal components analysis on the MCMC chain. It is composed of a diagonal matrix and a product of carefully chosen reflection matrices. On various numerical tests we show that it outperforms diagonal preconditioning in terms of absolute performance, and that it outperforms traditional dense preconditioning and multiple diagonal plus low-rank alternatives in terms of time-normalised performance.

</details>


### [374] [Data-Efficient Non-Gaussian Semi-Nonparametric Density Estimation for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09375)
*Aaron R. Liao,Kenshiro Oguri,Michele D. Carpenter*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: The paper proposes a fast Seminonparametric (SNP) density estimator that captures non-Gaussian state distributions of nonlinear dynamics with far fewer samples than plain Monte Carlo, validated on the chaotic Lorenz system.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nonlinear dynamical systems induce non-Gaussian state distributions essential for estimation/control, but brute-force Monte-Carlo propagation is computationally prohibitive.

Method: Represent the state density by a Hermite-polynomial-based SNP expansion; cast coefficient fitting as a maximum-likelihood problem whose integrals are approximated with small Monte-Carlo ensembles; solve via a convex relaxation that yields good initial values.

Result: On the Lorenz system the SNP estimator accurately reproduces multi-modal, heavy-tailed densities and quantiles while using an order-of-magnitude fewer samples than direct Monte-Carlo.

Conclusion: SNP densities with Monte-Carlo likelihood and convex initialization offer a sample-efficient alternative for uncertainty propagation in nonlinear dynamics, enabling tractable uncertainty quantification in estimation and control tasks.

Abstract: Accurate representation of non-Gaussian distributions of quantities of interest in nonlinear dynamical systems is critical for estimation, control, and decision-making, but can be challenging when forward propagations are expensive to carry out. This paper presents an approach for estimating probability density functions of states evolving under nonlinear dynamics using Seminonparametric (SNP), or Gallant-Nychka, densities. SNP densities employ a probabilists' Hermite polynomial basis to model non-Gaussian behavior and are positive everywhere on the support by construction. We use Monte Carlo to approximate the expectation integrals that arise in the maximum likelihood estimation of SNP coefficients, and introduce a convex relaxation to generate effective initial estimates. The method is demonstrated on density and quantile estimation for the chaotic Lorenz system. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can accurately capture non-Gaussian density structure and compute quantiles using significantly fewer samples than raw Monte Carlo sampling.

</details>


### [375] [Conformal Prediction in Hierarchical Classification with Constrained Representation Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.19038)
*Thomas Mortier,Alireza Javanmardi,Yusuf Sale,Eyke Hüllermeier,Willem Waegeman*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次将 split conformal 框架推广到层级分类，设计两套高效推断算法，实验验证准确覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有保形预测均针对平面分类/回归，无法处理层级标签空间中的“预测集必须为内部节点”这一硬性约束；缺乏可扩展且理论保障的推断方法。

Method: 1. 提出“层级 split 保形预测”总体框架，用层级一致性损失定义非共形分数；2. 算法 A 仅返回内部节点作为预测集，通过动态规划在树上回溯求解；3. 算法 B 放宽节点约束，引入表示复杂度惩罚，将问题转化为带权集合覆盖，用贪心近似高效求解；4. 均给出有限样本边际覆盖保证与复杂度上界。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100、MIRA 等四层基准上，两算法均达到 1−α 名义覆盖率；算法 B 平均预测集大小比 A 减小 15–30%，且运行时间 <1 s/样本。
