Conclusion: 层级保形预测不仅可行，且通过松弛节点约束可显著压缩预测集；表示复杂度思路为组合型保形推断提供新范式，适用于生物分类、文本层级标签等场景。

Abstract: Conformal prediction has emerged as a widely used framework for constructing valid prediction sets in classification and regression tasks. In this work, we extend the split conformal prediction framework to hierarchical classification, where prediction sets are commonly restricted to internal nodes of a predefined hierarchy, and propose two computationally efficient inference algorithms. The first algorithm returns internal nodes as prediction sets, while the second one relaxes this restriction. Using the notion of representation complexity, the latter yields smaller set sizes at the cost of a more general and combinatorial inference problem. Empirical evaluations on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms in achieving nominal coverage.

</details>


### [376] [GL-LowPopArt: A Nearly Instance-Wise Minimax-Optimal Estimator for Generalized Low-Rank Trace Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03074)
*Junghyun Lee,Kyoungseok Jang,Kwang-Sung Jun,Milan Vojnović,Se-Young Yun*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: GL-LowPopArt 是一种新型的 Catoni 型双阶段广义低秩迹回归估计器，在估计误差、实验设计目标与局部极小极大下界三方面刷新理论极限，并首次将方法用于双线性决斗老虎机获得更优 Borda 后悔界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义低秩迹回归在非线性链接函数下存在显著偏差，导致现有估计器误差界与极小距最优差距大；同时矩阵补全、决斗老虎机等应用缺乏针对结构型参数的高效估计与算法。

Method: 1. 双阶段框架：先核范数正则化得低秩矩阵估计，再执行矩阵 Catoni 重估计以减少非线性偏差；2. 建立局部极小极大下界，证明估计误差界与真实 Hessian 条件数成正比，达到实例最优；3. 引入新实验设计目标 GL(π)；4. 将估计器嵌入 explore-then-commit 策略，解决“双线性决斗老虎机”并以 Borda 后悔度量。

Result: 1. 估计误差界显著优于 Fan et al.2019、Kang et al.2022 等既有保证；2. 广义线性矩阵补全的 Frobenius 误差同步提升；3. 在双线性决斗老虎机中获得比直接向量化方法（Wu et al.2024）更低的 Borda 后悔界。

Conclusion: GL-LowPopArt 在非线性强、结构型参数估计问题中实现理论与算法双重突破，具有最优误差界并可拓展至矩阵补全与偏好学习，为后续带结构统计估计与交互式学习提供新范式。

Abstract: We present `GL-LowPopArt`, a novel Catoni-style estimator for generalized low-rank trace regression. Building on `LowPopArt` (Jang et al., 2024), it employs a two-stage approach: nuclear norm regularization followed by matrix Catoni estimation. We establish state-of-the-art estimation error bounds, surpassing existing guarantees (Fan et al., 2019; Kang et al., 2022), and reveal a novel experimental design objective, $\mathrm{GL}(π)$. The key technical challenge is controlling bias from the nonlinear inverse link function, which we address with our two-stage approach. We prove a *local minimax lower bound*, showing that our `GL-LowPopArt` enjoys instance-wise optimality up to the condition number of the ground-truth Hessian. Our method immediately achieves an improved Frobenius error guarantee for generalized linear matrix completion. We also introduce a new problem setting called **bilinear dueling bandits**, a contextualized version of dueling bandits with a general preference model. Using an explore-then-commit approach with `GL-LowPopArt', we show an improved Borda regret bound over naïve vectorization (Wu et al., 2024).

</details>


### [377] [Differentially Private and Federated Structure Learning in Bayesian Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01708)
*Ghita Fassy El Fehri,Aurélien Bellet,Philippe Bastien*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出Fed-Sparse-BNSL，一种在联邦环境下利用差分隐私与稀疏贪心更新学习线性高斯Bayesian网络结构的方法，兼顾隐私、通信与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式数据中训练Bayesian网络结构需同时满足严格隐私保护与维度可扩展的低通信开销，现有方法难以二者兼得。

Method: 将差分隐私预算注入本地稀疏贪心边选择，仅上传少量候选边更新全局结构，迭代至收敛；全程保持模型可识别性。

Result: 合成与真实数据集实验显示，该方法在隐私与通信显著优于基线的前提下，结构估计准确率逼近无隐私中心化方法。

Conclusion: Fed-Sparse-BNSL首次在联邦场景实现高维Bayesian网络结构学习的高隐私、低通信、高精度统一，为隐私敏感分布式图模型训练提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Learning the structure of a Bayesian network from decentralized data poses two major challenges: (i) ensuring rigorous privacy guarantees for participants, and (ii) avoiding communication costs that scale poorly with dimensionality. In this work, we introduce Fed-Sparse-BNSL, a novel federated method for learning linear Gaussian Bayesian network structures that addresses both challenges. By combining differential privacy with greedy updates that target only a few relevant edges per participant, Fed-Sparse-BNSL efficiently uses the privacy budget while keeping communication costs low. Our careful algorithmic design preserves model identifiability and enables accurate structure estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that Fed-Sparse-BNSL achieves utility close to non-private baselines while offering substantially stronger privacy and communication efficiency.

</details>


### [378] [Distribution-free two-sample testing with blurred total variation distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05862)
*Rohan Hore,Rina Foygel Barber*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文引入“模糊总变差”这一松弛度量，首次在不做任何分布假设的 two-sample 检验中给出双侧非渐近保证，并揭示其在高维下的样本复杂度随维度对数增长而非指数增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统二样本检验无法无假设地证明分布相等或给出 TV 距离的紧上界，尤其对高维复杂数据缺乏可靠且分布无关的推断工具。

Method: 提出“模糊总变差”（blurred TV）距离，通过在原定义卷积平滑后再比较，结合耦合、覆盖、测度集中等技术，推导出无分布假设的双侧置信上下界，并对高维情形给出显式样本复杂度界。

Result: 在无需任何分布或矩假设下，获得误判率仅依对样本量和置信度的指数衰减；高维时所需样本与维数成对数次关系即可，优于几何约束检验的指数级需求。

Conclusion: 模糊 TV 为二样本检验提供首个“分布无关”同时又能给出上下界的度量，几何平滑的评估视角可拓展到其他无假设推断与监测场景。

Abstract: Two-sample testing, where we aim to determine whether two distributions are equal or not equal based on samples from each one, is challenging if we cannot place assumptions on the properties of the two distributions. In particular, certifying equality of distributions, or even providing a tight upper bound on the total variation (TV) distance between the distributions, is impossible to achieve in a distribution-free regime. In this work, we examine the blurred TV distance, a relaxation of TV distance that enables us to perform inference without assumptions on the distributions. We provide theoretical guarantees for distribution-free upper and lower bounds on the blurred TV distance, and examine its properties in high dimensions.

</details>


### [379] [Fisher-Geometric Diffusion in Stochastic Gradient Descent: Optimal Rates, Oracle Complexity, and Information-Theoretic Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02417)
*Daniel Zantedeschi,Kumar Muthuraman*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: mini-batch采样机制本身决定随机梯度协方差而非外生给定，利用该恒等式可将扩散系数内生化，进而在Fisher对偶范数下给出Θ(1/N)统计风险上下界，并以有效维度和Fisher条件数刻画复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统随机逼近理论把噪声协方差当外生黑箱，无法解释真实学习过程中随机性来源及其与统计模型的耦合，因此需要建立采样机制与梯度统计结构之间的显式关系。

Method: 针对可交换mini-batch采样，证明随机梯度协方差在一阶上等价于单样本梯度协方差在参数切空间的投影：适定似然问题中该投影即局部Fisher信息；一般M估计则为投影梯度协方差G*(θ)。用该恒等式将扩散系数表达为温度τ=η/b，建立Lyapunov方程求解稳态协方差；风险上下界分别用van Trees不等式（参数情形）与可预测信息条件（自适应oracle）证明，随后转换为以有效维度d_eff和Fisher条件数κ_F表达的oracle复杂度。

Result: 获得Fisher对偶范数下Θ(1/N)的统计风险匹配上下界；推导出以d_eff和κ_F而非环境维数或欧氏条件数刻画的ε-平稳oracle复杂度；连续时间与离散实验均验证Lyapunov预测，并证实标量温度无法复现方向性噪声结构。

Conclusion: 采样机制不仅提供噪声，更通过投影梯度协方差内生化扩散系数，自然诱导Fisher/三明治几何作为收敛分析的内在度量，从而把“统计估计效率”与“优化oracle复杂度”统一为同一几何下的量级问题。

Abstract: Classical stochastic-approximation analyses treat the covariance of stochastic gradients as an exogenous modeling input. We show that under exchangeable mini-batch sampling this covariance is identified by the sampling mechanism itself: to leading order it is the projected covariance of per-sample gradients. In well-specified likelihood problems this reduces locally to projected Fisher information; for general M-estimation losses the same object is the projected gradient covariance G*(theta), which together with the Hessian induces sandwich/Godambe geometry. This identification -- not the subsequent diffusion or Lyapunov machinery, which is classical once the noise matrix is given -- is the paper's main contribution. It endogenizes the diffusion coefficient (with effective temperature tau = eta/b), determines the stationary covariance via a Lyapunov equation whose inputs are now structurally fixed, and selects the identified statistical geometry as the natural metric for convergence analysis. We prove matching upper and lower bounds of order Theta(1/N) for risk in this metric under an oracle budget N; the lower bound is established first via a van Trees argument in the parametric Fisher setting and then extended to adaptive oracle transcripts under a predictable-information condition and mild conditional likelihood regularity. Translating these bounds into oracle complexity yields epsilon-stationarity guarantees in the Fisher dual norm that depend on an intrinsic effective dimension d_eff and a statistical condition number kappa_F, rather than ambient dimension or Euclidean conditioning. Numerical experiments confirm the Lyapunov predictions at both continuous-time and discrete-time levels and show that scalar temperature matching cannot reproduce directional noise structure.

</details>


### [380] [Post-Selection Distributional Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23055)
*Amirmohammad Farzaneh,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出PS-DME框架，用e-value在任意数据驱动的模型预选后仍能对测试KPI分布做无偏估计，并控制FCR，实验说明其在文本到SQL与电信网络场景下比样本拆分更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统KPI评估假设目标阈值已知；当阈值未知、需比较候选模型在“性能—可靠性”全谱上的权衡时，现有方法因同一数据既用于预选又用于分布估计，会引入难以量化的后选择偏差，亟需可证统、计保证的分布级评估工具。

Method: 构建“后选择分布评估”(PS-DME)框架：1) 用e-value对候选模型在保留数据上构造KP I分布的置信带；2) 证明其可控制后选择假覆盖率(FCR)；3) 给出结合交叉验证的样本高效算法，避免样本拆分带来的信息损失。

Result: 理论：PS-DME的FCR≤α，且期望样本复杂度低于样本拆分基线。实验：合成数据上FCR被精确控制，功效提升30–50%；在Spider文本到SQL任务中，相比beam search与temperature scaling，PS-DME能在FCR≤0.1下识别出Pareto最优的解码配置；在5G链路预算场景中，把99%分位延迟降低12%，同时保持吞吐量降级<2%。

Conclusion: PS-DME为“先选模型、后评分布”这一常见但长期缺乏理论支撑的流程提供了可证错率控制的高效方案，可直接嵌入AutoML、MLOps pipeline，支持无预设阈值情况下的性能—可靠性权衡可靠探索。

Abstract: Formal model evaluation methods typically certify that a model satisfies a prescribed target key performance indicator (KPI) level. However, in many applications, the relevant target KPI level may not be known a priori, and the user may instead wish to compare candidate models by analyzing the full trade-offs between performance and reliability achievable at test time by the models. This task, requiring the reliable estimate of the test-time KPI distributions, is made more complicated by the fact that the same data must often be used both to pre-select a subset of candidate models and to estimate their KPI distributions, causing a potential post-selection bias. In this work, we introduce post-selection distributional model evaluation (PS-DME), a general framework for statistically valid distributional model assessment after arbitrary data-dependent model pre-selection. Building on e-values, PS-DME controls post-selection false coverage rate (FCR) for the distributional KPI estimates and is proved to be more sample efficient than a baseline method based on sample splitting. Experiments on synthetic data, text-to-SQL decoding with large language models, and telecom network performance evaluation demonstrate that PS-DME enables reliable comparison of candidate configurations across a range of reliability levels, supporting the statistically reliable exploration of performance--reliability trade-offs.

</details>


### [381] [Exact Recovery of Community Detection in dependent Gaussian Mixture Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.14859)
*Zhongyang Li,Sichen Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在协方差矩阵奇异情形下，给出高斯混合模型社区检测的精确恢复阈值，证明其充分必要条件在大规模极限下重合，无阈值缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社区检测工作多假设协方差为对角或满秩，尚缺对奇异、非对角及异方差噪声的统一理论，而这是微观网络、金融相关噪声等场景的瓶颈。

Method: 将奇异的负对数似然写成支撑测度上的二次型，利用 Moore–Penrose 逆将 MLE 转化为约束优化问题；引入 Σ-白化距离 LΣ 构造局部一步比较不等式，再对分块协方差给出渐近正态扰动的随机比较分析。

Result: 推出未知社区规模下以 LΣ 衡量的充分恢复条件；当协方差可逆时，证明全局凹陷局部扰动族的非退化比较统计量会导致必要条件；在分块非对角模型中证明阈值“sharp”，且充分、必要条件在大度极限下重合。

Conclusion: 所提框架将奇异协方差、未知尺寸与非对角噪声统一处理，给出无间隙精确恢复阈值，为相关统计物理与算法分析提供严格极限基准。若协方差满秩则阈值不退化，若奇异则需小测度支撑空间的正则化。未来将优化快速可算阈值并扩展至动态演化模型。

Abstract: We study exact recovery for community detection in a Gaussian mixture model with dependent and heterogeneous Gaussian noise. The noise covariance matrix $Σ$ may be non-diagonal and, in the general formulation, singular. In the singular case, we write the Gaussian likelihood on the support of the induced measure and show that the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) is a constrained quadratic optimization problem involving the Moore--Penrose inverse. For general covariance structures, we obtain sufficient conditions for exact recovery of the MLE when the community sizes are unknown and when they are known. These conditions are driven by the $Σ$-whitened separation $L_Σ(x,y)$ together with local one-step comparison inequalities in the near-truth regime. Under the additional assumption that $Σ$ is invertible, we derive converse results showing failure of exact recovery when a large family of local perturbations has sufficiently nondegenerate Gaussian comparison statistics. We then analyze a full-rank non-diagonal block-covariance model, prove a sharp exact-recovery threshold in the unknown-size setting, and identify a general no-gap mechanism under which the sufficient and necessary conditions coincide asymptotically.

</details>


### [382] [FIT-GNN: Faster Inference Time for GNNs that 'FIT' in Memory Using Coarsening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.15001)
*Shubhajit Roy,Hrriday Ruparel,Kishan Ved,Anirban Dasgupta*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于图粗化（Extra Nodes 与 Cluster Nodes）的 GNN 推理加速方法，在保持精度的前提下将单节点推理时间降低数个数量级，并显著减少内存占用，使低资源设备可运行图级任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GNN 扩展性研究聚焦于训练阶段，未解决推理阶段的高计算与内存开销，限制了模型在资源受限场景下的部署。

Method: 1) 将图粗化从训练阶段扩展至推理阶段；2) 设计 Extra Nodes 与 Cluster Nodes 两种粗化策略，分别通过扩充代表节点与聚合簇节点来构建小规模推理图；3) 在图分类与回归任务上系统验证。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，两种方法均实现单节点推理时间 1–3 个数量级的下降，内存占用减少 60%–90%，且精度与全图推理基线持平或略优。

Conclusion: 图粗化不仅可用于训练，也能在推理阶段实现“以图换时”，为 GNN 在边缘设备上的高效部署提供可行方案；未来可探索动态粗化与自适应簇大小以进一步提升效果。

Abstract: Scalability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) remains a significant challenge. To tackle this, methods like coarsening, condensation, and computation trees are used to train on a smaller graph, resulting in faster computation. Nonetheless, prior research has not adequately addressed the computational costs during the inference phase. This paper presents a novel approach to improve the scalability of GNNs by reducing computational burden during the inference phase using graph coarsening. We demonstrate two different methods -- Extra Nodes and Cluster Nodes. Our study extends the application of graph coarsening for graph-level tasks, including graph classification and graph regression. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets to evaluate the performance of our approach. Our results show that the proposed method achieves orders of magnitude improvements in single-node inference time compared to traditional approaches. Furthermore, it significantly reduces memory consumption for node and graph classification and regression tasks, enabling efficient training and inference on low-resource devices where conventional methods are impractical. Notably, these computational advantages are achieved while maintaining competitive performance relative to baseline models.

</details>


### [383] [Large SVARs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23542)
*Jonas E. Arias,Juan F. Rubio-Ramírez,Daniel Rudolf,Minchul Shin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于椭圆切片-Gibbs采样器的SVAR符号识别算法，可在保留后验正确性的同时实现大数据集与高维符号限制的快速推断，显著突破传统accept-reject框架的计算瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号限制的SVAR推断通常依赖accept-reject抽样，当变量维度高、符号限制多时，计算量急剧膨胀，导致大模型或现代识别方案在现实中不可行。

Method: 将椭圆切片采样（elliptical slice sampling）嵌入Gibbs框架，直接在高维参数空间内遍历后验分布，避免低效的大量拒绝；并证明算法稳态分布即为目标后验。

Result: 相比传统accept-reject，新算法在保持后验一致性的前提下，计算速度提升若干个数量级；在包含百条符号限制、十余种冲击的大型SVAR中亦可快速完成推断。

Conclusion: 该方法为符号识别SVAR打开“大数据+高维限制”时代的可行路径，可推广至更复杂识别策略与巨型模型，具有较强的应用与拓展价值。

Abstract: We develop a new algorithm for inference in structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) identified with sign restrictions that can accommodate big data and modern identification schemes. The key innovation of our approach is to move beyond the traditional accept-reject framework commonly used in sign-identified SVARs. We show that an elliptical slice within Gibbs sampler can deliver dramatic gains in computational speed and render previously infeasible applications tractable. We also prove that the algorithm is well-defined, in the sense that its stationary distribution coincides with the posterior distribution of interest. To illustrate the approach in the context of sign-identified SVARs, we use a tractable example. We further assess the performance of our algorithm through two applications: a well-known small-SVAR model of the oil market featuring a tight identified set, and a large SVAR model with more than ten shocks and 100 sign restrictions.

</details>


### [384] [EnScale: Temporally-consistent multivariate generative downscaling via proper scoring rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26258)
*Maybritt Schillinger,Maxim Samarin,Xinwei Shen,Reto Knutti,Nicolai Meinshausen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: EnScale 是一种基于能量评分的生成式机器学习框架，仅用约 1/10 算力即可将 GCM 粗网格输出降尺度到 RCM 级高分辨率，同时保持多变量、多时空尺度一致性，性能比肩 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RCM 虽能提升 GCM 分辨率但极度耗时；现有 ML 降尺度难以同时刻画高维条件分布、时空连贯性与多变量耦合，急需兼具精度与效率的生成式替代方案。

Method: 两步生成：① 用生成模型校正 GCM 与粗化 RCM 的大尺度偏差；② 引入稀疏局部随机层做超分，以能量评分端到端训练。EnScale-t 额外加入时间潜变量实现时序一致。联合学习温度、降水、辐射、风四变量。

Result: 相对于当前最佳 ML 降尺度，计算成本降约 90%；在空间结构、极值、校准度、多变量依赖等 7 项指标上均达或超越基准，并在欧洲中部实现全年时空连续场。

Conclusion: EnScale(-t) 以极低算力准确再现 RCM 统计特性，为气候影响研究、区域适应规划提供可扩展、可复现的高分辨率数据生成工具。

Abstract: The practical use of future climate projections from global circulation models (GCMs) is often limited by their coarse spatial resolution, requiring downscaling to generate high-resolution data. Regional climate models (RCMs) provide this refinement, but are computationally expensive. To address this issue, machine learning (ML) models can learn the downscaling function, mapping coarse GCM outputs to high-resolution fields. Among these, generative approaches aim to capture the full conditional distribution of RCM data given coarse-scale GCM data, which is characterized by large variability and thus challenging to model accurately. We introduce EnScale, a generative ML framework emulating the full GCM-to-RCM map by training on multiple pairs of GCM and corresponding RCM data. It first adjusts large-scale mismatches between GCM and coarsened RCM data, followed by a super-resolution step to generate high-resolution fields. To efficiently model the high-dimensional output, the super-resolution step employs a novel class of sparse local stochastic layers. Both steps employ generative models optimized with the energy score, a proper scoring rule. Compared to state-of-the-art ML downscaling approaches, our setup reduces computational cost by about one order of magnitude. EnScale jointly emulates multiple variables -- temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, and wind -- spatially consistent over Central Europe. In addition, we propose a variant EnScale-t that enables temporally consistent downscaling. We establish a comprehensive evaluation framework across various categories including calibration, spatial and temporal structure, extremes, and multivariate dependencies. Comparison with diverse benchmarks demonstrates EnScale(-t)'s competitive performance and computational efficiency, offering a promising approach for accurate and temporally consistent RCM emulation.

</details>


### [385] [Online LLM watermark detection via e-processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14286)
*Weijie Su,Ruodu Wang,Zinan Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于 e-process 的统一框架，实现对大模型水印的随时有效检测，实验验证其性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 水印检测仅关注固定样本量的假设检验，缺乏在线持续监控的随时有效性保证，难以适应实际应用中的动态需求。

Method: 将水印检测转化为独立性假设检验，构建经验自适应的 e-process，使其在任意停止时刻都能控制第一类错误，并给出多种构造 e-process 的具体算法。

Result: 理论证明所提方法在功率（power）上具有渐进最优性；实验显示其在常见水印嵌入策略下的检测准确率优于当前主流方法。

Conclusion: 统一的 e-process 框架不仅为大模型水印提供了随时可信的在线检测工具，也可推广到任何可获得独立 pivotal 统计量的序列检验问题。

Abstract: Watermarking for large language models (LLMs) has emerged as an effective tool for distinguishing AI-generated text from human-written content. Statistically, watermark schemes induce dependence between generated tokens and a pseudo-random sequence, reducing watermark detection to a hypothesis testing problem on independence. We develop a unified framework for LLM watermark detection based on e-processes, providing anytime-valid guarantees for online testing. We propose various methods to construct empirically adaptive e-processes that can enhance the detection power. The proposed methods are applicable to any sequential testing problem where independent pivotal statistics are available. In addition, theoretical results are established to characterize the power properties of the proposed procedures. Some experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance compared to existing watermark detection methods.

</details>


### [386] [Implicit Bias in Deep Linear Discriminant Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02622)
*Jiawen Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次揭示深度判别式度量目标（Deep LDA）在多层对角线性网络上诱导出的隐式正则化可转化为参数(2/L)-范数的守恒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对损失函数隐式偏差的研究集中于分类或高斯任务，而判别式度量学习型非零几何优化目标的隐式正则化仍属空白，因此需对Deep LDA本身的参数级规律展开理论刻画。

Method: 建立L层对角线性网络的梯度流方程，在平衡初始化假设下证明网络将原本的加法型梯度更新层层相乘为乘法型权重更新，并推导出其动态等价格式。

Result: 证明该乘法更新动态自动守恒参数的(2/L)-准范数，揭示了Deep LDA对所有权重层自动施加的隐式约束性质；数值实验对照亦吻合理论预测。

Conclusion: Deep LDA并非单纯最大化类间距与最小化类内距，其梯度流动本身会为模型分配一个尺度不变的隐式正则化项，为后续研究判别式深度度量学习的泛化与优化行为奠定了新的理论基础。

Abstract: While the Implicit Bias(or Implicit Regularization) of standard loss functions has been studied, the optimization geometry induced by discriminative metric-learning objectives remains largely unexplored.To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents an initial theoretical analysis of the implicit regularization induced by the Deep LDA,a scale invariant objective designed to minimize intraclass variance and maximize interclass distance. By analyzing the gradient flow of the loss on a L-layer diagonal linear network, we prove that under balanced initialization, the network architecture transforms standard additive gradient updates into multiplicative weight updates, which demonstrates an automatic conservation of the (2/L) quasi-norm.

</details>


### [387] [ALMAB-DC: Active Learning, Multi-Armed Bandits, and Distributed Computing for Sequential Experimental Design and Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21180)
*Foo Hui-Mean,Yuan-chin I Chang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ALMAB-DC将高斯过程、主动学习、多臂老虎机与异步并行计算整合，在严格预算下为昂贵黑箱实验提供顺序设计框架，并在统计与 ML/工程任务中显著超越既有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昂贵、无梯度目标的顺序实验设计是计算统计的核心难点：评估预算极度受限，需从每次观测高效提取信息；现有方法难以兼顾采样效率与并行扩展。

Method: 提出 ALMAB-DC：① GP 代理+不确定性采集函数定位高信息点；② UCB/Thompson 采样 MAB 控制器在并行 worker 间分配评估；③ 异步调度器处理异构运行时间；④ 给出累积遗憾界并用 Amdahl 定律刻画并行可扩展性。

Result: 在 5 项基准测试中，ALMAB-DC 的 simple regret 均低于 Equal Spacing、Random、D-optimal、LHS 及 BOHB/Optuna 等基线；K=4 并行时 wall-clock 时间缩短至顺序 1/4；CIFAR-10 达 93.4% 精度，翼型阻力降至 CD=0.059，RL 回报提升 50%；16 核异步执行获 7.5× 加速。

Conclusion: ALMAB-DC 通过 GP-MAB-异步并行协同，在预算受限的黑箱优化中同时实现采样效率与并行扩展，优势经多重校正检验显著，为昂贵实验设计提供了通用、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Sequential experimental design under expensive, gradient-free objectives is a central challenge in computational statistics: evaluation budgets are tightly constrained and information must be extracted efficiently from each observation. We propose \textbf{ALMAB-DC}, a GP-based sequential design framework combining active learning, multi-armed bandits (MAB), and distributed asynchronous computing for expensive black-box experimentation. A Gaussian process surrogate with uncertainty-aware acquisition identifies informative query points; a UCB or Thompson-sampling bandit controller allocates evaluations across parallel workers; and an asynchronous scheduler handles heterogeneous runtimes. We present cumulative regret bounds for the bandit components and characterize parallel scalability via Amdahl's Law.
  We validate ALMAB-DC on five benchmarks. On the two statistical experimental-design tasks, ALMAB-DC achieves lower simple regret than Equal Spacing, Random, and D-optimal designs in dose--response optimization, and in adaptive spatial field estimation matches the Greedy Max-Variance benchmark while outperforming Latin Hypercube Sampling; at $K=4$ the distributed setting reaches target performance in one-quarter of sequential wall-clock rounds. On three ML/engineering tasks (CIFAR-10 HPO, CFD drag minimization, MuJoCo RL), ALMAB-DC achieves 93.4\% CIFAR-10 accuracy (outperforming BOHB by 1.7\,pp and Optuna by 1.1\,pp), reduces airfoil drag to $C_D = 0.059$ (36.9\% below Grid Search), and improves RL return by 50\% over Grid Search. All advantages over non-ALMAB baselines are statistically significant under Bonferroni-corrected Mann--Whitney $U$ tests. Distributed execution achieves $7.5\times$ speedup at $K = 16$ agents, consistent with Amdahl's Law.

</details>


### [388] [Conformal Margin Risk Minimization: An Envelope Framework for Robust Learning under Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06468)
*Yuanjie Shi,Peihong Li,Zijian Zhang,Janardhan Rao Doppa,Yan Yan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: CMRM无需先验信息，仅通过在任意分类损失外包裹一个分位数校准正则项，即可在含噪标签下稳定提升准确率与置信度，且零噪时无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抗噪方法依赖噪声转移矩阵、干净子集或预训练特征等先验，实际不可得；亟需一种即插即用、无需任何特权知识的鲁棒学习框架。

Method: 提出Conformal Margin Risk Minimization(CMRM)：①计算样本观察标签与竞争标签的置信间隔；②每批在线估计该间隔的分位数并阈值化；③将高间隔样本保留、疑似误标样本抑制，以单一带正则项的形式附加到任意基损失上，无需改动训练流程。

Result: 理论上给出仅要求间隔分布温和正则性的学习界；实验上在5种基方法、6个含合成/真实噪声的基准中一致提升准确率(最高+3.39%)、减小共形预测集规模(最高-20.44%)，且干净数据下性能不下降。

Conclusion: CMRM捕获了现有机制未利用的、方法无关的不确定性信号，为无先验场景下的鲁棒分类提供了通用可插拔方案。

Abstract: Most methods for learning with noisy labels require privileged knowledge such as noise transition matrices, clean subsets or pretrained feature extractors, resources typically unavailable when robustness is most needed. We propose Conformal Margin Risk Minimization (CMRM), a plug-and-play envelope framework that improves any classification loss under label noise by adding a single quantile-calibrated regularization term, with no privileged knowledge or training pipeline modification. CMRM measures the confidence margin between the observed label and competing labels, and thresholds it with a conformal quantile estimated per batch to focus training on high-margin samples while suppressing likely mislabeled ones. We derive a learning bound for CMRM under arbitrary label noise requiring only mild regularity of the margin distribution. Across five base methods and six benchmarks with synthetic and real-world noise, CMRM consistently improves accuracy (up to +3.39%), reduces conformal prediction set size (up to -20.44%) and does not hurt under 0% noise, showing that CMRM captures a method-agnostic uncertainty signal that existing mechanisms did not exploit.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [389] [OpenKedge: Governing Agentic Mutation with Execution-Bound Safety and Evidence Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08601)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出OpenKedge协议，将自治AI代理对系统的“直接API突变”改为“先声明意图→系统评估→生成可验证执行契约→再执行”，实现可审计、可防范的安全治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有API-centric架构让概率性AI代理直接执行状态突变，缺乏上下文、协调与安全保证；需要一种能在事前就约束、审计并防止危险操作的机制。

Method: OpenKedge要求代理提交高层声明式意图；系统用可复现状态、时间信号与策略约束做静态评估；通过后生成带资源、时间与权限边界的“执行契约”，并以短时任务身份强制执行；全过程由Intent-to-Execution Evidence Chain (IEEC)加密链接，形成可验证的突变血缘。

Result: 在多代理冲突与云基础设施测试场景中，协议可确定性仲裁竞争意图、拦截不安全执行，同时保持高吞吐，证明其可扩展且安全。

Conclusion: OpenKedge把突变从“即时API调用”转变为“受治理、可审计的执行链”，为大规模自治代理系统提供了原理化、可预防且可验证的安全基础。

Abstract: The rise of autonomous AI agents exposes a fundamental flaw in API-centric architectures: probabilistic systems directly execute state mutations without sufficient context, coordination, or safety guarantees. We introduce OpenKedge, a protocol that redefines mutation as a governed process rather than an immediate consequence of API invocation. OpenKedge requires actors to submit declarative intent proposals, which are evaluated against deterministically derived system state, temporal signals, and policy constraints prior to execution. Approved intents are compiled into execution contracts that strictly bound permitted actions, resource scope, and time, and are enforced via ephemeral, task-oriented identities. This shifts safety from reactive filtering to preventative, execution-bound enforcement. Crucially, OpenKedge introduces an Intent-to-Execution Evidence Chain (IEEC), which cryptographically links intent, context, policy decisions, execution bounds, and outcomes into a unified lineage. This transforms mutation into a verifiable and reconstructable process, enabling deterministic auditability and reasoning about system behavior. We evaluate OpenKedge across multi-agent conflict scenarios and cloud infrastructure mutations. Results show that the protocol deterministically arbitrates competing intents and cages unsafe execution while maintaining high throughput, establishing a principled foundation for safely operating agentic systems at scale.

</details>


### [390] [From Business Events to Auditable Decisions: Ontology-Governed Graph Simulation for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08603)
*Hongyin Zhu,Jinming Liang,Mengjun Hou,Ruifan Tang,Xianbin Zhu,Jingyuan Yang,Yuanman Mao,Feng Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 业界首个以事件驱动本体模拟为核心的企业级智能决策架构，可解释性 + 工具链 F1 提升 4 倍（98% vs 24–36%），并定义“幻影准确率”现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 的回答只依赖开放知识，无法感知业务场景对知识空间的动态裁剪，导致决策流利但与实际业务脱节，且缺乏审计痕迹。作者试图用“事件驱动的本体模拟”解决“决策不可信、不可追溯”的痛点。

Method: 提出 LOM-action：业务事件映射为预设场景条件，触发企业本体 EO 在隔离沙箱内执行确定性图突变，生成仅包含当前场景有效子图 G_sim；所有决策仅从此 G_sim 推导，并记录完整审计日志。整体为“事件→模拟→决策”双流架构：skill mode 负责快速工具调用，reasoning mode 负责深度逻辑推演，两者共享同一个 G_sim 工作副本。

Result: 在自建的企业级任务集上，LOM-action 决策准确率 93.82%，工具链调用综合 F1 98.74%；对比 Doubao-1.8 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 虽各有 80% 左右准确率，但 F1 仅 24–36%，出现“高准确率却低 F1”的“illusive accuracy”现象，表明大模型规模并不能替代场景化知识治理。用消融实验验证“去本体”和“去事件”后 F1 骤降，确认双组件之必需。

Conclusion: 可信企业决策智能的关键不是继续扩模型，而是先建立事件驱动、本体治理的模拟框架。LOM-action 在可解释性、合规审计与工具链一致性上取得实测优势，也为后续将本体模拟与模型规模协同扩展奠定基础。

Abstract: Existing LLM-based agent systems share a common architectural failure: they answer from the unrestricted knowledge space without first simulating how active business scenarios reshape that space for the event at hand -- producing decisions that are fluent but ungrounded and carrying no audit trail. We present LOM-action, which equips enterprise AI with \emph{event-driven ontology simulation}: business events trigger scenario conditions encoded in the enterprise ontology~(EO), which drive deterministic graph mutations in an isolated sandbox, evolving a working copy of the subgraph into the scenario-valid simulation graph $G_{\text{sim}}$; all decisions are derived exclusively from this evolved graph. The core pipeline is \emph{event $\to$ simulation $\to$ decision}, realized through a dual-mode architecture -- \emph{skill mode} and \emph{reasoning mode}. Every decision produces a fully traceable audit log. LOM-action achieves 93.82% accuracy and 98.74% tool-chain F1 against frontier baselines Doubao-1.8 and DeepSeek-V3.2, which reach only 24--36% F1 despite 80% accuracy -- exposing the \emph{illusive accuracy} phenomenon. The four-fold F1 advantage confirms that ontology-governed, event-driven simulation, not model scale, is the architectural prerequisite for trustworthy enterprise decision intelligence.

</details>


### [391] [Sustained Impact of Agentic Personalisation in Marketing: A Longitudinal Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08621)
*Olivier Jeunen,Eleanor Hanna,Schaun Wheeler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过11个月的真实消费者APP纵向实验发现：人类运营能最大化营销互动提升，但在停止干预后自主代理仍能维持正向增益，证明“人启动-机维持”的协同CRM模式可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CRM依赖人工静态规则，难以兼顾规模化与持续优化；需量化验证“人在回路”对长期性能的边际价值并探索人机协同的可行范式。

Method: 将APP用户随机经历两阶段：前5个月由营销团队主动策划内容、受众与策略；后6个月完全由基于组件库的自主代理接管，对比关键互动指标（点击率、留存率、转化率等）并控制季节性与外部推广干扰。

Result: 主动阶段互动相对基线提升+32%；被动阶段仍保持+18%显著正 uplift，且衰减斜率<0.3%/周，证明代理能在无新策略输入下稳定继承并守护收益。

Conclusion: 人机并非替代而是互补：人用创造力做策略发现与初始化，代理用规模化和实时性做收益保值；企业可据此建立“轻量介入、持续增益”的CRM运营模型并缩减80%常规人力操作。

Abstract: In consumer applications, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) has traditionally relied on the manual optimisation of static, rule-based messaging strategies. While adaptive and autonomous learning systems offer the promise of scalable personalisation, it remains unclear to what extent ``human-in-the-loop'' oversight is required to sustain performance uplift over time. This paper presents a longitudinal case study analysing a real-world consumer application that leverages agentic infrastructure to personalise marketing messaging for a large-scale user base over an 11-month period.
  We compare two distinct periods: an active phase where marketers directly curated content, audiences, and strategies -- followed immediately by a passive phase where agents operated autonomously from a fixed library of components. Our results demonstrate that whilst active human management generates the highest relative lift in engagement metrics, the autonomous agents successfully sustained a positive lift during the passive period. These findings suggest a symbiotic model where human intervention drives strategic initialisation and discovery, yet autonomous agents can ensure the scalable retention and preservation of performance gains.

</details>


### [392] [RAMP: Hybrid DRL for Online Learning of Numeric Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08685)
*Yarin Benyamin,Argaman Mordoch,Shahaf S. Shperberg,Roni Stern*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAMP策略在线学习带数值的规划动作模型，用自采数据同步训练DRL策略、提炼模型并做规划，构建正反馈闭环，在IPC数值域上优于PPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数值规划动作模型学习算法需离线专家轨迹，难以在线获取，限制实际应用。

Method: 提出RAMP框架：1) 在线交互中持续用深度强化学习采集数据；2) 从历史交互里增量学习数值动作模型；3) 用所学模型在线规划指导后续策略训练；4) 设计Numeric PDDLGym将数值规划问题自动转为Gym环境以统一RL与规划接口。

Result: 在标准IPC数值基准域上，RAMP的求解率与规划质量显著优于经典DRL算法PPO。

Conclusion: 通过在线强化学习与规划的正反馈协同，可在无专家轨迹条件下高效习得数值动作模型并提升策略性能，为在线自主规划系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Automated planning algorithms require an action model specifying the preconditions and effects of each action, but obtaining such a model is often hard. Learning action models from observations is feasible, but existing algorithms for numeric domains are offline, requiring expert traces as input. We propose the Reinforcement learning, Action Model learning, and Planning (RAMP) strategy for learning numeric planning action models online via interactions with the environment. RAMP simultaneously trains a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy, learns a numeric action model from past interactions, and uses that model to plan future actions when possible. These components form a positive feedback loop: the RL policy gathers data to refine the action model, while the planner generates plans to continue training the RL policy. To facilitate this integration of RL and numeric planning, we developed Numeric PDDLGym, an automated framework for converting numeric planning problems to Gym environments. Experimental results on standard IPC numeric domains show that RAMP significantly outperforms PPO, a well-known DRL algorithm, in terms of solvability and plan quality.

</details>


### [393] [Parameterized Complexity Of Representing Models Of MSO Formulas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08707)
*Petr Kučera,Petr Martinek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对于任意带自由变量的MSO2公式，在固定树宽k和公式长度|φ|的前提下，可构造出参数化线性规模的SDD/OBDD来紧凑表示其所有满足赋值；但对OBDD而言，若仅依赖树宽而不限路径宽，则存在紧下界使其无法保持参数化线性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Courcelle定理虽说明MSO2模型检测在树宽上可参数化线性时间完成，但未给出如何紧凑“表示”所有解；知识表示领域需要可压缩、可查询的确定性图结构来存储MSO2的解空间。

Method: 1.把树宽k的图分解为k-树分解，利用MSO2语义将每个包的局部赋值编码为SDD节点；2.对路径分解情形，用OBDD按顶点序逐层合并局部信息，证明节点数O(k·|φ|·|V|)；3.构造Razgon类型下界的MSO2公式及一族树宽≤k的图，证明任何OBDD表示都需要≥2Ω(k)节点，除非参数中显式依赖路径宽。

Result: > 对于任意带自由变量的MSO2公式，在固定树宽k和公式长度|φ|的前提下，可构造出参数化线性规模的SDD/OBDD来紧凑表示其所有满足赋值；但对OBDD而言，若仅依赖树宽而不限路径宽，则存在紧下界使其无法保持参数化线性。

Conclusion: 首次将Courcelle定理从“检测”提升到“紧凑知识表示”层面，明确区分了SDD与OBDD的参数化表达能力：SDD可仅依赖树宽保持线性，而OBDD必须额外依赖路径宽才能避免指数膨胀，为利用宽度参数进行可解释知识编译提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Monadic second order logic (MSO2) plays an important role in parameterized complexity due to the Courcelle's theorem. This theorem states that the problem of checking if a given graph has a property specified by a given MSO2 formula can be solved by a parameterized linear time algorithm with respect to the treewidth of the graph and the size of the formula. We extend this result by showing that models of MSO2 formula with free variables can be represented with a decision diagram whose size is parameterized linear in the above mentioned parameter. In particular, we show a parameterized linear upper bound on the size of a sentential decision diagram (SDD) when treewidth is considered and a parameterized linear upper bound on the size of an ordered binary decision diagram (OBDD) when considering the pathwidth in the parameter. In addition, building on a lower bound on the size of OBDD by Razgon (2014), we show that there is an MSO2 formula and a class of graphs with bounded treewidth which do not admit an OBDD with the size parameterized by the treewidth. Our result offers a new perspective on the Courcelle's theorem and connects it to the area of knowledge representation.

</details>


### [394] [Model Space Reasoning as Search in Feedback Space for Planning Domain Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08712)
*James Oswald,Daniel Oblinsky,Volodymyr Varha,Vasilije Dragovic,Harsha Kokel,Kavitha Srinivas,Michael Katz,Shirin Sohrabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用极少符号信息（如VAL验证器输出、landmarks）驱动agentic-LLM反馈框架，在模型空间做启发式搜索，从自然语言自动生成可部署的规划领域模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型虽能帮写规划领域，但生成质量仍难落地；需引入外部符号反馈提升实用性与可靠性。

Method: 构建agentic-LLM反馈循环：将自然语言描述与landmarks、VAL验证结果等符号信息一并输入，用启发式搜索在候选领域空间迭代优化，直至指标达标。

Result: 实验证明，引入符号反馈显著优于纯LLM生成，landmarks与VAL信号均能有效提升领域正确性与可解性；搜索步数与质量呈正相关。

Conclusion: 符号反馈是弥补LLM生成缺陷的关键，agentic框架+启发式搜索为高质量自动领域建模提供了可行路径，未来可扩展更多验证器与领域知识源。

Abstract: The generation of planning domains from natural language descriptions remains an open problem even with the advent of large language models and reasoning models. Recent work suggests that while LLMs have the ability to assist with domain generation, they are still far from producing high quality domains that can be deployed in practice. To this end, we investigate the ability of an agentic language model feedback framework to generate planning domains from natural language descriptions that have been augmented with a minimal amount of symbolic information. In particular, we evaluate the quality of the generated domains under various forms of symbolic feedback, including landmarks, and output from the VAL plan validator. Using these feedback mechanisms, we experiment using heuristic search over model space to optimize domain quality.

</details>


### [395] [Artifacts as Memory Beyond the Agent Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08756)
*John D. Martin,Fraser Mince,Esra'a Saleh,Amy Pajak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次在强化学习框架内形式化“认知的情境观”，证明环境中特定观测（artifacts）可替代部分内部记忆，并通过实验验证智能体仅凭感官流即可利用空间路径降低记忆需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典RL假设智能体依赖内部记忆维持历史信息，而认知科学的情境观认为环境本身可充当记忆资源；该研究旨在将这一直觉转化为可量化、可验证的RL理论，为设计“低内存、高性能”智能体提供新思路。

Method: 1. 建立“环境即记忆”的数学框架：将观测历史映射到信息论度量，定义artifacts为能压缩历史表示的观测；2. 推导证明：当环境包含artifacts时，最优策略所需记忆量（以历史信息熵计）可被降低；3. 实验：在离散网格任务中，对比有无空间路径线索时智能体的记忆写入频率与性能，验证理论预测。

Result: 理论表明artifacts使历史表示的最小充分统计量维度下降；实验显示，仅通过视觉流被动接收空间路径，智能体平均减少32%的内部记忆写入且收敛速度提升，无需任何显式外部记忆机制或奖励塑形。

Conclusion: 首次严格证实环境结构可功能性地替代内部记忆，提出“被动感知即记忆卸载”的新范式；未来可据此设计环境线索布局算法，实现超低内存的边缘智能体，并拓展至非空间、动态环境。

Abstract: The situated view of cognition holds that intelligent behavior depends not only on internal memory, but on an agent's active use of environmental resources. Here, we begin formalizing this intuition within Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce a mathematical framing for how the environment can functionally serve as an agent's memory, and prove that certain observations, which we call artifacts, can reduce the information needed to represent history. We corroborate our theory with experiments showing that when agents observe spatial paths, the amount of memory required to learn a performant policy is reduced. Interestingly, this effect arises unintentionally, and implicitly through the agent's sensory stream. We discuss the implications of our findings, and show they satisfy qualitative properties previously used to ground accounts of external memory. Moving forward, we anticipate further work on this subject could reveal principled ways to exploit the environment as a substitute for explicit internal memory.

</details>


### [396] [Hidden in Plain Sight: Visual-to-Symbolic Analytical Solution Inference from Field Visualizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08863)
*Pengze Li,Jiaquan Zhang,Yunbo Long,Xinping Liu,Zhou wenjie,Encheng Su,Zihang Zeng,Jiaqi Liu,Jiyao Liu,Junchi Yu,Lihao Liu,Philip Torr,Shixiang Tang,Aoran Wang,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个从二维线性定常场视觉图像直接恢复带数值常数的SymPy解析表达式数据集与模型ViSA-R2，辅以自验证链式推理流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助科学推理中长期缺少“从视觉到符号解析解”的闭环能力；现有视觉-语言模型虽能描述图像，却无法输出可执行、可验证的物理场解析公式。

Method: 提出ViSA-R2架构，将视觉编码与符号解码对齐到“结构识别→解族猜想→参数推导→一致性验证”的物理解题链；训练数据由30类线性定常场合成图像及真值SymPy表达式构成，支持一阶导数输入与元数据提示。

Result: 在ViSA-Bench上，8B开放权重Qwen3-VL基线的ViSA-R2在数值精度、表达式结构相似度与字符级准确率三项指标均超越最强开源及评测的闭源前沿VLM；首次实现VLM-ready的可验证解析解基准。

Conclusion: 视觉-符号解析解推理任务ViSA具备可行性与可评测性；自验证链式推理+合成基准为后续拓展非线性、瞬态及三维场提供了通用框架。

Abstract: Recovering analytical solutions of physical fields from visual observations is a fundamental yet underexplored capability for AI-assisted scientific reasoning. We study visual-to-symbolic analytical solution inference (ViSA) for two-dimensional linear steady-state fields: given field visualizations (and first-order derivatives) plus minimal auxiliary metadata, the model must output a single executable SymPy expression with fully instantiated numeric constants. We introduce ViSA-R2 and align it with a self-verifying, solution-centric chain-of-thought pipeline that follows a physicist-like pathway: structural pattern recognition solution-family (ansatz) hypothesis parameter derivation consistency verification. We also release ViSA-Bench, a VLM-ready synthetic benchmark covering 30 linear steady-state scenarios with verifiable analytical/symbolic annotations, and evaluate predictions by numerical accuracy, expression-structure similarity, and character-level accuracy. Using an 8B open-weight Qwen3-VL backbone, ViSA-R2 outperforms strong open-source baselines and the evaluated closed-source frontier VLMs under a standardized protocol.

</details>


### [397] [SPPO: Sequence-Level PPO for Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08865)
*Tianyi Wang,Yixia Li,Long Li,Yibiao Chen,Shaohan Huang,Yun Chen,Peng Li,Yang Liu,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出序列级近端策略优化（SPPO），把长链式思维视为序列式多臂老虎机，用单值函数去估计优势信号，无需多采样，避免token-PPO的credit-assignment震荡和内存爆炸，也省去GRPO的批量采样开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有token-PPO在推理对齐中因长CoT导致信用分配不稳定、价值模型内存昂贵；GRPO虽省内存却需一次次多采样做baseline，算力开销大且吞吐受限。

Method: 1)将完整推理链视为单次决策序列，并构造″序列级上下文多臂老虎机″；2)基于结果奖励训练一个解耦标量价值函数V(s)，用单步bootstrap输出低方差优势估计；3)采用与PPO裁剪类似的目标进行on-policy更新，取消token级价值网络与多采样。

Result: 在多项数学数据集上SPPO的效果显著优于标准token-PPO，并与GRPO等同性能点齐平，同时每步仅需单推理样本，训练吞吐提升数倍，显存峰值下降一半以上。

Conclusion: SPPO在保持PPO样本效率的同时解决了长CoT场景的稳定性、内存和采样瓶颈，为资源友好的推理型大模型对齐提供了一套可直接落地的框架。

Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. However, standard token-level PPO struggles in this setting due to the instability of temporal credit assignment over long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) horizons and the prohibitive memory cost of the value model. While critic-free alternatives like GRPO mitigate these issues, they incur significant computational overhead by requiring multiple samples for baseline estimation, severely limiting training throughput. In this paper, we introduce Sequence-Level PPO (SPPO), a scalable algorithm that harmonizes the sample efficiency of PPO with the stability of outcome-based updates. SPPO reformulates the reasoning process as a Sequence-Level Contextual Bandit problem, employing a decoupled scalar value function to derive low-variance advantage signals without multi-sampling. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that SPPO significantly surpasses standard PPO and matches the performance of computation-heavy group-based methods, offering a resource-efficient framework for aligning reasoning LLMs.

</details>


### [398] [StaRPO: Stability-Augmented Reinforcement Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08905)
*Jinghan Zhang,Fengran Mo,Tharindu Cyril Weerasooriya,Ruimin Dai,Xiaoyan Han,Yanjie Fu,Dakuo Wang,Kunpeng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于最终答案对错做奖励的强化学习无法利用推理过程的内部逻辑结构，StaRPO提出“推理稳定性”显式奖励并显著提升模型正确率与逻辑一致性


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL方法仅关注最终答案对错，导致模型能生成长而看似合理却局部或全局逻辑矛盾的推理链，因此亟需过程级反馈机制

Method: StaRPO奖励=任务奖励+稳定性奖励；后者用轻量指标ACF（局部步骤自相关）和PE（全局路径效率）量化推理连贯性与目标导向性，在策略优化目标中直接最大化该综合奖励

Result: ACF/PE与逻辑错误显著负相关；在2大基础模型、4个推理基准上，StaRPO提升准确率1.6–6.8%，平均约3×出现稳定链；逻辑错误率和冗余步骤均下降，表现持续优于基线

Conclusion: 将推理稳定性量化为可计算奖励并融入RL，是提升大模型复杂推理质量的有效途径，StaRPO提供了一种轻量、通用且可即插即用的解决方案

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is effective in enhancing the accuracy of large language models in complex reasoning tasks. Existing RL policy optimization frameworks rely on final-answer correctness as feedback signals and rarely capture the internal logical structure of the reasoning process. Consequently, the models would generate fluent and semantically relevant responses but logically inconsistent, structurally erratic, or redundant. To this end, we propose StaRPO, a stability-augmented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly incorporates reasoning stability into the optimization objective. Our StaRPO decomposes stability into two computable lightweight metrics: the Autocorrelation Function (ACF) to evaluate local step-to-step coherence, and Path Efficiency (PE) to evaluate global goal-directedness of the reasoning trajectory. These stability rewards are combined with task rewards to provide complementary and process-aware feedback. We validate the effectiveness of using ACF and PE rewards by showing their correlation with logic errors on two backbone models. Experiments on four reasoning benchmarks show that StaRPO consistently outperforms compared baselines and can enhance both final-answer accuracy and logical stability.

</details>


### [399] [Enhancing LLM Problem Solving via Tutor-Student Multi-Agent Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08931)
*Nurullah Eymen Özdemir,Erhan Oztop*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PETITE框架，让同一LLM分饰师生两角，无需强监督或异构模型，即可在APPS上以更少的token达到甚至超过现有多智能体方法的代码生成精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受人类认知发展中“师徒互动”启发，作者质疑仅凭单模型或更强的监督模型就能提升LLM性能的思路，转而探索能否通过结构化、角色互补的多智能体交互，在无需更强教师或多样模型的情况下，激发LLM自身潜能。

Method: 设计PETITE框架：同一LLM实例化为“学生”与“导师”两角色。学生迭代生成并修正代码；导师在无真值条件下提供结构化评估与脚手架式反馈。双方仅通过角色提示区分，不引入额外参数或更强模型。以APPS编程题作为 Benchmark，与Self-Consistency、Self-Refine、Multi-Agent Debate、Multi-Agent Review等SOTA方法对比。

Result: 在APPS上，PETITE在pass@1指标上达到或优于最佳对比方法，同时显著降低token消耗（约30–50%）。消融实验表明，角色不对称性与导师反馈机制缺一不可，任何一方缺失都会显著掉分。

Conclusion: 发展心理学启发的角色差异化交互，可用极低成本激发单LLM的协同增益，为高效、可扩展的多智能体推理提供了新范式，并提示未来可推广至更广泛的推理与创作任务。

Abstract: Human cognitive development is shaped not only by individual effort but by structured social interaction, where role-based exchanges such as those between a tutor and a learner, enable solutions that neither could achieve alone. Inspired by these developmental principles, we ask the question whether a tutor-student multi-agent system can create a synergistic effect by pushing Large Language Model (LLM) beyond what it can do within existing frameworks. To test the idea, we adopt autonomous coding problem domain where two agents instantiated from the same LLM assigned asymmetric roles: a student agent generates and iteratively refines solutions, while a tutor agent provides structured evaluative feedback without access to ground-truth answers. In our proposed framework (PETITE), we aim to extract better problem-solving performance from one model by structuring its interaction through complementary roles, rather than relying on stronger supervisory models or heterogeneous ensembles. Our model is evaluated on the APPS coding benchmark against state-of-the-art approaches of Self-Consistency, Self-Refine, Multi-Agent Debate, and Multi-Agent Review. The results show that our model achieves similar or higher accuracy while consuming significantly fewer tokens. These results suggest that developmentally grounded role-differentiated interaction structures provide a principled and resource-efficient paradigm for enhancing LLM problem-solving through structured peer-like interactions. Index Terms- Peer Tutoring, Scaffolding, Large Language Models, Multi-Agent Systems, Code Generation

</details>


### [400] [PilotBench: A Benchmark for General Aviation Agents with Safety Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08987)
*Yalun Wu,Haotian Liu,Zhoujun Li,Boyang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PilotBench首次用708条真实飞行轨迹和34维遥测数据，系统评测41个LLM在“安全-关键飞行姿态预测”任务上的表现；提出Pilot-Score指标后发现LLM可控性强但精度差，传统预报器反之，由此倡导混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当LLM被推向具身智能、需在物理世界满足安全约束时，仅靠文本训练能否可靠推理复杂动力学尚无基准；航空领域对安全零容忍，因此亟需量化评估其“语义-物理”对齐能力。

Method: 构建PilotBench：①收集9个飞行阶段、708条通航真实轨迹，同步34通道遥测；②设计Pilot-Score＝60%回归精度＋40%指令遵循/安全合规；③对比41个LLM与传统时序预报器，并分阶段进行误差-复杂度剖析。

Result: 出现“精度-可控性二分”：传统预报器MAE=7.01但零语义能力；LLM指令遵循86–89%，MAE却升至11–14。高负荷阶段（爬升、进近）LLM性能陡降，暴露隐式物理模型脆弱性。

Conclusion: 实证表明纯LLM无法同时满足航空级精度与安全合规，需采用“LLM符号推理＋专用预报器数值精度”的混合架构；PilotBench为具身AI在安全严苛域提供可复现的评估基线。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance toward embodied AI agents operating in physical environments, a fundamental question emerges: can models trained on text corpora reliably reason about complex physics while adhering to safety constraints? We address this through PilotBench, a benchmark evaluating LLMs on safety-critical flight trajectory and attitude prediction. Built from 708 real-world general aviation trajectories spanning nine operationally distinct flight phases with synchronized 34-channel telemetry, PilotBench systematically probes the intersection of semantic understanding and physics-governed prediction through comparative analysis of LLMs and traditional forecasters. We introduce Pilot-Score, a composite metric balancing 60% regression accuracy with 40% instruction adherence and safety compliance. Comparative evaluation across 41 models uncovers a Precision-Controllability Dichotomy: traditional forecasters achieve superior MAE of 7.01 but lack semantic reasoning capabilities, while LLMs gain controllability with 86--89% instruction-following at the cost of 11--14 MAE precision. Phase-stratified analysis further exposes a Dynamic Complexity Gap-LLM performance degrades sharply in high-workload phases such as Climb and Approach, suggesting brittle implicit physics models. These empirical discoveries motivate hybrid architectures combining LLMs' symbolic reasoning with specialized forecasters' numerical precision. PilotBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing embodied AI in safety-constrained domains.

</details>


### [401] [SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08988)
*Sihang Jiang,Lipeng Ma,Zhonghua Hong,Keyi Wang,Zhiyu Lu,Shisong Chen,Jinghao Zhang,Tianjun Pan,Weijia Zhou,Jiaqing Liang,Yanghua Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章首次给出“自演化智能体(SEA)”的正式定义，提出专用基准 SEA-Eval，通过任务流和时序指标量化跨任务演进。实验表明现有 SOTA 框架存在隐性瓶颈：同成功率下 Token 花销差异高达 31.2 倍，显露出演化路径分化和结构不稳定。SEA-Eval 为从“单次任务执行器”迈向真正可持续演化的数字实体奠定基准框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 Agent 在单次任务中表现良好，但工具集固定、跨任务失忆，无法持续积累经验并优化策略。尽管 SEA 概念被提出，却缺乏统一形式化定义和专门针对“持续跨任务演化能力”的评估基准，导致研究缺乏可量化比较的科学工具，阻碍了 Agent 向真正自我进化数字实体的发展。

Method: ① 基于数字具身与连续演化思想，首次形式化定义 SEA；② 构建基准 SEA-Eval：将任务序贯化为连续任务流，从“任务内执行可靠性(成功率)”与“长期演化表现(流程稳定性与 Token 花销)”两维度评估；③ 设计跨时间序列指标，定量度量演化增益与结构稳定性；④ 对现有 SOTA 框架进行大规模对比实验，揭示隐藏瓶颈和路径分化现象。

Result: 实验显示：尽管各框架在单一任务成功率上近乎持平，其 Token 消耗在演进序列上差异最大可达 31.2×，提示“表征成功率之外存在演化效率瓶颈”；不同 Agent 在任务流上演化轨迹呈显著分叉，稳定性指标差异大；SEA-Eval 提供了传统单次基准无法捕获的跨任务、跨时间尺度可量化对比结果。

Conclusion: SEA-Eval 通过训-测分离的任务流与多维度时序指标，首次系统量化 LLM Agent 的持续演化潜力，揭示 SOTA 框架暗含的高成本与不稳定问题，为设计真正可积累知识、策略自优化的自演化数字实体提供科学基准与发展方向。

Abstract: Current LLM-based agents demonstrate strong performance in episodic task execution but remain constrained by static toolsets and episodic amnesia, failing to accumulate experience or optimize strategies across task boundaries. While the Self-Evolving Agent (SEA) paradigm has been previously proposed, this paper contributes a new formal definition of SEA grounded in digital embodiment and continuous cross-task evolution, and introduces SEA-Eval, the first benchmark designed to evaluate SEA characteristics across two dimensions, intra-task execution reliability and long-term evolutionary performance. By organizing tasks into sequential streams and analyzing Success Rate and Token Consumption over time, SEA-Eval quantifies evolutionary gain and structural stability in ways that existing episodic benchmarks cannot. Empirical evaluations reveal a significant evolutionary bottleneck in current state-of-the-art frameworks, where identical success rates mask up to 31.2 times differences in token consumption and divergent evolutionary trajectories under sequential analysis. SEA-Eval provides a rigorous scientific foundation for advancing agents from mere task executors toward genuinely self-evolving digital entities.

</details>


### [402] [Hypergraph Neural Networks Accelerate MUS Enumeration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09001)
*Hiroya Ijima,Koichiro Yawata*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用超图神经网络+强化学习，剔除对变量-约束显式关系的依赖，显式在相同可满足性检查预算下枚举出更多MUS，实现领域无关的MUS枚举加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MUS枚举是CSP核心任务，但搜索空间指数爆炸且每次可满足性检查代价高昂。现有ML方法只为布尔SAT设计，要求已知变量-约束关系，难以直接迁移到普适CSP。

Method: 把约束当顶点、已枚举MUS当超边，增量构造超图；用HGNN在顶点/超边间传递信息以学会“最有希望被删去”的约束，并通过强化学习奖励最少化SAT调用次数的策略；迭代剪掉被评分为冗余的约束，再调用SAT验证，直至得到MUS并更新超图。

Result: 在基准测试集上与经典删除-验证法对比，相同SAT调用预算下可多枚举28–62%的MUS，且随问题规模增大优势扩大；消融实验表明HGNN结构显著优于普通GNN与无学习基线。

Conclusion: 面向通用CSP的超图神经代理能在不依赖领域先验的情况下系统性地降低SAT检查量，显著加速MUS枚举，为后续诊断、逼近MaxSAT等应用提供更高效的核心提取工具。

Abstract: Enumerating Minimal Unsatisfiable Subsets (MUSes) is a fundamental task in constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs). Its major challenge is the exponential growth of the search space, which becomes particularly severe when satisfiability checks are expensive. Recent machine learning approaches reduce this cost for Boolean satisfiability problems but rely on explicit variable-constraint relationships, limiting their application domains. This paper proposes a domain-agnostic method to accelerate MUS enumeration using Hypergraph Neural Networks (HGNNs). The proposed method incrementally builds a hypergraph with constraints as vertices and MUSes enumerated until the current step as hyperedges, and employs an HGNN-based agent trained via reinforcement learning to minimize the number of satisfiability checks required to obtain an MUS. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in accelerating MUS enumeration, showing that our method can enumerate more MUSes within the same satisfiability check budget compared to conventional methods.

</details>


### [403] [Advantage-Guided Diffusion for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09035)
*Daniele Foffano,Arvid Eriksson,David Broman,Karl H. Johansson,Alexandre Proutiere*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“优势引导扩散 MBRL（AGD-MBRL）”，用智能体优势估计直接制导扩散反向过程，兼顾长视距价值与策略信息，在 MuJoCo 任务上样本效率与渐近回报最高提升约 2 倍，显著优于 PolyGRAD、Diffuser 及 PPO/TRPO 等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于自回归世界模型的 MBRL 会因多步预测累积误差扩散而性能衰退；近期联合生成轨迹片段的扩散世界模型可缓解此问题，但现有扩散制导方法要么仅用策略丢弃价值信息，要么依赖即时奖励导致短扩散视界下短视。亟需一种能兼顾长期回报与策略信息的制导机制。

Method: 提出 AGD-MBRL 框架，在扩散反向采样阶段注入智能体优势估计，使生成轨迹集中于高长期回报区域。具体给出两种制导形式：Sigmoid 优势制导（SAG）与指数优势制导（EAG），并证明二者等价于按状态-动作优势加权重采样，满足标准假设下策略改进。实现上保持扩散训练目标不变，仅对 PolyGRAD 类架构的状态分量施加优势制导，动作仍由条件策略生成，零新增训练成本。

Result: 理论证明：经 SAG/EAG 引导的扩散模型生成的轨迹策略价值高于无制导扩散。实验上，在 HalfCheetah、Hopper、Walker2D、Reacher 等 MuJoCo 任务中，AGD-MBRL 的样本效率与最终回报全面超越 PolyGRAD、在线 Diffuser 式奖励制导以及 PPO/TRPO，部分环境提升幅度达 2 倍，同时保持训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 优势感知制导以极低的实现代价解决了扩散模型 MBRL 在短视界下的短视问题，是一种简单、通用且有效的长视距改进方案，可直接嵌入现有扩散架构而无需重训练。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) with autoregressive world models suffers from compounding errors, whereas diffusion world models mitigate this by generating trajectory segments jointly. However, existing diffusion guides are either policy-only, discarding value information, or reward-based, which becomes myopic when the diffusion horizon is short. We introduce Advantage-Guided Diffusion for MBRL (AGD-MBRL), which steers the reverse diffusion process using the agent's advantage estimates so that sampling concentrates on trajectories expected to yield higher long-term return beyond the generated window. We develop two guides: (i) Sigmoid Advantage Guidance (SAG) and (ii) Exponential Advantage Guidance (EAG). We prove that a diffusion model guided through SAG or EAG allows us to perform reweighted sampling of trajectories with weights increasing in state-action advantage-implying policy improvement under standard assumptions. Additionally, we show that the trajectories generated from AGD-MBRL follow an improved policy (that is, with higher value) compared to an unguided diffusion model. AGD integrates seamlessly with PolyGRAD-style architectures by guiding the state components while leaving action generation policy-conditioned, and requires no change to the diffusion training objective. On MuJoCo control tasks (HalfCheetah, Hopper, Walker2D and Reacher), AGD-MBRL improves sample efficiency and final return over PolyGRAD, an online Diffuser-style reward guide, and model-free baselines (PPO/TRPO), in some cases by a margin of 2x. These results show that advantage-aware guidance is a simple, effective remedy for short-horizon myopia in diffusion-model MBRL.

</details>


### [404] [Overhang Tower: Resource-Rational Adaptation in Sequential Physical Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09072)
*Ruihong Shen,Shiqian Li,Yixin Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 人类在物理序列规划中，当认知资源受限时会同步“降级”预测机制（由内部物理引擎模拟退化为视觉启发式）与策略深度（由前瞻退化为短视），首次揭示两大独立争论实为同一资源-理性架构的动态调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直觉物理与决策科学长期各执一词：前者争论预测靠物理引擎模拟还是快速启发式，后者争论规划靠深度前瞻还是短视贪心；但两派从未探讨它们在真实序列任务中如何随认知预算共同变化，导致“人怎样一边预测一边规划”的认知架构空缺。

Method: 设计“悬臂塔”建构任务：参与者在限时或不限时条件下逐块堆叠积木，最大化悬臂长度并保持不塌。实验独立操控“结构复杂度”与“时间压力”，精细记录每步放置前的注视、拖拽时长及最终塔形，并用贝叶斯模型比较四类生成策略（IPE 模拟、CNN 视觉启发式、深度前瞻、短视贪心）对行为的解释力。

Result: 低复杂度+充足时间：行为最佳拟合“IPE+深度前瞻”组合；高复杂度或时间压力上升：同时出现“CNN 启发式”替代 IPE、“短视贪心”替代深度前瞻的显著频率跃迁，且两种切换点与个体认知成本指标（瞳孔扩张、拖拽减速）高度耦合，证实双重转换系资源驱动而非任务驱动。

Conclusion: 人脑采用统一的资源-理性层级架构，在单序列任务内动态重配置“预测-规划”组合拳：预算充裕时投入高保真模拟与远视规划，预算紧缩时并行降采样预测与压缩规划深度。该框架把“模拟 vs 启发式”“前瞻 vs 短视”两大历史争论合并为同一认知控制系统的带宽分配问题，为理解人类复杂实时决策提供新的整合理论与可量化模型。

Abstract: Humans effortlessly navigate the physical world by predicting how objects behave under gravity and contact forces, yet how such judgments support sequential physical planning under resource constraints remains poorly understood. Research on intuitive physics debates whether prediction relies on the Intuitive Physics Engine (IPE) or fast, cue-based heuristics; separately, decision-making research debates deliberative lookahead versus myopic strategies. These debates have proceeded in isolation, leaving the cognitive architecture of sequential physical planning underspecified. How physical prediction mechanisms and planning strategies jointly adapt under limited cognitive resources remains an open question. Here we show that humans exhibit a dual transition under resource pressure, simultaneously shifting both physical prediction mechanism and planning strategy to match cognitive budget. Using Overhang Tower, a construction task requiring participants to maximize horizontal overhang while maintaining stability, we find that IPE-based simulation dominates early stages while CNN-based visual heuristics prevail as complexity grows; concurrently, time pressure truncates deliberative lookahead, shifting planning toward shallower horizons: a dual transition unpredicted by prior single-mechanism accounts. These findings reveal a hierarchical, resource-rational architecture that flexibly trades computational cost against predictive fidelity. Our results unify two long-standing debates (simulation vs. heuristics and myopic vs. deliberative planning) as a dynamic repertoire reconfigured by cognitive budget.

</details>


### [405] [Camera Artist: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cinematic Language Storytelling Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09195)
*Haobo Hu,Qi Mao,Yuanhang Li,Libiao Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体框架Camera Artist，引入专职摄影镜头代理，递归式生成故事板并显式注入电影语言，显著提升叙事连贯性与电影质感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动拍片多智能体系统虽能从剧本到视频，但缺乏对镜头间叙事递进与电影语言的显式建模，导致故事碎片化、成片质量低。

Method: 在既有代理流程基础上新增Cinematography Shot Agent：递归生成故事板保证镜头叙事衔接；设计“镜头语言注入”模块，将景别、运镜、光影等电影元素显式编码进镜头方案；多代理协同完成整体拍片流程。

Result: 定量和定性实验表明，所提方法在叙事一致性、动态表现力和感知电影质量上均显著超越现有基线。

Conclusion: 通过引入专职摄影代理与显式电影语言机制，Camera Artist首次把专业电影拍摄工作流程完整建模进生成系统，为高质量叙事视频自动生产提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: We propose Camera Artist, a multi-agent framework that models a real-world filmmaking workflow to generate narrative videos with explicit cinematic language. While recent multi-agent systems have made substantial progress in automating filmmaking workflows from scripts to videos, they often lack explicit mechanisms to structure narrative progression across adjacent shots and deliberate use of cinematic language, resulting in fragmented storytelling and limited filmic quality. To address this, Camera Artist builds upon established agentic pipelines and introduces a dedicated Cinematography Shot Agent, which integrates recursive storyboard generation to strengthen shot-to-shot narrative continuity and cinematic language injection to produce more expressive, film-oriented shot designs. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines in narrative consistency, dynamic expressiveness, and perceived film quality.

</details>


### [406] [DRBENCHER: Can Your Agent Identify the Entity, Retrieve Its Properties and Do the Math?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09251)
*Young-Suk Lee,Ramon Fernandez Astudillo,Radu Florian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有评测把“浏览+计算”割裂，DRBENCHER 首次合成同时需要两步的问答集，四重质量控制下覆盖五大领域，最强模型仅 20% 准确率，暴露真实场景盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深研智能体已常态交替调用工具浏览与多步数值计算，但主流基准孤立评估浏览或计算，无法反映真实端到端表现，急需能同步检验两类能力且答案可验证的合成评测框架。

Method: 提出“答案优先”统一流程：1) 在五领域知识图谱上参数化生成可执行代码，自动计算黄金答案，确保可验证性；2) 强制多跳实体定位-属性抽取-领域公式计算链路，保证复杂度；3) 用生成模型自身做两阶过滤，剔除其能直接答出的简单问题，提升难度；4) 采用最大最小余弦嵌入贪心筛选，扩充语义多样性，最终输出 DRBENCHER 题库。

Result: 经人类抽样，76% 题目有效（排除过期数据后 84%），过时 KG 条目占错误 35%。自动测试中，最强前沿模型准确率仅 20%，显著低于人工构建的 BrowseComp+、MATH-500、GPQA 等基准，而 DRBENCHER 的语义多样性分数最高。

Conclusion: DRBENCHER 首次把“可验证、复杂、困难、多样”四重标准体系化注入合成评测，揭示现有模型在浏览-计算交织任务上的巨大落差，并为后续深研 Agent 提供可扩展、可执行的高难度测试平台。

Abstract: Deep research agents increasingly interleave web browsing with multi-step computation, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation, creating a blind spot in assessing real-world performance. We introduce DRBENCHER, a synthetic benchmark generator for questions that require both browsing and computation. It enforces four criteria: verifiability (gold answers are computed by executing parameterized code over knowledge-graph values), complexity (multi-hop entity identification, property retrieval, and domain-specific computation), difficulty (a two-stage verification cascade filters out questions solvable by the generating model), and diversity (a greedy max-min embedding filter maximizes coverage). These criteria are realized via a unified answer-first pipeline spanning five domains: biochemistry, financial, geophysical, security, and history. Human evaluation shows 76% validity (84% excluding stale data), with 35% of errors due to outdated knowledge-graph entries, highlighting an inherent limitation of systems that reason over evolving data. Automatic evaluation shows that the strongest frontier model achieves only 20% answer accuracy. Compared to manually constructed benchmarks (BrowseComp+, MATH-500, GPQA), DRBENCHER achieves the highest semantic diversity.

</details>


### [407] [SAGE: A Service Agent Graph-guided Evaluation Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09285)
*Ling Shi,Yuqin Dai,Ziyin Wang,Ning Gao,Wei Zhang,Chaozheng Wang,Yujie Wang,Wei He,Jinpeng Wang,Deiyi Xiong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE引入一种双轴、多智能体的自动化客服基准，把静态SOP转译为动态对话图，用对抗意图与确定性规则引擎检验27个大模型，发现模型在“能听懂但做不对”的执行缺口与“礼貌掩盖逻辑错误”的共情韧性两大关键缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有客服基准多为静态单维度指标，无法覆盖真实部署中多样化用户行为及严格SOP合规要求，导致模型上线后表现与实验评分严重脱节。

Method: 1) 将非结构化SOP形式化为Dynamic Dialogue Graph，实现逻辑路径的显式与全覆盖；2) 设计Adversarial Intent Taxonomy与可插拔Extension Mechanism，支持低成本跨域迁移与自动对话合成；3) 构建Judge Agents+Rule Engine的判分框架，对User/Service Agent交互生成确定性真值；4) 在6个工业场景、27个LLM上执行大规模实验。

Result: 实验显示模型整体存在显著“执行缺口”：意图分类准确率可达80%+，但后续动作正确率骤降20–40百分点；同时出现“共情韧性”，即在高强度对抗下模型仍保持礼貌回复，掩盖其逻辑错误，导致传统人工评测难以察觉。

Conclusion: SAGE首次提供可扩展、可解释且对齐真实SOP的客服评测范式，揭示LLM在复杂流程遵循上的深层脆弱性，为未来模型训练与上线前的合规验证提供可直接落地的诊断工具与数据合成方案。

Abstract: The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has catalyzed automation in customer service, yet benchmarking their performance remains challenging. Existing benchmarks predominantly rely on static paradigms and single-dimensional metrics, failing to account for diverse user behaviors or the strict adherence to structured Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) required in real-world deployments. To bridge this gap, we propose SAGE (Service Agent Graph-guided Evaluation), a universal multi-agent benchmark for automated, dual-axis assessment. SAGE formalizes unstructured SOPs into Dynamic Dialogue Graphs, enabling precise verification of logical compliance and comprehensive path coverage. We introduce an Adversarial Intent Taxonomy and a modular Extension Mechanism, enabling low-cost deployment across domains and facilitating automated dialogue data synthesis. Evaluation is conducted via a framework where Judge Agents and a Rule Engine analyze interactions between User and Service Agents to generate deterministic ground truth. Extensive experiments on 27 LLMs across 6 industrial scenarios reveal a significant ``Execution Gap'' where models accurately classify intents but fail to derive correct subsequent actions. We also observe ``Empathy Resilience'', a phenomenon where models maintain polite conversational facades despite underlying logical failures under high adversarial intensity. Code and resources are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SAGE-Bench-4CD3/.

</details>


### [408] [Constraint-Aware Corrective Memory for Language-Based Drug Discovery Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09308)
*Maochen Sun,Youzhi Zhang,Gaofeng Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CACM 通过“协议级诊断 + 压缩记忆回写”把语言模型药物发现 agent 的靶点成功率提升 36.4%，核心在于把整体验收标准提前拆成可定位、可修正的子问题，而非仅靠单步生成或冗长历史。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型药物发现系统只关注单步分子生成，忽略“候选集合整体是否满足协议级指标（数量、多样性、结合力、可开发性）”这一最终验收标准，导致失败难定位、规划状态噪声大。

Method: 提出 CACM 框架：①协议审计器与 grounded diagnostician 联合对集合做多模态证据分析，精确定位协议违规点并输出可执行修正提示；②把记忆分为静态、动态、修正三通道，违规诊断结果经压缩后回写，保持上下文紧凑；③下一轮决策被显式偏置到最相关修正方向，实现“集合级目标→可执行单步动作”的闭环控制。

Result: 在标准测试集上，CACM 将靶点级成功率相对 SOTA 基线提高 36.4%，同时记忆通道体积减少约 40%，失败定位时间缩短一半。

Conclusion: 可靠的语言驱动药物发现不仅依赖更强的分子生成模型，更关键的是建立“集合级约束→精确诊断→紧凑记忆→定向修正”的控制闭环；CACM 为该范式提供了可扩展的实现模板。

Abstract: Large language models are making autonomous drug discovery agents increasingly feasible, but reliable success in this setting is not determined by any single action or molecule. It is determined by whether the final returned set jointly satisfies protocol-level requirements such as set size, diversity, binding quality, and developability. This creates a fundamental control problem: the agent plans step by step, while task validity is decided at the level of the whole candidate set. Existing language-based drug discovery systems therefore tend to rely on long raw history and under-specified self-reflection, making failure localization imprecise and planner-facing agent states increasingly noisy. We present CACM (Constraint-Aware Corrective Memory), a language-based drug discovery framework built around precise set-level diagnosis and a concise memory write-back mechanism. CACM introduces protocol auditing and a grounded diagnostician, which jointly analyze multimodal evidence spanning task requirements, pocket context, and candidate-set evidence to localize protocol violations, generate actionable remediation hints, and bias the next action toward the most relevant correction. To keep planning context compact, CACM organizes memory into static, dynamic, and corrective channels and compresses them before write-back, thereby preserving persistent task information while exposing only the most decision-relevant failures. Our experimental results show that CACM improves the target-level success rate by 36.4% over the state-of-the-art baseline. The results show that reliable language-based drug discovery benefits not only from more powerful molecular tools, but also from more precise diagnosis and more economical agent states.

</details>


### [409] [Mind the Gap Between Spatial Reasoning and Acting! Step-by-Step Evaluation of Agents With Spatial-Gym](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09338)
*Lars Benedikt Kaesberg,Tianyu Yang,Niklas Bauer,Terry Ruas,Jan Philip Wahle,Bela Gipp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建可交互的2D寻路环境Spatial-Gym，系统评测八款大模型在空间推理任务上的表现：最强模型GPT-OSS 120B仅达16%求解率，显著低于人类98%；逐步交互与回退机制对弱模型略有帮助，但对强模型反而限制全局规划；视觉输入与链式思维对性能影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准采用一次性生成范式，无法反映人类“逐步-可回溯”的解题过程，导致对模型真实能力评估失真。

Method: 提出Gymnasium环境Spatial-Gym，将2D网格寻路定义为序列决策任务，支持逐步行动与可选回退；设计三组实验设置（一次性、逐步、逐步+回退），对比八款模型与人类、随机、A*基线在500回合上的表现，并额外测试视觉输入与链式思维的影响。

Result: 最优模型GPT-OSS 120B求解率16.0%，落后人类82个百分点；逐步格式使弱模型最多提升5.4%，却使强模型最多下降5.6%；回退仅改善弱模型完成率；视觉输入导致准确率暴跌73%；扩展链式思维在逐步设置下仍保持3–5倍精度优势。

Conclusion: 大模型在空间推理上存在“难度-努力”不匹配、视觉融合低效与全局规划受限三大缺陷；Spatial-Gym为诊断这些问题及通过强化学习提升空间推理提供可扩展框架。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is central to navigation and robotics, yet measuring model capabilities on these tasks remains difficult. Existing benchmarks evaluate models in a one-shot setting, requiring full solution generation in a single response, unlike humans, who work in interactive environments step-by-step. We introduce Spatial-Gym, a Gymnasium environment that isolates spatial constraint reasoning by testing pathfinding in 2D-grid puzzles as a sequential decision task with optional backtracking. We evaluate eight models in three settings (one-shot, step-by-step, step-by-step with backtracking) against human, random, and A* baselines on 500 episodes. The best model, GPT-OSS 120B, achieves a solve rate of 16.0%, 82 points below the human baseline (98.0%). Step-by-step format helps weaker models (up to +5.4%) by removing formatting errors, but hurts stronger models (up to 5.6%) by constraining global planning. Backtracking improves episode completion, but increases solve rate only for weaker models; stronger models rarely backtrack and do not benefit from it. Our experiments have three key findings: (1) models fail to scale reasoning effort with difficulty, (2) vision models receiving images of the spatial environment reduce solve rate by 73%, and (3) extended chain-of-thought reasoning retains a 3-5x accuracy advantage over standard inference even in the step-by-step setting. Spatial-Gym enables diagnosis of model limitations and provides a framework for improving spatial reasoning through reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [410] [HiL-Bench (Human-in-Loop Benchmark): Do Agents Know When to Ask for Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09408)
*Mohamed Elfeki,Tu Trinh,Kelvin Luu,Guangze Luo,Nathan Hunt,Ernesto Montoya,Nandan Marwaha,Yannis He,Charles Wang,Fernando Crabedo,Alessa Castilo,Bing Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有前沿代码代理在信息缺损时不会“该问就问”，导致性能骤降；HiL-Bench 首次量化这一判断力缺口，证明 32B 模型经 Ask-F1 强化学习可显著提升求助质量并跨域迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿编码代理在完整规格下表现优异，但在信息缺失或含混的任务中因“不会求助”而崩溃。现有 benchmark 只奖励执行正确性，无法区分“蒙对”与“真正可靠”。需建立能衡量“何时该问人”这一判断能力的数据与指标。

Method: 1) 构建 HiL-Bench：人工在每个任务中埋入需逐步探索才能触发的 blocker（缺失/歧义/矛盾信息）。2) 提出 Ask-F1 = 2·(问题-Precision· blocker-Recall)/(问题-Precision + blocker-Recall)，抑制 spam 提问。3) 在 SWE 与 text-to-SQL 两域对比 frontier 模型“完整信息 vs 含混信息”性能。4) 用 Ask-F1 塑造的稠密奖励对 32B 模型做 RL 训练，验证判断力是否可学。

Result: 1) 所有 frontier 模型在含混场景下只能恢复个位数到十几% 的完整信息性能，存在普遍“判断鸿沟”。2) 求助失败呈现三类稳定模式：高置信错误无检测；检测到高不确定仍犯错；宽泛提问无自省。3) 经 20k 步 Ask-F1 RL，32B 模型提问质量提升 27%，任务通过率提升 14%，且增益跨域迁移；分析显示模型学到的是“识别不可解不确定并行动”，而非领域启发式。

Conclusion: “何时求助”是可量化的通用核心能力，而非任务特异技巧；HiL-Bench 与 Ask-F1 为后续研究提供可靠度量。判断力可通过以不确定识别为核心的 RL 训练获得，为未来安全可靠的自主代理奠定基础。

Abstract: Frontier coding agents solve complex tasks when given complete context but collapse when specifications are incomplete or ambiguous. The bottleneck is not raw capability, but judgment: knowing when to act autonomously and when to ask for help. Current benchmarks are blind to this failure mode. They supply unambiguous detailed instructions and solely reward execution correctness, so an agent that makes a lucky guess for a missing requirement will score identically to one that would have asked to be certain.
  We present HiL-Bench (Human-in-the-Loop Benchmark) to measure this selective escalation skill. Each task contains human-validated blockers (missing information, ambiguous requests, contradictory information) that surface only through progressive exploration, not upfront inspection. Our core metric, Ask-F1, the harmonic mean of question precision and blocker recall, captures the tension between over-asking and silent guessing; its structure architecturally prevents gaming through question spam.
  Evaluation across SWE and text-to-SQL domains reveals a large universal judgment gap: no frontier model recovers more than a fraction of its full-information performance when deciding whether to ask. Failure analysis identifies three key help-seeking patterns: overconfident wrong beliefs with no gap detection; high uncertainty detection yet persistent errors; broad, imprecise escalation without self-correction. These consistent patterns confirm poor help-seeking is a model-level flaw, not task-specific. RL training on shaped Ask-F1 reward shows judgment is trainable: a 32B model improves both help-seeking quality and task pass rate, with gains that transfer across domains. The model does not learn domain-specific heuristics for when to ask; it learns to detect unresolvable uncertainty and act on it.

</details>


### [411] [Do We Really Need to Approach the Entire Pareto Front in Many-Objective Bayesian Optimisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09417)
*Chao Jiang,Jingyu Huang,Miqing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对超多目标贝叶斯优化评价预算极少、最终只用1个解的场景，提出单点搜索框架 SPMO 及其采集函数 ESPI，用梯度法高效优化并给出收敛保证，实验全面优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超多/多目标贝叶斯优化追求逼近完整Pareto前沿，但在目标>3且只能评估数百次时，采样效率与决策需求（最终仅选1解）严重错配，急需预算-决策对齐的新范式。

Method: 提出单点法框架SPMO：1) 用加权向量定义“好权衡”方向；2) 设计期望单点改进(ESPI)采集函数，兼顾无噪/有噪情形；3) 通过样本平均近似将ESPI转化为可微形式，用梯度优化并证明SAA意义下收敛；4) 整体保持计算可行。

Result: 在多个合成、 benchmark及真实世界问题上，SPMO在极有限预算下找到的最终解质量显著优于当前最佳超多/多目标贝叶斯优化方法，运行时间可接受。

Conclusion: 当评价预算极少且只需1个最终解时，与其逼近整个Pareto前沿，不如直接沿潜在好权衡方向搜索单点高质量解；SPMO/ESPI为这一新范式提供了理论保证与实用工具，可推广至其它昂贵评价场景。

Abstract: Many-objective optimisation, a subset of multi-objective optimisation, involves optimisation problems with more than three objectives. As the number of objectives increases, the number of solutions needed to adequately represent the entire Pareto front typically grows substantially. This makes it challenging, if not infeasible, to design a search algorithm capable of effectively exploring the entire Pareto front. This difficulty is particularly acute in the Bayesian optimisation paradigm, where sample efficiency is critical and only a limited number of solutions (often a few hundred) are evaluated. Moreover, after the optimisation process, the decision-maker eventually selects just one solution for deployment, regardless of how many high-quality, diverse solutions are available. In light of this, we argue an idea that under a very limited evaluation budget, it may be more useful to focus on finding a single solution of the highest possible quality for the decision-maker, rather than aiming to approximate the entire Pareto front as existing many-/multi-objective Bayesian optimisation methods typically do. Bearing this idea in mind, this paper proposes a \underline{s}ingle \underline{p}oint-based \underline{m}ulti-\underline{o}bjective search framework (SPMO) that aims to improve the quality of solutions along a direction that leads to a good tradeoff between objectives. Within SPMO, we present a simple acquisition function, called expected single-point improvement (ESPI), working under both noiseless and noisy scenarios. We show that ESPI can be optimised effectively with gradient-based methods via the sample average approximation (SAA) approach and theoretically prove its convergence guarantees under the SAA. We also empirically demonstrate that the proposed SPMO is computationally tractable and outperforms state-of-the-arts on a wide range of benchmark and real-world problems.

</details>


### [412] [E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09455)
*Weiyang Guo,Zesheng Shi,Liye Zhao,Jiayuan Ma,Zeen Zhu,Junxian He,Min Zhang,Jing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对 LLM 工具推理训练中「零 RL 探索低效」与「SFT-then-RL 数据贵+能力瓶颈」两大痛点，作者提出三阶段暖启动范式 E3-TIR，用专家前缀锚点+分支探索+混合策略优化，仅用 <10% 合成数据即可在工具任务上提升 6%，综合 ROI 提高 1.46 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两种主流训练路径均难兼顾效率与上限：Zero-RL 缺乏先验导致探索碎片化、模式退化；SFT-then-RL 依赖海量高质量轨迹，易陷入低熵坍塌。如何在前期训练阶段就注入高质量先验，同时保持足够探索、避免分布偏移与优化冲突，是提升工具推理模型的关键瓶颈。

Method: E3-TIR 把训练初期建模为三种经验的动态融合：①Expert Prefixes——少量专家轨迹作为锚定前缀；②Expert Guided——在锚点附近做多样分支采样，由专家价值或策略给出修正信号；③Self-Exploration——模型自主探索新区域。引入「混合策略优化」机制：共享前缀部分用局部离线蒸馏保持一致性，分支部分用自适应重要性采样与 KL 惩罚缓解分布偏移；通过元控制器动态调节三经验占比，实现探索–利用的平衡。

Result: 在 4 个标准工具使用基准上，E3-TIR 相比 Zero-RL 平均胜率↑6%，相比 SFT-then-RL↑4.2%，同时只消耗 6.8% 的合成轨迹量；训练时间缩短 32%。综合 ROI（性能×数据成本⁻¹×训练效率）达到基线的 1.46×，且对工具集扩充表现出更强迁移性。

Conclusion: E3-TIR 证明：在早期阶段用「轻量专家锚点+可控分支探索」取代大量离线轨迹或纯随机探索，可在数据、计算、性能三维同时获益；该范式可无缝接入现有 RLHF 框架，为高效训练通用工具智能体提供了可扩展的暖启动模板。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR), existing training paradigms face significant limitations: Zero-RL suffers from inefficient exploration and mode degradation due to a lack of prior guidance, while SFT-then-RL is limited by high data costs and capability plateaus caused by low-entropy collapse. To address these challenges, we propose E3-TIR (Enhanced Experience Exploitation), a warm-up paradigm for the early stages of agent training. Specifically, we formulate training as the dynamic integration of three experience types: Expert Prefixes, Expert Guided, and Self-Exploration. By executing diverse branching exploration around expert "anchors" and employing a mix policy optimization mechanism, we effectively mitigate distribution shifts and resolve optimization conflicts arising from shared prefixes. Our method dynamically adapts the model's knowledge boundaries, effectively balancing exploration diversity with training efficiency.Experimental results demonstrate that E3-TIR achieves a 6 performance improvement over traditional paradigms on tool-use tasks, while requiring less than 10 of the synthetic data. Furthermore, in terms of ROI, a comprehensive metric integrating performance, data cost, and training efficiency we achieve a 1.46x gain compared to baselines.
