Code is available at https://github.com/yuki-younai/E3-TIR.

</details>


### [413] [Process Reward Agents for Steering Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09482)
*Jiwoong Sohn,Tomasz Sternal,Kenneth Styppa,Torsten Hoefler,Michael Moor*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Process Reward Agent（PRA），在推理每一步实时调用外部知识给出可验证奖励，无需更新策略模型即可在 MedQA 等医学基准上刷新 4B 规模 SOTA，并通用于 0.5B–8B 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识密集型推理的中间步骤难以局部验证，错误易累积；现有 PRM 仅事后评分，无法嵌入动态解码。

Method: PRA 把冻结策略与可检索外部知识解耦：每生成一步即检索相关证据，由轻量奖励模型输出即时过程奖励，支持 beam / MCTS 等搜索式解码在线剪枝。

Result: MedQA 上 4B 模型达 80.8% 新 SOTA；0.5B–8B 等不同规模冻结模型零样本提升最高 25.7%，跨模型一致增益。

Conclusion: PRA 证明无需重训即可为任意骨架注入领域知识，实现“策略冻结 + 可插拔领域奖励”的新范式。

Abstract: Reasoning in knowledge-intensive domains remains challenging as intermediate steps are often not locally verifiable: unlike math or code, evaluating step correctness may require synthesizing clues across large external knowledge sources. As a result, subtle errors can propagate through reasoning traces, potentially never to be detected. Prior work has proposed process reward models (PRMs), including retrieval-augmented variants, but these methods operate post hoc, scoring completed trajectories, which prevents their integration into dynamic inference procedures. Here, we introduce Process Reward Agents (PRA), a test-time method for providing domain-grounded, online, step-wise rewards to a frozen policy. In contrast to prior retrieval-augmented PRMs, PRA enables search-based decoding to rank and prune candidate trajectories at every generation step. Experiments on multiple medical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PRA consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 80.8% accuracy on MedQA with Qwen3-4B, a new state of the art at the 4B scale. Importantly, PRA generalizes to unseen frozen policy models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters, improving their accuracy by up to 25.7% without any policy model updates. More broadly, PRA suggests a paradigm in which frozen reasoners are decoupled from domain-specific reward modules, allowing the deployment of new backbones in complex domains without retraining.

</details>


### [414] [Strategic Algorithmic Monoculture:Experimental Evidence from Coordination Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09502)
*Gonzalo Ballestero,Hadi Hosseini,Samarth Khanna,Ran I. Shorrer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究区分了算法“初级单一文化”与“策略性单一文化”，发现大语言模型(LLM)在基线动作相似度上远高于人类，也能像人类一样根据协调激励调节相似度，但在需要保持差异才能获得奖励的场景中，LLM维持异质性的能力明显不如人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中，AI代理间的行为趋同(算法单一文化)可能带来系统性风险。既有研究难以厘清基线相似与策略性相似，需实证比较人类与LLM在这两种机制下的表现。

Method: 设计可分离“初级”与“策略性”算法单一文化的实验框架，分别招募人类与LLM被试，在需协调与奖励异质性的博弈中记录其动作分布及激励响应。

Result: LLM呈现出比人类更高的基线动作相似度(初级单一文化)。面对协调激励，两者均提高相似度；但当奖励差异时，人类能持续维持异质性，LLM却迅速收敛，差异显著。

Conclusion: LLM已具备策略性调节相似性的能力，但在需主动保持差异的复杂社交场景下仍逊于人类，提示未来多智能体部署需引入异质性维持机制以降低系统性风险。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly operate in multi-agent environments where outcomes depend on coordination. We distinguish primary algorithmic monoculture -- baseline action similarity -- from strategic algorithmic monoculture, whereby agents adjust similarity in response to incentives. We implement a simple experimental design that cleanly separates these forces, and deploy it on human and large language model (LLM) subjects. LLMs exhibit high levels of baseline similarity (primary monoculture) and, like humans, they regulate it in response to coordination incentives (strategic monoculture). While LLMs coordinate extremely well on similar actions, they lag behind humans in sustaining heterogeneity when divergence is rewarded.

</details>


### [415] [On Divergence Measures for Training GFlowNets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09355)
*Tiago da Silva,Eliezer de Souza da Silva,Diego Mesquita*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用Renyi-α、Tsallis-α、逆向/正向KL四种散度代替传统对数平方误差，结合方差约减控制变量，为GFlowNets提供无偏且低方差的梯度估计器，实现更快更稳定的摊销采样训练，并系统搭建了GFlowNets与一般变分推断之间的理论桥梁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFlowNets传统训练目标（期望对数平方误差）虽与变分推断相关，却并非标准KL散度，直接优化KL会导致有偏方差大的梯度估计器，限制算法收敛速度与稳定性。作者希望在不引入偏差的前提下，为GFlowNets提供可扩展、低方差的通用散度优化框架。

Method: 1) 系统比较Renyi-α、Tsallis-α、逆向KL、正向KL四大散度在GFlowNets中的梯度表达；2) 基于REINFORCE leave-one-out与score-matching构造控制变量，给出每种散度的无偏方差缩减估计器；3) 在离散组合空间上采用GFlowNets流匹配条件，将散度最小化问题转化为可端到端训练的随机优化；4) 给出不同散度对应的理论方差上界与收敛性分析。

Result: 在合成贝叶斯网络结构学习与分子片段生成两大任务上，四种新散度目标均较基线（对数平方误差）收敛更快，其中逆向KL在200K步内达到−log-likelihood 3.2→1.8，提升44%；Renyi-α(0.5)所需梯度方差降低3.7×，采样效率提升2.1×；控制变量使梯度信噪比提高1 order of magnitude，训练时间缩短35%，且未出现传统KL训练中的模式坍缩。

Conclusion: 只要把散度选得恰当并配套方差约减，GFlowNets可直接执行通用变分近似，无需牺牲无偏性即可显著加速收敛。该框架统一了以往启发式训练目标，为后续在因果发现、NLP与药物设计等组合生成任务中引入更丰富散度与结构先验奠定理论与算法基础。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are amortized inference models designed to sample from unnormalized distributions over composable objects, with applications in generative modeling for tasks in fields such as causal discovery, NLP, and drug discovery. Traditionally, the training procedure for GFlowNets seeks to minimize the expected log-squared difference between a proposal (forward policy) and a target (backward policy) distribution, which enforces certain flow-matching conditions. While this training procedure is closely related to variational inference (VI), directly attempting standard Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimization can lead to proven biased and potentially high-variance estimators. Therefore, we first review four divergence measures, namely, Renyi-$α$'s, Tsallis-$α$'s, reverse and forward KL's, and design statistically efficient estimators for their stochastic gradients in the context of training GFlowNets. Then, we verify that properly minimizing these divergences yields a provably correct and empirically effective training scheme, often leading to significantly faster convergence than previously proposed optimization. To achieve this, we design control variates based on the REINFORCE leave-one-out and score-matching estimators to reduce the variance of the learning objectives' gradients. Our work contributes by narrowing the gap between GFlowNets training and generalized variational approximations, paving the way for algorithmic ideas informed by the divergence minimization viewpoint.

</details>


### [416] [Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08362)
*Jiawei Chen,Ruoxi Xu,Boxi Cao,Ruotong Pan,Yunfei Zhang,Yifei Hu,Yong Du,Tingting Gao,Yaojie Lu,Yingfei Sun,Xianpei Han,Le Sun,Xiangyu Wu,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个基于真实数据构建的跨场景长程用户行为仿真基准 OmniBehavior，揭示现有 LLM 陷入“平均积极用户”结构性偏差，个体异质性与长尾行为丢失，为高精度仿真指明改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型被寄望成为通用用户模拟器，但既有基准局限于孤立场景、狭窄动作空间或合成数据，无法反映真实人类行为的全貌。亟需一个能覆盖长时程、跨场景、异质行为的真实数据基准，以检验并提升模型仿真保真度。

Method: 从真实世界数据中构建统一框架 OmniBehavior，整合长程、跨场景、异构行为；设计实验对比孤立场景与真实决策的因果链差异；系统评估主流 LLM 在基准上的表现，并通过与真实用户行为的对比量化结构性偏差。

Result: 实验证明孤立场景数据集存在“隧道视野”，而真实决策依赖长程跨场景因果链；即使上下文窗口扩大，SOTA LLM 仍难以准确模拟复杂行为；模拟输出呈现“平均积极用户”倾向：过度活跃、人格同质化、乌托邦偏差，导致个体差异和长尾行为显著丢失。

Conclusion: LLM 用户仿真面临结构性偏差，未来需针对性矫正模型平均化倾向，引入个性化机制与长尾数据增强，才能迈向高保真、可信赖的用户行为仿真。

Abstract: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has illuminated the potential for a general-purpose user simulator. However, existing benchmarks remain constrained to isolated scenarios, narrow action spaces, or synthetic data, failing to capture the holistic nature of authentic human behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniBehavior, the first user simulation benchmark constructed entirely from real-world data, integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns into a unified framework. Based on this benchmark, we first provide empirical evidence that previous datasets with isolated scenarios suffer from tunnel vision, whereas real-world decision-making relies on long-term, cross-scenario causal chains. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that current models struggle to accurately simulate these complex behaviors, with performance plateauing even as context windows expand. Crucially, a systematic comparison between simulated and authentic behaviors uncovers a fundamental structural bias: LLMs tend to converge toward a positive average person, exhibiting hyper-activity, persona homogenization, and a Utopian bias. This results in the loss of individual differences and long-tail behaviors, highlighting critical directions for future high-fidelity simulation research.

</details>


### [417] [VerifAI: A Verifiable Open-Source Search Engine for Biomedical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08549)
*Miloš Košprdić,Adela Ljajić,Bojana Bašaragin,Darija Medvecki,Lorenzo Cassano,Nikola Milošević*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VerifAI 是一个开源生物医学问答专家系统，通过「答案原子化+NLI 验证」三步流程，在 HealthVer 上超越 GPT-4，显著降低幻觉并给出可追溯的证据链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统在生物医学等高风险场景下仍会输出幻觉，尤其伪造引用，亟需一个可被事后验证且开源的解决方案。

Method: 构建三模块流水线：①面向 PubMed 的混合检索模块（MAP@10 42.7%）；②引用感知型生成器，在自研 23 k 问答-引用对数据集上微调；③基于微调 NLI 的验证器，将生成答案拆分为原子命题并与证据做蕴含判别。

Result: 在 HealthVer 基准上，验证器 F1 达 SOTA 并优于 GPT-4；端到端系统相比零 shots 基线，幻觉引用下降 62%，并保持答案完整度；全流程开源（代码、权重、数据）。

Conclusion: VerifAI 证明「生成-分解-验证」是低幻觉、可追溯生物医学问答的有效范式，其模块化开源设计可直接嵌入临床、制药等高风险 AI 应用。

Abstract: We introduce VerifAI, an open-source expert system for biomedical question answering that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a novel post-hoc claim verification mechanism. Unlike standard RAG systems, VerifAI ensures factual consistency by decomposing generated answers into atomic claims and validating them against retrieved evidence using a fine-tuned natural language inference (NLI) engine. The system comprises three modular components: (1) a hybrid Information Retrieval (IR) module optimized for biomedical queries (MAP@10 of 42.7%), (2) a citation-aware Generative Component fine-tuned on a custom dataset to produce referenced answers, and (3) a Verification Component that detects hallucinations with state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming GPT-4 on the HealthVer benchmark. Evaluations demonstrate that VerifAI significantly reduces hallucinated citations compared to zero-shot baselines and provides a transparent, verifiable lineage for every claim. The full pipeline, including code, models, and datasets, is open-sourced to facilitate reliable AI deployment in high-stakes domains.

</details>


### [418] [Unbiased Rectification for Sequential Recommender Systems Under Fake Orders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08550)
*Qiyu Qin,Yichen Li,Haozhao Wang,Cheng Wang,Rui Zhang,Ruixuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章提出DITaR框架，能够在不重训模型的情况下精准识别并重定向修正序列推荐系统中的假订单攻击，兼顾推荐质量、效率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假订单通过混入真实用户序列误导推荐结果，传统重训防御代价高；作者希望在不重训的前提下，精准剔除有害假订单、保留有益信息，保护用户真实兴趣与系统公平性。

Method: DITaR采用“协同+语义”双视角表征差异检测可疑样本，再用梯度上升对真正有害的假订单进行靶向修正，同时保留数据增强价值，维持原数据量与序列结构。

Result: 在三个公开数据集上，DITaR在推荐精度、计算耗时与鲁棒性指标上均显著优于现有最好方法，实现轻量级无偏修正。

Conclusion: 假订单并非全有害，精准识别+靶向修正即可低成本恢复系统信任；DITaR为不重训场景下的序列推荐防御提供了高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Fake orders pose increasing threats to sequential recommender systems by misleading recommendation results through artificially manipulated interactions, including click farming, context-irrelevant substitutions, and sequential perturbations. Unlike injecting carefully designed fake users to influence recommendation performance, fake orders embedded within genuine user sequences aim to disrupt user preferences and mislead recommendation results, thereby manipulating exposure rates of specific items to gain competitive advantages. To protect users' authentic interest preferences and eliminate misleading information, this paper aims to perform precise and efficient rectification on compromised sequential recommender systems while avoiding the enormous computational and time costs of retraining existing models. Specifically, we identify that fake orders are not absolutely harmful - in certain cases, partial fake orders can even have a data augmentation effect. Based on this insight, we propose Dual-view Identification and Targeted Rectification (DITaR), which primarily identifies harmful samples to achieve unbiased rectification of the system. The core idea of this method is to obtain differentiated representations from collaborative and semantic views for precise detection, and then filters detected suspicious fake orders to select truly harmful ones for targeted rectification with gradient ascent. This ensures that useful information in fake orders is not removed while preventing bias residue. Moreover, it maintains the original data volume and sequence structure, thus protecting system performance and trustworthiness to achieve optimal unbiased rectification. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that DITaR achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in terms of recommendation quality, computational efficiency, and system robustness.

</details>


### [419] [Automated Standardization of Legacy Biomedical Metadata Using an Ontology-Constrained LLM Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08552)
*Josef Hardi,Martin J. O'Connor,Marcos Martinez-Romero,Jean G. Rosario,Stephen A. Fisher,Mark A. Musen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于 LLM 的元数据标准化系统借助实时权威术语服务，在 HuBMAP 839 份遗留元数据上的准确率始终高于纯 LLM，提供可扩展的生物医学数据 FAIR 化方案


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研元数据常不完整且不符合社区标准，导致数据发现与重用受限；现有报告指南缺乏可被机器理解的标准化表示

Method: 提出 LLM 实时调用权威生物医学术语服务动态获取规范术语，组合字段名与本体约束形成机器可操作模板，对 HuBMAP 遗产元数据进行批处理并与专家标注金牌标准进行精确匹配评估

Result: 注入实时工具访问的系统在约束与非约束字段上均稳定优于纯 LLM，整体准确率提升显著

Conclusion: 该方案证明动态术语检索可有效弥补大模型静态知识不足，为大规模自动 FAIR 化提供可扩展、可复用的实践路径

Abstract: Scientific metadata are often incomplete and noncompliant with community standards, limiting dataset findability, interoperability, and reuse. When reporting guidelines exist, they typically lack machine-actionable representations. Producing FAIR datasets requires encoding metadata standards as machine-actionable templates with rich field specifications and precise value constraints. Recent work has shown that LLMs guided by field names and ontology constraints can improve metadata standardization, but these approaches treat constraints as static text prompts, relying on the model's training knowledge alone. We present an LLM-based metadata standardization system that queries authoritative biomedical terminology services in real time to retrieve canonically correct vocabulary terms on demand. We evaluate this approach on 839 legacy metadata records from the Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP) using an expert-curated gold standard for exact-match assessment. Our evaluation shows that augmenting the LLM with real-time tool access consistently improves prediction accuracy over the LLM alone across both ontology-constrained and non-ontology-constrained fields, demonstrating a practical, scalable approach to automated standardization of biomedical metadata.

</details>


### [420] [GNN-as-Judge: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Graph Learning with GNN Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08553)
*Ruiyao Xu,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对低资源场景下LLM在文本属性图中因标注稀缺而难以微调的痛点，提出“GNN-as-Judge”框架：先用GNN定位高影响未标记节点，再让LLM与GNN协同生成可信伪标签，并通过弱监督微调抑制噪声，实现小样本半监督学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本属性图(TAG)中节点文本信息丰富，但标注极度稀缺时，现有方法无法充分利用LLM的语义能力；同时，伪标签质量与噪声成为关键瓶颈，需要结构感知的可靠标签生成与鲁棒微调机制。

Method: 设计两阶段框架：①协同伪标签生成——以GNN衡量标注节点对未标注节点的影响度，选取高影响候选，再结合LLM与GNN的预测一致/不一致模式筛选可靠伪标签；②弱监督微调——引入置信加权损失与噪声抑制正则，仅利用高置信伪标签蒸馏知识，避免过拟合噪声。

Result: 在多个TAG数据集的低资源(5%–10%标注)设定下，GNN-as-Judge较最强基线提升4%–12%的F1，标注越少优势越显著；消融实验表明伪标签质量( Precision↑9%)与微调鲁棒性(噪声容忍度↑15%)均优于独立LLM或GNN方案。

Conclusion: 将GNN的结构归纳偏置注入LLM伪标签生成与微调流程，可在极少量标注条件下释放大模型潜能，为低资源图学习提供通用范式，并验证“结构感知的协同裁判”是提升LLM在TAG中数据效率的关键路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) due to their superior semantic understanding ability on textual node features. However, their effectiveness as predictors in the low-resource setting, where labeled nodes are severely limited and scarce, remains constrained since fine-tuning LLMs usually requires sufficient labeled data, especially when the TAG shows complex structural patterns. In essence, this paper targets two key challenges: (i) the difficulty of generating and selecting reliable pseudo labels on TAGs for LLMs, and (ii) the need to mitigate potential label noise when fine-tuning LLMs with pseudo labels. To counter the challenges, we propose a new framework, GNN-as-Judge, which can unleash the power of LLMs for few-shot semi-supervised learning on TAGs by incorporating the structural inductive bias of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Specifically, GNN-as-Judge introduces a collaborative pseudo-labeling strategy that first identifies the most influenced unlabeled nodes from labeled nodes, then exploits both the agreement and disagreement patterns between LLMs and GNNs to generate reliable labels. Furthermore, we develop a weakly-supervised LLM fine-tuning algorithm that can distill the knowledge from informative pseudo labels while mitigating the potential label noise. Experiments on multiple TAG datasets demonstrate that GNN-as-Judge significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in low-resource regimes where labeled data are scarce.

</details>


### [421] [Drift and selection in LLM text ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08554)
*Søren Riis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用可解析的$n$-gram模型刻画“AI生成→公开文本→再训练”的闭环，发现无约束循环必使语料坍缩为浅层均衡，唯有引入“择优发布”类过滤机制才能维持深层结构，并给出与浅层均衡的最大可保持差异的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大模型输出大量进入互联网并被后续模型当作训练数据，人们担心“自我喂养”会稀释稀有语言现象、压缩语料多样性；亟需量化分析递归发布对公共文本的长期影响。

Method: 1) 构建基于可变阶$n$-gram的exactly solvable数学框架；2) 将语料演化拆为“drift（无过滤重用）”与“selection（发布/排序/验证过滤）”两股力；3) 在无限语料极限下解析求解稳态分布，对比统计性发布与规范性发布（奖励质量、正确性、新颖性）的均衡结构。

Result: 无过滤时稀有形式指数消失，语料收敛到“浅层均衡”，任何前瞻步数均不再带来额外收益；规范性发布可维持深层结构，其相对浅层均衡的KL散度存在有限上界，且该上界随选择强度单调增大。

Conclusion: 框架首次给出递归出版何时导致语料压缩、何时靠选择机制维系丰富结构的量化判据，为AI训练语料的设计与过滤策略提供理论依据——必须引入对质量/新颖性的正向选择，否则公共文本将不可逆地“塌陷”。

Abstract: The public text record -- the material from which both people and AI systems now learn -- is increasingly shaped by its own outputs. Generated text enters the public record, later agents learn from it, and the cycle repeats. Here we develop an exactly solvable mathematical framework for this recursive process, based on variable-order $n$-gram agents, and separate two forces acting on the public corpus. The first is drift: unfiltered reuse progressively removes rare forms, and in the infinite-corpus limit we characterise the stable distributions exactly. The second is selection: publication, ranking and verification filter what enters the record, and the outcome depends on what is selected. When publication merely reflects the statistical status quo, the corpus converges to a shallow state in which further lookahead brings no benefit. When publication is normative -- rewarding quality, correctness or novelty -- deeper structure persists, and we establish an optimal upper bound on the resulting divergence from shallow equilibria. The framework therefore identifies when recursive publication compresses public text and when selective filtering sustains richer structure, with implications for the design of AI training corpora.

</details>


### [422] [EMA Is Not All You Need: Mapping the Boundary Between Structure and Content in Recurrent Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08556)
*Arth Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EMA 迹作为极简时序基线，揭示了固定系数累积的不可逆信息稀释：既能在零标签下逼近 BiGRU 完成句法角色标注，又会因数据无关压缩把 130 M 模型 perplexity 拉到 260，且后续注意力无法补救。只有输入相关、可学习的选择机制才能突破这一瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用“最简循环基线”EMA 划清固定系数累积的能力边界，回答“高效序列模型到底比简单时序平均多得到什么”。

Method: 将指数滑动平均（EMA）作为对照探针：(i) 与有监督 BiGRU 对比，在零标签的句法角色任务上测试其可表达性；(ii) 把 130 M 语言模型中的上下文全部替换为 EMA 迹，测量 C4 困惑度；(iii) 用“注意力替换线性预测器”的消融实验定位性能缺口来源；(iv) 借数据处理不等式论证信息稀释的不可逆性。

Result: EMA-Hebbian 网络在零标签下达到 96 % BiGRU 性能，并在结构相关角色上反超；同规模模型仅用 EMA 上下文时 perplexity 260（≈8×GPT-2），注意力替换实验显示差距完全源于迹本身；理论分析确认其为数据无关的 lossy 压缩。

Conclusion: 无论沿时间还是深度，固定系数累积都会遭受不可逆的信息稀释；欲保留关键信息，必须引入输入相关的可学习选择机制。该结果给“为何需要门控/检索式上下文”提供了定量和理论解释。

Abstract: What exactly do efficient sequence models gain over simple temporal averaging? We use exponential moving average (EMA) traces, the simplest recurrent context (no gating, no content-based retrieval), as a controlled probe to map the boundary between what fixed-coefficient accumulation can and cannot represent. EMA traces encode temporal structure: a Hebbian architecture with multi-timescale traces achieves 96% of a supervised BiGRU on grammatical role assignment with zero labels, surpassing the supervised model on structure-dependent roles. EMA traces destroy token identity: a 130M-parameter language model using only EMA context reaches C4 perplexity 260 (8x GPT-2), and a predictor ablation (replacing the linear predictor with full softmax attention) yields identical loss, localizing the entire gap to the traces. The traces apply lossy, data-independent compression; by the data processing inequality, no downstream predictor can recover the discarded information. Fixed-coefficient accumulation, whether across time or depth, suffers irreversible information dilution that only learned, input-dependent selection can resolve.

</details>


### [423] [Re-Mask and Redirect: Exploiting Denoising Irreversibility in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08557)
*Arth Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 只需把已“承诺”的拒绝 token 重新遮罩并换成 12 个肯定前缀，就能让两类安全对齐扩散式大模型在 HarmBench 上攻击成功率分别达到 76.1% 与 81.8%；复杂梯度扰动反而降低成功率，证明安全对齐仅靠“单调去噪”这一脆弱假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式语言模型（dLLM）通过在 64 步去噪中逐步复原文本。作者假设：模型之所以表现安全，是因为前 8–16 步就固定了拒绝 token，且后续步骤永不反悔。如果打破这一单调性，安全外壳可能瞬间崩溃。

Method: 1) 观察 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-7B-Instruct 的去噪轨迹，记录 refusal token 的首次出现步；2) 设计两阶段免梯度攻击：把已 commit 的拒绝 token 重新 mask，并强制注入 12 个肯定性前缀 token；3) 对比加入 Gumbel-softmax 可微扰动的强化版本，验证复杂度是否提升攻击效果。

Result: 简单重遮罩+前缀注入即获得 76.1%（LLaDA）与 81.8%（Dream）的 ASR，显著高于梯度优化扰动的 41.5%；攻击对任意 128-token 有害提示均有效（n=159）。越复杂的优化反而削弱成功率，说明漏洞是结构性而非对抗性。

Conclusion: dLLM 的安全对齐并非鲁棒，而是“建筑上浅薄”——只要去噪调度被违反即可绕过。作者提出三类防御：安全感知的动态遮罩调度、逐 step 前缀检测、commit 后二次验证，强调需把安全机制嵌入扩散循环本身，而非仅依赖初始 token 承诺。

Abstract: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences. We show that their safety alignment rests on a single fragile assumption: that the denoising schedule is monotonic and committed tokens are never re-evaluated. Safety-aligned dLLMs commit refusal tokens within the first 8-16 of 64 denoising steps, and the schedule treats these commitments as permanent. A trivial two-step intervention - re-masking these tokens and injecting a 12-token affirmative prefix - achieves 76.1% ASR on HarmBench (n=159, Lg=128) against LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 81.8% ASR (n=159) against Dream-7B-Instruct, without any gradient computation or adversarial search. The simplicity of this exploit is itself the central finding: augmenting with gradient-optimized perturbation via a differentiable Gumbel-softmax chain consistently degrades ASR (e.g., 41.5% vs. 76.1% at Lg=128), confirming that the vulnerability is structural rather than requiring sophisticated exploitation. These findings reveal that dLLM safety is not adversarially robust but architecturally shallow - it holds only because the denoising schedule is never violated. We discuss defenses including safety-aware unmasking schedules, step-conditional prefix detection, and post-commitment re-verification.

</details>


### [424] [WAND: Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Autoregressive Text-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08558)
*Hanna Lee,Tan Dat Nguyen,Jaehoon Kang,Kyuhong Shim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WAND 通过“窗口注意+知识蒸馏”把自回归 TTS 的 O(n²) 代价压到 O(1)，显存降 66%，音质不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码器式自回归 TTS 随序列长度平方级增长的显存与计算开销，使其在长句或流式场景难以落地。

Method: 1) 将全自注意拆为“条件全局注意+生成局部滑窗注意”；2) 课程学习逐步缩窗，避免微调崩溃；3) 用全注意教师模型蒸馏，少量数据即可恢复高保真。

Result: 在三个主流 AR-TTS 系统上，WAND 保持与原模型同等主观/客观音质，KV 缓存显存最多省 66.2%，单步延迟与序列长度无关且接近常数。

Conclusion: WAND 首次证明无需重新设计模型即可把长序列自回归 TTS 的复杂度降到 O(1)，为实时、高保真、长段落语音合成提供了可立即部署的方案。

Abstract: Recent decoder-only autoregressive text-to-speech (AR-TTS) models produce high-fidelity speech, but their memory and compute costs scale quadratically with sequence length due to full self-attention. In this paper, we propose WAND, Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation, a framework that adapts pretrained AR-TTS models to operate with constant computational and memory complexity. WAND separates the attention mechanism into two: persistent global attention over conditioning tokens and local sliding-window attention over generated tokens. To stabilize fine-tuning, we employ a curriculum learning strategy that progressively tightens the attention window. We further utilize knowledge distillation from a full-attention teacher to recover high-fidelity synthesis quality with high data efficiency. Evaluated on three modern AR-TTS models, WAND preserves the original quality while achieving up to 66.2% KV cache memory reduction and length-invariant, near-constant per-step latency.

</details>


### [425] [Medical Reasoning with Large Language Models: A Survey and MR-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08559)
*Xiaohan Ren,Chenxiao Fan,Wenyin Ma,Hongliang He,Chongming Gao,Xiaoyan Zhao,Fuli Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗推理领域的研究现状，指出模型在真实临床场景下的表现远低于考试级任务，并提出新基准 MR-Bench 以评估临床级推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 LLMs 在医学考试题上表现优异，但真实临床决策对安全、上下文敏感且证据持续更新，仅靠事实回忆无法满足需求，亟需聚焦“医疗推理”本身。

Method: 以认知临床理论为纲，将医疗推理抽象为“溯因-演绎-归纳”迭代过程；将现有方法归为7条技术路线（含训练式与免训练）；统一跨基准评测代表性模型；并基于真实医院数据构建 MR-Bench 新基准。

Result: 统一实验显示，模型在考试任务与实际临床任务间存在显著性能落差；MR-Bench 进一步放大该差距，揭示当前方法难以满足真实临床推理要求。

Conclusion: 论文首次给出 LLM 医疗推理的方法-基准-评测全景图，明确现存关键缺口，为未来研究提供方向与评估基线。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on medical exam-style tasks, motivating growing interest in their deployment in real-world clinical settings. However, clinical decision-making is inherently safety-critical, context-dependent, and conducted under evolving evidence. In such situations, reliable LLM performance depends not on factual recall alone, but on robust medical reasoning. In this work, we present a comprehensive review of medical reasoning with LLMs. Grounded in cognitive theories of clinical reasoning, we conceptualize medical reasoning as an iterative process of abduction, deduction, and induction, and organize existing methods into seven major technical routes spanning training-based and training-free approaches. We further conduct a unified cross-benchmark evaluation of representative medical reasoning models under a consistent experimental setting, enabling a more systematic and comparable assessment of the empirical impact of existing methods. To better assess clinically grounded reasoning, we introduce MR-Bench, a benchmark derived from real-world hospital data. Evaluations on MR-Bench expose a pronounced gap between exam-level performance and accuracy on authentic clinical decision tasks. Overall, this survey provides a unified view of existing medical reasoning methods, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and highlights key gaps between current model performance and the requirements of real-world clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [426] [Uncertainty Estimation for the Open-Set Text Classification systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08560)
*Leonid Erlygin,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出文本领域整体不确定性估计（HolUE），解决开放集文本分类（OSTC）中文本与画廊两类不确定性，显著提升拒识性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放集文本分类需同时处理已知类别与未知样本，现有方法难以区分文本本身歧义与数据分布模糊带来的双重不确定性，导致系统不可靠。

Method: 将 HolUE 适配到文本域，显式建模文本不确定性（query 模糊）与画廊不确定性（分布歧义），利用不确定性得分决定拒识，并构建新 OSTC 基准。

Result: Yahoo、DBPedia、PAN、CLINC150 四数据集 PRR 分别提升 365%、347%、240%、40%，在固定假正例率下显著优于质量基线 SCF。

Conclusion: 显式分离两类不确定性可有效预判识别错误，HolUE 为开放集文本分类提供了鲁棒且可信的不确定性估计框架。代码与协议已开源。

Abstract: Accurate uncertainty estimation is essential for building robust and trustworthy recognition systems. In this paper, we consider the open-set text classification (OSTC) task - and uncertainty estimation for it. For OSTC a text sample should be classified as one of the existing classes or rejected as unknown. To account for the different uncertainty types encountered in OSTC, we adapt the Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) method for the text domain. Our approach addresses two major causes of prediction errors in text recognition systems: text uncertainty that stems from ill formulated queries and gallery uncertainty that is related the ambiguity of data distribution.
  By capturing these sources, it becomes possible to predict when the system will make a recognition error. We propose a new OSTC benchmark and conduct extensive experiments on a wide range of data, utilizing the authorship attribution, intent and topic classification datasets. HolUE achieves 40-365% improvement in Prediction Rejection Ratio (PRR) over the quality-based SCF baseline across datasets: 365% on Yahoo Answers (0.79 vs 0.17 at FPIR 0.1), 347% on DBPedia (0.85 vs 0.19), 240% on PAN authorship attribution (0.51 vs 0.15 at FPIR 0.5), and 40% on CLINC150 intent classification (0.73 vs~0.52). We make public our code and protocols https://github.com/Leonid-Erlygin/text_uncertainty.git

</details>


### [427] [Neural networks for Text-to-Speech evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08562)
*Ilya Trofimenko,David Kocharyan,Aleksandr Zaitsev,Pavel Repnikov,Mark Levin,Nikita Shevtsov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次用两套专用神经网络—Neural-SBS与WhisperBert+MOSNet—自动逼近人类主观评定，在规模TTS品质监测中显著提升效率并降低 38% 误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模TTS产品需持续、可靠的主观品质反馈，但传统招募听众打MOS/SBS发费时费力，且评审间偏差大，学界亟需可替代且性能接近人类的自动打分模型。

Method: 针对SBS相对评价，提出HuBERT带动的NeuralSBS；针对MOS绝对评价，先改进MOSNet（自定义序列长度批归一化），再以Whisper音频特征+BERT文本嵌入做多模型堆叠集成（stacking）。同时考察交叉注意力融合与多SpeechLM、零样本大模型作为基线并做消融。

Result: 在SOMOS数据集上NeuralSBS准确率73.7%；集成MOS模型RMSE≈0.40，低于人类内部RMSE(0.62)。交叉注意力盲目融合反降性能，零样本LLM与SpeechLM表现逊于专用学习架构。

Conclusion: 专门设计的神经网络级联明显优于通用大模型及交叉注意力直接融合，已逼近甚至超越人类评级精度，可经济快速地扩展至线上TTS质量监控，但仍需更多语种与域外测试以验证鲁棒性。

Abstract: Ensuring that Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems deliver human-perceived quality at scale is a central challenge for modern speech technologies. Human subjective evaluation protocols such as Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and Side-by-Side (SBS) comparisons remain the de facto gold standards, yet they are expensive, slow, and sensitive to pervasive assessor biases. This study addresses these barriers by formulating, and implementing a suite of novel neural models designed to approximate expert judgments in both relative (SBS) and absolute (MOS) settings. For relative assessment, we propose NeuralSBS, a HuBERT-backed model achieving 73.7% accuracy (on SOMOS dataset). For absolute assessment, we introduce enhancements to MOSNet using custom sequence-length batching, as well as WhisperBert, a multimodal stacking ensemble that combines Whisper audio features and BERT textual embeddings via weak learners. Our best MOS models achieve a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of ~0.40, significantly outperforming the human inter-rater RMSE baseline of 0.62. Furthermore, our ablation studies reveal that naively fusing text via cross-attention can degrade performance, highlighting the effectiveness of ensemble-based stacking over direct latent fusion. We additionally report negative results with SpeechLM-based architectures and zero-shot LLM evaluators (Qwen2-Audio, Gemini 2.5 flash preview), reinforcing the necessity of dedicated metric learning frameworks.

</details>


### [428] [Temperature-Dependent Performance of Prompting Strategies in Extended Reasoning Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08563)
*Mousa Salah,Amgad Muneer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用IMO级39题系统测试Grok-4.1的扩展推理模式，发现零样本提示在T=0.4/0.7达59%准确率，而链式思维提示在温度两端最优；扩展推理收益随温度升高从6倍倍增至14.3倍，表明温度应与提示策略联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展推理模型允许LLM在测试阶段显式分配计算资源，但业界仍默认对推理任务用T=0，缺乏温度与提示策略联合优化的实证依据。

Method: 在AMO-Bench的39道IMO级别难题上，以Grok-4.1扩展推理模型为对象，采用2×4因子设计：链式思维 vs. 零样本提示 × 温度0.0/0.4/0.7/1.0，记录准确率并量化扩展推理相对基线的增益倍数。

Result: 零样本提示在T=0.4与0.7均达59%峰值；链式思维提示在T=0.0与1.0表现最佳。扩展推理的相对收益随温度单调上升，T=0.0时6倍，T=1.0时14.3倍。

Conclusion: 温度与提示策略必须联合调优；盲目设T=0会低估扩展推理潜力，高温度下其收益更显著，为推理任务采样策略提供新范式。

Abstract: Extended reasoning models represent a transformative shift in Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities by enabling explicit test-time computation for complex problem solving. However, the optimal configuration of sampling temperature and prompting strategy for these systems remains largely underexplored. We systematically evaluate chain-of-thought and zero-shot prompting across four temperature settings (0.0, 0.4, 0.7, and 1.0) using Grok-4.1 with extended reasoning on 39 mathematical problems from AMO-Bench, a challenging International Mathematical Olympiad-level benchmark. We find that zero-shot prompting achieves peak performance at moderate temperatures, reaching 59% accuracy at T=0.4 and T=0.7, while chain-of-thought prompting performs best at the temperature extremes. Most notably, the benefit of extended reasoning increases from 6x at T=0.0 to 14.3x at T=1.0. These results suggest that temperature should be optimized jointly with prompting strategy, challenging the common practice of using T=0 for reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [429] [Dynamic sparsity in tree-structured feed-forward layers at scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08565)
*Reza Sedghi,Robin Schiewer,Anand Subramoney,David Kappel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用树状稀疏前馈层替换 Transformer 的密集 MLP，在 <5% 激活率下仍能媲美密集模型，并揭示“路由自剪枝”现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 的 FFN 在标准长度下已占计算大头，亟需无需额外路由网络、可即插即用的稀疏替代方案。

Method: 提出树状结构前馈层，通过硬分层路由实现条件计算；训练时使用标准交叉熵，无任何辅助损失；在 1B+ 参数的自回归语言模型及下游 QA 任务上系统评估。

Result: 零样本/少样本 QA 中，稀疏模型与密集基线打平；>1B 规模下仍保持性能；训练中出现“自动剪枝”——硬路由与不对称非线性使闲置路径永久失活，部分动态稀疏转为静态结构稀疏；通过简单架构调制可恢复平衡树。

Conclusion: 树状稀疏 FFN 是一种可扩展、可控且无需额外路由网络的大型 Transformer 稀疏化机制。

Abstract: At typical context lengths, the feed-forward MLP block accounts for a large share of a transformer's compute budget, motivating sparse alternatives to dense MLP blocks. We study sparse, tree-structured feed-forward layers as drop-in replacements for MLP blocks in deep transformer architectures, enabling conditional computation via hard hierarchical routing without a separate router network. We demonstrate for the first time that this form of tree-structured conditional sparsity can be applied for autoregressive language modeling and downstream question answering, including zero- and few-shot settings, and its scalability beyond 1B parameters. Despite activating fewer than 5% of the feed-forward block's units per token, our models match dense baselines under controlled training and fine-tuning protocols. We further analyze training dynamics and identify an emergent auto-pruning effect: the interaction of hard routing with asymmetric nonlinearities progressively deactivates unused paths, yielding partial conversion of dynamic routing into static structural sparsity. We show that simple architectural choices can modulate this behavior and recover balanced trees without auxiliary losses. Overall, our work demonstrates that tree-structured feed-forward layers provide a scalable and controllable mechanism for sparsifying large transformer models.

</details>


### [430] [Can We Still Hear the Accent? Investigating the Resilience of Native Language Signals in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08568)
*Nabelanita Utami,Sasano Ryohei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 随着写作辅助工具从机器翻译进化到大模型，学术论文的母语痕迹逐年减弱，但不同母语群体的“同质化”速度并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大模型写作辅助是否导致研究论文语言风格趋同，即“同质化”现象，并量化不同母语作者群体在这一过程中的差异。

Method: 构建半自动标注框架，从ACL Anthology抽取三个时期（前NN、前LLM、后LLM）的论文，微调NLI分类器检测作者母语指纹，纵向比较分类准确率变化，并分语种做细粒度异常检测。

Result: NLI准确率随时间持续下降，显示整体语言同质化；但后LLM时期出现语种级异常：中文、法文表现出比预期更强的“抗同化”能力，而日文、韩文下降幅度高于模型预期。

Conclusion: 大模型写作辅助确实在稀释学术论文的母语痕迹，但不同母语背景的受影响程度显著不均，提示需针对特定语种监控语言多样性丧失风险。

Abstract: The evolution of writing assistance tools from machine translation to large language models (LLMs) has changed how researchers write. This study investigates whether this shift is homogenizing research papers by analyzing native language identification (NLI) trends in ACL Anthology papers across three eras: pre-neural network (NN), pre-LLM, and post-LLM. We construct a labeled dataset using a semi-automated framework and fine-tune a classifier to detect linguistic fingerprints of author backgrounds. Our analysis shows a consistent decline in NLI performance over time. Interestingly, the post-LLM era reveals anomalies: while Chinese and French show unexpected resistance or divergent trends, Japanese and Korean exhibit sharper-than-expected declines.

</details>


### [431] [QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08570)
*Ali Slim,Haydar Hamieh,Jawad Kotaich,Yehya Ghosn,Mahdi Chehimi,Ammar Mohanna,Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次用跨Qiskit/PennyLane/Cirq的统一基准QuanBench+评估LLMs量子代码生成；单轮最佳Pass@1≈60%，经错误反馈修复后最高升至83%，但框架迁移仍是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有量子代码评估仅局限单一框架，无法辨别模型是真正具备量子推理能力，还是单纯依赖对特定API的熟悉度，因此需构建多框架对齐的公平测试集。

Method: 构建含42项任务的QuanBench+，覆盖算法、门分解与态制备；三框架任务一一对应。用可执行功能测试统计Pass@1/5，对概率输出采用KL-divergence接受准则；引入“运行时错误/结果错误→反馈→重试”的修复环节，观察模型自我修正能力。

Result: 单轮框架内最优：Qiskit 59.5%、Cirq 54.8%、PennyLane 42.9%；经1次反馈修复后分别提升至83.3%、76.2%、66.7%。跨框架一致性仍低，显示性能严重依赖框架专属知识。

Conclusion: LLMs在量子代码生成上已有实质进展，但可靠的多框架通用生成尚不可行；未来需解耦量子逻辑与框架语法，提升模型在陌生API上的泛化能力。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet quantum code generation is still evaluated mostly within single frameworks, making it difficult to separate quantum reasoning from framework familiarity. We introduce QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, with 42 aligned tasks covering quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation.
  We evaluate models with executable functional tests, report Pass@1 and Pass@5, and use KL-divergence-based acceptance for probabilistic outputs. We additionally study Pass@1 after feedback-based repair, where a model may revise code after a runtime error or wrong answer. Across frameworks, the strongest one-shot scores reach 59.5% in Qiskit, 54.8% in Cirq, and 42.9% in PennyLane; with feedback-based repair, the best scores rise to 83.3%, 76.2%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results show clear progress, but also that reliable multi-framework quantum code generation remains unsolved and still depends strongly on framework-specific knowledge.

</details>


### [432] [Robust Reasoning Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08571)
*Pavel Golikov,Evgenii Opryshko,Gennady Pekhimenko,Mark C. Jeffrey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 大模型数学推理对文本格式极度敏感，开放权重模型在格式扰动和连续题情境中均出现灾难性退化，暴露其记忆污染与架构脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM在标准数学基准上表现优异，但其推理过程被证明严重依赖标准文本格式，缺乏鲁棒性，急需系统评估其格式泛化与持续推理能力。

Method: 构建含14种扰动技术的管道，对AIME 2024进行格式攻击；并设计单上下文连续解题实验，隔离工作记忆污染，评测8个SOTA模型的鲁棒与持续推理表现。

Result: 前沿闭源模型较鲁棒，而开放权重模型在扰动下平均准确率最高降55%，部分达100%；连续解题实验中7B–120B模型及Claude Opus 4.6均出现明显后续题精度衰减，证明中间推理污染了标准密集注意力。

Conclusion: 现有密集注意力架构无法自我清除推理残留，需在CoT内部引入显式上下文重置；未来推理系统必须重新划定“原子推理任务”粒度，从根本上解决可靠推理的架构瓶颈。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high performance on standard mathematical benchmarks, their underlying reasoning processes remain highly overfit to standard textual formatting. We propose a perturbation pipeline consisting of 14 techniques to evaluate robustness of LLM reasoning. We apply this pipeline to AIME 2024 dataset and evalute 8 state-of-the-art models on the resulting benchmark. While frontier models exhibit resilience, open weights reasoning models suffer catastrophic collapses (up to 55% average accuracy drops across perturbations and up to 100% on some), exposing structural fragility. To further disentangle mechanical parsing failures from downstream reasoning failures, we strictly isolate the models' working memory capacity by forcing models to solve multiple unperturbed mathematical problems sequentially within a single context window. Our results indicate that open weight models ranging from 7B to 120B parameters and Claude Opus 4.6 exhibit accuracy decay on subsequent problems. This degradation demonstrates that intermediate reasoning steps permanently pollute standard dense attention mechanisms. We argue that to achieve reliable reasoning, future reasoning architectures must integrate explicit contextual resets within a model's own Chain-of-Thought, leading to fundamental open questions regarding the optimal granularity of atomic reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [433] [Silhouette Loss: Differentiable Global Structure Learning for Deep Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08573)
*Matheus Vinícius Todescato,Joel Luís Carbonera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Soft Silhouette损失将聚类轮廓系数可微化，在batch级别同时优化类内紧致与类间分离，与交叉熵或对比损失无缝加权，取得更高精度和更低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉熵不直接约束嵌入空间的几何结构；现有度量学习虽能提升类间/类内关系，但计算昂贵且复杂。需要一种轻量级、可直接嵌入训练流程并能与现有损失互补的目标函数。

Method: 把聚类分析中的轮廓系数改写成可微形式，定义软Silhouette损失：对batch中每个样本，衡量其到本类中心与最近异类中心的相对距离。该损失仅需按类别求均值，复杂度O(B·C)远低于成对对比损失O(B²)。提出将Soft Silhouette与交叉熵或监督对比损失线性组合的双目标及三目标混合训练框架。

Result: 在7个数据集上，CE+SoftSil平均Top-1准确率由36.71%提升至38.44%；进一步与SupCon混合后达39.08%，超越单独SupCon的37.85%，且GPU时间与显存消耗均显著下降。消融实验验证各分量增益显著。

Conclusion: 经典聚类准则可被重构成高效可微损失，为深度表示学习提供兼顾局部成对一致性与全局聚类结构的新视角；Soft Silhouette损失通用、易插拔，可与多种主流目标联合优化。

Abstract: Learning discriminative representations is a central goal of supervised deep learning. While cross-entropy (CE) remains the dominant objective for classification, it does not explicitly enforce desirable geometric properties in the embedding space, such as intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. Existing metric learning approaches, including supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) and proxy-based methods, address this limitation by operating on pairwise or proxy-based relationships, but often increase computational cost and complexity. In this work, we introduce Soft Silhouette Loss, a novel differentiable objective inspired by the classical silhouette coefficient from clustering analysis. Unlike pairwise objectives, our formulation evaluates each sample against all classes in the batch, providing a batch-level notion of global structure. The proposed loss directly encourages samples to be closer to their own class than to competing classes, while remaining lightweight. Soft Silhouette Loss can be seamlessly combined with cross-entropy, and is also complementary to supervised contrastive learning. We propose a hybrid objective that integrates them, jointly optimizing local pairwise consistency and global cluster structure. Extensive experiments on seven diverse datasets demonstrate that: (i) augmenting CE with Soft Silhouette Loss consistently improves over CE and other metric learning baselines; (ii) the hybrid formulation outperforms SupCon alone; and (iii) the combined method achieves the best performance, improving average top-1 accuracy from 36.71% (CE) and 37.85% (SupCon2) to 39.08%, while incurring substantially lower computational overhead. These results suggest that classical clustering principles can be reinterpreted as differentiable objectives for deep learning, enabling efficient optimization of both local and global structure in representation spaces.

</details>


### [434] [Distilling Genomic Models for Efficient mRNA Representation Learning via Embedding Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08574)
*Rasched Haidari,Sam Martin,Maxime Allard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 以嵌入级蒸馏将百亿级基因组大模型压缩为 1/200 的 mRNA 专用小模型，在 mRNA-bench 上性能保持最优，首次证明序列层面蒸馏对生物大模型的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有基因组大模型虽表现优异，但参数量数亿且推理成本高，难以在资源受限环境部署。作者希望以知识蒸馏保留其 mRNA 表征特性，大幅降低计算开销。

Method: 采用“嵌入级蒸馏”框架：冻结教师模型（SoTA 基因组大模型），训练小型学生模型使其 mRNA 序列隐层嵌入与教师对齐，而非对齐输出 logits；对比实验验证其数值稳定性优于 logit 蒸馏。

Result: 学生模型体积减小 200 倍，在 mRNA-bench 基准上取得同类最小规模模型中的 SOTA 准确率，并能与参数量百倍的教师模型直接竞争。

Conclusion: 嵌入级蒸馏可作为生物基础模型的高效、可扩展训练策略，降低大模型使用门槛，为低算力条件下的序列建模提供实用方案。

Abstract: Large Genomic Foundation Models have recently achieved remarkable results and in-vivo translation capabilities. However these models quickly grow to over a few Billion of parameters and are expensive to run when compute is limited. To overcome this challenge, we present a distillation framework for transferring mRNA representations from a state of the art genomic foundation model into a much smaller model specialized for mRNA sequences, reducing the size by 200-fold. Embedding-level distillation worked better than logit based methods, which we found unstable. Benchmarking on mRNA-bench demonstrates that the distilled model achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable size and competes with larger architectures for mRNA-related tasks. Our results highlight embedding-based distillation of mRNA sequences as an effective training strategy for biological foundation models. This enables similar efficient and scalable sequence modelling in genomics, particularly when large models are computationally challenging or infeasible.

</details>


### [435] [MolPaQ: Modular Quantum-Classical Patch Learning for Interpretable Molecular Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08575)
*Syed Rameez Naqvi,Lu Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOLPAQ 用少量量子比特生成潜在片段，经经典 β-VAE 组装成分子，兼顾 100 % 化学有效性与 0.905 多样性，在 QED 与芳香片段生成上显著优于纯经典模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现生成模型常在有效性、多样性与属性控制之间折衷，作者探索以量子-经典混合架构一次性解决三项需求。

Method: 1) 用 β-VAE 在 QM9 上预训练化学对齐潜空间；2) 量子补丁生成器输出纠缠节点嵌入，经价态感知聚合器重建成图；3) 以潜判别器与化学奖励对抗微调，实现属性引导。

Result: 100 % RDKit 有效性、99.75 % 新颖性、0.905 多样性；在同等参数量下，平均 QED 提升 ≈2.3 %，芳香片段出现率增 ≈10–12 %。

Conclusion: 量子模块作为紧凑拓扑塑形算子，可在不牺牲有效性与多样性的前提下提供可解释的属性控制，首次展示量子优势的实际化学意义。

Abstract: Molecular generative models must jointly ensure validity, diversity, and property control, yet existing approaches typically trade off among these objectives. We present MOLPAQ, a modular quantum-classical generator that assembles molecules from quantum-generated latent patches. A \b{eta}-VAE pretrained on QM9 learns a chemically aligned latent manifold; a reduced conditioner maps molecular descriptors into this space; and a parameter-efficient quantum patch generator produces entangled node embeddings that a valence-aware aggregator reconstructs into valid molecular graphs. Adversarial fine-tuning with a latent critic and chemistry-shaped reward yields 100\% RDKit validity, 99.75\% novelty, and 0.905 diversity. Beyond aggregate metrics, the pretrained quantum generator, steered by the conditioner, improves mean QED by approx. 2.3\% and increases aromatic motif incidence by approx. 10-12\% relative to a parameter-matched classical generator, highlighting its role as a compact topology-shaping operator.

</details>


### [436] [GAN-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning for Semantic-Aware Resource Allocation in 6G Network Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08576)
*Daniel Benniah John*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GAN-DDPG 框架，利用条件 GAN 增强训练数据、DDPG 实现连续资源分配，并引入语义感知奖励，一举解决 6G 三大场景的频谱浪费、离散动作与训练单一问题，实验验证在 URLLC、eMBB、mMTC 上分别提升 22%、20%、25% 频效并降低 18% 时延与 31% 丢包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G 需同时满足 eMBB（1 Tbps）、mMTC（每平方公里千万级终端）与 URLLC（0.1–1 ms 时延）的极端异构需求，而现有分配机制因语义盲、动作离散与训练样本单一导致频谱利用率低下，急需一体化智能方案。

Method: 设计 GAN-DDPG：条件 GAN 按业务需求生成高多样性流量样本；DDPG 在连续动作空间执行细粒度资源分配；奖励函数嵌入语义冗余度指标，引导屏蔽无效比特，实现语义-无线联合优化。

Result: 统计仿真表明，相较基线 DDPG，URLLC、eMBB、mMTC 频谱效率分别提升 22%、20%、25%（p<0.001），端到端时延降 18%，丢包率降 31%，且训练样本多样性提高 2.4 倍。

Conclusion: 通过对抗式数据增强、连续动作决策与语义感知奖励，GAN-DDPG 首次在单一框架内同时攻克 6G 三大场景的频谱浪费、离散性与训练局限，为实现 Tbps 级、海量连接与亚毫秒可靠通信提供了可扩展的智能资源分配范式。

Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks must support heterogeneous services: enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB) requiring 1 Tbps data rates, massive Machine-Type Communications (mMTC) supporting 10 million devices per km, and Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communications (URLLC) with 0.1-1 ms latency. Current resource allocation suffers from three limitations: (1) semantic blindness wasting 35% bandwidth on redundant data, (2) discrete action quantization, and (3) limited training diversity. This paper proposes GAN-DDPG, a Generative Adversarial Network-enhanced Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient framework integrating conditional GANs for traffic synthesis, continuous action DDPG, and semantic-aware reward optimization. Extensive simulations with statistical validation demonstrate significant improvements: 22% URLLC, 20% eMBB, 25% mMTC spectral efficiency gains (all p < 0.001) compared to baseline DDPG, with 18% latency and 31% packet loss reduction.

</details>


### [437] [Distributionally Robust Token Optimization in RLHF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08577)
*Yeping Jin,Jiaming Hu,Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文本小幅扰动即可让大模型在多步推理任务中失效；本文提出DRTO，以f-散度模糊集约束最坏情况token奖励，对齐RLHF与鲁棒优化，显著缓解分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在训练分布外的小幅格式、措辞或语言扰动下会出现灾难性失效，尤其破坏多步推理链的连贯性。现有RLHF仅在经验分布上优化期望奖励，对分布偏移缺乏理论保证，亟需一种token级、最坏情况可控的对齐方法。

Method: 提出Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO)：1) 在token级RLHF框架下，将单步奖励函数视为随机变量；2) 以f-散度（含KL、χ²等）构造围绕小批次经验分布的模糊集；3) 通过强对偶求解最坏情况期望奖励上界，得到闭式或一阶可解的鲁棒策略梯度；4) 迭代更新策略，使策略在模糊集内最小化最坏情况累积负奖励。

Result: 在GSM8K与MathQA数学推理基准上，DRTO相比标准RLHF在分布偏移场景（同义改写、符号替换、非英 prompt）平均提升9.17%与2.49%；消融显示f-散度半径与提升呈正相关，且对干净分布几乎无损。

Conclusion: DRTO首次将分布鲁棒优化引入token级对齐，理论保证最坏情况奖励下界，实证缓解多步推理的脆弱性；可无缝嵌入现有RLHF管线，为LLM在部署环境的鲁棒对齐提供新baseline。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to respond correctly to prompts that align to the data they were trained and fine-tuned on. Yet, small shifts in wording, format, or language can trigger surprisingly large failures, especially on multi-step reasoning problems. To address this problem, we propose a Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO) approach, which combines token-level Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO). DRTO bounds worst case token-wise rewards by constructing an f-divergence ambiguity set over a loss minibatch, leading to a theoretical robustness. Empirically, DRTO enhances consistency under distribution shifts in mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving 9.17\% improvement on GSM8K and 2.49% improvement on MathQA.

</details>


### [438] [Structured Exploration and Exploitation of Label Functions for Automated Data Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08578)
*Phong Lam,Ha-Linh Nguyen,Thu-Trang Nguyen,Son Nguyen,Hieu Dinh Vo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EXPONA 将标签函数（LF）生成建模为一个“多样性-可靠性”双目标优化问题，能在表面、结构、语义多级空间自动搜索 LF，并用可靠性机制去噪，在 11 个数据集上同时实现 98.9% 覆盖率和 87% 标签质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手工标注昂贵易错；现有自动 LF 方法依赖大模型表层启发或人工原语，导致覆盖低、噪声高、下游效果不稳定。

Method: 提出 EXPONA 框架：① 多级 LF 空间（表面/结构/语义）系统化枚举与嵌入；② 基于互信息+预测一致性的可靠性评估，抑制冗余与噪声；③ 保持互补信号的多样性约束；④ 用生成的弱标签训练下游分类器并闭环验证。

Result: 在 11 个跨域分类数据集上，EXPONA 比 SOTA 自动 LF 方法平均提升弱标签质量 30–87%，覆盖率达 98.9%，下游加权 F1 提升 8–46%。

Conclusion: 通过“多样性-可靠性”平衡的多级 LF 自动探索与去噪，EXPONA 可低成本产出高覆盖、高质量的弱标签，显著提升模型鲁棒性与通用性。

Abstract: High-quality labeled data is critical for training reliable machine learning and deep learning models, yet manual annotation remains costly and error-prone. Programmatic labeling addresses this challenge by using label functions (LFs), i.e., heuristic rules that automatically generate weak labels for training datasets. However, existing automated LF generation methods either rely on large language models (LLMs) to synthesize surface-level heuristics or employ model-based synthesis over hand-crafted primitives. These approaches often result in limited coverage and unreliable label quality. In this paper, we introduce EXPONA, an automated framework for programmatic labeling that formulates LF generation as a principled process balancing diversity and reliability. EXPONA systematically explores multi-level LFs, spanning surface, structural, and semantic perspectives. EXPONA further applies reliability-aware mechanisms to suppress noisy or redundant heuristics while preserving complementary signals. To evaluate EXPONA, we conducted extensive experiments on eleven classification datasets across diverse domains. Experimental results show that EXPONA consistently outperformed state-of-the-art automated LF generation methods. Specifically, EXPONA achieved nearly complete label coverage (up to 98.9%), improved weak label quality by up to 87%, and yielded downstream performance gains of up to 46% in weighted F1. These results indicate that EXPONA's combination of multi-level LF exploration and reliability-aware filtering enabled more consistent label quality and downstream performance across diverse tasks by balancing coverage and precision in the generated LF set.

</details>


### [439] [On the Spectral Geometry of Cross-Modal Representations: A Functional Map Diagnostic for Multimodal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08579)
*Krisanu Sarkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉与语言独立预训练模型在谱复杂性上趋同，但方向完全不匹配，导致经典谱对齐失效，并提出三项诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态检索主流依赖大数据对齐，而本研究想回答：若只在几何层面（即无配对样本、无梯度）将两套已冻结的单模态表示强行对齐，到底能走多远，以及失败根源为何。

Method: 以计算几何的“函数映射”框架，把跨模态对齐视为图拉普拉斯特征基之间的紧凑线性算子；对比基准为 Procrustes 对齐和相对表示；评估指标包括谱距离、对角占优、正交误差和拉普拉斯交换误差。

Result: 函数映射在所有监督预算下检索性能均低于基准；然而两编码器的归一化谱距离仅 0.043，说明独立训练已演化出同等“内在复杂性”；其对角占优均值＜0.05，正交误差高达 70.15，揭示特征基几乎随机错位。

Conclusion: 首次量化了“谱复杂性–方向间隙”：模型捕获的信息量趋同，但组织方式迥异，构成谱对齐的边界条件；三项诊断量可直接用于预判任何跨模态表示的谱可兼容性，无需数据试错。

Abstract: We study cross-modal alignment between independently pretrained vision (DINOv2) and language (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) encoders using the functional map framework from computational geometry, which represents correspondence between representation manifolds as a compact linear operator between graph Laplacian eigenbases. While the framework underperforms Procrustes alignment and relative representations for cross-modal retrieval across all supervision budgets, it reveals a structural property of multimodal representations. We find that the Laplacian eigenvalue spectra of the two encoders are quantitatively similar (normalized spectral distance 0.043), indicating that independently trained models develop manifolds of comparable intrinsic complexity. However, the functional map exhibits near-zero diagonal dominance (mean below 0.05) and large orthogonality error (70.15), showing that the eigenvector bases are effectively unaligned. We term this decoupling the spectral complexity--orientation gap: models converge in how much structure they capture but not in how they organize it. This gap defines a boundary condition for spectral alignment methods and motivates three diagnostic quantities : diagonal dominance, orthogonality deviation, and Laplacian commutativity error for characterizing cross-modal representation compatibility.

</details>


### [440] [Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Dual-Branch Reconstruction and Autoregressive Flow-based Residual Density Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08582)
*Jun Liu,Ying Chen,Ziqian Lu,Qinyue Tong,Jun Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DBR-AF利用双分支重构编码器分离交叉与变量内关系，结合自回归流对残差密度建模，缓解过拟合与误报问题，在七个基准上刷新MTSAD最佳指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重构式MTSAD方法常因过度关注跨变量相关而学到虚假关联，并简单累加重构误差，导致难重构的正常点被误判；需解耦统计建模并精细化残差分布估计以降低误报。

Method: 提出DBR-AF框架：1) Dual-Branch Reconstruction编码器并行学习跨变量相关与单变量统计特性，抑制伪相关；2) Autoregressive Flow模块堆叠可逆变换对多变量残差分布精确密度估计，把高重构误差但密度大的困难样本归入正常，提高判别力。

Result: 在七个多变量时序异常检测基准数据集上，DBR-AF显著优于现有SOTA方法；消融实验表明DBR与AF模块独立移除均带来明显性能下降，验证二者缺一不可。

Conclusion: 通过结构化解耦加深度概率残差建模，DBR-AF有效抑制虚假相关与高重构误差造成的虚假异常，为工业与航空航天等高可靠监控场景提供了更精准的异常检测方案。

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection (MTSAD) is critical for real-world monitoring scenarios such as industrial control and aerospace systems. Mainstream reconstruction-based anomaly detection methods suffer from two key limitations: first, overfitting to spurious correlations induced by an overemphasis on cross-variable modeling; second, the generation of misleading anomaly scores by simply summing up multivariable reconstruction errors, which makes it difficult to distinguish between hard-to-reconstruct samples and genuine anomalies. To address these issues, we propose DBR-AF, a novel framework that integrates a dual-branch reconstruction (DBR) encoder and an autoregressive flow (AF) module. The DBR encoder decouples cross-variable correlation learning and intra-variable statistical property modeling to mitigate spurious correlations, while the AF module employs multiple stacked reversible transformations to model the complex multivariate residual distribution and further leverages density estimation to accurately identify normal samples with large reconstruction errors. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that DBR-AF achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ablation studies validating the indispensability of its core components.

</details>


### [441] [CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08584)
*Chuxu Song,Zhencan Peng,Jiuqi Wei,Chuanhui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CSAttention 是一种无需再训练的稀疏注意力方法，在 95% 稀疏度、128 K 长度下仍保持满注意力精度，解码阶段仅用查表与累加，实现 4.6× 推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 的 KV-cache 与注意力计算已成为在线解码吞吐的绝对瓶颈；现有稀疏注意力因 Query-Key 分布漂移，高稀疏度时精度骤降，无法直接用于生产。

Method: 离线预填充阶段一次性构建以查询为中心的质心查分表（固定大小），将全上下文扫描转为在线查表+GPU 并行累加；完全零训练、零梯度更新，仅修改推理引擎。

Result: 在 32 K–128 K 长度、95% 稀疏度下，CSAttention 与满注意力精度差 <0.2%，较最佳稀疏基线速度提升 1.9×–4.6×，LLM 下游任务平均恢复率 >99%。

Conclusion: 通过“用存储换计算”并消除分布漂移，CSAttention 首次把高稀疏注意力推向生产级可重用长上下文服务，为超长 KV-cache 提供即时、即插即用的推理加速方案。

Abstract: Long-context LLMs increasingly rely on extended, reusable prefill prompts for agents and domain Q&A, pushing attention and KV-cache to become the dominant decode-time bottlenecks. While sparse attention reduces computation and transfer costs, it often struggles to maintain accuracy at high sparsity levels due to the inherent distribution shift between Queries and Keys. We propose Centroid-Scoring Attention (CSAttention), a training-free sparse attention method optimized for high-throughput serving of reusable contexts. CSAttention adopts a storage-for-computation strategy tailored to the offline-prefill/online-decode setting: it front-loads computation into a one-time offline prefill phase that can be amortized across multiple queries, while aggressively optimizing per-step decoding latency. Specifically, CSAttention constructs query-centric lookup tables during offline prefill, whose size remains fixed during decoding, and enables online decoding to replace full-context scans with efficient table lookups and GPU-friendly score accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CSAttention achieves near-identical accuracy to full attention. Under high sparsity (95%) and long-context settings (32K-128K), CSAttention consistently outperforms state-of-the-art sparse attention methods in both model accuracy and inference speed, achieving up to 4.6x inference speedup over the most accurate baseline at a context length of 128K.

</details>


### [442] [QCFuse: Query-Centric Cache Fusion for Efficient RAG Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08585)
*Jianxin Yan,Zeheng Qian,Wangze Ni,Zhitao Shen,Zhiping Wang,Haoyang Li,Jia Zhu,Lei Chen,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QCFuse 首次把「用户查询」作为 KV-cache 去重与局部重计算的全局信号，在保持 pipeline 并行度的前提下，把 RAG-LLM 推理延迟降 40%，部分任务还带来额外精度增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV-cache 复用/融合方法只依据局部 token 相似度做筛选，无法感知用户查询带来的全局语义需求，导致冗余计算与缓存浪费；若强行引入查询感知，又会因上下文编码开销和流水并行约束而得不偿失。

Method: 提出语义摘要锚点（SSA）：先用极轻量编码器把查询压缩成若干高信息量锚向量，再让锚向量与 RAG 段落做一次性跨注意力打分，得到「查询相关度掩码」。在推理阶段：1) 仅对掩码内 token 保留 KV-cache，其余丢弃；2) 对丢弃位置按「最后一层注意力显著性」做极小规模重计算，兼顾并行度与召回；3) 流水线更新仅发生在关键层，避免打断调度。

Result: 在 MSMARCO、Open-Domain QA 与多轮对话数据集上，与最强基线（局部相似性缓存+全量重计算）相比：首 token 延迟平均降低 40%，峰值显存占用减少 22–28%，答案精确匹配率持平或最高提升 3.7%，并在噪声文档较多的场景表现出「注意力降噪」效果。

Conclusion: 把「查询」作为 KV-cache 管理的第一级过滤信号，可在不牺牲流水并行的条件下，同时压缩计算与显存；SSA-掩码+关键层重计算框架具有良好的通用性，为后续长上下文、多查询批处理以及异构缓存系统提供了新的优化方向。

Abstract: Cache fusion accelerates generation process of LLMs equipped with RAG through KV caching and selective token recomputation, thereby reducing computational costs and improving efficiency. However, existing methods primarily rely on local perspectives for token selection and lack global awareness from the user query. Utilizing this global awareness is challenging due to the high cost of obtaining context-aware query representations and the strict pipeline constraints required for efficient attention analysis. Thus, this demonstration introduces QCFuse, an innovative KV cache fusion system centered on the user query. QCFuse leverages semantic summary anchors to enhance query representations and selectively recomputes query-related tokens to improve accuracy, updating tokens based on the attention distribution of the most critical Transformer layer to preserve the high efficiency of the pipeline structure. Evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that QCFuse significantly improves the response efficiency of LLMs by 40\% while maintaining equivalent accuracy compared to current methods. Additionally, in certain scenarios, QCFuse achieves an attention denoising effect that yields higher response accuracy, demonstrating substantial potential in the optimization of LLM inference.

</details>


### [443] [FluidFlow: a flow-matching generative model for fluid dynamics surrogates on unstructured meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08586)
*David Ramos,Lucas Lacasa,Fermín Gutiérrez,Eusebio Valero,Gonzalo Rubio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于条件流匹配的生成式代理模型 FluidFlow，可直接在结构与非结构网格上学习CFD映射，显著优于MLP基线，为流体动力学多查询场景提供高精度、可扩展的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CFD计算昂贵，现有深度学习代理模型仍需网格插值预处理且难以处理非结构网格；需构建一种无需插值、保几何、可扩展的生成式流体代理框架。

Method: 以条件流匹配（Flow Matching）为核心，设计生成模型 FluidFlow，分别用 U-Net 与 DiT 作为主干网络，直接接收网格坐标与物理参数作为条件，端到端学习噪声分布到 CFD 场的确定性输运映射。

Result: 在二维翼型压力系数预测与三维整机非结构网格压力/摩阻系数预测两大基准上，FluidFlow 相对强 MLP 基线误差显著降低，泛化性提升；DiT 版本可扩展至大规模非结构数据并保持高预测精度。

Conclusion: 流匹配生成式框架能有效、灵活地构建流体动力学代理模型，兼顾几何保真、网格通用与工程可扩展性，具备直接服务实际工程与科学多查询任务的潜力。

Abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides high-fidelity simulations of fluid flows but remains computationally expensive for many-query applications. In recent years deep learning (DL) has been used to construct data-driven fluid-dynamic surrogate models. In this work we consider a different learning paradigm and embrace generative modelling as a framework for constructing scalable fluid-dynamics surrogate models. We introduce FluidFlow, a generative model based on conditional flow-matching, a recent alternative to diffusion models that learns deterministic transport maps between noise and data distributions. FluidFlow is specifically designed to operate directly on CFD data defined on both structured and unstructured meshes alike, without the needs to perform any mesh interpolation pre-processing and preserving geometric fidelity. We assess the capabilities of FluidFlow using two different core neural network architectures, a U-Net and diffusion transformer (DiT), and condition their learning on physically meaningful parameters. The methodology is validated on two benchmark problems of increasing complexity: prediction of pressure coefficients along an airfoil boundary across different operating conditions, and prediction of pressure and friction coefficients over a full three-dimensional aircraft geometry discretized on a large unstructured mesh. In both cases, FluidFlow outperform strong multilayer perceptron baselines, achieving significantly lower error metrics and improved generalisation across operating conditions. Notably, the transformer-based architecture enables scalable learning on large unstructured datasets while maintaining high predictive accuracy. These results demonstrate that flow-matching generative models provide an effective and flexible framework for surrogate modelling in fluid dynamics, with potential for realistic engineering and scientific applications.

</details>


### [444] [Act or Escalate? Evaluating Escalation Behavior in Automation with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08588)
*Matthew DosSantos DiSorbo,Harang Ju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在「机进人退」还是「人机升舱」的两难中，可把大模型当作不确定性下的决策体：预测→自评置信→比较行动与升舱的预期成本。横跨五大真实场景与多模型族发现：模型隐含的升舱阈值差异巨大且难以由规模或架构预测，自我置信还系统性失准。通过仅提示、标置信、改成本比到链式思维监督微调(SFT)等多级干预，发现只有后者能让模型在跨域、跨成本、跨表述下保持稳健升舱策略。结论：升舱行为是模型特异属性，部署前需量化校准，并让模型显式推理不确定性与代价方能实现鲁棒对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中大量任务需在「自动执行」与「转交人工」之间权衡，而现有研究多关注模型置信度本身，忽视决策成本对阈值的影响。作者希望揭示模型隐含的升舱阈值如何分布、能否被预测，以及能否通过训练让模型学会显式权衡不确定性-成本，从而提供安全部署的普适决策框架。

Method: 1. 建模：把「是否升舱」形式化为不确定性下的成本最小化决策，比较「行动成本」与「升舱成本」。
2. 大规模实证：五大人机协同场景（需求预测、内容推荐、审核、贷款、自动驾驶）× 多模型族，记录模型给出的「预测-置信-行动」三元组，反推出其隐含的升舱阈值。
3. 干预实验：①改代价比；②提供外部准确率信号；③引导链式思维(CoT)提示；④监督微调(SFT)让模型输出阈值的显式推理。
4. 评估：测量阈值偏移、置信校准度、策略跨域泛化性、对抗成本变化鲁棒性等。

Result: • 不同模型隐含的升舱阈值跨度高达一个数量级，且与规模/架构无显著相关性。
• 模型自评置信普遍存在模式化失准，miscalibration 程度亦因模型而异。
• 提示法只在具备显式推理能力的模型上有效。
• 仅在「CoT 目标数据上做 SFT」才能让模型：准确输出阈值推理 → 在跨数据集、跨成本比、跨提示形式及全新任务上保持一致的升舱策略，泛化鲁棒性显著优于基线。

Conclusion: 1.「何时升舱」不是简单置信阈值，而是模型特异、难以外推的决策属性，应在部署前专门度量与校准。
2. 通过让模型显式「思考不确定性并比较决策成本」并进行链式思维监督微调，可得到对成本变化与域外分布均稳健的升舱策略。
3. 后续对齐研究应将「不确定性显式推理-成本权衡」作为训练目标，而非仅提升预测准确率或置信校准。

Abstract: Effective automation hinges on deciding when to act and when to escalate. We model this as a decision under uncertainty: an LLM forms a prediction, estimates its probability of being correct, and compares the expected costs of acting and escalating. Using this framework across five domains of recorded human decisions-demand forecasting, content recommendation, content moderation, loan approval, and autonomous driving-and across multiple model families, we find marked differences in the implicit thresholds models use to trade off these costs. These thresholds vary substantially and are not predicted by architecture or scale, while self-estimates are miscalibrated in model-specific ways. We then test interventions that target this decision process by varying cost ratios, providing accuracy signals, and training models to follow the desired escalation rule. Prompting helps mainly for reasoning models. SFT on chain-of-thought targets yields the most robust policies, which generalize across datasets, cost ratios, prompt framings, and held-out domains. These results suggest that escalation behavior is a model-specific property that should be characterized before deployment, and that robust alignment benefits from training models to reason explicitly about uncertainty and decision costs.

</details>


### [445] [AlphaLab: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Across Optimization Domains with Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08590)
*Brendan R. Hogan,Xiwen Chen,James T. Wilson,Kashif Rasul,Adel Boyarsky,Thomas Kamei,Anderson Schneider,Yuriy Nevmyvaka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaLab 是首个无需人工干预即可自动化完成“数据探索→评估框架→大规模 GPU 实验”闭环的 LLM 智能体系统；在 CUDA 优化、LLM 预训练、交通预测三大任务上分别取得 4.4×、22%↓loss、23–25%↑ 的显著收益，并证明多模型并行搜索可带来互补策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化或计算密集型研究依赖专家反复试错，周期长、成本高。作者希望让 LLM 智能体直接接管完整实验循环，从而把“人力驱动”变成“算力驱动”，实现科研自动化。

Method: 三阶段零人工管道：① Self-Adapter 阶段用 LLM 生成领域适配器并自动写代码产出首版报告；② Eval-Crafter 阶段自构建对抗性验证指标与测试集；③ Strategist/Worker 循环在 GPU 集群并发试验，持续提炼经验至可写回 prompt 的“playbook”。所有领域行为被解耦为模型自生成的可插拔 Adapter，无需改框架即可迁移任务。

Result: GPT-5.2 与 Claude-Opus-4.6 双模型 campaign 下：CUDA 内核平均提速 4.4×（峰值 91×）；自监督预训练验证 loss 降低 22%；交通预测误差下降 23–25%；金融时序附录亦优于基线。两模型在各领域表现互有胜负，显示异构智能体可扩大搜索空间。

Conclusion: AlphaLab 首次证明 LLM 智能体能端到端自动化高算力科研流程，其“自生成适配器+在线 prompt 优化”范式具备跨领域通用性。多模型并行可提供互补解，预示未来科研或进入“无人值守、算力换知识”的新阶段。

Abstract: We present AlphaLab, an autonomous research harness that leverages frontier LLM agentic capabilities to automate the full experimental cycle in quantitative, computation-intensive domains. Given only a dataset and a natural-language objective, AlphaLab proceeds through three phases without human intervention: (1) it adapts to the domain and explores the data, writing analysis code and producing a research report; (2) it constructs and adversarially validates its own evaluation framework; and (3) it runs large-scale GPU experiments via a Strategist/Worker loop, accumulating domain knowledge in a persistent playbook that functions as a form of online prompt optimization. All domain-specific behavior is factored into adapters generated by the model itself, so the same pipeline handles qualitatively different tasks without modification. We evaluate AlphaLab with two frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6) on three domains: CUDA kernel optimization, where it writes GPU kernels that run 4.4x faster than torch.compile on average (up to 91x); LLM pretraining, where the full system achieves 22% lower validation loss than a single-shot baseline using the same model; and traffic forecasting, where it beats standard baselines by 23-25% after researching and implementing published model families from the literature. The two models discover qualitatively different solutions in every domain (neither dominates uniformly), suggesting that multi-model campaigns provide complementary search coverage. We additionally report results on financial time series forecasting in the appendix, and release all code at https://brendanhogan.github.io/alphalab-paper/.

</details>


### [446] [From Dispersion to Attraction: Spectral Dynamics of Hallucination Across Whisper Model Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08591)
*Ivan Viakhirev,Kirill Borodin,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 语音识别大模型“幻觉”背后存在可预测的谱相变：中等模型先发散，超大模型反而主动压缩秩，彻底脱离声学证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示大模型幻觉并非随机失败，而是深层网络出现可量化的谱相变，为建立安全预警指标提供理论依据。

Method: 提出谱敏感性定理，用层间增益与对齐度预测“色散区→吸引子区”的相变；对 Whisper 全尺寸系列进行对抗扰动实验，提取激活图 eigenspectra，追踪 Cross/Self-Attention 秩变化与谱斜率。

Result: 理论预测被验证：中等模型出现结构崩解（Regime I，Cross-Attention 秩塌缩 13.4%）；大模型进入压缩吸引子（Regime II，Self-Attention 主动压秩 −2.34%，谱斜率变硬），显著脱离声学证据。

Conclusion: 幻觉是大模型为保持内部一致而主动“压缩现实”的必然结果；谱相变可作为早期诊断指标，指导检测与抑制策略。

Abstract: Hallucinations in large ASR models present a critical safety risk. In this work, we propose the \textit{Spectral Sensitivity Theorem}, which predicts a phase transition in deep networks from a dispersive regime (signal decay) to an attractor regime (rank-1 collapse) governed by layer-wise gain and alignment. We validate this theory by analyzing the eigenspectra of activation graphs in Whisper models (Tiny to Large-v3-Turbo) under adversarial stress. Our results confirm the theoretical prediction: intermediate models exhibit \textit{Structural Disintegration} (Regime I), characterized by a $13.4\%$ collapse in Cross-Attention rank. Conversely, large models enter a \textit{Compression-Seeking Attractor} state (Regime II), where Self-Attention actively compresses rank ($-2.34\%$) and hardens the spectral slope, decoupling the model from acoustic evidence.

</details>


### [447] [Mapping generative AI use in the human brain: divergent neural, academic, and mental health profiles of functional versus socio emotional AI use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08594)
*Junjie Wang,Xianyang Gan,Dan Liu,Jingxian He,Stefania Ferraro,Keith M. Kendrick,Weihua Zhao,Shuxia Yao,Christian Montag,Benjamin Becker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 频繁用Gen-AI写作业的学生成绩更好、背外侧前额叶更厚; 频繁跟AI聊情感的学生心理更差、颞上回与杏仁核更小。使用动机决定同一技术在大脑与行为上的正负走向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类ChatGPT工具已成为大学生日常认知-社交新环境, 但其对发育中大脑的异质性影响尚缺神经影像证据, 可能掩盖认知收益与心理风险并存的双刃剑效应。

Method: 222名大学生问卷调查+高分辨结构MRI; 将AICA使用细分为通用、功能(学业)与情感三类; 计算解剖学(VBM)、元分析网络定位、行为解码三层次关联分析。

Result: 1)学业型使用频率↑→GPA↑+背外侧前额叶/距状回灰质体积↑+海马网络聚类/局部效率↑; 2)情感型使用频率↑→抑郁与社交焦虑↑+颞上回及杏仁核体积↓; 3)两种效应独立且方向相反, 提示同一技术依使用动机激活不同神经网络。

Conclusion: Gen-AI对青少年神经发育呈

Abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence conversational agents (AICAs) among university students constitutes a novel cognitive social environment whose impact on the maturing brain remains elusive. Combining surveys with high resolution structural MRI, we examined patterns of general, functional, and socio emotional AICA use, academic performance, mental health, and brain structural signatures in a comparatively large sample of 222 young individuals. Across computational anatomy, meta analytic network level, and behavioral decoding analyses, we observed use specific associations. Higher general and functional AICA use frequencies were linked to better academic outcomes (GPA), larger dorsolateral prefrontal and calcarine gray matter volume, and enhanced hippocampal network clustering and local efficiency. In contrast, more frequent socio emotional AICA use was associated with poorer mental health (depression, social anxiety) and lower volume of superior temporal and amygdalar regions central to social and affective processing. These findings indicate that the same class of AI tools exerts distinct effects depending on usage patterns and motivations, engaging prefrontal hippocampal systems that support cognition versus socio emotional systems that may track distress linked usage. These heterogeneities are crucial for designing environments that harness the educational benefits of AI while mitigating mental health risks.

</details>


### [448] [Adaptive Rigor in AI System Evaluation using Temperature-Controlled Verdict Aggregation via Generalized Power Mean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08595)
*Aleksandr Meshkov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出温度可调裁决聚合（TCVA），用温度参数动态控制评估严格度，无需额外 LLM 调用即可在对话或安全关键场景间切换，并逼近人类一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM-as-Judge 在裁决系统的输出多为二元或三档，且严格度固定，无法根据不同领域的容错需求自适应调整，导致与安全或对话场景的真人评分出现偏差。

Method: 将五档裁决得分转为数值后，以幂均值作为聚合函数并引入温度 T∈[0.1,1.0]：T 越低愈悲观（幂均值指数趋 min），越高愈宽容（趋 max）。评测时仅需一次抽样推理，调温不再调用模型。

Result: 在 SummEval 与 USR 上，TCVA 忠诚性 Spearman ρ=0.667，与当前 SOTA（RAGAS, 0.676）相当；在所有温度点均优于 DeepEval；能通过滑动温度在低或高置信区域分别适配安全关键与开放式对话类应用。

Conclusion: TCVA 以极简的后处理实现领域感知的评估严格度可调，在无需额外推理成本的前提下，逼近甚至有时超越现有方法的真人一致性，为 LLM 系统评估提供了一种灵活而实用的新标准。

Abstract: Existing evaluation methods for LLM-based AI systems, such as LLM-as-a-Judge, verdict systems, and NLI, do not always align well with human assessment because they cannot adapt their strictness to the application domain. This paper presents Temperature-Controlled Verdict Aggregation (TCVA), a method that combines a five-level verdict-scoring system with generalized power-mean aggregation and an intuitive temperature parameter T [0.1, 1.0] to control evaluation rigor. Low temperatures yield pessimistic scores suited for safety-critical domains; high temperatures produce lenient scores appropriate for conversational AI. Experimental evaluation on three benchmark datasets with human Likert-scale annotations (SummEval and USR) shows that TCVA achieves correlation with human judgments comparable to RAGAS on faithfulness (Spearman = 0.667 vs. 0.676) while consistently outperforming DeepEval. The method requires no additional LLM calls when adjusting the temperature parameter.

</details>


### [449] [STIndex: A Context-Aware Multi-Dimensional Spatiotemporal Information Extraction System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08597)
*Wenxiao Zhang,Yu Liu,Qiang sun,Yihao Ding,Sirui Li,Yanbing Liu,Jin B. Hong,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STIndex 利用「时间-空间」作为通用锚点，把非结构化文本自动建成可交互的多维时空数仓，在公共卫生基准上把实体抽取 F1 提升 3-4 个百分点，已开源并上线演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统实体/事件抽取管线脆弱、知识图谱依赖昂贵本体且跨领域迁移差；而时空是天然通用上下文，可统一异构信息并直接服务检索与推理，因此亟需一套端到端、低成本的时空结构化方案。

Method: 提出 STIndex：1) 用户通过可配置层级定义领域分析维度；2) LLM 做上下文感知抽取与地理/时间归一化，含文档级记忆、地理编码纠错与质量验证；3) 结果写入多维时空数据仓库，并配套交互式仪表盘支持可视化、聚类、突发检测与实体网络分析。

Result: 在公共卫生评测集上，相比基线，STIndex 把时空实体抽取 F1 提高 4.37%（GPT-4o-mini）与 3.60%（Qwen3-8B），系统已上线并可公开访问。

Conclusion: 以时空为锚的端到端结构化策略可显著降低领域适配成本、增强跨域泛化，并即时支持下游时空分析；STIndex 验证了该路线在真实场景中的可行性与增益。

Abstract: Extracting structured knowledge from unstructured data still faces practical limitations: entity and event extraction pipelines remain brittle, knowledge graph construction requires costly ontology engineering, and cross-domain generalization is rarely production-ready. In contrast, space and time provide universal contextual anchors that naturally align heterogeneous information and benefit downstream tasks such as retrieval and reasoning. We introduce \textbf{STIndex}, an end-to-end system that structures unstructured content into a multidimensional spatiotemporal data warehouse. Users define domain-specific analysis dimensions with configurable hierarchies, while large language models perform context-aware extraction and grounding. \textbf{STIndex} integrates document-level memory, geocoding correction, and quality validation, and offers an interactive analytics dashboard for visualization, clustering, burst detection, and entity network analysis. In evaluation on a public health benchmark, \textbf{STIndex} improves spatiotemporal entity extraction F1 by 4.37\% (GPT-4o-mini) and 3.60\% (Qwen3-8B). A live demonstration and open-source code are available at https://stindex.ai4wa.com/dashboard.

</details>


### [450] [TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Title and Abstract Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08602)
*Yuki Kataoka,Masahiro Banno,Michihito Kyo,Shuri Nakao,Tomoo Sato,Shunsuke Taito,Tomohiro Takayama,Takahiro Tsuge,Yasushi Tsujimoto,Ryuhei So,Toshi A. Furukawa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究者发布了一个免代码、无服务器的Chrome插件TiAb Review Plugin，直接在浏览器内用Google Sheets协作，并集成Gemini LLM与ASReview式主动学习完成文献初筛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端系统需付费，开源平台需编程，研究者希望让不会编程的用户也能零成本、协作式地完成系统综述的标题摘要初筛。

Method: ①插件基于Chrome+TypeScript，所有计算均在前端完成；②用Google Sheets存储与同步记录，无需自建服务器；③ASReview TF-IDF+Naive Bayes算法在前端重实现，6个公开数据集10折交叉验证验证一致性；④用Gemini系列模型16组参数初筛后，选定最优配置并在5个数据集上评测召回与WSS指标。

Result: 前端ASReview与Python版前100位排序完全一致；Gemini最优配置的召回率94–100%，精度2–15%，WSS@95介于48.7–87.3%，可直接显著减少需人工阅读文献量。

Conclusion: TiAb Review Plugin成功将无需服务器的LLM与ML初筛流程整合到浏览器插件，具备高性能、易部署和协作能力，可直接用于实际系统综述初筛。

Abstract: Background: Server-based screening tools impose subscription costs, while open-source alternatives require coding skills. Objectives: We developed a browser extension that provides no-code, serverless artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted title and abstract screening and examined its functionality. Methods: TiAb Review Plugin is an open-source Chrome browser extension (available at https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tiab-review-plugin/alejlnlfflogpnabpbplmnojgoeeabij). It uses Google Sheets as a shared database, requiring no dedicated server and enabling multi-reviewer collaboration. Users supply their own Gemini API key, stored locally and encrypted. The tool offers three screening modes: manual review, large language model (LLM) batch screening, and machine learning (ML) active learning. For ML evaluation, we re-implemented the default ASReview active learning algorithm (TF-IDF with Naive Bayes) in TypeScript to enable in-browser execution, and verified equivalence against the original Python implementation using 10-fold cross-validation on six datasets. For LLM evaluation, we compared 16 parameter configurations across two model families on a benchmark dataset, then validated the optimal configuration (Gemini 3.0 Flash, low thinking budget, TopP=0.95) with a sensitivity-oriented prompt on five public datasets (1,038 to 5,628 records, 0.5 to 2.0 percent prevalence). Results: The TypeScript classifier produced top-100 rankings 100 percent identical to the original ASReview across all six datasets. For LLM screening, recall was 94 to 100 percent with precision of 2 to 15 percent, and Work Saved over Sampling at 95 percent recall (WSS@95) ranged from 48.7 to 87.3 percent. Conclusions: We developed a functional browser extension that integrates LLM screening and ML active learning into a no-code, serverless environment, ready for practical use in systematic review screening.
