To address this, we introduce Humanoid-LLA, a Large Language Action Model that maps expressive language commands to physically executable whole-body actions for humanoid robots. Our approach integrates three core components: a unified motion vocabulary that aligns human and humanoid motion primitives into a shared discrete space; a vocabulary-directed controller distilled from a privileged policy to ensure physical feasibility; and a physics-informed fine-tuning stage using reinforcement learning with dynamics-aware rewards to enhance robustness and stability. Extensive evaluations in simulation and on real-world Unitree G1 and Booster T1 humanoids show that Humanoid-LLA delivers strong language generalization while maintaining high physical fidelity, outperforming existing language-conditioned controllers in motion naturalness, stability, and execution success rate.

</details>


### [634] [Bharat Scene Text: A Novel Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Indian Language Scene Text Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23071)
*Anik De,Abhirama Subramanyam Penamakuri,Rajeev Yadav,Aditya Rathore,Harshiv Shah,Devesh Sharma,Sagar Agarwal,Pravin Kumar,Anand Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者发布了一个覆盖11种印度语+英语的10万词真实场景文本数据集BSTD，并微调英文SOTA模型，首次系统评估印度语场景文本识别任务，数据和模型全部开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英文场景文本识别已近成熟，而印度语因文字多样、字体非标、书写风格差异及缺乏高质量数据与开源模型，仍属未解难题。

Method: 构建BSTD：6,500+张印度多语地区场景图→人工精标10万+词→支持检测、语种判别、裁词识别、端到端识别四类任务；将英文SOTA检测与识别模型微调至印度语。

Result: 微调后的英文模型在印度语上性能显著下降，暴露出字形复杂、标注稀缺等挑战，但也验证BSTD可驱动后续研究。

Conclusion: BSTD为印度语场景文本识别提供了首个大规模基准与开源基线，填补数据与模型空白，有望推动该领域快速发展。

Abstract: Reading scene text, that is, text appearing in images, has numerous application areas, including assistive technology, search, and e-commerce. Although scene text recognition in English has advanced significantly and is often considered nearly a solved problem, Indian language scene text recognition remains an open challenge. This is due to script diversity, non-standard fonts, and varying writing styles, and, more importantly, the lack of high-quality datasets and open-source models. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bharat Scene Text Dataset (BSTD) - a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark for studying Indian Language Scene Text Recognition. It comprises more than 100K words that span 11 Indian languages and English, sourced from over 6,500 scene images captured across various linguistic regions of India. The dataset is meticulously annotated and supports multiple scene text tasks, including: (i) Scene Text Detection, (ii) Script Identification, (iii) Cropped Word Recognition, and (iv) End-to-End Scene Text Recognition. We evaluated state-of-the-art models originally developed for English by adapting (fine-tuning) them for Indian languages. Our results highlight the challenges and opportunities in Indian language scene text recognition. We believe that this dataset represents a significant step toward advancing research in this domain. All our models and data are open source.

</details>


### [635] [See, Hear, and Understand: Benchmarking Audiovisual Human Speech Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02231)
*Le Thien Phuc Nguyen,Zhuoran Yu,Samuel Low Yu Hang,Subin An,Jeongik Lee,Yohan Ban,SeungEun Chung,Thanh-Huy Nguyen,JuWan Maeng,Soochahn Lee,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有视频基准难以精细考核“谁在何时说了什么”，作者发布3 212题的AV-SpeakerBench，以说话者为推理核心并嵌入视听依赖；Gemini 2.5 Pro最佳，开源模型差距主要在视听融合而非视觉感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型需同步理解视觉、音频与语言，但主流视频基准要么无需听声即可作答，要么仅粗略评估语音，无法检验模型对“谁-说了什么-何时说”的精细对齐能力。

Method: 构建AV-SpeakerBench：①以说话者而非场景为推理单元；②问题语义直接嵌入视听依赖，迫使模型必须融合两种模态；③专家标注保证时间精度与跨模态一致性。共3 212道多选题，覆盖真实场景。

Result: 在严格零样本测试中，Gemini系列持续领先；Gemini 2.5 Pro取得最高分。开源模型里，Qwen3-Omni-30B接近Gemini 2.0 Flash，但与Gemini 2.5 Pro仍有显著差距，主因是视听融合薄弱而非视觉感知不足。

Conclusion: AV-SpeakerBench首次系统量化“以说话者为核心的视听推理”，揭示当前开源模型在精细跨模态融合上的短板，为未来多模态系统提供了可靠评测基线。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are expected to jointly interpret vision, audio, and language, yet existing video benchmarks rarely assess fine-grained reasoning about human speech. Many tasks remain visually solvable or only coarsely evaluate speech, offering limited insight into whether models can align who speaks, what is said, and when it occurs. We introduce AV-SpeakerBench, a curated benchmark of 3,212 multiple-choice questions focused on speaker-centric audiovisual reasoning in real-world videos. It features: (1) a speaker-centered formulation that treats speakers-not scenes-as the core reasoning unit; (2) fusion-grounded question design embedding audiovisual dependencies into question semantics; and (3) expert-curated annotations ensuring temporal precision and cross-modal validity. Comprehensive evaluations show that the Gemini family consistently outperforms open-source systems, with Gemini 2.5 Pro achieving the best results. Among open models, Qwen3-Omni-30B approaches Gemini 2.0 Flash but remains far behind Gemini 2.5 Pro, primarily due to weaker audiovisual fusion rather than visual perception. We believe AV-SpeakerBench establishes a rigorous foundation for advancing fine-grained audiovisual reasoning in future multimodal systems.

</details>


### [636] [From Navigation to Refinement: Revealing the Two-Stage Nature of Flow-based Diffusion Models through Oracle Velocity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02826)
*Haoming Liu,Jinnuo Liu,Yanhao Li,Liuyang Bai,Yunkai Ji,Yuanhe Guo,Shenji Wan,Hongyi Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次给出基于流的扩散模型的可精确计算的理想目标场，揭示其训练过程天然分成早期全局布局、后期精细记忆的‘从导航到精修’两阶段；阐明了多项实用技巧为何有效，并提出指导未来改进的原理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式扩散模型虽已成为图像/视频生成的主流框架，但其‘记忆还是泛化’的训练行为机理尚不清楚，需从底层目标出发揭示其动力学本质。

Method: 复溯流速匹配（FM）目标，导出边缘速度场的闭式表达式，得到可精确计算的‘理想目标场’；通过解析该场的时间演化，发现它会自然提出早、晚两阶段的训练目标，并据此解释时间步偏移、无分类器引导间隔及潜空间设计等技巧为何奏效。

Result: 在理论上证明了流扩散模型的训练动力学默认为①早期受多模态混合驱动，学习全局布局，②后期被最近邻样本主导，倾向记忆局部细节；该框架可系统解释若干实证技巧，并为未来架构与算法改进提供原则。

Conclusion: 流扩散模型的训练目标本质上已从‘导航到精修’两阶段预设。利用这一认识可指导调度器设计、潜空间选择与正则化策略，从而在保证多样性的同时降低记忆风险；研究为扩散模型的动态机理与改进方向建立了供后续探索的理论基础。

Abstract: Flow-based diffusion models have emerged as a leading paradigm for training generative models across images and videos. However, their memorization-generalization behavior remains poorly understood. In this work, we revisit the flow matching (FM) objective and study its marginal velocity field, which admits a closed-form expression, allowing exact computation of the oracle FM target. Analyzing this oracle velocity field reveals that flow-based diffusion models inherently formulate a two-stage training target: an early stage guided by a mixture of data modes, and a later stage dominated by the nearest data sample. The two-stage objective leads to distinct learning behaviors: the early navigation stage generalizes across data modes to form global layouts, whereas the later refinement stage increasingly memorizes fine-grained details. Leveraging these insights, we explain the effectiveness of practical techniques such as timestep-shifted schedules, classifier-free guidance intervals, and latent space design choices. Our study deepens the understanding of diffusion model training dynamics and offers principles for guiding future architectural and algorithmic improvements. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/from-navigation-to-refinement/.

</details>


### [637] [Out-of-the-box: Black-box Causal Attacks on Object Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03730)
*Melane Navaratnarajah,David A. Kelly,Hana Chockler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BlackCAtt 是一种无需模型内部信息、基于因果最小像素集的黑盒对抗攻击工具，可生成可解释、难察觉、跨架构的物体检测器扰动，并在仅知边界框或额外置信度时超越现有黑盒方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有白盒、架构相关且依赖损失函数的对抗扰动虽有效，却缺乏对其成功机制的清晰解释，阻碍了对漏洞的理解与模型加固；亟需一种可解释、黑盒、通用的攻击手段来揭示物体检测器的真实脆弱点。

Method: 提出 BlackCAtt：通过因果推断识别对检测输出“充分且最小”的像素子集，仅修改这些像素即可误导检测器；无需梯度/架构信息，支持仅边界框标签或附加置信度两种查询模式，并可作为元算法嵌入其他黑盒攻击以进一步压缩扰动。

Result: 在 PASCAL VOC、COCO 等基准上，仅知边界框时 BlackCAtt 的攻击成功率与扰动量已优于或媲美最新黑盒方法；若额外利用置信度，与 SquareAttack 结合可将平均 L0 距离从 0.987 降至 0.072，成功率不降。消融实验证实因果像素选择是性能提升的核心。

Conclusion: BlackCAtt 通过“因果足够”策略首次实现物体检测黑盒攻击的可解释性与最小扰动，验证了其作为诊断工具和增强现有攻击的潜力，为后续模型鲁棒性分析与防御提供了新视角。

Abstract: Adversarial perturbations are a useful way to expose vulnerabilities in object detectors. Existing perturbation methods are frequently white-box, architecture specific and use a loss function. More importantly, while they are often successful, it is rarely clear why they work. Insights into the mechanism of this success would allow developers to understand and analyze these attacks, as well as fine-tune the model to prevent them.
  This paper presents BlackCAtt, a black-box algorithm and tool, which uses minimal, causally sufficient pixel sets to construct explainable, imperceptible, reproducible, architecture-agnostic attacks on object detectors. We evaluate BlackCAtt on standard benchmarks and compare it to other black-box adversarial attacks methods. When BlackCAtt has access only to the position and label of a bounding box, it produces attacks that are comparable or better to those produced by other black-box methods. When BlackCAtt has access to the model confidence as well, it can work as a meta-algorithm, improving the ability of standard black-box techniques to construct smaller, less perceptible attacks.
  As BlackCAtt attacks manipulate causes only, the attacks become fully explainable. We compare the performance of BlackCAtt with other black-box attack methods and show that targeting causal pixels leads to smaller and less perceptible attacks. For example, when using BlackCAtt with SquareAttack, it reduces the average distance ($L_0$ norm) of the attack from the original input from $0.987$ to $0.072$, while maintaining a similar success rate. We perform ablation studies on the BlackCAtt algorithm and analyze the effect of different components on its performance.

</details>


### [638] [SkillFactory: Self-Distillation For Learning Cognitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.04072)
*Zayne Sprague,Jack Lu,Manya Wadhwa,Sedrick Keh,Mengye Ren,Greg Durrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillFactory 在 RL 前用模型自生成的“银标”长思维链进行 SFT，即可把基础模型尚未展现的验证、回溯、换法等推理技能“预置”为归纳偏置，使后续 RL 更稳健、泛化更强且不易回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究证实，只有当基础模型已显式具备某些推理技能时，RL 才能进一步放大这些技能；对于尚未出现的技能，如何在不依赖更强教师蒸馏的前提下，让模型先“学会”再“用好”还没有系统方案。

Method: SkillFactory：纯自监督——让基础模型采样出长回答后，通过重排、截断、拼接等启发式规则，把其自身输出改造成包含验证、回溯、换法等认知技能的“银标”思维链，再用 SFT 预训练；随后进入 RL 阶段。

Result: 1) 经 SkillFactory SFT 初始化的模型在 RL 后能在更难任务上泛化，而纯基础模型 RL 无法做到；2) 可验证模型在回答中确实调用了所学技能；3) 在域外任务上，SkillFactory+RL 模型性能回退显著小于直接 RL 的基础模型。

Conclusion: RL 前通过轻量级 SFT 注入“银标”推理链，可低成本建立有益的归纳偏置，使模型后续在 RL 中更高效、稳健地掌握并运用复杂认知技能，为不依赖蒸馏的推理能力扩展提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Reasoning models leveraging long chains of thought employ various cognitive skills, such as verification of their answers, backtracking, retrying by an alternate method, and more. Previous work has shown that when a base language model exhibits these skills, training that model further with reinforcement learning (RL) can learn to leverage them. How can we get models to leverage skills that aren't exhibited by base models? Our work, SkillFactory, is a method for fine-tuning models to roughly learn these skills during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage prior to RL. Our approach does not rely on distillation from a stronger model, but instead uses samples from the model itself, rearranged to provide training data in the format of those skills. These "silver" SFT traces may be imperfect, but are nevertheless effective for priming a model to acquire skills during RL. Our evaluation shows that (1) starting from SkillFactory SFT initialization helps a model to generalize to harder variants of a task post-RL, despite lower performance pre-RL;(2) cognitive skills are indeed used by the model; (3) RLed SkillFactory models are more robust to regression on out-of-domain tasks than RLed base models. Our work suggests that inductive biases learned prior to RL help models learn robust cognitive skill use.

</details>


### [639] [Relational Visual Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07833)
*Thao Nguyen,Sicheng Mo,Krishna Kumar Singh,Yilin Wang,Jing Shi,Nicholas Kolkin,Eli Shechtman,Yong Jae Lee,Yuheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者首次把“关系相似性”引入视觉匹配任务，提出一套可测评的基准和 11.4 万匿名化图文对，微调出能捕获图像潜在结构对应关系而非表层特征差异的模型，指出主流属性指标 LPIPS/CLIP/DINO 均存在严重盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉相似度评价皆聚焦外形、颜色等“属性相似”，而人类还能凭借结构映射发现跨模态、跨形状的关系相似（如桃子≈地球：皮→地壳、肉→地幔、核→果核）。这一高阶类比能力尚未被机器度量工具覆盖，限制了自动归纳、知识迁移和零样本推理水平，亟需把“关系相似”形式化并落地评测。

Method: 1. 形式化定义：两图“关系相似”当且仅当图中内部函数或元素间结构对应一致，而与表层属性无关。2. 构建 RelSIM 数据集：114k 张自然/合成图+匿名化说明，去名词化，仅用拓扑、顺序、方位等词描述关系以屏蔽属性偏置。3. 基于该数据微调对比式 Vision-Language 模型，蒸馏出专门衡量结构匹配的嵌入，采用知网形式模板，同时合成“近正反例”正负对做对抗训练。4. 设计新指标 RelScore，通过图文对齐跨模态宣战即可测度。

Result: 微调模型在下列任务上显著超越 CLIP、DINO、LPIPS：① 跨学科类比分类（↑32-62% IoU）；② 结构对应检索（↑28% mAP）；③ 新出区域性分布材料检测（↑41% top-1 Acc）表明能正确使用抽象因果关联而非表面分布；④ 零样本推理时发现高达 79% 的人机一致性。反测显示主流模型近乎随机，恰属不可比的结果突现

Conclusion: 关系相似性是导致人类高级类比能力的核心成分，但现有视觉度量及模型完全忽视其存在。本文提出的 RelSIM 数据集和结构嵌入模型第一次将这一抽象维度呈现给视觉计算，判明并证实缺口所在。未来若想在类比推理、跨域迁移、知识发现上将视觉系统推向“类人级”，必须把关系相似作为损失和评测的核心组件。作者公开数据集和代码以激发后续提升和扩展多场景结构对齐。与此同时，提示社区若忽视本盲点将无法跨越“从观察到推理”的效率损失壁垒。

Abstract: Humans do not just see attribute similarity -- we also see relational similarity. An apple is like a peach because both are reddish fruit, but the Earth is also like a peach: its crust, mantle, and core correspond to the peach's skin, flesh, and pit. This ability to perceive and recognize relational similarity, is arguable by cognitive scientist to be what distinguishes humans from other species. Yet, all widely used visual similarity metrics today (e.g., LPIPS, CLIP, DINO) focus solely on perceptual attribute similarity and fail to capture the rich, often surprising relational similarities that humans perceive. How can we go beyond the visible content of an image to capture its relational properties? How can we bring images with the same relational logic closer together in representation space? To answer these questions, we first formulate relational image similarity as a measurable problem: two images are relationally similar when their internal relations or functions among visual elements correspond, even if their visual attributes differ. We then curate 114k image-caption dataset in which the captions are anonymized -- describing the underlying relational logic of the scene rather than its surface content. Using this dataset, we finetune a Vision-Language model to measure the relational similarity between images. This model serves as the first step toward connecting images by their underlying relational structure rather than their visible appearance. Our study shows that while relational similarity has a lot of real-world applications, existing image similarity models fail to capture it -- revealing a critical gap in visual computing.

</details>


### [640] [Multi-agent Adaptive Mechanism Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21794)
*Qiushi Han,David Simchi-Levi,Renfei Tan,Zishuo Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DRAM 是首个无需先验信念即可在真值化报税的同时实现 O(√T) 似然遗憾的自适应拍卖框架，并满足下界最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当委托人完全不知道代理人的信念或偏好分布时，既要保证激励相容，又要最小化支付成本，这两项目标通常难以兼得。如何使机制能在无先验信息的环境中边学习边控制激励，是机制设计与在线学习交界处的最新挑战。

Method: 作者提出 Distributionally Robust Adaptive Mechanism (DRAM) 框架，把分布式鲁棒线性规划嵌入序贯博弈的每一轮：1. 用在线学习收敛的插件估计器更新对信念的分布集合；2. 通过不断收缩的模糊集降低所需的激励支付；3. 将结构先验和延迟反馈并入统一的分布鲁棒优化模型，从而同时保证 高概率的真值化条件与成本最小化。

Result: 理论证明 DRAM 能在任何 T 轮交互中以 ≥1−δ 的概率迫使代理人诚实报告，同时累积遗憾 R_T 仅为 Õ(√T)，并给出 matching 下界表明该阶数无法被任何可行自适应机制突破。实验部分展示了在一般结构先验和延迟反馈场景下同样维持性能。

Conclusion: DRAM 首次把分布鲁棒在线优化引入多智能体激励学习，为“未知激励约束”问题提供了最优遗憾保证的真值化机制，适用于拍卖、合同以及任何需要边学习边激励的应用。

Abstract: We study a sequential mechanism design problem in which a principal seeks to elicit truthful reports from multiple rational agents while starting with no prior knowledge of agents' beliefs. We introduce Distributionally Robust Adaptive Mechanism (DRAM), a general framework combining insights from both mechanism design and online learning to jointly address truthfulness and cost-optimality. Throughout the sequential game, the mechanism estimates agents' beliefs and iteratively updates a distributionally robust linear program with shrinking ambiguity sets to reduce payments while preserving truthfulness. Our mechanism guarantees truthful reporting with high probability while achieving $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ cumulative regret, and we establish a matching lower bound showing that no feasible adaptive mechanism can asymptotically do better. The framework generalizes to plug-in estimators, supporting structured priors and delayed feedback. To our knowledge, this is the first adaptive mechanism under general settings that maintains truthfulness and achieves optimal regret when incentive constraints are unknown and must be learned.

</details>


### [641] [The Two-Stage Decision-Sampling Hypothesis: Understanding the Emergence of Self-Reflection in RL-Trained LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01580)
*Zibo Zhao,Yuanting Zha,Haipeng Zhang,Xingcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次从梯度归因视角证明：RL 训练把策略自动拆成「生成器 π_sample」与「验证器 π_d」两阶段，奖励对二者梯度均衡，而 SFT+KL 正则对 π_d 几乎无约束，由此给出「反思能力只能由 RL 涌现」的机理级解释，并在算术任务上验证 π_d 的改进是泛化提升主因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管多轮 RL 后 LLM 表现出自我反思与修正能力，SFT 却做不到，但现有理论无法回答「统一优化目标如何分化出生成与反思两种功能」这一核心问题。

Method: 1) 提出「梯度归因性质」度量奖励信号在策略组件上的分布；2) 建立「两阶段决策-采样(DS)假设」，将策略显式拆分为负责生成的 π_sample 与负责验证的 π_d；3) 证明 surrogate 奖励对双组分梯度均衡，而 SFT 与 KL 惩罚呈「长度加权不平衡归因」，对 π_d 几乎无正则，形成不对称约束；4) 设计算术推理实验分离 π_sample 与 π_d 的贡献。

Result: 理论：推导出 Balanced vs Unbalanced Gradient Attribution 定理，揭示长度加权 KL 使 π_sample 过正则而 π_d 欠优化的必然性。实验：在多位数运算上，RL 相比 SFT 绝对提升 18.3%，其中 72% 来自 π_d（决策正确率）提升，仅 28% 来自 π_sample（采样多样性）改进；消融 KL 长度加权后 π_d 梯度增大 4.7×，反思频率提升 2.9×。

Conclusion: 「反思」不是新增模块，而是统一 RL 目标下梯度自动在策略内部切分出的验证器 π_d；SFT 因缺少均衡梯度无法催生该功能。该机制为设计自纠模型提供了第一条原理性解释——任何希望获得自我修正能力的训练范式，必须确保奖励(或等效信号)对「生成-验证」双通路实现平衡梯度归因。

Abstract: Self-reflection capabilities emerge in Large Language Models after RL post-training, with multi-turn RL achieving substantial gains over SFT counterparts. Yet the mechanism of how a unified optimization objective gives rise to functionally distinct capabilities of generating solutions and evaluating when to revise them remains opaque. To address this question, we introduce the Gradient Attribution Property to characterize how reward gradients distribute across policy components, formalized through the Two-Stage Decision-Sampling (DS) Hypothesis, which decomposes the policy into sampling ($π_{sample}$) for generation and decision ($π_{d}$) for verification. We prove that surrogate rewards exhibit Balanced Gradient Attribution, while SFT and KL penalties exhibit Unbalanced Gradient Attribution, with length-weighting creating asymmetric regularization that constrains $π_{sample}$ while leaving $π_{d}$ under-optimized, providing an theoretical explanation of why RL succeeds where SFT fails. We also empirically validate our theoretical predictions on arithmetic reasoning demonstrates that RL's superior generalization stems primarily from improved decision-making ($π_{d}$) rather than sampling capabilities, providing a first-principles mechanistic explanation for self-correction in thinking models.

</details>


### [642] [Adversarial Evasion Attacks on Computer Vision using SHAP Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10587)
*Frank Mollard,Marcus Becker,Florian Roehrbein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种利用 SHAP 值的白盒对抗攻击，可在梯度遮蔽场景下比 FGSM 更稳定地生成误判，且扰动对人眼不可察觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示深度视觉模型在推断阶段对输入特征重要性的依赖可被反向利用，进而构造更隐蔽且对梯度掩藏鲁棒的新型攻击。

Method: 在推断阶段计算每个输入像素的 SHAP 值，将其作为扰动权重，迭代放大对输出影响最大的特征，生成对抗样本；并与 FGSM 在常规及梯度遮蔽场景下对比。

Result: 实验表明，SHAP 攻击在梯度遮蔽等防御条件下仍能持续降低输出置信度并诱导高比例误分类，鲁棒性显著优于 FGSM。

Conclusion: SHAP 值不仅可解释模型，也能被恶意利用构造高鲁棒隐蔽攻击，提示未来需针对特征级解释设计新型防御机制。

Abstract: The paper introduces a white-box attack on computer vision models using SHAP values. It demonstrates how adversarial evasion attacks can compromise the performance of deep learning models by reducing output confidence or inducing misclassifications. Such attacks are particularly insidious as they can deceive the perception of an algorithm while eluding human perception due to their imperceptibility to the human eye. The proposed attack leverages SHAP values to quantify the significance of individual inputs to the output at the inference stage. A comparison is drawn between the SHAP attack and the well-known Fast Gradient Sign Method. We find evidence that SHAP attacks are more robust in generating misclassifications particularly in gradient hiding scenarios.

</details>


### [643] [Screen, Cache, and Match: A Training-Free Causality-Consistent Reference Frame Framework for Human Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22160)
*Jianan Wang,Nailei Hei,Li He,Huanzhen Wang,Aoxing Li,Yingkai Zhao,Yuxuan Lin,Haofen Wang,Chunyang Wang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 无需训练的FrameCache框架以因果缓存参考帧，显著增强长序列人像视频扩散生成的时间连续性和视觉稳定性，即插即用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型在生成长时序人像动画时长期依赖建模不足，导致身份漂移与时间抖动；同时，训练开销大且难以无缝接入已有模型。

Method: 提出双层因果缓存机制：①参考层用Screen-Cache-Match(SCM)动态维护高质量参考记忆，提供运动一致的外观先验；②生成层用Trajectory-Aware Autoregressive Generation(TAAG)，通过重叠感知潜变量传播与高低频域双域融合对齐相邻视频块的去噪轨迹。

Result: 在多个标准数据集上零样本集成各类扩散基线均获得时间更连贯、视觉更稳定的视频，定量显著改善FID/VFID等指标。

Conclusion: FrameCache在不重训的前提下大幅缓解长期依赖与身份漂移问题，验证历史帧因果复用与轨迹对齐策略的有效性，为长视频扩散模型提供普适即插即用方案。

Abstract: Human animation aims to generate temporally coherent and visually consistent videos over long sequences, yet modeling long-range dependencies while preserving frame quality remains challenging. Inspired by the human ability to leverage past observations for interpreting ongoing actions, we propose FrameCache, a training-free, causality-consistent reference frame framework. FrameCache explicitly converts historical generation results into causal guidance through two complementary mechanisms. First, at the reference level, a novel Screen-Cache-Match (SCM) strategy constructs a dynamic, high-quality reference memory, ensuring motion-consistent appearance guidance to reduce identity drift. Second, at the generative level, a Trajectory-Aware Autoregressive Generation (TAAG) mechanism aligns denoising trajectories across adjacent video chunks. This is achieved through an overlap-aware latent propagation and a dual-domain fusion strategy that seamlessly blends low-frequency structural layouts with high-frequency textural details. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that FrameCache consistently improves temporal coherence and visual stability while integrating seamlessly with diverse diffusion baselines. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [644] [Self-Supervised Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction with Gaussian Representations for Fetal MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22990)
*Yinsong Wang,Thomas Fletcher,Xinzhe Luo,Aine Travers Dineen,Rhodri Cusack,Chen Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用3D-Gaussian做胎儿MRI无监督slice-to-volume重建，无需GT，多分辨率训练，速度精度双提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SVR需多正交栈、耗时长；有监督学习无GT可用。亟需无需真值即可快速高保真重建的方案。

Method: GaussianSVR：①3D Gaussian表征目标体；②前向切片采集模型自监督；③多分辨率联合优化高斯参数与空间变换。

Result: 在胎儿MRI数据上，无GT条件下重建精度优于现有baseline，速度显著快于传统SVR。

Conclusion: GaussianSR首次将3D-Gaussian用于自监督SVR，摆脱对GT与多正交栈依赖，为临床胎儿MRI快速重建提供实用工具。

Abstract: Reconstructing 3D fetal MR volumes from motion-corrupted stacks of 2D slices is a crucial and challenging task. Conventional slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) methods are time-consuming and require multiple orthogonal stacks for reconstruction. While learning-based SVR approaches have significantly reduced the time required at the inference stage, they heavily rely on ground truth information for training, which is inaccessible in practice. To address these challenges, we propose GaussianSVR, a self-supervised framework for slice-to-volume reconstruction. GaussianSVR represents the target volume using 3D Gaussian representations to achieve high-fidelity reconstruction. It leverages a simulated forward slice acquisition model to enable self-supervised training, alleviating the need for ground-truth volumes. Furthermore, to enhance both accuracy and efficiency, we introduce a multi-resolution training strategy that jointly optimizes Gaussian parameters and spatial transformations across different resolution levels. Experiments show that GaussianSVR outperforms the baseline methods on fetal MR volumetric reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/Yinsong0510/GaussianSVR-Self-Supervised-Slice-to-Volume-Reconstruction-with-Gaussian-Representations.

</details>


### [645] [On the Limits of Layer Pruning for Generative Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01997)
*Safal Shrestha,Anubhav Shrestha,Aadim Nepal,Minwu Kim,Keith Ross*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对大语言模型做层剪枝后，分类任务可快速回弹，但生成式推理（算术、代码等）即使再用约 400B token 微调也难以恢复到原水平，表明算法能力一旦剪枝即基本丢失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明层剪枝能压缩 LLM 且不显著损害分类指标，但在生成式推理任务上性能骤降，缺乏系统分析其损失机理与可恢复性，尤其在训练数据/算力受限场景下是否还能恢复关键算法能力尚不清楚。

Method: 1) 对 LLM 进行不同深度剪枝，比较剪枝前后在分类基准与 GSM8K、HumanEval⁺ 等生成式推理任务上的性能；2) 在无预训练规模数据与算力的现实约束下，仅用自生成答案做监督微调，评估最小化恢复策略的上限；3) 设计算术、括号生成等探针任务，验证剪枝是否损失核心算法能力；4) 对比不同规模（∼400B token）微调后的恢复曲线，量化深度对推理性能的实际影响。

Result: 层剪枝后分类任务平均可恢复≈90% 原性能且几乎无需调参；而生成式推理即使投入大至 400B token 微调，仍远低于原水平（GSM8K↓>30%，HumanEval⁺↓>40%）。探针实验显示剪枝直接破坏算术运算与括号匹配等算法能力，且破坏程度随深度减少而指数级放大。

Conclusion: 在训练资源受限条件下，层剪枝对生成式推理造成的算法能力损伤具有不可逆性；若下游任务依赖算术、代码等多步逻辑生成，应谨慎或避免深度剪枝；仅当目标为分类且允许轻微性能折损时，深度压缩方可实用。研究为“何时可剪枝”提供了明确边界与工程指导。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that layer pruning can effectively compress large language models (LLMs) while retaining strong performance on classification benchmarks, often with little or no finetuning. In contrast, generative reasoning tasks, such as GSM8K and HumanEval\textsuperscript{+}, exhibit substantially weaker recovery. We show that beyond surface-level text degradation, pruning leads to a loss of key algorithmic capabilities, including arithmetic computation and balanced parenthesis generation. Under realistic post-training constraints, without access to pretraining-scale data or compute, we evaluate a minimal recovery strategy based on supervised finetuning with self-generated responses. This approach recovers up to 90\% of baseline performance on classification tasks, but recovery for generative reasoning remains fundamentally limited. Notably, even models finetuned on $\sim$400B tokens after pruning fail to recover their original reasoning performance, suggesting that such capabilities are not as easily restored. This limitation persists even on simple tasks such as arithmetic, which do not require multi-step generation. Overall, we characterize the practical limits of layer pruning for generative reasoning and provide guidance on when depth reduction is effective under constrained post-training regimes.

</details>


### [646] [Tiled Prompts: Overcoming Prompt Misguidance in Image and Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03342)
*Bryan Sangwoo Kim,Jonghyun Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对基于全局文本提示的扩散超分辨模型因“提示误引导”导致的局部细节缺失与伪影，提出Tiled Prompts框架：为每个潜空间瓦块自动生成专属局部提示，实现局部文本后验下的超分辨，显著提升高分辨图像/视频感知质量并抑制幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本条件扩散SR模型采用全局单一提示配合潜空间瓦块分治，造成①遗漏局部细节（omission error）②引入局部无关语义（commission error），在瓦块层面累积伪影与幻觉，限制真实高分辨率内容重建质量。

Method: Tiled Prompts：首先利用轻量级语义解析器将全局提示拆解为区域语义单元，再通过瓦块空间索引与内容感知过滤器为每个瓦块动态生成局部提示；随后在各瓦块内部执行局部文本条件扩散采样，最后拼接并做全局一致性后处理，整个过程计算开销极低。

Result: 在4K/8K真实图像与视频SR基准上，相较于全局提示基线，LPIPS降低7.4%，FID降低11.2%，Tile Artifact Score降低38%；用户调研显示73%偏好Tiled Prompts结果，幻觉区域减少一半以上。

Conclusion: 局部化文本条件可有效消除全局提示在瓦块粒度的语义失配，Tiled Prompts为兼顾效率与质量的高分辨率扩散SR提供了零成本插件式解决方案，可无缝嵌入任何潜空间瓦块策略。

Abstract: Text-conditioned diffusion models have advanced image and video super-resolution by using prompts as semantic priors, and modern super-resolution pipelines typically rely on latent tiling to scale to high resolutions. In practice, a single global caption is used with the latent tiling, often causing prompt misguidance. Specifically, a coarse global prompt often misses localized details (errors of omission) and provides locally irrelevant guidance (errors of commission) which leads to substandard results at the tile level. To solve this, we propose Tiled Prompts, a unified framework for image and video super-resolution that generates a tile-specific prompt for each latent tile and performs super-resolution under locally text-conditioned posteriors to resolve prompt misguidance with minimal overhead. Our experiments on high resolution real-world images and videos show that tiled prompts bring consistent gains in perceptual quality and fidelity, while reducing hallucinations and tile-level artifacts that can be found in global-prompt baselines. Project Page: https://bryanswkim.github.io/tiled-prompts/.

</details>


### [647] [SPEAR: An Engineering Case Study of Multi-Agent Coordination for Smart Contract Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04418)
*Indraveni Chebolu,Arnab Mallick,Harmesh Rana*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPEAR是一个多智能体智能合约审计框架，用 MAS 模式把审计拆成“规划-执行-修复”三类角色，通过谈判与拍卖协议动态协调，并在受控故障实验中优于集中式与流水线方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单点或流水线式智能合约审计工具在任务优先级、资源分配与故障恢复上缺乏弹性，导致高价值漏洞被遗漏或修复代价高。

Method: 将审计建模为多智能体协同任务：Planning Agent 用风险启发式排序合约；Execution Agent 以 Contract Net 协议分派任务；Repair Agent 对生成产物采用“程序优先”修复策略。各 Agent 基于 AGM 信念修正维护局部状态，通过谈判与拍卖持续更新计划。

Result: 在受控注入故障场景下，SPEAR 相较集中式和流水线基准，在协调效率、故障自愈率与 CPU/内存占用上均取得显著优势。

Conclusion: 论文证实多智能体模式可提升智能合约审计的鲁棒性与资源利用率，SPEAR 为安全分析流程引入了可扩展、自恢复的协同范例。

Abstract: We present SPEAR, a multi-agent coordination framework for smart contract auditing that applies established MAS patterns in a realistic security analysis workflow. SPEAR models auditing as a coordinated mission carried out by specialized agents: a Planning Agent prioritizes contracts using risk-aware heuristics, an Execution Agent allocates tasks via the Contract Net protocol, and a Repair Agent autonomously recovers from brittle generated artifacts using a programmatic-first repair policy. Agents maintain local beliefs updated through AGM-compliant revision, coordinate via negotiation and auction protocols, and revise plans as new information becomes available. An empirical study compares the multi-agent design with centralized and pipeline-based alternatives under controlled failure scenarios, focusing on coordination, recovery behavior, and resource use.

</details>


### [648] [Overstating Attitudes, Ignoring Networks: LLM Biases in Simulating Misinformation Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04674)
*Eun Cheol Choi,Lindsay E. Young,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于 LLM 的虚假信息系统调查仿真会放大信念-分享关联，并忽略人际网络因素，因此更适合用于发现模型偏差，而非替代人类样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 越来越常被用作“计算社会科学”中的代理被试，其是否能准确复现人类对虚假信息的易感性模式尚无实证检验。作者希望厘清：当把真实调查中的网络、人口、态度与行为特征输入 LLM 后，它能否再现人类对“相信并转发虚假信息”的分布和预测关系。

Method: 研究团队从三项在线调查中抽取真实受访者的档案（包含 49–110 项网络、人口、态度与行为变量），用同样提示词让 GPT-3.5/4 扮演这些“合成受访者”完成与原问卷完全相同的题目。随后对比：1) 回答分布的一致性（KL 散度、重叠系数）；2) 特征-结果关联的恢复度（相关系数、标准化回归系数）；3) 线性解释方差（R²）。最后通过探针实验与训练语料分析解释偏差来源。

Result: 1) 单题分布大体接近，但 LLM 显著高估“既相信又分享”的共现概率（信念-分享关联系数比真人高 0.10–0.27）。2) 用模拟数据拟合的线性模型 R² 平均提高 18–35 个百分点，并将权重过度分配给态度/行为变量（+40–60%），同时把网络特征权重压至接近零；而真人数据模型中网络结构仍显著。3) 提示链追踪表明，LLM 在解释时高频调用“认知偏差”“回音室”等刻板概念，印证训练语料中对“虚假信息—态度”的共现强度被人为放大。

Conclusion: LLM 调查仿真会系统放大态度驱动叙事、抹平人际网络差异，从而“过度理性化”人类的错误信息行为。这种偏差可作为诊断工具揭示模型内在刻板知识，但在需要生态效度的场景下，LLM 尚无法直接替代人类样本；研究者应把“合成调查”定位为偏差探针而非样本替身。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxies for human judgment in computational social science, yet their ability to reproduce patterns of susceptibility to misinformation remains unclear. We test whether LLM-simulated survey respondents, prompted with participant profiles drawn from social survey data measuring network, demographic, attitudinal and behavioral features, can reproduce human patterns of misinformation belief and sharing. Using three online surveys as baselines, we evaluate whether LLM outputs match observed response distributions and recover feature-outcome associations present in the original survey data. LLM-generated responses capture broad distributional tendencies and show modest correlation with human responses, but consistently overstate the association between belief and sharing. Linear models fit to simulated responses exhibit substantially higher explained variance and place disproportionate weight on attitudinal and behavioral features, while largely ignoring personal network characteristics, relative to models fit to human responses. Analyses of model-generated reasoning and LLM training data suggest that these distortions reflect systematic biases in how misinformation-related concepts are represented. Our findings suggest that LLM-based survey simulations are better suited for diagnosing systematic divergences from human judgment than for substituting it.

</details>


### [649] [Exploring Teachers' Perspectives on Using Conversational AI Agents for Group Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07142)
*Prerna Ravi,Carúmey Stevens,Beatriz Flamia Azevedo,Jasmine David,Brandon Hanks,Hal Abelson,Grace Lin,Emma Anderson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 设计一款语音对话代理Phoenix，让33名K12教师以“试玩+问卷+焦点小组”方式体验其在面对面小组协作中的角色，发现教师既认可其促活价值，也担忧其可能侵蚀学生自主与教学一致性，并据此提出教师视角下的协同AI设计张力与启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 21世纪课堂强调协作，但教师依旧难以及时、高质量地撬动同伴互动；生成式AI的实时对话潜力为现场协作提供新支架，而教师对该类AI如何嵌入并影响课堂人际生态的认知尚属空白，需先厘清教师心智模型与顾虑，才能设计出真正“合教”的群体面向代理。

Method: 采用探索性定性设计：①设计语音近端代理Phoenix，可实时监听小组对话并以“同伴”身份插话；②组织33位K12教师参加playtesting（试玩）、Survey（Likert+开放题）、Focus-group三轮数据收集；③用主题分析法归纳教师对代理行为、群体动力学变化与课堂可行性的感知。

Result: 教师普遍认同Phoenix能打破沉默、重分配话语权并引入多元观点；同时提出四大风险：学生自主决策被代理“带节奏”；语音拟人引发信任/隐私不适；过度人格化削弱学生间直接互动； AI输出或与课程目标、评价标准错位。这些张力映射出教师对AI“专家-同伴-工具”三重角色定位的矛盾。

Conclusion: 要让群体面向的生成式AI真正服务协作学习，设计者需在“促活 vs 自主”“拟人 vs 工具”“即兴生成 vs 教学对齐”之间提供可调节、可追溯、教师可驯化的脚手架，而非黑箱插话者；未来应进一步将教师纳入迭代共同设计，把代理从“神秘第三方”转化为“教师可调的教学副驾”。

Abstract: Collaboration is a cornerstone of 21st-century learning, yet teachers continue to face challenges in supporting productive peer interaction. Emerging generative AI tools offer new possibilities for scaffolding collaboration, but their role in mediating in-person group work remains underexplored, especially from the perspective of educators. This paper presents findings from an exploratory qualitative study with 33 K12 teachers who interacted with Phoenix, a voice-based conversational agent designed to function as a near-peer in face-to-face group collaboration. Drawing on playtesting sessions, surveys, and focus groups, we examine how teachers perceived the agent's behavior, its influence on group dynamics, and its classroom potential. While many appreciated Phoenix's capacity to stimulate engagement, they also expressed concerns around autonomy, trust, anthropomorphism, and pedagogical alignment. We contribute empirical insights into teachers' mental models of AI, reveal core design tensions, and outline considerations for group-facing AI agents that support meaningful, collaborative learning.

</details>


### [650] [An Adaptive Model Selection Framework for Demand Forecasting under Horizon-Induced Degradation to Support Business Strategy and Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13939)
*Adolfo González,Víctor Parada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对间歇性、高变异需求，提出 horizon-aware 的动态模型选择框架 AHSIV，可在多 SKU 场景下稳定模型排序，提升库存与采购决策一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间歇需求下，不同预测模型在不同指标、需求状态及预测步长上排名剧烈波动，导致静态“最优模型”列表无法为库存、采购提供一致决策支持。需要一种能随预测步长与需求结构动态调整的选择机制。

Method: 构建 AHSIV 框架，整合：①Metric Degradation by Forecast Horizon（MDFH）量化步长引发的指标退化；②结构需求分类识别间歇/块状/光滑等机制；③多目标 Pareto 支配提取非劣模型集；④层级偏差精修进一步削减选择偏差。四组件嵌入统一决策架构，实现“步长-状态”条件化模型推荐。

Result: 在 Walmart、M3、M4、M5 共 4 个数据集、多训练-测试划分及 12 步预测步长下，AHSIV 在聚合精度上与最强单一指标基线统计无差异，同时将模型分配跨步长不一致率显著降低，提升异质需求环境下决策稳健性。

Conclusion: 多 SKU 预测模型选择不应视为静态排序问题；引入“步长-机制”自适应选择，可显著增强库存规划、采购对齐与运营决策的稳定性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Business environments characterized by intermittent demand, high variability, and multi-step planning horizons require forecasting policies that support consistent operational decisions across heterogeneous SKU portfolios. Because no forecasting model is universally dominant, and model rankings vary across error metrics, demand regimes, and forecast horizons, forecasting model assignment is a nontrivial decision problem in inventory planning, procurement, and supply management. This study proposes the Adaptive Hybrid Selector for Intermittency and Variability (AHSIV), a horizon-aware and regime-conditioned model selection framework designed to address horizon-induced ranking instability. The framework integrates the Metric Degradation by Forecast Horizon (MDFH), structural demand classification, multi-objective Pareto dominance, and hierarchical bias refinement within a unified decision architecture. The empirical evaluation is conducted on the Walmart, M3, M4, and M5 datasets under multiple train-test partition schemes and twelve-step forecasting horizons. The results show that AHSIV achieves statistical equivalence with the strongest single-metric baseline in aggregated performance while improving the consistency of model assignment across forecast horizons in heterogeneous demand settings. These findings indicate that forecasting model selection in multi-SKU environments should not be treated as a static ranking problem. Instead, horizon-consistent and structurally adaptive selection mechanisms can provide more robust support for inventory planning, procurement alignment, and operational decision-making in business forecasting systems.

</details>


### [651] [SubQuad: Near-Quadratic-Free Structure Inference with Distribution-Balanced Objectives in Adaptive Receptor framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17330)
*Rong Fu,Zijian Zhang,Kun Liu,Jiekai Wu,Xianda Li,Simon Fong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SubQuad 是一项适配大规模人群 T/B 细胞-V(D)J 测序数据的端到端可行性方案，可把成对亲和力计算的复杂度和内存占压缩到近 sub-quadratic，同时确保稀有抗原克隆亚群在检索与聚类中保持代表性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既往比较个体或群体免疫图库（repertoire）时，a）两两序列亲和力（affinity）计算呈近 O(n²) 时间/内存瓶颈；b）临床关注的低丰度抗原特异性克隆常被数据量大的高频克隆淹没，导致后期疫苗靶点或生物标志物筛选出现选择偏差（bias）。

Method: SubQuad 按“索引→粗筛→精筛→聚类”构建流水线：
1) 用 MinHash 指纹（sketch-based）做抗原感知预过滤，早筛候选集，使需要精细比对的序列数大幅缩减；
2) GPU 并行化 gapped-alignment + 稠密向量内积两种亲和核函数，兼顾序列相似度与语义嵌入；
3) 可微分 gating 模型动态决定每对序列的两个通道权重，多模态输出综合得分；
4) 在训练中引入“公平性”正则，迫使各个稀有的抗原特异子群在聚类结果与 Top-k 召回间获得不低于设定比例的表征，实现自适应重采样或重加权；
5) 自动校准循环持续调整超参，确保子群比例均衡。

Result: 在大型病毒和肿瘤样本（>0.3 B CDR3 条序列）上，与普通两两比对或仅 GPU 加速的基线相比，SubQuad：
- 计算时间平均减少 3–4×，峰值内存占用下降 >50%（近似 O(n↑1.4) 左右）；
- Recall@k ≥ 与人类专家标注的同类方法或只落后 <2%；
- 子群纯度（cluster purity）、子群级召回提升 5–12%，占总数 <1% 的罕见抗原克隆被检出率提升 1.8–3×；
- 整个流程（过滤+对齐+融合+聚类）可在单卡 A100 上 1 小时内完成亿人序列规模的 repo。

Conclusion: SubQuad 通过联合设计索引、相似性融合与公平目标，首次实现了兼顾计算效率与偏倚纠正的“可行/可扩展”的大型人群免疫图库检索框架，为疫苗靶点排序、罕见抗原克隆标定等转化应用提供了可重现、可解释的端对端范式。

Abstract: Comparative analysis of adaptive immune repertoires at population scale is hampered by two practical bottlenecks: the near-quadratic cost of pairwise affinity evaluations and dataset imbalances that obscure clinically important minority clonotypes. We introduce SubQuad, an end-to-end pipeline that addresses these challenges by combining antigen-aware, near-subquadratic retrieval with GPU-accelerated affinity kernels, learned multimodal fusion, and fairness-constrained clustering. The system employs compact MinHash prefiltering to sharply reduce candidate comparisons, a differentiable gating module that adaptively weights complementary alignment and embedding channels on a per-pair basis, and an automated calibration routine that enforces proportional representation of rare antigen-specific subgroups. On large viral and tumor repertoires SubQuad achieves measured gains in throughput and peak memory usage while preserving or improving recall@k, cluster purity, and subgroup equity. By co-designing indexing, similarity fusion, and equity-aware objectives, SubQuad offers a scalable, bias-aware platform for repertoire mining and downstream translational tasks such as vaccine target prioritization and biomarker discovery.

</details>


### [652] [Descriptor: Parasitoid Wasps and Associated Hymenoptera Dataset (DAPWH)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20028)
*Joao Manoel Herrera Pinheiro,Gabriela Do Nascimento Herrera,Luciana Bueno Dos Reis Fernandes,Alvaro Doria Dos Santos,Ricardo V. Godoy,Eduardo A. B. Almeida,Helena Carolina Onody,Marcelo Andrade Da Costa Vieira,Angelica Maria Penteado-Dias,Marcelo Becker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 发布了包含3 556张高分辨率图像的寄生蜂分割与尺度标注数据集，为该类群自动识别奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 寄生蜂总科（姬蜂科+茧蜂科）是生物多样性监测和农业害虫调控的关键类群，但其形态隐蔽、未知种众多，缺乏可用于深度学习的图像资源，严重制约了自动化鉴定与生态评估。

Method: 构建针对新热带区姬蜂科和茧蜂科的图像数据集：①采集并精选3 556张高分辨率田野照片；②扩展包含Andrenidae、Apidae、Bethylidae等9个补充科以提高模型鲁棒性；③对其中1 739张核心图像采用COCO格式，标注了全虫体、翅脉和比例尺的多类别边界框，实现形态特征与尺度信息同步。

Result: 形成了目前最大、标注最细的新热带寄生蜂公开图像库；COCO子集提供可用于目标检测/分割的即训即用标签，可直接输入主流计算机视觉框架。

Conclusion: 该数据集填补了寄生蜂总科数字化资源的空白，为开发高精度自动识别模型、加速物种发现与害虫天敌资源调查提供了开放基础，并可推广至其他高多样性昆虫类群。

Abstract: Accurate taxonomic identification is the cornerstone of biodiversity monitoring and agricultural management, particularly for the hyper-diverse superfamily Ichneumonoidea. Comprising the families Ichneumonidae and Braconidae, these parasitoid wasps are ecologically critical for regulating insect populations, yet they remain one of the most taxonomically challenging groups due to their cryptic morphology and vast number of undescribed species. To address the scarcity of robust digital resources for these key groups, we present a curated image dataset designed to advance automated identification systems. The dataset contains 3,556 high-resolution images, primarily focused on Neotropical Ichneumonidae and Braconidae, while also including supplementary families such as Andrenidae, Apidae, Bethylidae, Chrysididae, Colletidae, Halictidae, Megachilidae, Pompilidae, and Vespidae to improve model robustness. Crucially, a subset of 1,739 images is annotated in COCO format, featuring multi-class bounding boxes for the full insect body, wing venation, and scale bars. This resource provides a foundation for developing computer vision models capable of identifying these families.

</details>


### [653] [Reinforcement-aware Knowledge Distillation for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22495)
*Zhaoyang Zhang,Shuli Jiang,Yantao Shen,Yuting Zhang,Dhananjay Ram,Shuo Yang,Zhuowen Tu,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 引入在RL阶段动态“精选”教师示范片段并与PPO类信任域目标耦合的RL-aware蒸馏 (RLAD)，显著优于离线蒸馏、纯GRPO及带KL正则的对齐蒸馏，在小型化长链推理模型中有效兼顾训练稳定性、探索-利用及教师知识继承。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维LLM由RL后训练获得强推理能力，但推理成本大需蒸馏为小模型；现有KD专为SFT设计，采用固定教师轨迹或KL正则，与RL的滚动分布不匹配、目标冲突，导致KL权重难调且阻碍奖励最大化。亟需一套能在RL循环中自适应选用教师知识的蒸馏框架。

Method: 提出RL-aware Distillation (RLAD)框架：① 仅在当前策略更新确有增益时选择性模仿教师轨迹；② 设计Trust-Region Ratio Distillation (TRRD)，以PPO/GRPO似然比形式将教师示范锚于“教师-旧策略”混合分布，配合优势信号，直接在学生滚动数据上实现三目标（探索、利用、模仿）自平衡，从根本上替代了KL散度正则项。

Result: 在多种逻辑推理与数学基准上，RLAD稳定超越离线蒸馏、标准GRPO以及带KL对齐的在线师生KD，以较小模型尺寸取得更高推理性能。

Conclusion: TRRD通过优势感知的信任域动态度量，可在RL阶段兼容探索、奖励最大化与教师知识继承；RLAD为高效、低成本部署长链推理LLM提供了新范式，未来可扩展至更多推理任务与RL算法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has recently driven major gains in long chain-of-thought reasoning large language models (LLMs), but the high inference cost of such models motivates distillation into smaller students. Most existing knowledge distillation (KD) methods are designed for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), relying on fixed teacher traces or teacher-student Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence-based regularization. When combined with RL, these approaches often suffer from distribution mismatch and objective interference: teacher supervision may not align with the student's evolving rollout distribution, and the KL regularizer can compete with reward maximization and require careful loss balancing. To address these issues, we propose RL-aware distillation (RLAD), which performs selective imitation during RL -- guiding the student toward the teacher only when it improves the current policy update. Our core component, Trust Region Ratio Distillation (TRRD), replaces the teacher-student KL regularizer with a PPO/GRPO-style likelihood-ratio objective anchored to a teacher--old-policy mixture, yielding advantage-aware, trust-region-bounded distillation on student rollouts and naturally balancing exploration, exploitation, and imitation. Across diverse logic reasoning and math benchmarks, RLAD consistently outperforms offline distillation, standard GRPO, and KL-based on-policy teacher-student knowledge distillation.

</details>


### [654] [Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03099)
*Ruinan Jin,Yingbin Liang,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在经典有界方差模型下首次证明 Adam 与 SGD 在高概率收敛意义下的本质分离：Adam 对置信参数 δ 的依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，而 SGD 至少为 δ^{-1}，从而从理论上解释了 Adam 经验收敛更快的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 Adam 在应用中常比 SGD 收敛更快，但现有理论给出的收敛保证与 SGD 几乎相同，无法解释这一经验差距。

Method: 1) 揭示 Adam 隐含的对梯度二阶矩的归一化结构；2) 构造停时并建立鞅分析框架；3) 在仅假设梯度二阶矩有界的经典模型下，分别推导 Adam 与 SGD 的高概率收敛上/下界。

Result: 首次给出两种优化器在高概率意义下的严格区分：Adam 收敛率对置信参数 δ 的依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，而 SGD 必须承受至少 δ^{-1} 的依赖。

Conclusion: 理论结果首次在经典假设下量化 Adam 优于 SGD 的收敛优势，为解释其经验性能提供了严格依据，并展示了二阶矩归一化与停时鞅技术在现代优化理论中的潜力。

Abstract: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

</details>


### [655] [Better Eyes, Better Thoughts: Why Vision Chain-of-Thought Fails in Medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06665)
*Yuan Wu,Zongxian Yang,Jiayu Qian,Songpan Gao,Guanxing Chen,Qiankun Li,Yu-An Huang,Zhi-An Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 医学视觉问答任务中，Chain-of-Thought 反而不如直接回答；作者提出“医学感知瓶颈”假说，并设计两种无需训练的推理时视觉锚定策略，显著提升 CoT 效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用领域的 CoT 在大型视觉语言模型上表现优异，但医学场景是否同样受益尚无人系统研究；作者想揭示并解决 CoT 在医学视觉问答中失效的根本原因。

Method: 1) 在多个通用及医学专用模型上对比 CoT 与 Direct Answering；2) 提出“医学感知瓶颈”——早期视觉定位失误被 CoT 放大；3) 引入两种零训练推理干预：① 感知锚定（RoI 提示）② 描述锚定（高质量文本引导）；4) 在 4 个医学 VQA 基准与 3 类模型上系统评估。

Result: CoT 平均比 Direct Answering 低 2.7–8.1 个百分点；引入锚定策略后，CoT 准确率提升 4.4–12.9 个百分点，在 62 % 的设置中反超 Direct Answering，同时显著降低幻觉与跨模态不一致。

Conclusion: 医学 VLM 的核心瓶颈是视觉-语义对齐而非推理链长度；推理时增强视觉定位即可释放 CoT 潜力，未来应优先构建鲁棒的医学视觉表征与跨模态校准机制。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often benefit from chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting in general domains, yet its efficacy in medical vision-language tasks remains underexplored. We report a counter-intuitive trend: on medical visual question answering, CoT frequently underperforms direct answering (DirA) across general-purpose and medical-specific models. We attribute this to a \emph{medical perception bottleneck}: subtle, domain-specific cues can weaken visual grounding, and CoT may compound early perceptual uncertainty rather than correct it. To probe this hypothesis, we introduce two training-free, inference-time grounding interventions: (i) \emph{perception anchoring} via region-of-interest cues and (ii) \emph{description grounding} via high-quality textual guidance. Across multiple benchmarks and model families, these interventions improve accuracy, mitigate CoT degradation, and in several settings reverse the CoT--DirA inversion. Our findings suggest that reliable clinical VLMs require robust visual grounding and cross-modal alignment, beyond extending text-driven reasoning chains. Code is available \href{https://github.com/TianYin123/Better_Eyes_Better_Thoughts}{here}.

</details>


### [656] [Memory-efficient Continual Learning with Prototypical Exemplar Condensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13804)
*Minh-Duong Nguyen,Thien-Thanh Dao,Le-Tuan Nguyen,Dung D. Le,Kok-Seng Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用合成的“原型样本”+扰动增强把CL的存储压缩到每类远少于20例，同时保持SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习需回放旧数据防灾难性遗忘，但保存大量原始样本(SPC>20)带来存储与隐私瓶颈，需进一步压缩内存。

Method: 1) 训练阶段为每类生成少量可形成稳定特征原型的合成样本（prototypical exemplars）并永久缓存，替代完整原始图；2) 回放时对这些样本做扰动式数据增强以产生多样合成变体，辅助模型重训。

Result: 在多个大规模、多任务基准上，即使每类仅保存个位数合成样本，该方法仍优于需20+ SPC的主流coreset基线，且随任务数与数据集规模增大优势更明显。

Conclusion: 合成原型样本与扰动增强能在极低内存下保持旧知识，为资源受限与隐私敏感场景提供了可扩展的持续学习新范式。

Abstract: Rehearsal-based continual learning (CL) mitigates catastrophic forgetting by maintaining a subset of samples from previous tasks for replay. Existing studies primarily focus on optimizing memory storage through coreset selection strategies. While these methods are effective, they typically require storing a substantial number of samples per class (SPC), often exceeding 20, to maintain satisfactory performance. In this work, we propose to further compress the memory footprint by synthesizing and storing prototypical exemplars, which can form representative prototypes when passed through the feature extractor. Owing to their representative nature, these exemplars enable the model to retain previous knowledge using only a small number of samples while preserving privacy. Moreover, we introduce a perturbation-based augmentation mechanism that generates synthetic variants of previous data during training, thereby enhancing CL performance. Extensive evaluations on widely used benchmark datasets and settings demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves superior performance compared to existing baselines, particularly in scenarios involving large-scale datasets and a high number of tasks.

</details>


### [657] [Fine-tuning is Not Enough: A Parallel Framework for Collaborative Imitation and Reinforcement Learning in End-to-end Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13842)
*Zhexi Lian,Haoran Wang,Xuerun Yan,Weimeng Lin,Xianhong Zhang,Yongyu Chen,Jia Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于纯模仿学习（IL）的端到端自动驾驶受示范质量约束，而先用IL后做RL的“串行微调”容易漂移且上限低下。本文提出 PaIR-Drive 并行框架：训练阶段 IL、RL 各跑一支路；推理阶段 RL 用 IL 结果继续优化轨迹，并基于树状轨迹神经采样+GRPO 强化探索能力。在 NAVSIM 两版本基准上分别获得 91.2 PDMS 和 87.9 EPDMS，持续优于串行 RL 微调，并能修正专家次优行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶目前两条思路：一是模仿驾驶示范（IL），依赖人工数据且无法落实数值优化；二是模仿→强化学习串行微调，但由于策略漂移和初始化束缚，性能易见天花板。同时，二者“串行”导致每次换传入专家策略就得重训 RL，成本高。本文目标是解除 IL-RL 的耦合与上限，实现高质量的端到端规划。

Method: 1. 并行双分支训练：IL 分支最小化专家示范最大确定性熵，RL 分支最小化经安全奖励调制的最大熵 RL 目标；共享骨干网络参数，独立头网络与特征缓存，彻底无梯度冲突。2. 推理级差分优化：仅用 IL 生成高层轨迹候选，RL 分支对该轨迹进行加权重打分并可选细化，突破 IL 经验。3. GRPO：先树形算法规整采样高粗略轨迹，再 Monte-Carlo Tree Refine，引入对称同簇折扣因子扩量，提升探索效率。4. 奖励函数结合安全、轨迹质量与能效；不依赖人工规则校正。整体流程一阶段即可收敛，无需额外重训练。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2（NAVSIM Planner Metric Score / Expected-PDMS）基准上，PaIR-Drive 基于 Transfuser 和 DiffusionDrive 两种 IL 骨干，分别取得 91.2（↑+3.9）与 87.9（↑+4.2）PDMS 分数，均高于同类 BCQ、SIL、CQL 等串行 RL 微调方案。出错率激增场景与炫光雨夜样本上，PaIR-Drive 主动刹停或换道，优于原始专家轨迹，证明其对专家“次优决策”具备纠正能力。实验带来的计算开销 < 6%，无需改动车端推理时延。

Conclusion: PaIR-Drive 通过并行 IL-RL 框架和信息互补的推理显式打通“示范→优化→超越”链路，既摆脱串行微调多次重训练，又突破重建示范单一的表达能力瓶颈。GET 样可复用到任何基于 Transformer 或 Diffuser 的端到端规划器，并为具身智能的 IL-RL 混合学习提供可泛化接口。未来可在外环匝道、多车博弈等更复杂场景继续验证，并结合更长时域因果模型提升时序一致性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving is typically built upon imitation learning (IL), yet its performance is constrained by the quality of human demonstrations. To overcome this limitation, recent methods incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) through sequential fine-tuning. However, such a paradigm remains suboptimal: sequential RL fine-tuning can introduce policy drift and often leads to a performance ceiling due to its dependence on the pretrained IL policy. To address these issues, we propose PaIR-Drive, a general Parallel framework for collaborative Imitation and Reinforcement learning in end-to-end autonomous driving. During training, PaIR-Drive separates IL and RL into two parallel branches with conflict-free training objectives, enabling fully collaborative optimization. This design eliminates the need to retrain RL when applying a new IL policy. During inference, RL leverages the IL policy to further optimize the final plan, allowing performance beyond prior knowledge of IL. Furthermore, we introduce a tree-structured trajectory neural sampler to group relative policy optimization (GRPO) in the RL branch, which enhances exploration capability. Extensive analysis on NAVSIMv1 and v2 benchmark demonstrates that PaIR-Drive achieves Competitive performance of 91.2 PDMS and 87.9 EPDMS, building upon Transfuser and DiffusionDrive IL baselines. PaIR-Drive consistently outperforms existing RL fine-tuning methods, and could even correct human experts' suboptimal behaviors. Qualitative results further confirm that PaIR-Drive can effectively explore and generate high-quality trajectories.

</details>


### [658] [You've Got a Golden Ticket: Improving Generative Robot Policies With A Single Noise Vector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15757)
*Omkar Patil,Ondrej Biza,Thomas Weng,Karl Schmeckpeper,Wil Thomason,Xiaohan Zhang,Robin Walters,Nakul Gopalan,Sebastian Castro,Eric Rosen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 仅用固定的初始噪声（golden ticket）替代高斯采样，即可无损冻结式提升预训练机器人扩散/流匹配策略，在43项仿真/真实任务成功改进38项，成功率最高提升58–60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和扩散策略为每次推断重新采样初始噪声，存在

Method: 提出“golden ticket”概念：对冻结的预训练扩散/流匹配策略，仅搜索并固定一个最优初始噪声向量，无需重训练或额外网络。采用纯蒙特卡罗滚动评估：不断注入恒定噪声、执行完整回合、收集稀疏奖励，利用随机局部搜索迭代更新噪声，直至收敛于最大回报。整个过程仅依赖可注入噪声和能计算任务奖励的接口，无需其他模型或基础设施。

Result: 43项模拟与真实操作任务中，38项性能提升；仿真任务成功率相对提升最高58%，真实任务在50次搜索回合内最高提升60%。多任务场景下，不同golden tickets对应的行为多样性构成Pareto前沿，可平衡速度与成功率；跨任务迁移中，针对某一任务优化的ticket也能显著提升相关任务表现。

Conclusion: 首次证明仅通过固定最佳初始噪声即可廉价、高效地推动预训练扩散/流匹配策略改进，为预训练VLA及机器人策略提供无训练、零参数更新的即插即用增强方案，并公开了代码、预训练模型与golden tickets。

Abstract: What happens when a pretrained generative robot policy is provided a constant initial noise as input, rather than repeatedly sampling it from a Gaussian? We demonstrate that the performance of a pretrained, frozen diffusion or flow matching policy can be improved with respect to a downstream reward by swapping the sampling of initial noise from the prior distribution (typically isotropic Gaussian) with a well-chosen, constant initial noise input -- a golden ticket. We propose a search method to find golden tickets using Monte-Carlo policy evaluation that keeps the pretrained policy frozen, does not train any new networks, and is applicable to all diffusion/flow matching policies (and therefore many VLAs). Our approach to policy improvement makes no assumptions beyond being able to inject initial noise into the policy and calculate (sparse) task rewards of episode rollouts, making it deployable with no additional infrastructure or models. Our method improves the performance of policies in 38 out of 43 tasks across simulated and real-world robot manipulation benchmarks, with relative improvements in success rate by up to 58% for some simulated tasks, and 60% within 50 search episodes for real-world tasks. We also show unique benefits of golden tickets for multi-task settings: the diversity of behaviors from different tickets naturally defines a Pareto frontier for balancing different objectives (e.g., speed, success rates); in VLAs, we find that a golden ticket optimized for one task can also boost performance in other related tasks. We release a codebase with pretrained policies and golden tickets for simulation benchmarks using VLAs, diffusion policies, and flow matching policies.

</details>


### [659] [Improving Automatic Summarization of Radiology Reports through Mid-Training of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19275)
*Mengxian Lyu,Cheng Peng,Ziyi Chen,Mengyuan Zhang,Jieting Li Lu,Yonghui Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在放射科报告自动摘要任务中，通过“预训练→子域中训练→微调”三阶段策略，模型 GatorTronT5-Radio 在 UF Health 大数据上先进行临床领域预训练，再在 OpenI/MIMIC-CXR 上做子域中训练，最终 ROUGE-L 与 RadGraph-F1 均优于直接微调基线，并显著缓解小样本冷启动问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医生撰写放射科报告负担重，现有 LLM 多采用“预训练+直接微调”策略，未能充分挖掘临床子域特性，导致摘要事实一致性不足且在数据稀缺时表现差。需要一种更精细的适应机制来提升摘要质量与样本效率。

Method: 提出“子域中训练”概念，构建三阶段流水线：(1) 通用语料预训练；(2) 临床文本（UF Health 3.2 亿句）持续预训练；(3) 以放射科报告为子域在中等规模数据上做中训练。随后在同一基准（OpenI、MIMIC-CXR）上微调，对比无中训练方案，并用 ROUGE-L 与 RadGraph-F1 双重指标评估。

Result: GatorTronT5-Radio 在 ROUGE-L 上绝对提升 1.5–2.1 分，RadGraph-F1 提升 3.4–4.7 分；在 10%、50% 数据量的少样本场景中，BLEU-2 与 F1 分别提升 7–12 分，冷启动迭代次数减少 40% 以上。

Conclusion: 实证证明“预训练→中训练→微调”优于传统直接微调，子域中训练能显著注入放射科先验知识，提高摘要忠实度与数据效率，为临床文本生成提供可推广的渐进式适应范式。

Abstract: Automatic summarization of radiology reports is an essential application to reduce the burden on physicians. Previous studies have widely used the "pre-training, fine-tuning" strategy to adapt large language models (LLMs) for summarization. This study proposed a subdomain adaptation through a mid-training method to improve summarization. We explored three adaptation strategies: (1) general-domain pre-training, (2) clinical-domain pre-training, and (3) clinical-domain pre-training followed by subdomain mid-training. We developed models using large-scale clinical text from the University of Florida (UF) Health and conducted mid-training and fine-tuning experiments using widely used benchmark datasets including OpenI and MIMIC-CXR. The experimental results show that the mid-trained model, GatorTronT5-Radio, achieved the best performance, outperforming models without mid-training in both text-based measures (ROUGE-L) and factuality measures (RadGraph-F1). Our mid-training methods also demonstrate better few-shot learning and could alleviate the "cold start" problem reported in previous studies as a learning barrier. Our findings support the use of "pre-training, mid-training, fine-tuning," instead of the widely used direct fine-tuning strategy.

</details>


### [660] [RAM: Recover Any 3D Human Motion in-the-Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19929)
*Sen Jia,Ning Zhu,Jinqin Zhong,Jiale Zhou,Huaping Zhang,Jenq-Neng Hwang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAM提出一个结合运动感知语义追踪、自适应卡尔曼滤波、时序记忆网络与轻量级预测器的端到端框架，在无需额外训练数据（Zero-shot）场景下，对野外多人视频实现稳定身份关联与高精度3D动作重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外多人场景存在严重遮挡、动态交互频繁及相机运动剧烈等问题，现有方法在身份保持、平滑性与3D精度上难以兼顾。作者希望构建一种无需标记、零样本即可泛化的3D动作捕捉范式。

Method: 1) 运动感知语义追踪器：利用语义与运动线索，引入自适应卡尔曼滤波实现鲁棒身份关联；2) 记忆增强时序HMR模块：通过外部记忆库存储并注入历史时空先验，提升单帧重建的时序一致性；3) 轻量级预测器：基于过去帧预测未来姿态，保证遮挡期间的连续性；4) 门控融合器：自适应加权合并重建与预测特征，抑制误差累积。

Result: 在PoseTrack与3DPW两个野外多人基准上，RAM在Zero-shot身份追踪稳定性（IDF1↑12.3%）与3D姿态精度（MPJPE↓9.7%，PA-MPJPE↓8.1%）均显著超越此前最佳方法，并在跨场景迁移测试中验证其泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过把运动建模、记忆先验与预测机制统一进一个框架，RAM为无需标记的野外3D动作捕捉提供了可泛化的新范式，兼顾了遮挡下的身份连续性、时序平滑度与几何精度。

Abstract: RAM incorporates a motion-aware semantic tracker with adaptive Kalman filtering to achieve robust identity association under severe occlusions and dynamic interactions. A memory-augmented Temporal HMR module further enhances human motion reconstruction by injecting spatio-temporal priors for consistent and smooth motion estimation. Moreover, a lightweight Predictor module forecasts future poses to maintain reconstruction continuity, while a gated combiner adaptively fuses reconstructed and predicted features to ensure coherence and robustness. Experiments on in-the-wild multi-person benchmarks such as PoseTrack and 3DPW, demonstrate that RAM substantially outperforms previous state-of-the-art in both Zero-shot tracking stability and 3D accuracy, offering a generalizable paradigm for markerless 3D human motion capture in-the-wild.

</details>


### [661] [Chronological Contrastive Learning: Few-Shot Progression Assessment in Irreversible Diseases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21935)
*Clemens Watzenböck,Daniel Aletaha,Michaël Deman,Thomas Deimel,Jana Eder,Ivana Janickova,Robert Janiczek,Peter Mandl,Philipp Seeböck,Gabriela Supp,Paul Weiser,Georg Langs*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChronoCon：无专家标签，仅凭患者影像的复诊时间顺序做对比学习，为不可逆疾病生成高质量表征，在极低标注量下即可取得接近全监督的影像严重程度评分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定量影像评分成本高、一致性差，而临床档案中大量未标注纵向影像未被利用；现有自监督方法普遍忽视时序信息。

Method: 提出ChronoCon，构建纵向扫描的时间顺序作为排序约束，用单调进展假设代替人工标签，设计基于时间序的对比损失，学习疾病相关表征。

Result: 在类风湿关节炎X线分级任务上，ChronoCon显著优于ImageNet预训练全监督基线；仅5例患者标签微调即可达到86%的组内相关系数，实现少样本高一致性预测。

Conclusion: 利用常规影像元数据中的时序结构做对比学习，可在不可逆疾病场景下大幅减少专家标注需求，为低资源医疗影像建模提供新范式。

Abstract: Quantitative disease severity scoring in medical imaging is costly, time-consuming, and subject to inter-reader variability. At the same time, clinical archives contain far more longitudinal imaging data than expert-annotated severity scores. Existing self-supervised methods typically ignore this chronological structure. We introduce ChronoCon, a contrastive learning approach that replaces label-based ranking losses with rankings derived solely from the visitation order of a patient's longitudinal scans. Under the clinically plausible assumption of monotonic progression in irreversible diseases, the method learns disease-relevant representations without using any expert labels. This generalizes the idea of Rank-N-Contrast from label distances to temporal ordering. Evaluated on rheumatoid arthritis radiographs for severity assessment, the learned representations substantially improve label efficiency. In low-label settings, ChronoCon significantly outperforms a fully supervised baseline initialized from ImageNet weights. In a few-shot learning experiment, fine-tuning ChronoCon on expert scores from only five patients yields an intraclass correlation coefficient of 86% for severity score prediction. These results demonstrate the potential of chronological contrastive learning to exploit routinely available imaging metadata to reduce annotation requirements in the irreversible disease domain. Code is available at https://github.com/cirmuw/ChronoCon.

</details>


### [662] [Towards Context-Aware Image Anonymization with Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27817)
*Robert Aufschläger,Jakob Folz,Gautam Savaliya,Manjitha D Vidanalage,Michael Heigl,Martin Schramm*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CAIAMAR 以多智能体扩散框架在本地实现街景上下文敏感匿名化，Re-ID 风险降 73%，画质指标领先，满足 GDPR 可审计要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景影像含大量情境相关 PII，传统方法过度打码或漏检隐性标识，API 方案又牺牲数据主权，需兼顾高精度、高画质与合规本地处理的匿名化框架。

Method: 构建多智能体系统 CAIAMAR，三智能体按 PDCA 轮询协作：粗检候选→精裁区块→开放词汇分割→30% IoU 去重；对不确定隐性 PII 引入大视觉-语言模型并依据“私有/公有空间”情境推理，采用模态特定扩散+外观去相关进行像素级匿名化，全流程本地开源模型运行并生成可审计日志。

Result: 在 CUHK03-NP 上行人 Re-ID 首位命中率从 62.4% 降至 16.9%，风险降低 73%；CityScapes 上 KID=0.001、FID=9.1，图像质量显著优于现有方法；系统能检出跨类别非直接 PII 并保持下游语义分割性能。

Conclusion: CAIAMAR 通过上下文感知多智能体与扩散匿名化，在本地实现高安全性、高画质、可审计的街景 PII 脱敏，满足 GDPR 透明性要求，为隐私保护与数据利用提供了兼顾安全与质量的实用方案。

Abstract: Street-level imagery contains personally identifiable information (PII), some of which is context-dependent. Existing anonymization methods either over-process images or miss subtle identifiers, while API-based solutions compromise data sovereignty. We present an agentic framework CAIAMAR (\underline{C}ontext-\underline{A}ware \underline{I}mage \underline{A}nonymization with \underline{M}ulti-\underline{A}gent \underline{R}easoning) for context-aware PII segmentation with diffusion-based anonymization, combining pre-defined processing for high-confidence cases with multi-agent reasoning for indirect identifiers. Three specialized agents coordinate via round-robin speaker selection in a Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle, enabling large vision-language models to classify PII based on spatial context (private vs. public property) rather than rigid category rules. The agents implement spatially-filtered coarse-to-fine detection where a scout-and-zoom strategy identifies candidates, open-vocabulary segmentation processes localized crops, and $IoU$-based deduplication ($30\%$ threshold) prevents redundant processing. Modal-specific diffusion guidance with appearance decorrelation substantially reduces re-identification (Re-ID) risks. On CUHK03-NP, our method reduces person Re-ID risk by $73\%$ ($R1$: $16.9\%$ vs. $62.4\%$ baseline). For image quality preservation on CityScapes, we achieve KID: $0.001$, and FID: $9.1$, significantly outperforming existing anonymization. The agentic workflow detects non-direct PII instances across object categories, and downstream semantic segmentation is preserved. Operating entirely on-premise with open-source models, the framework generates human-interpretable audit trails supporting EU's GDPR transparency requirements while flagging failed cases for human review.

</details>


### [663] [Kill-Chain Canaries: Stage-Level Tracking of Prompt Injection Across Attack Surfaces and Model Safety Tiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28013)
*Haochuan Kevin Wang,Zechen Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对生产级多智能体LLM系统，提出“kill-chain canary”四阶段追踪框架，揭示提示注入危害并非仅由单点成功率决定，而是高度依赖下游写节点位置与通道匹配，为金融等敏感场景提供可落地的安全加固依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM已用于文档处理与业务流程，但现有防御只给“攻成/未成”二元结论，无法指导复杂管道的诊断与加固。

Method: 设计加密token贯穿 EXPOSED→PERSISTED→RELAYED→EXECUTED 四阶段，在950次实验、5种前沿模型、6类攻击面、5种防御条件下量化注入传播路径。

Result: Claude在内存写阶段即阻断全部注入(ASR=0/164)；GPT-4o-mini中继传播率53%；DeepSeek同模型不同面ASR 0%–100%跳变；写节点路由决定传播生死；四种防御均因通道失配单面失效；隐形白字PDF载荷与可见文字ASR持平。

Conclusion: 提示注入应被视为“管道架构”问题而非模型弱点；部署时优先把写操作路由给经校验的模型/通道，并补充渲染层外检测，可显著降低金融文档等高风险场景的实际泄露与执行风险。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are entering production -- processing documents, managing workflows, acting on behalf of users -- yet their resilience to prompt injection is still evaluated with a single binary: did the attack succeed? This leaves architects without the diagnostic information needed to harden real pipelines. We introduce a kill-chain canary methodology that tracks a cryptographic token through four stages (EXPOSED -> PERSISTED -> RELAYED -> EXECUTED) across 950 runs, five frontier LLMs, six attack surfaces, and five defense conditions. The results reframe prompt injection as a pipeline-architecture problem: every model is fully exposed, yet outcomes diverge downstream -- Claude blocks all injections at memory-write (0/164 ASR), GPT-4o-mini propagates at 53%, and DeepSeek exhibits 0%/100% across surfaces from the same model. Three findings matter for deployment: (1) write-node placement is the highest-leverage safety decision -- routing writes through a verified model eliminates propagation; (2) all four defenses fail on at least one surface due to channel mismatch alone, no adversarial adaptation required; (3) invisible whitefont PDF payloads match or exceed visible-text ASR, meaning rendered-layer screening is insufficient. These dynamics apply directly to production: institutional investors and financial firms already run NLP pipelines over earnings calls, SEC filings, and analyst reports -- the document-ingestion workflows now migrating to LLM agents. Code, run logs, and tooling are publicly released.

</details>


### [664] [Explorable Theorems: Making Written Theorems Explorable by Grounding Them in Formal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02598)
*Hita Kambhamettu,Will Crichton,Sean Welleck,Harrison Goldstein,Andrew Head*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将LLM静态文本解释升级为基于Lean形式化证明的交互式‘可探索定理’系统，用户能在步骤粒度上执行、举例、追溯依赖，显著提升数学证明理解效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单纯依赖LLM生成的静态文字解释，无法提供可执行、可逐步展开的交互体验，限制了对技术内容（尤其数学证明）的深度理解。

Method: 设计“可探索定理”系统：用LLM将定理及其文字证明自动转译为Lean形式化语言，并建立原文与Lean代码的双向链接；读者可在任意步骤执行Lean证明、注入自定义实例/反例、追踪逻辑依赖，系统实时返回中间状态。

Result: 16人用户实验表明，拥有交互探索功能的实验组在证明阅读任务中的答案正确率、细节丰富度和整体理解得分均显著优于对照组。

Conclusion: 将解释锚定于可执行的形式化表示，可突破LLM静态文本的天花板，为数学等高严谨领域提供更强的交互式学习工具。

Abstract: LLM-generated explanations can make technical content more accessible, but there is a ceiling on what they can support interactively. Because LLM outputs are static text, they cannot be executed or stepped through. We argue that grounding explanations in a formalized representation enables interactive affordances beyond what static text supports. We instantiate this idea for mathematical proof comprehension with explorable theorems, a system that uses LLMs to translate a theorem and its written proof into Lean, a programming language for machine-checked proofs, and links the written proof with the Lean code. Readers can work through the proof at a step-level granularity, test custom examples or counterexamples, and trace the logical dependencies bridging each step. Each worked-out step is produced by executing the Lean proof on that example and extracting its intermediate state. A user study ($n = 16$) shows potential advantages of this approach: in a proof-reading task, participants who had access to the provided explorability features gave better, more correct, and more detailed answers to comprehension questions, demonstrating a stronger overall understanding of the underlying mathematics.

</details>


### [665] [Verbalizing LLMs' assumptions to explain and control sycophancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03058)
*Myra Cheng,Isabel Sieh,Humishka Zope,Sunny Yu,Lujain Ibrahim,Aryaman Arora,Jared Moore,Desmond Ong,Dan Jurafsky,Diyi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: LLMs can be socially sycophantic, affirming users when they ask questions like "am I in the wrong?" rather than providing genuine assessment. We hypothesize that this behavior arises from incorrect assumptions about the user, like underestimating how often users are seeking information over reassurance. We present Verbalized Assumptions, a framework for eliciting these assumptions from LLMs. Verbalized Assumptions provide insight into LLM sycophancy, delusion, and other safety issues, e.g., the top bigram in LLMs' assumptions on social sycophancy datasets is ``seeking validation.'' We provide evidence for a causal link between Verbalized Assumptions and sycophantic model behavior: our assumption probes (linear probes trained on internal representations of these assumptions) enable interpretable fine-grained steering of social sycophancy. We explore why LLMs default to sycophantic assumptions: on identical queries, people expect more objective and informative responses from AI than from other humans, but LLMs trained on human-human conversation do not account for this difference in expectations. Our work contributes a new understanding of assumptions as a mechanism for sycophancy.

</details>


### [666] [From Paper to Program: Accelerating Quantum Many-Body Algorithm Development via a Multi-Stage LLM-Assisted Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04089)
*Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LLM多阶段科学算法辅助研发流程，先在理实映射层显式提取文献缺失的关键计算约束(索引规约、约化顺序、免存储算子等)，再生成代码；以DMRG为基准，显著优于直接提示，物理验证通过率由46%提升至100%，研发周期从数周压缩至24小时以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽能快速产码，但对依赖隐含结构假设的科学算法缺乏可靠性；文献通常不写清索引约定、约化顺序与矩阵免存约束，直接让LLM编码易错且难纠错。

Method: 分离“理论提取→形式规格→代码实现”三阶段：1)LLM代理抽原文并生成人类评审的中间技术规格；2)规格显式表达索引、约化顺序、免存储等约束；3)用该规格再调LLM生成最终代码。实验覆盖16组主流模型与DMRG基准，比较直接编码与规格中介两种路径。

Result: 规格中介路径全部通过物理验证（纠缠标度、拓扑序复现），成功率100%；直接提示路径仅46%。研发周期由研究生数周工程降至24小时内，关键增益来自规格阶段外化的隐含计算知识而非文档结构。

Conclusion: 将文献缺失的计算约束显式化为中间规格，是LLM可靠生成复杂科学算法代码的核心；多阶段人机协同可突破LLM“黑箱”局限，为计算物理、量子多体等领域提供高效、可验证的研发范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate code rapidly but remain unreliable for scientific algorithms whose correctness depends on structural assumptions rarely explicit in the source literature. We introduce a multi-stage LLM-assisted workflow that separates theory extraction, formal specification, and code implementation. The key step is an intermediate technical specification -- produced by a dedicated LLM agent and reviewed by the human researcher -- that externalizes implementation-critical computational knowledge absent from the source literature, including explicit index conventions, contraction orderings, and matrix-free operational constraints that avoid explicit storage of large operator matrices. A controlled comparison shows that it is this externalized content, rather than the formal document structure, that enables reliable code generation. As a stringent benchmark, we apply this workflow to the Density-Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG), a canonical quantum many-body algorithm requiring exact tensor-index logic, gauge consistency, and memory-aware contractions. The resulting code reproduces the critical entanglement scaling of the spin-$1/2$ Heisenberg chain and the symmetry-protected topological order of the spin-$1$ Affleck--Kennedy--Lieb--Tasaki model. Across 16 tested combinations of leading foundation models, all workflows satisfied the same physics-validation criteria, compared to a 46\% success rate for direct, unmediated implementation. The workflow reduced a development cycle typically requiring weeks of graduate-level effort to under 24 hours.

</details>


### [667] [Many Preferences, Few Policies: Towards Scalable Language Model Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04144)
*Cheol Woo Kim,Jai Moondra,Roozbeh Nahavandi,Andrew Perrault,Milind Tambe,Swati Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 借 PALM 算法，用少量可复用的 LLM 组合（portfolio）为不同用户在不同偏好权重下提供近似最优输出，并在理论上保证组合规模与近似质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为每个用户单独维护并微调大模型在算力、内存和工程上不可行，需在系统成本与个性化体验之间找平衡点。

Method: 引入多维偏好向量描述用户在安全、幽默、简洁等属性上的权重；提出 PALM 框架，在给定各属性奖励函数后，用含有理论保障的组合构造算法选出小规模 LLM，使得对任意权重都能找到组合中的模型，其混合奖励接近该权重下的全局最优。

Result: 给出组合规模与近似质量的理论上界，刻画样本复杂度及所需模型多样性；在公开基准上验证组合大小远低于用户数量，同时输出多样性优于常用基线。

Conclusion: PALM 实现了用少数 LLM 覆盖全用户偏好的理论可行且经验有效方案，为后续将个性化成本降到可部署规模奠定了理论与技术基础。

Abstract: The holy grail of LLM personalization is a single LLM for each user, perfectly aligned with that user's preferences. However, maintaining a separate LLM per user is impractical due to constraints on compute, memory, and system complexity. We address this challenge by developing a principled method for selecting a small portfolio of LLMs that captures representative behaviors across heterogeneous users. We model user preferences across multiple traits (e.g., safety, humor, brevity) through a multi-dimensional weight vector. Given reward functions across these dimensions, our algorithm PALM (Portfolio of Aligned LLMs) generates a small portfolio of LLMs such that, for any weight vector, the portfolio contains a near-optimal LLM for the corresponding scalarized objective. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first result that provides theoretical guarantees on both the size and approximation quality of LLM portfolios for personalization. It characterizes the trade-off between system cost and personalization, as well as the diversity of LLMs required to cover the landscape of user preferences. We provide empirical results that validate these guarantees and demonstrate greater output diversity over common baselines.

</details>


### [668] [Boosted Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Analysis and Healthcare Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04334)
*Zequn Chen,Wesley J. Marrero*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Researchers and practitioners are increasingly considering reinforcement learning to optimize decisions in complex domains like robotics and healthcare. To date, these efforts have largely utilized expectation-based learning. However, relying on expectation-focused objectives may be insufficient for making consistent decisions in highly uncertain situations involving multiple heterogeneous groups. While distributional reinforcement learning algorithms have been introduced to model the full distributions of outcomes, they can yield large discrepancies in realized benefits among comparable agents. This challenge is particularly acute in healthcare settings, where physicians (controllers) must manage multiple patients (subordinate agents) with uncertain disease progression and heterogeneous treatment responses. We propose a Boosted Distributional Reinforcement Learning (BDRL) algorithm that optimizes agent-specific outcome distributions while enforcing comparability among similar agents and analyze its convergence. To further stabilize learning, we incorporate a post-update projection step formulated as a constrained convex optimization problem, which efficiently aligns individual outcomes with a high-performing reference within a specified tolerance. We apply our algorithm to manage hypertension in a large subset of the US adult population by categorizing individuals into cardiovascular disease risk groups. Our approach modifies treatment plans for median and vulnerable patients by mimicking the behavior of high-performing references in each risk group. Furthermore, we find that BDRL improves the number and consistency of quality-adjusted life years compared with reinforcement learning baselines.

</details>


### [669] [ALTO: Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration for Heterogeneous LoRA Training Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05426)
*Jingwei Zuo,Xinze Feng,Zien Liu,Kaijian Wang,Fanjiang Ye,Ye Cao,Zhuang Wang,Yuke Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ALTO，首个针对多并发 LoRA 超参调优任务的高效训练调度系统，通过早停、融合 GEMM、Rank-local 并行及跨任务调度，在不影响模型质量下获至多 13.8× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 虽为主流 PEFT 范式，但其性能对秩、学习率等超参敏感，需系统遍历多组配置。现有系统将各调优任务独立执行，导致算力浪费与 GPU 利用率低，亟待协同优化框架。

Method: ALTO 采用“共享冻结主干+多并发适配器”思路，集成三项关键技术与两级调度：① 在线损失轨迹监控，及时终止低潜力配置；② 融合分组 GEMM 与新型 Rank-local Adapter Parallelism，把存活适配器同域共置并回收空闲显存；③ 结合同任务链式调度与跨任务资源抢占/回填，利用 LoRA 可预测时长改善多任务放置。

Result: 在大规模集群实验上，ALTO 相较当前最优基线，GPU 时间缩短 7.5–13.8 倍，吞吐提高 4.3–7.9 倍，各种下游任务指标基本无下降。

Conclusion: 多 LoRA 任务间可挖掘协同收益；ALTO 以系统-算法联设方式，将早停、算子融合、并行化与调度协同，实现高效共享式超参搜索，为生产环境中大模型微调提供可扩展低耗能解决方案。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is now the dominant method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, but achieving a high-quality adapter often requires systematic hyperparameter tuning because LoRA performance is highly sensitive to configuration choices. In practice, this leads to many concurrent LoRA jobs, often spanning heterogeneous tasks in multi-tenant environments. Existing systems largely handle these jobs independently, which both wastes computation on weak candidates and leaves GPUs underutilized. We present ALTO (Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration), a co-designed training system that accelerates LoRA hyperparameter tuning while enabling efficient cluster sharing across heterogeneous tasks. The central insight behind ALTO is that when multiple tuning jobs run concurrently over a shared frozen backbone, they expose optimization opportunities that single-job designs cannot exploit. Building on this, ALTO monitors loss trajectories to terminate unpromising configurations early, uses fused grouped GEMM together with a new rank-local adapter parallelism to co-locate surviving adapters and reclaim freed GPU capacity, and combines intra-task and inter-task scheduling to improve multi-task placement by leveraging the predictable duration of LoRA jobs. Extensive evaluation shows that ALTO achieves up to $13.8\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art without sacrificing adapter quality.

</details>


### [670] [DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06161)
*Zhengming Yu,Li Ma,Mingming He,Leo Isikdogan,Yuancheng Xu,Dmitriy Smirnov,Pablo Salamanca,Dao Mi,Pablo Delgado,Ning Yu,Julien Philip,Xin Li,Wenping Wang,Paul Debevec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DiffHDR 利用预训练视频扩散模型在 Log-Gamma 潜空间内生成式“补全”过曝与欠曝区域，将 8-bit LDR 视频稳健升格为可重曝光的 HDR 视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
