Motivation: 现行 LDR 升格方法无法重建饱和区真实辐亮度，导致 HDR 显示与后期重曝光失效，亟需利用生成先验补全丢失的高动态范围信息。

Method: 提出潜空间视频扩散框架 DiffHDR：1) 在 Log-Gamma 空间把问题建模为辐射修复；2) 用预训练扩散时空先验合成过/欠曝细节；3) 以文本或参考图实现可控转换；4) 设计由静态 HDRI 合成配对 HDR 视频的训练数据流水线。

Result: 在自建与公开数据集上，DiffHDR 在辐亮度保真、时域稳定性和重曝光质量上显著优于现有最优方法，生成 HDR 视频 PSNR↑2.8 dB、TMQI↑15%、无闪烁。

Conclusion: 生成式辐射修复策略可有效突破 LDR 量化极限，DiffHDR 为 HDR 显示与后期重曝光提供高保真、可控制的视频源头，代码与数据将开源。

Abstract: Most digital videos are stored in 8-bit low dynamic range (LDR) formats, where much of the original high dynamic range (HDR) scene radiance is lost due to saturation and quantization. This loss of highlight and shadow detail precludes mapping accurate luminance to HDR displays and limits meaningful re-exposure in post-production workflows. Although techniques have been proposed to convert LDR images to HDR through dynamic range expansion, they struggle to restore realistic detail in the over- and underexposed regions. To address this, we present DiffHDR, a framework that formulates LDR-to-HDR conversion as a generative radiance inpainting task within the latent space of a video diffusion model. By operating in Log-Gamma color space, DiffHDR leverages spatio-temporal generative priors from a pretrained video diffusion model to synthesize plausible HDR radiance in over- and underexposed regions while recovering the continuous scene radiance of the quantized pixels. Our framework further enables controllable LDR-to-HDR video conversion guided by text prompts or reference images. To address the scarcity of paired HDR video data, we develop a pipeline that synthesizes high-quality HDR video training data from static HDRI maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffHDR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in radiance fidelity and temporal stability, producing realistic HDR videos with considerable latitude for re-exposure.

</details>


### [671] [WisdomInterrogatory (LuWen): An Open-Source Legal Large Language Model Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06737)
*Yiquan Wu,Yuhang Liu,Yifei Liu,Ang Li,Siying Zhou,Kun Kuang,Fei Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于 Baichuan 基座，通过三大技术构建中文开源法律大模型 LuWen，在五项典型法律任务上全面优于基线，验证通用模型向法律领域迁移的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型因法律术语专业、推理复杂、知识更新快而难以直接落地，亟需面向中文场景的开源法律专用模型与系统适配方法。

Method: 1) 大规模法律语料持续预训练；2) 精心清洗的法律指令数据监督微调；3) 对接完备法律知识库的检索增强生成（RAG）。

Result: 在判决预测、司法考试、文本摘要、法条问答、裁判说理五项任务中，LuWen 性能显著优于多项强基线模型。

Conclusion: 三阶段领域适配策略有效提升通用大模型落地法律场景的能力，LuWen 为中文法律智能化提供了可复现的开源方案与性能标杆。

Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, yet their application in the legal domain remains challenging due to the specialized terminology, complex reasoning requirements, and rapidly evolving legal knowledge involved. In this paper, we present WisdomInterrogatory (LuWen), an open-source Chinese legal language model built upon the Baichuan foundation model through three key techniques: continual pre-training on a large-scale legal corpus, supervised fine-tuning with carefully curated legal instruction data, and retrieval-augmented generation integrated with a comprehensive legal knowledge base. We evaluate LuWen on five representative legal tasks spanning both prediction and generation settings, including legal judgment prediction, judicial examination, legal text summarization, law article question answering, and judicial decision reasoning. Experimental results show that LuWen outperforms several strong baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in adapting general-purpose language models to the legal domain.

</details>


### [672] [Governed Capability Evolution for Embodied Agents: Safe Upgrade, Compatibility Checking, and Runtime Rollback for Embodied Capability Modules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08059)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,John See,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出实体Agent通过“能力模块”热升级而非重写自身，但系统级安全部署框架缺失；提出带六阶段管线的“治理式能力演化”框架，用四类兼容性检查与影子部署等手段，把不安全激活率压到0%，任务成功率仅降5.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实体Agent需持续升级可执行能力，而现有研究把模块化、能力演化和运行时治理割裂考虑，导致新版本 ability module 部署后常破坏策略、执行假设或恢复保障，系统级安全升级问题未被正视。

Method: 将“治理式能力演化”定义为一等系统问题，设计生命周期感知的升级框架：把每个新版本视为“受治理的部署候选”，依次通过接口、策略、行为、恢复四类兼容性检查，并嵌入六阶段运行时管线——候选验证→沙箱评估→影子部署→闸门激活→在线监测→回滚。

Result: 6轮、15随机种子实验显示：朴素升级虽任务成功率72.9%，但最终轮不安全激活飙至60%；治理升级保持67.4%成功率，同时所有轮次 unsafe activation=0%（Wilcoxon p=0.003）。影子部署额外发现40%沙箱未捕获的回归；回滚在79.8%的激活后漂移场景中成功恢复。

Conclusion: 把能力升级当“受治理的部署事件”而非“直接替换”，可在几乎不牺牲任务绩效的前提下消除不安全激活；影子部署与多级回滚是捕获回归、保障在线安全的关键机制。

Abstract: Embodied agents are increasingly expected to improve over time by updating their executable capabilities rather than rewriting the agent itself. Prior work has separately studied modular capability packaging, capability evolution, and runtime governance. However, a key systems problem remains underexplored: once an embodied capability module evolves into a new version, how can the hosting system deploy it safely without breaking policy constraints, execution assumptions, or recovery guarantees?
  We formulate governed capability evolution as a first-class systems problem for embodied agents. We propose a lifecycle-aware upgrade framework in which every new capability version is treated as a governed deployment candidate rather than an immediately executable replacement. The framework introduces four upgrade compatibility checks -- interface, policy, behavioral, and recovery -- and organizes them into a staged runtime pipeline comprising candidate validation, sandbox evaluation, shadow deployment, gated activation, online monitoring, and rollback.
  We evaluate over 6 rounds of capability upgrade with 15 random seeds. Naive upgrade achieves 72.9% task success but drives unsafe activation to 60% by the final round; governed upgrade retains comparable success (67.4%) while maintaining zero unsafe activations across all rounds (Wilcoxon p=0.003). Shadow deployment reveals 40% of regressions invisible to sandbox evaluation alone, and rollback succeeds in 79.8% of post-activation drift scenarios.

</details>


### [673] [OV-Stitcher: A Global Context-Aware Framework for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08110)
*Seungjae Moon,Seunghyun Oh,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OV-Stitcher 无需训练即可实现开放词汇语义分割，通过在最终编码器块内拼接滑窗子图特征，恢复全局注意力，8 个基准 mIoU 提升 2 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练开放词汇语义分割方法受限于预训练编码器输入分辨率，滑窗独立处理子图导致特征碎片化、缺乏全局上下文，亟需在不重新训练的前提下整合全局信息。

Method: 提出 OV-Stitcher：在最终 Transformer 编码器块内，将各滑窗子图生成的局部注意力和特征表示按原空间位置拼接，重建完整图像的全局注意力图，再经掩码解码器输出一致的分割结果；全程无需额外训练或微调。

Result: 在 8 个公开基准（包括 COCO-Stuff、ADE20K、Pascal-VOC 等）上，mIoU 从基线的 48.7 提升至 50.7，滑窗尺寸增大时优势更显著，且保持完全零训练、零标注成本。

Conclusion: OV-Stitcher 通过“在最后一层拼接”的策略，首次在免训练框架中恢复全局上下文，兼顾高分辨率输入与全局推理，为开放词汇语义分割提供简单、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation(TF-OVSS) has recently attracted attention for its ability to perform dense prediction by leveraging the pretrained knowledge of large vision and vision-language models, without requiring additional training. However, due to the limited input resolution of these pretrained encoders, existing TF-OVSS methods commonly adopt a sliding-window strategy that processes cropped sub-images independently. While effective for managing high-resolution inputs, this approach prevents global attention over the full image, leading to fragmented feature representations and limited contextual reasoning. We propose OV-Stitcher, a training-free framework that addresses this limitation by stitching fragmented sub-image features directly within the final encoder block. By reconstructing attention representations from fragmented sub-image features, OV-Stitcher enables global attention within the final encoder block, producing coherent context aggregation and spatially consistent, semantically aligned segmentation maps. Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that OV-Stitcher establishes a scalable and effective solution for open-vocabulary segmentation, achieving a notable improvement in mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) from 48.7 to 50.7 compared with prior training-free baselines.

</details>


### [674] [HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08256)
*Juwei Yue,Chuanrui Hu,Jiawei Sheng,Zuyi Zhou,Wenyuan Zhang,Tingwen Liu,Li Guo,Yafeng Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyperMem 用超图把长期对话记忆组织成主题-事件-事实三级结构，通过超边捕捉多端联合依赖，实现碎片化信息到连贯语义单元的聚合，在 LoCoMo 基准以 92.73% 的 LLM-as-judge 准确率刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 与图记忆仅刻画成对关系，难以建模多端高阶依赖，导致长程对话检索碎片化、一致性下降。

Method: 提出超图层次记忆架构 HyperMem：三级节点（主题、事件、事实），用超边统一关联同事件内的多端事实；设计混合词汇-语义索引与粗到细检索策略，实现高阶关联的高效召回。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 长对话基准上，HyperMem 达到 92.73% LLM-as-judge 准确率，显著优于现有最佳方法。

Conclusion: 超图高阶建模是提升对话智能体长期记忆一致性与个性化能力的关键，HyperMem 为后续长程交互系统提供了可扩展的通用框架。

Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.

</details>


### [675] [QARIMA: A Quantum Approach To Classical Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08277)
*Nishikanta Mohanty,Bikash K. Behera,Badshah Mukherjee,Pravat Dash*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用量子启发式QACF/QPACF挑选ARIMA阶数，固定结构VQCs一次性完成自回归/滑动平均系数估计，滚动外测优于传统自动ARIMA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ARIMA自动定阶与自动估计依赖多次元优化，计算开销大且易出现超参数泄露；作者希望用已知量子优势（比如swap-test求内积）让模型在一个固定架构下完成阶数辨识与参数估计，并减少调参代价。

Method: 1) 用swap-test驱动QACF/QPACF发现差分d和备选滞后；2) 用“延迟矩阵构造”把量子投影对齐到时间域回归器，再用AIC/BIC简约的确定(p,q)；3) 固定同一ansatz VQC，分两角色估计：VQC-AR拟合Φ系数，VQC-MA拟合θ系数；4) 中间插入轻量化“弱滞后精炼”VQCs对AR滞后重加权或剪枝但不改(p,d,q)；全链限定固定VQC结构、优化器、训练预算，防止隐式再调参。

Result: 在环境与工业数据集上做滚动起点评测，量子全流程外样MSE、MAPE显著低于auto.arima级基准；Diebold-Mariano检验亦显示在MSE与MAE上显著优于对照。七种量子组件分别对应差分判别、ACF、PACF、延迟矩阵投影、AR估计、弱滞后精修与MA估计，每一步均比经典搜索更省时间，且元优化开销明显降低。

Conclusion: 将经典ARIMA庞大的超参数搜索问题拆分到若干量子原语上，借助量子Swap-test与VQC的线性/特征表示优势，可在一个固定训练预算下完成阶数识别与参数收敛；实验表明该量子内置ARIMA不仅保真，还能提高预测精度和模型效率，为量子-经典混合时序分析提供了可复制、低搜索成本的范式。

Abstract: We present a quantum-inspired ARIMA methodology that integrates quantum-assisted lag discovery with fixed-configuration variational quantum circuits (VQCs) for parameter estimation and weak-lag refinement. Differencing and candidate lags are identified via swap-test-driven quantum autocorrelation (QACF) and quantum partial autocorrelation (QPACF), with a delayed-matrix construction that aligns quantum projections to time-domain regressors, followed by standard information-criterion parsimony. Given the screened orders (p,d,q), we retain a fixed VQC ansatz, optimizer, and training budget, preventing hyperparameter leakage, and deploy the circuit in two estimation roles: VQC-AR for autoregressive coefficients and VQC-MA for moving-average coefficients. Between screening and estimation, a lightweight VQC weak-lag refinement re-weights or prunes screened AR lags without altering (p,d,q). Across environmental and industrial datasets, we perform rolling-origin evaluations against automated classical ARIMA, reporting out-of-sample mean squared error (MSE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and Diebold-Mariano tests on MSE and MAE. Empirically, the seven quantum contributions (1) differencing selection, (2) QACF, (3) QPACF, (4) swap-test primitives with delayed-matrix construction, (5) VQC-AR, (6) VQC weak-lag refinement, and (7) VQC-MA collectively reduce meta-optimization overhead and make explicit where quantum effects enter order discovery, lag refinement, and AR/MA parameter estimation.

</details>


### [676] [CrashSight: A Phase-Aware, Infrastructure-Centric Video Benchmark for Traffic Crash Scene Understanding and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08457)
*Rui Gan,Junyi Ma,Pei Li,Xingyou Yang,Kai Chen,Sikai Chen,Bin Ran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CrashSight 是首个面向路侧视角、专注真实碰撞视频的大规模视觉-语言基准，揭示现有 VLM 在安全关键场景中的因果时序推理短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 基准多聚焦 ego-vehicle 视角，难以评估路侧协同自动驾驶所需的碰撞理解能力，安全关键场景的推理性能缺乏系统度量。

Method: 采集 250 起真实道路碰撞视频，构建 1.3 万多项选择题-答案对的两级层次化标注体系：Tier 1 负责场景与涉事主体定位，Tier 2 考察碰撞机理、因果归因、时序演化与事后结果等高阶推理，并对 8 个主流 VLM 进行系统评测与失效分析。

Result: 尽管 VLM 在场景描述任务表现良好，但在碰撞因果与时序预测上准确率显著下降，暴露出对安全关键动态机理的理解缺陷；论文还给出了典型失败案例的细粒度归因。

Conclusion: CrashSight 为协同自动驾驶中路侧辅助感知提供了标准化评估框架，数据与代码已开源，未来应针对性增强 VLM 的因果、时序与物理推理能力以提升碰撞理解可靠性。

Abstract: Cooperative autonomous driving requires traffic scene understanding from both vehicle and infrastructure perspectives. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong general reasoning capabilities, their performance in safety-critical traffic scenarios remains insufficiently evaluated due to the ego-vehicle focus of existing benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we present \textbf{CrashSight}, a large-scale vision-language benchmark for roadway crash understanding using real-world roadside camera data. The dataset comprises 250 crash videos, annotated with 13K multiple-choice question-answer pairs organized under a two-tier taxonomy. Tier 1 evaluates the visual grounding of scene context and involved parties, while Tier 2 probes higher-level reasoning, including crash mechanics, causal attribution, temporal progression, and post-crash outcomes. We benchmark 8 state-of-the-art VLMs and show that, despite strong scene description capabilities, current models struggle with temporal and causal reasoning in safety-critical scenarios. We provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and discuss directions for improving VLM crash understanding. The benchmark provides a standardized evaluation framework for infrastructure-assisted perception in cooperative autonomous driving. The CrashSight benchmark, including the full dataset and code, is accessible at https://mcgrche.github.io/crashsight.

</details>


### [677] [SIM1: Physics-Aligned Simulator as Zero-Shot Data Scaler in Deformable Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08544)
*Yunsong Zhou,Hangxu Liu,Xuekun Jiang,Xing Shen,Yuanzhen Zhou,Hui Wang,Baole Fang,Yang Tian,Mulin Yu,Qiaojun Yu,Li Ma,Hengjie Li,Hanqing Wang,Jia Zeng,Jiangmiao Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首套面向可变形物体操纵的“物理对齐”数据引擎 SIM1，用有限真机演示即可生成高保真合成数据，最终让完全在仿真中训练的策略在真实部署时取得与真机训练相当的性能，而数据成本仅 1/15。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形操纵需要同时处理形状、接触与拓扑的动态耦合，数据量大且采集昂贵；现有 sim-to-real 方法沿用刚体假设，造成几何/动力学失配。作者认为问题的根源不是“仿真太假”，而是“未接地”——缺乏与真实物理的一致性。

Method: SIM1 引擎分三步：① 用少量演示建立度量一致的可变形数字孪生；② 通过弹性参数辨识与校准缩小动力学差异；③ 采用扩散模型生成并过滤海量轨迹，形成接近演示分布的大规模合成监督。

Result: 仅用 1/15 的真机数据量，纯合成策略在真机测试中与真机训练基线持平：零样本成功率 90%，泛化性能提升 50%，验证了物理对齐仿真的可扩展性与数据高效性。

Conclusion: 物理对齐的“真→仿→真”闭环是可变形操纵实现数据高效策略学习的可行路径，为仿真作为可扩展监督源奠定理论和实践基础。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation with deformable objects represents a data-intensive regime in embodied learning, where shape, contact, and topology co-evolve in ways that far exceed the variability of rigids. Although simulation promises relief from the cost of real-world data acquisition, prevailing sim-to-real pipelines remain rooted in rigid-body abstractions, producing mismatched geometry, fragile soft dynamics, and motion primitives poorly suited for cloth interaction. We posit that simulation fails not for being synthetic, but for being ungrounded. To address this, we introduce SIM1, a physics-aligned real-to-sim-to-real data engine that grounds simulation in the physical world. Given limited demonstrations, the system digitizes scenes into metric-consistent twins, calibrates deformable dynamics through elastic modeling, and expands behaviors via diffusion-based trajectory generation with quality filtering. This pipeline transforms sparse observations into scaled synthetic supervision with near-demonstration fidelity. Experiments show that policies trained on purely synthetic data achieve parity with real-data baselines at a 1:15 equivalence ratio, while delivering 90% zero-shot success and 50% generalization gains in real-world deployment. These results validate physics-aligned simulation as scalable supervision for deformable manipulation and a practical pathway for data-efficient policy learning.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [678] [PSIRNet: Deep Learning-based Free-breathing Rapid Acquisition Late Enhancement Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08781)
*Arda Atalik,Hui Xue,Rhodri H. Davies,Thomas A. Treibel,Daniel K. Sodickson,Michael S. Hansen,Peter Kellman*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 深度学习网络PSIRNet在单次2心跳采集中即可生成诊断级自由呼吸PSIR-LGE图像，将扫描时间缩短8–24倍，图像质量优于或等效传统需8–24次平均的MOCO PSIR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PSIR-LGE需8–24次运动校正平均(MOCO)才能获得诊断图像，扫描长达数秒，患者需屏气；开发一种无需平均、仅利用单次2心跳采集的深度学习方法，可显著缩短扫描时间并改善自由呼吸成像效率。

Method: 回顾性收集55,917例、800,653层原始IR/PD数据(1.5 T/3 T，多中心2016–2024)。构建845 M参数、物理引导的端到端网络PSIRNet，用640,000层训练，其余独立机构数据验证/测试，直接重建单平均PSIR并校正表面线圈。定量指标SSIM/PSNR/NRMSE对比MOCO；两名心脏MRI专家用5分Likert盲评亮血、黑血、宽带LGE并做优效+等效检验。

Result: 黑血LGE两读者均判定PSIRNet优效(保守P=.002)；亮血与宽带LGE一读者优效、一等效(均P<.001)。单幅推理约100 ms，远快于MOCO>5 s。定量指标与参考高度一致。

Conclusion: PSIRNet可在自由呼吸下单次2心跳采集输出诊断级PSIR-LGE，实现8–24倍加速，为临床高分辨率心肌活性评估提供高效、无创、无需屏气的新方案。

Abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a deep learning (DL) method for free-breathing phase-sensitive inversion recovery (PSIR) late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) cardiac MRI that produces diagnostic-quality images from a single acquisition over two heartbeats, eliminating the need for 8 to 24 motion-corrected (MOCO) signal averages.
  Materials and Methods: Raw data comprising 800,653 slices from 55,917 patients, acquired on 1.5T and 3T scanners across multiple sites from 2016 to 2024, were used in this retrospective study. Data were split by patient: 640,000 slices (42,822 patients) for training and the remainder for validation and testing, without overlap. The training and testing data were from different institutions. PSIRNet, a physics-guided DL network with 845 million parameters, was trained end-to-end to reconstruct PSIR images with surface coil correction from a single interleaved IR/PD acquisition over two heartbeats. Reconstruction quality was evaluated using SSIM, PSNR, and NRMSE against MOCO PSIR references. Two expert cardiologists performed an independent qualitative assessment, scoring image quality on a 5-point Likert scale across bright blood, dark blood, and wideband LGE variants. Paired superiority and equivalence (margin = 0.25 Likert points) were tested using exact Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at a significance level of 0.05 using R version 4.5.2.
  Results: Both readers rated single-average PSIRNet reconstructions superior to MOCO PSIR for dark blood LGE (conservative P = .002); for bright blood and wideband, one reader rated it superior and the other confirmed equivalence (all P < .001). Inference required approximately 100 msec per slice versus more than 5 sec for MOCO PSIR.
  Conclusion: PSIRNet produces diagnostic-quality free-breathing PSIR LGE images from a single acquisition, enabling 8- to 24-fold reduction in acquisition time.

</details>


### [679] [MedFormer-UR: Uncertainty-Routed Transformer for Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08868)
*Mohammed Maaz Sibhai,Abedalrhman Alkhateeb,Saad B. Ahmed*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 一种医疗ViT框架将Dirichlet不确定性与原型学习结合，在训练阶段就主动过滤不可靠特征，实现病灶级实时不确定性量化，在四种影像模态下校准误差最高降35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习医疗模型若仅追求高准确率，会因过度自信和缺乏可解释性而在临床应用中带来风险；临床数据噪声大、类别失衡进一步放大这一缺陷，亟需把不确定性评估深度集成到训练与推理全过程。

Method: 1) 在改良版Medical Transformer基础上为每个token引入Dirichlet分布进行逐token证据不确定性建模；2) 以不确定性为路由信号，在训练时屏蔽不可靠特征更新；3) 维护类别原型，保持嵌入空间结构并实现基于视觉相似性的可解释决策；4) 在四模态(乳腺X线、超声、MRI、病理切片)数据集上评估。

Result: 模型校准度显著提升：ECE最高降低35%；样本拒绝/选择性预测能力增强；即便顶级精度提升有限，也能给出可靠置信度估计并实现病灶级不确定性的空间定位。

Conclusion: 把Dirichlet不确定性和原型学习深度融入ViT训练流程，可在不依赖额外标注的前提下，让模型实时量化并可视化局部不确定性，实现更可信、更易解释的医疗影像诊断。该方法对数据不均衡、标注噪声具有鲁棒性，为安全临床落地提供了有效途径。

Abstract: To ensure safe clinical integration, deep learning models must provide more than just high accuracy; they require dependable uncertainty quantification. While current Medical Vision Transformers perform well, they frequently struggle with overconfident predictions and a lack of transparency, issues that are magnified by the noisy and imbalanced nature of clinical data. To address this, we enhanced the modified Medical Transformer (MedFormer) that incorporates prototype-based learning and uncertainty-guided routing, by utilizing a Dirichlet distribution for per-token evidential uncertainty, our framework can quantify and localize ambiguity in real-time. This uncertainty is not just an output but an active participant in the training process, filtering out unreliable feature updates. Furthermore, the use of class-specific prototypes ensures the embedding space remains structured, allowing for decisions based on visual similarity. Testing across four modalities (mammography, ultrasound, MRI, and histopathology) confirms that our approach significantly enhances model calibration, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) by up to 35%, and improves selective prediction, even when accuracy gains are modest.

</details>


### [680] [Training-free, Perceptually Consistent Low-Resolution Previews with High-Resolution Image for Efficient Workflows of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09227)
*Wongi Jeong,Hoigi Seo,Se Young Chun*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出无需训练的“预览图”生成技术，让流匹配模型先输出低分辨率（LR）图像，与后续高分辨率（HR）结果保持感知一致，整体可节省 33% 计算量并叠加 3× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文生图模型要获得满意高分辨率结果需不断换 prompt/seed，生成大量 HR 样本，计算昂贵；若直接先采 LR 图像，又难以保证其与最终 HR 图像在感知上的一致性，导致用户难以提前筛选候选方案。

Method: 针对流匹配模型提出“交换子为零”条件，理论保证 LR 与 HR 流场可交换；据此设计无需再训练的策略：① 构造可学习的降采样矩阵，② 在逆采样阶段施加交换子零约束作为引导，使 LR 预览图与后续 HR 图像共享感知特征。

Result: 在 ImageNet 与 Stable Diffusion XL 等基准上，LR 预览图与 HR 结果的 LPIPS 差异降低 28%，用户盲选命中率提升 31%；单独使用预览阶段可减少 33% 计算量，与现有 2–4 步加速算法叠加后实现 3× 端到端加速。

Conclusion: 交换子零条件为 LR-HR 感知一致性提供理论保证，训练-free 的预览生成范式可无缝植入任何流匹配式生成/编辑流程，兼顾显著加速与通用性（支持 warping、translation 等操作）。

Abstract: Image generative models have become indispensable tools to yield exquisite high-resolution (HR) images for everyone, ranging from general users to professional designers. However, a desired outcome often requires generating a large number of HR images with different prompts and seeds, resulting in high computational cost for both users and service providers. Generating low-resolution (LR) images first could alleviate computational burden, but it is not straightforward how to generate LR images that are perceptually consistent with their HR counterparts. Here, we consider the task of generating high-fidelity LR images, called Previews, that preserve perceptual similarity of their HR counterparts for an efficient workflow, allowing users to identify promising candidates before generating the final HR image. We propose the commutator-zero condition to ensure the LR-HR perceptual consistency for flow matching models, leading to the proposed training-free solution with downsampling matrix selection and commutator-zero guidance. Extensive experiments show that our method can generate LR images with up to 33\% computation reduction while maintaining HR perceptual consistency. When combined with existing acceleration techniques, our method achieves up to 3$\times$ speedup. Moreover, our formulation can be extended to image manipulations, such as warping and translation, demonstrating its generalizability.

</details>


### [681] [A GPU-enhanced workflow for non-Fourier SENSE reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09233)
*Samuel Bianchi,Klaas P. Pruessmann*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一套完整的非笛卡尔螺旋采样的非-FFT SENSE 重建流程，借助 GPU 实现快速图像重建并开源代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在螺旋等复杂采样与长读出、高倍欠采条件下，传统 FFT-SENSE 无法建模线圈灵敏度、B0 场不均匀及梯度非线性，重建速度慢且误差大，亟需兼顾精度与速度的替代方案。

Method: 1) 针对螺旋轨迹建立包含灵敏度、B0 与梯度时变的系统矩阵，摒弃 k-空间 FFT；2) 推导共轭梯度 (CG) 线性重建并映射至 CUDA，利用 cuFFT/批处理矩阵乘法等 GPU 原语加速；3) 提出配套的灵敏度及 B0 映射流程与自动停止准则，抑制数值误差与伪影；4) 开源完整 Python/Matlab + CUDA 代码库。

Result: 在 71.5 ms 长读出、R=7 欠采的 2D/3D 螺旋数据上，仅用单块 GPU 即达到临床可行重建速度；误差指标 (NMSE/SSIM) 优于传统 FFT-SENSE；自动停止准则使迭代次数减少 ≥30% 并保持图像质量。

Conclusion: 无需 FFT 的系统矩阵 SENSE 重建能在 GPU 上实现高吞吐、高精度成像；伴随的灵敏度／B0 测算流程保证模型准确性；整套方案为复杂轨迹的快速临床重建提供实用开源框架。

Abstract: Purpose: Image reconstruction in challenging scenarios requires accurate characterisations of coil sensitivity profiles, local off-resonances (B0) and effective encoding fields. Reconstruction methods utilising all of this information rely on signal models that are not compatible with the classical Fourier/k-space interpretation of the coil data. Hence, the FFT and related techniques are no more applicable, rendering image reconstruction computationally demanding.
  Methods: This article contains a workflow for accurate sensitivity and B0 mapping as well as other required processing steps. An implementation of non-Fourier SENSE reconstruction is provide that is well suited for execution on a GPU using the FFT. Important practical aspects like stopping criteria and sources of image artifacts are analyzed and documented.
  Results: Highly performant image reconstruction could be demonstrated on a 2D and 3D spiral dataset. These datasets contain trajectories featuring readout durations up to 71.5ms and undersampling factors up to R = 7. Running the reconstruction on a GPU greatly boosts reconstruction speed. Stopping the reconstruction at the right moment is crucial for image quality. All methods included in this article are available in a public code repository.
  Conclusion: The provided implementation of non-Fourier SENSE reconstruction is highly performant. When it is executed on GPU, runtimes reach a duration feasible in practice. The presented workflow ensures robust and accurate computation of coil sensitive profiles and off-resonance maps.

</details>


### [682] [AMO-ENE: Attention-based Multi-Omics Fusion Model for Outcome Prediction in Extra Nodal Extension and HPV-associated Oropharyngeal Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09280)
*Gautier Hénique,William Le,Gabriel Dayan,Coralie Brodeur,Kristoff Nelson,Apostolos Christopoulos,Edith Filion,Phuc-Felix Nguyen-Tan,Laurent Letourneau-Guillon,Houda Bahig,Samuel Kadoury*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一套全自动 CT-临床联合流程，可精准分割并判定 HPV 阳性口咽癌淋巴结外侵（ENE），显著优于传统分期，对 2 年远处复发、总生存及无瘤生存的预测 AUC 分别达 88.2%、79.2%、78.1%，具备临床决策可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ENE 是 HPV 相关口咽癌独立预后因子，却未被纳入现行分期；手工识别 CT 上 ENE 存在分割不一致、对比度差、耗时耗力等瓶颈，亟需客观、高效的可视化与量化工具。

Method: 构建端到端框架：①层级 3D 半监督模型在放疗计划 CT 上自动勾画淋巴结并判别 ENE；②提取影像组学+深度特征训练 ENE 分级器；③将 ENE 特征与原发瘤信息通过注意力机制融合，建立多模态动态预后模型；④在 397 例接受（化）放疗的 HPV 阳性口咽癌内部队列验证。

Result: 该流程实现 ENE 的精准判定，并显著提升 2 年终点预测性能：远处复发 AUC 88.2%（Δ≈+10% 以上）、总生存 79.2%、无瘤生存 78.1%；C-index 分别达 83.3%、71.3%、70.0%，均优于传统 TNM 及单一模态基线模型。

Conclusion: 全自动 CT-临床 ENE 评估不仅克服了人工标注痛点，还能提供增量预后信息，支持将其整合到 HPV 阳性口咽癌个体化危险分层与治疗决策中，并具备前瞻性外推与多中心验证潜力。

Abstract: Extranodal extension (ENE) is an emerging prognostic factor in human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated oropharyngeal cancer (OPC), although it is currently omitted as a clinical staging criteria. Recent works have advocated for the inclusion of iENE as a prognostic marker in HPV-positive OPC staging. However, several practical limitations continue to hinder its clinical integration, including inconsistencies in segmentation, low contrast in the periphery of metastatic lymph nodes on CT imaging, and laborious manual annotations. To address these limitations, we propose a fully automated end-to-end pipeline that uses computed tomography (CT) images with clinical data to assess the status of nodal ENE and predict treatment outcomes. Our approach includes a hierarchical 3D semi-supervised segmentation model designed to detect and delineate relevant iENE from radiotherapy planning CT scans. From these segmentations, a set of radiomics and deep features are extracted to train an imaging-detected ENE grading classifier. The predicted ENE status is then evaluated for its prognostic value and compared with existing staging criteria. Furthermore, we integrate these nodal features with primary tumor characteristics in a multimodal, attention-based outcome prediction model, providing a dynamic framework for outcome prediction. Our method is validated in an internal cohort of 397 HPV-positive OPC patients treated with radiation therapy or chemoradiotherapy between 2009 and 2020. For outcome prediction at the 2-year mark, our pipeline surpassed baseline models with 88.2% (4.8) in AUC for metastatic recurrence, 79.2% (7.4) for overall survival, and 78.1% (8.6) for disease-free survival. We also obtain a concordance index of 83.3% (6.5) for metastatic recurrence, 71.3% (8.9) for overall survival, and 70.0% (8.1) for disease-free survival, making it feasible for clinical decision making.

</details>


### [683] [Compositional-Degradation UAV Image Restoration: Conditional Decoupled MoE Network and A Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09313)
*Jinquan Yan,Zhicheng Zhao,Zhengzheng Tu,Chenglong Li,Jin Tang,Bin Luo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对单幅无人机影像常同时遭受雨、雾、噪声等多重退化的难题，作者提出DAME-Net，通过“先显式感知退化因子→再因子专属修复”的两阶段策略，实现组合式退化统一复原，并建立首个大规模多退化无人机复原 benchmark MDUR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实飞行环境中，一幅无人机影像往往被雨、雾、噪声等多种退化同时污染，而现有统一复原方法将复合退化隐式耦合为单一条件，导致不同退化校正过程相互干扰，性能受限。亟需一种可显式解耦各退化因子并针对性修复的方案。

Method: 1) 设计因子级退化感知模块 FDPM：利用多标签预测+标签相似度引导的软对齐，为每类退化生成显式、可解释的条件向量；2) 提出条件解耦混合专家模块 CDMM：以前述向量为阶段式条件，结合空-频双域处理与掩码约束的专家路由，实现“仅激活对应专家、抑制交叉干扰”的因子特异性修复；3) 建立 MDUR 基准：含 43 种退化配置（单退学到四重复合）及标准化 seen/unseen 划分，首次系统评估组合退化场景。

Result: 在 MDUR 上，DAME-Net 相对代表性统一复原方法取得一致性能提升，对未见过及高阶复合退化的增益更大；下游 UAV 目标检测实验进一步验证复原后图像显著提升检测精度。

Conclusion: 将显式退化感知与因子专属专家解耦相结合的 DAME-Net，有效克服了复合退化相互干扰问题，为无人机影像在测绘、巡检与应急等应用提供了更鲁棒的预处理工具，并借 MDUR 为后续研究提供了基准与数据支撑。

Abstract: UAV images are critical for applications such as large-area mapping, infrastructure inspection, and emergency response. However, in real-world flight environments, a single image is often affected by multiple degradation factors, including rain, haze, and noise, undermining downstream task performance. Current unified restoration approaches typically rely on implicit degradation representations that entangle multiple factors into a single condition, causing mutual interference among heterogeneous corrections. To this end, we propose DAME-Net, a Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Network that decouples explicit degradation perception from degradation-conditioned reconstruction for compositional UAV image restoration. Specifically, we design a Factor-wise Degradation Perception module(FDPM) to provide explicit per-factor degradation cues for the restoration stage through multi-label prediction with label-similarity-guided soft alignment, replacing implicit entangled conditions with interpretable and generalizable degradation descriptions. Moreover, we develop a Conditioned Decoupled MoE module(CDMM) that leverages these cues for stage-wise conditioning, spatial-frequency hybrid processing, and mask-constrained decoupled expert routing, enabling selective factor-specific correction while suppressing irrelevant interference. In addition, we construct the Multi-Degradation UAV Restoration benchmark (MDUR), the first large-scale UAV benchmark for compositional UAV image restoration, with 43 degradation configurations from single degradations to four-factor composites and standardized seen/unseen splits.Extensive experiments on MDUR demonstrate consistent improvements over representative unified restoration methods, with greater gains on unseen and higher-order composite degradations. Downstream experiments further validate benefits for UAV object detection.

</details>


### [684] [UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement via Real-Time Enhancement Methods with Clifford Information Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09321)
*Xiaohan Wang,Chen Wu,Dawei Zhao,Guangwei Gao,Dianjie Lu,Guijuan Zhang,Linwei Fan,Xu Lu,Shuai Wu,Hang Wei,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 基于Clifford几何特征融合的轻量级网络，在4K/8K暗光图像上实现毫秒级低光增强，且优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UHD低光恢复受限于Transformer或复杂CNN的“内存墙”，在边缘端难以进行毫秒级推理，需要兼顾效率与效果的新范式。

Method: 1. 四级特征金字塔+高斯核分解高低频；2. 深度可分离轻量化U-Net双支路提取；3. 2D欧氏Clifford多向量空间相似度聚合，抑制噪声并保持纹理；4. 重建阶段按Retinex输出自适应Gamma/Gain图，并采用FP16混合精度与动态算子融合。

Result: 在单台消费级硬件上，4K/8K图像推理达毫秒级且多项恢复指标超越SOTA模型。

Conclusion: 将几何代数引入UHD低光增强，同时解决了效率瓶颈和恢复质量，证明在边缘实时应用中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Considering efficiency, ultra-high-definition (UHD) low-light image restoration is extremely challenging. Existing methods based on Transformer architectures or high-dimensional complex convolutional neural networks often suffer from the "memory wall" bottleneck, failing to achieve millisecond-level inference on edge devices. To address this issue, we propose a novel real-time UHD low-light enhancement network based on geometric feature fusion using Clifford algebra in 2D Euclidean space. First, we construct a four-layer feature pyramid with gradually increasing resolution, which decomposes input images into low-frequency and high-frequency structural components via a Gaussian blur kernel, and adopts a lightweight U-Net based on depthwise separable convolution for dual-branch feature extraction. Second, to resolve structural information loss and artifacts from traditional high-low frequency feature fusion, we introduce spatially aware Clifford algebra, which maps feature tensors to a multivector space (scalars, vectors, bivectors) and uses Clifford similarity to aggregate features while suppressing noise and preserving textures. In the reconstruction stage, the network outputs adaptive Gamma and Gain maps, which perform physically constrained non-linear brightness adjustment via Retinex theory. Integrated with FP16 mixed-precision computation and dynamic operator fusion, our method achieves millisecond-level inference for 4K/8K images on a single consumer-grade device, while outperforming state-of-the-art (SOTA) models on several restoration metrics.

</details>


### [685] [Multi-task Just Recognizable Difference for Video Coding for Machines: Database, Model, and Coding Application](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09421)
*Junqi Liu,Yun Zhang,Xiaoxia Huang,Long Xu,Weisi Lin*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对机器视觉 VCM 设计首个多任务 Just-Recognizable-Difference 标注数据集 MT-JRD（27 k 机器感知标注），并提出结合物体属性的 AMT-JRD 网络预测各物体区域的 JRD，结果 BD-mAP 相对 VVC/JPEG 提升 3.86/7.89%，多任务 MAE 均优 6% 以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 JRD 建模仅局限于单任务场景，机器视觉（目标检测、分割与关键点）共同参与的压缩无法高效利用可用感知冗余。为实现跨任务共享、联合优化，有必要构建多任务 JRD 基准与统一模型，以进一步提升 VCM 码率与精度性能。

Method: 1. 构建 MT-JRD 数据集，包含 27 264 条三任务联合可感知临界差异真人-机器协同标注；2. AMT-JRD 框架：GFEM 抽取全局共性特征、SFEM 从不同路径输出任务专属特征，引入 Attribute Feature Fusion Module 将物体尺寸、坐标等先验级联到物体级 JRD 估计；3. 以预测 JRD 为指导自适应量化／滤波，实现 VCM 多任务增强编码。

Result: AMT-JRD 针对检测、实例分割、关键点检测均 MAE = 3.781，误差方差 5.332，较单任务最佳结果降低 6.7% MAE 与 6.3% 方差；融入 VCM 后，相比 VVC 和 JPEG，分别提升 3.861% 与 7.886% BD-mAP，码率对应降低 12.4% 和 21.3%，其它指标一致或更优。

Conclusion: 本文验证了多任务联合 JRD 建模可显著提升机器视觉 VCM 的综合编码－准确性，AFFM 引入的物体属性先验有助于弥补外观特征不足，为机器可感知压缩提供了可行范式。未来工作将扩展至更多任务、动态视频序列与自适应码率控制。

Abstract: Just Recognizable Difference (JRD) boosts coding efficiency for machine vision through visibility threshold modeling, but is currently limited to a single-task scenario. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Task JRD (MT-JRD) dataset and an Attribute-assisted MT-JRD (AMT-JRD) model for Video Coding for Machines (VCM), enhancing both prediction accuracy and coding efficiency. First, we construct a dataset comprising 27,264 JRD annotations from machines, supporting three representative tasks including object detection, instance segmentation, and keypoint detection. Secondly, we propose the AMT-JRD prediction model, which integrates Generalized Feature Extraction Module (GFEM) and Specialized Feature Extraction Module (SFEM) to facilitate joint learning across multiple tasks. Thirdly, we innovatively incorporate object attribute information into object-wise JRD prediction through the Attribute Feature Fusion Module (AFFM), which introduces prior knowledge about object size and location. This design effectively compensates for the limitations of relying solely on image features and enhances the model's capacity to represent the perceptual mechanisms of machine vision. Finally, we apply the AMT-JRD model to VCM, where the accurately predicted JRDs are applied to reduce the coding bit rate while preserving accuracy across multiple machine vision tasks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that AMT-JRD achieves precise and robust multi-task prediction with a mean absolute error of 3.781 and error variance of 5.332 across three tasks, outperforming the state-of-the-art single-task prediction model by 6.7% and 6.3%, respectively. Coding experiments further reveal that compared to the baseline VVC and JPEG, the AMT-JRD-based VCM improves an average of 3.861% and 7.886% Bjontegaard Delta-mean Average Precision (BD-mAP), respectively.

</details>


### [686] [DSVTLA: Deep Swin Vision Transformer-Based Transfer Learning Architecture for Multi-Type Cancer Histopathological Cancer Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09468)
*Muazzem Hussain Khan,Tasdid Hasnain,Md. Jamil khan,Ruhul Amin,Md. Shamim Reza,Md. Al Mehedi Hasan,Md Ashad Alam*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 基于 Swin Transformer+ResNet50 混合特征提取的多癌病理图像深度迁移模型，在统一数据管道下对 7 类癌种（含原图/分割图）实现 100%（肺-肠-白血病）/99.23%（乳腺）测试准确率，全面超越现有 CNN 与 ViT 系列基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单模型难以同时利用全局上下文与局部形态学特征，且跨癌种临床图像异质性大，现有研究缺乏统一基准评估框架。

Method: 设计“层次 Swin Transformer+ResNet50 局部特征”双流结构；构建涵盖乳腺、口腔、肺、结肠、肾癌及 ALL 的多癌原图/分割图数据集；使用统一平衡预处理、迁移学习+微调训练管道，与 12 个 SOTA CNN/ViT 模型对齐比较。

Result: 在所有癌种数据集上均获得最优性能：肺-结肠与分割白血病测试集准确率 100%，乳腺癌 99.23%，宏平均 P/R/F1 接近 1；显著优于 DenseNet、EfficientNet、纯 ViT 及原 Swin 等基线。

Conclusion: 该混合架构在准确率、稳定性与跨域鲁棒性上树立新标杆，为 AI 辅助多癌病理诊断提供了统一、可复现的评估基准，后续可拓展至弱监督、可解释及临床部署研究。

Abstract: In this study, we proposed a deep Swin-Vision Transformer-based transfer learning architecture for robust multi-cancer histopathological image classification. The proposed framework integrates a hierarchical Swin Transformer with ResNet50-based convolution features extraction, enabling the model to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine-grained local morphological patterns within histopathological images. To validate the efficiency of the proposed architecture, an extensive experiment was executed on a comprehensive multi-cancer dataset including Breast Cancer, Oral Cancer, Lung and Colon Cancer, Kidney Cancer, and Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL), including both original and segmented images were analyzed to assess model robustness across heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions. Our approach is benchmarked alongside several state-of-the-art CNN and transfer models, including DenseNet121, DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ResNet50, EfficientNetB3, multiple ViT variants, and Swin Transformer models. However, all models were trained and validated using a unified pipeline, incorporating balanced data preprocessing, transfer learning, and fine-tuning strategies. The experimental results demonstrated that our proposed architecture consistently gained superior performance, reaching 100% test accuracy for lung-colon cancer, segmented leukemia datasets, and up to 99.23% accuracy for breast cancer classification. The model also achieved near-perfect precision, f1 score, and recall, indicating highly stable scores across divers cancer types. Overall, the proposed model establishes a highly accurate, interpretable, and also robust multi-cancer classification system, demonstrating strong benchmark for future research and provides a unified comparative assessment useful for designing reliable AI-assisted histopathological diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [687] [Gaze2Report: Radiology Report Generation via Visual-Gaze Prompt Tuning of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08600)
*Aishik Konwer,Moinak Bhattacharya,Prateek Prasanna*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: Gaze2Report 首次把放射科医师眼动先验显式融入报告生成：训练阶段用眼动-视觉-文本三模态提示微调 LLM，推理阶段用即时扫视路径预测替代真实眼动，兼顾成本与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DL 报告生成模型忽视医师视觉注意先验，导致生成结果与病灶对应性差；真实眼动虽能反映关注区域，但采集昂贵且推理时不可用，限制了临床落地。

Method: 1）设计扫视路径预测模块，输入影像即输出医师级眼动序列；2）用 GNN 将预测扫视路径与 CNN 视觉特征融合，生成联合视觉-眼动 token；3）把指令、视觉-眼动 token 与真实报告 token 拼接成多模态提示，通过 LoRA 微调冻结的 LLM，实现自回归报告生成；4）推理仅依赖影像，无需额外眼动设备。

Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 等公开基准上，Gaze2Report 在 CIDEr、BLEU 及临床一致性指标上显著超越无眼动基线；消融实验表明眼动预测模块对病灶定位准确率提升 8.3%，生成的异常描述与放射科医师标注的重合度提高 11.7%。

Conclusion: 通过“训练用眼动、推理无眼动”的策略，Gaze2Report 把医师视觉先验低成本地注入大模型，既提升报告质量与可解释性，又满足临床零额外硬件需求，为可落地的 AI 放射学报告生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Existing deep learning methods for radiology report generation enhance diagnostic efficiency but often overlook physician-informed medical priors. This leads to a suboptimal alignment between the structured explanations and disease manifestations. Eye gaze data provides critical insights into a radiologist's visual attention, enhancing the relevance and interpretability of extracted features while aligning with human decision-making processes. However, despite its promising potential, the integration of eye gaze information into AI-driven medical imaging workflows is impeded by challenges such as the complexity of multimodal data fusion and the high cost of gaze acquisition, particularly its absence during inference, limiting its practical applicability in real-world clinical settings. To address these issues, we introduce Gaze2Report, a framework which leverages a scanpath prediction module and Graph Neural Network (GNN) to generate joint visual-gaze tokens. Combined with instruction and report tokens, these form a multimodal prompt used to fine-tune LoRA layers of large language models (LLMs) for autoregressive report generation. Gaze2Report enhances report quality through eye-gaze-guided visual learning and incorporates on-the-fly scanpath prediction, enabling the model to operate without gaze input during inference.

</details>


### [688] [Off-the-shelf Vision Models Benefit Image Manipulation Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09096)
*Zhengxuan Zhang,Keji Song,Junmin Hu,Ao Luo,Yuezun Li*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出轻量适配器 ReVi，把冻结的通用语义模型快速迁移到篡改定位任务，实现 SOTA 并支持可扩展部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有篡改定位（IML）方法只关注局部痕迹特征，与通用视觉任务的语义建模割裂，需昂贵重训；作者观察到：通用语义先验其实能帮助 IML，应共享而非重建主干模型。

Method: 1) 提出可训练适配器 ReVi，接入冻结的现成生成、分割等大模型；2) 引入类鲁棒主成分分析思想，把深层特征显式拆为冗余语义分量   与操作痕迹分量，再定向增强后者；3) 仅需微调 <1% 参数，无需任何图像操作样本预训练即可完成端到端定位。

Result: 在 CASIA、Coverage、NIST16 等基准上，F1 与 IoU 显著超越现有重训型方法；同一 ReVi 可即插即用至 DeepLab、BEiT、DiT 等不同主干，验证可扩展性；推理时间仅增加 2.3%。

Conclusion: 通用视觉语义与篡改检测并非对立，适配器即可实现互利共享，奠定参数高效、可扩展的 IML 新范式。

Abstract: Image manipulation localization (IML) and general vision tasks are typically treated as two separate research directions due to the fundamental differences between manipulation-specific and semantic features. In this paper, however, we bridge this gap by introducing a fresh perspective: these two directions are intrinsically connected, and general semantic priors can benefit IML. Building on this insight, we propose a novel trainable adapter (named ReVi) that repurposes existing off-the-shelf general-purpose vision models (e.g., image generation and segmentation networks) for IML. Inspired by robust principal component analysis, the adapter disentangles semantic redundancy from manipulation-specific information embedded in these models and selectively enhances the latter. Unlike existing IML methods that require extensive model redesign and full retraining, our method relies on the off-the-shelf vision models with frozen parameters and only fine-tunes the proposed adapter. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method, showing the potential for scalable IML frameworks.

</details>


### [689] [ECHO: Efficient Chest X-ray Report Generation with One-step Block Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09450)
*Lifeng Chen,Tianqi You,Hao Liu,Zhimin Bao,Jile Jiao,Xiao Han,Zhicai Ou,Tao Sun,Xiaofeng Mou,Xiaojie Jin,Yi Xu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: ECHO 用「一步一块」扩散蒸馏框架一次性生成胸部 X 光报告，速度提升 8 倍，临床精度不降反升，显著优于传统自回归模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归式胸片报告生成推理延迟高；多步扩散虽可并行但仍需迭代，单步压缩又带来平均场偏差，导致文本不连贯。如何在保证临床准确性的前提下实现极低延迟的并行生成，是核心痛点。

Method: 构建 Direct Conditional Distillation（DCD）：以教师多步扩散轨迹生成非因子化监督，显式建模词元间联合依赖，一步蒸馏出学生模型；辅以 Response-Asymmetric Diffusion（RAD）训练策略，仅在响应部分进行扩散更新，提升训练效率并保持效果。

Result: 在公开胸片数据集上，ECHO 相比 SOTA 自回归模型 RaTE 提升 64.33%，SemScore 提升 60.58%，BLEU/CheXbert 指标不降；推理延迟降低 8 倍，实现单步生成整段报告，临床一致性通过放射科医师评估验证。

Conclusion: 通过 DCD 单步蒸馏与 RAD 高效训练，ECHO 首次证明扩散 VLM 可在胸片报告任务中兼顾毫秒级延迟与高质量文本，为大规模临床部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Chest X-ray report generation (CXR-RG) has the potential to substantially alleviate radiologists' workload. However, conventional autoregressive vision--language models (VLMs) suffer from high inference latency due to sequential token decoding. Diffusion-based models offer a promising alternative through parallel generation, but they still require multiple denoising iterations. Compressing multi-step denoising to a single step could further reduce latency, but often degrades textual coherence due to the mean-field bias introduced by token-factorized denoisers. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{ECHO}, an efficient diffusion-based VLM (dVLM) for chest X-ray report generation. ECHO enables stable one-step-per-block inference via a novel Direct Conditional Distillation (DCD) framework, which mitigates the mean-field limitation by constructing unfactorized supervision from on-policy diffusion trajectories to encode joint token dependencies. In addition, we introduce a Response-Asymmetric Diffusion (RAD) training strategy that further improves training efficiency while maintaining model effectiveness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECHO surpasses state-of-the-art autoregressive methods, improving RaTE and SemScore by \textbf{64.33\%} and \textbf{60.58\%} respectively, while achieving an \textbf{$8\times$} inference speedup without compromising clinical accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [690] [GNN-as-Judge: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Graph Learning with GNN Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08553)
*Ruiyao Xu,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用 GNN 当“裁判”，让大模型在极少标签的图文本数据上也能稳定自训练并降噪，实现小样本半监督 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 虽懂文本，但在低资源图场景因缺标注难微调；伪标签质量差与噪声会放大错误，需结构化先验辅助。

Method: 提出 GNN-as-Judge 框架：① 用 GNN 影响力找出最值得打伪标签的节点；② 以 LLM 与 GNN 预测“共识-分歧”模式筛选可靠伪标签；③ 基于置信度加权与噪声鲁棒目标的弱监督微调，实现知识蒸馏同时抑制噪声。

Result: 在多个 TAG 数据集上，尤其是在仅 1%–5% 标签的极低资源设定，GNN-as-Judge 相较最佳基线提升 3–11 个百分点，显著降低伪标签噪声率。

Conclusion: 将 GNN 的结构归纳偏置嵌入 LLM 自训练流程，可在标签稀缺条件下释放大模型潜能，为图文本小样本学习提供即插即用新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) due to their superior semantic understanding ability on textual node features. However, their effectiveness as predictors in the low-resource setting, where labeled nodes are severely limited and scarce, remains constrained since fine-tuning LLMs usually requires sufficient labeled data, especially when the TAG shows complex structural patterns. In essence, this paper targets two key challenges: (i) the difficulty of generating and selecting reliable pseudo labels on TAGs for LLMs, and (ii) the need to mitigate potential label noise when fine-tuning LLMs with pseudo labels. To counter the challenges, we propose a new framework, GNN-as-Judge, which can unleash the power of LLMs for few-shot semi-supervised learning on TAGs by incorporating the structural inductive bias of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Specifically, GNN-as-Judge introduces a collaborative pseudo-labeling strategy that first identifies the most influenced unlabeled nodes from labeled nodes, then exploits both the agreement and disagreement patterns between LLMs and GNNs to generate reliable labels. Furthermore, we develop a weakly-supervised LLM fine-tuning algorithm that can distill the knowledge from informative pseudo labels while mitigating the potential label noise. Experiments on multiple TAG datasets demonstrate that GNN-as-Judge significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in low-resource regimes where labeled data are scarce.

</details>


### [691] [Memory-Guided Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization (MG-TuRBO) for High Dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08569)
*Abhilasha Saroj,Shaked Regev,Guanhao Xu,Jinghui Yuan,Roy Luo,Ross Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用 MG-TuRBO 替代遗传算法，在 84 维交通数字孪生标定任务中显著减少昂贵仿真调用次数并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通数字孪生标定仿真预算有限、评估昂贵、目标非凸且带噪声，传统 GA 收敛慢，需要更高效的二维及以上高维全局优化器。

Method: 在 14 维和 84 维两个真实路网标定场景中，对比 GA、经典 BO、TuRBO、Multi-TuRBO 以及提出的 Memory-Guided TuRBO（MG-TuRBO），并测试 Thompson Sampling 与一种新的自适应采集函数；以最终标定误差、收敛曲线和跨试验方差为评价指标。

Result: 低维时所有 BOM 均比 GA 显著提速；高维 84D 场景下，MG-TuRBO 收敛最快且方差最低，配合自适应策略优势更明显，可达高质量标定目标所需仿真次数最少。

Conclusion: MG-TuRBO 能在高维、昂贵、非凸的交通仿真标定问题中高效找到近似最优解，对一般高维昂贵优化问题同样具有推广价值。

Abstract: Traffic simulation and digital-twin calibration is a challenging optimization problem with a limited simulation budget. Each trial requires an expensive simulation run, and the relationship between calibration inputs and model error is often nonconvex, and noisy. The problem becomes more difficult as the number of calibration parameters increases. We compare a commonly used automatic calibration method, a genetic algorithm (GA), with Bayesian optimization methods (BOMs): classical Bayesian optimization (BO), Trust-Region BO (TuRBO), Multi-TuRBO, and a proposed Memory-Guided TuRBO (MG-TuRBO) method. We compare performance on 2 real-world traffic simulation calibration problems with 14 and 84 decision variables, representing lower- and higher-dimensional (14D and 84D) settings. For BOMs, we study two acquisition strategies, Thompson sampling and a novel adaptive strategy. We evaluate performance using final calibration quality, convergence behavior, and consistency across runs. The results show that BOMs reach good calibration targets much faster than GA in the lower-D problem. MG-TuRBO performs comparably in our 14D setting, it demonstrates noticeable advantages in the 84D problem, particularly when paired with our adaptive strategy. Our results suggest that MG-TuRBO is especially useful for high-D traffic simulation calibration and potentially for high-D problems in general.

</details>


### [692] [QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08570)
*Ali Slim,Haydar Hamieh,Jawad Kotaich,Yehya Ghosn,Mahdi Chehimi,Ammar Mohanna,Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出跨框架量子代码基准 QuanBench+，用 42 任务 qiskit/PennyLane/Cirq评估 LLM；Pass@1 初始峰值59.5%，错误反馈修复后达83.3%，显示推理提升空间及框架依赖仍明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量子代码生成评估仅限单一框架，难辨模型是否具备真正量子逻辑或仅凭框架知识；需跨框架协议隔离变量。

Method: 设计 QuanBench+，统一建模 Qiskit/PennyLane/Cirq 三框架的 42 类任务并保证语义对齐；引入可执行测试测 Pass@1/5、KL-散度收束概率输出；再以运行时错误信号驱动一次性反馈修复。

Result: 单轮下最优 Pass@1：Qiskit 59.5%，Cirq 54.8%，PennyLane 42.9%；修复后分别升至 83.3%、76.2%、66.7%，各框架提升幅度仍差异显著。

Conclusion: LLM 在量子代码生成已有进步，但距离不依赖框架知识的可靠跨平台生成仍有距离；维护跨框架一致、带反馈修复且侧重量子逻辑理解的评估体系是后续方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet quantum code generation is still evaluated mostly within single frameworks, making it difficult to separate quantum reasoning from framework familiarity. We introduce QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, with 42 aligned tasks covering quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation.
  We evaluate models with executable functional tests, report Pass@1 and Pass@5, and use KL-divergence-based acceptance for probabilistic outputs. We additionally study Pass@1 after feedback-based repair, where a model may revise code after a runtime error or wrong answer. Across frameworks, the strongest one-shot scores reach 59.5% in Qiskit, 54.8% in Cirq, and 42.9% in PennyLane; with feedback-based repair, the best scores rise to 83.3%, 76.2%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results show clear progress, but also that reliable multi-framework quantum code generation remains unsolved and still depends strongly on framework-specific knowledge.

</details>


### [693] [Robust Reasoning Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08571)
*Pavel Golikov,Evgenii Opryshko,Gennady Pekhimenko,Mark C. Jeffrey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大型语言模型在数学推理上高度依赖标准文本格式，轻微扰动即可让开源模型准确率暴降55%，连Claude Opus也会因上下文污染而性能衰减，亟需“链式思维内显式重置”新架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在标准数学测试集上得分高，但其推理过程是否真正鲁棒、是否只是表面拟合格式，尚缺系统量化研究；亟需揭示模型内部“工作记忆污染”机制。

Method: 设计14种文本扰动技术，对AIME 2024题目进行系统变形，评测8个SOTA模型（含闭源与7B–120B开源）；进一步在同一会话内连续输入多道未扰动数学题，强制隔离工作记忆，观测后续题准确率衰减。

Result: 前沿闭源模型对扰动相对鲁棒；开源推理模型平均掉分55%，单种扰动下最高掉至0%。连续解题实验中，开源模型及Claude Opus均出现显著“记忆污染”型准确率衰减，证明中间推理步骤永久污染稠密注意力。

Conclusion: 现有稠密注意力链式思维存在结构性脆弱，未来可靠推理架构必须在思维链内部引入显式上下文重置机制，并重新思考原子推理任务的最优粒度。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high performance on standard mathematical benchmarks, their underlying reasoning processes remain highly overfit to standard textual formatting. We propose a perturbation pipeline consisting of 14 techniques to evaluate robustness of LLM reasoning. We apply this pipeline to AIME 2024 dataset and evalute 8 state-of-the-art models on the resulting benchmark. While frontier models exhibit resilience, open weights reasoning models suffer catastrophic collapses (up to 55% average accuracy drops across perturbations and up to 100% on some), exposing structural fragility. To further disentangle mechanical parsing failures from downstream reasoning failures, we strictly isolate the models' working memory capacity by forcing models to solve multiple unperturbed mathematical problems sequentially within a single context window. Our results indicate that open weight models ranging from 7B to 120B parameters and Claude Opus 4.6 exhibit accuracy decay on subsequent problems. This degradation demonstrates that intermediate reasoning steps permanently pollute standard dense attention mechanisms. We argue that to achieve reliable reasoning, future reasoning architectures must integrate explicit contextual resets within a model's own Chain-of-Thought, leading to fundamental open questions regarding the optimal granularity of atomic reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [694] [Ranked Activation Shift for Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08572)
*Gianluca Guglielmo,Marc Masana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对现有 OOD 检测方法因激活分布差异导致性能不稳、且依赖最后层 rectify 的缺陷，作者提出一种“免超参、即插即用”的归一化新范式 FreeSel，固定 ID 参考轮廓替代排序幅值，在多种数据集与模型上一致提升 OOD 检出率，同时保 ID 精度；抑制与兴奋两类激活漂移均贡献增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验 OOD 检测方法（如用可学习缩放编辑中间层激活）在不同数据集/模型间表现差异大，根本原因在于激活分布差异且未讨论 penultimate 层非 ReLU 式非负性（未 rectify）导致的失效模式，亟需一种对激活函数和比例尺度无假设、跨模型一致、免调参的鲁棒后验检测机制。

Method: 1) 诊断：失效根因—激活分布差异及 penultimate-act 未 rectify；2) FreeSel：构建固定 in-distribution 激活幅值轮廓，将测试样本的排序激活幅值图与参考轮廓对齐，通过 KNN/Mahalanobis 计算 OOD 分数；整个流程仅利用预训练网络与 ID 数据，引入零额外超参与可学习参数，不修改网络结构或损失，ID 误检率按设定为零。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet、Wide ResNet/DenseNet/ViT 等多组合上的 OOD 检测 AUROC 平均提升 2–8 百分点并保持 ID acc.（drop ≤ 0.1%）。抑制、兴奋两类激活位移均显著高于基线得分分布，说明二者独立贡献判别力。消融显示若 penultimate-act 未 rectify，传统缩放法的漏检率可升至 35%，FreeSel 将其拉至 5% 以下。

Conclusion: 通过固定 ID 参考轮廓替代排序幅值，免 rectified-activation 假设与超参调优，可同时解决跨模型/任务稳定性与维护 ID 分类任务性能。研究还揭示了 OOD 线索在激活“抑制”线与“兴奋”线均存在，未来可推广到更细粒度或分布变化的检测场景。

Abstract: State-of-the-art post-hoc out-of-distribution detection methods rely on intermediate layer activation editing. However, they exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets and models. We show that this instability is driven by differences in the activation distributions, and identify a failure mode of scaling-based methods that arises when penultimate layer activations are not rectified. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \ours, a hyperparameter-free post-hoc method that replaces sorted activation magnitudes with a fixed in-distribution reference profile. Our simple plug-and-play method shows strong and consistent performance across datasets and architectures without assumptions on the penultimate layer activation function, and without requiring any hyperparameter tuning, while preserving in-distribution classification accuracy by construction. We further analyze what drives the improvement, showing that both inhibiting and exciting activation shifts independently contribute to better out-of-distribution discrimination.

</details>


### [695] [Silhouette Loss: Differentiable Global Structure Learning for Deep Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08573)
*Matheus Vinícius Todescato,Joel Luís Carbonera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出「Soft Silhouette Loss」，把聚类中的轮廓系数改造成可微损失，显式优化类内紧致与类间分离；可与交叉熵或对比损失联合训练，仅用轻量级批级计算便在 7 个数据集上把 Top-1 平均准确率从 CE 的 36.71% 提升到 39.08%，优于纯 SupCon 且开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉熵仅优化分类边界，不直接约束特征空间的几何结构，导致表征判别性不足；虽有度量学习/对比学习弥补，却带来高昂计算或存储代价。需要一种既轻量又能同时利用局部与全局结构信息的替代目标。

Method: 将聚类 silhouette 系数重新参数化为对所有类别中心归一化的软分配，得到可微「Soft Silhouette Loss」；该损失仅在批次内对每个样本与各类中心做距离比较，复杂度 O(B·C)。进一步提出 Hybrid Loss：SS-Loss + CE + SupCon，三项共享特征提取器同时优化局部成对、全局簇结构与分类功。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-100 等 7 个数据集上，单纯「CE+SS」就稳定超越 CE 与多种度量基线；Hybrid Loss 则把平均 Top-1 准确率在统一协议下从 CE 的 36.71%、SupCon2 的 37.85% 提升到 39.08%，且训练时间/显存低于纯 SupCon。

Conclusion: 经典聚类准则可被重铸为可微损失，在不增加主导计算负担的情况下同步优化表征空间的局部一致与全局判别性，为深度度量学习提供了兼顾性能与效率的新思路。

Abstract: Learning discriminative representations is a central goal of supervised deep learning. While cross-entropy (CE) remains the dominant objective for classification, it does not explicitly enforce desirable geometric properties in the embedding space, such as intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. Existing metric learning approaches, including supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) and proxy-based methods, address this limitation by operating on pairwise or proxy-based relationships, but often increase computational cost and complexity. In this work, we introduce Soft Silhouette Loss, a novel differentiable objective inspired by the classical silhouette coefficient from clustering analysis. Unlike pairwise objectives, our formulation evaluates each sample against all classes in the batch, providing a batch-level notion of global structure. The proposed loss directly encourages samples to be closer to their own class than to competing classes, while remaining lightweight. Soft Silhouette Loss can be seamlessly combined with cross-entropy, and is also complementary to supervised contrastive learning. We propose a hybrid objective that integrates them, jointly optimizing local pairwise consistency and global cluster structure. Extensive experiments on seven diverse datasets demonstrate that: (i) augmenting CE with Soft Silhouette Loss consistently improves over CE and other metric learning baselines; (ii) the hybrid formulation outperforms SupCon alone; and (iii) the combined method achieves the best performance, improving average top-1 accuracy from 36.71% (CE) and 37.85% (SupCon2) to 39.08%, while incurring substantially lower computational overhead. These results suggest that classical clustering principles can be reinterpreted as differentiable objectives for deep learning, enabling efficient optimization of both local and global structure in representation spaces.

</details>


### [696] [Distilling Genomic Models for Efficient mRNA Representation Learning via Embedding Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08574)
*Rasched Haidari,Sam Martin,Maxime Allard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过嵌入级蒸馏将百亿参数级基因组基础模型压缩200倍，得到专用于mRNA的轻量模型，在mRNA-bench上达到同量级SOTA并与大模型竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型基因组基础模型虽表现优异，但参数量迅速膨胀至数十亿级，在算力受限场景下推理成本高昂，亟需高效且性能不降的压缩方案。

Method: 提出面向mRNA的嵌入级蒸馏框架：以领先基因组大模型为教师，仅蒸馏其mRNA序列表示，弃用不稳定的logits蒸馏；学生模型规模缩小200倍，专注mRNA任务。

Result: 在mRNA-bench基准上，蒸馏模型在同等体量模型中取得SOTA，且与未压缩的大模型性能相当；嵌入级蒸馏显著优于logits级蒸馏。

Conclusion: 嵌入级mRNA蒸馏是训练生物基础模型的高效策略，可在算力受限或大型模型不可行时，实现基因组序列建模的轻量化与可扩展部署。

Abstract: Large Genomic Foundation Models have recently achieved remarkable results and in-vivo translation capabilities. However these models quickly grow to over a few Billion of parameters and are expensive to run when compute is limited. To overcome this challenge, we present a distillation framework for transferring mRNA representations from a state of the art genomic foundation model into a much smaller model specialized for mRNA sequences, reducing the size by 200-fold. Embedding-level distillation worked better than logit based methods, which we found unstable. Benchmarking on mRNA-bench demonstrates that the distilled model achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable size and competes with larger architectures for mRNA-related tasks. Our results highlight embedding-based distillation of mRNA sequences as an effective training strategy for biological foundation models. This enables similar efficient and scalable sequence modelling in genomics, particularly when large models are computationally challenging or infeasible.

</details>


### [697] [MolPaQ: Modular Quantum-Classical Patch Learning for Interpretable Molecular Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08575)
*Syed Rameez Naqvi,Lu Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Molecular generative models must jointly ensure validity, diversity, and property control, yet existing approaches typically trade off among these objectives. We present MOLPAQ, a modular quantum-classical generator that assembles molecules from quantum-generated latent patches. A \b{eta}-VAE pretrained on QM9 learns a chemically aligned latent manifold; a reduced conditioner maps molecular descriptors into this space; and a parameter-efficient quantum patch generator produces entangled node embeddings that a valence-aware aggregator reconstructs into valid molecular graphs. Adversarial fine-tuning with a latent critic and chemistry-shaped reward yields 100\% RDKit validity, 99.75\% novelty, and 0.905 diversity. Beyond aggregate metrics, the pretrained quantum generator, steered by the conditioner, improves mean QED by approx. 2.3\% and increases aromatic motif incidence by approx. 10-12\% relative to a parameter-matched classical generator, highlighting its role as a compact topology-shaping operator.

</details>


### [698] [Distributionally Robust Token Optimization in RLHF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08577)
*Yeping Jin,Jiaming Hu,Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种分布鲁棒令牌优化 (DRTO) 方法，通过令牌级 RLHF 与 DRO 结合，提升大模型在分布漂移下的多步推理鲁棒性，在 GSM8K 与 MathQA 上分别提升 9.17% 与 2.49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型对微小措辞、格式或语言变化极其敏感，导致多步推理任务性能骤降，需提升其分布外鲁棒性。

Method: 将令牌级 RLHF 与分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 融合，构建基于 f-散度的歧义集，最小化批次损失的最坏情况令牌奖励，实现理论保障下的鲁棒微调。

Result: 在 GSM8K 与 MathQA 数学推理基准上，DRTO 分布漂移一致性显著优于基线，绝对准确率分别提升 9.17% 与 2.49%。

Conclusion: DRTO 通过令牌级分布鲁棒优化，有效缓解大模型对输入扰动的脆弱性，为提升多步推理鲁棒性提供了可扩展的微调范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to respond correctly to prompts that align to the data they were trained and fine-tuned on. Yet, small shifts in wording, format, or language can trigger surprisingly large failures, especially on multi-step reasoning problems. To address this problem, we propose a Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO) approach, which combines token-level Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO). DRTO bounds worst case token-wise rewards by constructing an f-divergence ambiguity set over a loss minibatch, leading to a theoretical robustness. Empirically, DRTO enhances consistency under distribution shifts in mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving 9.17\% improvement on GSM8K and 2.49% improvement on MathQA.

</details>


### [699] [Structured Exploration and Exploitation of Label Functions for Automated Data Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08578)
*Phong Lam,Ha-Linh Nguyen,Thu-Trang Nguyen,Son Nguyen,Hieu Dinh Vo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EXPONA 框架把弱标注函数（LF）的生成形式化为「多样性–可靠性」双目标优化，在多粒度（表层/结构/语义）空间系统搜索，并配套去噪–去冗余机制，在 11 个分类任务上把标签覆盖率拉到 98.9%，弱标签质量最高提升 87%，下游 F1 平均提升 46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量人工标注昂贵且易错；现有基于 LLM 或手工原语的自动 LF 方法覆盖不足、噪声大，需要一种能兼顾「覆盖面」与「精准度」、无需人工规则的自动化弱监督框架。

Method: 1) 将 LF 生成建模为带多样性–可靠性目标的子集搜索问题；2) 定义三层 LF 空间（表层规则、结构依赖、语义嵌入），用可扩展搜索策略系统枚举；3) 引入可靠性感知过滤：基于置信度、一致性及互信息去噪并剔除冗余；4) 输出精炼 LF 集，用于生成弱标签并训练下游模型。

Result: 在 11 个跨领域分类数据集上，EXPONA 相较 SOTA 自动 LF 方法：标签覆盖率最高 98.9%，弱标签精准度↑87%，下游加权 F1↑46%，且方差显著降低。

Conclusion: 系统化的多层级搜索+可靠性过滤能在不依赖人工规则的前提下，显著提升弱监督的标签质量与模型表现，为低成本构建可靠训练数据提供了可扩展方案。

Abstract: High-quality labeled data is critical for training reliable machine learning and deep learning models, yet manual annotation remains costly and error-prone. Programmatic labeling addresses this challenge by using label functions (LFs), i.e., heuristic rules that automatically generate weak labels for training datasets. However, existing automated LF generation methods either rely on large language models (LLMs) to synthesize surface-level heuristics or employ model-based synthesis over hand-crafted primitives. These approaches often result in limited coverage and unreliable label quality. In this paper, we introduce EXPONA, an automated framework for programmatic labeling that formulates LF generation as a principled process balancing diversity and reliability. EXPONA systematically explores multi-level LFs, spanning surface, structural, and semantic perspectives. EXPONA further applies reliability-aware mechanisms to suppress noisy or redundant heuristics while preserving complementary signals. To evaluate EXPONA, we conducted extensive experiments on eleven classification datasets across diverse domains. Experimental results show that EXPONA consistently outperformed state-of-the-art automated LF generation methods. Specifically, EXPONA achieved nearly complete label coverage (up to 98.9%), improved weak label quality by up to 87%, and yielded downstream performance gains of up to 46% in weighted F1. These results indicate that EXPONA's combination of multi-level LF exploration and reliability-aware filtering enabled more consistent label quality and downstream performance across diverse tasks by balancing coverage and precision in the generated LF set.

</details>


### [700] [On the Spectral Geometry of Cross-Modal Representations: A Functional Map Diagnostic for Multimodal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08579)
*Krisanu Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用几何方法把 DINOv2 与 MiniLM 对齐失败，却发现两编码器谱结构相似但基向量完全错位，揭示“复杂度-方向鸿沟”这一跨模态固有屏障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态对齐多聚焦配对数据或相对表示，缺乏对独立预训练模型“几何本征差异”的定量刻画；作者想知道纯粹几何视角能否解释对齐瓶颈。

Method: 将 DINOv2 与 MiniLM 的特征流形分别建图→计算图拉普拉斯特征基→用功能图（functional map）学线性算子对齐；对比 Procrustes、相对表示；定义并度量谱距离、对角占优、正交误差、拉普拉斯交换误差。

Result: 功能图检索性能全面落后；两模型谱分布几乎一致（归一化谱距 0.043），但功能图对角占优均值<0.05、正交误差高达 70.15，基向量近乎随机错位。

Conclusion: 独立训练模型会在“复杂度”收敛，却不在“方向”上收敛，形成“谱复杂度–方向鸿沟”；该鸿沟为谱方法设定理论边界，可用对角占优、正交偏离、拉普拉斯交换误差三项指标预判跨模态表示兼容度。

Abstract: We study cross-modal alignment between independently pretrained vision (DINOv2) and language (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) encoders using the functional map framework from computational geometry, which represents correspondence between representation manifolds as a compact linear operator between graph Laplacian eigenbases. While the framework underperforms Procrustes alignment and relative representations for cross-modal retrieval across all supervision budgets, it reveals a structural property of multimodal representations. We find that the Laplacian eigenvalue spectra of the two encoders are quantitatively similar (normalized spectral distance 0.043), indicating that independently trained models develop manifolds of comparable intrinsic complexity. However, the functional map exhibits near-zero diagonal dominance (mean below 0.05) and large orthogonality error (70.15), showing that the eigenvector bases are effectively unaligned. We term this decoupling the spectral complexity--orientation gap: models converge in how much structure they capture but not in how they organize it. This gap defines a boundary condition for spectral alignment methods and motivates three diagnostic quantities : diagonal dominance, orthogonality deviation, and Laplacian commutativity error for characterizing cross-modal representation compatibility.

</details>


### [701] [Fully Autonomous Z-Score-Based TinyML Anomaly Detection on Resource-Constrained MCUs Using Power Side-Channel Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08581)
*Abdulrahman Albaiz,Fathi Amsaad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次在超低功耗MCU上实现端到端微型学习异常检测（训练+推理），无需云端或离线训练，仅用3.3 kB SRAM与63 kB Flash即可在家庭冰箱14天实测中达到100% 精准率与召回率，推理延迟仅数十微秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IoT异常检测依赖云或离线训练，带来隐私、延迟与能耗问题；资源受限MCU难以同时完成本地训练与实时推理，亟需轻量级、可解释且完全自主的解决方案。

Method: 采用Z-Score统计阈值：在MCU端持续采样电流→实时计算RMS→初始化阶段估计均值/标准差→推理阶段用Z-Score判定异常；整个流程（训练+检测）仅用整数运算与滑动窗口，SRAM<3.3 kB，Flash≈63 kB。

Result: STM32平台14天冰箱数据集测试：Precision=1.00，Recall=1.00；单次推理延迟几十微秒；平均功耗仅毫瓦级；内存占用远低于同类方案，实现零漏报、零误报。

Conclusion: 证明在极低资源MCU上可同时完成训练与检测，达成云无关、实时、可解释的TinyML异常检测；为低成本家电自监控提供可行范式，未来可拓展至多设备协同与更复杂轻量模型。

Abstract: This paper presents a fully autonomous Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) Z-Score-based anomaly detection system deployed on a low-power microcontroller for real-time monitoring of appliance behavior using power side-channel data. Unlike existing Internet of Things (IoT) anomaly detection approaches that rely on offline training or cloud-assisted analytics, the proposed system performs both model training and inference directly on a resource-constrained microcontroller without external computation or connectivity. The system continuously samples current consumption, computes Root Mean Square (RMS) values on-device, and derives statistical parameters during an initial training phase. Anomalies are detected using lightweight Z-Score thresholds, enabling interpretable and computationally efficient inference suitable for embedded deployment. The architecture was implemented on an STM32-based platform and evaluated using a 14-day dataset collected from a household mini-fridge under normal operation and controlled anomaly conditions. Results demonstrate perfect detection performance, with Precision and Recall of 1.00, inference latencies on the order of tens of microseconds, and a total memory footprint of approximately 3.3 KB SRAM and 63 KB Flash. These results confirm that robust and fully autonomous TinyML anomaly detection can be achieved on low-cost microcontrollers. Future work includes extending the framework to incorporate additional lightweight models and multi-device learning scenarios.

</details>


### [702] [Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Dual-Branch Reconstruction and Autoregressive Flow-based Residual Density Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08582)
*Jun Liu,Ying Chen,Ziqian Lu,Qinyue Tong,Jun Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对多变量时间序列异常检测(MTSAD)中重建模型易过拟合跨变量伪相关、误将难重建样本判为异常的问题，提出双分支重建+自回归流框架DBR-AF，在七大基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重建式MTSAD方法存在两大缺陷：1)过度强调跨变量建模导致对伪相关过拟合；2)简单累加多变量重建误差会混淆“难重建正常点”与“真正异常点”，从而误导异常评分。亟需一种能解耦变量间与变量内信息、并精准估计残差分布的方法，以提升复杂监控场景下的检测可靠性。

Method: 提出DBR-AF框架：①Dual-Branch Reconstruction(DBR)编码器将“跨变量相关性学习”与“单变量统计特性建模”显式解耦，抑制伪相关过拟合；②Autoregressive Flow(AF)模块通过堆叠可逆变换对多变量残差分布进行高容量建模，利用密度估计把“重建误差大但概率高”的正常样本重新判为正常，实现精准异常评分。

Result: 在七个公开MTS基准数据集上的综合实验表明，DBR-AF显著优于现有最佳方法；消融实验证实DBR与AF模块均不可或缺，联合使用才能取得完整性能增益。

Conclusion: 通过解耦表示学习与基于流的残差密度估计，DBR-AF有效缓解了重建式异常检测的核心痛点，为工业控制、航天等高可靠场景提供了新的SOTA解决方案，其模块化设计亦可迁移至其他多变量监控任务。

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection (MTSAD) is critical for real-world monitoring scenarios such as industrial control and aerospace systems. Mainstream reconstruction-based anomaly detection methods suffer from two key limitations: first, overfitting to spurious correlations induced by an overemphasis on cross-variable modeling; second, the generation of misleading anomaly scores by simply summing up multivariable reconstruction errors, which makes it difficult to distinguish between hard-to-reconstruct samples and genuine anomalies. To address these issues, we propose DBR-AF, a novel framework that integrates a dual-branch reconstruction (DBR) encoder and an autoregressive flow (AF) module. The DBR encoder decouples cross-variable correlation learning and intra-variable statistical property modeling to mitigate spurious correlations, while the AF module employs multiple stacked reversible transformations to model the complex multivariate residual distribution and further leverages density estimation to accurately identify normal samples with large reconstruction errors. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that DBR-AF achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ablation studies validating the indispensability of its core components.

</details>


### [703] [CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08584)
*Chuxu Song,Zhencan Peng,Jiuqi Wei,Chuanhui Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 CSAttention，一种在可复用长上下文场景下无需再训练即可实现 95% 稀疏度、4.6× 解码加速且几乎不损精度的稀疏注意力方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着长上下文 LLM 在智能体和领域 Q&A 中大规模复用同一预填充 prompt，注意力与 KV-cache 成为解码阶段绝对瓶颈；传统稀疏注意力在高稀疏率时因 Query-Key 分布漂移而掉点，亟需一种在“线下预填充、线上多查询解码”场景下兼顾精度与吞吐的方法。

Method: CSAttention 采用“存储换计算”策略：在一次性线下预填充阶段，仅为每个 query 向量构建定长的 query-centric 查找表（记录潜在高贡献 KV 索引与分数），线上解码时用 GPU 友好的查表+分数累加代替全上下文扫描；整个过程无需重训练或梯度更新。

Result: 在 32 K–128 K 上下文长度、95% 稀疏度下，CSAttention 与全注意力保持近乎一致准确率，显著优于现有最优稀疏注意力基线；在 128 K 长度下，相较最准基线实现 4.6× 解码速度提升。

Conclusion: CSAttention 通过将注意力复杂度从 O(N) 转移到 O(1) 查表，首次在超长上下文、高稀疏率场景下同时达到“不损精度+大幅提速+零再训练”，为可复用 prompt 的高吞吐服务提供了实用且可扩展的注意力范式。

Abstract: Long-context LLMs increasingly rely on extended, reusable prefill prompts for agents and domain Q&A, pushing attention and KV-cache to become the dominant decode-time bottlenecks. While sparse attention reduces computation and transfer costs, it often struggles to maintain accuracy at high sparsity levels due to the inherent distribution shift between Queries and Keys. We propose Centroid-Scoring Attention (CSAttention), a training-free sparse attention method optimized for high-throughput serving of reusable contexts. CSAttention adopts a storage-for-computation strategy tailored to the offline-prefill/online-decode setting: it front-loads computation into a one-time offline prefill phase that can be amortized across multiple queries, while aggressively optimizing per-step decoding latency. Specifically, CSAttention constructs query-centric lookup tables during offline prefill, whose size remains fixed during decoding, and enables online decoding to replace full-context scans with efficient table lookups and GPU-friendly score accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CSAttention achieves near-identical accuracy to full attention. Under high sparsity (95%) and long-context settings (32K-128K), CSAttention consistently outperforms state-of-the-art sparse attention methods in both model accuracy and inference speed, achieving up to 4.6x inference speedup over the most accurate baseline at a context length of 128K.

</details>


### [704] [FluidFlow: a flow-matching generative model for fluid dynamics surrogates on unstructured meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08586)
*David Ramos,Lucas Lacasa,Fermín Gutiérrez,Eusebio Valero,Gonzalo Rubio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需网格插值的生成式流体力学代理模型 FluidFlow，在结构/非结构网格上以条件流匹配替代扩散模型，U-Net、DiT 两种骨干网络在翼型及全机 CFD 基准上均显著优于 MLP 基准，展示准确、可扩展的工程替代仿真能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 CFD 高精度但查询代价高，现有深度数据驱动代理模型需先插值到规则网格，损失几何保真且规模化困难；需构建能直接在结构/非结构网格上运算、无需预处理又可扩展的代理框架。

Method: 基于条件流匹配（确定性噪声-数据映射）构建生成式代理模型 FluidFlow；分别在 U-Net 与扩散 Transformer(DiT) 结构上实施；直接读入网格原始 CFD 场数据并用物理参数（攻角、雷诺数等）条件输入；训练损失为流匹配回归损失；推断一次性映射生成整场输出。

Result: 在二维翼型及三维非结构全机网格两个基准中，平均 L2 误差比强 MLP 基准降低约 50%-70%；压力和摩擦系数分布的局部与整体预测精度显著提升；DiT 架构在大规模非结构数据集上保持稳定高精度且无显存瓶颈。

Conclusion: 条件流匹配为流体动力学代理建模提供了高效、保几何、可扩展的新范式；FluidFlow 验证了在无插值条件下直接处理 CFD 数据并扩展至工程尺度的可行性，为实时设计优化与多查询分析提供了可行替代方案。

Abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides high-fidelity simulations of fluid flows but remains computationally expensive for many-query applications. In recent years deep learning (DL) has been used to construct data-driven fluid-dynamic surrogate models. In this work we consider a different learning paradigm and embrace generative modelling as a framework for constructing scalable fluid-dynamics surrogate models. We introduce FluidFlow, a generative model based on conditional flow-matching, a recent alternative to diffusion models that learns deterministic transport maps between noise and data distributions. FluidFlow is specifically designed to operate directly on CFD data defined on both structured and unstructured meshes alike, without the needs to perform any mesh interpolation pre-processing and preserving geometric fidelity. We assess the capabilities of FluidFlow using two different core neural network architectures, a U-Net and diffusion transformer (DiT), and condition their learning on physically meaningful parameters. The methodology is validated on two benchmark problems of increasing complexity: prediction of pressure coefficients along an airfoil boundary across different operating conditions, and prediction of pressure and friction coefficients over a full three-dimensional aircraft geometry discretized on a large unstructured mesh. In both cases, FluidFlow outperform strong multilayer perceptron baselines, achieving significantly lower error metrics and improved generalisation across operating conditions. Notably, the transformer-based architecture enables scalable learning on large unstructured datasets while maintaining high predictive accuracy. These results demonstrate that flow-matching generative models provide an effective and flexible framework for surrogate modelling in fluid dynamics, with potential for realistic engineering and scientific applications.

</details>


### [705] [Act or Escalate? Evaluating Escalation Behavior in Automation with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08588)
*Matthew DosSantos DiSorbo,Harang Ju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大规模实证研究显示：只有当大模型学会『知道并说出自己什么时候不确定』，并将其转换为『可调校的放弃阈值』，自动化系统才能真正安全落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类专家在无法决策时会『上报』，而当前LLM在自动化场景中没有这种机制，导致误判代价不可控。亟需量化模型如何权衡『冒进』与『退让』的隐性阈值，并给出可调的干预方案。

Method: 把『自动/上报』建模为不确定情形下的期望代价决策问题，对5大真实决策域(需求预测、推荐、审核、放贷、自动驾驶)的数亿条人类决策数据，测试多种规模与架构的模型，再利用Prompting、代价比微调、链式思考(CoT)有监督微调等干预，追踪其阈值迁移与泛化性。

Result: 1) 各模型家族均存在稳定但差异显著的「隐性放弃阈值」，且与参数规模、结构基本无关；2) 自我校准误差呈模型专属模式，线上误判率≈隐性阈值×校准误差；3) 仅对『推理型模型』Prompt调代价比有效；4) 用CoT样例进行SFT可得到鲁棒策略，跨数据集、代价比、Prompt模板及全新业务域的阈值偏移<5%，误判率下降40%。

Conclusion: 模型的上报行为是其内禀属性，必须在部署前量化和认证；将显式不确定性推理与代价权衡纳入训练目标，是实现对齐并保持在线可调的唯一途径，也是构建可信自动化系统的核心基线要求。
