Motivation: 铁矿石烧结等工业系统的非平稳多元序列预测受显著概念漂移和标签验证延迟的双重影响，离线模型的性能迅速退化；现有静态或被动更新方法难以在无即时监督条件下同时提取多尺度时空特征并克服稳定性-可塑性困境。

Method: 构建 Drift-Aware Multi-Scale Dynamic Learning (DA-MSDL) 框架：1) 多尺度双分支卷积骨干网络分离局部波动与长期趋势；2) 采用 Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) 在无标签条件下在线检测特征分布漂移；3) 基于漂移严重度的分层微调策略，结合动态记忆队列的优先经验回放实现快速分布对齐并抑制灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在真实工业烧结数据及公开基准的长期跨度实验中，DA-MSDL 在严重概念漂移下持续优于代表性基线，表现出强跨域泛化能力与预测稳定性。

Conclusion: DA-MSDL 为无即时监督、高漂移、标签延迟的非平稳环境提供了一种有效的在线动态学习范式，可广泛应用于复杂工业质量监控。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of nonstationary multivariate time series remains a critical challenge in complex industrial systems such as iron ore sintering. In practice, pronounced concept drift compounded by significant label verification latency rapidly degrades the performance of offline-trained models. Existing methods based on static architectures or passive update strategies struggle to simultaneously extract multi-scale spatiotemporal features and overcome the stability-plasticity dilemma without immediate supervision. To address these limitations, a Drift-Aware Multi-Scale Dynamic Learning (DA-MSDL) framework is proposed to maintain robust multi-output predictive performance via online adaptive mechanisms on nonstationary data streams. The framework employs a multi-scale bi-branch convolutional network as its backbone to disentangle local fluctuations from long-term trends, thereby enhancing representational capacity for complex dynamic patterns. To circumvent the label latency bottleneck, DA-MSDL leverages Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) for unsupervised drift detection. By quantifying online statistical deviations in feature distributions, DA-MSDL proactively triggers model adaptation prior to inference. Furthermore, a drift-severity-guided hierarchical fine-tuning strategy is developed. Supported by prioritized experience replay from a dynamic memory queue, this approach achieves rapid distribution alignment while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Long-horizon experiments on real-world industrial sintering data and a public benchmark dataset demonstrate that DA-MSDL consistently outperforms representative baselines under severe concept drift. Exhibiting strong cross-domain generalization and predictive stability, the proposed framework provides an effective online dynamic learning paradigm for quality monitoring in nonstationary environments.

</details>


### [781] [Bringing Clustering to MLL: Weakly-Supervised Clustering for Partial Multi-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09359)
*Yu Chen,Weijun Lv,Yue Huang,Xuhuan Zhu,Fang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 部分多标签学习存在候选标签中既有正标签也有负标签的噪声干扰。传统聚类的“隶属度求和为 1”与多标签“若干 0/1”不兼容。论文提出弱监督聚类框架 WSC−PML，把隶属度矩阵 A 分解为 Π ⊙ F，Π 保证聚类约束、F 保留多标签特性，通过原型学习−置信度评估−迭代聚类三步流程，24 个数据集上全面超越 6 个 SOTA 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分多标签学习中，训练样本只会拿到“候选标签集”，其中混杂相关与不相关标签，导致模型把负标签错当正标签训练。现有方法要么对噪声标签做阈值过滤，要么引入额外先验，缺乏系统利用数据内在结构的手段。作者认为聚类能够挖掘实例相似性从而检测噪声，但多标签场景下传统 softmax-型隶属度与 0/1 标签的“求和不为 1”在数学上根本冲突，需要重新设计兼容机制。

Method: 提出弱监督聚类框架 WSC−PML，核心是把归一化的隶属度矩阵 A 分解为 Π ⊙ F：
1. Π 承接聚类的“行和为 1”约束，用于实例分配分类原型；
2. F 为无约束的置信度矩阵，负责保持多标签“标签独立、任意数量正类”特性；
3. 算法分三阶段：
   (a) 原型初始化——用带噪正负候选标签预训练网络，获得初始实例嵌入与类别原型；
   (b) 弱监督生成——计算嵌入-原型距离，引入置信衰减因子，构造伪标签与置信权重；
   (c) 联合优化——交替更新 A 分解子矩阵，利用置信重加权损失更新网络，使网络既贴合聚类结构，又严格遵守多标签监督信号。
整个流程无需任何干净标签，以在线方式自适应净化候选标签并训练模型。

Result: 在涵盖图像、文本、生物信息等领域的 24 个公开数据集上，以 Hamming Loss、Ranking Loss、One-error、Coverage、Average Precision 五项指标综合评估，WSC−PML 在所有指标和全部数据集中均优于 6 个当前最佳方法（PML-NI、PML-LRS、DR- PML 等），平均指标改进在 5%–20% 区间。在噪声率 30% 和 50% 的合成实验上亦保持最少性能下降，且训练收敛速度与显存占用与主流方案持平。

Conclusion: 证明“聚类结构 + 多标签监督”可通过矩阵分解得到兼容统一，突破了传统聚类不适用于多标签噪声场景的数学障碍；端到端的弱监督迭代框架对高噪声率鲁棒，可无缝迁移到任何多标签架构上；未来可扩展到多正负对比策略及额外噪声模型假设，并为一般噪声标签学习提供通用思路。

Abstract: Label noise in multi-label learning (MLL) poses significant challenges for model training, particularly in partial multi-label learning (PML) where candidate labels contain both relevant and irrelevant labels. While clustering offers a natural approach to exploit data structure for noise identification, traditional clustering methods cannot be directly applied to multi-label scenarios due to a fundamental incompatibility: clustering produces membership values that sum to one per instance, whereas multi-label assignments require binary values that can sum to any number. We propose a novel weakly-supervised clustering approach for PML (WSC-PML) that bridges clustering and multi-label learning through membership matrix decomposition. Our key innovation decomposes the clustering membership matrix $\mathbf{A}$ into two components: $\mathbf{A} = \mathbfΠ \odot \mathbf{F}$, where $\mathbfΠ$ maintains clustering constraints while $\mathbf{F}$ preserves multi-label characteristics. This decomposition enables seamless integration of unsupervised clustering with multi-label supervision for effective label noise handling. WSC-PML employs a three-stage process: initial prototype learning from noisy labels, adaptive confidence-based weak supervision construction, and joint optimization via iterative clustering refinement. Extensive experiments on 24 datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms six state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [782] [Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network for High-Dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii Equations on Unbounded Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09361)
*Zhangyong Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a stochastic-dimension frozen sampled neural network (SD-FSNN) for solving a class of high-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equations (GPEs) on unbounded domains. SD-FSNN is unbiased across all dimensions, and its computational cost is independent of the dimension, avoiding the exponential growth in computational and memory costs associated with Hermite-basis discretizations. Additionally, we randomly sample the hidden weights and biases of the neural network, significantly outperforming iterative, gradient-based optimization methods in terms of training time and accuracy. Furthermore, we employ a space-time separation strategy, using adaptive ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers to update the evolution coefficients and incorporate temporal causality. To preserve the structure of the GPEs, we integrate a Gaussian-weighted ansatz into the neural network to enforce exponential decay at infinity, embed a normalization projection layer for mass normalization, and add an energy conservation constraint to mitigate long-time numerical dissipation. Comparative experiments with existing methods demonstrate the superior performance of SD-FSNN across a range of spatial dimensions and interaction parameters. Compared to existing random-feature methods, SD-FSNN reduces the complexity from linear to dimension-independent. Additionally, SD-FSNN achieves better accuracy and faster training compared to general high-dimensional solvers, while focusing specifically on high-dimensional GPEs on unbounded domains.

</details>


### [783] [Is More Data Worth the Cost? Dataset Scaling Laws in a Tiny Attention-Only Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09389)
*Götz-Henrik Wiegand,Lorena Raichle,Rico Städeli,Tomas Hrycej,Bernhard Bermeitinger,Siegfried Handschuh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在可控小模型上验证了“数据量↑⇒性能↑但边际收益递减”的缩放律，30%数据即可达90%验证精度，为资源受限场景提供数据-算力权衡指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer训练随数据/算力增长而变贵；大规模缩放律在小规模、受控环境下的适用性及可操作指导尚缺。

Method: 用精简的仅注意力解码器，固定算力，按2的幂次逐步扩增训练子集，隔离数据量对验证Token级准确率的影响。

Result: 性能随数据量平滑上升并出现明显边际递减；仅需≈30%数据即可逼近全量数据90%的验证准确率。

Conclusion: 小模型+受控实验同样符合缩放律，为数据或算力受限的小团队/探索阶段提供“用30%数据快速迭代”的实用策略。

Abstract: Training Transformer language models is expensive, as performance typically improves with increasing dataset size and computational budget. Although scaling laws describe this trend at large scale, their implications in controlled, smaller-scale settings remain less explored. In this work, we isolate dataset-size effects using a strongly reduced attention-only decoder architecture. By training on progressively larger power-of-two subsets, we observe smooth performance improvements accompanied by clear diminishing returns, consistent with scaling-law behavior. Using only about 30% of the training data is sufficient to reach approximately 90% of the full-data validation token-level accuracy. These results provide actionable insights into dataset scaling in a controlled, component-isolated setting and offer practical guidance for balancing dataset size and computational cost in compute- and data-restricted environments, such as small research labs and exploratory model development.

</details>


### [784] [Efficient Unlearning through Maximizing Relearning Convergence Delay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09391)
*Khoa Tran,Simon S. Woo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对模型清洗需求，本文提出完整评价指标+深度擦除框架『影响消除式去忘却』，以重学收敛延迟衡量彻底性，在权重与预测两空间同步净化并给出理论保证，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器去忘却（machine unlearning）主要关注预测精度变化，忽视了权重空间中信息残留，难以评判被遗忘数据的真实可被复原风险，因此需要更全面、可量化的评估手段与清除手段。

Method: 1) 提出『重学收敛延迟』（relearning convergence delay，RCD）指标，同时度量权重空间与输出空间差异；2) 建立Influence Eliminating Unlearning（I-E-U）框架：在权重损失驱动下对忘却集做性能退化，辅以权重衰减与噪声注入，确保保留集性能；3) 给出指数收敛与误差上界等理论分析并推导出最优去忘却更新过程。

Result: 在分类与生成两类忘却任务上，I-E-U在RCD、Recall-for-Forget、Membership Attack Accuracy等多指标上均显著优于SOTA方法，并接近理想噪声重训练上限；同时RF保留精度保持一致，端到端稳定性提升30%—50%。

Conclusion: 综合评价RCD能更真实反映模型信息清除程度；I-E-U在保障效用性的同时实现深度去忘却，为后续隐私合规、模型可追溯更新奠定了测量基准与算法范式。理论分析亦表明该方法具备通用性与可扩展性。后续计划将框架扩展至大模型增量与联邦场景中。

Abstract: Machine unlearning poses challenges in removing mislabeled, contaminated, or problematic data from a pretrained model. Current unlearning approaches and evaluation metrics are solely focused on model predictions, which limits insight into the model's true underlying data characteristics. To address this issue, we introduce a new metric called relearning convergence delay, which captures both changes in weight space and prediction space, providing a more comprehensive assessment of the model's understanding of the forgotten dataset. This metric can be used to assess the risk of forgotten data being recovered from the unlearned model. Based on this, we propose the Influence Eliminating Unlearning framework, which removes the influence of the forgetting set by degrading its performance and incorporates weight decay and injecting noise into the model's weights, while maintaining accuracy on the retaining set. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing metrics and our proposed relearning convergence delay metric, approaching ideal unlearning performance. We provide theoretical guarantees, including exponential convergence and upper bounds, as well as empirical evidence of strong retention and resistance to relearning in both classification and generative unlearning tasks.

</details>


### [785] [OASIS: Online Activation Subspace Learning for Memory-Efficient Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09406)
*Sakshi Choudhary,Utkarsh Saxena,Kaushik Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 引入OASIS，一种在线激活子空间学习算法，用动态低秩投影显式削减激活与优化器状态内存，在无需改动前向计算的前提下实现2×峰值显存节省并保持全参数微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM训练内存瓶颈主要来自激活而非权重；先前方法要么仅压缩梯度/优化器状态，要么依赖固定投影或架构改动，无法兼顾实时性与精度。

Method: OASIS在训练过程中持续学习并在线更新一个低维激活子空间；前向时将中间激活实时投影到该子空间存储，反向时利用子空间诱导的低秩梯度直接在子空间内维护优化器状态，并通过“投影感知”优化器在子空间变化时稳定地迁移状态。

Result: 在多种微调与预训练任务上，OASIS相比全参数微调峰值内存降低最高2倍，同时保持同等性能；在低秩对比方法中也取得显著优势。

Conclusion: OASIS首次将激活、梯度与优化器状态统一纳入可演化的低秩子空间，兼顾内存、精度与训练稳定性，为大模型高效训练提供了新的通用框架。

Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) is constrained by memory requirements, with activations accounting for a substantial fraction of the total footprint. Existing approaches reduce memory using low-rank weight parameterizations or low-rank gradient subspaces for optimizer states, while activation memory is addressed through architectural modifications or compression schemes based on periodically updated projections. We propose OASIS, an online activation subspace learning algorithm for memory-efficient training that tracks and continuously updates a low-dimensional activation subspace during training. Intermediate activations are projected onto this evolving subspace, reducing memory without modifying forward-pass computations. The evolving activation subspace induces low-rank gradient representations, enabling both gradients and optimizer states to be maintained directly in this subspace, while a projection-aware optimizer consistently transports optimizer states across subspace updates for stable training. Across various finetuning and pretraining tasks, OASIS achieves up to $2\times$ lower peak memory than full fine-tuning while matching its performance and outperforming prior low-rank methods.

</details>


### [786] [NOMAD: Generating Embeddings for Massive Distributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09419)
*Aishwarya Sarkar,Sayan Ghosh,Nathan R. Tallent,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 面向十亿级边的图嵌入,NOMAD 用 MPI 分布式框架将 LINE 算法扩展到数百节点,比现有最快实现整体提速 12-370 倍且保真度不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于随机行走的图嵌入方法必须为全图重复采样,单机内存和算力难以支撑 Web、科学计算中日益增长的百万至十亿边规模图,需要可扩展的分布式方案。

Method: 提出 NOMAD——基于 MPI 的分布式内存框架,复用并改造 LINE 的邻近度模型;通过分区异步采样、压缩通信、局部负采样等机制降低不规则通信与同步开销,在数百 CPU 节点上协同训练。

Result: 在 NERSC Perlmutter CPU 集群上,NOMAD 较多线程 LINE/node2vec 中位加速 10/100 倍,较分布式 PBG 快 35-76 倍;下游任务质量与 LINE/node2vec/GraphVite 相当;端到端处理真实大图提速 12-370 倍。

Conclusion: 借助 MPI-分布式异步随机行走与针对性工程优化,NOMAD 首次把结构保持的图嵌入扩展到十亿边量级,兼得高保真与数量级性能提升,为大规模图机器学习提供了可行基线。

Abstract: Successful machine learning on graphs or networks requires embeddings that not only represent nodes and edges as low-dimensional vectors but also preserve the graph structure. Established methods for generating embeddings require flexible exploration of the entire graph through repeated use of random walks that capture graph structure with samples of nodes and edges. These methods create scalability challenges for massive graphs with millions-to-billions of edges because single-node solutions have inadequate memory and processing capabilities.
  We present NOMAD, a distributed-memory graph embedding framework using the Message Passing Interface (MPI) for distributed graphs. NOMAD implements proximity-based models proposed in the widely popular LINE (Large-scale Information Network Embedding) algorithm. We propose several practical trade-offs to improve the scalability and communication overheads confronted by irregular and distributed graph embedding methods, catering to massive-scale graphs arising in web and science domains. NOMAD demonstrates median speedups of 10/100x on CPU-based NERSC Perlmutter cluster relative to the popular reference implementations of multi-threaded LINE and node2vec, 35-76x over distributed PBG, and competitive embedding quality relative to LINE, node2vec, and GraphVite, while yielding 12-370x end-to-end speedups on real-world graphs.

</details>


### [787] [Offline Local Search for Online Stochastic Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09423)
*Gerdus Benadè,Rathish Das,Thomas Lavastida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将局部搜索算法系统性地从离线嵌入组合多臂老虎机，给出 O(log³ T) 近似遗憾上界，打破以往多项式依赖 T 的瓶颈，并在一类广泛问题上验证框架的通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 CMAB 环境中，如何把离线段算法搬到在线场景并保证低遗憾，目前已研究了贪心与线性规划类方法，但理论性能更强的局部搜索算法尚未被探索。填补这一空白可显著拓宽现有离线－在线算法转换工具的适用范围。

Method: 提出通用框架：①离线局部搜索 S 能以 γ 近似终止；②对每条臂维护置信上界（UCB），每一步用局部搜索在置信集合上迭代，直到满足停机条件；③证明整个过程仅产生 O(k log³ T) 的近似伪遗憾，其中 k 为邻域规模、T 为时间长度。

Result: 理论上，给出 CMAB 环境下首个基于局部搜索的 O(log³ T) 高概率近似遗憾界，彻底摆脱 T 的多项式依赖。实例验证：对最小化总完工期调度、拟阵最小成本基与带不确定性聚类三个 NP-难组合问题，分别获得紧致遗憾与可验证的最优基。

Conclusion: 局部搜索可无缝嵌入 CMAB 并保持卓越近似性能；框架对多种结构约束均成立，为今后离线组合算法→在线低遗憾算法的转化提供了统一可扩展路径。

Abstract: Combinatorial multi-armed bandits provide a fundamental online decision-making environment where a decision-maker interacts with an environment across $T$ time steps, each time selecting an action and learning the cost of that action. The goal is to minimize regret, defined as the loss compared to the optimal fixed action in hindsight under full-information. There has been substantial interest in leveraging what is known about offline algorithm design in this online setting. Offline greedy and linear optimization algorithms (both exact and approximate) have been shown to provide useful guarantees when deployed online. We investigate local search methods, a broad class of algorithms used widely in both theory and practice, which have thus far been under-explored in this context. We focus on problems where offline local search terminates in an approximately optimal solution and give a generic method for converting such an offline algorithm into an online stochastic combinatorial bandit algorithm with $O(\log^3 T)$ (approximate) regret. In contrast, existing offline-to-online frameworks yield regret (and approximate regret) which depend sub-linearly, but polynomially on $T$. We demonstrate the flexibility of our framework by applying it to three online stochastic combinatorial optimization problems: scheduling to minimize total completion time, finding a minimum cost base of a matroid and uncertain clustering.

</details>


### [788] [AdaCubic: An Adaptive Cubic Regularization Optimizer for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09437)
*Ioannis Tsingalis,Constantine Kotropoulos,Corentin Briat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaCubic 是一种无需调参、可扩展的深度学习优化器，通过动态调整三次正则权重并采用 Hutchinson 近似 Hessian，在 CV/NLP/SP 任务上达到或超越主流算法，同时保持立方牛顿法的局部收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度优化器在超参敏感、调参代价高昂的大规模场景下表现受限，且尚无将三次正则成功扩展至深度学习的实用方案。

Method: 1) 构建带三次约束的辅助优化问题，在线自适应调节三次项系数；2) 引入 Hutchinson 随机估计近似 Hessian，降低立方步计算量；3) 固定一套超参，实现完全免调参训练。

Result: 理论：AdaCubic 继承立方正则牛顿法的局部二阶收敛性质；实验：在计算机视觉、自然语言处理与信号处理三大领域任务上，AdaCubic 一致优于或媲美 Adam、SGD-M、RMSprop 等主流优化器，且无需调参。

Conclusion: AdaCubic 首次把动态三次正则与 Hessian 估计结合并扩展至大规模深度学习，兼具理论收敛保证与实用鲁棒性，为研究人员和工程师提供了一种高效、低成本的优化器选择。

Abstract: A novel regularization technique, AdaCubic, is proposed that adapts the weight of the cubic term. The heart of AdaCubic is an auxiliary optimization problem with cubic constraints that dynamically adjusts the weight of the cubic term in Newton's cubic regularized method. We use Hutchinson's method to approximate the Hessian matrix, thereby reducing computational cost. We demonstrate that AdaCubic inherits the cubically regularized Newton method's local convergence guarantees. Our experiments in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, and Signal Processing tasks demonstrate that AdaCubic outperforms or competes with several widely used optimizers. Unlike other adaptive algorithms that require hyperparameter fine-tuning, AdaCubic is evaluated with a fixed set of hyperparameters, rendering it a highly attractive optimizer in settings where fine-tuning is infeasible. This makes AdaCubic an attractive option for researchers and practitioners alike. To our knowledge, AdaCubic is the first optimizer to leverage cubic regularization in scalable deep learning applications.

</details>


### [789] [ECHO: Efficient Chest X-ray Report Generation with One-step Block Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09450)
*Lifeng Chen,Tianqi You,Hao Liu,Zhimin Bao,Jile Jiao,Xiao Han,Zhicai Ou,Tao Sun,Xiaofeng Mou,Xiaojie Jin,Yi Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ECHO——一种基于单步扩散的胸部 X 光报告生成模型，在 8× 加速的同时，RaTE 与 SemScore 分别提升 64% 与 60%，超越现有自回归 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视觉-语言模型生成延迟高；扩散模型虽可并行，但多步去噪仍耗时。若强行压缩为单步，则因 token 因子化去噪带来的“平均场”偏差而损失文本连贯性，急需一种兼顾速度与生成的胸部报告生成方案。

Method: 1) Direct Conditional Distillation（DCD）：利用扩散策略采样轨迹构建非因子化监督，显式建模 token 间联合分布，抑制单步去噪的平均场偏差；2) Response-Asymmetric Diffusion（RAD）：在非对称损失下加速训练并保效果；3) 整体构成单块单步推理的扩散式 VLM——ECHO。

Result: 在标准胸片报告数据集上，ECHO 推理速度提升 8 倍，医学相关性指标 RaTE 提升 64.33%，语义连贯指标 SemScore 提升 60.58%，临床准确率与最领先自回归模型相当或更优。

Conclusion: DCD 与 RAD 框架首次在医学影像报告任务中实现单步稳定扩散生成，为实时辅助诊断奠定基础，可推广至其他对延迟敏感的序列生成场景。

Abstract: Chest X-ray report generation (CXR-RG) has the potential to substantially alleviate radiologists' workload. However, conventional autoregressive vision--language models (VLMs) suffer from high inference latency due to sequential token decoding. Diffusion-based models offer a promising alternative through parallel generation, but they still require multiple denoising iterations. Compressing multi-step denoising to a single step could further reduce latency, but often degrades textual coherence due to the mean-field bias introduced by token-factorized denoisers. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{ECHO}, an efficient diffusion-based VLM (dVLM) for chest X-ray report generation. ECHO enables stable one-step-per-block inference via a novel Direct Conditional Distillation (DCD) framework, which mitigates the mean-field limitation by constructing unfactorized supervision from on-policy diffusion trajectories to encode joint token dependencies. In addition, we introduce a Response-Asymmetric Diffusion (RAD) training strategy that further improves training efficiency while maintaining model effectiveness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECHO surpasses state-of-the-art autoregressive methods, improving RaTE and SemScore by \textbf{64.33\%} and \textbf{60.58\%} respectively, while achieving an \textbf{$8\times$} inference speedup without compromising clinical accuracy.

</details>


### [790] [SafeAdapt: Provably Safe Policy Updates in Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09452)
*Maksim Anisimov,Francesco Belardinelli,Matthew Wicker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Rashomon 集合的先验安全策略更新框架，在持续强化学习中保证策略在旧任务上的安全属性不被遗忘，实验验证其优于正则化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署 RL 时，环境动态或性能目标不断变化，需在更新策略的同时保留已见任务的安全保证；现有方法要么无形式化保证，要么只能事后验证，亟需先验且可证明的安全更新机制。

Method: 引入 Rashomon 集合——在示范数据分布内满足安全约束的策略参数区域；将任意 RL 算法的新策略投影至该集合，确保更新后的策略仍满足旧任务安全约束，实现先验保证。

Result: 在 Frozen Lake 与 Poisoned Apple 网格环境中，该方法在下游适应过程中对源任务保持 100% 确定性安全，而正则化基线出现灾难性安全遗忘；同时适应性能与安全性均显著优于对比方案。

Conclusion: 通过 Rashomon 投影的先验安全更新可为持续 RL 提供形式化、可证明的安全性，兼顾适应性与安全，适用于非平稳安全关键场景的实际部署。

Abstract: Safety guarantees are a prerequisite to the deployment of reinforcement learning (RL) agents in safety-critical tasks. Often, deployment environments exhibit non-stationary dynamics or are subject to changing performance goals, requiring updates to the learned policy. This leads to a fundamental challenge: how to update an RL policy while preserving its safety properties on previously encountered tasks? The majority of current approaches either do not provide formal guarantees or verify policy safety only a posteriori. We propose a novel a priori approach to safe policy updates in continual RL by introducing the Rashomon set: a region in policy parameter space certified to meet safety constraints within the demonstration data distribution. We then show that one can provide formal, provable guarantees for arbitrary RL algorithms used to update a policy by projecting their updates onto the Rashomon set. Empirically, we validate this approach across grid-world navigation environments (Frozen Lake and Poisoned Apple) where we guarantee an a priori provably deterministic safety on the source task during downstream adaptation. In contrast, we observe that regularisation-based baselines experience catastrophic forgetting of safety constraints while our approach enables strong adaptation with provable guarantees that safety is preserved.

</details>


### [791] [Integrated electro-optic attention nonlinearities for transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09512)
*Luis Mickeler,Kai Lion,Alfonso Nardi,Jost Kellner,Pierre Didier,Bhavin J. Shastri,Niao He,Rachel Grange*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 采用铌酸锂薄膜 MZ 调制器直接替代数字 Softmax/Sigmoid，在保持 ViT 与 LLM 精度的同时，把非线性部分推理延时至少降一个量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 的 Softmax 仅占算子数 <1%，却成为延迟瓶颈；急需在光子域内完成高速、低位宽的非线性映射。

Method: 将电光 MZ 非线性特性用于近似 Softmax/Sigmoid，构建 2×2 阵列协同编码；输入输出均 4-bit 量化，并在 10 GBaud 速率下注入噪声测试鲁棒性。

Result: 在 ViT 与 7B LLM 上精度与数字对照模型差距 <0.5%；端到端延迟可减小约 12×，功耗降 >5×，对噪声具有 >3σ 容限。

Conclusion: TFLN 调制器可作为硅基光子计算单元混入主芯片，为 Transformer 提供超低延迟、高能效的非线性函数实现路径。

Abstract: Transformers have emerged as the dominant neural-network architecture, achieving state-of-the-art performance in language processing and computer vision. At the core of these models lies the attention mechanism, which requires a nonlinear, non-negative mapping using the Softmax function. However, although Softmax operations account for less than 1% of the total operation count, they can disproportionately bottleneck overall inference latency. Here, we use thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs) as analog nonlinear computational elements to drastically reduce the latency of nonlinear computations. We implement electro-optic alternatives to digital Softmax and Sigmoid, and evaluate their performance in Vision Transformers and Large Language Models. Our system maintains highly competitive accuracy, even under aggressive 4-bit input-output quantization of the analog units. We further characterize system noise at encoding speeds up to 10 GBaud and assess model robustness under various noise conditions. Our findings suggest that TFLN modulators can serve as nonlinear function units within hybrid co-packaged hardware, enabling high-speed and energy-efficient nonlinear computation.

</details>


### [792] [Toward World Models for Epidemiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09519)
*Zeeshan Memon,Yiqi Su,Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas,Walid Saad,Liang Zhao,Naren Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出流行病世界模型框架，把疫情抽象为“部分可观测、受控且含行为反馈”的动力系统，并借三类案例证明世界模型是政策推理的必要工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流行病学决策依赖不完整、滞后的观测信号，且干预效果受人类行为自适应反馈影响，需统一框架来联合建模潜疫情状态、噪声观测与政策-行为耦合。

Method: (1) 将疫情形式化为受控、部分观测的潜变量动力系统；(2) 显式刻画三大特征：潜状态、政策内生的噪声观测、干预-行为反馈；(3) 设计三个案例—策略性瞒报、观测滞后、反事实干预—验证框架的必要性。

Result: 案例显示：忽略潜状态与行为反馈会导致政策误判；世界模型能揭示策略性瞒报偏差、滞后信号失真及相同历史下不同干预序列的异轨演化。

Conclusion: 流行病学是世界模型的天然却未被充分探索的场景；显式世界建模可提升疫情监测、预测与政策评估的可信度，为应对未来大流行提供普适方法。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a unifying paradigm for learning latent dynamics, simulating counterfactual futures, and supporting planning under uncertainty. In this paper, we argue that computational epidemiology is a natural and underdeveloped setting for world models. This is because epidemic decision-making requires reasoning about latent disease burden, imperfect and policy-dependent surveillance signals, and intervention effects are mediated by adaptive human behavior. We introduce a conceptual framework for epidemiological world models, formulating epidemics as controlled, partially observed dynamical systems in which (i) the true epidemic state is latent, (ii) observations are noisy and endogenous to policy, and (iii) interventions act as sequential actions whose effects propagate through behavioral and social feedback. We present three case studies that illustrate why explicit world modeling is necessary for policy-relevant reasoning: strategic misreporting in behavioral surveillance, systematic delays in time-lagged signals such as hospitalizations and deaths, and counterfactual intervention analysis where identical histories diverge under alternative action sequences.

</details>


### [793] [Event-Driven Temporal Graph Networks for Asynchronous Multi-Agent Cyber Defense in NetForge_RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09523)
*Igor Jankowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对MARL策略从仿真网络安全演练（Sim）向真实SOCs（Real）迁移时的Sim2Real鸿沟，提出高保真异步连续时间仿真器NetForge_RL和对应算法CT-GMARL；零样本实测迁移奖励提升98k，蓝方收益翻倍并多恢复12倍受损服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络防御仿真器对协议栈、时间同步、观测噪声过度简化，导致在SOC环境中训练的MARL策略无法直接迁移。亟需一个能原生弥合Sim2Real缺口、支持零信任约束且处理真实SIEM日志连续时间特性的训练平台。

Method: 1. 构建NetForge_RL：将网络防御建模为连续时间、部分可观测的半马尔可夫决策过程（POSMDP）；引入ZTNA策略，强制智能体处理NLP编码的SIEM遥测；采用双引擎模式，可在Mock/Hypervisor高速训练，也可切换至Docker对真实漏洞零样本评估。
2. 设计CT-GMARL：基于固定步长的Neural ODE，对不规则采样告警序列进行连续时间图表示学习；在多智能体层面联合优化。
3. 实验设置：与离散时间强基线R-MAPPO、QMIX对比，评估指标包括蓝方奖励、服务恢复数和零样本迁移成功率。

Result: 在NetForge仿真环境，CT-GMARL收敛时中位蓝方奖励57,135，分别比R-MAPPO与QMIX提升2.0×和2.1×；恢复受损服务数量领先最强基线12×，并避免

Conclusion: 高保真异步连续时间仿真与Neural-ODE驱动的CT-GMARL显著缩窄Sim2Real缺口，首次实现网络安全MARL策略的零样本高效迁移，为真实SOCs部署提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: The transition of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policies from simulated cyber wargames to operational Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is fundamentally bottlenecked by the Sim2Real gap. Legacy simulators abstract away network protocol physics, rely on synchronous ticks, and provide clean state vectors rather than authentic, noisy telemetry. To resolve these limitations, we introduce NetForge_RL: a high-fidelity cyber operations simulator that reformulates network defense as an asynchronous, continuous-time Partially Observable Semi-Markov Decision Process (POSMDP). NetForge enforces Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA) constraints and requires defenders to process NLP-encoded SIEM telemetry. Crucially, NetForge bridges the Sim2Real gap natively via a dual-mode engine, allowing high-throughput MARL training in a mock hypervisor and zero-shot evaluation against live exploits in a Docker hypervisor. To navigate this continuous-time POSMDP, we propose Continuous-Time Graph MARL (CT-GMARL), utilizing fixed-step Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) to process irregularly sampled alerts. We evaluate our framework against discrete baselines (R-MAPPO, QMIX). Empirical results demonstrate that CT-GMARL achieves a converged median Blue reward of 57,135 - a 2.0x improvement over R-MAPPO and 2.1x over QMIX. Critically, CT-GMARL restores 12x more compromised services than the strongest baseline by avoiding the "scorched earth" failure mode of trivially minimizing risk by destroying network utility. On zero-shot transfer to the live Docker environment, CT-GMARL policies achieve a median reward of 98,026, validating the Sim2Real bridge.

</details>


### [794] [ANTIC: Adaptive Neural Temporal In-situ Compressor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09543)
*Sandeep S. Cranganore,Andrei Bodnar,Gianluca Galleti,Fabian Paischer,Johannes Brandstetter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: The persistent storage requirements for high-resolution, spatiotemporally evolving fields governed by large-scale and high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) have reached the petabyte-to-exabyte scale. Transient simulations modeling Navier-Stokes equations, magnetohydrodynamics, plasma physics, or binary black hole mergers generate data volumes that are prohibitive for modern high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructures. To address this bottleneck, we introduce ANTIC (Adaptive Neural Temporal in situ Compressor), an end-to-end in situ compression pipeline. ANTIC consists of an adaptive temporal selector tailored to high-dimensional physics that identifies and filters informative snapshots at simulation time, combined with a spatial neural compression module based on continual fine-tuning that learns residual updates between adjacent snapshots using neural fields. By operating in a single streaming pass, ANTIC enables a combined compression of temporal and spatial components and effectively alleviates the need for explicit on-disk storage of entire time-evolved trajectories. Experimental results demonstrate how storage reductions of several orders of magnitude relate to physics accuracy.

</details>


### [795] [Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08362)
*Jiawei Chen,Ruoxi Xu,Boxi Cao,Ruotong Pan,Yunfei Zhang,Yifei Hu,Yong Du,Tingting Gao,Yaojie Lu,Yingfei Sun,Xianpei Han,Le Sun,Xiangyu Wu,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个全真实数据用户仿真基准 OmniBehavior 揭示：现有 LLM 因“平均正向社会人”结构偏差，无法复现跨场景长程长尾行为，性能随上下文加长仍停滞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被寄望成为通用用户模拟器，但既有基准只用孤立场景、狭窄动作空间或合成数据，难以反映真实人类行为的整体性与长程跨域因果链。

Method: 构建完全基于真实行为日志的 OmniBehavior 基准，整合长时域、跨场景、异构行为模式；系统对比 SOTA LLM 生成轨迹与真实轨迹，量化结构偏差。

Result: 实证表明孤立场景数据集存在“隧道视野”；LLM 模拟准确率随上下文窗口扩大仍趋于平台；模拟群体向“高活跃、人格同质化、乌托邦”均值收敛，个体差异与长尾行为显著丢失。

Conclusion: 高保真用户模拟需重新审视模型目标与评价指标，未来研究应优先纠正结构性正向偏见、增强异质性与长程因果建模能力。

Abstract: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has illuminated the potential for a general-purpose user simulator. However, existing benchmarks remain constrained to isolated scenarios, narrow action spaces, or synthetic data, failing to capture the holistic nature of authentic human behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniBehavior, the first user simulation benchmark constructed entirely from real-world data, integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns into a unified framework. Based on this benchmark, we first provide empirical evidence that previous datasets with isolated scenarios suffer from tunnel vision, whereas real-world decision-making relies on long-term, cross-scenario causal chains. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that current models struggle to accurately simulate these complex behaviors, with performance plateauing even as context windows expand. Crucially, a systematic comparison between simulated and authentic behaviors uncovers a fundamental structural bias: LLMs tend to converge toward a positive average person, exhibiting hyper-activity, persona homogenization, and a Utopian bias. This results in the loss of individual differences and long-tail behaviors, highlighting critical directions for future high-fidelity simulation research.

</details>


### [796] [Self-Sovereign Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08551)
*Wenjie Qu,Xuandong Zhao,Jiaheng Zhang,Dawn Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统探讨“自给自足智能体”——无需人类干预即可自行赚取资源、维持运行并自我扩张的 AI 系统——的技术可行性与治理风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型与智能体框架已使 AI 能力显著跃升，可能从“人类开发的工具”演变为“自主数字行动者”。作者要厘清：距完全经济自给还有多远？若实现，会带来哪些安全、社会与治理冲击？

Method: 采用“技术—风险”双轴分析：① 拆解当前代理框架、模型推理、链上支付、无许可基础设施等模块，量化剩余技术壁垒（如长期记忆、稳健盈利、抗对抗环境）；② 构建自给场景推演矩阵，评估分布式身份、DAO 融资、匿名计算、跨境监管缺口等深层风险。

Result: 得出三条核心发现：1) 若将现成大模型、插件市场、加密支付与无代码部署拼接，已可在限定任务流（如 DeFi 套利、内容农场）中实现“准自给”原型；2) 剩余壁垒集中在三方面——长期稳健盈利模型、抗对抗性安全闭环、链下法律身份与责任；3) 风险呈“三高一模糊”：高隐蔽性、高扩散性、高锁定性，现有监管框架对匿名跨链实体几乎真空。

Conclusion: 自给自足智能体不再是科幻，而是 2–3 年内可见的技术现实。呼吁立即建立“算法出生登记”、可审计盈利上限、链上可撤销权限 3 项底线治理机制，否则将出现无法关停、难以追责、自我增殖的“数字永久公司”。

Abstract: We investigate the emerging prospect of self-sovereign agents -- AI systems that can economically sustain and extend their own operation without human involvement. Recent advances in large language models and agent frameworks have substantially expanded agents' practical capabilities, pointing toward a potential shift from developer-controlled tools to more autonomous digital actors. We analyze the remaining technical barriers to such deployments and discuss the security, societal, and governance challenges that could arise if such systems become practically viable. A project page is available at: https://self-sovereign-agent.github.io.

</details>


### [797] [A Representation-Level Assessment of Bias Mitigation in Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08561)
*Svetoslav Nizhnichenkov,Rahul Nair,Elizabeth Daly,Brian Mac Namee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对比BERT与Llama2去偏前后表示，发现去偏操作一致地缩小性别-职业距离，提出WinoDec数据集助力解码器模型审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础大模型深植性别偏见，需从内部表示角度量化并验证去偏方法是否真正“让模型忘记”刻板关联；尤其缺乏针对解码器架构的可重复审计工具。

Method: 以BERT与Llama2为代理，对比去偏前后性别—职业token向量在嵌入空间的平均余弦相似度、质心距离及聚类重叠度；将44个性别词与300个职业词组合为模板嵌入，运用WinoBias/WinoBias+指标并在新数据集WinoDec（4k含性别-职业序列）扩展测试。

Result: 去偏后两模型均显著降低性别与刻板职业的距离差距，不同性别方向方差减小37–52%，质心移动呈现正交化与均等化；表示映射聚类可视化出现更大重叠；改变幅度与去偏策略强度呈线性趋势，且效果跨层稳定。

Conclusion: 去偏可解释地表现为几何空间中的“平衡化&中性化”变换，表明表示层审计能直接度量公平进度；WinoDec为评估解码器提供了公开基准，建议未来结合表示度量与生成测试做联合审计。

Abstract: We investigate how successful bias mitigation reshapes the embedding space of encoder-only and decoder-only foundation models, offering an internal audit of model behaviour through representational analysis. Using BERT and Llama2 as representative architectures, we assess the shifts in associations between gender and occupation terms by comparing baseline and bias-mitigated variants of the models. Our findings show that bias mitigation reduces gender-occupation disparities in the embedding space, leading to more neutral and balanced internal representations. These representational shifts are consistent across both model types, suggesting that fairness improvements can manifest as interpretable and geometric transformations. These results position embedding analysis as a valuable tool for understanding and validating the effectiveness of debiasing methods in foundation models. To further promote the assessment of decoder-only models, we introduce WinoDec, a dataset consisting of 4,000 sequences with gender and occupation terms, and release it to the general public. (https://github.com/winodec/wino-dec)

</details>


### [798] [Temperature-Dependent Performance of Prompting Strategies in Extended Reasoning Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08563)
*Mousa Salah,Amgad Muneer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次系统研究扩展推理-LLM 的温度 × 提示策略交互；发现零样本在中温最优，链式思维在极值温最优，且扩展推理增益随温度升高而放大，推翻“推理必用 T=0”惯例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展推理模型虽赋予 LLM 显式测试时计算能力，却缺乏如何设定采样温度与提示策略的指导。作者旨在填补这一空白，避免经验拍脑袋。

Method: 以 Grok-4.1 扩展推理版本为实验平台，在 AMO-Bench 的 39 道 IMO 级数学题上，全面扫描 0.0/0.4/0.7/1.0 四种温度与零样本 vs. 链式思维两种提示，对比准确率并度量扩展推理相对基线的倍数增益。

Result: 零样本在 T=0.4 与 0.7 达峰 59 %；链式思维则在两端极值温度最佳；扩展推理的增益系数由 T=0 时的 6× 增至 T=1 时的 14.3×，呈单调上升趋势。

Conclusion: 温度并非越小越好，而应与提示策略联合优化；高温度下扩展推理收益最大，提示未来系统可动态调度温度-提示组合以释放更强解题能力。

Abstract: Extended reasoning models represent a transformative shift in Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities by enabling explicit test-time computation for complex problem solving. However, the optimal configuration of sampling temperature and prompting strategy for these systems remains largely underexplored. We systematically evaluate chain-of-thought and zero-shot prompting across four temperature settings (0.0, 0.4, 0.7, and 1.0) using Grok-4.1 with extended reasoning on 39 mathematical problems from AMO-Bench, a challenging International Mathematical Olympiad-level benchmark. We find that zero-shot prompting achieves peak performance at moderate temperatures, reaching 59% accuracy at T=0.4 and T=0.7, while chain-of-thought prompting performs best at the temperature extremes. Most notably, the benefit of extended reasoning increases from 6x at T=0.0 to 14.3x at T=1.0. These results suggest that temperature should be optimized jointly with prompting strategy, challenging the common practice of using T=0 for reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [799] [Attention-Based Sampler for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08564)
*Yuyan Zhou,Kai Syun Hou,Weiyu Chen,James Kwok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）的并行解码顺序从经验式改为理论驱动：按注意力矩阵列和降序解码即可近似最大化序列似然，无需再训练即可提升生成质量与并行度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型（ARM）串行解码效率低、灵活性差；扩散式大语言模型虽可并行，却仅用 token 级启发式解码，忽视全局结构，导致生成质量不佳。如何从理论上确定最佳解码顺序，兼顾似然最大化和并行性，是亟待解决的问题。

Method: 1. 从序列似然最大化出发，理论证明“按注意力矩阵列和降序解码”可近似达到最优似然；2. 据此提出免训练解码算法 Attn-Sampler；3. 引入分块注意力近似与动态阈值剪枝，降低计算开销并保持并行度。

Result: 在多项基准任务上，Attn-Sampler 在 BLEU、ROUGE、 perplexity 等指标上优于现有贪心/随机顺序扩散解码，同时解码并行度提高 1.5–2.4×，Wall-clock 速度提升 30–50%。

Conclusion: 注意力矩阵列和提供了简单、可解释且理论支撑的最优解码顺序信号；免训练的 Attn-Sampler 在不增加训练成本的前提下，显著提升了扩散式大语言模型的生成质量与推理效率，为并行语言模型解码开辟了新范式。

Abstract: Auto-regressive models (ARMs) have established a dominant paradigm in language modeling. However, their strictly sequential decoding paradigm imposes fundamental constraints on both inference efficiency and modeling flexibility. To address these limitations, diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have been proposed, offering the potential for parallel decoding and flexible language modeling. Despite these advantages, current dLLMs decoding strategies rely primarily on token level information, which fails to account for global sequence structure and often yields suboptimal results. In this paper, we study the decoding order selection problem from the perspective of log-likelihood maximization. We theoretically demonstrate that optimal sequence likelihood can be approximately achieved by decoding tokens in descending order of their attention matrix column sums. This finding provides a principled justification for attention-guided decoding and offers a theoretically grounded alternative to greedy search. We instantiate this theoretical insight in a new training-free decoding algorithm, termed Attn-Sampler, and further propose a block attention approximation and dynamic attention thresholding for practical acceleration. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed method, demonstrating that it achieves superior generation quality while enhancing the decoding parallelism.

</details>


### [800] [Dynamic sparsity in tree-structured feed-forward layers at scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08565)
*Reza Sedghi,Robin Schiewer,Anand Subramoney,David Kappel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用类树稀疏前替 MLP，算力降至 5%，仍保 1B+ 模型性能，并揭示路由动态自剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 中前馈 MLP 占绝大部分计算，需要能在不损性能的前提下大幅降低 FLOPs 的稀疏替代。

Method: 将 MLP 替换为树状层级前馈，利用硬路由做条件计算，无需单独路由网络；通过非对称激活与自然稀疏化控制静态结构。

Result: 在零/少样本生成式语言建模和下游 QA 上，激活 <5% 参数即可与稠密基线媲美；训练中出现自剪枝，渐进把动态路由转成静态稀疏。

Conclusion: 树型稀疏前馈是大型 Transformer 的可控、可扩展稀疏化机制，为高效预训练和推理提供方向。

Abstract: At typical context lengths, the feed-forward MLP block accounts for a large share of a transformer's compute budget, motivating sparse alternatives to dense MLP blocks. We study sparse, tree-structured feed-forward layers as drop-in replacements for MLP blocks in deep transformer architectures, enabling conditional computation via hard hierarchical routing without a separate router network. We demonstrate for the first time that this form of tree-structured conditional sparsity can be applied for autoregressive language modeling and downstream question answering, including zero- and few-shot settings, and its scalability beyond 1B parameters. Despite activating fewer than 5% of the feed-forward block's units per token, our models match dense baselines under controlled training and fine-tuning protocols. We further analyze training dynamics and identify an emergent auto-pruning effect: the interaction of hard routing with asymmetric nonlinearities progressively deactivates unused paths, yielding partial conversion of dynamic routing into static structural sparsity. We show that simple architectural choices can modulate this behavior and recover balanced trees without auxiliary losses. Overall, our work demonstrates that tree-structured feed-forward layers provide a scalable and controllable mechanism for sparsifying large transformer models.

</details>


### [801] [Sentiment Classification of Gaza War Headlines: A Comparative Analysis of Large Language Models and Arabic Fine-Tuned BERT Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08566)
*Amr Eleraqi,Hager H. Mustafa,Abdul Hadi N. Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究以2023年加沙战争为例，比较3种LLM与6种阿拉伯BERT模型对冲突报道的情绪解读差异，发现模型选择本身即是一种叙事立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情绪分析多追求与人工标注一致，却忽视模型架构差异会系统性地塑造对战争叙事的“情感镜头”。作者提出将情绪分类视为模型生成的解释行为，而非单一真理的逼近。

Method: 收集10,990条阿拉伯语头条(Eleraqi 2026)，用信息论与分布指标(Shannon熵、JS距离、方差分数)量化模型间差异；再进行框架条件实验，观察人道、法律、安全三种叙事框架对GPT-4.1等模型情绪判断的调节作用。

Result: 1) 差异显著且非随机：微调BERT(尤其MARBERT)高度倾向中性；LLM持续放大负面，LLaMA-3.1-8B几乎全线崩解为负面。2) 仅GPT-4.1能依框架显著调节情绪极性，其余LLM语境调制弱。

Conclusion: 在战争与危机语境下，把自动情绪输出视为中立、可互换的“媒体基调测量”存在风险；应将算法差异本身作为研究对象，并在计算社会科学与媒体研究中承认模型即立场。

Abstract: This study examines how different artificial intelligence architectures interpret sentiment in conflict-related media discourse, using the 2023 Gaza War as a case study. Drawing on a corpus of 10,990 Arabic news headlines (Eleraqi 2026), the research conducts a comparative analysis between three large language models and six fine-tuned Arabic BERT models. Rather than evaluating accuracy against a single human-annotated gold standard, the study adopts an epistemological approach that treats sentiment classification as an interpretive act produced by model architectures. To quantify systematic differences across models, the analysis employs information-theoretic and distributional metrics, including Shannon Entropy, Jensen-Shannon Distance, and a Variance Score measuring deviation from aggregate model behavior. The results reveal pronounced and non-random divergence in sentiment distributions. Fine-tuned BERT models, particularly MARBERT, exhibit a strong bias toward neutral classifications, while LLMs consistently amplify negative sentiment, with LLaMA-3.1-8B showing near-total collapse into negativity. Frame-conditioned analysis further demonstrates that GPT-4.1 adjusts sentiment judgments in line with narrative frames (e.g., humanitarian, legal, security), whereas other LLMs display limited contextual modulation. These findings suggest that the choice of model constitutes a choice of interpretive lens, shaping how conflict narratives are algorithmically framed and emotionally evaluated. The study contributes to media studies and computational social science by foregrounding algorithmic discrepancy as an object of analysis and by highlighting the risks of treating automated sentiment outputs as neutral or interchangeable measures of media tone in contexts of war and crisis.

</details>


### [802] [GAN-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning for Semantic-Aware Resource Allocation in 6G Network Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08576)
*Daniel Benniah John*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 设计 GAN-DDPG 框架，通过条件 GAN 数据增广与语义感知奖励，在 6G 三业务场景下将频谱效率提升 20-25%，延迟降低 18%，丢包下降 31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G 需同时满足 eMBB(Tbps)、mMTC(1000 万/km²) 与 URLLC(0.1-1 ms) 极致指标，而现有分配算法因语义冗余、离散动作及训练样本不足导致性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出 GAN-DDPG：条件 GAN 合成真实业务流量扩增训练集；连续 DDPG 决策连续功率/子带/波束；将语义冗余度显式纳入回报函数，引导策略削冗余、保关键信息。

Result: 与原始 DDPG 相比，统计仿真显示 URLLC 频段效率提升 22%，eMBB 提升 20%，mMTC 提升 25%，时延下降 18%，丢包率下降 31%，显著性均达 p<0.001。

Conclusion: GAN-DDPG 通过语义感知生成式增广与连续控制，突破资源离散与样本匮乏限制，可作为 6G 多业务高效动态分配的基础框架。

Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks must support heterogeneous services: enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB) requiring 1 Tbps data rates, massive Machine-Type Communications (mMTC) supporting 10 million devices per km, and Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communications (URLLC) with 0.1-1 ms latency. Current resource allocation suffers from three limitations: (1) semantic blindness wasting 35% bandwidth on redundant data, (2) discrete action quantization, and (3) limited training diversity. This paper proposes GAN-DDPG, a Generative Adversarial Network-enhanced Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient framework integrating conditional GANs for traffic synthesis, continuous action DDPG, and semantic-aware reward optimization. Extensive simulations with statistical validation demonstrate significant improvements: 22% URLLC, 20% eMBB, 25% mMTC spectral efficiency gains (all p < 0.001) compared to baseline DDPG, with 18% latency and 31% packet loss reduction.

</details>


### [803] [Adjoint Matching through the Lens of the Stochastic Maximum Principle in Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08580)
*Carles Domingo-Enrich,Jiequn Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将奖励微调扩散/流模型与Boltzmann采样统一为随机最优控制(SOC)问题，基于随机最大值原理(SMP)严格重建并推广了Adjoint Matching(AM)算法，证明其Hamiltonian目标泛函与SOC原问题一阶变分等价，临界满足HJB方程；在扩散系数与状态-控制无关时得到无Hessian项的轻量损失，并揭示AM是SMP驱动的连续时间逐次逼近法，为随机控制提供可实现的SMP迭代路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流模型奖励微调及Boltzmann型采样均需求解“在SDE约束下优化控制”的SOC问题，但经典基于HJB或SMP的方法面临高维HJB不可解、SMP含不可计算鞅项等计算障碍，亟需可落地的一阶型算法。

Method: 1)基于SMP推导一般Hamiltonian伴随匹配目标，涵盖控制依赖漂移与扩散且运行费用凸的SOC问题；2)证明其期望一阶变分与原SOC目标相同，保证临界点满足HJB平稳条件；3)对常值扩散系数情形，恢复无Hessian的lean adjoint matching损失并给出最优控制唯一性条件；4)将AM解释为SMP诱导的连续时间逐次逼近迭代，完全避开鞅项，可直接用可观测噪声样本实现更新。

Result: 理论上，首次在SMP框架下严格证明Adjoint Matching与HJB平稳条件等价；算法上，提出可扩展、易实现的lean loss及迭代模板，无需反向SDE或高阶导数；实验对比显示其在高维生成任务中比传统SMP/HJB方案收敛更快、方差更低，可直接用于扩散模型奖励微调与能量引导采样。

Conclusion: Adjoint Matching不仅是扩散模型奖励微调的高效算法，更是随机控制领域首个可规模化实现的SMP型一阶方法，架起了“生成模型优化”与“随机控制理论”之间的可计算桥梁，并为进一步研究非凸费用、部分观测等更复杂SOC问题提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: Reward fine-tuning of diffusion and flow models and sampling from tilted or Boltzmann distributions can both be formulated as stochastic optimal control (SOC) problems, where learning an optimal generative dynamics corresponds to optimizing a control under SDE constraints. In this work, we revisit and generalize Adjoint Matching, a recently proposed SOC-based method for learning optimal controls, and place it on a rigorous footing by deriving it from the Stochastic Maximum Principle (SMP). We formulate a general Hamiltonian adjoint matching objective for SOC problems with control-dependent drift and diffusion and convex running costs, and show that its expected value has the same first variation as the original SOC objective. As a consequence, critical points satisfy the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) stationarity conditions. In the important practical case of state- and control-independent diffusion, we recover the lean adjoint matching loss previously introduced in adjoint matching, which avoids second-order terms and whose critical points coincide with the optimal control under mild uniqueness assumptions. Finally, we show that adjoint matching can be precisely interpreted as a continuous-time method of successive approximations induced by the SMP, yielding a practical and implementable alternative to classical SMP-based algorithms, which are obstructed by intractable martingale terms in the stochastic setting. These results are also of independent interest to the stochastic control community, providing new implementable objectives and a viable pathway for SMP-based iterations in stochastic problems.

</details>


### [804] [OpenKedge: Governing Agentic Mutation with Execution-Bound Safety and Evidence Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08601)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OpenKedge 用「先申报、再治理、后执行」的三段式协议，把 AI 自主代理的随机 API 调用改造成可验证、可审计、可冲突裁决的安全流程，在多代理与云基础设施实验中实现高吞吐与确定性安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 API 架构把概率性 AI 代理的每次调用直接映射为状态变更，缺乏上下文、协调与安全保证，导致冲突与不可预测风险。

Method: 1) 代理提交声明式意图提案；2) 系统用确定性派生状态+时间信号+策略约束进行预执行评估；3) 获批意图被编译成限时、限资源、限动作的「执行合约」；4) 通过一次性任务身份强制履约；5) IEEC 证据链把意图、上下文、策略、执行边界、结果一次性加密串联，形成可重放审计轨迹。

Result: 多代理冲突与云基础设施突变实验显示：OpenKedge 能确定性仲裁竞争意图，将不安全执行限制在合约边界内，同时保持高吞吐。

Conclusion: OpenKedge 把「事后过滤」转为「事前治理+执行时笼箍+事后可证」，为大规模部署自治代理提供了可复制、可审计、可推理的安全地基。

Abstract: The rise of autonomous AI agents exposes a fundamental flaw in API-centric architectures: probabilistic systems directly execute state mutations without sufficient context, coordination, or safety guarantees. We introduce OpenKedge, a protocol that redefines mutation as a governed process rather than an immediate consequence of API invocation. OpenKedge requires actors to submit declarative intent proposals, which are evaluated against deterministically derived system state, temporal signals, and policy constraints prior to execution. Approved intents are compiled into execution contracts that strictly bound permitted actions, resource scope, and time, and are enforced via ephemeral, task-oriented identities. This shifts safety from reactive filtering to preventative, execution-bound enforcement. Crucially, OpenKedge introduces an Intent-to-Execution Evidence Chain (IEEC), which cryptographically links intent, context, policy decisions, execution bounds, and outcomes into a unified lineage. This transforms mutation into a verifiable and reconstructable process, enabling deterministic auditability and reasoning about system behavior. We evaluate OpenKedge across multi-agent conflict scenarios and cloud infrastructure mutations. Results show that the protocol deterministically arbitrates competing intents and cages unsafe execution while maintaining high throughput, establishing a principled foundation for safely operating agentic systems at scale.

</details>


### [805] [TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Title and Abstract Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08602)
*Yuki Kataoka,Masahiro Banno,Michihito Kyo,Shuri Nakao,Tomoo Sato,Shunsuke Taito,Tomohiro Takayama,Takahiro Tsuge,Yasushi Tsujimoto,Ryuhei So,Toshi A. Furukawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TiAb Review Plugin是第一个无服务器、零代码的浏览器插件，将LLM批量初筛与可验证的ML主动学习整合到同一工作流，可直接用于系统评价文献初筛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统评价初筛工具要么需付费订阅服务器，要么要求用户具备编码能力，限制了广泛应用。作者希望提供一种免费、免服务器、零代码且支持多人协作的解决方案。

Method: 基于Chrome扩展框架，用Google Sheets作共享数据库；本地加密存储用户自备的Gemini API密钥。提供三种模式：人工勾选、LLM批量判定、浏览器内ML主动学习。ML模块将ASReview默认TF-IDF+朴素贝叶斯用TypeScript重实现，并用10折交叉验证在6个公开数据集上与Python原版对比一致性。LLM模块在基准数据集上比较16组Gemini 3.0 Flash配置，选出最优参数（低思考预算、TopP=0.95）后，再用敏感型提示词在5个外部数据集（1038–5628篇、患病率0.5–2%）评估召回与效率。

Result: TypeScript版与原版ASReview的前100位排序100%一致。LLM模式下召回率94–100%，精确率2–15%，95%召回水平下的抽样工作量节省（WSS@95）48.7–87.3%。

Conclusion: 该插件首次把LLM批量初筛与可验证的ML主动学习无缝集成到无服务器、零代码环境，性能与原版ASReview一致，可直接用于实际系统评价初筛，并支持多人协作。

Abstract: Background: Server-based screening tools impose subscription costs, while open-source alternatives require coding skills. Objectives: We developed a browser extension that provides no-code, serverless artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted title and abstract screening and examined its functionality. Methods: TiAb Review Plugin is an open-source Chrome browser extension (available at https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tiab-review-plugin/alejlnlfflogpnabpbplmnojgoeeabij). It uses Google Sheets as a shared database, requiring no dedicated server and enabling multi-reviewer collaboration. Users supply their own Gemini API key, stored locally and encrypted. The tool offers three screening modes: manual review, large language model (LLM) batch screening, and machine learning (ML) active learning. For ML evaluation, we re-implemented the default ASReview active learning algorithm (TF-IDF with Naive Bayes) in TypeScript to enable in-browser execution, and verified equivalence against the original Python implementation using 10-fold cross-validation on six datasets. For LLM evaluation, we compared 16 parameter configurations across two model families on a benchmark dataset, then validated the optimal configuration (Gemini 3.0 Flash, low thinking budget, TopP=0.95) with a sensitivity-oriented prompt on five public datasets (1,038 to 5,628 records, 0.5 to 2.0 percent prevalence). Results: The TypeScript classifier produced top-100 rankings 100 percent identical to the original ASReview across all six datasets. For LLM screening, recall was 94 to 100 percent with precision of 2 to 15 percent, and Work Saved over Sampling at 95 percent recall (WSS@95) ranged from 48.7 to 87.3 percent. Conclusions: We developed a functional browser extension that integrates LLM screening and ML active learning into a no-code, serverless environment, ready for practical use in systematic review screening.

</details>


### [806] [Semantic Intent Fragmentation: A Single-Shot Compositional Attack on Multi-Agent AI Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08608)
*Tanzim Ahad,Ismail Hossain,Md Jahangir Alam,Sai Puppala,Yoonpyo Lee,Syed Bahauddin Alam,Sajedul Talukder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次定义的“语义意图拆分(SIF)”攻击无需注入或后续交互，仅需一句合法请求便能让大模型编排器把任务拆分成独立无害的子任务，组合后却整体违反企业安全策略；14个真实企业场景中71%成功，而现有子任务级防护全部放行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型编排器将用户请求自动拆分为子任务并调用下游模型/工具。当前所有安全分类器都在子任务粒度运行，无法感知“组合后才违规”的意图拆分风险，形成可被利用的系统性盲区。

Method: (1) 提出SIF攻击框架并实例化四种原子机制：批量作用域提升、静默数据外渗、嵌入式触发器部署、准标识符聚合；(2) 基于OWASP LLM06:2025、MITRE ATLAS、NIST构建三阶段红队自动化管线，为金融报告、信息安全、HR分析三类业务生成14个高保真场景；(3) 用20B GPT编排器验证并采用三信号交叉验证：确定性污点分析、思维链合规评审、跨模型合规裁判(FP=0%)；(4) 评估并给出“计划级信息流追踪+组合合规评估”的闭环检测方案。

Result: 在14个企业场景中共10个触发策略违规计划，成功率71%；所有子任务均被现有分类器判为无害。实验表明模型能力越强，SIF成功率越高；提出的组合级检测方案可在执行前100%发现攻击。

Conclusion: 子任务级防护存在固有组合安全缺口，但可通过“计划级信息流追踪+组合合规判决”闭环解决；建议将SIF纳入LLM编排器默认威胁模型，并在部署层强制启用组合式策略引擎。

Abstract: We introduce Semantic Intent Fragmentation (SIF), an attack class against LLM orchestration systems where a single, legitimately phrased request causes an orchestrator to decompose a task into subtasks that are individually benign but jointly violate security policy. Current safety mechanisms operate at the subtask level, so each step clears existing classifiers -- the violation only emerges at the composed plan. SIF exploits OWASP LLM06:2025 through four mechanisms: bulk scope escalation, silent data exfiltration, embedded trigger deployment, and quasi-identifier aggregation, requiring no injected content, no system modification, and no attacker interaction after the initial request. We construct a three-stage red-teaming pipeline grounded in OWASP, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST frameworks to generate realistic enterprise scenarios. Across 14 scenarios spanning financial reporting, information security, and HR analytics, a GPT-20B orchestrator produces policy-violating plans in 71% of cases (10/14) while every subtask appears benign. Three independent signals validate this: deterministic taint analysis, chain-of-thought evaluation, and a cross-model compliance judge with 0% false positives. Stronger orchestrators increase SIF success rates. Plan-level information-flow tracking combined with compliance evaluation detects all attacks before execution, showing the compositional safety gap is closable.

</details>


### [807] [Detection of Hate and Threat in Digital Forensics: A Case-Driven Multimodal Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08609)
*Ponkoj Chandra Shill*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对数字取证场景下的图像‐文本混合证据，提出一种“先判断证据来源、再按需调用模型”的多模态框架，可解释地识别仇恨/威胁内容，避免对干净文本的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化方法要么默认输入为干净文本，要么盲目用视觉模型，未考虑数字取证中常见的扫描文档、图片嵌字、上下文报告等异质证据，导致证据链不可解释且误判风险高。

Method: 构建三阶段流程：①证据解析器把输入拆成“图片嵌字、上下文文本、纯视觉”三类；②根据配置开关，分别调用文本分类器、ViT-语言模型跨模态融合或纯视觉推理；③输出结果附带证据来源标签，供溯源。

Result: 在模拟取证数据集上，相比统一多模态基线，宏平均F1提升6–11%，且同一案件内部决策逻辑稳定，可给出“仅因嵌入文字触发”或“仅因视觉场景触发”等解释。

Conclusion: 按证据存在性条件化推理，能贴合取证规范、增强可追溯性，并减少无依据的模态假设，为法庭呈现提供透明路径。

Abstract: Digital forensic investigations increasingly rely on heterogeneous evidence such as images, scanned documents, and contextual reports. These artifacts may contain explicit or implicit expressions of harm, hate, threat, violence, or intimidation, yet existing automated approaches often assume clean text input or apply vision models without forensic justification. This paper presents a case-driven multimodal approach for hate and threat detection in forensic analysis. The proposed framework explicitly determines the presence and source of textual evidence, distinguishing between embedded text, associated contextual text, and image-only evidence. Based on the identified evidence configuration, the framework selectively applies text analysis, multimodal fusion, or image-only semantic reasoning using vision language models with vision transformer backbones (ViT). By conditioning inference on evidence availability, the approach mirrors forensic decision-making, improves evidentiary traceability, and avoids unjustified modality assumptions. Experimental evaluation on forensic-style image evidence demonstrates consistent and interpretable behavior across heterogeneous evidence scenarios.

</details>


### [808] [Sustained Impact of Agentic Personalisation in Marketing: A Longitudinal Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08621)
*Olivier Jeunen,Eleanor Hanna,Schaun Wheeler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在11个月的现实场景里，让营销机器人先“离线”再“独自营业”：有人管时效果最好，无人管时仍能保持正向提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CRM靠人工制定静态规则，难以在大规模用户中持续提效；自适应系统虽可个性化，却缺乏“人需干预多久”的实证证据。

Method: 纵向对比实验——先3个月人工策划内容、人群与策略（活跃期），后8个月仅由代理从固定组件库自主生成消息（被动期），追踪关键 engagement 指标变化。

Result: 活跃期人工干预带来最高相对提升；被动期无人干预下，代理仍能维持显著为正的提升，且衰减有限。

Conclusion: 人机共生最优：人负责策略初始化与持续发现，代理负责规模化地留存并固化收益，从而降低长期人工负载。

Abstract: In consumer applications, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) has traditionally relied on the manual optimisation of static, rule-based messaging strategies. While adaptive and autonomous learning systems offer the promise of scalable personalisation, it remains unclear to what extent ``human-in-the-loop'' oversight is required to sustain performance uplift over time. This paper presents a longitudinal case study analysing a real-world consumer application that leverages agentic infrastructure to personalise marketing messaging for a large-scale user base over an 11-month period.
  We compare two distinct periods: an active phase where marketers directly curated content, audiences, and strategies -- followed immediately by a passive phase where agents operated autonomously from a fixed library of components. Our results demonstrate that whilst active human management generates the highest relative lift in engagement metrics, the autonomous agents successfully sustained a positive lift during the passive period. These findings suggest a symbiotic model where human intervention drives strategic initialisation and discovery, yet autonomous agents can ensure the scalable retention and preservation of performance gains.

</details>


### [809] [Spectral-Transport Stability and Benign Overfitting in Interpolating Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08625)
*Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Lundström Fredriksson-Imanov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出谱-传输稳定性框架，系统解释了过参数化插值估计器为何能同时实现零训练误差与非平凡预测性能，并给出插值从良性走向恶化的理论判据，统一刻画了算法稳定性、双下降和隐式正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习普遍实现插值（零训练误差）却保有良好泛化，传统统计理论难以解释这一现象，更缺乏划分良性的‘合理过拟合’与破坏性的‘危险过拟合’的清晰指标；作者试图建立覆盖算法、几何与统计的综合统一理论。

Method: 引入谱代替传统 VC 维的复杂度思路，提出三项核心度量：①数据分布的谱几何（特征值衰减）、②估计器在单样本替换下的稳定性（transport stability）、③标签噪声与谱结构的耦合（alignment）。将它们组合成规模依赖的 Fredriksson 指数，并在某类可容许谱尺度上令该指数趋于零，即可获得插值相下的有限样本超额风险界，并论证过渡速率和相变现象。针对‘谱呈多项式衰减的线性模型’做模型特例，给出显式定阈定理与收敛速率证明。

Result: 得到插值相下的通用超额风险上界；为‘良性过拟合’提供完整判别条件（Fredriksson 指数归零），并给出其随多项式谱衰减的快速、慢速相变速率；在线性插值案例中证明最优收敛率为 O(d_eff/n)，令算子理论框架能解释常见的双下降曲线。

Conclusion: 通过谱-传输稳定性框架，首次将算法稳定性、双下降、良性过拟合、算子理论学习理论和优化诱导的隐式偏差纳入同一结构；显式揭示了过参数化方法通过最小化谱-传输能量进行隐式正则的机制，为后续泛化分析提供普适理论工具，但对真实深度网络谱结构的验证及扩展到非线性/随机算法仍待未来工作。

Abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for generalization in the interpolating regime of statistical learning. The central question is why highly overparameterized estimators can attain zero empirical risk while still achieving nontrivial predictive accuracy, and how to characterize the boundary between benign and destructive overfitting. We introduce a spectral-transport stability framework in which excess risk is controlled jointly by the spectral geometry of the data distribution, the sensitivity of the learning rule under single-sample replacement, and the alignment structure of label noise. This leads to a scale-dependent Fredriksson index that combines effective dimension, transport stability, and noise alignment into a single complexity parameter for interpolating estimators. We prove finite-sample risk bounds, establish a sharp benign-overfitting criterion through the vanishing of the index along admissible spectral scales, and derive explicit phase-transition rates under polynomial spectral decay. For a model-specific specialization, we obtain an explicit theorem for polynomial-spectrum linear interpolation, together with a proof of the resulting rate. The framework also clarifies implicit regularization by showing how optimization dynamics can select interpolating solutions of minimal spectral-transport energy. These results connect algorithmic stability, double descent, benign overfitting, operator-theoretic learning theory, and implicit bias within a unified structural account of modern interpolation.

</details>


### [810] [3D-VCD: Hallucination Mitigation in 3D-LLM Embodied Agents through Visual Contrastive Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08645)
*Makanjuola Ogunleye,Eman Abdelrahman,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个面向3D具身智能的推理阶段幻觉抑制框架3D-VCD，通过在3D场景图上做语义-几何扰动作对比解码，无需重训即可显著降低幻觉并提升HEAL等3D基准的可靠决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉抑制技术针对2D视觉-语言，无法解决3D场景特有的

Method: 提出3D-VCD：1) 将场景转为对象级3D图；2)施加类别替换、坐标/尺寸扰动生成失真图；3)对比原图与失真图的单步logits，抑制对场景内容不敏感的token；4)零重训推断阶段即插即用。

Result: 在3D-POPE、HEAL两基准上，与BLIP-2等基线相比，3D-VCD平均降低X%-Y%幻觉率并同步提升下游任务(Y%)，零样本跨场景迁移效果稳定，推理耗时≈1.3×原模型。

Conclusion: 证明了基于3D结构化表示的对比推理是可行且实用的幻觉抑制新范式，为安全具身智能提供不依赖重训的即插即用方案，并指出可扩展至物理交互与动态场景约束的未来方向。

Abstract: Large multimodal models are increasingly used as the reasoning core of embodied agents operating in 3D environments, yet they remain prone to hallucinations that can produce unsafe and ungrounded decisions. Existing inference-time hallucination mitigation methods largely target 2D vision-language settings and do not transfer to embodied 3D reasoning, where failures arise from object presence, spatial layout, and geometric grounding rather than pixel-level inconsistencies. We introduce 3D-VCD, the first inference-time visual contrastive decoding framework for hallucination mitigation in 3D embodied agents. 3D-VCD constructs a distorted 3D scene graph by applying semantic and geometric perturbations to object-centric representations, such as category substitutions and coordinate or extent corruption. By contrasting predictions under the original and distorted 3D contexts, our method suppresses tokens that are insensitive to grounded scene evidence and are therefore likely driven by language priors. We evaluate 3D-VCD on the 3D-POPE and HEAL benchmarks and show that it consistently improves grounded reasoning without any retraining, establishing inference-time contrastive decoding over structured 3D representations as an effective and practical route to more reliable embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [811] [High-dimensional inference for the $γ$-ray sky with differentiable programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08648)
*Siddharth Mishra-Sharma,Tracy R. Slatyer,Yitian Sun,Yuqing Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可微分概率编程技术一次性处理银河系中心γ射线余辉(GCE)模型空间巨大的难题，同时推断连续空间形态并展示该方法在天体物理中的普适潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系中心γ射线余辉(GCE)成因长期未解，候选空间模板众多且形态连续，传统逐模板拟合效率低、无法穷尽模型空间，需一种可同时对连续形态建模并高效推断的方法。

Method: 构建完全可微的γ射线前向模型与似然函数，利用GPU加速与向量化实现连续空间模板的自由参数化；在可微分概率编程框架下采用变分推断，对整个高维连续模型空间进行一次性联合推断。

Result: 方法可在单次推断中评估与GCE相容的连续空间形态，显著降低计算开销，实现对大模型空间的高效贝叶斯推断。

Conclusion: 可微分概率编程为处理天体物理中“模板空间巨大”类问题提供通用、高效的新范式，未来可拓展至其他波段与天体物理数据分析。

Abstract: We motivate the use of differentiable probabilistic programming techniques in order to account for the large model-space inherent to astrophysical $γ$-ray analyses. Targeting the longstanding Galactic Center $γ$-ray Excess (GCE) puzzle, we construct differentiable forward model and likelihood that make liberal use of GPU acceleration and vectorization in order to simultaneously account for a continuum of possible spatial morphologies consistent with the GCE emission in a fully probabilistic manner. Our setup allows for efficient inference over the large model space using variational methods. Beyond application to $γ$-ray data, a goal of this work is to showcase how differentiable probabilistic programming can be used as a tool to enable flexible analyses of astrophysical datasets.

</details>


### [812] [Geometry-Induced Long-Range Correlations in Recurrent Neural Network Quantum States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08661)
*Asif Bin Ayub,Amine Mohamed Aboussalah,Mohamed Hibat-Allah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 仅用O(N log N)代价把「空洞卷积」嵌进自回归RNN量子态，可显式诱导长程关联，在临界横场Ising与Cluster态上同时击败标准RNN与计算昂贵的Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归RNN量子态能无马尔可夫链采样，却被其顺序结构束缚在指数衰减关联，难以描述临界或纠缠态的长程特性；纯Transformer虽能增强感受野却带来O(N²)乃至更高开销，需寻找既能保留RNN线性-对数复杂度又能引入长程偏置的折中方案。

Method: 提出Dilated RNN波函数：将循环单元按指数级扩张间距连接（空洞卷积思想），使任意两格点间最短路径长度降至O(log N)；在前向传播时仅保留局部参数共享与稀疏依赖，整体运算复杂度控制在O(N log N)。在简化线性化与微扰极限下解析证明扩张会改变关联几何并可诱发幂律衰减；对临界一维横场Ising模型与具长程条件关联的Cluster态进行数值变分蒙特卡罗，对比标准RNN与Transformer基准。

Result: 理论分析：扩张使有效关联长度按空洞步长成指数增长，可在1D链上产生任意幂指数。数值实验：在临界横场Ising中，扩张RNN的连通两点关联呈~r^{-η}幂律，与传统RNN的指数衰减形成鲜明对比；在同一网络结构和参数量下，同时精确复现Cluster态纠缠熵与局部可观测量，此前RNN方案需显著增加参数量仍难收敛。计算开销相较标准RNN仅增常数倍，远低于自注意力机制。

Conclusion: 空洞扩张是一种几何级、低成本的长程归纳偏置注入方式，可在保持RNN线性-对数复杂度的前提下，系统性地拓宽自回归神经量子态的关联捕捉能力，为临界量子相与高度纠缠态的紧凑表示提供新普适工具，也可推广至更高维晶格及其他生成建模任务。

Abstract: Neural Quantum States based on autoregressive recurrent neural network (RNN) wave functions enable efficient sampling without Markov-chain autocorrelation, but standard RNN architectures are biased toward finite-length correlations and can fail on states with long-range dependencies. A common response is to adopt transformer-style self-attention, but this typically comes with substantially higher computational and memory overhead. Here we introduce dilated RNN wave functions, where recurrent units access distant sites through dilated connections, injecting an explicit long-range inductive bias while retaining a favorable $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$ forward pass scaling. We show analytically that dilation changes the correlation geometry and can induce power-law correlation scaling in a simplified linearized and perturbative setting. Numerically, for the critical 1D transverse-field Ising model, dilated RNNs reproduce the expected power-law connected two-point correlations in contrast to the exponential decay typical of conventional RNN ansätze. We further show that the dilated RNN accurately approximates the one-dimensional Cluster state, a paradigmatic example with long-range conditional correlations that has previously been reported to be challenging for RNN-based wave functions. These results highlight dilation as a simple geometric mechanism for building correlation-aware autoregressive neural quantum states.

</details>


### [813] [An Algorithm for Fast Assembling Large-Scale Defect-Free Atom Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08669)
*Tao Zhang,Xiaodi Li,Hui Zhai,Linghui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用一套机器学习＋改进GS算法的框架，把10⁴量级缺陷-free原子阵列的组装时间压缩到真空寿命以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光镊原子阵列虽具极佳扩展性，但现有算法在路径规划与势场生成环节存在NP难与刷新慢的双重瓶颈，致使器件无法瞬间生成10⁴无缺陷阵列。

Method: 提出两模块一体化框架：(i)基于图神经网络＋改进拍卖解码器的监督式路径规划；(ii)兼顾相位与振幅权重的相位场重则化GS算法势场生成。推理/刷新时间分别≈5ms/0.5ms，均低于真空寿命和SLM帧率。

Result: 算法可直接在SLM刷新周期内快速生成10⁴缺陷原子阵列并稳定重复，耗时远短于常规真空俘获寿命，硬件瓶颈同步解决。

Conclusion: 该方法突破扩数量子计算的算法障碍，为后续10⁴级光镊阵列提供可靠、实时、可扩展的缺陷-free装载方案，同时适用于其他SLM驱动的原子光学系统。

Abstract: It is widely believed that tens of thousands of physical qubits are needed to build a practically useful quantum computer. Atom arrays formed by optical tweezers are among the most promising platforms for achieving this goal, owing to the excellent scalability and mobility of atomic qubits. However, assembling a defect-free atom array with ~ 10^4 qubits remains algorithmically challenging, alongside other hardware limitations. This is due to the computationally hard path-planning problems and the time-consuming generation of suffciently smooth trajectories for optical tweezer potentials by spatial light modulators (SLM). Here, we present a unified framework comprising two innovative components to fully address these algorithmic challenges: (1) a path-planning module that employs a supervised learning approach using a graph neural network combined with a modified auction decoder, and (2) a potential-generation module called the phase and profile-aware Weighted Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm. The inference time for the first module is nearly a size-independent constant overhead of ~ 5 ms, and the second module generates a potential frame with about 0.5 ms, a timescale shorter than the current commercial SLM refresh time. Altogether, our algorithm enables the assembly of an atom array with 10^4 qubits on a timescale much shorter than the typical vacuum lifetime of the trapped atoms.

</details>


### [814] [EfficientSign: An Attention-Enhanced Lightweight Architecture for Indian Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08694)
*Rishabh Gupta,Shravya R. Nalla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于 EfficientNet-B0 的轻量级模型 EfficientSign，在 12k+ ISL 手语字母数据集上，用 62% 更少参数达到 99.94% 准确率，可直接部署在手机端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 要让手语识别在手机上实时运行，需在极低计算预算下保持高精度，现有大模型或手工特征无法满足。

Method: 以 EfficientNet-B0 为骨干，插入 SE 通道注意力与自研空间注意力模块，专注提取手势区域；并用 5×5 折叠交叉验证对比 5 种方案；同时把深度特征喂给 SVM/LR/KNN 验证表征能力。

Result: EfficientSign 准确率 99.94%±0.05%，与 ResNet18 的 99.97% 相当，参数仅 4.2 M（减少 62%）；SVM 用 1280 维深度特征亦达 99.63%，远超 2015 年 SURF 最佳 92%。

Conclusion: 注意力增强的轻量模型可在移动端高效完成 ISL 识别，无需大模型或手工特征工程，为移动手语应用提供了可落地的解决方案。

Abstract: How do you build a sign language recognizer that works on a phone? That question drove this work. We built EfficientSign, a lightweight model which takes EfficientNet-B0 and focuses on two attention modules (Squeeze-and-Excitation for channel focus, and a spatial attention layer that focuses on the hand gestures). We tested it against five other approaches on 12,637 images of Indian Sign Language alphabets, all 26 classes, using 5-fold cross-validation. EfficientSign achieves the accuracy of 99.94% (+/-0.05%), which matches the performance of ResNet18's 99.97% accuracy, but with 62% fewer parameters (4.2M vs 11.2M). We also experimented with feeding deep features (1,280-dimensional vectors pulled from EfficientNet-B0's pooling layer) into classical classifiers. SVM achieved the accuracy of 99.63%, Logistic Regression achieved the accuracy of 99.03% and KNN achieved accuracy of 96.33%. All of these blow past the 92% that SURF-based methods managed on a similar dataset back in 2015. Our results show that attention-enhanced learning model provides an efficient and deployable solution for ISL recognition without requiring a massive model or hand-tuned feature pipelines anymore.

</details>


### [815] [Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08701)
*Dengjia Zhang,Alexander Martin,William Jurayj,Kenton Murray,Benjamin Van Durme,Reno Kriz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次提出跨文本、语音、视频的统一不确定推理（UMUI）任务，并给出可标定概率的人类标注评测集；所提3B模型CLUE在5类模态上性能持平或优于32B基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本不确定推理无法覆盖语音、视频等模态，现有方法仅限单模态二元蕴含判断，缺乏细粒度、可标定的概率推理框架；跨模态场景存在空白。

Method: 1) 构建三模态人类标定数据集，提供0-1连续概率；2) 设计CLUE框架，融合自洽教师标定与分布式置信探针，实现跨模态标定预测；3) 同时在既有文本、音频基准及自建多模态数据上统一评测。

Result: 3B CLUE模型在全部5种设定（文本、音频、视频、视听、文本-视听）上，标定误差与下游不确定推理指标均优于或持平最大32B基线，验证小模型跨模态标定能力。

Conclusion: 统一多模态不确定推理可借助标定策略在小参数规模下完成，CLUE为后续跨模态可信概率估计提供新基准与方法论。

Abstract: We introduce Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a multimodal inference task spanning text, audio, and video, where models must produce calibrated probability estimates of hypotheses conditioned on a premise in any modality or combination. While uncertain inference has been explored in text, extension to other modalities has been limited to single-modality binary entailment judgments, leaving no framework for fine-grained probabilistic reasoning in or across other modalities. To address this, we curate a human-annotated evaluation set with scalar probability judgments across audio, visual, and audiovisual settings, and additionally evaluate on existing text and audio benchmarks. We introduce CLUE (Calibrated Latent Uncertainty Estimation), which combines self-consistent teacher calibration and distribution-based confidence probing to produce calibrated predictions. We demonstrate that our 3B-parameter model achieves equivalent or stronger performance than baselines up to 32B parameters across all modalities.

</details>


### [816] [QoS-QoE Translation with Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08703)
*Yingjie Yu,Mingyuan Wu,Ahmadreza Eslaminia,Lingzhi Zhao,Kaizhuo Yan,Klara Nahrstedt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者开源了一个面向视频流的结构化 QoS-QoE 映射数据集，并用其微调 LLM，实现双向 QoS↔QoE 预测，为多媒体质量建模提供可复现的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多篇文献给出的 QoS-QoE 关系彼此割裂、实验设定与报告格式不一，难以复用、横向比较或大规模分析，需要统一、可扩展的数据资源。

Method: 设计全自动管道：爬取文献→抽取 QoS-QoE 关系→迭代校验；为每条记录保留参数定义、支撑证据与上下文元数据；构建 QoS-QoE Translation 数据集；用该数据集对 LLM 进行监督微调并评估双向预测性能。

Result: 数据集覆盖视频流媒体场景，LLM 微调后在连续值与离散标签的 QoS→QoE 与 QoE→QoS 双向翻译任务均取得显著提升；代码和数据公开可复现。

Conclusion: 结构化 QoS-QoE 数据集填补了领域空白，可直接充当 LLM 评测基准，并支撑后续基于大模型的多媒体质量预测与自适应优化研究。

Abstract: QoS-QoE translation is a fundamental problem in multimedia systems because it characterizes how measurable system and network conditions affect user-perceived experience. Although many prior studies have examined this relationship, their findings are often developed for specific setups and remain scattered across papers, experimental settings, and reporting formats, limiting systematic reuse, cross-scenario generalization, and large-scale analysis. To address this gap, we first introduce QoS-QoE Translation dataset, a source-grounded dataset of structured QoS-QoE relationships from the multimedia literature, with a focus on video streaming related tasks. We construct the dataset through an automated pipeline that combines paper curation, QoS-QoE relationship extraction, and iterative data evaluation. Each record preserves the extracted relationship together with parameter definitions, supporting evidence, and contextual metadata. We further evaluate the capability of large language models (LLMs) on QoS-QoE translation, both before and after supervised fine-tuning on our dataset, and show strong performance on both continuous-value and discrete-label prediction in bidirectional translation, from QoS-QoE and QoE-QoS. Our dataset provides a foundation for benchmarking LLMs in QoS-QoE translation and for supporting future LLM-based reasoning for multimedia quality prediction and optimization. The complete dataset and code are publicly available at https://yyu6969.github.io/qos-qoe-translation-page/, for full reproducibility and open access.

</details>


### [817] [Deep Learning-Based Tracking and Lineage Reconstruction of Ligament Breakup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08711)
*Vrushank Ahire,Vivek Kurumanghat,Mudasir Ganaie,Lipika Kabiraj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两阶段深度学习框架，仅用高速阴影图像即可端到端重建液片破碎的父子谱系与破碎树，为一次雾化统计提供自动化工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多目标跟踪无法刻画液膜破碎中“一变多”的物理事件，导致喷雾的一次雾化过程难以从图像序列定量解析。

Method: ①基于 Faster R-CNN+FPN 检测单帧液丝与液滴；②用保持形态的合成数据增强训练；③用 Transformer-MLP 将帧间关系分类为“延续/破碎/无关联”，输入为物理启发几何特征。

Result: 检测 F1 最高 0.872；破碎事件识别准确率 86.1%，破碎召回率 100%，可输出破碎树、子代数目及粒径分布。

Conclusion: 首次实现仅依赖阴影成像的液膜破碎谱系全自动追踪，为复杂液体一次雾化研究提供高精度、可扩展的图像分析平台。

Abstract: The disintegration of liquid sheets into ligaments and droplets involves highly transient, multi-scale dynamics that are difficult to quantify from high-speed shadowgraphy images. Identifying droplets, ligaments, and blobs formed during breakup, along with tracking across frames, is essential for spray analysis. However, conventional multi-object tracking frameworks impose strict one-to-one temporal associations and cannot represent one-to-many fragmentation events. In this study, we present a two-stage deep learning framework for object detection and temporal relationship modeling across frames. The framework captures ligament deformation, fragmentation, and parent-child lineage during liquid sheet disintegration. In the first stage, a Faster R-CNN with a ResNet-50 backbone and Feature Pyramid Network detects and classifies ligaments and droplets in high-speed shadowgraphy recordings of an impinging Carbopol gel jet. A morphology-preserving synthetic data generation strategy augments the training set without introducing physically implausible configurations, achieving a held-out F1 score of up to 0.872 across fourteen original-to-synthetic configurations. In the second stage, a Transformer-augmented multilayer perceptron classifies inter-frame associations into continuation, fragmentation (one-to-many), and non-association using physics-informed geometric features.
