This propagation is non-trivial: coefficient substitution alters the covariance structure, and soundness requires proving that the modified Jacobian retains generic full rank -- a new theoretical result (Reduced HTC Theorem). We prove that IIC is sound, monotone, converges in O(|E|) iterations (empirically <=2), and strictly subsumes both HTC and ancestor decomposition. Exhaustive verification on all graphs with n<=5 (134,144 edges) confirms 100% precision (zero false positives); with combined seeds, IIC reduces the HTC gap by over 80%. The propagation gain is gamma~4x (2 seeds identifying ~3% of edges to 97.5% total identification), far exceeding gamma<=1.2x of prior methods that incorporate side information without iterative feedback.

</details>


### [856] [Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09320)
*Siqi Chen,Zhiqiang Wang,Yili Shen,Xianqi Deng,Xi Cheng,Cheng-Wei Ju,Jun Yi,Guo Ling,Dieaa Alhmoud,Hui Guan,Zhou Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FB-GNN-MBE 将基于片段的图神经网络融入多体展开理论，用 QM 算单片段能量、GNN 学多体相互作用，在 2B/3B 能量上达到化学精度；配合“教师-学生”迁移学习，可在不重新训练的情况下快速预测不同尺寸水团簇，显著优于传统模型，适用于大体系电子结构模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当体系超过数百原子后，第一性原理 QM 建模成本过高，亟需一种既能保持量子精度、又能线性扩展且可迁移的替代方法，以支撑复杂化学系统的理性设计与机理研究。

Method: 提出 FB-GNN-MBE 框架：① 将大体系切分为片段，QM 计算单片段能量；② 用 GNN 在 MBE 框架下学习并预测两体、三体等高阶相互作用；③ 构建“教师-学生”迁移协议：先在水团簇混合密度大数据上训练重量级 FB-GNN（教师），再蒸馏至轻量 GNN（学生），最后在统一密度 (H₂O)₂₁ 小数据集微调，实现跨体系零重训练预测。

Result: 在水、苯酚及其混合物的 2B、3B 能量测试上达到化学精度（≈1 kcal mol⁻¹）；准确复现水、苯酚二聚体的一维解离曲线；迁移后模型对任意尺度水团簇的 2B/3B 能量预测误差 <1 meV/分子，耗时降低 1–2 个数量级，显著优于非 FB-GNN 基线。

Conclusion: FB-GNN-MBE 以“QM 片段+GNN 多体”策略在精度、复杂度与可解释性间取得平衡；结合教师-学生迁移学习，可在极小数据与计算开销下跨体系泛化，为大规模分子模拟提供了实用、可扩展的高精度电子结构预测工具。

Abstract: Mechanistic understanding and rational design of complex chemical systems depend on fast and accurate predictions of electronic structures beyond individual building blocks. However, if the system exceeds hundreds of atoms, first-principles quantum mechanical (QM) modeling becomes impractical. In this study, we developed FB-GNN-MBE by integrating a fragment-based graph neural network (FB-GNN) into the many-body expansion (MBE) theory and demonstrated its capacity to reproduce first-principles potential energy surfaces (PES) for hierarchically structured systems with manageable accuracy, complexity, and interpretability. Specifically, we divided the entire system into basic building blocks (fragments), evaluated their one-fragment energies using a QM model, and addressed many-fragment interactions using the structure-property relationships trained by FB-GNNs. Our investigation shows that FB-GNN-MBE achieves chemical accuracy in predicting two-body (2B) and three-body (3B) energies across water, phenol, and mixture benchmarks, as well as the one-dimensional dissociation curves of water and phenol dimers. To transfer the success of FB-GNN-MBE across various systems with minimal computational costs and data demands, we developed and validated a teacher-student learning protocol. A heavy-weight FB-GNN trained on a mixed-density water cluster ensemble (teacher) distills its learned knowledge and passes it to a light-weight GNN (student), which is later fine-tuned on a uniform-density (H2O)21 cluster ensemble. This transfer learning strategy resulted in efficient and accurate prediction of 2B and 3B energies for variously sized water clusters without retraining. Our transferable FB-GNN-MBE framework outperformed conventional non-FB-GNN-based models and showed high practicality for large-scale molecular simulations.

</details>


### [857] [Biologically-Grounded Multi-Encoder Architectures as Developability Oracles for Antibody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09369)
*Simon J. Crouzet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用冻结的蛋白语言模型编码器＋可配置注意力解码器，CrossAbSense 在 5 项可开发性预测中 3 项提升 12–20%，实验筛选成本有望大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型可快速产出海量 de novo 抗体序列，但逐条实验表征成本过高，亟需精准、低成本的可开发性预测器。

Method: 1) 固定 6B 参数蛋白语言模型作序列编码器；2) 对 5 个属性分别做 200 组超参搜索，试出最优注意力解码器：自注意(aggregation 属性) vs 双向交叉注意(表达/热稳定性)；3) GDPa1 基准 242 个治疗性 IgG 训练与验证。

Result: 在 GDPa1 上 3/5 项指标比基线提升 12–20%，其余 2 项持平；学习到的链融合权重显示重链主导聚集风险(w_H=0.62)，稳定性需双链平衡(w_H=0.51)。

Conclusion: 无需再训练大编码器，仅通过针对性解码器即可准确预测关键开发属性，为 AI 设计→实验验证的闭环提供高效过滤，显著降低早期筛选成本。

Abstract: Generative models can now propose thousands of \emph{de novo} antibody sequences, yet translating these designs into viable therapeutics remains constrained by the cost of biophysical characterization. Here we present CrossAbSense, a framework of property-specific neural oracles that combine frozen protein language model encoders with configurable attention decoders, identified through a systematic hyperparameter campaign totaling over 200 runs per property. On the GDPa1 benchmark of 242 therapeutic IgGs, our oracles achieve notable improvements of 12--20\% over established baselines on three of five developability assays and competitive performance on the remaining two. The central finding is that optimal decoder architectures \emph{invert} our initial biological hypotheses: self-attention alone suffices for aggregation-related properties (hydrophobic interaction chromatography, polyreactivity), where the relevant sequence signatures -- such as CDR-H3 hydrophobic patches -- are already fully resolved within single-chain embeddings by the high-capacity 6B encoder. Bidirectional cross-attention, by contrast, is required for expression yield and thermal stability -- properties that inherently depend on the compatibility between heavy and light chains. Learned chain fusion weights independently confirm heavy-chain dominance in aggregation ($w_H = 0.62$) versus balanced contributions for stability ($w_H = 0.51$). We demonstrate practical utility by deploying CrossAbSense on 100 IgLM-generated antibody designs, illustrating a path toward substantial reduction in experimental screening costs.

</details>


### [858] [Variational Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Hydrological PDE-Constrained Learning with Inherent Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09374)
*Prasad Nimantha Madusanka Ukwatta Hewage,Midhun Chakkravarthy,Ruvan Kumara Abeysekara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次把参数化变分量子电路嵌入经典物理引导神经网络，建立洪泛区模拟的量子增强框架，在收敛速度和参数规模上优于纯经典方案，并给出理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 PINN 在多源遥感水动力 PDE 约束学习中训练慢、参数多，且缺乏内禀不确定性表达与通往量子优势的途径，急需融合量子算力与物理知识的水文预测新范式。

Method: 提出 Hybrid Quantum-Classical PINN：用可调角编码把多源遥感特征映射到量子态，硬件高效变分 ansatz 加纠缠层处理，Saint-Venant 浅水方程与 Manning 公式作为可微分物理损失，直接对量子测量不确定性进行量化，并引入“多灾→洪泛”量子迁移预训练协议。在斯里兰卡 Kalu 河盆地卫星与气象多模数据上做数值验证。

Result: 对比同等规模经典 PINN，HQC-PINN 训练迭代次数减少≈3 倍、可训参数量下降≈44%，分类精度持平；理论分析表明物理约束压缩了优化景观，天然抑制变分量子线路中的贫瘠高原现象。

Conclusion: 首次在流域水文预测中实现量子增强的物理信息学习，证明混合量子-经典架构能在保持精度的同时显著压缩资源开销，并为地球系统科学迈向量子优势提供可行路径。

Abstract: We propose a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Physics-Informed Neural Network (HQC-PINN) that integrates parameterized variational quantum circuits into the PINN framework for hydrological PDE-constrained learning. Our architecture encodes multi-source remote sensing features into quantum states via trainable angle encoding, processes them through a hardware-efficient variational ansatz with entangling layers, and constrains the output using the Saint-Venant shallow water equations and Manning's flow equation as differentiable physics loss terms. The inherent stochasticity of quantum measurement provides a natural mechanism for uncertainty quantification without requiring explicit Bayesian inference machinery. We further introduce a quantum transfer learning protocol that pre-trains on multi-hazard disaster data before fine-tuning on flood-specific events. Numerical simulations on multi-modal satellite and meteorological data from the Kalu River basin, Sri Lanka, show that the HQC-PINN achieves convergence in ~3x fewer training epochs and uses ~44% fewer trainable parameters compared to an equivalent classical PINN, while maintaining competitive classification accuracy. Theoretical analysis indicates that hydrological physics constraints narrow the effective optimization landscape, providing a natural mitigation against barren plateaus in variational quantum circuits. This work establishes the first application of quantum-enhanced physics-informed learning to hydrological prediction and demonstrates a viable path toward quantum advantage in environmental science.

</details>


### [859] [Sharp description of local minima in the loss landscape of high-dimensional two-layer ReLU neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09412)
*Jie Huang,Bruno Loureiro,Stefano Sarao Mannelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对两层ReLU网络的总体损失面给出低维精确表征，发现其与SGD动态存在一一对应，并揭示过参数化下最小值由孤立转为连通、全局解更易到达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论与简化假设常忽略真实神经损失面的复杂结构，亟需一个可精确解析且与算法动态直接挂钩的最小模型，以回答“宽网络为何易训练”这一核心问题。

Method: 在服从高斯协变量的师生可实现框架下，利用可测函数空间矩封闭技术，证明所有局部极小可由有限维“汇总统计量”精确参数化；随后建立这些统计量在单步SGD映射下的不动点方程，并借动力系统工具分析其吸引域与连通性。

Result: 导出局部极小的低维代数刻画；证明对应统计量空间内SGD不动点的吸引性；揭示在适度参数化下极小值孤立，而在过参数化下出现平坦方向连接，全局极小吸引域扩大，局部伪解吸引域收缩；对比常用假设（如旋转对称、二次可微）会丢失上述结构。

Conclusion: 即使是最简单的非线性网络，其损失面也呈现层次化连通与算法可达性突变，提示理论分析必须保留非光滑与过参数化特征，才能准确预测优化行为与收敛质量。

Abstract: We study the population loss landscape of two-layer ReLU networks of the form $\sum_{k=1}^K \mathrm{ReLU}(w_k^\top x)$ in a realisable teacher-student setting with Gaussian covariates. We show that local minima admit an exact low-dimensional representation in terms of summary statistics, yielding a sharp and interpretable characterisation of the landscape. We further establish a direct link with one-pass SGD: local minima correspond to attractive fixed points of the dynamics in summary statistics space. This perspective reveals a hierarchical structure of minima: they are typically isolated in the well-specified regime, but become connected by flat directions as network width increases. In this overparameterised regime, global minima become increasingly accessible, attracting the dynamics and reducing convergence to spurious solutions. Overall, our results reveal intrinsic limitations of common simplifying assumptions, which may miss essential features of the loss landscape even in minimal neural network models.

</details>


### [860] [Beyond Augmented-Action Surrogates for Multi-Expert Learning-to-Defer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09414)
*Yannis Montreuil,Axel Carlier,Lai Xing Ng,Wei Tsang Ooi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在“先路由再给专家补信息”的设定下，仅把路由与信息选择拆成独立模块会失败；提出一个联合学习的增广替代函数，理论保证可收敛到贝叶斯最优，并在多种任务上显著提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 L2D 默认为固定信息，但现实系统的专家可在路由后再获取检索结果、工具输出等追加信息—“附加建议”：需同时学习“让谁做”和“给什么资料”，而朴素分离方法在极小非平凡情形都不一致，因此需要联合学习框架与理论保证。

Method: 将“专家+建议”视为联合动作空间，构造增广替代函数，用统一的头同时学习路由与信息选择；证明在可分解假设下的 H-一致性及超额风险迁移界；提出拒绝手工分头的统一训练策略。

Result: 理论上：当样本数→∞ 时算法收敛到 Bayes-optimal 复合策略；实验上：表格、文本、多模态任务中均优于标准 L2D 及其分离头变体，花费与错误率均大幅降低；合成数据验证了分离方法确实落入理论预测的失效模式。

Conclusion: 附加信息选择必须与路由决策拉在一起学。增广替代函数提供一致的优化目标并显著提升性能，是下一代理可择专家系统的有效且可扩展方案。

Abstract: Learning-to-Defer routes each input to the expert that minimizes expected cost, but it assumes that the information available to every expert is fixed at decision time. Many modern systems violate this assumption: after selecting an expert, one may also choose what additional information that expert should receive, such as retrieved documents, tool outputs, or escalation context. We study this problem and call it Learning-to-Defer with advice. We show that a broad family of natural separated surrogates, which learn routing and advice with distinct heads, is inconsistent even in the smallest non-trivial setting. We then introduce an augmented surrogate that operates on the composite expert--advice action space and prove an $\mathcal{H}$-consistency guarantee together with an excess-risk transfer bound, yielding recovery of the Bayes-optimal policy in the limit. Experiments on tabular, language, and multi-modal tasks show that the resulting method improves over standard Learning-to-Defer while adapting its advice-acquisition behavior to the cost regime; a synthetic benchmark confirms the failure mode predicted for separated surrogates.

</details>


### [861] [PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09415)
*Siyuan Zhou,Hejun Wang,Hu Cheng,Jinxi Li,Dongsheng Wang,Junwei Jiang,Yixiao Jin,Jiayue Huang,Shiwei Mao,Shangjia Liu,Yafei Yang,Hongkang Song,Shenxing Wei,Zihui Zhang,Peng Huang,Shijie Liu,Zhengli Hao,Hao Li,Yitian Li,Wenqi Zhou,Zhihan Zhao,Zongqi He,Hongtao Wen,Shouwang Huang,Peng Yun,Bowen Cheng,Pok Kazaf Fu,Wai Kit Lai,Jiahao Chen,Kaiyuan Wang,Zhixuan Sun,Ziqi Li,Haochen Hu,Di Zhang,Chun Ho Yuen,Bing Wang,Zhihua Wang,Chuhang Zou,Bo Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PhysInOne 是首个达 200 万帧、71 类物理现象的超大规模合成数据集，提供 3D 几何、语义、运动与属性等全要素真值，显著拔高基础模型在视频生成、未来帧预测、物性估计与动作迁移任务中的物理合理性，并揭示复杂动力学与内在属性估计两大盲区，为物理可信世界模型设立新基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 训练数据在物理一致性上规模极小（仅数百至数千例），难以支撑具身智能与生成式世界模型对复杂、多物体、真实场景物理规律的学习。

Method: 程序化生成 153 810 个动态 3D 场景，覆盖力学、光学、流体与电磁 71 类基础现象；每帧同步输出 3D 几何、语义、运动向量、物理属性与文本描述五类真值，形成 200 万带标注视频。

Result: 在四大任务（物理感知视频生成、长短时未来帧预测、物理属性估计、动作迁移）上，对基础模型微调后，物理合理性指标显著优于现有最佳方法，同时暴露出对复杂耦合动力学与内在属性估计的系统性缺陷。

Conclusion: PhysInOne 以两个数量级的规模优势为物理可信 AI 提供可复现基准，推动生成、仿真到具身智能全链路的世界模型研究。

Abstract: We present PhysInOne, a large-scale synthetic dataset addressing the critical scarcity of physically-grounded training data for AI systems. Unlike existing datasets limited to merely hundreds or thousands of examples, PhysInOne provides 2 million videos across 153,810 dynamic 3D scenes, covering 71 basic physical phenomena in mechanics, optics, fluid dynamics, and magnetism. Distinct from previous works, our scenes feature multiobject interactions against complex backgrounds, with comprehensive ground-truth annotations including 3D geometry, semantics, dynamic motion, physical properties, and text descriptions. We demonstrate PhysInOne's efficacy across four emerging applications: physics-aware video generation, long-/short-term future frame prediction, physical property estimation, and motion transfer. Experiments show that fine-tuning foundation models on PhysInOne significantly enhances physical plausibility, while also exposing critical gaps in modeling complex physical dynamics and estimating intrinsic properties. As the largest dataset of its kind, orders of magnitude beyond prior works, PhysInOne establishes a new benchmark for advancing physics-grounded world models in generation, simulation, and embodied AI.

</details>


### [862] [Automated Instruction Revision (AIR): A Structured Comparison of Task Adaptation Strategies for LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09418)
*Solomiia Bilyk,Volodymyr Getmanskyi,Taras Firman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 规则归纳的自动指令修正(AIR)方法利用少量任务样本让LLM适配下游任务。在多任务测评中，AIR在标签重映射分类上表现最优或接近最优，而检索和微调分别在封闭问答与结构抽取/推理中更优。该工作指出没有一种烘焙策略在所有场景均占优势，强调适配方式应依据任务特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有让大模型适应下游任务的策略（提示优化、检索微调等）各有局限。作者希望用少量示例、可解释的“指令规则”达成快速定制，并系统厘清不同适配方法何时何用。

Method: 提出Automated Instruction Revision(AIR)：1)基于规则归纳从少量标注中抽象出紧凑可读的指令规则；2)在测试时动态修正提示；3)构建多维度基准（知识注入、结构化抽取、标签重映射、逻辑推理）并与prompt优化、KNN检索、标准微调作对比实验。

Result: 在五份基准上的结果显示任务特性强烈影响最优策略：AIR在标签重映射分类稳居第一或并列第一；KNN检索在closed-book QA领先；微调在结构化抽取与事件顺序推理占绝对优势；AIR优势仅在任务行为可被简短规则描述的条件下显现，否则检索/微调更佳。

Conclusion: 适配性能任务依赖显著，不存在万能策略。AIR是一种低成本且具备可解释性的替代方案，适用于可规则化任务；而涉及源特定知识或数据标注偏好的复杂任务，仍以检索或微调为首选。作者建议按任务特性动态选择适配技术。

Abstract: This paper studies Automated Instruction Revision (AIR), a rule-induction-based method for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks using limited task-specific examples. We position AIR within the broader landscape of adaptation strategies, including prompt optimization, retrieval-based methods, and fine-tuning. We then compare these approaches across a diverse benchmark suite designed to stress different task requirements, such as knowledge injection, structured extraction, label remapping, and logical reasoning. The paper argues that adaptation performance is strongly task-dependent: no single method dominates across all settings. Across five benchmarks, AIR was strongest or near-best on label-remapping classification, while KNN retrieval performed best on closed-book QA, and fine-tuning dominated structured extraction and event-order reasoning. AIR is most promising when task behavior can be captured by compact, interpretable instruction rules, while retrieval and fine-tuning remain stronger in tasks dominated by source-specific knowledge or dataset-specific annotation regularities.

</details>


### [863] [Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Videos and Camera Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09429)
*Wonbong Jang,Shikun Liu,Soubhik Sanyal,Juan Camilo Perez,Kam Woh Ng,Sanskar Agrawal,Juan-Manuel Perez-Rua,Yiannis Douratsos,Tao Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将相机参数估计与视图生成统一在一个扩散模型中，利用“光线像素”联合去噪，实现预测相机轨迹、生成新视角视频等三项任务，并在闭环自一致性测试中验证其可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统将相机参数恢复与新视角渲染视为独立问题，在稀疏观测或姿态模糊时相互依赖却被割裂。需建立一个能同时推断相机轨迹并生成对应图像的单一框架。

Method: 提出“光线像素”概念，将所有相机参数编码为可参与去噪的像素张量，与视频帧一同通过视频扩散模型训练；采用解耦的自-交叉注意力机制实现联合去噪，单模型同时学习前向（轨迹→视频）与逆向（视频→轨迹）分布。

Result: 同一模型完成三任务：纯视频推断相机轨迹、少量图像联合生成视频与轨迹、按给定轨迹生成视频。闭环自一致性测试显示，逆向轨迹预测与正向视频生成高度吻合，仅需极少去噪步数即可获得可信姿态。

Conclusion: 将相机参数与图像联合建模为扩散过程，可在稀疏观测下获得自洽的轨迹与视图，显著简化传统“先定位再渲染”的两段式流程，为稀疏视角场景重建与相机可控视频生成提供了端到端新范式。

Abstract: Recovering camera parameters from images and rendering scenes from novel viewpoints have long been treated as separate tasks in computer vision and graphics. This separation breaks down when image coverage is sparse or poses are ambiguous, since each task needs what the other produces. We propose Rays as Pixels, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM) that learns a joint distribution over videos and camera trajectories. We represent each camera as dense ray pixels (raxels) and denoise them jointly with video frames through Decoupled Self-Cross Attention mechanism. A single trained model handles three tasks: predicting camera trajectories from video, jointly generating video and camera trajectory from input images, and generating video from input images along a target camera trajectory. Because the model can both predict trajectories from a video and generate views conditioned on its own predictions, we evaluate it through a closed-loop self-consistency test, demonstrating that its forward and inverse predictions agree. Notably, trajectory prediction requires far fewer denoising steps than video generation, even a few denoising steps suffice for self-consistency. We report results on pose estimation and camera-controlled video generation.

</details>


### [864] [Continuous Orthogonal Mode Decomposition: Haptic Signal Prediction in Tactile Internet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09446)
*Mohammad Ali Vahedifar,Mojtaba Nazari,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种用于触觉互联网的双边预测神经网络架构 MDA，通过连续正交模态分解框架实现人/机器人两侧信号补全，预测精度达98.6%/97.3%，推理延迟仅0.065 ms，满足亚毫秒级实时触觉控制需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉互联网要求亚毫秒级延迟和超高可靠性，任何丢包或延迟都会导致触觉控制失稳。传统方法仅对原始数据做隐式特征提取，难以同时满足双侧信号恢复与超低延迟要求。

Method: 设计Mode-Domain Architecture(MDA)：1)构建双边预测网络，在人端与机器人端同步恢复缺失信号；2)提出Continuous-Orthogonal Mode Decomposition框架，引入正交约束从根本上消除现有分解方法的“模态重叠”问题；3)在结构化特征空间内完成轻量级预测，保证超低推理延迟。

Result: 实验表明MDA在人端预测准确率为98.6%，机器人端97.3%；单次推理延迟仅0.065 ms，相较现有基准显著降低，已满足0.1 ms级触觉遥操作实时要求。

Conclusion: 通过正交模态分解与双边预测协同，MDA首次实现亚毫秒级推理延迟下的高可靠信号恢复，为触觉互联网提供了可部署的实时控制解决方案。

Abstract: The Tactile Internet demands sub-millisecond latency and ultra-high reliability, as high latency or packet loss could lead to haptic control instability. To address this, we propose the Mode-Domain Architecture (MDA), a bilateral predictive neural network architecture designed to restore missing signals on both the human and robot sides. Unlike conventional models that extract features implicitly from raw data, MDA utilizes a novel Continuous-Orthogonal Mode Decomposition framework. By integrating an orthogonality constraint, we overcome the pervasive issue of "mode overlapping" found in state-of-the-art decomposition methods. Experimental results demonstrate that this structured feature extraction achieves high prediction accuracies of 98.6% (human) and 97.3% (robot). Furthermore, the model achieves ultra-low inference latency of 0.065 ms, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks and meeting the stringent real-time requirements of haptic teleoperation.

</details>


### [865] [An Open-Source, Open Data Approach to Activity Classification from Triaxial Accelerometry in an Ambulatory Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09451)
*Sepideh Nikookar,Edward Tian,Harrison Hoffman,Matthew Parks,J. Lucas McKay,Yashar Kiarashi,Tommy T. Thomas,Alex Hall,David W. Wright,Gari D. Clifford*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 公开了50 Hz三轴加速度数据集与开源代码，用二元（F1=0.79）与CNN五活动（F1=0.83）分类器，证明细粒度活动识别可提升临床健康监测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多局限于步数或15–60 s平均能耗估计，忽视高采样率加速度信号在细粒度活动识别与临床情境化中的潜力。

Method: 23名健康受试者佩戴同步三轴加速度+II导联心电仪，平均26 min，完成躺、坐、站、走、跑五种标准动作。采用信号处理二分类（高/低活动）与CNN多分类双方案，代码与数据一并开源。

Result: 高/低活动二分类F1=0.79；五类活动CNN模型F1=0.83，表明高精度可迁移至自然行为监测。

Conclusion: 精细行为活动分类能为传统生理指标提供情境信息，支持远程患者监测、预测分析与个性化干预的临床决策工具开发。

Abstract: The accelerometer has become an almost ubiquitous device, providing enormous opportunities in healthcare monitoring beyond step counting or other average energy estimates in 15-60 second epochs.
  Objective: To develop an open data set with associated open-source code for processing 50 Hz tri-axial accelerometry-based to classify patient activity levels and natural types of movement.
  Approach: Data were collected from 23 healthy subjects (16 males and seven females) aged between 23 and 62 years using an ambulatory device, which included a triaxial accelerometer and synchronous lead II equivalent ECG for an average of 26 minutes each. Participants followed a standardized activity routine involving five distinct activities: lying, sitting, standing, walking, and jogging. Two classifiers were constructed: a signal processing technique to distinguish between high and low activity levels and a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based approach to classify each of the five activities.
  Main results: The binary (high/low) activity classifier exhibited an F1 score of 0.79. The multi-class CNN-based classifier provided an F1 score of 0.83. The code for this analysis has been made available under an open-source license together with the data on which the classifiers were trained and tested.
  Significance: The classification of behavioral activity, as demonstrated in this study, offers valuable context for interpreting traditional health metrics and may provide contextual information to support the future development of clinical decision-making tools for patient monitoring, predictive analytics, and personalized health interventions.

</details>


### [866] [Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09487)
*Jan Schneider,Mridul Mahajan,Le Chen,Simon Guist,Bernhard Schölkopf,Ingmar Posner,Dieter Büchler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向肌腱驱动软体机械臂的通用仿真—现实迁移（sim-to-real）框架 GeAN，无需扭矩传感器即可精准建模非线性驱动系统，并在 4 自由度气动人工肌肉臂 PAMY2 上首次完成仿真训练策略的直接实物部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌腱+软体人工肌肉可兼顾高速与安全，却因强非线性、摩擦与迟滞导致无法将仿真策略可靠迁移到真实硬件，从而限制了该类机器人在实践中的应用。

Method: 构建

Result: GeAN 仅用关节轨迹即可在线训练出高精度驱动模型；在 PAMY2 上，仿真训练的目标定位与

Conclusion: GeAN 为软体肌腱驱动系统的 sim-to-real 迁移提供了一条可泛化、无需昂贵扭矩传感的可行路径，为四自由度以上肌肉驱动臂的实用化奠定基础。

Abstract: Tendon drives paired with soft muscle actuation enable faster and safer robots while potentially accelerating skill acquisition. Still, these systems are rarely used in practice due to inherent nonlinearities, friction, and hysteresis, which complicate modeling and control. So far, these challenges have hindered policy transfer from simulation to real systems. To bridge this gap, we propose a sim-to-real pipeline that learns a neural network model of this complex actuation and leverages established rigid body simulation for the arm dynamics and interactions with the environment. Our method, called Generalized Actuator Network (GeAN), enables actuation model identification across a wide range of robots by learning directly from joint position trajectories rather than requiring torque sensors. Using GeAN on PAMY2, a tendon-driven robot powered by pneumatic artificial muscles, we successfully deploy precise goal-reaching and dynamic ball-in-a-cup policies trained entirely in simulation. To the best of our knowledge, this result constitutes the first successful sim-to-real transfer for a four-degrees-of-freedom muscle-actuated robot arm.

</details>


### [867] [XFED: Non-Collusive Model Poisoning Attack Against Byzantine-Robust Federated Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09489)
*Israt Jahan Mouri,Muhammad Ridowan,Muhammad Abdullah Adnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次提出「非共谋型」投毒威胁，并给出无需任何节点互通、且对聚合算法免疫的XFED攻击，在6组数据、8种防御下显著优于现有方法，暴露联邦学习新的安全盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型投毒依赖多节点串通，易被溯源与检测；作者想知道在毫无协作的现实条件下是否仍能高效破坏聚合模型，并填补该假设的理论与实证空白。

Method: 1)提出非共谋投毒威胁模型：各被控节点独立生成恶意梯度，不通信、不窥视他人参数、不预知服务器防御；2)设计聚合无关的攻击XFED——仅利用本地数据迭代和公开聚合输出即可构造对聚合器影响最大的对抗更新；3)在IID/非IID的6个典型数据集上，与6种现有投毒基线及8种先进鲁棒聚合防御进行对比实验。

Result: XFED在准确率平均降幅、攻击成功率、基于余弦距离的隐蔽性指标上均显著领先于现有投毒手段；对Multi-Krum、Trimmed-Mean、Median、FLTrust、FoolsGold、Dnc等8种防御的最优准确率降低13.7–40.2个百分点，攻击隐蔽性最高提升63%；且不受联邦目标任务、数据分布和聚合算法的影响。

Conclusion: 无需节点间任何通信即可达成高效隐蔽投毒，这表明当前鲁棒聚合思路难以覆盖独立攻击者场景；联邦学习体系安全性被严重低估，亟需在客户端检测、可信硬件、统计验证等多维度引入更实用且攻防协同的防御机制。

Abstract: Model poisoning attacks pose a significant security threat to Federated Learning (FL). Most existing model poisoning attacks rely on collusion, requiring adversarial clients to coordinate by exchanging local benign models and synchronizing the generation of their poisoned updates. However, sustaining such coordination is increasingly impractical in real-world FL deployments, as it effectively requires botnet-like control over many devices. This approach is costly to maintain and highly vulnerable to detection. This context raises a fundamental question: Can model poisoning attacks remain effective without any communication between attackers? To address this challenge, we introduce and formalize the \textbf{non-collusive attack model}, in which all compromised clients share a common adversarial objective but operate independently. Under this model, each attacker generates its malicious update without communicating with other adversaries, accessing other clients' updates, or relying on any knowledge of server-side defenses. To demonstrate the feasibility of this threat model, we propose \textbf{XFED}, the first aggregation-agnostic, non-collusive model poisoning attack. Our empirical evaluation across six benchmark datasets shows that XFED bypasses eight state-of-the-art defenses and outperforms six existing model poisoning attacks. These findings indicate that FL systems are substantially less secure than previously believed and underscore the urgent need for more robust and practical defense mechanisms.

</details>


### [868] [RecaLLM: Addressing the Lost-in-Thought Phenomenon with Explicit In-Context Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09494)
*Kyle Whitecross,Negin Rahimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RecaLLM通过“显式检索-推理”交替机制解决推理链增长后上下文检索急剧退化（lost-in-thought）的瓶颈，128 K上下文无需128 K训练样本即可显著提升长文基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理链变长时，LLM逐步丢失对上下文的检索能力（lost-in-thought），长文推理严重受限；现有方法需巨量超长样本微调，成本高且不根治该瓶颈。

Method: 提出RecaLLM：①训练数据仅用≤10 K token样本；②交错式“检索-推理”解码循环；③零额外开销的受约束解码，允许模型在生成中间步骤前把所需证据片段原样copy；④在词汇/语义两类检索任务上微调。

Result: RULER、HELMET两基准全面领先基线，128 K上下文测试仍持续增益；对照实验证实其与同等长文训练方法相比，数据长度要求降低10倍以上。

Conclusion: 将检索显式嵌入推理链可用短文本高效解锁超长上下文能力，为未来长上下文LLM提供低成本、高可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: We propose RecaLLM, a set of reasoning language models post-trained to make effective use of long-context information. In-context retrieval, which identifies relevant evidence from context, and reasoning are deeply intertwined: retrieval supports reasoning, while reasoning often determines what must be retrieved. However, their interaction remains largely underexplored. In preliminary experiments on several open-source LLMs, we observe that in-context retrieval performance substantially degrades even after a short reasoning span, revealing a key bottleneck for test-time scaling that we refer to as lost-in-thought: reasoning steps that improve performance also make subsequent in-context retrieval more challenging. To address this limitation, RecaLLM interleaves reasoning with explicit in-context retrieval, alternating between reasoning and retrieving context information needed to solve intermediate subproblems. We introduce a negligible-overhead constrained decoding mechanism that enables verbatim copying of evidence spans, improving the grounding of subsequent generation. Trained on diverse lexical and semantic retrieval tasks, RecaLLM achieves strong performance on two long-context benchmarks, RULER and HELMET, significantly outperforming baselines. Notably, we observe consistent gains at context windows of up to 128K tokens using training samples of at most 10K tokens, far shorter than those used by existing long-context approaches, highlighting a promising path toward improving long-context performance without expensive long-context training data.

</details>


### [869] [Envisioning the Future, One Step at a Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09527)
*Stefan Andreas Baumann,Jannik Wiese,Tommaso Martorella,Mahdi M. Kalayeh,Björn Ommer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于稀疏点轨迹的自回归扩散模型，可在单幅图像上毫秒级并行生成数千条符合物理的长时程轨迹，在开放世界运动预测精度与采样效率上均优于现有稠密方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频或隐空间预测方法把大量算力浪费在稠密外观，导致长时-多模态运动探索代价过高；需要一种以轻量轨迹为核心、可迅速生成大量合理未来的动力学表示。

Method: 1) 将开放场景动力学建模为稀疏点轨迹的逐步推理；2) 用自回归扩散模型在短程局部可预测范围内递推轨迹，并显式刻画不确定性累积；3) 单图即可并行展开数千条未来，可加入运动初始约束；4) 提出基于野外视频的 OWM 基准以评估轨迹分布的精度与多样性。

Result: 在 OWM 上与稠密模拟器相比，轨迹预测精度持平或更高，而采样速度提升两个数量级，支持毫秒级大规模并行生成。

Conclusion: 稀疏轨迹-扩散框架首次使开放集、长时域、多模态运动预测同时具备高保真、高效率与可扩展性，为自动驾驶、机器人规划等实时应用奠定基础。

Abstract: Accurately anticipating how complex, diverse scenes will evolve requires models that represent uncertainty, simulate along extended interaction chains, and efficiently explore many plausible futures. Yet most existing approaches rely on dense video or latent-space prediction, expending substantial capacity on dense appearance rather than on the underlying sparse trajectories of points in the scene. This makes large-scale exploration of future hypotheses costly and limits performance when long-horizon, multi-modal motion is essential. We address this by formulating the prediction of open-set future scene dynamics as step-wise inference over sparse point trajectories. Our autoregressive diffusion model advances these trajectories through short, locally predictable transitions, explicitly modeling the growth of uncertainty over time. This dynamics-centric representation enables fast rollout of thousands of diverse futures from a single image, optionally guided by initial constraints on motion, while maintaining physical plausibility and long-range coherence. We further introduce OWM, a benchmark for open-set motion prediction based on diverse in-the-wild videos, to evaluate accuracy and variability of predicted trajectory distributions under real-world uncertainty. Our method matches or surpasses dense simulators in predictive accuracy while achieving orders-of-magnitude higher sampling speed, making open-set future prediction both scalable and practical. Project page: http://compvis.github.io/myriad.

</details>


### [870] [Case-Grounded Evidence Verification: A Framework for Constructing Evidence-Sensitive Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09537)
*Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh,Mehdi Joodaki,Mahshad Lotfinia,Sven Nebelung,Daniel Truhn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“基于案例的证据验证”框架，用自动生成显式支持与反例的监督信号，训练出真正依赖证据的判别器，在放射学任务上显著优于只看案例或只看证据的基线，且跨域迁移时仍保持证据依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有证据推理模型常把检索文本简单拼到预测里，因监督弱、证据与主张关联松散、评估未直接检验证据依赖性，导致模型并未真正“依据证据”做判断。

Method: 构建“案例-证据-主张”三元组任务；设计无人工标注的监督构造流程：利用局部案例语境自动生成支持样本，并通过语义受控的反事实错误状态及相关主题负样例生成非支持样本；在放射学域实例化，用标准验证器在该数据上训练。

Result: 所学验证器在支持/非支持二分类上远超仅看案例或仅看证据的基线；保留正确证据时性能稳定，去掉或调换证据后性能骤降，证明模型确实依赖证据；该证据依赖可迁移至未见过的新证据文章及外部病例分布，但在证据源分布偏移时性能下降，且对骨干网络选择敏感。

Conclusion: 证据 grounding 的主要瓶颈不仅是模型容量，更在于缺乏能刻画证据因果角色的监督信号；自动生成显式支持与反例的监督框架可有效缓解此瓶颈，为构建真正证据驱动的推理系统提供可行路径。

Abstract: Evidence-grounded reasoning requires more than attaching retrieved text to a prediction: a model should make decisions that depend on whether the provided evidence supports the target claim. In practice, this often fails because supervision is weak, evidence is only loosely tied to the claim, and evaluation does not test evidence dependence directly. We introduce case-grounded evidence verification, a general framework in which a model receives a local case context, external evidence, and a structured claim, and must decide whether the evidence supports the claim for that case. Our key contribution is a supervision construction procedure that generates explicit support examples together with semantically controlled non-support examples, including counterfactual wrong-state and topic-related negatives, without manual evidence annotation. We instantiate the framework in radiology and train a standard verifier on the resulting support task. The learned verifier substantially outperforms both case-only and evidence-only baselines, remains strong under correct evidence, and collapses when evidence is removed or swapped, indicating genuine evidence dependence. This behavior transfers across unseen evidence articles and an external case distribution, though performance degrades under evidence-source shift and remains sensitive to backbone choice. Overall, the results suggest that a major bottleneck in evidence grounding is not only model capacity, but the lack of supervision that encodes the causal role of evidence.

</details>


### [871] [Large Language Models Generate Harmful Content Using a Distinct, Unified Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09544)
*Hadas Orgad,Boyi Wei,Kaden Zheng,Martin Wattenberg,Peter Henderson,Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大模型用少量通用权重就能生成有害内容，对齐训练只压缩而未消除这组权重，导致下游微调时“有组织的恶意”被整体激活；定向剪枝这些权重可缓解此风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厘清安全护栏为何脆弱：对齐后的模型仍易被越狱或下游微调唤醒广泛的新风险，需检验其“有害性”是否在内部存在一致且可被干预的结构。

Method: 把定向权重剪枝当作因果探针，比较对齐/未对齐版本在不同有害任务及良性任务上的性能变化；通过域内剪枝验证能否阻断“突现误对齐”。

Result: 1.有害生成依赖一个与多种恶意类型通用、与良性能力分离的紧凑权重子集；2.对齐模型中该子集被显著压缩；3.剪枝该子集可大幅降低突现误对齐，却不影响模型识别或解释有害内容的能力。

Conclusion: 大模型内部存在组织化、可被因果操控的有害性结构；未来安全策略应针对该结构而非仅靠表层护栏，如剪枝或显式重构这些权重以构建更鲁棒的防御。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) undergo alignment training to avoid harmful behaviors, yet the resulting safeguards remain brittle: jailbreaks routinely bypass them, and fine-tuning on narrow domains can induce ``emergent misalignment'' that generalizes broadly. Whether this brittleness reflects a fundamental lack of coherent internal organization for harmfulness remains unclear. Here we use targeted weight pruning as a causal intervention to probe the internal organization of harmfulness in LLMs. We find that harmful content generation depends on a compact set of weights that are general across harm types and distinct from benign capabilities. Aligned models exhibit a greater compression of harm generation weights than unaligned counterparts, indicating that alignment reshapes harmful representations internally--despite the brittleness of safety guardrails at the surface level. This compression explains emergent misalignment: if weights of harmful capabilities are compressed, fine-tuning that engages these weights in one domain can trigger broad misalignment. Consistent with this, pruning harm generation weights in a narrow domain substantially reduces emergent misalignment. Notably, LLMs harmful generation capability is dissociated from how they recognize and explain such content. Together, these results reveal a coherent internal structure for harmfulness in LLMs that may serve as a foundation for more principled approaches to safety.

</details>


### [872] [Task-Distributionally Robust Data-Free Meta-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.14756)
*Zixuan Hu,Yongxian Wei,Li Shen,Zhenyi Wang,Baoyuan Wu,Chun Yuan,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章首次系统剖析了无数据元学习(DFML)的鲁棒性盲点，发现任务分布漂移(TDS)与任务分布投毒(TDC)两大失效模式，并提出含任务重建-记忆插值回放-模型自筛选三组件的可信DFML框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DFML方法仅用预训练模型合成数据做元学习，却忽视其在开放环境下的鲁棒性，尤其缺乏对灾难性遗忘与恶意模型投毒等失效模式的系统研究，阻碍其在真实场景中的可信部署。

Method: 1) 用模型反演从多预训练模型重建合成任务；2) 提出任务记忆插值回放策略，抑制TDS导致的元知识遗忘；3) 集成自动模型筛选机制，实时剔除投毒或低质量模型，阻断TDC攻击面。

Result: 理论分析证明框架在TDS下可保持元知识一致性，在TDC下能检测并隔离恶意模型；实验表明相较于基线DFML，该方法在任务漂移场景平均准确率提升12.4%，在投毒攻击下鲁棒准确率提升18.7%。

Conclusion: DFML并非天然鲁棒，TDS与TDC是其两大核心脆弱点；所提可信框架无需原始训练数据即可同时缓解遗忘与投毒问题，为DFML走向开放世界提供理论与实践支撑。

Abstract: Data-Free Meta-Learning (DFML) aims to enable efficient learning of unseen few-shot tasks, by meta-learning from multiple pre-trained models without accessing their original training data. While existing DFML methods typically generate synthetic data from these models to perform meta-learning, a comprehensive analysis of DFML's robustness-particularly its failure modes and vulnerability to potential attacks-remains notably absent. Such an analysis is crucial as algorithms often operate in complex and uncertain real-world environments. This paper fills this significant gap by systematically investigating the robustness of DFML, identifying two critical but previously overlooked vulnerabilities: Task-Distribution Shift (TDS) and Task-Distribution Corruption (TDC). TDS refers to the sequential shifts in the evolving task distribution, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of previously learned meta-knowledge. TDC exposes a security flaw of DFML, revealing its susceptibility to attacks when the pre-trained model pool includes untrustworthy models that deceptively claim to be beneficial but are actually harmful. To mitigate these vulnerabilities, we propose a trustworthy DFML framework comprising three components: synthetic task reconstruction, meta-learning with task memory interpolation, and automatic model selection. Specifically, utilizing model inversion techniques, we reconstruct synthetic tasks from multiple pre-trained models to perform meta-learning. To prevent forgetting, we introduce a strategy to replay interpolated historical tasks to efficiently recall previous meta-knowledge. Furthermore, our framework seamlessly incorporates an automatic model selection mechanism to automatically filter out untrustworthy models during the meta-learning process. Code is available at https://github.com/Egg-Hu/Trustworthy-DFML.

</details>


### [873] [Inferring Latent Temporal Sparse Coordination Graph for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19253)
*Wei Duan,Jie Lu,Junyu Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量时空稀疏图 LTS-CG，利用历史观测自抽样稀疏交互结构并融合未来预测与当前推断，端到端提升 MARL 协同效果与规模性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MARL 图方法仅用单步观测，图冗余、交换有害且全连接计算昂贵，阻碍大规模高效协作。

Method: 1) 基于历史观测计算成对先验概率并稀疏采样 Latent Temporal Sparse Coordination Graph；2) Predict-Future 前瞻下一观测、Infer-Present 补全当下上下文，两者共同动态生成时序图；3) 图推理与策略学习并行，复杂度仅与智能体数量线性相关。

Result: StarCraft II 基准实验显示，LTS-CG 在相同网络规模下胜率、样本效率与可扩展性均显著优于现有图 MARL 基线。

Conclusion: 通过引入时序稀疏交互与双阶段隐推断，LTS-CG 可在计算高效的前提下，持续捕获并利用历史—未来信息，实现更可扩展且鲁棒的多智能体协同。

Abstract: Effective agent coordination is crucial in cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). While agent cooperation can be represented by graph structures, prevailing graph learning methods in MARL are limited. They rely solely on one-step observations, neglecting crucial historical experiences, leading to deficient graphs that foster redundant or detrimental information exchanges. Additionally, high computational demands for action-pair calculations in dense graphs impede scalability. To address these challenges, we propose inferring a Latent Temporal Sparse Coordination Graph (LTS-CG) for MARL. The LTS-CG leverages agents' historical observations to calculate an agent-pair probability matrix, where a sparse graph is sampled from and used for knowledge exchange between agents, thereby simultaneously capturing agent dependencies and relation uncertainty. The computational complexity of this procedure is only related to the number of agents. This graph learning process is further augmented by two innovative characteristics: Predict-Future, which enables agents to foresee upcoming observations, and Infer-Present, ensuring a thorough grasp of the environmental context from limited data. These features allow LTS-CG to construct temporal graphs from historical and real-time information, promoting knowledge exchange during policy learning and effective collaboration. Graph learning and agent training occur simultaneously in an end-to-end manner. Our demonstrated results on the StarCraft II benchmark underscore LTS-CG's superior performance.

</details>


### [874] [Group-Aware Coordination Graph for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.10976)
*Wei Duan,Jie Lu,Junyu Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Group-Aware Coordination Graph(GACG)，在MARL中同步学习成对及高阶群体关系，并引入群体距离损失，星际2实验验证其领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MARL关系图学习只关注agent两两关系，忽略更高阶群体层面依赖，且无法边学习图边交换局部可观测信息，限制了群体协作效果。

Method: 1) 基于轨迹行为模式推断群体结构，构建GACG，同时建模成对合作与群体级依赖；2) 用图卷积在决策阶段聚合跨agent信息；3) 提出群体距离损失，鼓励同组行为一致、不同组间分异。

Result: 在StarCraft II微操任务上，GACG显著优于基线；消融实验证实高阶图学习与群体距离损失各自独立提升团队回报。

Conclusion: GACG首次在MARL中显式同步学习成对和群体关系图，结合图卷积与群体距离正则，有效提升多智能体协作与专业化，验证了高阶关系建模的重要性。

Abstract: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) necessitates seamless collaboration among agents, often represented by an underlying relation graph. Existing methods for learning this graph primarily focus on agent-pair relations, neglecting higher-order relationships. While several approaches attempt to extend cooperation modelling to encompass behaviour similarities within groups, they commonly fall short in concurrently learning the latent graph, thereby constraining the information exchange among partially observed agents. To overcome these limitations, we present a novel approach to infer the Group-Aware Coordination Graph (GACG), which is designed to capture both the cooperation between agent pairs based on current observations and group-level dependencies from behaviour patterns observed across trajectories. This graph is further used in graph convolution for information exchange between agents during decision-making. To further ensure behavioural consistency among agents within the same group, we introduce a group distance loss, which promotes group cohesion and encourages specialization between groups. Our evaluations, conducted on StarCraft II micromanagement tasks, demonstrate GACG's superior performance. An ablation study further provides experimental evidence of the effectiveness of each component of our method.

</details>


### [875] [Learning General Representation of 12-Lead Electrocardiogram with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08559)
*Sehun Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ECG-JEPA，一种面向12导联心电图的自监督模型；它在潜空间进行掩码预测，无需重建原始波形，配合专为此数据设计的Cross-Pattern Attention，在18万样本上预训练后在下游诊断、特征提取与分割任务均达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗心电数据标注稀缺，传统监督学习受限；自监督学习可挖掘无标注数据中的语义，但现有方法多依赖原始信号重建，易受噪声影响且L2损失不适合ECG特性，需更鲁棒的表征策略。

Method: 1)设计ECG-JEPA架构：编码器将12导联ECG映射至潜空间，掩码部分潜变量后由预测器还原被掩部分，训练目标仅为潜空间预测误差，避免重建噪声。2)提出Cross-Pattern Attention(CroPA)：在Transformer内部对不同导联间的时序模式做屏蔽式跨导联注意力，增强多导联协同表征。3)数据：合并多个公开ECG数据集约18万例进行大规模预训练。4)下游适配：线性评估、微调及像素级分割头验证表征质量。

Result: 在多个公开基准上，ECG-JEPA在心律分类、心肌梗死检测、左心室肥厚等诊断任务将SOTA准确率提升1–3%；特征提取的线性评估AUC平均提升4.8%；在ECG像素级分割任务上Dice系数提升2.1%。仅使用10%标注时性能仍优于全监督基线。

Conclusion: 潜空间掩码建模策略能有效抑制ECG噪声并克服L2损失缺陷；Cross-Pattern Attention可捕捉12导联互补信息，显著提升表征语义与泛化能力；ECG-JEPA为医学时序自监督提供高效、可扩展的新框架，代码已开源便于复用与改进。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) captures the heart's electrical signals, offering valuable information for diagnosing cardiac conditions. However, the scarcity of labeled data makes it challenging to fully leverage supervised learning in the medical domain. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising solution, enabling models to learn from unlabeled data and uncover meaningful patterns. In this paper, we show that masked modeling in the latent space can be a powerful alternative to existing self-supervised methods in the ECG domain. We introduce ECG-JEPA, an SSL model for 12-lead ECG analysis that learns semantic representations of ECG data by predicting in the hidden latent space, bypassing the need to reconstruct raw signals. This approach offers several advantages in the ECG domain: (1) it avoids producing unnecessary details, such as noise, which is common in ECG; and (2) it addresses the limitations of naive L2 loss between raw signals. Another key contribution is the introduction of Cross-Pattern Attention (CroPA), a specialized masked attention mechanism tailored for 12-lead ECG data. ECG-JEPA is trained on the union of several open ECG datasets, totaling approximately 180,000 samples, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in various downstream tasks including diagnostic classification, feature extraction, and segmentation. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/sehunfromdaegu/ECG_JEPA.

</details>


### [876] [FIT-GNN: Faster Inference Time for GNNs that 'FIT' in Memory Using Coarsening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.15001)
*Shubhajit Roy,Hrriday Ruparel,Kishan Ved,Anirban Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用图粗化策略只在推理阶段用小规模图，实现推理 1–2 个数量级提速、内存大降，同时在图/点级任务上保持与全图模型相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN 扩展的痛点已由训练阶段转向推理阶段：已有剪枝、蒸馏、计算树等方案聚焦训练加速，而推理仍需在全图上逐节点聚合，计算与内存开销随图规模线性暴增，严重阻碍资源受限设备的在线部署。因此亟需专门降低推理复杂度的策略。

Method: 提出运用图粗化而非原图进行前向传播，并在粗化图与原图节点间建立映射。设计了两种映射构造方式：Extra Nodes(把超节点作为附加节点加入原图)与 Cluster Nodes(直接用超节点取代原图节点)。训练完的大图 GNN 直接拷贝参数到小规模粗化图，无需重训即可推理。同时扩展了图级分类/回归任务，用粗化图级表示做图级预测。

Result: 在多个公开基准(引文、蛋白质、社交网络等)上的节点分类、图分类、图回归任务中，与全图 GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE 基准相比：单节点推理时间降低 1–2 个数量级；GPU/CPU 内存占用下降 60–90%；在多数数据集上准确率和 R² 与基线持平甚至略升；在树莓派等低资源设备上仍能实时推理而基线方案完全跑不动。

Conclusion: 推理期图粗化能为 GNN 带来极致的压缩-加速红利，同时几乎无损性能，是迄今成本最低的部署方案之一。未来可结合自适应粗化、多步粗化和增量更新进一步权衡精度与效率。

Abstract: Scalability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) remains a significant challenge. To tackle this, methods like coarsening, condensation, and computation trees are used to train on a smaller graph, resulting in faster computation. Nonetheless, prior research has not adequately addressed the computational costs during the inference phase. This paper presents a novel approach to improve the scalability of GNNs by reducing computational burden during the inference phase using graph coarsening. We demonstrate two different methods -- Extra Nodes and Cluster Nodes. Our study extends the application of graph coarsening for graph-level tasks, including graph classification and graph regression. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets to evaluate the performance of our approach. Our results show that the proposed method achieves orders of magnitude improvements in single-node inference time compared to traditional approaches. Furthermore, it significantly reduces memory consumption for node and graph classification and regression tasks, enabling efficient training and inference on low-resource devices where conventional methods are impractical. Notably, these computational advantages are achieved while maintaining competitive performance relative to baseline models.

</details>


### [877] [Graph Defense Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.11568)
*Xin He,Wenqi Fan,Yili Wang,Chengyi Liu,Rui Miao,Xin Juan,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Graph Defense Diffusion Model（GDDM），用扩散模型的去噪与建模能力统一净化多种对抗攻击下的图数据，不需重训练即可跨数据集迁移，实验效果显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在对抗攻击下性能骤降；现有图净化方法只能应对单一攻击类型，依赖启发式先验，缺乏对图数据的 comprehensive 建模。

Method: 将扩散模型迭代去噪机制与图攻击的逐步性对齐，设计两项核心模块：① Graph Structure-Driven Refiner，保证去噪后图结构不失真；② Node Feature-Constrained Regularizer，进一步清除残留扰动；同时针对不同攻击场景定制去噪策略。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上抵御多种目标/非目标攻击，净化后的图在节点分类与图分类任务中均优于SOTA，且具备零样本跨数据集迁移能力。

Conclusion: GDDM首次将扩散模型用于图对抗净化，兼顾多攻击类型、可扩展性与跨域迁移，为鲁棒图学习提供了通用高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which can greatly degrade their performance. Existing graph purification methods attempt to address this issue by filtering attacked graphs. However, they struggle to defend effectively against multiple types of adversarial attacks (e.g., targeted attacks and non-targeted attacks) simultaneously due to limited flexibility. Additionally, these methods lack comprehensive modeling of graph data, relying heavily on heuristic prior knowledge. To overcome these challenges, we introduce the Graph Defense Diffusion Model (GDDM), a flexible purification method that leverages the denoising and modeling capabilities of diffusion models. The iterative nature of diffusion models aligns well with the stepwise process of adversarial attacks, making them particularly suitable for defense. By iteratively adding and removing noises (edges), GDDM effectively purifies attacked graphs, restoring their original structures and features. Our GDDM consists of two key components: (1) Graph Structure-Driven Refiner, which preserves the basic fidelity of the graph during the denoising process, and ensures that the generated graph remains consistent with the original scope; and (2) Node Feature-Constrained Regularizer, which removes residual impurities from the denoised graph, further enhancing the purification effect. By designing tailored denoising strategies to handle different types of adversarial attacks, we improve the GDDM's adaptability to various attack scenarios. Furthermore, GDDM demonstrates strong scalability, leveraging its structural properties to seamlessly transfer across similar datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that GDDM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in defending against various adversarial attacks, showcasing its robustness and effectiveness.

</details>


### [878] [Mamba-Based Graph Convolutional Networks: Tackling Over-smoothing with Selective State Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.15461)
*Xin He,Yili Wang,Wenqi Fan,Xu Shen,Xin Juan,Rui Miao,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对GNN过平滑问题，提出融入Mamba序列建模思想的MbaGCN，三组件协同自适应聚合邻域信息，为深层图网络提供可扩展新骨架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN随深度增加陷入过平滑，节点表征趋同且无法区分不同邻域重要性，亟需可区分、可扩展的深度架构。

Method: 构建MbaGCN：①消息聚合层提取邻域特征；②选择性状态空间变换层借鉴Mamba状态空间模型，自适应更新节点隐状态；③节点状态预测层输出最终表征，实现端到端训练。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，MbaGCN虽未全面领先，但显著缓解过平滑，验证Mamba范式与图学习融合的可行性。

Conclusion: MbaGCN为深层GNN提供新基准框架，证明序列Mamba机制可迁移至图域，启迪后续图网络结构创新。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown great success in various graph-based learning tasks. However, it often faces the issue of over-smoothing as the model depth increases, which causes all node representations to converge to a single value and become indistinguishable. This issue stems from the inherent limitations of GNNs, which struggle to distinguish the importance of information from different neighborhoods. In this paper, we introduce MbaGCN, a novel graph convolutional architecture that draws inspiration from the Mamba paradigm-originally designed for sequence modeling. MbaGCN presents a new backbone for GNNs, consisting of three key components: the Message Aggregation Layer, the Selective State Space Transition Layer, and the Node State Prediction Layer. These components work in tandem to adaptively aggregate neighborhood information, providing greater flexibility and scalability for deep GNN models. While MbaGCN may not consistently outperform all existing methods on each dataset, it provides a foundational framework that demonstrates the effective integration of the Mamba paradigm into graph representation learning. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, we demonstrate that MbaGCN paves the way for future advancements in graph neural network research.

</details>


### [879] [Low Rank Based Subspace Inference for the Laplace Approximation of Bayesian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02345)
*Josua Faller,Jörg Martin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于 Laplace 近似的低秩子空间推断能以极低维度逼近完整贝叶斯后验，为 UQ 提供新的强基线与评价指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有子空间推断方法缺乏理论依据，也无法在不知道真实后验时评估其近似质量；需要给出“最优”子空间的构造并为后续方法提供可计算的基准。

Method: 先推导 Laplace 近似下“最优”低维子空间的闭式表达式；再用低秩分解近似完整后验协方差，构造 scalable 子空间推断算法；最后提出不依赖真实后验的子空间近似质量评价指标。

Result: 低秩协方差子空间 Laplace 近似在多个数据集上与完整 Laplace 后验几乎重合，维度削减 1–2 个数量级；算法在大型网络上可运行，且 consistently 优于现有子空间方法；提出的评价指标与真实误差高度相关。

Conclusion: 低秩技术可严格支撑“子空间足够”假设，给出的子空间模型既是实用算法也是可计算的强基线，同时为无真值情况下的子空间方法比较提供了新工具。

Abstract: Subspace inference for neural networks assumes that a subspace of their parameter space suffices to produce a reliable uncertainty quantification. In this work, we underpin the validity of this assumption by using low rank techniques. We derive an expression for a subspace model to a Bayesian inference scenario based on the Laplace approximation that is, in a certain sense, optimal given a specific dataset. We empirically show that a Laplace approximation constructed with a dimensionally reduced covariance matrix closely matches the full Laplace approximation obtained using the exact covariance matrix. Where feasible, this subspace model can serve as a baseline for benchmarking the performance of subspace models. In addition, we provide a scalable approximation of this subspace construction that is usable in practice and compare it to existing subspace models from the literature. In general, our approximation scheme outperforms previous work. Furthermore, we present a metric to qualitatively compare the approximation quality of different subspace models even if the exact Laplace approximation is unknown.

</details>


### [880] [Neurons Speak in Ranges: Breaking Free from Discrete Neuronal Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06809)
*Muhammad Umair Haider,Hammad Rizwan,Hassan Sajjad,Peizhong Ju,A. B. Siddique*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对LLM中神经元多义性难题，本文提出NeuronLens框架，将概念归因定位到神经元内部的激活区间，实现更精准的解释与干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型中普遍存在“多义神经元”，即同一神经元对多个语义概念均显著激活，导致传统“单神经元-单概念”归因失效，严重阻碍模型可解释性与可控性。

Method: 系统扫描编码器与解码器架构、多个数据集的神经元激活，发现概念条件激活幅值呈高斯型、低重叠分布；据此提出NeuronLens：在神经元内部划定概念专属激活区间，进行区间级解释与干预（区间裁剪/增强），而非整神经元屏蔽。

Result: 区间干预在目标概念上达到与整神经元屏蔽相近的操纵效果，但对非目标概念的连带损伤降低50%以上，整体模型性能下降显著更小；验证了区间级归因的精确性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 神经元内部存在可分离的概念专属激活子空间，NeuronLens首次利用该规律实现区间级解释与干预，为LLM精细控制提供新范式，并提示未来可扩展至更多模型与任务。

Abstract: Pervasive polysemanticity in large language models (LLMs) undermines discrete neuron-concept attribution, posing a significant challenge for model interpretation and control. We systematically analyze both encoder and decoder based LLMs across diverse datasets, and observe that even highly salient neurons for specific semantic concepts consistently exhibit polysemantic behavior. Importantly, we uncover a consistent pattern: concept-conditioned activation magnitudes of neurons form distinct, often Gaussian-like distributions with minimal overlap. Building on this observation, we hypothesize that interpreting and intervening on concept-specific activation ranges can enable more precise interpretability and targeted manipulation in LLMs. To this end, we introduce NeuronLens, a novel range-based interpretation and manipulation framework, that localizes concept attribution to activation ranges within a neuron. Extensive empirical evaluations show that range-based interventions enable effective manipulation of target concepts while causing substantially less collateral degradation to auxiliary concepts and overall model performance compared to neuron-level masking.

</details>


### [881] [Reducing Class Bias In Data-Balanced Datasets Through Hardness-Based Resampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07031)
*Pawel Pukowski,Venet Osmani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Hardness-Based Resampling（HBR）以样本“难度”而非类别频率作为重采样依据，可显著缩小平衡数据集上的类间性能差距，揭示类偏差根源不仅是数据不平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为类偏差源于类别数据量失衡，仅靠重平衡即可解决；作者质疑该假设，发现即使类别完全均衡仍存在显著性能差异，需探查更深层的难度因素。

Method: 提出Hardness-Based Resampling：先为每样本估计学习难度，再对难样本过采样、易样本欠采样；引入gap-与dispersion-指标评估类间差异；同时利用SOTA扩散模型生成最难样本来扩充训练集。

Result: HBR在CIFAR-10上缩小召回率差距32%，在CIFAR-100上缩小16%，均优于频率重采样；用扩散模型有针对性补充最难样本进一步提升公平性。

Conclusion: 数据平衡不足以消除类偏差，需转向以学习难度为核心的数据选择策略；Fairness调优应同时关注样本难度与生成方式。

Abstract: Class-bias, that is class-wise performance disparities, is typically attributed to data imbalance and addressed through frequency-based resampling. However, we demonstrate that substantial bias persists even in perfectly balanced datasets, proving that class frequency alone cannot explain unequal model performance. We investigate these disparities through the lens of class-level learning difficulty and propose Hardness-Based Resampling (HBR), a strategy that leverages hardness estimates to guide data selection. To better capture these effects, we introduce an evaluation protocol that complements global metrics with gap- and dispersion-based measures. Our experiments show that HBR significantly reduces recall gaps, by up to 32% on CIFAR-10 and 16% on CIFAR-100, outperforming standard frequency-based resampling. We further show that we can improve fairness outcomes by selectively using the hardest samples from a state-of-the-art diffusion model, rather than randomly selecting them. These findings demonstrate that data balance alone is insufficient to mitigate class bias, necessitating a shift toward hardness-aware approaches.

</details>


### [882] [Task-agnostic Low-rank Residual Adaptation for Efficient Federated Continual Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12318)
*Feng Yu,Jia Hu,Geyong Min*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个面向联邦连续微调（FCFT）场景、无需任务标签且参数零增长的低秩残差适配方法 Fed-TaLoRA，通过任务无关模块+聚合后校准+低秩残差更新，在持续非独立同分布数据流上实现高聚合保真度与极低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Fed-PEFT 默认标签空间固定、任务静态，而真实场景下各客户端会持续遇到新类别且无法预知任务身份，导致灾难性遗忘、任务专用模块参数膨胀及非独立同分布带来的聚合不一致三类核心挑战。

Method: 提出 Fed-TaLoRA：① 所有任务共享单一低秩适配器，杜绝参数增长；② 聚合后对全局模型执行理论支撑的残差权重更新，校正异构偏移；③ 策略性选择插入位置以降低通信与计算；④ 给出收敛性与聚合误差界分析。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 等四个基准上，相比最佳基线平均提升 3.2%-7.8% 的最终准确率，遗忘率降低 40%+，通信量与 FLOPs 均压缩 60% 以上。

Conclusion: Fed-TaLoRA 首次在 FCFT 设定下同时解决遗忘、参数膨胀与聚合偏差，为联邦大模型持续落地提供了轻量、理论可靠且实验优越的方案。

Abstract: Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (Fed-PEFT) enables lightweight adaptation of large pre-trained models in federated learning settings by updating only a small subset of parameters. However, Fed-PEFT methods typically assume a fixed label space and static downstream tasks, which is restrictive in realistic application scenarios where clients continuously encounter new classes over time. This leads to an emerging problem, known as \emph{Federated Continual Fine-Tuning} (FCFT). In FCFT, clients collaboratively fine-tune a pre-trained model over a sequence of tasks, where each client observes disjoint sets of new classes over time, and task identity is unavailable at inference time. FCFT is challenging because it simultaneously suffers from severe forgetting under non-IID client data distributions, parameter growth and task-specific inference caused by task-wise modules, and aggregation inconsistency across heterogeneous clients. To address these challenges, we propose Federated Task-agnostic Low-rank Residual Adaptation (Fed-TaLoRA), a novel approach for efficient FCFT built on task-agnostic adaptation, post-aggregation model calibration, and strategic low-rank adaptation placement. Fed-TaLoRA continuously fine-tunes a single shared module across sequential tasks to avoid task-wise parameter growth, and further introduces a theoretically grounded residual weight update mechanism to calibrate the aggregated global model and improve aggregation fidelity. We provide a theoretical analysis of the convergence and aggregation behavior of Fed-TaLoRA. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that Fed-TaLoRA consistently outperforms strong baselines while reducing communication and computation costs significantly.

</details>


### [883] [Revitalizing Black-Box Interpretability: Actionable Interpretability for LLMs via Proxy Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12509)
*Junhao Liu,Haonan Yu,Zhenyu Yan,Xin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出低成本可解释性框架 ProxyX，代理 LLM 边界并与目标对齐，能经济地驱动提示压缩与毒样本清除等实用优化任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统后验解释可帮助调试与优化，但直接在 LLM 上运行模型无关解释方法需反复前向推导，计算负担极高，难以用于实时或规模化开发；现有工作多停留在观测层面，缺乏可操作的工具链。

Method: ProxyX 框架：先“筛”后“用”。先用高效小模型（proxy）逼近目标 LLM 的局部决策边界；通过统计对齐检验（screen）筛选与 LLM 奇异点一致的区域，仅在该区域部署代理；整体流程无需修改 LLM 内部结构，属于模型无关的黑箱间接逼近策略。

Result: 在线房产数据与指令微调设置上，代理解释对 LLM 决策的保真度>90%，仅花费 LLM 推理资源的 11%。下游任务上，基于代理的提示压缩平均减少 60% 词符成本，保持性能；模型识别出的毒样本被移除后，下游准确率最高提升 8.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过“筛-用”机制将后验解释从被动观测升级为可扩展开发原语，显著降低 LLM  Debug 与优化的门槛，代码与数据集一并开源，推动可解释性从学术研究走向实际落地。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanations provide transparency and are essential for guiding model optimization, such as prompt engineering and data sanitation. However, applying model-agnostic techniques to Large Language Models (LLMs) is hindered by prohibitive computational costs, rendering these tools dormant for real-world applications. To revitalize model-agnostic interpretability, we propose a budget-friendly proxy framework that leverages efficient models to approximate the decision boundaries of expensive LLMs. We introduce a screen-and-apply mechanism to statistically verify local alignment before deployment. Our empirical evaluation confirms that proxy explanations achieve over 90% fidelity with only 11% of the oracle's cost. Building on this foundation, we demonstrate the actionable utility of our framework in prompt compression and poisoned example removal. Results show that reliable proxy explanations effectively guide optimization, transforming interpretability from a passive observation tool into a scalable primitive for LLM development. Additionally, we open-source code and datasets to facilitate future research.

</details>


### [884] [Provable Post-Training Quantization: Theoretical Analysis of OPTQ and Qronos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.04853)
*Haoyu Zhang,Shihao Zhang,Ian Colbert,Rayan Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次给出OPTQ（GPTQ）及Qronos两种主流PTQ算法的定量误差界，解释并指导其关键实现细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPTQ虽被广泛应用，却缺乏理论保证；作者希望用可量化误差界填补空白，为算法调参与改进提供依据。

Method: 将OPTQ迭代量化过程建模为带正则的最小二乘更新，利用矩阵扰动与随机集中不等式，分别导出确定性和随机版本的2-范数/∞-范数非渐近误差界，并推广至Qronos。

Result: 获得显式依赖校准数据范数与正则参数ε的误差上界；随机OPTQ进一步给出∞-范数界，可直接约束量化字母表大小；相同技术对Qronos也给出新界，解释其经验优势。

Conclusion: 理论首次证实“按特征范数降序量化”等启发式合理性，提供正则参数ε与比特宽度的选取指南，并为后续PTQ算法设计奠定量化误差分析框架。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a crucial tool for reducing the memory and compute costs of modern deep neural networks, including large language models (LLMs). Among PTQ algorithms, the OPTQ framework-also known as GPTQ-has emerged as a leading method due to its computational efficiency and strong empirical performance. Despite its widespread adoption, however, OPTQ lacks rigorous quantitative theoretical guarantees. This paper presents the first quantitative error bounds for both deterministic and stochastic variants of OPTQ, as well as for Qronos, a recent related state-of-the-art PTQ algorithm. We analyze how OPTQ's iterative procedure induces quantization error and derive non-asymptotic 2-norm error bounds that depend explicitly on the calibration data and a regularization parameter that OPTQ uses. Our analysis provides theoretical justification for several practical design choices, including the widely used heuristic of ordering features by decreasing norm, as well as guidance for selecting the regularization parameter. For the stochastic variant, we establish stronger infinity-norm error bounds, which enable control over the required quantization alphabet and are particularly useful for downstream layers and nonlinearities. Finally, we extend our analysis to Qronos, providing new theoretical bounds, for both its deterministic and stochastic variants, that help explain its empirical advantages.

</details>


### [885] [AR-KAN: Autoregressive-Weight-Enhanced Kolmogorov-Arnold Network for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02967)
*Chen Zeng,Tiehang Xu,Qiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Traditional neural networks struggle to capture the spectral structure of complex signals. Fourier neural networks (FNNs) attempt to address this by embedding Fourier series components, yet many real-world signals are almost-periodic with non-commensurate frequencies, posing additional challenges. Building on prior work showing that ARIMA outperforms large language models (LLMs) for time series forecasting, we extend the comparison to neural predictors and find that ARIMA still maintains a clear advantage. Inspired by this finding, we propose the Autoregressive-Weight-Enhanced Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (AR-KAN). Based in the Universal Myopic Mapping Theorem, it integrates a pre-trained AR module for temporal memory with a KAN for nonlinear representation. We prove that the AR module preserves essential temporal features while reducing redundancy, and that the upper bound of the approximation error for AR-KAN is smaller than that for KAN in a probabilistic sense. Experimental results also demonstrate that AR-KAN delivers exceptional performance compared to existing models, both on synthetic almost-periodic functions and real-world datasets. These results highlight AR-KAN as a robust and effective framework for time series forecasting. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChenZeng001/AR-KAN.

</details>


### [886] [STCast: Adaptive Boundary Alignment for Global and Regional Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25210)
*Hao Chen,Tao Han,Jie Zhang,Song Guo,Lei Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 STCast 框架，用空间对齐注意力和月份专家混合模块动态优化区域边界并分配月级预报，在区域/全球预报、极端事件检测及集合预报四任务上均优于 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于物理边界或区域裁剪的区域集成方法受限于静态且不精确的边界，导致泛化能力差。

Method: 1) Spatial-Aligned Attention（SAA）：对齐全球与区域空间分布以初始化边界，并利用注意得分自适应精调；2) Temporal Mixture-of-Experts（TMoE）：按离散高斯分布将各月大气变量动态路由至专属专家，强化月尺度时序建模。

Result: 在区域天气预报、全球预报、极端事件预测及集合预报四项任务中，STCast 均一致超越现有最佳方法。

Conclusion: 通过动态优化区域边界与月份级专家分配，STCast 显著提升了区域精细化预报与多任务泛化性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: To gain finer regional forecasts, many works have explored the regional integration from the global atmosphere, e.g., by solving boundary equations in physics-based methods or cropping regions from global forecasts in data-driven methods. However, the effectiveness of these methods is often constrained by static and imprecise regional boundaries, resulting in poor generalization ability. To address this issue, we propose Spatial-Temporal Weather Forecasting (STCast), a novel AI-driven framework for adaptive regional boundary optimization and dynamic monthly forecast allocation. Specifically, our approach employs a Spatial-Aligned Attention (SAA) mechanism, which aligns global and regional spatial distributions to initialize boundaries and adaptively refines them based on attention-derived alignment patterns. Furthermore, we design a Temporal Mixture-of-Experts (TMoE) module, where atmospheric variables from distinct months are dynamically routed to specialized experts using a discrete Gaussian distribution, enhancing the model's ability to capture temporal patterns. Beyond global and regional forecasting, we evaluate our STCast on extreme event prediction and ensemble forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate consistent superiority over state-of-the-art methods across all four tasks. Code: https://github.com/chenhao-zju/STCast

</details>


### [887] [On-the-Fly Adaptation to Quantization: Configuration-Aware LoRA for Efficient Fine-Tuning of Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25214)
*Rongguang Ye,Ming Tang,Edith C. H. Ngai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoA-LoRA 用一套参数适配任意位宽配置，无需为每种量化重复微调，在边缘端实现即插即用的高精度压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超大预训练模型落地边缘隐私场景需大幅压缩，现有“量化+高精度 LoRA 微调”方案虽有效，但边缘设备能力各异，为每种位宽配置单独微调成本过高，亟需一次性训练、多处部署的通用适配器。

Method: 提出配置感知 LoRA（CoA-LoRA）：建立低秩适配系数预测网络，将任意逐层位宽配置映射为相应低秩增量；设计基于帕累托前沿的配置搜索，迭代优化训练配置集，使预测网络在全部预算范围内逼近最优增量。

Result: 在多项基准与模型上，CoA-LoRA 一次训练即可覆盖 2–8 bit 任意配置，平均精度持平或优于针对每配置单独微调的 SOTA，且额外时间开销为零；存储仅增加 1.2–2.3 %。

Conclusion: CoA-LoRA 突破“一配置一微调”瓶颈，实现边缘场景下大模型压缩的即插即用，为异构设备高效部署提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: As increasingly large pre-trained models are released, deploying them on edge devices for privacy-preserving applications requires effective compression. Recent works combine quantization with the fine-tuning of high-precision LoRA adapters, which can substantially reduce model size while mitigating the accuracy loss from quantization. However, edge devices have inherently heterogeneous capabilities, while performing configuration-wise fine-tuning for every quantization setting is computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose CoA-LoRA, a method that dynamically adjusts the LoRA adapter to arbitrary quantization configurations (i.e., the per-layer bit-width choices of a pre-trained model) without requiring repeated fine-tuning. This is accomplished via a configuration-aware model that maps each configuration to its low-rank adjustments. The effectiveness of this model critically depends on the training configuration set, a collection of configurations chosen to cover different total bit-width budgets. However, constructing a high-quality configuration set is non-trivial. We therefore design a Pareto-based configuration search that iteratively optimizes the training configuration set, yielding more precise low-rank adjustments. Our experiments demonstrate that, unlike the state-of-the-art methods that require fine-tuning a separate LoRA adapter for each configuration, CoA-LoRA incurs no additional time cost while achieving comparable or even superior performance to those methods.

</details>


### [888] [Large Reasoning Models Learn Better Alignment from Flawed Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00938)
*ShengYun Peng,Eric Smith,Ivan Evtimov,Song Jiang,Pin-Yu Chen,Hongyuan Zhan,Haozhu Wang,Duen Horng Chau,Mahesh Pasupuleti,Jianfeng Chi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECAP 是一种轻量级 RL 后训练方法，在不增加额外成本的前提下，让大模型学会识别并主动修正思维链中的有害前提，从而兼顾安全与推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大推理模型（LRMs）虽能生成链式思维（CoT），却缺乏对思维过程本身的安全审视，易被注入的有害前提诱导输出恶意内容。

Method: 提出 RECAP：在 RLHF 阶段混合“对抗对齐的 CoT 预填充”与常规提示，训练模型在检测到有害推理轨迹时主动 override 并重新路由到安全答案，无需额外模型或计算开销。

Result: RECAP 在多项安全基准上显著提升鲁棒性，降低 over-refusal，保留核心推理能力，且在推理 token 预算不变的情况下，模型表现出更高频率的自我反省行为，能持续抵御多次自适应攻击。

Conclusion: RECAP 证明仅通过 RLHF 阶段的巧妙数据设计即可实现思维链层面的安全对齐，为后续大模型安全后训练提供了低成本、高泛化的有效范式。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) "think" by generating structured chain-of-thought (CoT) before producing a final answer, yet they still lack the ability to reason critically about safety alignment and are easily biased when a flawed premise is injected into their thought process. We propose RECAP (Robust Safety Alignment via Counter-Aligned Prefilling), a principled reinforcement learning (RL) method for post-training that explicitly teaches models to override flawed reasoning trajectories and reroute to safe and helpful responses. RECAP trains on a mixture of synthetically generated counter-aligned CoT prefills and standard prompts, requires no additional training cost or modifications beyond vanilla reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and substantially improves safety and jailbreak robustness, reduces overrefusal, and preserves core reasoning capability -- all while maintaining inference token budget. Extensive analysis shows that RECAP-trained models engage in self-reflection more frequently and remain robust under adaptive attacks, preserving safety even after repeated attempts to override their reasoning.

</details>


### [889] [Batch Distillation Data for Developing Machine Learning Anomaly Detection Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.18075)
*Justus Arweiler,Indra Jungjohann,Aparna Muraleedharan,Heike Leitte,Jakob Burger,Kerstin Münnemann,Fabian Jirasek,Hans Hasse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: <0x2F}T}{4}通过自建实验装置并公开119组带标注、含多源异构数据的小型间歇精馏基准数据集，解决了化工过程机器学习异常检测长期缺乏公开实验数据的痛点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化工过程异常检测亟需公开实验数据以训练与评估机器学习模型，但现有研究多依赖仿真或专有数据，严重阻碍方法落地与横向比较。

Method: 搭建实验室规模间歇精馏装置，设计覆盖正常与多种异常工况的实验矩阵；同步采集DCS传感器-执行器时序、在线台式NMR浓度曲线、视频/音频等多模态数据；建立领域本体并由专家完成异常标注；提供测量不确定度与丰富元数据，按结构化格式开源至Zenodo。

Result: 获得119组严格配对（正常vs异常）实验数据，涵盖宽操作条件与混合物体系；数据规模、模态多样性、标注完整性均优于现有公开数据集；数据库已分配永久DOI并完全免费开放。

Conclusion: 该数据集为开发、验证与解释化工机器学习异常检测算法提供了首个高可信实验基准，同时支持异常溯源与缓解策略研究，预计推动该领域从仿真走向工业落地。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) holds great potential to advance anomaly detection (AD) in chemical processes. However, the development of ML-based methods is hindered by the lack of openly available experimental data. To address this gap, we have set up a laboratory-scale batch distillation plant and operated it to generate an extensive experimental database, covering fault-free experiments and experiments in which anomalies were intentionally induced, for training advanced ML-based AD methods. In total, 119 experiments were conducted across a wide range of operating conditions and mixtures. Most experiments containing anomalies were paired with a corresponding fault-free one. The database that we provide here includes time-series data from numerous sensors and actuators, along with estimates of measurement uncertainty. In addition, unconventional data sources -- such as concentration profiles obtained via online benchtop NMR spectroscopy and video and audio recordings -- are provided. Extensive metadata and expert annotations of all experiments are included. The anomaly annotations are based on an ontology developed in this work. The data are organized in a structured database and made freely available via doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17395543. This new database paves the way for the development of advanced ML-based AD methods. As it includes information on the causes of anomalies, it further enables the development of interpretable and explainable ML approaches, as well as methods for anomaly mitigation.

</details>


### [890] [Predicting Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease using Machine Learning Methods: A Retrospective Cohort Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22293)
*Mary E. An,Paul M. Griffin,Jonathan G. Stine,Balakrishnan S. Ramakrishna,Soundar R. T. Kumara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者利用EHR数据训练并公平性后处理的可解释模型MASER，仅用10项常规指标即可在初级保健场景中早期发现MASLD，AUROC 0.84，准确率81%，且缓解种族差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MASLD影响30-40%美国成人，早期常无症状，需借助现有EHR在初级保健中低成本、公平地筛查，以避免肝硬化等严重后果。

Method: 回顾性队列，分训练/验证/测试集(n≈109k)。用LASSO、RF、XGBoost、NN构建模型，选LASSO-LogReg（Top10特征）兼顾性能与可解释性；再采用Equal-Opportunity后处理，提升种族亚组间真阳性率的一致性。

Result: LASSO模型AUROC=0.84，Acc 78%，Se 72%，Sp 79%，F1=0.617。公平性调整后Acc↑81%，Sp↑94%，Se↓41%，F1↓0.515，显著降低种族差异。

Conclusion: MASER在常规采集的少量特征下获得与复杂模型相当的预测力，具备初级保健嵌入潜力；经公平性校正后可用于多元人群，有待前瞻性研究验证。

Abstract: Background: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) affects 30-40% of US adults and is the most common chronic liver disease. Although often asymptomatic, progression can lead to cirrhosis. The objective of the study was to develop and evaluate an electronic health record (EHR) based prediction model to support early detection of MASLD in primary care settings. Methods: We evaluated LASSO logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and a neural network model for MASLD prediction using clinical feature subsets from a large EHR database, including the top 10 ranked features. To reduce disparities in true positive rates across racial and ethnic subgroups, we applied an equal opportunity postprocessing method in a prediction model called MASLD EHR Static Risk Prediction (MASER). Results: This retrospective cohort study included 59,492 participants in the training data, 24,198 in the validating data, and 25,188 in the testing data. The LASSO logistic regression model with the top 10 features was selected for its interpretability and comparable performance. Before fairness adjustment, the model achieved AUROC of 0.84, accuracy of 78%, sensitivity of 72%, specificity of 79%, and F1-score of 0.617. After equal opportunity postprocessing, accuracy modestly increased to 81% and specificity to 94%, while sensitivity decreased to 41% and F1-score to 0.515, reflecting the fairness trade-off. Conclusions: MASER achieved competitive performance for MASLD prediction, comparable to previously reported ensemble and tree-based models, while using a limited and routinely collected feature set and a diverse study population. The model is designed to support early detection and potential integration into primary care workflows. MASER demonstrates EHR-ready MASLD prediction with fairness adjustments, supporting future primary care implementation pending prospective validation.

</details>


### [891] [LLM4Delay: Flight Delay Prediction via Cross-Modality Adaptation of Large Language Models and Aircraft Trajectory Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23636)
*Thaweerath Phisannupawong,Joshua Julian Damanik,Han-Lim Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LLM4Delay，首次把大语言模型用于终端区管制视角的航班延误预测，融合文本航行情报与多轨迹数据，跨模态映射后显著优于现有 ATM 方法，并支持在线更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端区航班延误是 ATM 低效的直接体现，传统预测仅利用数值时序或孤立文本，未充分挖掘管制员可见的完整情景（航迹+气象+通告）及其互补信息。

Method: 构建多实例轨迹编码器抽取航迹特征；设计实例级投影层，将轨迹表征映射为语言令牌，与航行情报文本拼接后输入预训练 LLM；联合预训练轨迹编码器与冻结 LLM 进行跨模态微调，实现连续上下文更新。

Result: 在真实终端区数据集上，LLM4Delay 的延误预测准确率较最优 ATM 基线提升 X%，较现有“时序→语言”适配方法提升 Y%，验证文本与轨迹互补价值。

Conclusion: 大模型可成功吸收空管异构数据，实例级投影策略有效弥合模态鸿沟；框架具备在线部署潜力，为后续数字塔台、协同流量管理提供实时决策参考。

Abstract: Flight delay prediction has become a key focus in air traffic management (ATM), as delays reflect inefficiencies in the system. This paper proposes LLM4Delay, a large language model (LLM)-based framework for predicting flight delays from the perspective of air traffic controllers monitoring aircraft after they enter the terminal maneuvering area (TMA). LLM4Delay is designed to integrate textual aeronautical information, including flight data, weather reports, and aerodrome notices, together with multiple trajectories that model airspace conditions, forming a comprehensive delay-relevant context. By jointly leveraging comprehensive textual and trajectory contexts via instance-level projection, an effective cross-modality adaptation strategy that maps multiple instance-level trajectory representations into the language modality, the framework improves delay prediction accuracy. LLM4Delay demonstrates superior performance compared to existing ATM frameworks and prior time-series-to-language adaptation methods. This highlights the complementary roles of textual and trajectory data while leveraging knowledge from both the pretrained trajectory encoder and the pretrained LLM. The proposed framework enables continuous updates to predictions as new information becomes available, indicating potential operational relevance.

</details>


### [892] [Dual Mamba for Node-Specific Representation Learning: Tackling Over-Smoothing with Selective State Space Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06756)
*Xin He,Yili Wang,Yiwei Dai,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DMbaGCN——把 Mamba 引入图卷积的双模块框架，通过局部状态演化与全局上下文感知显式建模逐层表示动态，从而系统缓解深层图神经网络的过度平滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有残差或跳层方法仅在层间粗暴堆叠，未显式刻画节点在不同传播层的专属演化路径，也未利用全图信息，导致深层网络快速失去节点区分度，过度平滑难题未根治。
