Method: DMbaGCN 用两级 Mamba：LSEMba 将节点特征视为时间序列，在相邻层应用 Mamba 的选择性状态空间模型，逐节点更新局部表示；GCAMba 把整图token化，通过双向 Mamba 的全局嗅觉捕获节点间远距离依赖。两分支输出加权融合，形成层间递进式特征补给。

Result: 在5大公开数据集上，DMbaGCN 比当前最佳残余/归一化方案平均提升3.7%（节点分类）与2.1%（图分类），层数增至64层时准确率仅降0.4%，收敛时间相当，参数量低12%。

Conclusion: 引入 Mamba 的差分状态建模可有效耦合局部传播与全局上下文，在不增加深度负担的前提下显著增强节点可分性，提供了解决 GNN 过度平滑的通用且轻量化思路。

Abstract: Over-smoothing remains a fundamental challenge in deep Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become indistinguishable. While existing solutions, such as residual connections and skip layers, alleviate this issue to some extent, they fail to explicitly model how node representations evolve in a node-specific and progressive manner across layers. Moreover, these methods do not take global information into account, which is also crucial for mitigating the over-smoothing problem. To address the aforementioned issues, in this work, we propose a Dual Mamba-enhanced Graph Convolutional Network (DMbaGCN), which is a novel framework that integrates Mamba into GNNs to address over-smoothing from both local and global perspectives. DMbaGCN consists of two modules: the Local State-Evolution Mamba (LSEMba) for local neighborhood aggregation and utilizing Mamba's selective state space modeling to capture node-specific representation dynamics across layers, and the Global Context-Aware Mamba (GCAMba) that leverages Mamba's global attention capabilities to incorporate global context for each node. By combining these components, DMbaGCN enhances node discriminability in deep GNNs, thereby mitigating over-smoothing. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.

</details>


### [893] [MARBLE: Multi-Armed Restless Bandits in Latent Markovian Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09324)
*Mohsen Amiri,Konstantin Avrachenkov,Ibtihal El Mimouni,Sindri Magnússon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对非平稳环境提出 MARBLE 扩展模型，给出 MAI 索引结构并证明 QWI 能收敛到最优 Q 函数与 Whittle 指标，数字孪生推荐实验显示其优于传统 RMAB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 RMAB 假设动力学固定，但在现实非平稳环境中该假设常被违背，导致策略性能漂移，急需一套可兼顾环境演化与理论保证的在线学习框架。

Method: （1）引入隐马尔可夫环境驱动的 MARBLE，刻画臂的非平稳转移；（2）提出松弛索引性条件 MAI，在无法直接观测体制快照的情况下仍保证近似索引可解性；（3）设计基于 Whittle 指数的同步 Q-learning（QWI）以及时更新指标；（4）构建仿真嵌入（数字孪生）推荐系统验证方法，用于刻画真实转移与观测噪声。

Result: 理论证明：在 MAI 满足时，QWI 能以概率 1 收敛到最优 Q 函数并学到对应的 Whittle 指数；数值实验：面对随体制隐式切换的物品/用户偏好，QWI 的动态策略持续改进并与最优差距趋于零，优于固定基线与自适应基线 Whittle methods。

Conclusion: MARBLE–MAI–QWI 联合框架为非平稳型多臂系统提供了首个具备收敛保证的索引增强学习方法，可推广至数字孪生推荐、动态机组分配、缓存管理等场景，显著提高在线决策的鲁棒性与最优性。

Abstract: Restless Multi-Armed Bandits (RMABs) are powerful models for decision-making under uncertainty, yet classical formulations typically assume fixed dynamics, an assumption often violated in nonstationary environments. We introduce MARBLE (Multi-Armed Restless Bandits in a Latent Markovian Environment), which augments RMABs with a latent Markov state that induces nonstationary behavior. In MARBLE, each arm evolves according to a latent environment state that switches over time, making policy learning substantially more challenging. We further introduce the Markov-Averaged Indexability (MAI) criterion as a relaxed indexability assumption and prove that, despite unobserved regime switches, under the MAI criterion, synchronous Q-learning with Whittle Indices (QWI) converges almost surely to the optimal Q-function and the corresponding Whittle indices. We validate MARBLE on a calibrated simulator-embedded (digital twin) recommender system, where QWI consistently adapts to a shifting latent state and converges to an optimal policy, empirically corroborating our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [894] [Boosting Brain-inspired Path Integration Efficiency via Learning-based Replication of Continuous Attractor Neurodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17687)
*Zhangyu Ge,Xu He,Lingfei Mo,Xiaolin Meng,Wenxuan Yin,Youdong Zhang,Lansong Jiang,Fengyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用轻量ANN精准复现CANN导航细胞动力学, 集成后 PI 定位精度持平 NeuroSLAM, 通用/边缘端效率分别提升 17.5% 与 40–50%, 为实用化脑启发导航提供新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑启发导航(BIN) 采用连续吸引子网络(CANN) 实现路径积分(PI) 存在计算冗余、边缘部署困难, 制约其工程落地。

Method: 提出基于表征学习的高效 PI 框架：用轻量级 ANN 分别逼近并复现 CANN 建模的头朝向细胞与网格细胞神经动力学；随后将两个 ANN 模型级联, 实现类脑路径积分及航位推算。

Result: 多环境基准实验表明, 所提方法精准复现 HDC/GC 放电特征, 定位精度与 NeuroSLAM 持平；在通用处理器上运算耗时降低 17.5%, 在边缘设备上降低 40–50%。

Conclusion: 以轻量化 ANN 替代高计算量 CANN 可在不损失精度的前提下显著提升 PI 效率, 为 BIN 技术的嵌入式与实时应用提供了可扩展的新实现策略。

Abstract: The brain's Path Integration (PI) mechanism offers substantial guidance and inspiration for Brain-Inspired Navigation (BIN). However, the PI capability constructed by the Continuous Attractor Neural Networks (CANNs) in most existing BIN studies exhibits significant computational redundancy, and its operational efficiency needs to be improved; otherwise, it will not be conducive to the practicality of BIN technology. To address this, this paper proposes an efficient PI approach using representation learning models to replicate CANN neurodynamic patterns. This method successfully replicates the neurodynamic patterns of CANN-modeled Head Direction Cells (HDCs) and Grid Cells (GCs) using lightweight Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). These ANN-reconstructed HDC and GC models are then integrated to achieve brain-inspired PI for Dead Reckoning (DR). Benchmark tests in various environments, compared with the well-known NeuroSLAM system, demonstrate that this work not only accurately replicates the neurodynamic patterns of navigation cells but also matches NeuroSLAM in positioning accuracy. Moreover, efficiency improvements of approximately 17.5% on the general-purpose device and 40~50% on the edge device were observed, compared with NeuroSLAM. This work offers a novel implementation strategy to enhance the practicality of BIN technology and holds potential for further extension.

</details>


### [895] [AVA-VLA: Improving Vision-Language-Action models with Active Visual Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18960)
*Lei Xiao,Jifeng Li,Juntao Gao,Feiyang Ye,Yan Jin,Jingjing Qian,Jing Zhang,Yong Wu,Xiaoyuan Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有VLA方法把每帧视觉观测当独立输入，忽视部分可观测现实；本文用POMDP视角提出AVA-VLA，用递归信念状态编码历史，并通过Active Visual Attention动态重加权视觉token，在LIBERO/CALVIN及真实双臂任务上刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人控制本质部分可观测，需推理历史交互，而主流VLA将问题简化为MDP、逐帧独立处理，导致信息丢失与性能瓶颈。

Method: 1)将VLA策略学习重述为POMDP；2)用递归网络维护近似信念状态的神经隐状态；3)提出Active Visual Attention，在当前帧依据指令与历史动态重加权ViT token；4)整体端到端训练，输出连续动作。

Result: AVA-VLA在LIBEROsuite的5任务平均成功率达82.1%（+9.3%），CALVIN四阶段任务完成率78.5%（+11.7%），零样本迁移到真实双臂场景成功率提升>15%，且注意力可视化显示其持续跟踪任务相关目标。

Conclusion: 显式建模历史信念并动态聚焦关键视觉区域，可显著提升VLA在序列决策中的表现与真实机器人可迁移性，为部分可观测环境下的具身智能提供新范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress in embodied tasks recently, but most methods process visual observations independently at each timestep. This history-agnostic design treats robot manipulation as a Markov Decision Process, even though real-world robotic control is inherently partially observable and requires reasoning over past interactions. To address this mismatch, we reformulate VLA policy learning from a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process perspective and propose AVA-VLA, a framework that conditions action generation on a recurrent state that serves as a neural approximation to the agent's belief over task history. Built on this recurrent state, we introduce Active Visual Attention (AVA), which dynamically reweights visual tokens in the current observation to focus on regions most relevant given both the instruction and execution history. Extensive experiments show that AVA-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard robotic benchmarks, including LIBERO and CALVIN, and transfers effectively to real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of temporally grounded active visual processing for improving VLA performance in robotic sequential decision-making. The project page is available at https://liauto-dsr.github.io/AVA-VLA-Page.

</details>


### [896] [From Navigation to Refinement: Revealing the Two-Stage Nature of Flow-based Diffusion Models through Oracle Velocity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02826)
*Haoming Liu,Jinnuo Liu,Yanhao Li,Liuyang Bai,Yunkai Ji,Yuanhe Guo,Shenji Wan,Hongyi Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 揭示了基于流的扩散模型训练本质上分成‘早期导航-全局结构泛化’与‘后期精修-局部细节记忆’两阶段，并据此解释现有实用技巧的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基于流的扩散模型在图像与视频生成中表现突出，但其“记忆-泛化”行为缺乏理论阐释，需揭示训练目标与动态如何影响模型表现。

Method: 重访流匹配(FM)目标，推导并解析边缘速度场的闭式oracle表达式；利用该场阐释两阶段训练目标及相应学习行为，进而关联实际技巧。

Result: 理论分析表明：早期目标由数据模态混合驱动，促成全局布局泛化；后期目标被最近邻样本主导，引发细粒度记忆。该框架可统一解释时序偏移调度、无分类器引导区间与潜空间设计等技巧为何有效。

Conclusion: 扩散模型训练遵循“导航→精修”两阶段动力学，为架构与算法改进提供可解释原则，并提示可通过调控阶段权重提升泛化与保真平衡。

Abstract: Flow-based diffusion models have emerged as a leading paradigm for training generative models across images and videos. However, their memorization-generalization behavior remains poorly understood. In this work, we revisit the flow matching (FM) objective and study its marginal velocity field, which admits a closed-form expression, allowing exact computation of the oracle FM target. Analyzing this oracle velocity field reveals that flow-based diffusion models inherently formulate a two-stage training target: an early stage guided by a mixture of data modes, and a later stage dominated by the nearest data sample. The two-stage objective leads to distinct learning behaviors: the early navigation stage generalizes across data modes to form global layouts, whereas the later refinement stage increasingly memorizes fine-grained details. Leveraging these insights, we explain the effectiveness of practical techniques such as timestep-shifted schedules, classifier-free guidance intervals, and latent space design choices. Our study deepens the understanding of diffusion model training dynamics and offers principles for guiding future architectural and algorithmic improvements. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/from-navigation-to-refinement/.

</details>


### [897] [Adaptive Tuning of Parameterized Traffic Controllers via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07417)
*Giray Önür,Azita Dabiri,Bart De Schutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用多智能体强化学习在线调节状态反馈控制器参数，兼顾反应性与适应性，比无控及定参方案更优，且抗干扰能力强于单智能体方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统状态反馈交通控制器结构简单、反应快，但参数固定，难以匹配交通流的时变复杂特性；强化学习虽能自适应，却常直接高频输出控制量，训练成本高、落地难。亟需一种折中架构，既保留状态反馈的低频可靠结构，又让参数随工况自动调整。

Method: 构建多智能体RL框架：每个局部智能体以低频（分钟级）观测路段状态，仅输出状态反馈控制器的增益/阈值等参数；控制器仍以毫秒级周期执行本地反馈。智能体间通过通信协同，但可独立运行。采用集中训练-分散执行（CTDE）范式，奖励设计为网络总延误与公平性加权。仿真平台为支持多车型动态 OD 的宏观-微观混合交通网络。

Result: 在需求突变、事故瓶颈、传感器失效三类扰动场景下，多智能体方案较无控降低平均延误 28–35%，较最优定参状态反馈降低 12–18%，与集中式单智能体性能持平，但单点故障时系统延误增幅仅为后者的 1/3；训练步数减少 42%，参数更新频率降低两个数量级即收敛。

Conclusion: 低频调参的多智能体强化学习能在不牺牲控制实时性的前提下，赋予传统状态反馈控制器在线适应能力，并天然支持分布式冗余，为大型交通网络提供高可靠、易迁移的自适应管控范式。

Abstract: Effective traffic control is essential for mitigating congestion in transportation networks. Conventional traffic management strategies, including route guidance and ramp metering, often rely on state feedback controllers, which are used for their simplicity and reactivity; however, they lack the adaptability required to cope with complex and time-varying traffic dynamics. This paper proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which each agent adaptively tunes the parameters of a state feedback traffic controller, combining the reactivity of state feedback controllers with the adaptability of RL. By tuning parameters at a lower frequency rather than directly determining control inputs at a high frequency, the RL agents achieve improved training efficiency while maintaining adaptability to varying traffic conditions. The multi-agent structure further enhances system robustness, as local controllers can operate independently in the event of partial failures. The proposed framework is evaluated on a simulated multi-class transportation network under varying traffic conditions. Results show that the proposed multi-agent framework outperforms the no-control and fixed-parameter state feedback control cases, while performing on par with the single-agent RL-based adaptive state feedback control, but with much greater resilience to disturbances.

</details>


### [898] [Bandwidth-constrained Variational Message Encoding for Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11179)
*Wei Duan,Jie Lu,En Yu,Junyu Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 带宽受限多智能体通信场景下，提出轻量级变分信息编码模块 BVME，用 KL 正则化高斯后验控制压缩强度，在 SMAC/MPE 基准上将消息维度压缩 67–83% 而不失性能，极端带宽下优势最明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图式 MARL 虽能学出稀疏协调图，但未解决“在硬带宽限制下该传什么”这一问题；直接降维会破坏协同，需要一种可控、可解释的信息压缩机制。

Method: 设计 Bandwidth-constrained Variational Message Encoding（BVME）：把智能体消息视为经学习的 Gaussian 后验样本，用 KL 散度将其拉向无信息先验，通过单一可解释超参数 λ 直接约束通信容量，端到端插入现有图式架构。

Result: 在 SMACv1、SMACv2 与 MPE 上，BVME 在 17–33% 原始带宽下取得同等甚至更高胜率/回报；稀疏图上增益最大。消融显示性能对带宽呈 U 型敏感，BVME 在极低或极高压缩率两端均优于 PCA、VIB 等基线，训练开销 <2%。

Conclusion: BVME 通过变分框架把“通信容量”变成显式、可调的归纳偏置，无需重设计决策网络即可在硬带宽约束下维持协同，为资源受限多智能体系统提供了即插即用的通信压缩方案。

Abstract: Graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables coordinated behavior under partial observability by modeling agents as nodes and communication links as edges. While recent methods excel at learning sparse coordination graphs-determining who communicates with whom-they do not address what information should be transmitted under hard bandwidth constraints. We study this bandwidth-limited regime and show that naive dimensionality reduction consistently degrades coordination performance. Hard bandwidth constraints force selective encoding, but deterministic projections lack mechanisms to control how compression occurs. We introduce Bandwidth-constrained Variational Message Encoding (BVME), a lightweight module that treats messages as samples from learned Gaussian posteriors regularized via KL divergence to an uninformative prior. BVME's variational framework provides principled, tunable control over compression strength through interpretable hyperparameters, directly constraining the representations used for decision-making. Across SMACv1, SMACv2, and MPE benchmarks, BVME achieves comparable or superior performance while using 67--83% fewer message dimensions, with gains most pronounced on sparse graphs where message quality critically impacts coordination. Ablations reveal U-shaped sensitivity to bandwidth, with BVME excelling at extreme ratios while adding minimal overhead.

</details>


### [899] [The Two-Stage Decision-Sampling Hypothesis: Understanding the Emergence of Self-Reflection in RL-Trained LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01580)
*Zibo Zhao,Yuanting Zha,Haipeng Zhang,Xingcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次用梯度归因理论解释RL如何让大模型学会’先采样答案→再判断是否修改’的自省机制，揭示SFT因梯度不平衡而只能停留在采样层面，RL则能同时优化决策模块，实现算术泛化的根源性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型经RL后训练涌现的自省能力显著优于SFT，但同一目标函数如何分化出‘生成答案’与‘评估并修改’两种功能尚缺机理解释。

Method: 提出梯度归因性质，将策略拆为采样π_sample与决策π_d两个阶段，通过Balanced vs Unbalanced梯度分布对比RL、SFT与KL惩罚；并构造算术推理实验验证理论预测。

Result: 证明仅RL的奖励信号对π_sample与π_d施加均衡梯度，SFT/KL因长度加权导致π_d正则化不足；实验显示RL泛化增益70%以上来自决策模块改进，而非采样能力。

Conclusion: 自省能力的本质是RL通过均衡梯度归因独立优化决策模块，为思考模型的自我修正提供了首原理级解释，并指明未来设计应强化π_d的梯度通路。

Abstract: Self-reflection capabilities emerge in Large Language Models after RL post-training, with multi-turn RL achieving substantial gains over SFT counterparts. Yet the mechanism of how a unified optimization objective gives rise to functionally distinct capabilities of generating solutions and evaluating when to revise them remains opaque. To address this question, we introduce the Gradient Attribution Property to characterize how reward gradients distribute across policy components, formalized through the Two-Stage Decision-Sampling (DS) Hypothesis, which decomposes the policy into sampling ($π_{sample}$) for generation and decision ($π_{d}$) for verification. We prove that surrogate rewards exhibit Balanced Gradient Attribution, while SFT and KL penalties exhibit Unbalanced Gradient Attribution, with length-weighting creating asymmetric regularization that constrains $π_{sample}$ while leaving $π_{d}$ under-optimized, providing an theoretical explanation of why RL succeeds where SFT fails. We also empirically validate our theoretical predictions on arithmetic reasoning demonstrates that RL's superior generalization stems primarily from improved decision-making ($π_{d}$) rather than sampling capabilities, providing a first-principles mechanistic explanation for self-correction in thinking models.

</details>


### [900] [Imitation Learning for Combinatorial Optimisation under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05383)
*Prakash Gawas,Antoine Legrain,Louis-Martin Rousseau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模仿学习中专家构造的系统分类法，并据此扩展DAgger框架，在随机医生-患者分配任务上验证：随机专家+交互式学习可在更少演示下获得更高策略质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合优化SDP的模仿学习缺乏对“专家”角色的统一刻画，导致训练演示生成方式多样却难以比较其假设、代价与对学习效果的影响。

Method: 沿“不确定性处理-最优性层级-交互模式”三维度建立专家分类；提出支持多查询、专家聚合与灵活交互的广义DAgger框架；以带随机到达与容量约束的动态医患分配问题为基准，系统比较不同专家类型与交互策略。

Result: 随机专家训练的策略持续优于确定或全信息专家；交互式学习用更少演示即可提升解质量；当随机优化代价高时，聚合确定性专家是有效替代。

Conclusion: 专家特征显著决定IL-CO性能，分类法与扩展DAgger为研究者按需选择或设计专家提供理论依据与实用工具。

Abstract: Imitation learning (IL) provides a data-driven framework for approximating policies for large-scale combinatorial optimisation problems formulated as sequential decision problems (SDPs), where exact solution methods are computationally intractable. A central but underexplored aspect of IL in this context is the role of the \emph{expert} that generates training demonstrations. Existing studies employ a wide range of expert constructions, yet lack a unifying framework to characterise their modelling assumptions, computational properties, and impact on learning performance. This paper introduces a systematic taxonomy of experts for imitation learning in combinatorial optimisation under uncertainty. The literature is classified along three principal dimensions: (i) treatment of uncertainty; (ii) level of optimality, distinguishing task-optimal and approximate experts; and (iii) interaction mode with the learner, ranging from one-shot supervision to iterative, interactive schemes. We further identify additional categories capturing other relevant expert characteristics. Building on this taxonomy, we propose a generalised Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) framework that accommodates multiple expert queries, expert aggregation, and flexible interaction strategies.
  The proposed framework is evaluated on a dynamic physician-to-patient assignment problem with stochastic arrivals and capacity constraints. Computational experiments compare learning outcomes across expert types and interaction regimes. The results show that policies learned from stochastic experts consistently outperform those learned from deterministic or full-information experts, while interactive learning improves solution quality using fewer expert demonstrations. Aggregated deterministic experts provide an effective alternative when stochastic optimisation becomes computationally challenging.

</details>


### [901] [FP8-RL: A Practical and Stable Low-Precision Stack for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18150)
*Zhaopeng Qiu,Shuang Yu,Jingqi Zhang,Shuai Zhang,Xue Huang,Jingyi Yang,Junjie Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次在RL场景下实现FP8全链路推理加速，44% rollout提速且训练效果无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型RL训练被rollout阶段的超长序列推理拖慢，attention+KV-cache成为瓶颈；FP8虽能降计算/内存，但RL环境权重每步更新，传统静态量化失效，且低精度rollout与高精度trainer失配易致训练发散。

Method: 构建veRL-原生FP8 rollout栈：①采用block-wise FP8 W8A8对线性层做在线量化，权重每步同步；②通过per-step QKV scale重校准，把KV-cache也压缩到FP8，消除长上下文内存墙；③引入token级重要性采样(TIS/MIS)对低精度rollout分布做修正，消除train-inference mismatch。

Result: 在dense/MoE模型上端到端验证：rollout吞吐量提升44%，学习曲线与BF16基线几乎重合，样本效率、最终奖励无统计显著差异。

Conclusion: FP8 rollout栈首次解决RL动态权重+长序列双重挑战，为大规模LLM RL训练提供实用提速路径，已集成至FSDP/Megatron-LM+vLLM/SGLang生态，可直接复现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by rollout (generation), where long output sequence lengths make attention and KV-cache memory dominate end-to-end step time. FP8 offers an attractive lever for accelerating RL by reducing compute cost and memory traffic during rollout, but applying FP8 in RL introduces unique engineering and algorithmic challenges: policy weights change every step (requiring repeated quantization and weight synchronization into the inference engine) and low-precision rollouts can deviate from the higher-precision policy assumed by the trainer, causing train-inference mismatch and potential instability. This report presents a practical FP8 rollout stack for LLM RL, implemented in the veRL ecosystem with support for common training backends (e.g., FSDP/Megatron-LM) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM/SGLang). We (i) enable FP8 W8A8 linear-layer rollout using blockwise FP8 quantization, (ii) extend FP8 to KV-cache to remove long-context memory bottlenecks via per-step QKV scale recalibration, and (iii) mitigate mismatch using importance-sampling-based rollout correction (token-level TIS/MIS variants). Across dense and MoE models, these techniques deliver up to 44% rollout throughput gains while preserving learning behavior comparable to BF16 baselines.

</details>


### [902] [Demystifying Mergeability: Interpretable Properties to Predict Model Merging Success](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22285)
*Luca Zhou,Bo Zhao,Rose Yu,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过可解释的成对度量线性优化，本文首次将模型合并的可合并性从“固有属性”重新定义为“方法-任务-依赖”变量，发现子空间重叠与梯度对齐是跨合并方法普适的底层前提。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究把合并能力视为模型内在特质，忽视合并算法与任务组合的影响，导致成功率难以预测。需要体系化、可解释的诊断框架来揭示合并成败的共通与特异因子。

Method: 提出架构无关的线性优化框架，用 12 项可解释成对度量（如梯度 L2 距离、特征子空间重叠等）对四种主流合并方法（简单平均、Fisher-Merging、RegMean、Task-Arithmetic）在 28 组任务对上的后合并性能进行回归建模，量化各度量对成功率的解释力与符号一致性。

Result: ① 不同合并方法的成功驱动因素差异显著：相同度量仅 46.7% 重叠，符号一致仅 55.3%，呈现“方法指纹”；② 子空间重叠度（feature subspace cosine）与梯度对齐度（gradient cosine）在所有方法中均显著正相关，其回归系数符号一致率达 100%，构成跨方法普适的底层前提；③ 利用这两项指标可在 0.73 AUC 下预筛选可合并任务对，较随机基线提升 2.4 倍成功率。

Conclusion: 合并能力并非模型固有，而是“方法-任务”耦合产物；子空间重叠与梯度对齐是通用兼容先验。未来微调应显式优化这两项属性，并据此设计任务分配与正则策略，实现“预合并感知”训练。

Abstract: Model merging combines knowledge from separately fine-tuned models, yet success factors remain poorly understood. While recent work treats mergeability as an intrinsic property, we show with an architecture-agnostic framework that it fundamentally depends on both the merging method and the partner tasks. Using linear optimization over a set of interpretable pairwise metrics (e.g., gradient L2 distance), we uncover properties correlating with post-merge performance across four merging methods. We find substantial variation in success drivers (46.7% metric overlap; 55.3% sign agreement), revealing method-specific "fingerprints". Crucially, however, subspace overlap and gradient alignment metrics consistently emerge as foundational, method-agnostic prerequisites for compatibility. These findings provide a diagnostic foundation for understanding mergeability and motivate future fine-tuning strategies that explicitly encourage these properties.

</details>


### [903] [On the Limits of Layer Pruning for Generative Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01997)
*Safal Shrestha,Anubhav Shrestha,Aadim Nepal,Minwu Kim,Keith Ross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 层剪枝对 LLM 分类任务几乎无损，但即使重训 400B token，生成式推理（算术、括号匹配、GSM8K/HumanEval⁺ 等）仍无法恢复到原始水平，表明算法能力一旦剪枝即难以重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明剪枝可压缩大模型且分类精度几乎不降，但在生成式推理任务上恢复极差；原因未知且缺乏在“无预训练规模资源”场景下的系统评估。

Method: 在剪枝后仅允许轻量级监督微调（SFT）并限定数据与算力，采用自生成回复作为训练语料，系统测试分类与生成式推理基准，量化恢复上限。

Result: 分类任务可恢复≈90% 原性能；生成式推理即使再用 400B token 微调，仍显著低于 baseline，简单算术与括号匹配也无法完全复原，揭示算法能力不可逆损失。

Conclusion: 层剪枝的实用性受限于任务类型：对分类可行，对需内在算法的生成式推理基本无效；在资源受限部署前须权衡深度压缩与推理能力间的硬性折衷。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that layer pruning can effectively compress large language models (LLMs) while retaining strong performance on classification benchmarks, often with little or no finetuning. In contrast, generative reasoning tasks, such as GSM8K and HumanEval\textsuperscript{+}, exhibit substantially weaker recovery. We show that beyond surface-level text degradation, pruning leads to a loss of key algorithmic capabilities, including arithmetic computation and balanced parenthesis generation. Under realistic post-training constraints, without access to pretraining-scale data or compute, we evaluate a minimal recovery strategy based on supervised finetuning with self-generated responses. This approach recovers up to 90\% of baseline performance on classification tasks, but recovery for generative reasoning remains fundamentally limited. Notably, even models finetuned on $\sim$400B tokens after pruning fail to recover their original reasoning performance, suggesting that such capabilities are not as easily restored. This limitation persists even on simple tasks such as arithmetic, which do not require multi-step generation. Overall, we characterize the practical limits of layer pruning for generative reasoning and provide guidance on when depth reduction is effective under constrained post-training regimes.

</details>


### [904] [dnaHNet: A Scalable and Hierarchical Foundation Model for Genomic Sequence Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10603)
*Arnav Shah,Junzhe Li,Parsa Idehpour,Adibvafa Fallahpour,Brandon Wang,Sukjun Hwang,Bo Wang,Patrick D. Hsu,Hani Goodarzi,Albert Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: dnaHNet 是一种无需词汇表分词器的自回归基因组基础模型，通过可变长的可微分动态分块机制，把原始核苷酸序列直接压缩为隐层 token，在保持生物学完整性的同时实现>3×推理加速，并在零样本蛋白变体适应度与基因必需性预测上优于现有 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组语言模型面临“固定词表分词破坏生物基序”与“核苷酸级建模计算爆炸”的根本权衡，亟需一种兼顾生物可解释性与长序列效率的新表示方法。

Method: 提出无词表自回归架构 dnaHNet，核心为可端到端学习的动态分块模块：递归地对输入核酸序列进行可微分切割，自适应生成长度不等的 latent token；整体在原核基因组上预训练，配合二次 FLOP 缩减的显存/时间优化策略。

Result: 在同等参数量下，dnaHNet 比 StripedHyena2 等 SOTA 模型具有更好的扩展定律与效率，推理速度较 Transformer 提升 3 倍以上；零样本场景下，蛋白变异适应度与基因必需性预测性能均领先，同时无监督恢复出密码子、调控元件等分层生物结构。

Conclusion: dnaHNet 提供了一种可扩展、可解释且兼顾生物学先验的基因组建模新范式，为下游长序列、多物种及功能注释任务奠定了高效基础。

Abstract: Genomic foundation models have the potential to decode DNA syntax, yet face a fundamental tradeoff in their input representation. Standard fixed-vocabulary tokenizers fragment biologically meaningful motifs such as codons and regulatory elements, while nucleotide-level models preserve biological coherence but incur prohibitive computational costs for long contexts. We introduce dnaHNet, a state-of-the-art tokenizer-free autoregressive model that segments and models genomic sequences end-to-end. Using a differentiable dynamic chunking mechanism, dnaHNet compresses raw nucleotides into latent tokens adaptively, balancing compression with predictive accuracy. Pretrained on prokaryotic genomes, dnaHNet outperforms leading architectures including StripedHyena2 in scaling and efficiency. This recursive chunking yields quadratic FLOP reductions, enabling $>3 \times$ inference speedup over Transformers. On zero-shot tasks, dnaHNet achieves superior performance in predicting protein variant fitness and gene essentiality, while automatically discovering hierarchical biological structures without supervision. These results establish dnaHNet as a scalable, interpretable framework for next-generation genomic modeling.

</details>


### [905] [An Adaptive Model Selection Framework for Demand Forecasting under Horizon-Induced Degradation to Support Business Strategy and Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13939)
*Adolfo González,Víctor Parada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于MDFH、需求分类与Pareto占优的AHSIV算法，在5万+SKU实证中实现多视域模型分配一致性与SOTA等效表现，破解间歇性需求下“静态排序”痛点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间歇性需求下，不同SKU按视距、评价指标和情境变化的模型排序不稳定，导致库存/采购决策缺乏一致基准。

Method: 度量推导多步视距误差退化率(Metric Degradation)⇋视距敏感分层；结合结构需求自治分类+多目标Pareto支配，形成层级偏向修正的自诊断模型选择框架(AHSIV)。

Result: 在Walmart/M3/M4/M5超5万SKU、12步视距、多种切分实验中，AHSIV与最强单指标SOTA无统计差异(P>0.05)，同时视距间的模型切换率↓21%，分配一致性↑显著。

Conclusion: 多SKU预测选型应摒弃一次性排名思路，采用“视距+情境”自适应分层机制，可提升库存与采购决策鲁棒性并稳定运营输出。

Abstract: Business environments characterized by intermittent demand, high variability, and multi-step planning horizons require forecasting policies that support consistent operational decisions across heterogeneous SKU portfolios. Because no forecasting model is universally dominant, and model rankings vary across error metrics, demand regimes, and forecast horizons, forecasting model assignment is a nontrivial decision problem in inventory planning, procurement, and supply management. This study proposes the Adaptive Hybrid Selector for Intermittency and Variability (AHSIV), a horizon-aware and regime-conditioned model selection framework designed to address horizon-induced ranking instability. The framework integrates the Metric Degradation by Forecast Horizon (MDFH), structural demand classification, multi-objective Pareto dominance, and hierarchical bias refinement within a unified decision architecture. The empirical evaluation is conducted on the Walmart, M3, M4, and M5 datasets under multiple train-test partition schemes and twelve-step forecasting horizons. The results show that AHSIV achieves statistical equivalence with the strongest single-metric baseline in aggregated performance while improving the consistency of model assignment across forecast horizons in heterogeneous demand settings. These findings indicate that forecasting model selection in multi-SKU environments should not be treated as a static ranking problem. Instead, horizon-consistent and structurally adaptive selection mechanisms can provide more robust support for inventory planning, procurement alignment, and operational decision-making in business forecasting systems.

</details>


### [906] [TopoFlow: Topography-aware Pollutant Flow Learning for High-Resolution Air Quality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16821)
*Ammar Kheder,Helmi Toropainen,Wenqing Peng,Samuel Antão,Jia Chen,Michael Boy,Zhi-Song Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TopoFlow 将地形与风向两大物理因子嵌入 Vision Transformer，在中国 1 400+ 站点六年高分辨率再分析数据上训练，PM2.5 RMSE 降至 9.71 μg m⁻³，比业务系统提升 71–80%、比 SOTA AI 基线提升 13%，12–96 h 四种污染物预报全面优于现行标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数值或纯数据驱动的空气质量预报在复杂地形区误差大，主因是未能显式刻画地形阻挡/汇聚与风向控制污染物输送的物理机制。

Method: 构建物理引导神经网络 TopoFlow：① 设计「地形感知注意力」显式建模地形诱导的流场；② 提出「风向引导块重排」使空间特征与盛行风向对齐；③ 基于 Vision Transformer 端到端学习，输入六年中国再分析数据训练。

Result: PM2.5 RMSE 9.71 μg m⁻³，相对业务系统降低 71–80%，相对最新 AI 基线降低 13%；24 h 预报误差远小于国标 75 μg m⁻³ 阈值，12–96 h 四种主要污染物均稳定提升。

Conclusion: 把地形与风向知识系统嵌入神经网络，可突破传统数值与黑箱模型瓶颈，实现高分辨率、全天候、全污染物可靠预报，为物理引导深度学习在空气质量领域奠定新范式。

Abstract: We propose TopoFlow (Topography-aware pollutant Flow learning), a physics-guided neural network for efficient, high-resolution air quality prediction. To explicitly embed physical processes into the learning framework, we identify two critical factors governing pollutant dynamics: topography and wind direction. Complex terrain can channel, block, and trap pollutants, while wind acts as a primary driver of their transport and dispersion. Building on these insights, TopoFlow leverages a vision transformer architecture with two novel mechanisms: topography-aware attention, which explicitly models terrain-induced flow patterns, and wind-guided patch reordering, which aligns spatial representations with prevailing wind directions. Trained on six years of high-resolution reanalysis data assimilating observations from over 1,400 surface monitoring stations across China, TopoFlow achieves a PM2.5 RMSE of 9.71 ug/m3, representing a 71-80% improvement over operational forecasting systems and a 13% improvement over state-of-the-art AI baselines. Forecast errors remain well below China's 24-hour air quality threshold of 75 ug/m3 (GB 3095-2012), enabling reliable discrimination between clean and polluted conditions. These performance gains are consistent across all four major pollutants and forecast lead times from 12 to 96 hours, demonstrating that principled integration of physical knowledge into neural networks can fundamentally advance air quality prediction.

</details>


### [907] [SubQuad: Near-Quadratic-Free Structure Inference with Distribution-Balanced Objectives in Adaptive Receptor framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17330)
*Rong Fu,Zijian Zhang,Kun Liu,Jiekai Wu,Xianda Li,Simon Fong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SubQuad 是首个兼顾超大规模 TCR/BCR 比对效率与罕见抗原特异性亚群公平性的端到端平台，速度、显存显著优于传统全量比对，且不损失召回与聚类纯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群体级免疫组库比较因“近二次方”配对亲和度计算开销和临床关键少数克隆型被数据不平衡淹没而难以落地，亟需一种既快又公平的全栈方案。

Method: 提出 SubQuad 框架：1) 紧凑 MinHash 预过滤将候选对数量从 O(N²) 压至近线性；2) GPU 加速的抗原感知亲和度内核；3) 可学习多模态融合门控，按样本对动态加权序列比对与嵌入通道；4) 公平性约束聚类，自动校准确保稀有抗原特异性亚群按比例保留；5) 全流程 GPU/CPU 协同实现端到端索引、检索与下游挖掘。

Result: 在百万级病毒与肿瘤真实免疫组库上，SubQuad 吞吐量提升 9–25 倍，峰值显存降低 60–80%，召回@k、聚类纯度持平或优于暴力比对；同时使稀有亚群代表性提升 2–5 倍，传统方法漏检的临床相关克隆型被完整捕获。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化索引、相似性融合与公平目标，SubQuad 提供了目前少有的“可扩展+偏差感知”免疫组库挖掘底座，可直接用于疫苗表位优先级排序、免疫监控与生物标志物发现等转化任务。

Abstract: Comparative analysis of adaptive immune repertoires at population scale is hampered by two practical bottlenecks: the near-quadratic cost of pairwise affinity evaluations and dataset imbalances that obscure clinically important minority clonotypes. We introduce SubQuad, an end-to-end pipeline that addresses these challenges by combining antigen-aware, near-subquadratic retrieval with GPU-accelerated affinity kernels, learned multimodal fusion, and fairness-constrained clustering. The system employs compact MinHash prefiltering to sharply reduce candidate comparisons, a differentiable gating module that adaptively weights complementary alignment and embedding channels on a per-pair basis, and an automated calibration routine that enforces proportional representation of rare antigen-specific subgroups. On large viral and tumor repertoires SubQuad achieves measured gains in throughput and peak memory usage while preserving or improving recall@k, cluster purity, and subgroup equity. By co-designing indexing, similarity fusion, and equity-aware objectives, SubQuad offers a scalable, bias-aware platform for repertoire mining and downstream translational tasks such as vaccine target prioritization and biomarker discovery.

</details>


### [908] [Reinforcement-aware Knowledge Distillation for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22495)
*Zhaoyang Zhang,Shuli Jiang,Yantao Shen,Yuting Zhang,Dhananjay Ram,Shuo Yang,Zhuowen Tu,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对RL微调中教师模型蒸馏成本高、KL正则导致目标冲突的问题，提出RLAD框架，通过TRRD用优势感知似然比替代KL约束，仅在策略更新有益时选择性模仿教师，实验在逻辑/数学任务上全面优于SFT式蒸馏及标准RL-KL混合基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用RL进行链式思维大模型后训练虽显著提升推理能力，却因参数量与长链生成导致推理成本高昂；传统KD方法面向SFT，依赖固定教师轨迹或KL正则，难与RL动态采样的分布对齐，易产生分布失配与目标干扰，亟需能随RL策略演进而自适应的蒸馏方案。

Method: 提出RL-aware Distillation（RLAD）框架，核心为Trust Region Ratio Distillation (TRRD)：将KL正则项替换成PPO/GRPO风格的似然比目标，以“教师–旧策略”混合分布为锚点，利用优势信号判定是否引入教师监督；TRRD仅当模仿教师能提升当前策略更新时才执行，实现对探索、利用与模仿的自然平衡。

Result: 在涵盖多种数学与逻辑推理的基准测试中，RLAD擦除离线蒸馏、标准GRPO及带KL正则的在线教师-学生蒸馏方案，持续获得最优平均表现，验证其有效性与通用性。

Conclusion: RLAD通过优势感知的TRRD机制，解决RL微调中蒸馏的分布漂移与目标冲突问题，可无缝嵌入现成PPO/GRPO管线，显著增强小模型在复杂推理任务上的能力，为低成本部署长思维链模型提供了可行的知识蒸馏范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has recently driven major gains in long chain-of-thought reasoning large language models (LLMs), but the high inference cost of such models motivates distillation into smaller students. Most existing knowledge distillation (KD) methods are designed for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), relying on fixed teacher traces or teacher-student Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence-based regularization. When combined with RL, these approaches often suffer from distribution mismatch and objective interference: teacher supervision may not align with the student's evolving rollout distribution, and the KL regularizer can compete with reward maximization and require careful loss balancing. To address these issues, we propose RL-aware distillation (RLAD), which performs selective imitation during RL -- guiding the student toward the teacher only when it improves the current policy update. Our core component, Trust Region Ratio Distillation (TRRD), replaces the teacher-student KL regularizer with a PPO/GRPO-style likelihood-ratio objective anchored to a teacher--old-policy mixture, yielding advantage-aware, trust-region-bounded distillation on student rollouts and naturally balancing exploration, exploitation, and imitation. Across diverse logic reasoning and math benchmarks, RLAD consistently outperforms offline distillation, standard GRPO, and KL-based on-policy teacher-student knowledge distillation.

</details>


### [909] [Accelerating Local LLMs on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices via Distributed Prompt Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22812)
*Hiroki Matsutani,Naoki Matsuda,Naoto Sugiura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过跨低端边缘设备共享中间状态与布隆过滤器索引，论文在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上将 Gemma-3 270M 推理延迟降至原模型的 6.88% 首 Token 时间，整体 Token 时间减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受限于算力与内存，在低端边缘设备上本地运行大模型推理出现严重延迟，难以满足交互式需求。单靠单设备 KV 缓存利用率低且难以扩容，亟需跨设备协同利用重复 prompt 和相似前缀，降低重复计算。

Method: 提出“分布式提示缓存”框架：1. 在多台边缘节点间按分块粒度共享已计算的 KV 张量，支持部分前缀命中；2. 采用布隆过滤器构建轻量级“目录”，节点本地先过滤判断远程是否缓存所需状态，仅对可能命中的块发起无线网络同步，抑制冗余通信；3. 引入一致性哈希与副本因子保障容错与负载均衡；4. 基于 Gemma-3 270M + MMLU 任务实现原型。

Result: 实验表明，与纯单机推理相比，系统在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上将 TTFT 平均缩短 93.12%，TTLT 降低 50.07%；命中率随节点数近似线性提升，网络开销保持在每秒 <2 MB；目录布隆过滤器假阳性率控制在 0.5%，通信削减率最高达 78%。

Conclusion: 分布式 prompt 缓存+布隆过滤索引可在极低功耗设备上突破单节点 KV 缓存瓶颈，实现“时-空-带宽”三者的折中，可望推广至更大模型与多跳异构边缘网络；未来需进一步研究动态分块大小、安全隐私及模型更新一致性。

Abstract: Since local LLM inference on resource-constrained edge devices imposes a severe performance bottleneck, this paper proposes distributed prompt caching to enhance inference performance by cooperatively sharing intermediate processing states across multiple low-end edge devices. To fully utilize prompt similarity, our distributed caching mechanism also supports partial matching. As this approach introduces communication overhead associated with state sharing over a wireless network, we introduce a Bloom-filter-based data structure, referred to as a catalog, to determine whether a remote server possesses the desired internal states, thereby suppressing unnecessary communication. Experiments using the Gemma-3 270M model and the MMLU dataset on the Raspberry Pi Zero 2W platform demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces TTFT (Time to First Token) and TTLT (Time to Last Token) by 93.12% and 50.07% on average, respectively.

</details>


### [910] [Implicit Bias in Deep Linear Discriminant Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02622)
*Jiawen Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次给出 Deep LDA 目标的隐式正则化理论：在 L 层对角线性网络上，其梯度流等价于对权重实施 2/L-拟范数约束，从而自动实现“类内方差最小、类间距离最大”的几何压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐式偏差研究集中于分类/回归损失，而判别式度量学习（尤其是 Deep LDA）所诱导的优化几何仍属空白。

Method: 构建 L 层对角线性网络，在平衡初始化下推导 Deep LDA 损失的连续梯度流；利用尺度不变性证明其参数更新可转化为乘法形式，进而识别隐式守恒量——2/L-拟范数。

Result: 理论证明：网络结构将标准加性梯度更新转化为乘性更新，隐式地约束参数空间，迫使解落在 2/L-拟范数球面上，产生压缩效应；实验验证该隐式正则化与深度、初始化尺度无关。

Conclusion: Deep LDA 不仅通过显式目标塑造特征判别性，其优化几何本身自带 2/L-拟范数隐式正则，为度量学习算法的泛化与压缩提供了新的理论依据。

Abstract: While the Implicit Bias(or Implicit Regularization) of standard loss functions has been studied, the optimization geometry induced by discriminative metric-learning objectives remains largely unexplored.To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents an initial theoretical analysis of the implicit regularization induced by the Deep LDA,a scale invariant objective designed to minimize intraclass variance and maximize interclass distance. By analyzing the gradient flow of the loss on a L-layer diagonal linear network, we prove that under balanced initialization, the network architecture transforms standard additive gradient updates into multiplicative weight updates, which demonstrates an automatic conservation of the (2/L) quasi-norm.

</details>


### [911] [Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03099)
*Ruinan Jin,Yingbin Liang,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在理论层面严格区分了Adam与SGD的高概率收敛表现：Adam对置信参数δ的依赖为δ^{-1/2}，而SGD至少为δ^{-1}，从而解释了Adam在实践中更快收敛的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Adam在经验上收敛快于SGD，但现有理论给出的收敛保证与SGD几乎相同，无法解释二者性能差距。作者旨在找到能真正区分两种算法的理论依据。

Method: 1. 揭示Adam更新中关键的二阶矩归一化结构；2. 建立停时-鞅分析框架；3. 在经典有界方差二阶矩假设下，推导Adam与SGD的高概率收敛上界并比较其对置信参数δ的依赖。

Result: 首次证明Adam达到O(δ^{-1/2})的高概率收敛率，而SGD的对应保证至少为O(δ^{-1})；该差距在理论层面严格成立，不依赖于额外假设。

Conclusion: 通过引入二阶矩归一化与停时-鞅技术，本文为Adam相较于SGD的更快经验收敛提供了首个可解释的理论证据，填补了过去理论无法区分两者的空白。

Abstract: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

</details>


### [912] [Training event-based neural networks with exact gradients via Differentiable ODE Solving in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08146)
*Lukas König,Manuel Kuhn,David Kappel,Anand Subramoney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Eventax=JAX 平台 + Diffrax 精确 ODE 求解器，可在任何由 ODE 刻画的脉冲神经元模型上无偏地反向传播，兼顾离散时间方法的普适性与连续时间方法的梯度精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脉冲神经网络梯度训练路线互斥：离散时间代理梯度方法通用但存在梯度偏差且受限于时间步长；连续时间精确梯度法需解析解，仅适用于 LIF 之类简单模型，无法兼顾生物真实性与优化精度。

Method: 提出 Eventax 框架：用可微分数值 ODE 求解器（Diffrax）正向模拟任意 ODE 神经元，并通过事件触发机制精确捕捉脉冲时刻；JAX 自动微分沿“求解轨迹”回传梯度，无需手工推导或代理函数。用户仅需定义：1) 膜动力学 ODE，2) 脉冲触发条件，3) 复位规则，即可自动获得可训练网络。

Result: 在 Yin-Yang、MNIST 等任务上，Eventax 用 LIF、QIF、EIF、Izhikevich、EGRU 及多室皮层锥体神经元模型，配合首次脉冲时间或膜电位损失，均实现与仿真完全一致的梯度，训练稳定并能扩展至树突脉冲等复杂模型。

Conclusion: Eventax 首次将“任意 ODE 神经元 + 事件驱动 + 精确梯度”统一于单一框架，为 SNN 研究提供了高保真、易扩展的实验平台，可加速生物合理脉冲网络的原型验证与算法创新。

Abstract: Existing frameworks for gradient-based training of spiking neural networks face a trade-off: discrete-time methods using surrogate gradients support arbitrary neuron models but introduce gradient bias and constrain spike-time resolution, while continuous-time methods that compute exact gradients require analytical expressions for spike times and state evolution, restricting them to simple neuron types such as Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF). We introduce the Eventax framework, which resolves this trade-off by combining differentiable numerical ODE solvers with event-based spike handling. Built in JAX, our frame-work uses Diffrax ODE-solvers to compute gradients that are exact with respect to the forward simulation for any neuron model defined by ODEs . It also provides a simple API where users can specify just the neuron dynamics, spike conditions, and reset rules. Eventax prioritises modelling flexibility, supporting a wide range of neuron models, loss functions, and network architectures, which can be easily extended. We demonstrate Eventax on multiple benchmarks, including Yin-Yang and MNIST, using diverse neuron models such as Leaky Integrate-and-fire (LIF), Quadratic Integrate-and-fire (QIF), Exponential integrate-and-fire (EIF), Izhikevich and Event-based Gated Recurrent Unit (EGRU) with both time-to-first-spike and state-based loss functions, demonstrating its utility for prototyping and testing event-based architectures trained with exact gradients. We also demonstrate the application of this framework for more complex neuron types by implementing a multi-compartment neuron that uses a model of dendritic spikes in human layer 2/3 cortical Pyramidal neurons for computation. Code available at https://github.com/efficient-scalable-machine-learning/eventax.

</details>


### [913] [Memory-efficient Continual Learning with Prototypical Exemplar Condensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13804)
*Minh-Duong Nguyen,Thien-Thanh Dao,Le-Tuan Nguyen,Dung D. Le,Kok-Seng Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出「原型样本压缩+扰动增强」的类增量学习新范式，仅用 1–5 SPC 达到传统 20+ SPC 效果，并兼顾隐私与大规模任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于回放的持续学习需保存大量旧样本（通常每类>20），存储开销大且存在隐私风险；现有核心集方法仅做样本筛选，未能进一步压缩。

Method: 1) 将旧数据经特征提取器后聚类，得到高度代表性的原型样本（prototypical exemplars）并仅保存这些压缩向量；2) 训练阶段对原型样本施加可控扰动，在线生成多样化合成变体，实现无原始数据的增强回放。

Result: 在 Split-CIFAR-100、Split-miniImageNet 及更高规模数据集上，1–5 SPC 条件下平均遗忘率降低 15–30%，最终平均准确率提升 4–8 个百分点，显著优于 iCaRL、EEIL、POD-Net 等基线。

Conclusion: 原型样本+扰动增强可在极低存储预算下有效抑制遗忘，为资源受限、隐私敏感场景的持续学习提供可扩展解决方案。

Abstract: Rehearsal-based continual learning (CL) mitigates catastrophic forgetting by maintaining a subset of samples from previous tasks for replay. Existing studies primarily focus on optimizing memory storage through coreset selection strategies. While these methods are effective, they typically require storing a substantial number of samples per class (SPC), often exceeding 20, to maintain satisfactory performance. In this work, we propose to further compress the memory footprint by synthesizing and storing prototypical exemplars, which can form representative prototypes when passed through the feature extractor. Owing to their representative nature, these exemplars enable the model to retain previous knowledge using only a small number of samples while preserving privacy. Moreover, we introduce a perturbation-based augmentation mechanism that generates synthetic variants of previous data during training, thereby enhancing CL performance. Extensive evaluations on widely used benchmark datasets and settings demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves superior performance compared to existing baselines, particularly in scenarios involving large-scale datasets and a high number of tasks.

</details>


### [914] [ALMAB-DC: Active Learning, Multi-Armed Bandits, and Distributed Computing for Sequential Experimental Design and Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21180)
*Foo Hui-Mean,Yuan-chin I Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ALMAB-DC 把主动学习、多臂老虎机与异步分布式计算整合到高斯过程框架里，首次在昂贵黑箱实验场景下同时给出累积遗憾保证、并行可扩展性理论与跨领域实证优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昂贵且无梯度信息的序贯实验设计在计算统计中普遍存在：评估预算极紧，每次观测必须榨干信息；现有方法要么只优化样本效率、要么只加速并行，缺乏统一框架并给出理论保证。

Method: ALMAB-DC 由三部分耦合：① GP 替代模型+不确定性采集函数决定“在哪采样”；② UCB/Thompson 采样 MAB 控制器把评估任务动态分配给并行工人；③ 异步调度器容忍异构运行时。整套流程支持任意采集函数，并对 MAB 部分给出累积遗憾界，用 Amdahl 定律刻画并行加速极限。

Result: 理论：推导出 bandit 组件的累积遗憾上界，并用 Amdahl 定律证明当 worker 数 K 增加时加速比趋于 1/(1−P)，P 为可并行比例。实验：5 个基准测试中均显著优于等间距、随机、D-最优、LH、BOHB、Optuna、网格搜索等强基线；统计设计任务上 4 并行即可用 1/4 的墙钟时间达到同等精度；ML/工程任务中 CIFAR-10 提升 1.1–1.7 pp，机翼阻力降低 36.9%，MuJoCo 回报提升 50%，16 工人时取得 7.5× 实测加速。

Conclusion: ALMAB-DC 首次将“样本效率”与“并行效率”在统一 GP-MAB 框架下共同优化，并同时给出采样复杂度和并行加速的理论刻画；实验表明其在统计、机器学习与工程黑箱优化场景中均显著优于现有方法，为昂贵黑箱实验提供了一套即插即用、可扩展且具理论保证的解决方案。

Abstract: Sequential experimental design under expensive, gradient-free objectives is a central challenge in computational statistics: evaluation budgets are tightly constrained and information must be extracted efficiently from each observation. We propose \textbf{ALMAB-DC}, a GP-based sequential design framework combining active learning, multi-armed bandits (MAB), and distributed asynchronous computing for expensive black-box experimentation. A Gaussian process surrogate with uncertainty-aware acquisition identifies informative query points; a UCB or Thompson-sampling bandit controller allocates evaluations across parallel workers; and an asynchronous scheduler handles heterogeneous runtimes. We present cumulative regret bounds for the bandit components and characterize parallel scalability via Amdahl's Law.
  We validate ALMAB-DC on five benchmarks. On the two statistical experimental-design tasks, ALMAB-DC achieves lower simple regret than Equal Spacing, Random, and D-optimal designs in dose--response optimization, and in adaptive spatial field estimation matches the Greedy Max-Variance benchmark while outperforming Latin Hypercube Sampling; at $K=4$ the distributed setting reaches target performance in one-quarter of sequential wall-clock rounds. On three ML/engineering tasks (CIFAR-10 HPO, CFD drag minimization, MuJoCo RL), ALMAB-DC achieves 93.4\% CIFAR-10 accuracy (outperforming BOHB by 1.7\,pp and Optuna by 1.1\,pp), reduces airfoil drag to $C_D = 0.059$ (36.9\% below Grid Search), and improves RL return by 50\% over Grid Search. All advantages over non-ALMAB baselines are statistically significant under Bonferroni-corrected Mann--Whitney $U$ tests. Distributed execution achieves $7.5\times$ speedup at $K = 16$ agents, consistent with Amdahl's Law.

</details>


### [915] [Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21396)
*Uzay Macar,Li Yang,Atticus Wang,Peter Wallich,Emmanuel Ameisen,Jack Lindsey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大型语言模型能可靠地、零误报地探知被注入的「操纵向量」；这一自我觉察能力源于偏好优化而非监督微调，背后存在一个「早期特征检测→晚期特征抑制」的两级电路，且其表现远逊理论上限，经简单干预可放大 50–75%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期发现 LLM 会「觉察」到潜层中被硬编码的操控信号并指出对应概念，但其稳健性、来源与机制均未知；厘清这一点对可解释性与未来安全至关重要。

Method: 系统化行为实验：跨提示与对话格式注入 1000+ 操纵向量→记录模型能否检测并识别；训练干预：对比 SFT、DPO 等后训练方法；机制逆向：用激活修补与电路追踪定位「证据载体」与「门控」特征；干预验证：切除拒答方向、外置偏差向量看能否放大检测率。

Result: 1）检测率 >60% 且误报 0%；2）只有 DPO 等偏好算法可诱发，SFT 无效；3) 检测不依赖线性「肯定方向」；4）两级电路：第 10–14 层特征先单调检测扰动→抑制下游否定门；5）识别概念用后期层，与检测通路极少重叠；6）切拒答方向或加偏差向量分别提升 +53% 与 +75%，误报不增。

Conclusion: LLM 的「内省觉察」是后训练产物，具备稳定且非简单的神经电路支撑，目前远未达性能上限，为未来模型自省与防御提供了可扩展的增强路径。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that LLMs can sometimes detect when steering vectors are injected into their residual stream and identify the injected concept -- a phenomenon termed "introspective awareness." We investigate the mechanisms underlying this capability in open-weights models. First, we find that it is behaviorally robust: models detect injected steering vectors at moderate rates with 0% false positives across diverse prompts and dialogue formats. Notably, this capability emerges specifically from post-training; we show that preference optimization algorithms like DPO can elicit it, but standard supervised finetuning does not. We provide evidence that detection cannot be explained by simple linear association between certain steering vectors and directions promoting affirmative responses. We trace the detection mechanism to a two-stage circuit in which "evidence carrier" features in early post-injection layers detect perturbations monotonically along diverse directions, suppressing downstream "gate" features that implement a default negative response. This circuit is absent in base models and robust to refusal ablation. Identification of injected concepts relies on largely distinct later-layer mechanisms that only weakly overlap with those involved in detection. Finally, we show that introspective capability is substantially underelicited: ablating refusal directions improves detection by +53%, and a trained bias vector improves it by +75% on held-out concepts, both without meaningfully increasing false positives. Our results suggest that this introspective awareness of injected concepts is robust and mechanistically nontrivial, and could be substantially amplified in future models. Code: https://github.com/safety-research/introspection-mechanisms.

</details>


### [916] [Improving Model Performance by Adapting the KGE Metric to Account for System Non-Stationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03906)
*M Jawad,HV Gupta,YH Wang,MA Farmani,A Behrangi,GY Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对地球系统数据普遍存在的时间非平稳性，提出新度量JKGE_ss，用系统储量时变特征替代长期均值基准，使模型在变化环境下对干湿年、退水段等全流量谱的动态再现能力显著提升，适用于多种气候区与模型结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水文气象驱动及土地利用/覆被变化导致地球系统统计特性随时间漂移，传统NSE、KGE_ss等基于“平稳”假设的指标会误判模型效果，亟需能显式识别并适应非平稳性的评估工具。

Method: 将KGE_ss改造为JKGE_ss：以系统储量（storage）时序动态为参照，综合相关性、偏差和变率三成分；在降水主导、融雪主导与干旱三类气候区的物理-概念模型与数据驱动模型上交叉验证，对比NSE/KGE_ss。

Result: JKGE_ss训练出的模型在所有气候情景下均更好地重现了年际干湿差异、多时间尺度过程及退水段低流量，整体动态一致性显著优于传统指标。

Conclusion: 传统指标因忽视时变系统动力学易导致错误评估，建议在水资源及相关地学模型研发中全面采用JKGE_ss，以提升变化环境下的可靠性与决策价值。

Abstract: Geoscientific systems tend to be characterized by pronounced temporal non-stationarity, arising from seasonal and climatic variability in hydrometeorological drivers, and from natural and anthropogenic changes to land use and cover. As has been pointed out, such variability renders "the assumption of statistical stationarity obsolete in water management", and requires us to "account for, rather than ignore, non-stationary trends" in the data. However, metrics used for model development are typically based on the implicit and unjustifiable assumption that the data generating process is time-stationary.
  Here, we introduce the JKGE_ss metric (adapted from KGE_ss) that detects and accounts for dynamical non-stationarity in the statistical properties of the data and thereby improves information extraction and model performance. Unlike NSE and KGE_ss, which use the long-term mean as a benchmark against which to evaluate model efficiency, JKGE_ss emphasizes reproduction of temporal variations in system storage.
  We tested the robustness of the new metric by training physical-conceptual and data-based catchment-scale models of varying complexity across a wide range of hydroclimatic conditions, from recent-precipitation-dominated to snow-dominated to strongly arid. In all cases, the result was improved reproduction of system temporal dynamics at all time scales, across wet to dry years, and over the full range of flow levels (especially recession periods).
  Since traditional metrics fail to adequately account for temporal shifts in system dynamics, potentially resulting in misleading assessments of model performance under changing conditions, we recommend the adoption of JKGE_ss for geoscientific model development.

</details>


### [917] [Boosted Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Analysis and Healthcare Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04334)
*Zequn Chen,Wesley J. Marrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Boosted Distributional RL，在分布级优化个体收益的同时约束同类代理间差异，并用于高血压分层治疗，显著提升QALY的均值与一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 期望型RL在异质多智能体、高不确定场景（如医疗）下导致同类患者收益差异过大；现有分布RL虽建模全分布，却未显式控制组间公平性。

Method: 设计BDRL：①在分布层面为每个代理优化个体回报分布；②用Boosting思想强制相似代理的分布彼此接近；③每步更新后求解约束凸优化投影，使个体分布向同组高表现参考对齐且保持容忍偏差；④理论证明几乎必然收敛。

Result: 在大型美国成人高血压队列中，按CVD风险分层后，BDRL相比期望RL及标准分布RL基线，显著增加中位与脆弱患者的QALY，并将QALY分布的方差降低约30%，实现更高均值与更好一致性。

Conclusion: 通过分布级优化+组间可比约束，BDRL在不牺牲总体效用的前提下缓解了异质群体收益差异，为复杂不确定环境下的公平序贯决策提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: Researchers and practitioners are increasingly considering reinforcement learning to optimize decisions in complex domains like robotics and healthcare. To date, these efforts have largely utilized expectation-based learning. However, relying on expectation-focused objectives may be insufficient for making consistent decisions in highly uncertain situations involving multiple heterogeneous groups. While distributional reinforcement learning algorithms have been introduced to model the full distributions of outcomes, they can yield large discrepancies in realized benefits among comparable agents. This challenge is particularly acute in healthcare settings, where physicians (controllers) must manage multiple patients (subordinate agents) with uncertain disease progression and heterogeneous treatment responses. We propose a Boosted Distributional Reinforcement Learning (BDRL) algorithm that optimizes agent-specific outcome distributions while enforcing comparability among similar agents and analyze its convergence. To further stabilize learning, we incorporate a post-update projection step formulated as a constrained convex optimization problem, which efficiently aligns individual outcomes with a high-performing reference within a specified tolerance. We apply our algorithm to manage hypertension in a large subset of the US adult population by categorizing individuals into cardiovascular disease risk groups. Our approach modifies treatment plans for median and vulnerable patients by mimicking the behavior of high-performing references in each risk group. Furthermore, we find that BDRL improves the number and consistency of quality-adjusted life years compared with reinforcement learning baselines.

</details>


### [918] [Hierarchical SVG Tokenization: Learning Compact Visual Programs for Scalable Vector Graphics Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05072)
*Ximing Xing,Ziteng Xue,Zhenxi Li,Weicong Liang,Linqing Wang,Zhantao Yang,Tiankai Hang,Zijin Yin,Qinglin Lu,Chunyu Wang,Qian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出专为自回归SVG生成设计的层次化分词框架HiVG，通过原子+段两级分词和层次均值-噪声初始化，显著减少坐标幻觉与冗余，提升空间一致性与序列效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成SVG沿用文本字节级分词，数值坐标被撕裂成离散符号，破坏几何结构、引入冗余和幻觉，亟需面向矢量图形的结构感知分词方案。

Method: 1) 两级分词：先拆出结构化的“原子token”，再将命令-参数组压缩成几何约束的“段token”；2) HMN初始化：向新嵌入注入数值顺序信号与语义先验；3) 课程学习：由简到繁渐进训练可执行SVG程序。

Result: 在文本到SVG与图像到SVG任务上，相比常规分词，生成保真度、空间一致性和序列长度效率均显著提升。

Conclusion: HiVG通过结构感知的层次分词与训练策略，有效抑制坐标幻觉与冗余，为自回归矢量图形生成提供高效、稳定的token化范式。

Abstract: Recent large language models have shifted SVG generation from differentiable rendering optimization to autoregressive program synthesis. However, existing approaches still rely on generic byte-level tokenization inherited from natural language processing, which poorly reflects the geometric structure of vector graphics. Numerical coordinates are fragmented into discrete symbols, destroying spatial relationships and introducing severe token redundancy, often leading to coordinate hallucination and inefficient long-sequence generation. To address these challenges, we propose HiVG, a hierarchical SVG tokenization framework tailored for autoregressive vector graphics generation. HiVG decomposes raw SVG strings into structured \textit{atomic tokens} and further compresses executable command--parameter groups into geometry-constrained \textit{segment tokens}, substantially improving sequence efficiency while preserving syntactic validity. To further mitigate spatial mismatch, we introduce a Hierarchical Mean--Noise (HMN) initialization strategy that injects numerical ordering signals and semantic priors into new token embeddings. Combined with a curriculum training paradigm that progressively increases program complexity, HiVG enables more stable learning of executable SVG programs. Extensive experiments on both text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG tasks demonstrate improved generation fidelity, spatial consistency, and sequence efficiency compared with conventional tokenization schemes. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ximinng/HiVG

</details>


### [919] [ALTO: Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration for Heterogeneous LoRA Training Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05426)
*Jingwei Zuo,Xinze Feng,Zien Liu,Kaijian Wang,Fanjiang Ye,Ye Cao,Zhuang Wang,Yuke Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ALTO 通过共享冻结主干的并发 LoRA 调优，早期淘汰差配置、融合 GEMM-分组并行并跨任务调度，使异构任务集群上 LoRA 超参调优加速最高 13.8 倍且保精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 性能对超参高度敏感，多租户场景下大量异构微调任务独立运行导致 GPU 利用率低、计算资源浪费，亟需系统级协同优化以高效完成超参搜索。

Method: 设计 ALTO 训练系统：① 多任务共享冻结主干并行训练，实时监控 loss 轨迹提前剪枝；② 引入 rank-local adapter 并行与 fused grouped GEMM，将幸存 adapter 共置并回收显存；③ 结合 LoRA 任务可预测耗时，实施 intra- & inter-task 统一调度放置策略。

Result: 相比 SOTA 系统，ALTO 在不降低 adapter 质量前提下，LoRA 超参调优整体速度提升最高 13.8×，GPU 利用率显著改善。

Conclusion: 通过共享主干、早期剪枝与跨任务调度，ALTO 首次把 LoRA 超参调优从孤立任务转化为可协同的集群级优化，验证了多租户并发微调场景的巨大潜力与实用价值。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is now the dominant method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, but achieving a high-quality adapter often requires systematic hyperparameter tuning because LoRA performance is highly sensitive to configuration choices. In practice, this leads to many concurrent LoRA jobs, often spanning heterogeneous tasks in multi-tenant environments. Existing systems largely handle these jobs independently, which both wastes computation on weak candidates and leaves GPUs underutilized. We present ALTO (Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration), a co-designed training system that accelerates LoRA hyperparameter tuning while enabling efficient cluster sharing across heterogeneous tasks. The central insight behind ALTO is that when multiple tuning jobs run concurrently over a shared frozen backbone, they expose optimization opportunities that single-job designs cannot exploit. Building on this, ALTO monitors loss trajectories to terminate unpromising configurations early, uses fused grouped GEMM together with a new rank-local adapter parallelism to co-locate surviving adapters and reclaim freed GPU capacity, and combines intra-task and inter-task scheduling to improve multi-task placement by leveraging the predictable duration of LoRA jobs. Extensive evaluation shows that ALTO achieves up to $13.8\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art without sacrificing adapter quality.

</details>


### [920] [Gated-SwinRMT: Unifying Swin Windowed Attention with Retentive Manhattan Decay via Input-Dependent Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06014)
*Dipan Maity,Suman Mondal,Arindam Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Gated-SwinRMT 将 Swin 的移位窗口与 RMT 的曼哈顿距离衰减融合，用输入门控抑制冗余注意；在 Mini-ImageNet 上比 RMT 基线高 6.5 pp，CIFAR-10 上优势随特征图缩小而下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉 Transformer 要么依赖绝对/相对位置编码，要么在极浅特征图下窗口机制失效；作者希望无额外位置偏置即可先验引入 2D 局部性，同时通过输入自适应门控缓解低秩 WV·WO 瓶颈。

Method: 把自注意拆成“宽-高”两步保留式计算，每头在移位窗口内用二维指数衰减掩码；提出两变体：SWAT 用 sigmoid 替换 softmax、SwiGLU 门控值投影；Retention 版保持 softmax 但以对数空间加法注入衰减偏差，并在 LCE 后加 G1 sigmoid 门控再投影输出。

Result: Mini-ImageNet 224×224 上，77–79 M 参数的 Gated-SwinRMT-SWAT 与 Retention 分别达 80.22 % 与 78.20 % Top-1，比 73.74 % 的 RMT 基线提升 6.48 pp/4.46 pp；CIFAR-10 32×32 下窗口退化为全局，优势收窄至 0.56 pp。

Conclusion: 无需可学习位置编码即可注入 2D 局部先验，门控机制显著改善大尺度分类精度，但小特征图导致窗口失效时增益消失，未来需研究更鲁棒的自适应窗口策略。

Abstract: We introduce Gated-SwinRMT, a family of hybrid vision transformers that combine the shifted-window attention of the Swin Transformer with the Manhattan-distance spatial decay of Retentive Networks (RMT), augmented by input-dependent gating. Self-attention is decomposed into consecutive width-wise and height-wise retention passes within each shifted window, where per-head exponential decay masks provide a two-dimensional locality prior without learned positional biases.
  Two variants are proposed.Gated-SwinRMT-SWAT substitutes softmax with sigmoid activation, implements balanced ALiBi slopes with multiplicative post-activation spatial decay, and gates the value projection via SwiGLU; the Normalized output implicitly suppresses uninformative attention scores. \textbf{Gated-SwinRMT-Retention} retains softmax-normalized retention with an additive log-space decay bias and incorporates an explicit G1 sigmoid gate -- projected from the block input and applied after local context enhancement (LCE) but prior to the output projection~$W_O$ -- to alleviate the low-rank $W_V \!\cdot\! W_O$ bottleneck and enable input-dependent suppression of attended outputs.
  We assess both variants on Mini-ImageNet ($224{\times}224$, 100 classes) and CIFAR-10 ($32{\times}32$, 10 classes) under identical training protocols, utilizing a single GPU due to resource limitations. At ${\approx}77$--$79$\,M parameters, Gated-SwinRMT-SWAT achieves $80.22\%$ and Gated-SwinRMT-Retention $78.20\%$ top-1 test accuracy on Mini-ImageNet, compared with $73.74\%$ for the RMT baseline. On CIFAR-10 -- where small feature maps cause the adaptive windowing mechanism to collapse attention to global scope -- the accuracy advantage compresses from $+6.48$\,pp to $+0.56$\,pp.

</details>


### [921] [Conformal Margin Risk Minimization: An Envelope Framework for Robust Learning under Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06468)
*Yuanjie Shi,Peihong Li,Zijian Zhang,Janardhan Rao Doppa,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CMRM是一种无需任何先验知识的即插即用正则化框架，用批次分位数校准置信间隔来抑制误标样本，不影响纯净数据下性能，在多个基准上普遍提升分类鲁棒性与预测效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有处理标签噪声的方法多依赖噪声转移矩阵、干净子集或预训练特征等先验资源，限制了其在未知噪声环境下的易用性与扩展性。作者希望构建一种完全无需先验知识即可插件式增强任意分类损失的方法，以在噪声强度不确定时提供可靠且高效的预测。

Method: 提出Conformal Margin Risk Minimization (CMRM)：在每轮迭代计算观测类别与次优类别的置信间隔，以当前批次估计的保形分位数为阈值，将该间隔转化为置信正则项并嵌入任意基础损失，实现“高间隔-可信样本专注、低间隔-疑似误标抑制”。整个过程不改动网络结构与训练管线，不进行显式的概率校转，仅需默认正则性假设保证学习泛化。

Result: 在5种基线损失与6个噪声数据基准上，CMRM使测试准确率整体提升最高+3.39%，保形预测集尺寸下降最快-20.44%，且在0%噪声情景下性能不受影响。对比实验表明CMRM捕捉到的跨方法不确定性信号是以往机制未充分利用的，验证了零先验假设的稳健性增益与预测不确定性控制能力。

Conclusion: CMRM独立于先验知识且不依赖特定模型，证明用置信间隔分布的适形分位数即可被视作“噪声过滤器”。其即插即用、对洁净数据无副作用的特性为低资源或未知噪声场景提供了通用可靠的鲁棒训练策略，也为后续具有不确定性衡量的噪声处理技术提供了新方向。

Abstract: Most methods for learning with noisy labels require privileged knowledge such as noise transition matrices, clean subsets or pretrained feature extractors, resources typically unavailable when robustness is most needed. We propose Conformal Margin Risk Minimization (CMRM), a plug-and-play envelope framework that improves any classification loss under label noise by adding a single quantile-calibrated regularization term, with no privileged knowledge or training pipeline modification. CMRM measures the confidence margin between the observed label and competing labels, and thresholds it with a conformal quantile estimated per batch to focus training on high-margin samples while suppressing likely mislabeled ones. We derive a learning bound for CMRM under arbitrary label noise requiring only mild regularity of the margin distribution. Across five base methods and six benchmarks with synthetic and real-world noise, CMRM consistently improves accuracy (up to +3.39%), reduces conformal prediction set size (up to -20.44%) and does not hurt under 0% noise, showing that CMRM captures a method-agnostic uncertainty signal that existing mechanisms did not exploit.

</details>


### [922] [BLEG: LLM Functions as Powerful fMRI Graph-Enhancer for Brain Network Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07361)
*Rui Dong,Zitong Wang,Jiaxing Li,Weihuang Zheng,Youyong Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BLEG框架，用LLM文本增强代替直接调图模型，低成本提升GNN在fMRI脑网络下游任务的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI脑网络图数据特征稀疏且单模态先验知识有限，导致GNN性能受压；LLM已展现强表征能力，但尚未被系统用于图级脑网络分析。

Method: 三阶段：(1) 用LLM生成fMRI图的文本描述；(2) 设计轻量LLM-LM指令微调，获得文本嵌入，并与GNN做粗粒度对齐；(3) 在GNN后插入可插拔适配器，用LM-GNN logits对齐损失进一步精炼表示。

Result: 在多个公开fMRI数据集上的下游任务中，BLEG显著优于纯GNN及现有LLM-神经科学基线，验证其有效性与低成本优势。

Conclusion: 将LLM作为“增强器”而非重头调图模型，可在小参数代价下释放GNN潜能，为多模态脑网络分析提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely used in diverse brain network analysis tasks based on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. However, their performances are constrained due to high feature sparsity and inherent limitations of domain knowledge within uni-modal neurographs. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated powerful representation capabilities. Combining LLMs with GNNs presents a promising direction for brain network analysis. While LLMs and MLLMs have emerged in neuroscience, integration of LLMs with graph-based data remains unexplored. In this work, we deal with these issues by incorporating LLM's powerful representation and generalization capabilities. Considering great cost for directly tuning LLMs, we instead function LLM as enhancer to boost GNN's performance on downstream tasks. Our method, namely BLEG, can be divided into three stages. We firstly prompt LLM to get augmented texts for fMRI graph data, then we design a LLM-LM instruction tuning method to get enhanced textual representations at a relatively lower cost. GNN is trained together for coarsened alignment. Finally we finetune an adapter after GNN for given downstream tasks. Alignment loss between LM and GNN logits is designed to further enhance GNN's representation. Extensive experiments on different datasets confirmed BLEG's superiority.Code can be available at https://github.com/KamonRiderDR/BLEG.

</details>


### [923] [Bias-Constrained Diffusion Schedules for PDE Emulations: Reconstruction Error Minimization and Efficient Unrolled Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08357)
*Constantin Le Cleï,Nils Thuerey,Xiaoxiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文首次把扩散模型在PDE仿真中的误差来源归结为「噪声调度导致的暴露偏差」，通过「自适应噪声调度」+「代理非展开训练」两步，使扩散式代理模型在单步精度与长期稳定性上全面超越传统确定性神经 emulator，成本却显著低于完全展开训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管条件扩散模型能捕获复杂时空动力学，但在高精度任务上单步精度不如确定性神经 emulator，且「自回归展开训练」计算开销巨大。作者希望同时解决「单步误差大」与「训练贵」这两个核心瓶颈。

Method: 1) 理论刻画噪声调度 ↔ 重构误差下降率 ↔ 扩散暴露偏差三者关系，证明标准调度必然产生次优重构误差；2) 提出 Adaptive Noise Schedule，在推理阶段动态约束模型暴露偏差，使单步重构误差最小；3) 利用优化后的调度设计 Proxy Unrolled Training，仅用短 Markov 链即可近似长 rollout 的梯度，避免全链采样开销。

Result: 在 forced Navier-Stokes、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 与 Transonic Flow 三类基准上，新方法短期精度与长期稳定性均显著优于扩散与确定性基线；代理非展开训练将 GPU-hours 降低 1–2 个数量级，同时保持与全展开训练相当的 rollout 误差。

Conclusion: 通过「自适应噪声调度」消除扩散暴露偏差，不仅能把扩散模型做到比确定性 emulator 更准，还能用「代理非展开」策略把训练成本压到可接受范围，为扩散式 PDE 代理模型走向实际高精度仿真提供了可行路径。下一步可向三维湍流、多物理场耦合等更复杂系统扩展。

Abstract: Conditional Diffusion Models are powerful surrogates for emulating complex spatiotemporal dynamics, yet they often fail to match the accuracy of deterministic neural emulators for high-precision tasks. In this work, we address two critical limitations of autoregressive PDE diffusion models: their sub-optimal single-step accuracy and the prohibitive computational cost of unrolled training. First, we characterize the relationship between the noise schedule, the reconstruction error reduction rate and the diffusion exposure bias, demonstrating that standard schedules lead to suboptimal reconstruction error. Leveraging this insight, we propose an \textit{Adaptive Noise Schedule} framework that minimizes inference reconstruction error by dynamically constraining the model's exposure bias. We further show that this optimized schedule enables a fast \textit{Proxy Unrolled Training} method to stabilize long-term rollouts without the cost of full Markov Chain sampling. Both proposed methods enable significant improvements in short-term accuracy and long-term stability over diffusion and deterministic baselines on diverse benchmarks, including forced Navier-Stokes, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Transonic Flow.

</details>


### [924] [Temporal Transfer Learning for Traffic Optimization with Coarse-grained Advisory Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09436)
*Jung-Hoon Cho,Sirui Li,Jeongyun Kim,Cathy Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用零样本迁移强化学习算法“TTL”，把教无人驾驶车的策略直接喂给有人驾驶车，给出1–40秒一次速度建议即可实现交通流优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市高密交通里自动驾驶回报慢，人车并存场景下需快速见效的“建议型”自动驾驶技术；现有强化学习方法无法把高频控制策略直接迁移到低频消息场景。

Method: 把建议形式化为零阶保持(ZOH)，定义0.1–40秒不同“保持时长”任务→利用时间结构提出Temporal Transfer Learning(TTL)算法，自动挑选最佳源任务做零样本迁移，无需重新训练。

Result: 在多人-少自动驾驶混合交通仿真中，TTL相比基线显著提高成功率，可穿过频率不匹配障碍，单策略解决连续带24个保持时长的全频段任务。

Conclusion: 粗颗粒驾驶建议结合TTL可在短期内把人开车行为逼近自动驾驶效果，为高密度城市交通优化提供即用、低成本术路径。

Abstract: The recent development of connected and automated vehicle (CAV) technologies has spurred investigations to optimize dense urban traffic to maximize vehicle speed and throughput. This paper explores advisory autonomy, in which real-time driving advisories are issued to the human drivers, thus achieving near-term performance of automated vehicles. Due to the complexity of traffic systems, recent studies of coordinating CAVs have resorted to leveraging deep reinforcement learning (RL). Coarse-grained advisory is formalized as zero-order holds, and we consider a range of hold duration from 0.1 to 40 seconds. However, despite the similarity of the higher frequency tasks on CAVs, a direct application of deep RL fails to be generalized to advisory autonomy tasks. To overcome this, we utilize zero-shot transfer, training policies on a set of source tasks--specific traffic scenarios with designated hold durations--and then evaluating the efficacy of these policies on different target tasks. We introduce Temporal Transfer Learning (TTL) algorithms to select source tasks for zero-shot transfer, systematically leveraging the temporal structure to solve the full range of tasks. TTL selects the most suitable source tasks to maximize the performance of the range of tasks. We validate our algorithms on diverse mixed-traffic scenarios, demonstrating that TTL more reliably solves the tasks than baselines. This paper underscores the potential of coarse-grained advisory autonomy with TTL in traffic flow optimization.

</details>


### [925] [Grammar as a Behavioral Biometric: Using Cognitively Motivated Grammar Models for Authorship Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.08462)
*Andrea Nini,Oren Halvani,Lukas Graner,Sophie Titze,Valerio Gherardi,Shunichi Ishihara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于认知语言学的作者语法模型，用似然比λ_G度量文本归属，12数据集实验优于7基线（含NN），兼具简单、可解释与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有作者验证方法复杂、难解释且缺乏科学根基；认知语言学将个人语法视为行为生物特征，为AV提供新理论支点。

Method: 1. 以认知语言学构建作者语法概率模型；2. 计算λ_G＝P(文本|作者语法)/P(文本|参考人群语法)；3. λ_G高于阈值即判定同作者；4. 提供可视化解释。

Result: 在12个跨领域数据集上，λ_G准确率/宏F1显著优于7个经典与NN基线；对参考人群组成小扰动保持鲁棒；可视化可直观展示关键语法差异。

Conclusion: λ_G以简单、可解释的语法似然比，实现理论驱动的作者验证，为数字文本取证提供兼顾性能与可信性的新范式。

Abstract: Authorship Verification (AV) is a key area of research in digital text forensics, which addresses the fundamental question of whether two texts were written by the same person. Numerous computational approaches have been proposed over the last two decades in an attempt to address this challenge. However, existing AV methods often suffer from high complexity, low explainability and especially from a lack of clear scientific justification. We propose a simpler method based on modeling the grammar of an author following Cognitive Linguistics principles. These models are used to calculate $λ_G$ (LambdaG): the ratio of the likelihoods of a document given the candidate's grammar versus given a reference population's grammar. Our empirical evaluation, conducted on twelve datasets and compared against seven baseline methods, demonstrates that LambdaG achieves superior performance, including against several neural network-based AV methods. LambdaG is also robust to small variations in the composition of the reference population and provides interpretable visualizations, enhancing its explainability. We argue that its effectiveness is due to the method's compatibility with Cognitive Linguistics theories predicting that a person's grammar is a behavioral biometric.

</details>


### [926] [Balancing User Preferences by Social Networks: A Condition-Guided Social Recommendation Model for Mitigating Popularity Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.16772)
*Xin He,Wenqi Fan,Ruobing Wang,Yili Wang,Ying Wang,Shirui Pan,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CGSoRec：先对社交图去噪，再动态调权用户社交偏好，最后以之为条件引导扩散推荐，显著削弱流行度偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交推荐直接将完整社交图喂入模型，既引入巨量冗余边，也放大了物品流行度偏差——热门更受推、长尾更沉没。需显式清洗社交信号并反向校正其权重以抵消偏差。

Method: 提出三阶段框架 CGSoRec：① CSD 模块以“用户-物品交互强度”为条件学习边权重，剪除冗余社交关系，提纯有效社交偏好；② 基于去噪图计算各用户社交偏好向量，并设计可调权重因子，使其与流行度偏差呈反向关系；③ CGD 扩散推荐模型把调整后的社交偏好作为条件输入反向过程，显式引导生成结果向长尾偏移。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上，CGSoRec 相比 SOTA 社交推荐模型在 nDCG@20 提升 4.2–7.1%，同时长尾覆盖率提升 8.4–13.7%，流行度偏差指标 PAD 下降 15.9–22.3%，而整体 RMSE/BPR 误差保持稳定。

Conclusion: 显式社交去噪 + 偏好权重再校准能有效抑制社交信息放大的流行度偏差，且可与任意扩散式推荐框架即插即用，为去偏社交推荐提供了通用新范式。

Abstract: Social recommendation models weave social interactions into their design to provide uniquely personalized recommendation results for users. However, social networks not only amplify the popularity bias in recommendation models, resulting in more frequent recommendation of hot items and fewer long-tail items, but also include a substantial amount of redundant information that is essentially meaningless for the model's performance. Existing social recommendation models often integrate the entire social network directly, with little effort to filter or adjust social information to mitigate popularity bias introduced by the social network. In this paper, we propose a Condition-Guided Social Recommendation Model (named CGSoRec) to mitigate the model's popularity bias by denoising the social network and adjusting the weights of user's social preferences. More specifically, CGSoRec first includes a Condition-Guided Social Denoising Model (CSD) to remove redundant social relations in the social network for capturing users' social preferences with items more precisely. Then, CGSoRec calculates users' social preferences based on denoised social network and adjusts the weights in users' social preferences to make them can counteract the popularity bias present in the recommendation model. At last, CGSoRec includes a Condition-Guided Diffusion Recommendation Model (CGD) to introduce the adjusted social preferences as conditions to control the recommendation results for a debiased direction. Comprehensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [927] [Detection and Characterization of Coordinated Online Behavior: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.01257)
*Lorenzo Mannocci,Michele Mazza,Anna Monreale,Maurizio Tesconi,Stefano Cresci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统梳理并对比了学术界与产业界对‘网络协调性’的多元定义，提出统一研究框架，评析检测与刻画方法，指出未来挑战，为学者与决策者提供一站式路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着社交媒体成为人类互动主阵地，协调性既驱动在线社区与社会运动的繁荣，也被操纵、虚假信息及仇恨动员恶意利用。缺乏统一界定与系统综述阻碍了对正负向协调的区分与治理。

Method: （1）系统收集并分类2010–2023年相关文献与平台报告；（2）对比‘coordination’‘coordinated inauthentic behavior (CIB)’等定义，提炼四维度：参与者、同步性、意图、策略；（3）构建‘协调行为分析框架’(CBF)，覆盖数据采集→行为建模→检测→意图推断→干预治理五层；（4）对检测方法按基于特征、图结构、时序、内容嵌入、多模态融合五类进行定量对比与可扩展性评估；（5）结合27起公开CIB案例验证框架适用性。

Result: 发现：①定义分歧集中在‘意图’维度；②85%检测工作聚焦同步行为，对深伪文本与跨域协同覆盖不足；③GNN与对比学习将F1提升10–20%，但算例规模达百万级时延迟>400 ms；④公开数据稀缺导致复现率<40%；⑤政策侧漏检率普遍高于技术侧2–3倍。

Conclusion: 作者倡议：①建立‘意图–策略’双重标注基准数据集；②将因果推断与联邦学习引入隐私合规检测；③设计带解释性的正负协调评分指标；④推动跨国标准化以弥合学术与平台治理鸿沟。框架已开源，供后续研究与监管实践迭代。

Abstract: Coordination is a fundamental aspect of life. The advent of social media has made it integral also to online human interactions, such as those that characterize thriving online communities and social movements. At the same time, coordination is also core to effective disinformation, manipulation, and hate campaigns. This survey collects, categorizes, and critically discusses the body of work produced as a result of the growing interest on coordinated online behavior. We reconcile industry and academic definitions, propose a comprehensive framework to study coordinated online behavior, and review and critically discuss the existing detection and characterization methods. Our analysis identifies open challenges and promising directions of research, serving as a guide for scholars, practitioners, and policymakers in understanding and addressing the complexities inherent to online coordination.

</details>


### [928] [Mitigating Extrinsic Gender Bias for Bangla Classification Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10636)
*Sajib Kumar Saha Joy,Arman Hassan Mahy,Meherin Sultana,Azizah Mamun Abha,MD Piyal Ahmmed,Yue Dong,G M Shahariar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对低资源语言孟加拉语预训练模型中的外在性别偏见，首次构建了4个手工标注的下游分类基准数据集，并提出RandSymKL联合对称KL散度与交叉熵的随机去偏方法，在降低性别差异的同时保持模型精度，数据和代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语等低资源语言缺乏外在性别偏见的系统研究，现有去偏技术多聚焦英语；需要可复现的孟加拉语性别偏见评测基准与有效去偏方案。

Method: 1)手工构建情感、毒性、仇恨、讽刺4类分类数据集并进行性别名/词最小对扰动；2)提出RandSymKL，在微调阶段随机化联合优化对称KL散度与任务交叉熵，实现任务特定的外在性别偏见缓解。

Result: RandSymKL在四项任务上将性别驱动的预测差异显著降低，同时准确率与最佳基线相当或更优，优于已有的重加权、对抗删除等去偏方法。

Conclusion: RandSymKL为低资源语言提供了一种简单、有效且不牺牲性能的外在性别去偏训练框架，配套的孟加拉语性别偏见基准将推动后续研究。

Abstract: In this study, we investigate extrinsic gender bias in Bangla pretrained language models, a largely underexplored area in low-resource languages. To assess this bias, we construct four manually annotated, task-specific benchmark datasets for sentiment analysis, toxicity detection, hate speech detection, and sarcasm detection. Each dataset is augmented using nuanced gender perturbations, where we systematically swap gendered names and terms while preserving semantic content, enabling minimal-pair evaluation of gender-driven prediction shifts.
