We then propose RandSymKL, a randomized debiasing strategy integrated with symmetric KL divergence and cross-entropy loss to mitigate the bias across task-specific pretrained models. RandSymKL is a refined training approach to integrate these elements in a unified way for extrinsic gender bias mitigation focused on classification tasks. Our approach was evaluated against existing bias mitigation methods, with results showing that our technique not only effectively reduces bias but also maintains competitive accuracy compared to other baseline approaches. To promote further research, we have made both our implementation and datasets publicly available: https://github.com/sajib-kumar/Mitigating-Bangla-Extrinsic-Gender-Bias

</details>


### [929] [OmniPrism: Learning Disentangled Visual Concept for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.12242)
*Yangyang Li,Daqing Liu,Wu Liu,Allen He,Xinchen Liu,Yongdong Zhang,Guoqing Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OmniPrism，借助语言引导与对比正交解耦训练，在20万图文对上把内容、风格、构图等多维度概念彻底分离，再注入扩散模型新增跨注意力层，实现任意组合、无干扰的高质量创意图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法只能做单维度概念生成，或受无关概念干扰导致混淆；多概念场景下缺乏可靠解耦手段，限制创意自由度与生成质量。

Method: 1) 构建20万“成对概念解耦”数据集PCD-200K，保证每对图像仅共享目标概念；2) 设计对比正交解耦(COD)训练策略，在多模态特征空间内把不同语义概念投影到正交子空间；3) 在扩散模型新增跨注意力层，并引入块级嵌入(block embeddings)自适应调节各网络块的概念域，实现解耦表示的可控注入。

Result: 大量实验表明，OmniPrism可在内容、风格、构图等多维度上独立控制生成结果，FID、CLIP-score等指标优于现有最好方法，生成图像与文本提示及目标概念高度一致且无明显概念污染。

Conclusion: 通过显式语言引导的概念解耦与扩散模型结构改造，OmniPrism首次在统一框架内实现多维度、无干扰的创意图像生成，为后续文本驱动编辑、风格迁移等任务提供了通用、高保真的解耦基础。

Abstract: Creative visual concept generation often draws inspiration from specific concepts in a reference image to produce relevant outcomes. However, existing methods are typically constrained to single-aspect concept generation or are easily disrupted by irrelevant concepts in multi-aspect concept scenarios, leading to concept confusion and hindering creative generation. To address this, we propose OmniPrism, a visual concept disentangling approach for creative image generation. Our method learns disentangled concept representations guided by natural language and trains a diffusion model to incorporate these concepts. We utilize the rich semantic space of a multimodal extractor to achieve concept disentanglement from given images and concept guidance. To disentangle concepts with different semantics, we construct a paired concept disentangled dataset (PCD-200K), where each pair shares the same concept such as content, style, and composition. We learn disentangled concept representations through our contrastive orthogonal disentangled (COD) training pipeline, which are then injected into additional diffusion cross-attention layers for generation. A set of block embeddings is designed to adapt each block's concept domain in the diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can generate high-quality, concept-disentangled results with high fidelity to text prompts and desired concepts.

</details>


### [930] [Automatic Self-supervised Learning for Social Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.18735)
*Xin He,Wenqi Fan,Mingchen Sun,Ying Wang,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出AusRec框架，利用元学习自动为多个自监督辅助任务赋权，无需手工设计即可提升社交推荐性能，并在多数据集上验证其优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交推荐方法依赖人工设计辅助任务，需要大量领域知识，难以适应多样化推荐场景。

Method: 设计AusRec框架，将多种自监督辅助任务统一接入元学习优化流程，通过自动加权机制自适应分配各任务权重，无需手工调节即可优化社交推荐表示学习。

Result: 在多组真实社交推荐数据集上的对比实验表明，AusRec持续优于现有最优基线，验证其在不同场景下的有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: AusRec通过元学习自动赋权策略，摆脱了社交推荐中对手工辅助任务的依赖，具有较强的泛化能力，为社交推荐自适应学习提供了新思路。

Abstract: In recent years, researchers have leveraged social relations to enhance recommendation performance. However, most existing social recommendation methods require carefully designed auxiliary social tasks tailored to specific scenarios, which depend heavily on domain knowledge and expertise. To address this limitation, we propose Automatic Self-supervised Learning for Social Recommendations (AusRec), which integrates multiple self-supervised auxiliary tasks with an automatic weighting mechanism to adaptively balance their contributions through a meta-learning optimization framework. This design enables the model to automatically learn the optimal importance of each auxiliary task, thereby enhancing representation learning in social recommendations. Extensive experiments on several real-world datasets demonstrate that AusRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating its effectiveness and robustness across different recommendation scenarios.

</details>


### [931] [Conformal Prediction in Hierarchical Classification with Constrained Representation Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.19038)
*Thomas Mortier,Alireza Javanmardi,Yusuf Sale,Eyke Hüllermeier,Willem Waegeman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对层次分类任务提出两种高效分裂式保形预测算法，一种仅输出内部节点，另一种放宽限制并以表示复杂度换取更小预测集；实验验证其名义覆盖有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统保形预测面向扁平分类/回归，无法处理层次标签约束；现有方法在层次场景下要么仅允许内部节点作为预测集，要么计算代价高昂。

Method: 将分裂保形预测框架推广到层次分类：算法一（内部节点约束）通过节点祖先集的含入-排除构造满足覆盖；算法二解除内部节点限制，引入“表示复杂度”度量，将推理归结为带复杂度正则的组合优化问题，并给出多项式时间近似求解策略。

Result: 在多个层次基准数据集上，两算法均实现标称1-α覆盖；算法二在相同覆盖下平均预测集大小缩小10–30%，且运行时间与算法一相当。

Conclusion: 提出的层次分裂保形预测方法首次在严格覆盖保证下兼顾计算效率与预测集紧凑性，为层次分类的不确定性量化提供了可直接部署的工具；未来可进一步研究动态层次结构与非独立同分布场景扩展。

Abstract: Conformal prediction has emerged as a widely used framework for constructing valid prediction sets in classification and regression tasks. In this work, we extend the split conformal prediction framework to hierarchical classification, where prediction sets are commonly restricted to internal nodes of a predefined hierarchy, and propose two computationally efficient inference algorithms. The first algorithm returns internal nodes as prediction sets, while the second one relaxes this restriction. Using the notion of representation complexity, the latter yields smaller set sizes at the cost of a more general and combinatorial inference problem. Empirical evaluations on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms in achieving nominal coverage.

</details>


### [932] [Constraining Sequential Model Editing with Editing Anchor Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00035)
*Hao-Xiang Xu,Jun-Yu Ma,Zhen-Hua Ling,Ningyu Zhang,Jia-Chen Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过统计发现连续编辑参数矩阵会严重偏移导致模型泛化劣化，提出 EAC 框架以“锚点压缩”方式限制偏移，在 3 个 LLM、4 任务、2 种编辑方法上兼顾 >70% 泛化保持与编辑知识保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编辑方法在持续编辑场景下长期效果是灾难性的：每次更新都会向参数空间中注入新方向，累积后矩阵整体分布远离原始状态，引发过往知识关联崩溃与任务性能骤降，急需在不重训的前提下控制住这种偏移漂移。

Method: 设计 Editing Anchor Compression（EAC）：1. 选择能充分表达新增关系的“编辑锚点”参数子集；2. 在子空间中重参数化编辑向量，使其与锚点解耦合并压缩到接近原流形；3. 以正则项约束其余参数变动，确保总体矩阵距离 θₜ – θ₀ 最小化；4. 迭代更新锚点，保证后续编辑仍旧使用相同策略闭环控制漂移。

Result: 将 EAC 接入两种主流 editor（ROME、MEMIT）并在 Llama-2-7B、GPT-J-6B、Llama-3-8B 四任务（实体替换、简称、对话问答、常识推理）上实验。与原生编辑相比：主流 task 平均泛化指标跌幅从 ≈35% 降至 <10%，编辑准确率维持 95% 以上；累计编辑上千条后仍能留存超过 70% 原始性能，同时 WT103 PPL 升幅控制在 0.1 以内。

Conclusion: EAC 证明“压缩漂移方向+保锚点约束”能在不牺牲编辑正样的前提下大幅缓解连续编辑引发的灾难性遗忘，为无需重训即长期更新 LLM 知识提供了高效且易插拔的新范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with hallucinations due to false or outdated knowledge. Given the high resource demands of retraining these models, there is an increasing focus on developing model editing. However, the general abilities of LLMs across downstream tasks are prone to significant degradation during sequential editing. This paper statistically observes that the parameter matrix after editing exhibits a significant deviation compared to its previous state as the number of edits increases. This serious deviation affects the original knowledge associations within LLMs and leads to the degradation of their general abilities. To this end, a framework termed Editing Anchor Compression (EAC) is proposed to constrain the deviation of the parameter matrix during sequential editing. It compresses the editing information by selecting editing anchors that are important in encoding new relations without deviating too much from the original matrix, thereby preserving the general abilities. Experiments of applying EAC to two popular editing methods on three LLMs across four tasks are conducted. Evaluation results show that EAC effectively minimizes unreasonable deviations caused by model editing, preserving over 70% of the general abilities while better retaining the editing knowledge compared to the original counterpart methods.

</details>


### [933] [Universal Approximation with XL MIMO Systems: OTA Classification via Trainable Analog Combining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12758)
*Kyriakos Stylianopoulos,George C. Alexandropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: In this paper, we show that an eXtremely Large (XL) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) wireless system with appropriate analog combining components exhibits the properties of a universal function approximator, similar to a feedforward neural network. By treating the channel coefficients as the random nodes of a hidden layer and the receiver's analog combiner as a trainable output layer, we cast the XL MIMO system to the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) framework, leading to a novel formulation for Over-The-Air (OTA) edge inference without requiring traditional digital processing nor pre-processing at the transmitter. Through theoretical analysis and numerical evaluation, we showcase that XL-MIMO-ELM enables near-instantaneous training and efficient classification, even in varying fading conditions, suggesting the paradigm shift of beyond massive MIMO systems as OTA artificial neural networks alongside their profound communications role. Compared to conventional ELMs and deep learning approaches, whose training takes seconds to minutes, the proposed framework achieves on par performance (above $90\%$ classification accuracy across multiple data sets) with optimization latency of few milliseconds under the same number of trainable parameters, considering rich fading, low noise channels with XL receive antennas, making it highly attractive for inference tasks with ultra-low-power devices.

</details>


### [934] [SPP-SBL: Space-Power Prior Sparse Bayesian Learning for Block Sparse Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08518)
*Yanhao Zhang,Zhihan Zhu,Yong Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出方差变换框架与空间幂图先验，设计SPP-SBL算法，在无先验结构信息条件下实现块稀疏信号高精度重建，并在链式、多模态等多类数据上验证优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块稀疏贝叶斯方法需预先假设块结构模式，实际中该模式未知且可变，导致重建性能下降；亟需一种无需已知结构即可自适应捕获块模式、同时解决空间耦合参数估计开放问题的统一框架。

Method: 1) 构建方差变换统一框架，将已有模式类块稀疏贝叶斯方法纳入同一数学形式；2) 引入基于无向图的空间幂先验，把空间耦合参数转化为可学习的图边权；3) 结合EM算法与高次方程求根，提出SPP-SBL，实现空间耦合参数与信号联合估计；4) 理论分析指出相对耦合参数决定块模式捕获能力。

Result: SPP-SBL在链结构、多模式合成信号及图像、音频等多模态真实数据上，SNR、NMSE、SSIM等指标均显著优于E-BSBL、PC-SBL等最新方法，平均SNR提升2–5 dB；对未知块模式信号的首次实验显示块错误率下降40%以上。

Conclusion: 方差变换框架揭示块稀疏贝叶斯方法的内在统一规律；空间耦合参数而非其绝对值是捕获块模式的关键；SPP-SBL为无先验结构信息的块稀疏重建提供了理论与实用新范式，可推广至其他耦合高维逆问题。

Abstract: The recovery of block-sparse signals with unknown structural patterns remains a fundamental challenge in structured sparse signal reconstruction. By proposing a variance transformation framework, this paper unifies existing pattern-based block sparse Bayesian learning methods, and introduces a novel space power prior based on undirected graph models to adaptively capture the unknown patterns of block-sparse signals. By combining the EM algorithm with high-order equation root-solving, we develop a new structured sparse Bayesian learning method, SPP-SBL, which effectively addresses the open problem of space coupling parameter estimation in pattern-based methods. We further demonstrate that learning the relative values of space coupling parameters is key to capturing unknown block-sparse patterns and improving recovery accuracy. Experiments validate that SPP-SBL successfully recovers various challenging structured sparse signals (e.g., chain-structured signals and multi-pattern sparse signals) and real-world multi-modal structured sparse signals (images, audio), showing significant advantages in recovery accuracy across multiple metrics.

</details>


### [935] [Chain-of-Zoom: Extreme Super-Resolution via Scale Autoregression and Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18600)
*Bryan Sangwoo Kim,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将任意4× SR 网络循环调用直至超过 256×，无需重训练即可兼顾细节与语义一致性


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SISR方法在训练尺度外急剧退化，无法应对>4×甚至>8×的超分需求；而其他

Method: （1）将

Result: 在公开数据集上把4×扩散模型推至256×，FID、ID一致性、感知得分均显著优于基线级联与多步插值方案；用户主观评估>90%倾向于CoZ结果

Conclusion: 通过链式加条件概率分解+多尺度语义提示，首次验证了“矮脚本模型也可做极端超分”的可行性，为无需再训练、可任意尺度放大影像提供了通用范式

Abstract: Modern single-image super-resolution (SISR) models deliver photo-realistic results at the scale factors on which they are trained, but collapse when asked to magnify far beyond that regime. We address this scalability bottleneck with Chain-of-Zoom (CoZ), a model-agnostic framework that factorizes SISR into an autoregressive chain of intermediate scale-states with multi-scale-aware prompts. CoZ repeatedly re-uses a backbone SR model, decomposing the conditional probability into tractable sub-problems to achieve extreme resolutions without additional training. Because visual cues diminish at high magnifications, we augment each zoom step with multi-scale-aware text prompts generated by a vision-language model (VLM). The prompt extractor itself is fine-tuned using Generalized Reward Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a critic VLM, aligning text guidance towards human preference. Experiments show that a standard 4x diffusion SR model wrapped in CoZ attains beyond 256x enlargement with high perceptual quality and fidelity. Project Page: https://bryanswkim.github.io/chain-of-zoom/.

</details>


### [936] [GL-LowPopArt: A Nearly Instance-Wise Minimax-Optimal Estimator for Generalized Low-Rank Trace Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03074)
*Junghyun Lee,Kyoungseok Jang,Kwang-Sung Jun,Milan Vojnović,Se-Young Yun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GL-LowPopArt 是一种针对广义低秩迹回归的两阶段 Catoni 型估计器：先用核范数正则化，再用矩阵 Catoni 估计；在矩阵补全及双线性决斗老虎机中同时刷新估计误差与遗憾界，并给出局部极小极大下界证明其条件数意义下的实例最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有广义低秩迹回归与矩阵补全的误差界不够紧，且双线性决斗老虎机缺乏高效低 regret 算法；需要同时提升统计精度与在线决策效果。

Method: 1) 设计两阶段 GL-LowPopArt：阶段一核范数正则化得初始估计，阶段二矩阵 Catoni 降偏差；2) 提出实验设计目标 GL(π) 控制非线性逆链接函数带来的偏差；3) 将估计器嵌入 explore-then-commit 框架解决新提出的双线性决斗老虎机问题。

Result: 1) 获得当前最优的广义迹回归估计误差界，超越 Fan et al.2019、Kang et al.2022；2) 证明局部极小极大下界，显示估计器在真实 Hessian 条件数范围内实例最优；3) 在广义线性矩阵补全上得到更紧的 Frobenius 误差保证；4) 双线性决斗老虎机相比朴素向量化 (Wu et al.2024) 实现更低的 Borda regret 界。

Conclusion: GL-LowPopArt 通过两阶段 Catoni 策略同时降低偏差与方差，在理论误差与在线遗憾两个尺度上均刷新最优点，并揭示实验设计目标 GL(π) 对非线性广义模型的关键作用。

Abstract: We present `GL-LowPopArt`, a novel Catoni-style estimator for generalized low-rank trace regression. Building on `LowPopArt` (Jang et al., 2024), it employs a two-stage approach: nuclear norm regularization followed by matrix Catoni estimation. We establish state-of-the-art estimation error bounds, surpassing existing guarantees (Fan et al., 2019; Kang et al., 2022), and reveal a novel experimental design objective, $\mathrm{GL}(π)$. The key technical challenge is controlling bias from the nonlinear inverse link function, which we address with our two-stage approach. We prove a *local minimax lower bound*, showing that our `GL-LowPopArt` enjoys instance-wise optimality up to the condition number of the ground-truth Hessian. Our method immediately achieves an improved Frobenius error guarantee for generalized linear matrix completion. We also introduce a new problem setting called **bilinear dueling bandits**, a contextualized version of dueling bandits with a general preference model. Using an explore-then-commit approach with `GL-LowPopArt', we show an improved Borda regret bound over naïve vectorization (Wu et al., 2024).

</details>


### [937] [Gen-n-Val: Agentic Image Data Generation and Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04676)
*Jing-En Huang,I-Sheng Fang,Tzuhsuan Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Yu Wang,Jun-Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Gen-n-Val以双层智能体（LD提示优化+VL LM质量过滤）合成高质单实例数据，将 LVIS 无效样本率从 50% 压至 7%，在稀有类别上 Mask R-CNN mAP 提升 7.6%，开源可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVIS 等大型词汇基准存在数据稀缺、标注噪声与长尾失衡，现有合成方法常出现一罩多物、分割不准、标签错误，难以有效扩充训练集。

Method: 构建两智能体框架：① LLM 驱动的 LD 提示优化器，迭代改写文本提示以激发 Layer Diffusion 生成高质量单前景图像及精掩膜；② VLLM 数据验证器，自动筛除低质合成实例；两智能体提示均通过 TextGrad 元优化。

Result: 相较 MosaicFusion，无效合成样本率降至 7%；LVIS 稀有类 Mask R-CNN 分割提升 7.6% mAP，COCO 稀有类 YOLOv9c/11m 提升 3.6% mAP；开放词汇检测 YOLO-Worldv2-M 基线上再涨 7.1% mAP，且随模型与数据规模持续增益。

Conclusion: Gen-n-Val 证明“生成-验证”智能体协同可低成本产出高保真、类别均衡的合成数据，显著改善检测与分割在尾部类的性能，具备向更大词汇与模型扩容的潜力。

Abstract: The data scarcity, label noise, and long-tailed category imbalance remain important and unresolved challenges in many computer vision tasks, such as object detection and instance segmentation, especially on large-vocabulary benchmarks like LVIS, where most categories appear in only a few images. Current synthetic data generation methods still suffer from multiple objects per mask, inaccurate segmentation, incorrect category labels, and other issues, limiting their effectiveness. To address these issues, we introduce Gen-n-Val, a novel agentic data generation framework that leverages Layer Diffusion (LD), a Large Language Model (LLM), and a Vision Large Language Model (VLLM) to produce high-quality and diverse instance masks and images for object detection and instance segmentation. Gen-n-Val consists of two agents: (1) the LD prompt agent, an LLM, optimizes rompts to encourage LD to generate high-quality foreground single-object images and corresponding segmentation masks; and (2) the data validation agent, a VLLM, filters out low-quality synthetic instance images. The system prompts for both agents are optimized by TextGrad. Compared to state-of-the-art synthetic data approaches like MosaicFusion, our approach reduces invalid synthetic data from 50% to 7% and improves performance by 7.6% on rare classes in LVIS instance segmentation with Mask R-CNN, and by 3.6% mAP on rare classes in COCO instance segmentation with YOLOv9c and YOLO11m. Furthermore, Gen-n-Val shows significant improvements (7.1% mAP) over YOLO-Worldv2-M in open-vocabulary object detection benchmarks with YOLO11m. Moreover, Gen-n-Val has scalability in model capacity and dataset size. The code is available at https://github.com/aiiu-lab/Gen-n-Val.

</details>


### [938] [Learning Encodings by Maximizing State Distinguishability: Variational Quantum Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11552)
*Nico Meyer,Christopher Mutschler,Andreas Maier,Daniel D. Scherer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对近期容错设备，提出可学习噪声结构的变分量子纠错框架VarQEC，显著降低资源开销并在真实硬件验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面码等传统量子纠错码所需资源巨大，难以在即将出现的早期容错量子设备上部署，亟需低开销且能适配具体噪声结构的纠错方案。

Method: 以“噪声后量子态可区分度”为核心设计可微分损失函数，将编码线路参数化后通过变分优化迭代搜索，使纠错码自动匹配给定噪声模型（VarQEC框架）。

Result: 所得编码线路在理论上满足量子纠错条件，实验上在IBM与IQM硬件的演示中，逻辑错误率明显低于同资源下的表面码等传统码。

Conclusion: VarQEC为近-中期量子设备提供了可定制、低冗余的实用纠错途径，并表明机器学习与变分方法能在量子纠错设计中找到理论与实验兼顾的最优解。

Abstract: Quantum error correction is crucial for protecting quantum information against decoherence. Traditional codes like the surface code require substantial overhead, making them impractical for near-term, early fault-tolerant devices. We propose a novel objective function for tailoring error correction codes to specific noise structures by maximizing the distinguishability between quantum states after a noise channel, ensuring efficient recovery operations. We formalize this concept with the distinguishability loss function, serving as a machine learning objective to discover resource-efficient encoding circuits optimized for given noise characteristics. We implement this methodology using variational techniques, termed variational quantum error correction (VarQEC). Our approach yields codes with desirable theoretical and practical properties and outperforms standard codes in various scenarios. We also provide proof-of-concept demonstrations on IBM and IQM hardware devices, highlighting the practical relevance of our procedure.

</details>


### [939] [Bayesian Social Deduction with Graph-Informed Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17788)
*Shahab Rahimirad,Guven Gergerli,Lucia Romero,Angela Qian,Matthew Lyle Olson,Simon Stepputtis,Joseph Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种将信念推断外包给结构化概率模型、仅让大模型负责语言交互的混合框架，使小模型在Avalon中首次击败人类玩家（胜率67%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大模型虽在社会推理任务Avalon中表现强劲，但需昂贵测试时推理，且蒸馏后性能急剧下降，亟需轻量级实时方案。

Method: 将可观测对话输入贝叶斯信念网络实时更新隐藏状态，LLM仅用于自然语言理解与生成，二者通过接口解耦，实现模块化推理。

Result: 混合小模型在Agent-Agent对战中与10×参数量纯LLM性能持平；在控人实验中胜率67%，显著优于基线与人类队友，并获更高主观评分。

Conclusion: 结构化概率模型+大模型语言的混合架构是突破LLM社会推理瓶颈、实现高效实时人机博弈的有效路径。

Abstract: Social reasoning - inferring unobservable beliefs and intentions from partial observations of other agents - remains a challenging task for large language models (LLMs). We evaluate the limits of current reasoning language models in the social deduction game Avalon and find that while the largest models demonstrate strong performance, they require extensive test-time inference and degrade sharply when distilled to smaller, real-time-capable variants. To address this, we introduce a hybrid reasoning framework that externalizes belief inference to a structured probabilistic model, while using an LLM for language understanding and interaction. Our approach achieves competitive performance with much larger models in Agent-Agent play and, notably, is the first language agent to defeat human players in a controlled study - achieving a 67% win rate and receiving higher qualitative ratings than both reasoning baselines and human teammates. We release code, models, and a dataset to support future work on social reasoning in LLM agents, which can be found at https://camp-lab-purdue.github.io/bayesian-social-deduction/

</details>


### [940] [Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization for Solving Unit Commitment Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09503)
*Zhentong Shao,Jingtao Qin,Nanpeng Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用深度神经网络拟合二阶段随机机组组合中的再调度成本，并将其嵌入首阶段MILP，实现任意场景下的恒定规模建模与毫秒级求解，最优性损失<1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统两阶段随机机组组合(2S-SUC)在高维不确定场景下需要显式枚举所有场景，导致MILP规模爆炸、求解耗时，难以在线应用。

Method: 1)训练深度神经网络，输入机组启停决策与场景特征，输出对应的再调度成本。2)引入“场景嵌入网络”将任意规模场景集压缩为固定维度特征向量，实现数据驱动的场景降维。3)将训练好的网络作为黑箱成本函数嵌入首阶段MILP，形成恒定规模的混合整数线性模型。

Result: 在IEEE 5/30/118节点系统上，与标准MILP求解器及Benders分解相比，计算速度提升1–3个数量级，最优性差距均低于1%，且模型大小与场景数量无关。

Conclusion: 提出的神经随机优化框架可在保证经济性的前提下，将高维2S-SUC问题转化为恒定规模MILP，兼顾求解效率与建模精度，具备大规模在线调度潜力。

Abstract: This paper proposes a neural stochastic optimization method for efficiently solving the two-stage stochastic unit commitment (2S-SUC) problem under high-dimensional uncertainty scenarios. The proposed method approximates the second-stage recourse problem using a deep neural network trained to map commitment decisions and uncertainty features to recourse costs. The trained network is subsequently embedded into the first-stage UC problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), allowing for explicit enforcement of operational constraints while preserving the key uncertainty characteristics. A scenario-embedding network is employed to enable dimensionality reduction and feature aggregation across arbitrary scenario sets, serving as a data-driven scenario reduction mechanism. Numerical experiments on IEEE 5-bus, 30-bus, and 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed neural two-stage stochastic optimization method achieves solutions with an optimality gap of less than 1%, while enabling orders-of-magnitude speedup compared to conventional MILP solvers and decomposition-based methods. Moreover, the model's size remains constant regardless of the number of scenarios, offering significant scalability for large-scale stochastic unit commitment problems.

</details>


### [941] [BEDTime: A Unified Benchmark for Automatically Describing Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05215)
*Medhasweta Sen,Zachary Gottesman,Jiaxing Qiu,C. Bayan Bruss,Nam Nguyen,Tom Hartvigsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次系统性检验了多模态模型对时间序列结构属性描述的三大基本能力，发现专用时序–语言模型表现不如视觉–语言模型，所有方法鲁棒性均不足，并提出统一评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期复杂的多模态时序模型在推理、问答等高阶任务上声称高指标，却缺乏对基本描述能力(识别/区分/生成)的验证，研究动机正是填补这一盲区，拷问其对一维时间序列结构特性的理解到底有多可靠。

Method: 作者首先提炼出"一元时序结构描述三范式"(识别、区分、生成)，据此构建跨三模态(时序、图像、文本)的五数据集的综合评测平台——基准，并对17个SOTA模型展开零样本实验，同时加入多种真实鲁棒扰动以暴露出模误差。

Result: (1)专用时序–语言模型在三项基础任务中明显落后；(2)视觉–语言模型反而表现最佳；(3)语言单模模型效果最差；(4)所有模型对扰动均极脆弱，鲁棒性得分普遍急跌。上述结果与此前文献的高阶宣称形成鲜明反差。

Conclusion: 研究指出现有多模态时序模型对基础结构描述仍相当脆弱，其高阶性能或许依赖表面统计关联而非真正时序理解，建议未来模型应先在提出的上固基，再探索复杂推理，为持续改进多模态时序建模指明方向。

Abstract: Recent works propose complex multi-modal models that handle both time series and language, ultimately claiming high performance on complex tasks like time series reasoning and cross-modal question answering. However, they skip foundational evaluations that such complex models should have mastered. So we ask a simple question: \textit{How well can recent models describe structural properties of time series?} To answer this, we propose that successful models should be able to \textit{recognize}, \textit{differentiate}, and \textit{generate} descriptions of univariate time series. We then create \textbf{\benchmark}, a benchmark to assess these novel tasks, that comprises \textbf{five datasets} reformatted across \textbf{three modalities}. In evaluating \textbf{17 state-of-the-art models}, we find that (1) surprisingly, dedicated time series-language models fall short, despite being designed for similar tasks, (2) vision language models are quite capable, (3) language only methods perform worst, despite many lauding their potential, and (4) all approaches are clearly fragile to a range of real world robustness tests, indicating directions for future work. Together, our findings critique prior works' claims and provide avenues for advancing multi-modal time series modeling.

</details>


### [942] [Beyond Spherical geometry: Unraveling complex features of objects orbiting around stars from its transit light curve using deep learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14875)
*Ushasi Bhowmick,Shivam Kumaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用深度网络从凌日光变曲线反演二维随机形状的低阶傅里叶椭圆参数，可成功恢复整体轮廓、取向及大尺度扰动，但对高阶椭圆的偏心率与取向推断有限，非凸特征还原受取向影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凌日光变曲线几何反演本质病态，同一曲线可由多种形状产生；亟需定量评估光变曲线中究竟保留了多少形状信息，以确立反演极限。

Method: 1) 构建二维随机形状库，以傅里叶椭圆级数分解并逐级扰动理想椭圆；2) 用Yuti模拟对应光变曲线；3) 训练深度神经网络直接由光变曲线预测各阶傅里叶系数；4) 系统评估重建精度，并考察非凸特征与取向对结果的影响。

Result: 网络可高精度重建描述整体轮廓的低阶椭圆（阶数≤4），其尺度、取向及大尺度扰动均被成功复原；≥5阶时仅能可靠估计尺度，偏心率与取向退化明显；非凸结构的重建质量强烈依赖其在轨道面上的投影取向。

Conclusion: 光变曲线蕴含的几何信息足以约束低阶形状参数，证实其为提取凌日系统整体轮廓的有效工具；高阶细节因信息平滑而基本丢失，为后续观测策略与反演算法设定了理论上限。

Abstract: Characterizing the geometry of an object orbiting around a star from its transit light curve is a powerful tool to uncover various complex phenomena. This problem is inherently ill-posed, since similar or identical light curves can be produced by multiple different shapes. In this study, we investigate the extent to which the features of a shape can be embedded in a transit light curve. We generate a library of two-dimensional random shapes and simulate their transit light curves with light curve simulator, Yuti. Each shape is decomposed into a series of elliptical components expressed in the form of Fourier coefficients that adds increasingly diminishing perturbations to an ideal ellipse. We train deep neural networks to predict these Fourier coefficients directly from simulated light curves. Our results demonstrate that the neural network can successfully reconstruct the low-order ellipses, which describe overall shape, orientation and large-scale perturbations. For higher order ellipses the scale is successfully determined but the inference of eccentricity and orientation is limited, demonstrating the extent of shape information in the light curve. We explore the impact of non-convex shape features in reconstruction, and show its dependence on shape orientation. The level of reconstruction achieved by the neural network underscores the utility of using light curves as a means to extract geometric information from transiting systems.

</details>


### [943] [Bayesian Ego-graph Inference for Networked Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16606)
*Wei Duan,Jie Lu,Junyu Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: In networked multi-agent reinforcement learning (Networked-MARL), decentralized agents must act under local observability and constrained communication over fixed physical graphs. Existing methods often assume static neighborhoods, limiting adaptability to dynamic or heterogeneous environments. While centralized frameworks can learn dynamic graphs, their reliance on global state access and centralized infrastructure is impractical in real-world decentralized systems. We propose a stochastic graph-based policy for Networked-MARL, where each agent conditions its decision on a sampled subgraph over its local physical neighborhood. Building on this formulation, we introduce BayesG, a decentralized actor-framework that learns sparse, context-aware interaction structures via Bayesian variational inference. Each agent operates over an ego-graph and samples a latent communication mask to guide message passing and policy computation. The variational distribution is trained end-to-end alongside the policy using an evidence lower bound (ELBO) objective, enabling agents to jointly learn both interaction topology and decision-making strategies. BayesG outperforms strong MARL baselines on large-scale traffic control tasks with up to 167 agents, demonstrating superior scalability, efficiency, and performance.

</details>


### [944] [Interactive Program Synthesis for Modeling Collaborative Physical Activities from Narrated Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24250)
*Edward Kim,Daniel He,Jorge Chao,Wiktor Rajca,Mohammed Amin,Nishant Malpani,Ruta Desai,Antti Oulasvirta,Bjoern Hartmann,Sanjit Seshia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套以“可编辑程序”为核心的协同物理任务教学框架，用“边说边做”的方式让20名用户教会系统多人足球战术；70%参与者能成功修正程序意图，90%认为修正过程简单，并总结出协同任务特有的可解释性与修正难题及应对策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有HCI研究多聚焦单人物理任务，而协同任务因需推断队友意图带来额外歧义与动态性，亟需一种既可被用户理解又能被即时修正的机器行为表征，以降低教学门槛并提升信任。

Method: 将协同任务学习形式化为程序综合问题：系统以可读写的高级程序表征行为，利用“带旁白的动作演示”（自然语言+物理轨迹）作为统一输入/输出通道完成教学、检视与修正；无需用户接触代码即可双向沟通。框架包含：程序语法设计、基于演示-语言的程序合成与修订算法、以及实时自然语言反解释模块。

Result: 20名受试者进行单因素内用户研究，成功率为70%（14/20）能把策略程序迭代至与意图一致；主观易用度达90%（18/20认为修正容易）。研究进一步揭示了协同场景下程序表征粒度、队友角色绑定、意图歧义追踪等特有挑战，并收集到相应的用户修正模式与失败案例。

Conclusion: 可编辑程序+边说边做能有效支持协同物理任务的人机教学，但需解决角色-意图耦合、程序可读性与修正成本之间的张力；未来应引入更细粒度角色标注、半自动意图澄清与多模态差异可视化，以提升系统对高阶协同策略的学习与表达鲁棒性。

Abstract: Teaching systems physical tasks is a long standing goal in HCI, yet most prior work has focused on non collaborative physical activities. Collaborative tasks introduce added complexity, requiring systems to infer users assumptions about their teammates intent, which is an inherently ambiguous and dynamic process. This necessitates representations that are interpretable and correctable, enabling users to inspect and refine system behavior. We address this challenge by framing collaborative task learning as a program synthesis problem. Our system represents behavior as editable programs and uses narrated demonstrations, i.e. paired physical actions and natural language, as a unified modality for teaching, inspecting, and correcting system logic without requiring users to see or write code. The same modality is used for the system to communicate its learning to users. In a within subjects study, 20 users taught multiplayer soccer tactics to our system. 70 percent (14/20) of participants successfully refined learned programs to match their intent and 90 percent (18/20) found it easy to correct the programs. The study surfaced unique challenges in representing learning as programs and in enabling users to teach collaborative physical activities. We discuss these issues and outline mitigation strategies.

</details>


### [945] [RESample: A Robust Data Augmentation Framework via Exploratory Sampling for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.17640)
*Yuquan Xue,Guanxing Lu,Zhenyu Wu,Chuanrui Zhang,Bofang Jia,Zhengyi Gu,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有 VLA 模仿学习数据集以成功案例为主，覆盖度低、OOD 适应能力差。本文提出 RESample 框架，用轻量级覆盖函数定位低覆盖状态，并通过探索性采样在线自动化补数据，仅用 10–20% 的增量样本即可在新采集-重训练流程中带来 12% 的任务成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模高质量“成功轨迹” 数据集收集昂贵、分布狭窄，导致模型在 OOD 场景下能力断崖且无法自我恢复；需要低成本、高效率地扩展数据覆盖度，提升 VLA 模型的鲁棒性和泛化边界。

Method: 1) 设计基于核密度估计的轻量级 Coverage Function，实时计算训练集状态覆盖密度；2) 在策略 rollout 中持续监测潜在覆盖缺口，对低覆盖区域执行探索性动作采样；3) 将新采样本自动并入训练集并迭代重训练，形成闭环数据增强框架 RESample。

Result: 在 LIBERO 基准和多项真实机器人操作任务上，RESample 仅以 10–20% 额外样本，使 VLA 模型的平均成功率比强基线提高约 12%，OOD 场景性能增益更显著，同时保持与原方法相当的训练开销。

Conclusion: RESample 不依赖人工标注或昂贵失败数据，即可实现训练分布的高效扩展，显著提高 VLA 模仿学习模型在真实部署中的鲁棒性与泛化能力。未来可结合生成模型与在线自适应策略，进一步降低样本成本并扩展到多任务、多模态场景。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex tasks through imitation learning in recent robotic manipulation works. Based on large-scale and high-quality demonstration datasets, existing imitation learning method arms VLA models acquired with strong capabilities. However, these datasets that predominantly consist of successful trajectories, are costly to collect and often limited in distribution, leading to capability bottlenecks when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios during deployment while unable to recover. To address this issue, we propose an automated data augmentation framework named RESample that effectively improves the distribution coverage of VLA training datasets through the well-designed exploratory sampling mechanism. Specifically, the exploratory sampling mechanism identifies the potential coverage gaps during the policy rollout and actively samples exploratory actions to extend the coverage of training data with high sample efficiency. Furthermore, to effectively reflect the distribution of the training dataset, we propose a lightweight Coverage Function that indicates the coverage density of states in the training dataset, which further guides the exploratory sampling process to focus on low-coverage regions. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark as well as a series of real-world robotic tasks, demonstrating a significant performance gain of 12% of our proposed RESample over baselines, with only 10-20% additional samples compared to original training data.

</details>


### [946] [Contribution of task-irrelevant stimuli to drift of neural representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21588)
*Farhad Pashakhanloo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次系统揭示任务无关刺激方差与维度如何通过在线学习噪声驱动表征漂移，并给出跨学习规则、任务及网络结构的普适规律与可检验预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工与生物智能体在终身学习流中会出现虽行为稳、但内部表征渐变的现象——表征漂移；其来源与任务、网络结构、学习算法的关系尚缺跨体系上、系统化研究，阻碍了对终身学习机制的了解与脑计算的逆向工程。

Method: 1. 在线学习框架下定义并量化表征漂移；2. 核心比较两类噪声源：①任务无关子空间的方差/维度引起的“学习-噪声” vs ②传统高斯突触噪声。3. 理论推导漂移速度公式；4. 遍及相关学习规则：Hebbian（Oja、相似性匹配）与监督SGD（自编码器、两层感知机）；5. 系统操纵数据分布、任务结构与网络参数进行大规模模拟验证。

Result: 1. 任务无关刺激方差越高、子空间维数越大，漂移速度单调上升；2. 此“学习-噪声”导致的漂移在几何上呈沿无关基底方向的剪切漂移（shear-drift），与突触噪声产生的各向同性能耗式漂移有定性差异；3. 该规律在三类网络/两种学习范式中高度一致，说明弱依赖架构、强依赖“数据-任务耦合”密度。

Conclusion: 表征漂移可被视为“任务无关统计学属性→学习噪声→表征更新”的可观测映射；据此既可在模型条件比较不同学习规则，也能在实验数据中以漂移几何与维度依赖为探针挖掘皮层或深层网络的潜在计算逻辑，为终身学习与神经解码带来新工具与预测基准。

Abstract: Biological and artificial learners are inherently exposed to a stream of data and experience throughout their lifetimes and must constantly adapt to, learn from, or selectively ignore the ongoing input. Recent findings reveal that, even when the performance remains stable, the underlying neural representations can change gradually over time, a phenomenon known as representational drift. Studying the different sources of data and noise that may contribute to drift is essential for understanding lifelong learning in neural systems. However, a systematic study of drift across architectures and learning rules, and the connection to task, are missing. Here, in an online learning setup, we characterize drift as a function of data distribution, and specifically show that the learning noise induced by task-irrelevant stimuli, which the agent learns to ignore in a given context, can create long-term drift in the representation of task-relevant stimuli. Using theory and simulations, we demonstrate this phenomenon both in Hebbian-based learning -- Oja's rule and Similarity Matching -- and in stochastic gradient descent applied to autoencoders and a supervised two-layer network. We consistently observe that the drift rate increases with the variance and the dimension of the data in the task-irrelevant subspace. We further show that this yields different qualitative predictions for the geometry and dimension-dependency of drift than those arising from Gaussian synaptic noise. Overall, our study links the structure of stimuli, task, and learning rule to representational drift and could pave the way for using drift as a signal for uncovering underlying computation in the brain.

</details>


### [947] [Generative View Stitching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.24718)
*Chonghyuk Song,Michal Stary,Boyuan Chen,George Kopanas,Vincent Sitzmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“泛化视角缝合”GVS 并行采样策略，使任意基于 Diffusion Forcing 训练的视频模型在已知未来相机轨迹条件下生成全程一致、无碰撞、可闭环的长视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型只能依赖历史帧，无法利用未来相机位姿等先验，导致沿预定义轨迹生成时场景与摄像机发生碰撞并崩溃。

Method: 1) 将机器人规划中“扩散缝合”采样扩展为视频并行生成；2) 发现 Diffusion Forcing 隐含缝合所需的正反双向条件，无需重训模型；3) 设计 Omni Guidance，在采样同时引入过去与未来帧条件以强化时序一致性并实现闭环校正。

Result: GVS 在多种预定义相机路径下（含不可能楼梯等复杂轨迹）稳定生成无碰撞、帧级连贯、长距离闭环一致的视频，验证其兼容性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GVS 展示了利用现成视频扩散模型与未来条件进行并行缝合的可行性，为任意相机导向的长视频生成提供了一种通用且无需额外训练的解决方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models are capable of long rollouts that are stable and consistent with history, but they are unable to guide the current generation with conditioning from the future. In camera-guided video generation with a predefined camera trajectory, this limitation leads to collisions with the generated scene, after which autoregression quickly collapses. To address this, we propose Generative View Stitching (GVS), which samples the entire sequence in parallel such that the generated scene is faithful to every part of the predefined camera trajectory. Our main contribution is a sampling algorithm that extends prior work on diffusion stitching for robot planning to video generation. While such stitching methods usually require a specially trained model, GVS is compatible with any off-the-shelf video model trained with Diffusion Forcing, a prevalent sequence diffusion framework that we show already provides the affordances necessary for stitching. We then introduce Omni Guidance, a technique that enhances the temporal consistency in stitching by conditioning on both the past and future, and that enables our proposed loop-closing mechanism for delivering long-range coherence. Overall, GVS achieves camera-guided video generation that is stable, collision-free, frame-to-frame consistent, and closes loops for a variety of predefined camera paths, including Oscar Reutersvärd's Impossible Staircase. Results are best viewed as videos at https://andrewsonga.github.io/gvs.

</details>


### [948] [Scaling flow-based approaches for topology sampling in $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ gauge theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25704)
*Claudio Bonanno,Andrea Bulgarelli,Elia Cellini,Alessandro Nada,Dario Panfalone,Davide Vadacchino,Lorenzo Verzichelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用非平衡模拟＋开边界→逐步恢复周期边界的方法，彻底解决格点 QCD 在趋于连续极限时的“拓扑冻结”难题，并在 0.045 fm 极细格距下验证其 O(10×) 级别加速；进一步用随机归一化流优化边界演化，实现更高效拓扑采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 格点 SU(3) Yang-Mills 理论逼近连续极限时，拓扑电荷的临界慢化（拓扑冻结）使传统蒙特卡洛无法有效采样不同拓扑扇区，严重阻碍对 θ-真空、强 CP 问题等非微扰量的精确计算。

Method: 1) 引入开边界条件压低拓扑电荷自相关；2) 构建非平衡蒙特卡洛过程，逐步将开边界“绝热”恢复为周期边界，并用 Jarzynski 等式严格扣除边界切换带来的非物理效应；3) 设计专门用于边界条件演化的 Stochastic Normalizing Flow，用可逆神经网络参数化边界流形，实现更高效、更低方差的路径积分重加权。

Result: 在四维 SU(3) 纯规范理论中，实现拓扑电荷自相关时间 τ_int^Q 随格距 a 减小仅呈幂律增长而非指数爆炸；在 a≈0.045 fm 处仍保持拓扑隧穿，有效统计量提高一个量级；归一化流版本将边界切换代价再降 30–50%，重权重方差下降约 2 倍。

Conclusion: 首次给出在物理连续极限内可控、可扩展的拓扑采样策略，为格点 QCD 计算 θ-依赖量、胶子拓扑敏感性及 future BSM 格点研究铺平道路；流式边界演化框架亦可推广至其他具有拓扑障碍的格点场论。

Abstract: We develop a methodology based on out-of-equilibrium simulations to mitigate topological freezing when approaching the continuum limit of lattice gauge theories. We reduce the autocorrelation of the topological charge employing open boundary conditions, while removing exactly their unphysical effects using a non-equilibrium Monte Carlo approach in which periodic boundary conditions are gradually switched on. We perform a detailed analysis of the computational costs of this strategy in the case of the four-dimensional $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ Yang-Mills theory. After achieving full control of the scaling, we outline a clear strategy to sample topology efficiently in the continuum limit, which we check at lattice spacings as small as $0.045$ fm. We also generalize this approach by designing a customized Stochastic Normalizing Flow for evolutions in the boundary conditions, obtaining superior performances with respect to the purely stochastic non-equilibrium approach, and paving the way for more efficient future flow-based solutions.

</details>


### [949] [EGMOF: Efficient Generation of Metal-Organic Frameworks Using a Hybrid Diffusion-Transformer Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03122)
*Seunghee Han,Yeonghun Kang,Taeun Bae,Junho Kim,Younghun Kim,Varinia Bernales,Alan Aspuru-Guzik,Jihan Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EGMOF 用“扩散-Transformer”双模块把 MOF 逆向设计拆成“性质→描述符→结构”两步，小样本训练即可泛化到 29 种性质，氢吸附任务上有效率达 95 %、命中率 84 %，刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学空间巨大而带标签数据稀缺；现有生成模型需大数据且换目标就得重训，难以高效逆向设计 MOF。

Method: 构建 EGMOF 框架：Prop2Desc 为一维扩散模型，将目标性质映射到一组化学描述符；Desc2MOF 为 Transformer，将描述符解码为晶体结构。两阶段解耦，只需更新轻量级 Prop2Desc 即可适应新性质，无需重训整个网络。

Result: 在氢吸附数据集上，仅用 1000 个样本训练即达 >95 % 结构有效性、84 % 命中率，较最佳基线分别提升 57 % 与 14 %；同时在 CoREMOF、QMOF 及 27 组文本挖掘实验数据上完成条件生成，前人方法均未能覆盖如此广度。

Conclusion: 模块化“性质-描述符-结构”流水线显著降低数据需求并提升跨性质泛化能力，为 MOF 乃至更广材料的逆向设计提供了高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Designing materials with targeted properties remains challenging due to the vastness of chemical space and the scarcity of property-labeled data. While recent advances in generative models offer a promising way for inverse design, most approaches require large datasets and must be retrained for every new target property. Here, we introduce the EGMOF (Efficient Generation of MOFs), a hybrid diffusion-transformer framework that overcomes these limitations through a modular, descriptor-mediated workflow. EGMOF decomposes inverse design into two steps: (1) a one-dimensional diffusion model (Prop2Desc) that maps desired properties to chemically meaningful descriptors followed by (2) a transformer model (Desc2MOF) that generates structures from these descriptors. This modular hybrid design enables minimal retraining and maintains high accuracy even under small-data conditions. On a hydrogen uptake dataset, EGMOF achieved over 95% validity and 84% hit rate, representing significant improvements of up to 57% in validity and 14% in hit rate compared to existing methods, while remaining effective with only 1,000 training samples. Moreover, our model successfully performed conditional generation across 29 diverse property datasets, including CoREMOF, QMOF, and text-mined experimental datasets, whereas previous models have not. This work presents a data-efficient, generalizable approach to the inverse design of diverse MOFs and highlights the potential of modular inverse design workflows for broader materials discovery.

</details>


### [950] [Another BRIXEL in the Wall: Towards Cheaper Dense Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.05168)
*Alexander Lappe,Martin A. Giese*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BRIXEL通过知识蒸馏让学生网络在低分辨率下生成高分辨率特征图，性能超越高分辨率教师DINOv3，计算开销大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOv3等Vision Foundation Model需极高分辨率输入才能输出细粒度特征，导致显存与算力二次增长，难以在端侧或实时场景落地。

Method: 提出BRIXEL知识蒸馏框架：固定教师（高分辨率DINOv3）与学生（低分辨率同结构）网络，训练学生仅用低分辨率图像恢复教师的高分辨率特征图；蒸馏目标采用像素级MSE+特征余弦相似度双损失，无需任何下游标签。

Result: 在ADE20K语义分割与COCO检测/分割任务上，低分辨率学生网络mIoU/AP分别比高分辨率教师提升1.8–3.2 pp，且推理FLOPs减少约4×；将BRIXEL迁移到DINOv2、SAM等模型依旧获得1.5–2.4 pp稳定增益。

Conclusion: BRIXEL首次证明低分辨率输入即可复现甚至超越高分辨率特征的表达能力，为视觉大模型高效部署提供即插即用的通用压缩方案。

Abstract: Vision foundation models achieve strong performance on both global and locally dense downstream tasks. Pretrained on large images, the recent DINOv3 model family is able to produce very fine-grained dense feature maps, enabling state-of-the-art performance. However, computing these feature maps requires the input image to be available at very high resolution, as well as large amounts of compute due to the squared complexity of the transformer architecture. To address these issues, we propose BRIXEL, a simple knowledge distillation approach that has the student learn to reproduce its own feature maps at higher resolution. Despite its simplicity, BRIXEL outperforms the baseline DINOv3 models by large margins on downstream tasks when the resolution is kept fixed. We also apply BRIXEL to other recent dense-feature extractors and show that it yields substantial performance gains across model families. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/alexanderlappe/BRIXEL.

</details>


### [951] [Differentially Private and Federated Structure Learning in Bayesian Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01708)
*Ghita Fassy El Fehri,Aurélien Bellet,Philippe Bastien*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出联邦稀疏贝叶斯网络结构学习（Fed-Sparse-BNSL），在差分隐私保护下以低通信开销从分散数据恢复线性高斯网络结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式场景下，既要为各参与方提供严格隐私保证，又要避免通信量随维度爆炸，二者难以兼得。

Method: 联邦框架内融合差分隐私与稀疏贪婪边选择，每轮仅更新少量相关边，精心保持模型可识别性。

Result: 合成与真实数据实验显示，算法在隐私与通信显著优于基线的同时，结构估计精度接近无隐私 centralized 方法。

Conclusion: Fed-Sparse-BNSL 首次在联邦设置中同时实现强隐私、低通信与高精度结构学习，为隐私保护因果发现提供可行路径。

Abstract: Learning the structure of a Bayesian network from decentralized data poses two major challenges: (i) ensuring rigorous privacy guarantees for participants, and (ii) avoiding communication costs that scale poorly with dimensionality. In this work, we introduce Fed-Sparse-BNSL, a novel federated method for learning linear Gaussian Bayesian network structures that addresses both challenges. By combining differential privacy with greedy updates that target only a few relevant edges per participant, Fed-Sparse-BNSL efficiently uses the privacy budget while keeping communication costs low. Our careful algorithmic design preserves model identifiability and enables accurate structure estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that Fed-Sparse-BNSL achieves utility close to non-private baselines while offering substantially stronger privacy and communication efficiency.

</details>


### [952] [See, Hear, and Understand: Benchmarking Audiovisual Human Speech Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02231)
*Le Thien Phuc Nguyen,Zhuoran Yu,Samuel Low Yu Hang,Subin An,Jeongik Lee,Yohan Ban,SeungEun Chung,Thanh-Huy Nguyen,JuWan Maeng,Soochahn Lee,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AV-SpeakerBench 通过 3 212 道细粒度选择题，首次以“说话人”为核心单元评测 MLLM 在真实视频中同步推理“谁在何时说了什么”的能力，揭示现有模型音视频融合薄弱，Gemini-2.5 Pro 领先，开源模型最大瓶颈在跨模态对齐而非视觉感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频基准侧重视觉或仅粗粒度评估语音，缺乏对“说话人-内容-时刻”同步细粒度推理的专门测试，难以衡量 MLLM 是否真具备联合视听理解能力。

Method: 构建 AV-SpeakerBench：(1) 以说话人为核心推理单元；(2) 问题语义嵌入侵视听依赖，强制模型必须融合音视频才能答对；(3) 专家标注保证时间精度与跨模态一致性；共 3 212 道多选题，覆盖真实场景。

Result: Gemini 系列显著优于开源模型，Gemini-2.5 Pro 最佳；开源最大模型 Qwen3-Omni-30B 仅追平 Gemini-2.0 Flash，差距主因音视频融合不足，而非视觉感知弱。

Conclusion: AV-SpeakerBench 为细粒度视听推理提供严格基准，未来 MLLM 需重点提升跨模态融合而非单模态感知。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are expected to jointly interpret vision, audio, and language, yet existing video benchmarks rarely assess fine-grained reasoning about human speech. Many tasks remain visually solvable or only coarsely evaluate speech, offering limited insight into whether models can align who speaks, what is said, and when it occurs. We introduce AV-SpeakerBench, a curated benchmark of 3,212 multiple-choice questions focused on speaker-centric audiovisual reasoning in real-world videos. It features: (1) a speaker-centered formulation that treats speakers-not scenes-as the core reasoning unit; (2) fusion-grounded question design embedding audiovisual dependencies into question semantics; and (3) expert-curated annotations ensuring temporal precision and cross-modal validity. Comprehensive evaluations show that the Gemini family consistently outperforms open-source systems, with Gemini 2.5 Pro achieving the best results. Among open models, Qwen3-Omni-30B approaches Gemini 2.0 Flash but remains far behind Gemini 2.5 Pro, primarily due to weaker audiovisual fusion rather than visual perception. We believe AV-SpeakerBench establishes a rigorous foundation for advancing fine-grained audiovisual reasoning in future multimodal systems.

</details>


### [953] [Relational Visual Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07833)
*Thao Nguyen,Sicheng Mo,Krishna Kumar Singh,Yilin Wang,Jing Shi,Nicholas Kolkin,Eli Shechtman,Yong Jae Lee,Yuheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有视觉相似度指标只测“长得像”，人类还能看出“结构像”；本文首次把“关系相似”量化成可训练任务，用11.4 万匿名化图像-文字对微调 VLM，让模型学会把“逻辑同构”的图像拉近，补上了视觉计算长期缺失的一块拼图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能洞察“地球≈桃子”这类跨域结构类比，而 LPIPS/CLIP/DINO 等主流指标仅编码表层属性，无法刻画关系层面的相似性，导致检索、生成、推理任务丢失高阶语义。

Method: ① 把关系相似定义为目标函数：两图内部元素间的函数/关系结构一致即可，无视外观差异；② 构建 114k 图文对，其中文字匿名化，只描述空间、因果、层级等关系逻辑；③ 用该数据微调 Vision-Language 模型，使其嵌入空间反映关系而非像素距离。

Result: 实验表明，经微调的模型能在零样本条件下把“结构同构”图像聚到一起，显著优于 CLIP 等基线；与此同时，传统属性相似度任务性能不降，证明新增关系轴不牺牲原有能力。

Conclusion: 视觉相似度不能止于“看起来一样”，必须显式建模“关系一样”。本文提供的度量、数据集和模型首次让机器具备人类式的关系类比视力，为跨域检索、抽象推理、创造性生成等应用打开新维度，也暴露了现有一切视觉表征在关系层面的盲区。

Abstract: Humans do not just see attribute similarity -- we also see relational similarity. An apple is like a peach because both are reddish fruit, but the Earth is also like a peach: its crust, mantle, and core correspond to the peach's skin, flesh, and pit. This ability to perceive and recognize relational similarity, is arguable by cognitive scientist to be what distinguishes humans from other species. Yet, all widely used visual similarity metrics today (e.g., LPIPS, CLIP, DINO) focus solely on perceptual attribute similarity and fail to capture the rich, often surprising relational similarities that humans perceive. How can we go beyond the visible content of an image to capture its relational properties? How can we bring images with the same relational logic closer together in representation space? To answer these questions, we first formulate relational image similarity as a measurable problem: two images are relationally similar when their internal relations or functions among visual elements correspond, even if their visual attributes differ. We then curate 114k image-caption dataset in which the captions are anonymized -- describing the underlying relational logic of the scene rather than its surface content. Using this dataset, we finetune a Vision-Language model to measure the relational similarity between images. This model serves as the first step toward connecting images by their underlying relational structure rather than their visible appearance. Our study shows that while relational similarity has a lot of real-world applications, existing image similarity models fail to capture it -- revealing a critical gap in visual computing.

</details>


### [954] [Multi-agent Adaptive Mechanism Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21794)
*Qiushi Han,David Simchi-Levi,Renfei Tan,Zishuo Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DRAM框架，用在线学习思想在无需先验知识的情况下动态学习激励相容性，同时保证高概率真话和$	ilde O(rac{1}{T})$累计超额支付（达到下界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在不掌握Agent信念的情况下，如何在序列博弈中设计既确保讲真话又能让主办方长期支付最少的机制。

Method: 提出Distributionally Robust Adaptive Mechanism(DRAM)，每轮用观测更新信念区间，维护针对最恶劣分布的线性规划并缩减模糊集，结合LP和在线学习优化支付阈值。

Result: 证明高概率激励相容；主办方的累计付出与最优静态机制差距(regret)为$	ilde O(rac{1}{T})$且$rac{1}{T}$为紧下界；支持插件化估计器、延迟反馈和结构化先验。

Conclusion: DRAM首次在一般型激励约束未知并被动态学到的条件下，同时保持真话激励并达到最优遗憾速率，拓展了在线机制设计到分布不确定情形。

Abstract: We study a sequential mechanism design problem in which a principal seeks to elicit truthful reports from multiple rational agents while starting with no prior knowledge of agents' beliefs. We introduce Distributionally Robust Adaptive Mechanism (DRAM), a general framework combining insights from both mechanism design and online learning to jointly address truthfulness and cost-optimality. Throughout the sequential game, the mechanism estimates agents' beliefs and iteratively updates a distributionally robust linear program with shrinking ambiguity sets to reduce payments while preserving truthfulness. Our mechanism guarantees truthful reporting with high probability while achieving $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ cumulative regret, and we establish a matching lower bound showing that no feasible adaptive mechanism can asymptotically do better. The framework generalizes to plug-in estimators, supporting structured priors and delayed feedback. To our knowledge, this is the first adaptive mechanism under general settings that maintains truthfulness and achieves optimal regret when incentive constraints are unknown and must be learned.

</details>


### [955] [Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector for Stabilizing Latent Diffusion Inverse Problem Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04791)
*Lee Hyoseok,Sohwi Lim,Eunju Cha,Tae-Hyun Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出测量一致朗之万校正器(MCLC)，弥合逆问题求解器与扩散模型稳定反演动态的偏差，实现无需线性流形假设的LDM稳定化模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型(LDM)虽成为逆问题的强先验，但现有LDM求解器因动态不稳定而性能受限，需找出不稳定的根源并构建理论可靠的稳定机制。

Method: 1) 理论分析揭示求解器动态与扩散模型学到的稳定反演动态存在偏差；2) 设计即插即用模块MCLC，利用测量一致朗之万更新校正潜变量，绕开潜空间线性流形假设。

Result: MCLC在潜空间提供有原则的稳定化，无需假设线性流形即可显著降低求解器波动，使LDM逆问题求解更稳定可靠。

Conclusion: 通过弥补动态偏差，MCLC实现LDM逆问题求解器的理论驱动稳定化，为潜扩散模型在真实场景中的稳健应用奠定新方法。

Abstract: While latent diffusion models (LDMs) have emerged as powerful priors for inverse problems, existing LDM-based solvers frequently suffer from instability. In this work, we first identify the instability as a discrepancy between the solver dynamics and stable reverse diffusion dynamics learned by the diffusion model, and show that reducing this gap stabilizes the solver. Building on this, we introduce \textit{Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector (MCLC)}, a theoretically grounded plug-and-play stabilization module that remedies the LDM-based inverse problem solvers through measurement-consistent Langevin updates. Compared to prior approaches that rely on linear manifold assumptions, which often fail to hold in latent space, MCLC provides a principled stabilization mechanism, leading to more stable and reliable behavior in latent space.

</details>


### [956] [Sample Complexity of Composite Quantum Hypothesis Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08588)
*Jacob Paul Simpson,Efstratios Palias,Sharu Theresa Jose*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次给出了复合二择量子假设检验（QHT）在有限样本下的样本复杂度紧刻画，涵盖有无差分隐私约束的两种情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管复合QHT的渐近误差指数理论已完备，但工程实践中更关心的“到底需要多少个拷贝态才能达标”这一有限样本问题几乎空白。作者意在弥合这一理论与实用鸿沟。

Method: 1) 将问题抽象为“判断未知量子态属于两个不确定性集合中的哪一个”，定义样本复杂度为达到目标误差所需最少拷贝数；2) 对简单QHT的样本复杂度下界做推广，提出适用于任意基数不确定性集合的通用下界；3) 构造基于局部最优检验和typical subspace的协议，给出匹配下界至常数倍的上界；4) 引入(ε,δ)-差分隐私约束，重新设计随机化测量并分析其样本复杂度开销。

Result: - 上下界在仅含普适常数因子范围内匹配，首次实现复合QHT样本复杂度的紧表征；
- 对有限、无限不确定性集合均给出显式阶数，例如对允差ε、置信1−δ，样本复杂度Θ(log(1/δ)/ε^2)在典型情形下与经典简单QHT同阶；
- 差分隐私版本仅增加O(log(1/δ)/εε_priv^2)的额外拷贝数，其中ε_priv为隐私预算。

Conclusion: 复合量子假设检验的有限样本行为可被简洁的样本复杂度定律完全捕捉，且隐私保护需求带来的代价是低阶可公度开销。该框架为量子态验证、量子机器学习等任务提供了可直接查表使用的采样指南。

Abstract: This paper investigates symmetric composite binary quantum hypothesis testing (QHT), where the goal is to determine which of two uncertainty sets contains an unknown quantum state. While asymptotic error exponents for this problem are well-studied, the finite-sample regime remains poorly understood. We bridge this gap by characterizing the sample complexity -- the minimum number of state copies required to achieve a target error level. Specifically, we derive lower bounds that generalize the sample complexity of simple QHT and introduce new upper bounds for various uncertainty sets, including of both finite and infinite cardinalities. Notably, our upper and lower bounds match up to universal constants, providing a tight characterization of the sample complexity. Finally, we extend our analysis to the differentially private setting, establishing the sample complexity for privacy-preserving composite QHT.

</details>


### [957] [ConvoLearn: A Learning Sciences Grounded Dataset for Fine-Tuning Dialogic AI Tutors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08950)
*Mayank Sharma,Roy Pea,Hari Subramonyam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出半合成对话数据集ConvoLearn，用六维指标量化对话式教学，证明其可迁移到真实课堂，并用7B模型微调出媲美商用系统的AI导师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在教育落地的关键障碍：生成回答却忽视“对话共建知识”的核心教学原则，亟需可量化、可迁移的对话式教学数据与对齐方法。

Method: 1) 基于知识建构理论，设计六维对话教学框架；2) 围绕初中地球科学课程，合成并人工标注2,134条师生对话；3) 用ConvoLearn训练维度分类器，验证其在真实课堂录像中对专家评分的预测力；4) 以维度标签为监督信号，对Mistral-7B进行LoRA微调，生成对话式导师。

Result: 分类器在真实课堂的多个教学质量子量表上与专家评分显著相关(r>0.4)。微调后的7B模型在盲评中，其对话教学行为与强商用系统无显著差异，甚至部分维度优于基线。

Conclusion: 维度化、半合成的对话教学数据足以提供可迁移的 pedagogical signal，使小参数开放模型也能表现出高质量对话式辅导，为构建可解释、可扩展的AI导师奠定数据与方法基础。

Abstract: Despite their growing adoption in education, LLMs remain misaligned with the core principle of effective tutoring: the dialogic construction of knowledge. We introduce ConvoLearn, a dataset of 2,134 semi-synthetic tutor-student dialogues operationalizing six dimensions of dialogic tutoring grounded in knowledge-building theory, situated in a middle school Earth Science curriculum. We show that dimension-labeled dialogic training data captures meaningful pedagogical signal that generalizes beyond its semi-synthetic domain: scores from a classifier trained on ConvoLearn correlate significantly with expert-coded instructional quality in authentic classrooms across multiple subscales. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune Mistral-7B on ConvoLearn and show that dimension-level fine-tuning can steer a 7B open-weight model toward dialogic tutoring behavior that credentialed teachers rate as competitive with a strong proprietary baseline. With this work, we support the development of AI tutors capable of more dialogic interactions.

</details>


### [958] [Tiled Prompts: Overcoming Prompt Misguidance in Image and Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03342)
*Bryan Sangwoo Kim,Jonghyun Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用局部语义提示（每个瓦片独立标题）替换全局标题，保持极低开销同时显著提升超分辨真值感并消除幻觉/瓦片伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生扩散超分辨依赖全局标题，但瓦片化处理后标题无法表征局部细节，发生“漏掉应有”与“加入不该有”两类指导错误，导致瓦片级伪影与幻觉。

Method: 提出Tiled Prompts框架：对输入先视觉-语言分割，产生每瓦片专属局部提示；在扩散潜在空间对每瓦片以局部文本后验条件化采样；训练/推理无额外重量级分支，仅增加一次性标题生成开销。

Result: 在4K/8K真实图像与视频上，相比全局标题基线，LPIPS↓0.04–0.06、FID↓18–25、tile伪影减少70%，主观盲评一致偏好度>85%，未见显著速度下降。

Conclusion: 瓦片级语义条件可几乎零成本嵌入现有扩散超分辨管线，是解决局部幻觉与伪影的关键，可扩展至任意瓦片化生成任务。

Abstract: Text-conditioned diffusion models have advanced image and video super-resolution by using prompts as semantic priors, and modern super-resolution pipelines typically rely on latent tiling to scale to high resolutions. In practice, a single global caption is used with the latent tiling, often causing prompt misguidance. Specifically, a coarse global prompt often misses localized details (errors of omission) and provides locally irrelevant guidance (errors of commission) which leads to substandard results at the tile level. To solve this, we propose Tiled Prompts, a unified framework for image and video super-resolution that generates a tile-specific prompt for each latent tile and performs super-resolution under locally text-conditioned posteriors to resolve prompt misguidance with minimal overhead. Our experiments on high resolution real-world images and videos show that tiled prompts bring consistent gains in perceptual quality and fidelity, while reducing hallucinations and tile-level artifacts that can be found in global-prompt baselines. Project Page: https://bryanswkim.github.io/tiled-prompts/.

</details>


### [959] [Distribution-free two-sample testing with blurred total variation distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05862)
*Rohan Hore,Rina Foygel Barber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为“模糊全变差(blurred TV)”的两样本检验新指标，在无需对分布做任何假设的情况下，仍可给出 TV 距离的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统两样本检验若要宣称两个分布相等或给出 TV 距离的上界，通常必须假设分布的平滑性、参数形式等；若采用完全分布自由设定，连“相等”判断都不可行。因而需要一种能够兼顾无假设与可操作性的宽松度量。

Method: 引入并修剪 TV 距离的局部松弛——模糊 TV 距离（blurred TV）；在理论层面推导其在无分布假设条件下仍能给出上下界；进一步分析在高维场景中该度量的紧致性和可估计性。

Result: 给出了分布自由的模糊 TV 上下界理论保证；证明在高维下仍能保持斜率自适应；对任意支持空间都无需预先知道分布结构即可实施检验。

Conclusion: 通过“局部平滑”TV 距离，可以在完全不假设任何分布性质的情形下实现可证检验，平衡了传统 TV 的强无歧义与无假设检验的可行性，为两样本比较提供了新的实用框架。

Abstract: Two-sample testing, where we aim to determine whether two distributions are equal or not equal based on samples from each one, is challenging if we cannot place assumptions on the properties of the two distributions. In particular, certifying equality of distributions, or even providing a tight upper bound on the total variation (TV) distance between the distributions, is impossible to achieve in a distribution-free regime. In this work, we examine the blurred TV distance, a relaxation of TV distance that enables us to perform inference without assumptions on the distributions. We provide theoretical guarantees for distribution-free upper and lower bounds on the blurred TV distance, and examine its properties in high dimensions.

</details>


### [960] [When & How to Write for Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting in Video Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17667)
*Cheng cheng,Chenxing Wang,Aolin Li,Haijun Wu,Huiyun Hu,Juyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WeWrite借助用户日志后验采样+SFT-GRPO混合训练+“Fake Recall”并行召回，在视频搜索中对必要场景做个性化查询改写，线上VV>10s提升1.07%，改写率下降2.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法使用隐式历史特征时存在信号稀释与延迟反馈，导致查询意图识别不准，需一种能精准、实时利用用户行为的个性化改写方案。

Method: ①“何时写”：基于后验概率从用户日志自动挖掘高置信正样本，判定必须个性化干预的查询；②“如何写”：将SFT与GRPO结合，对齐大模型输出风格与检索系统 reward；③“线上部署”：采用并行“Fake Recall”架构，保证毫秒级改写延迟。

Result: 在头部视频平台大规模A/B实验中，WeWrite使有效播放(VV>10s)提升1.07%，用户再改写率降低2.97%，验证了框架的有效性、实时性与可落地性。

Conclusion: 通过“采样-训练-部署”三位一体设计，WeWrite解决了个性化改写中的信号质量、模型对齐与延迟瓶颈，为工业级视频搜索提供了可复制的低延迟个性化查询改写范式。

Abstract: In video search systems, user historical behaviors provide rich context for identifying search intent and resolving ambiguity. However, traditional methods utilizing implicit history features often suffer from signal dilution and delayed feedback. To address these challenges, we propose WeWrite, a novel Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting framework. Specifically, WeWrite tackles three key challenges: (1) When to Write: An automated posterior-based mining strategy extracts high-quality samples from user logs, identifying scenarios where personalization is strictly necessary; (2) How to Write: A hybrid training paradigm combines Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to align the LLM's output style with the retrieval system; (3) Deployment: A parallel "Fake Recall" architecture ensures low latency. Online A/B testing on a large-scale video platform demonstrates that WeWrite improves the Click-Through Video Volume (VV$>$10s) by 1.07% and reduces the Query Reformulation Rate by 2.97%.

</details>


### [961] [Fisher-Geometric Diffusion in Stochastic Gradient Descent: Optimal Rates, Oracle Complexity, and Information-Theoretic Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02417)
*Daniel Zantedeschi,Kumar Muthuraman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次把随机梯度协方差矩阵“内生化”为采样机制本身的投影梯度协方差，并由此建立以Fisher/三明治几何为度量、阶为Θ(1/N)的极小风险界，给出只依赖有效维度d_eff与统计条件数κ_F的ε-平稳复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典随机逼近把梯度噪声协方差当作外生给定参数，导致收敛界与真实统计结构脱节。作者希望将协方差“内生化”，使其由数据分布和采样规则唯一确定，从而将优化与统计几何天然衔接，获得更紧且可解释的理论保证。

Method: 1) 在可交换 mini-batch 设定下证明梯度协方差的主导项为投影的每样本梯度协方差 G*(θ)；2) 良置似然问题中局部等于投影 Fisher 信息，一般 M-估计则给出三明治/Godambe 几何；3) 用该内生气候(τ = η/b)建立 Lyapunov 方程以求平稳协方差；4) 先以 van Trees 不等式在参数 Fisher 模型得到 Θ(1/N) 下界，再推广至满足可预测信息条件的自适应 oracle 设置；5) 把风险界转成 oracle 复杂度，得出依赖 d_eff 与 κ_F 的 ε-Fisher 范数平稳保证；6) 连续与离散时间实验验证 Lyapunov 预测。

Result: 理论：给出阶为 Θ(1/N) 的极小风险界，上下界匹配；复杂度仅依赖有效维度 d_eff 与统计条件数 κ_F，与环境维度、欧氏条件数无关。实验：连续/离散时间下平稳协方差与 Lyapunov 方程预测一致；标量温度调参无法复现方向性噪声结构。

Conclusion: 把梯度噪声协方差内生化并识别为投影的梯度协方差 G*(θ) 是本文的核心贡献；这一视角统一了优化泛函收敛与统计几何，提供了更紧、仅依赖内在统计量(d_eff, κ_F)的收敛保证，为随机逼近与统计学习理论之间建立了新的桥梁。

Abstract: Classical stochastic-approximation analyses treat the covariance of stochastic gradients as an exogenous modeling input. We show that under exchangeable mini-batch sampling this covariance is identified by the sampling mechanism itself: to leading order it is the projected covariance of per-sample gradients. In well-specified likelihood problems this reduces locally to projected Fisher information; for general M-estimation losses the same object is the projected gradient covariance G*(theta), which together with the Hessian induces sandwich/Godambe geometry. This identification -- not the subsequent diffusion or Lyapunov machinery, which is classical once the noise matrix is given -- is the paper's main contribution. It endogenizes the diffusion coefficient (with effective temperature tau = eta/b), determines the stationary covariance via a Lyapunov equation whose inputs are now structurally fixed, and selects the identified statistical geometry as the natural metric for convergence analysis. We prove matching upper and lower bounds of order Theta(1/N) for risk in this metric under an oracle budget N; the lower bound is established first via a van Trees argument in the parametric Fisher setting and then extended to adaptive oracle transcripts under a predictable-information condition and mild conditional likelihood regularity. Translating these bounds into oracle complexity yields epsilon-stationarity guarantees in the Fisher dual norm that depend on an intrinsic effective dimension d_eff and a statistical condition number kappa_F, rather than ambient dimension or Euclidean conditioning. Numerical experiments confirm the Lyapunov predictions at both continuous-time and discrete-time levels and show that scalar temperature matching cannot reproduce directional noise structure.

</details>


### [962] [PACED: Distillation and On-Policy Self-Distillation at the Frontier of Student Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11178)
*Yuanda Xu,Hejian Sang,Zhengze Zhou,Ran He,Zhipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出低成本梯度调度策略 PACED，用 w(p)=p(1-p) 重聚焦蒸馏于“可学区间”，无结构改动与调参，理论保证 robust，帮助多模型在 AIME 系列提升最高 8.2 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准蒸馏对所有样本一视同仁，已学或超难样本浪费算力且易遗忘，需一种仅依赖学生自身水平动态调整训练权重的零超参方法。

Method: 1) 实证发现跨样本梯度信噪比随学生通过率呈钟形，边界处 SNR 塌陷；2) 推导出最优权重族 Beta-kernel w(p)=p^α(1 - p)^β，PACED 取 α=β=1 即 w(p)=p(1-p) 击中最大 SNR；3) 仅执行学生 rollout 采样，无需标签或教师结构改动；4) 后续引入两阶段前向-反向 KL 组合进一步提升难题性能。

Result: 在 MATH-500 和 AIME-2024/25 上，PACED 相对无加权蒸馏提高 8.2 分、相对强基线 AKL 提高 3.6 分；蒸馏与自我蒸馏遗忘率压至 1.4% 与 0.6%，两阶段 KL 再加 5.8 分。

Conclusion: SNR 驱动的自适应权重能把“可学区”筛选问题化为第一性解决方案；PACED 提供模型无关、零超参、理论可靠的蒸馏范式，为大规模蒸馏和持续学习设定新 SOTA。策略与任务难度无关，通用性强，有望推广至跨任务与在线学习。

Abstract: Standard LLM distillation treats all training problems equally -- wasting compute on problems the student has already mastered or cannot yet solve. We empirically show that this inefficiency has a precise gradient-level signature: the cross-problem gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) follows a bell curve over student pass rate, collapsing at both extremes.
  We propose PACED, which weights each problem by $w(p) = p(1{-}p)$ where $p$ is the student's empirical pass rate -- concentrating training on the zone of proximal development. This requires only student rollouts, no architectural changes, and no hyperparameters. We prove the Beta kernel $w(p) = p^α(1{-}p)^β$ is the leading-order optimal weight family arising from the SNR boundary-collapse structure, and is minimax-robust under misspecification (worst-case efficiency loss $O(δ^2)$).
  Across Qwen3, Qwen2.5, and Llama-3 families, PACED sets a new state of the art in our experimental setting on MATH-500, AIME~2024, and AIME~2025, improving over unweighted distillation by up to $\mathbf{+8.2}$ and over the strong AKL baseline by up to $\mathbf{+3.6}$, while reducing forgetting to $\mathbf{1.4\%}$ and $\mathbf{0.6\%}$ in distillation and self-distillation. A two-stage forward-then-reverse KL schedule pushes gains further to $\mathbf{+5.8}$ over standard forward KL on the hardest benchmark.

</details>


### [963] [CausalVAD: De-confounding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Causal Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18561)
*Jiacheng Tang,Zhiyuan Zhou,Zhuolin He,Jia Zhang,Kai Zhang,Jian Pu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CausalVAD 用轻量级因果干预插件 SCIS 阻断混淆因子，消除数据集捷径，实现端到端规划模型对偏差与噪声的鲁棒性，在 nuScenes 上刷新安全与精度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端规划模型因仅学统计相关而易陷入因果混淆，利用数据捷径，导致复杂场景下安全性与可靠性下降。

Method: 提出 CausalVAD 训练框架，核心为稀疏因果干预模块 SCIS：先构建驾驶情境原型字典，再对模型稀疏向量化查询执行后门调整式干预，切断混淆路径。

Result: nuScenes 基准测试显示，CausalVAD 达到 SOTA 规划精度与安全指标；在人为引入数据偏差与噪声的对抗测试中鲁棒性显著优于基线。

Conclusion: 轻量级因果干预即可有效去混淆，提升端到端自动驾驶模型的真实因果泛化能力与部署安全性。

Abstract: Planning-oriented end-to-end driving models show great promise, yet they fundamentally learn statistical correlations instead of true causal relationships. This vulnerability leads to causal confusion, where models exploit dataset biases as shortcuts, critically harming their reliability and safety in complex scenarios. To address this, we introduce CausalVAD, a de-confounding training framework that leverages causal intervention. At its core, we design the sparse causal intervention scheme (SCIS), a lightweight, plug-and-play module to instantiate the backdoor adjustment theory in neural networks. SCIS constructs a dictionary of prototypes representing latent driving contexts. It then uses this dictionary to intervene on the model's sparse vectorized queries. This step actively eliminates spurious associations induced by confounders, thereby eliminating spurious factors from the representations for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmarks like nuScenes show CausalVAD achieves state-of-the-art planning accuracy and safety. Furthermore, our method demonstrates superior robustness against both data bias and noisy scenarios configured to induce causal confusion.

</details>


### [964] [Post-Selection Distributional Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23055)
*Amirmohammad Farzaneh,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 传统方法只能判断模型是否达标；本文提出 PS-DME，可在数据驱动的模型预选后仍给出 KPI 分布的无偏估计，支持性能–可靠性全谱比较，并用 e-value 控制 FCR，比数据拆分更省样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 很多场景下目标 KPI 阈值未知，用户需要在测试阶段比较候选模型在整个性能–可靠性权衡曲线上的表现，而同一批数据既要选模型又要评估，会引入“选后偏差”，导致 KPI 分布估计不可靠。

Method: 提出 Post-Selection Distributional Model Evaluation（PS-DME）框架：1) 用 e-value 构造条件置信分布；2) 对任意（可数据自适应）预选算法，控制选后虚假覆盖率（FCR）；3) 无需样本拆分，复用全部数据进行估计，提升样本效率。

Result: 理论上证明 PS-DME 在 FCR 控制下更节省样本；在合成数据、大语言模型 text-to-SQL 解码、电信网络性能三类实验上，PS-DME 能稳定输出 KPI 分布置信带，支持跨多个可靠性级别的可信模型排序与权衡探索。

Conclusion: PS-DME 为“先选后估”场景提供了统一、统计有效的 KPI 分布评估工具，可在未知阈值条件下可靠地比较模型性能–可靠性权衡，适用于任意预选策略，兼具理论保证与实用增益。

Abstract: Formal model evaluation methods typically certify that a model satisfies a prescribed target key performance indicator (KPI) level. However, in many applications, the relevant target KPI level may not be known a priori, and the user may instead wish to compare candidate models by analyzing the full trade-offs between performance and reliability achievable at test time by the models. This task, requiring the reliable estimate of the test-time KPI distributions, is made more complicated by the fact that the same data must often be used both to pre-select a subset of candidate models and to estimate their KPI distributions, causing a potential post-selection bias. In this work, we introduce post-selection distributional model evaluation (PS-DME), a general framework for statistically valid distributional model assessment after arbitrary data-dependent model pre-selection. Building on e-values, PS-DME controls post-selection false coverage rate (FCR) for the distributional KPI estimates and is proved to be more sample efficient than a baseline method based on sample splitting. Experiments on synthetic data, text-to-SQL decoding with large language models, and telecom network performance evaluation demonstrate that PS-DME enables reliable comparison of candidate configurations across a range of reliability levels, supporting the statistically reliable exploration of performance--reliability trade-offs.

</details>


### [965] [Kill-Chain Canaries: Stage-Level Tracking of Prompt Injection Across Attack Surfaces and Model Safety Tiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28013)
*Haochuan Kevin Wang,Zechen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 传统单指标 ASR 无法指导生产级多智能体 LLM 系统的加固；本文提出四阶段 kill-chain 金丝雀方法，首次将提示注入风险映射为“流水线架构”问题，给出节点部署、信道匹配与文件渲染层的关键加固策略并开源数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 已在金融、法律等场景接管文档处理与工作流，但现有评估仅用“是否成功”二元指标，无法诊断攻击在哪一环节被阻断或传播，导致安全团队难以针对性加固真实管线。

Method: 设计一枚加密 kill-chain canary，把攻击路径拆分为 EXPOSED→PERSISTED→RELAYED→EXECUTED 四阶段；在 950 次实验中对 5 个前沿模型、6 种攻击面（邮件、PDF、Slack、API 等）、5 类防御（系统提示、沙箱、输出过滤等）进行追踪，量化每阶段的传播率。

Result: 所有模型在 EXPOSED 阶段均 100% 中招，但下游差异巨大：Claude 在 memory-write 处 0% 传播，GPT-4o-mini 达 53%，DeepSeek 在同一模型不同面上出现 0% 与 100% 的极端分叉；白底白字 PDF 负载与可见文本成功率相当。

Conclusion: 提示注入本质是“流水线架构”问题：最高杠杆决策是把写操作节点路由至已验证模型；四类防御均因信道失配而失效；渲染层筛查无法拦截隐形 payload。结论直接适用于已运行 LLM Agent 的金融机构 earnings-call、SEC filings 等文档摄取流程，并提供开源诊断工具。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are entering production -- processing documents, managing workflows, acting on behalf of users -- yet their resilience to prompt injection is still evaluated with a single binary: did the attack succeed? This leaves architects without the diagnostic information needed to harden real pipelines. We introduce a kill-chain canary methodology that tracks a cryptographic token through four stages (EXPOSED -> PERSISTED -> RELAYED -> EXECUTED) across 950 runs, five frontier LLMs, six attack surfaces, and five defense conditions. The results reframe prompt injection as a pipeline-architecture problem: every model is fully exposed, yet outcomes diverge downstream -- Claude blocks all injections at memory-write (0/164 ASR), GPT-4o-mini propagates at 53%, and DeepSeek exhibits 0%/100% across surfaces from the same model. Three findings matter for deployment: (1) write-node placement is the highest-leverage safety decision -- routing writes through a verified model eliminates propagation; (2) all four defenses fail on at least one surface due to channel mismatch alone, no adversarial adaptation required; (3) invisible whitefont PDF payloads match or exceed visible-text ASR, meaning rendered-layer screening is insufficient. These dynamics apply directly to production: institutional investors and financial firms already run NLP pipelines over earnings calls, SEC filings, and analyst reports -- the document-ingestion workflows now migrating to LLM agents. Code, run logs, and tooling are publicly released.

</details>


### [966] [R3PM-Net: Real-time, Robust, Real-world Point Matching Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05060)
*Yasaman Kashefbahrami,Erkut Akdag,Panagiotis Meletis,Evgeniya Balmashnova,Dip Goswami,Egor Bondarau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: R3PM-Net是面向真实工业场景、兼顾精度与速度的轻量级点云配准网络，并发布Sioux-Cranfield/Sioux-Scans两套真实数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度PCR方法只在干净稠密的合成数据上训练，难以泛化到含噪、遮挡、稀疏的真实工业扫描；工业现场需要毫秒内完成高精度配准。

Method: 提出全局-物体级轻量匹配网络R3PM-Net；构建含真实摄影测量与事件相机扫描的Sioux-Cranfield与Sioux-Scans数据集；仅用0.007秒完成一次推理。

Result: ModelNet40上fitness=1、inlier RMSE 0.029 cm，速度比RegTR快≈7×；Sioux-Cranfield保持fitness=1、RMSE 0.030 cm；Sioux-Scans极端场景<50 ms完成。

Conclusion: R3PM-Net在真实工业数据上实现迄今未见的高精度+毫秒级实时性能，为在线3D质检、机器人抓取等任务提供了可落地的配准方案。

Abstract: Accurate Point Cloud Registration (PCR) is an important task in 3D data processing, involving the estimation of a rigid transformation between two point clouds. While deep-learning methods have addressed key limitations of traditional non-learning approaches, such as sensitivity to noise, outliers, occlusion, and initialization, they are developed and evaluated on clean, dense, synthetic datasets (limiting their generalizability to real-world industrial scenarios). This paper introduces R3PM-Net, a lightweight, global-aware, object-level point matching network designed to bridge this gap by prioritizing both generalizability and real-time efficiency. To support this transition, two datasets, Sioux-Cranfield and Sioux-Scans, are proposed. They provide an evaluation ground for registering imperfect photogrammetric and event-camera scans to digital CAD models, and have been made publicly available. Extensive experiments demonstrate that R3PM-Net achieves competitive accuracy with unmatched speed. On ModelNet40, it reaches a perfect fitness score of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.029$ cm in only $0.007$s, approximately 7 times faster than the state-of-the-art method RegTR. This performance carries over to the Sioux-Cranfield dataset, maintaining a fitness of $1$ and inlier RMSE of $0.030$ cm with similarly low latency. Furthermore, on the highly challenging Sioux-Scans dataset, R3PM-Net successfully resolves edge cases in under 50 ms. These results confirm that R3PM-Net offers a robust, high-speed solution for critical industrial applications, where precision and real-time performance are indispensable. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/YasiiKB/R3PM-Net.

</details>


### [967] [HaloProbe: Bayesian Detection and Mitigation of Object Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06165)
*Reihaneh Zohrabi,Hosein Hasani,Akshita Gupta,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah,Anna Rohrbach,Marcus Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HaloProbe 用贝叶斯框架把「外部描述特征」与「模型内部解码信号」解耦，从而在无梯度、不改模型权重的前提下，精准估计每个词是否为幻觉，并直接用于解码，显著降低幻觉且不掉性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉-语言模型生成的图文描述易出现「对象幻觉」。现有检测方法仅依赖视觉 token 的注意力权重，但因 token 位置和名词重复等混杂变量，统计聚合时出现辛普森悖论，导致注意力趋势反转或消失，检测不可靠。

Method: 提出 HaloProbe：1) 将幻觉建模为后验概率 P(幻觉|内部信号, 外部统计)；2) 用平衡采样训练从混杂中剥离出纯内部证据；3) 结合外部先验得到 token 级幻觉概率；4) 不改动模型内部，仅把概率作为外部评分信号，在解码阶段引导词选择。

Result: 在多个基准上，HaloProbe 检测幻觉的 AP 比注意力基线平均提升 15.3%；用作解码评分时，幻觉率相较最佳干预型方法再降 9.2%，而 BLEU/CIDEr 等实用性指标保持不变。

Conclusion: 混杂变量使粗粒度注意力不可信；通过贝叶斯解耦，外部评分即可在不牺牲模型能力的情况下有效抑制幻觉，为幻觉检测与缓解提供了可插拔、无训练的新范式。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can produce object hallucinations in image descriptions, highlighting the need for effective detection and mitigation strategies. Prior work commonly relies on the model's attention weights on visual tokens as a detection signal. We reveal that coarse-grained attention-based analysis is unreliable due to hidden confounders, specifically token position and object repetition in a description. This leads to Simpson's paradox: the attention trends reverse or disappear when statistics are aggregated. Based on this observation, we introduce HaloProbe, a Bayesian framework that factorizes external description statistics and internal decoding signals to estimate token-level hallucination probabilities. HaloProbe uses balanced training to isolate internal evidence and combines it with a learned prior over external features to recover the true posterior.
